title: Highway Dhaba Chicken Curry
cooking_instructions: Grind the tomatoes into a purée.
Heat up oil and add the whole spices (cinnamon, cloves, green cardamom and black cardamom).
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are golden brown.

To the golden brown onions, add ginger garlic paste, slit green chillies, all the spice powders and salt. Saute for 20 seconds. To this, add tomato puree. Cook for 5 minutes, adding water if necessary.
Add the chicken pieces to this and saute for 2 minutes.
Add water to this and cover it with a lid. Cook it on low flame for 20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, the oil should be floating on the top or around the edges. This is a sign that the masalas have been cooked. Taste and adjust the salt.
Add chopped coriander leaves and crushed Kasuri Methi leaves to the chicken curry. Remove from the heat.
In another pan, heat up ghee and add chopped ginger to it. Add the chilli powder and turn off the flame. Add this to the chicken curry.

title: Egg Drop Curry
cooking_instructions: Grind 2 tomatoes in a mixer grinder to make tomato puree.
In a pan, heat 2 tbsp of oil. Then add the cumin seeds, once the cumin seeds start to splutter, add the chopped onions and saute for 3 mins or until it turns golden brown.
Add green chilli and add ginger-garlic paste and saute for a minute.
Add finely chopped tomatoes and saute till the tomatoes turn mushy.
Add tomato puree and cook for 2 mins.
Add the powdered spices - red chilli powder, turmeric powder, garam masala powder.
Add crushed Kasuri methi.
Reduce the flame to medium and break the eggs one by one to the pan.
Cover and cook for 5 mins. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot with rice or roti.

title: Bengali Fish Curry
cooking_instructions: Marinate the fish in salt and turmeric powder.
Make a paste of 2 tomatoes, strain and set aside.
Make a fine paste of 1 onion.
Fry the potato slices in the oil until golden brown and set aside.
Fry the fish in oil for 3 minutes and set aside.
Add mustard oil and 1 sliced onions and the slit green chillies. Saute for a minute and add the onion paste of 1 onion. Saute for 3 mins.
Add the tomato puree and simmer for 4 minutes. Add the powdered spices and salt, and continue to saute.
Add the potatoes, a cup of water and boil for 5 minutes.
Add the fish and cook for 2 minutes. Serve with rice.

title: Mutton Uppu Kari
cooking_instructions: Heat gingelly oil in a pressure cooker. On high heat, add the mutton pieces and saute for a few minutes until the colour starts to change and brown lightly.
Add all the other ingredients. Cover and pressure cook for 20 minutes on medium heat. Once pressure is released, open the cooker.
In a pestle and mortar, crush the garlic. Remove the stems from the dry red chillies.
In a pan, heat gingelly oil and add fennel seeds, cinnamon, dry red chilli and curry leaves. Once it turns aromatic, add the garlic and shallots. Saute until the shallots start to change colour.
Add the tomato and cook for 3-4 minutes, until it softens.

Add the cooked mutton and cook for 10 minutes or until the excess water dries up, stirring at regular intervals. Finish with black pepper powder and a sprinkling of curry leaves. The dish is ready to serve!

title: Dynamite Prawns
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, mix together the ingredients for the sauce. Set aside.
In another bowl, combine the prawns, soy sauce, black pepper powder and egg.
In another bowl, mix together the maida, cornflour, pepper and salt. Add the prawns to the flour individually and coat well. Once coated, dust off the excess flour and move it to another plate.
Heat up oil for shallow frying. Add the prawns to the pan without overcrowding the oil. Fry for 2 minutes on each side, or until it turns crispy. Remove it into a bowl.
Add the sauce to it and mix to coat the fried prawns with the sauce.
To serve, place lettuce leaves in a cocktail glass (or alternatively, in a plate). Fill with the dynamite prawns and sprinkle chopped spring onions on top.

title: Thattukada Chicken Fry
cooking_instructions: Make shallow slits on the large pieces of chicken.
Add all the ingredients for the marination to the chicken. Mix well and rest for 10 minutes.
In a pan, heat coconut oil. On medium heat, fry the chicken for 10 minutes.
Just before removing the chicken from the oil, add curry leaves and slit green chilli. Fry for a minute and remove from the oil. Serve as an appetizer.

title: Spicy Masala Fried egg
cooking_instructions: Cut the boiled Eggs into halves and keep it aside
In a bowl add maida and the remaining ingredients, add water and whisk it till it becomes a smooth thick batter.
Dip the eggs in batter, coat it well and coat it with panko crumbs.
Heat oil in a pan, deep fry the crumbed eggs. Serve it hot with ketchup or mayonnaise.

title: Kerala Sardine Fish Fry
cooking_instructions: In a bowl/plate, mix together the spice powders, salt and ginger garlic paste. Add a few drops of water and mix it into a thick paste.
Make slits on the fish. Mix it carefully with the prepared marination. Rest for at least 20 minutes at room temperature. You can store it for longer in the fridge.

Heat up a flat frying pan with coconut oil. Spread a layer of curry leaves on the bottom. This will prevent sticking. Place the fish pieces in the pan on medium-high heat. Do not overcrowd the pan. Cook for 3 minutes, until the bottom side starts to turn crisp. Flip the fish pieces and cook for another 4 minutes until fully crisp. Serve as a starter or with rice.

title: Fried Chicken Sandwich
cooking_instructions: Wash and slice the chicken into slices lengthwise. Marinate it with softened butter, salt. Pepper, and lemon juice.
In another plate, add maida, season it with salt and pepper. Add some chopped parsley to it and mix it well.
Heat oil in a pan, fry it on both sides till it turns golden brown. Cook it all the way through. Optionally, you can grill it in the pan with olive oil.
To assemble the sandwich, apply mayonnaise on bread, place lettuce, tomato, the cooked chicken. Place 2 slices of cheese over it.
Toast it in the griller till the bread is golden brown and has grill marks. Transfer it to a plate, Garnish it with chopped parsley, capers and olives. Serve it hot.

title: Hyderabadi Chicken 65
cooking_instructions: To the chicken, add all the ingredients for the marination. Mix it together and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes. You can keep it for up to overnight.
After the marination, add the cornflour, maida and egg for the 2nd marination. Mix just until combined.

Heat oil for deep-frying. Fry the chicken on medium-high heat until crisp and cooked inside, around 6-8 minutes. Remove from the oil and set aside. In another pan, heat oil and add garlic, ginger, green chilli and curry leaves. Saute for 30 seconds.
On low heat, add the red chilli powder and mix. Once mixed, add the beaten curd and mix again.
Add the fried chicken and mix on high heat until evenly coated. Finish with some coriander leaves. Serve hot as an appetizer or even as a side to biryani.

title: Chicken Cutlet
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add the garlic, green chilli and let it crackle.
Add the chopped onions and cook till it turns light brown.
Add the chilli and cumin powder. Add water, mix it well and let the masala cook for a minute. Turn off the flame and let it cool down a little.
In a bowl, add minced chicken, mashed potatoes and the sauteed masala.

Add the chopped coriander leaves, ½ cup bread crumbs, salt and pepper powder. Mix it well till it binds well and all the ingredients combine evenly. Divider the mixture into even sized balls and press them into patties
In a bowl beat eggs and in another bowl add bread crumbs. Coat the patties in the egg first and then the bread crumbs.
Heat oil in a pan, deep fry the patties on a medium flame to a golden brown colour. Serve it hot with ketchup or a dip of your choice.

title: Vegetable Salna
cooking_instructions:
Soak the cashew and poppy seeds in hot water for 10 minutes. 
 Grind it to a fine paste along with grated coconut. Set aside.
In a pressure cooker, heat oil and add the whole spices, followed by the onion and curry leaves. Saute for 2 minutes.
Add the ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute, followed by the tomato and mint leaves. Mix and add the powdered spices and salt.
Add the potato, carrot, beans and cauliflower. Mix and add lemon juice and the coconut paste. Give it a stir and then add water.
Cover and pressure cook for 2 whistles on high heat. Once the pressure has settled, serve it garnished with some coriander leaves. Serve with parotta or chapathi.

title: No Yeast Tawa Pizza
cooking_instructions: Prepare a soft dough with maida, salt, sugar and water. Knead it well and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Divide the dough into equal sized balls. Roll it into a flat disc.
Heat a tawa, Cook one side on low heat.
Spread the pizza sauce. Add the cheese and toppings. Cover the pan and cook it till the cheese melts. Serve it hot.

title: Tawa Paneer
cooking_instructions: Marinate the paneer in the ingredients given for marination for 10 minutes.
Heat oil and add the onions, saute until golden brown.
Add the green chillies and ginger-garlic paste and saute for a minute. Add the tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add the diced capsicum and mix well. Add the powder spices and salt and mix well.
Add ¼ Cup of water and cook the masala for 3 minutes.
Add the marinated paneer and cook for 5 minutes until dry and the masala coats the paneer.
Finish with butter, chopped mint and coriander leaves.

title: Red Sauce Pasta
cooking_instructions: Make slits on the bottom of the tomatoes.
Bring a small pot of water to a boil. Add the tomatoes and cook for 30 seconds. Transfer the tomatoes to a bowl of ice cold water. Once it cools, peel the skin and then remove some of the seeds.
Blend the tomato into a coarse puree. Set aside.
Heat olive oil in a pan and add garlic and red chilli flakes. Saute for a minute. Add the tomato puree and mix.

Add the salt, sugar, pepper and mixed herbs. Add ketchup and mix. Simmer for 5 minutes, adding a splash of water if it gets too dry. Set the sauce aside. To cook the pasta, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Season with salt and add the pasta. Cook for 8 minutes or according to package instructions. Drain out the pasta, reserving some of the cooking water
Add the pasta to the sauce, along with enough water to make the sauce smooth. Add the fresh cream and mix. Serve it with a sprinkling of grated mozzarella cheese.

title: Easy Drunken Noodles
cooking_instructions: Boil the noodles in salted water. Strain it, mix it with oil and keep it aside.
Heat oil in a wok/pan, Add ginger, garlic, red chillies and saute for a few seconds.
Add the onion, julienned carrot and spinach leaves and saute till the spinach is cooked.

Add the noodles and toss it for a few seconds on a high flame. Add the soy sauce, vinegar, salt, brown sugar and spring onions. Toss it until all the ingredients combine evenly. Transfer it to a bowl. Garnish it with sesame seeds and fried garlic. Serve it hot.

title: Sambar Rice
cooking_instructions: Soak tamarind in hot water and keep it aside.

Wash and soak the rice and dal for 30 minutes. In a pressure cooker, add the soaked rice and dal. Add water and salt, mix it and let it cook for 4 whistles. Turn off the flame and let the steam reduce gradually.
Heat oil in a pan, add mustard, garlic, dry red chillies and curry leaves and let it crackle.
Add the shallots and saute till they turn translucent
Add the carrot, drumstick and saute for 2 minutes
Add sambar powder and mix it well for 2 minutes
Add water and mix it till the masala dissolves in the water. Add the brinjal and mix it well
Add the tamarind water and mix. Keep it aside.
Add the vegetable mixture to the cooked rice and dal, mix it till all the ingredients combine evenly.
Add ghee, mix it well. Serve it hot along with pickle and chips/vadams/appalam.

title: Salna Half Boil Puffs
cooking_instructions: In a tawa, heat oil and add the egg. Sprinkle salt and pepper on top. Cook for 30 seconds, then remove from the heat.
Split open the puffs (any flavour). Add salna, chopped onion, tomato and coriander leaves. Top it off with the half-boil egg. Serve hot.

title: Chilli Paneer Puffs
cooking_instructions: Mix all the sauce, salt and pepper together in a bowl.
In a pan, heat oil and add the paneer and onion. Cook for a minute, then add the sauces. Cook for 2 minutes until the sauce coat the paneer well. Turn off the heat.
Split open the puffs and add the cooked paneer. Garnish it with some spring onion greens and white sesame seeds.

title: Veg Goat Leg Soup
cooking_instructions: Clean the goat leg tuber by cutting off the outside skin until you get only the white tuber. Cut it into small pieces.
In a pot, heat gingelly oil and add the whole spices. Add the garlic and shallots. Saute for 2 minutes.
Add the curry leaves, tomato, rock salt, coriander leaves and turmeric powder. Saute for a minute.
Add the chopped tuber and mix. Add water and allow it to come to a boil. Cover and cook on low heat for 30 minutes.
Strain the soup for serving.
In a small pan, toast peppercorns and then crush them. Serve it mixed with the soup, and garnish with chopped coriander leaves.

title: Chilli Tofu
cooking_instructions: Cut the tofu into dices. Add it to a bowl. Mix it along with salt and maida until evenly coated.
Shallow fry it for around 2 minutes on each side or until it turns crisp on the outside. Remove from the oil and set aside.
Make the sauce mixture by combining all the ingredients together in a bowl. Set aside.
In another wok/pan, heat oil and add the ginger, garlic and dry red chilli. Saute until light golden brown.
Add the green chilli and spring onion whites. Saute for 30 seconds more.
Add the onion, capsicum, salt and black pepper powder. Toss on high heat for 1 minute.
Add the prepared sauce mixture and mix. Add the fried tofu and toss to combine. Garnish with chopped spring onion greens and serve hot.

title: Pichu Pota Kozhi Varuval
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add the chicken pieces and saute them until they are completely cooked
Shred the chicken with your hands.
Heat oil in another pan, add garlic, onions, turmeric powder and green chilli. Saute the onions till they turn translucent.
Add the shredded chicken and mix it till all the ingredients in the pan combine evenly.
Finally, add the eggs, salt and black pepper powder and mix till the eggs are scrambled and cooked. Garnish it with coriander leaves. Serve it hot.

title: Besan Paratha
cooking_instructions: Knead a smooth and semi-firm dough using the flour, salt and water. Rest for 10 mins.
Dry roast the besan for 4 mins on a medium flame. Transfer to a bowl.
Add the remaining ingredients and mix well with ghee to get a crumbly slightly moist mixture and set aside.

Stuff the dough with the besan mixture, by dividing the dough into roundels. Dust in flour and flatten a little with your fingertips. Place the mixture in the center and seal the edges by pinching together and dust in flour again and rest for 5 minutes.
Roll the roundels flat, gently.
Cook on a preheated tava on medium heat, applying ghee and till golden brown on both sides.

title: Nool Parotta
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl, add maida, salt, sugar and water. Combine the flour and mix it to form a dough. Knead the dough for 15 minutes by continuously folding the dough.
Add 1 tbsp of oil on dough and rest for 60 minutes.
Make individual 2-inch dough balls.
Add 2 tbsp of oil on the dough balls and rest for 30 minutes.

Take a dough ball and flatten as thin as possible by forming a large circle. Apply oil on the spread dough. Using a knife or a pizza cutter, cut the spread dough vertically with a 2mm gap between each cut.
Bring the dough together and form a spiral.
Roll the spiralled dough using a pin into a 3-4 inch circle. Heat a Tawa, place the flattened parotta on the Tawa. Add oil. Cook on a medium flame for 2 mins and flip. Cook the other side for 2 mins.
By tapping the sides of the parotta right after it is cooked will fluff up the nool parotta. Repeat this for all the Parotta.

title: Mutton Liver Fry
cooking_instructions: Cut the mutton liver into 1 inch cubes. Marinate with salt and turmeric powder. Set aside for 15 minutes, while we cook the masala.
Heat oil in a pan and add the shallots. Cook until golden brown.
Add green chilli and ginger garlic paste. Saute for a minute.
Add the tomato and mix. Add all the spice powders and salt. Saute for 2 minutes.
Add the marinated mutton liver. Saute for 2 minutes on high heat.

Add water and bring it to a boil. Cover and reduce the heat to low, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove the lid and continue cooking until any excess moisture has evaporated. Sprinkle coriander leaves and mix. Serve hot with rice, kal dosa or parotta.

title: Chermoula Fish Fry
cooking_instructions: Prepare a marinade by blending the above ingredients into a fine paste.
Score the fish, rub the marinade on the fish and let it rest in the refrigerator for 20 minutes.
Heat a grill pan, add oil and grill the fish for 4 minutes on each side on a medium flame. Garnish is with coriander, lemon wedges. Serve it hot.

title: Crispy Schezwan Vegetables
cooking_instructions: Heat water in a pan and add the de-seeded chillies to it. Boil the chillies for 5 minutes. Strain the chillies and blend it to a fine paste. Keep it aside.
In a bowl, make a batter with maida, cornflour, salt, pepper, msg and water.
Add the vegetables to the batter and mix it till the vegetables are coated well with the batter.
Heat oil in a pan and deep fry the batter coated vegetables till they become crispy. Keep it aside.
To prepare the sauce, heat oil in a wok, add garlic, ginger and saute it for a few seconds.
Add coriander stem and fry it for a few seconds.
Add the chilli paste and cook it till oil separates from it.
Add soy sauce, tomato ketchup and mix it well. Add a little water, mix it, bring it to a boil and let it thicken.
Add the fried vegetables and toss it on a high flame till it is coated well with the sauce. Take it off the flame and serve it immediately, garinshed with chopped spring onions.

title: Quinoa Salad
cooking_instructions: Add the quinoa to a fine mesh strainer. Rinse it under running water for 30 seconds. Allow the excess water to drain off.
Add the quinoa to a pan and toast lightly. Add oil and continue toasting until the water has dried off, around 2 minutes.

Add water and salt, and bring it to a boil. Once it comes to a boil, cover and turn the flame to low. Cook for 15 minutes. Remove from the pan and allow it to cool. You can make it ahead of time and refrigerate it.
Combine all the ingredients for the dressing together.
Combine the quinoa and all the salad ingredients together. Add the dressing to the salad and combine. You can serve it chilled or as it is.

title: Quail Fry
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, add all the dry ingredients and mix it along with lemon juice and oil to form a smooth paste.
Make slits on the breast and thigh portions of the quail. Add the quail and coat them evenly. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.

Heat oil over medium-high heat. Add the marinated quail, leaving sufficient space in between.  Once it has fried for 2 minutes and has started to change colour, turn it around gently. Cook for 5 more minutes, turning it occasionally. Sprinkle a little chaat masala over the fried quail. Serve it with lemon juice and onion rings.

title: Chinese Bhel
cooking_instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add salt and the noodles. Cook it only until it softens, around 3 minutes. Drain the noodles and wash it in cold water lightly. Allow it to rest for 10 minutes so that it dries out.

Heat oil for deep-frying until properly hot. Over medium-high heat, fry the noodles in small batches until they turn golden brown and crisp. When they are fried, the oil bubbling will subside. Remove them from the oil.
In another pan, heat oil and add garlic, ginger, onion and capsicum. Saute for 30 seconds.
Add all the sauces, vinegar and black pepper powder. Add water and turn off the heat when it starts to bubble/simmer.
In another bowl, add the fried noodles, breaking them into small pieces. Add the cooked mixture, cabbage, coriander leaves and spring onions. Mix until well combined. Serve immediately.

title: Beetroot Rice
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add mustard, cumin, curry leaves, dry red chillies and let it crackle.
Add the onions and saute till they turn light brown.
Add the ginger garlic paste and cook it for a minute.
Add the sambar powder and cook it for a minute.
Add the grated beetroot. Cook it till it becomes soft.
Season the mixture and cook it till it is almost dry. Turn off the flame
Add the cooked rice to it. Mix it till it combines evenly. Garnish it with chopped coriander leaves. Serve it hot

title: Garlic Bread Pinwheel
cooking_instructions: To prepare the garlic butter, roast the garlic with olive oil and salt.

In another bowl, add the dry ingredients and mix it. Add the water with yeast and mix it till it forms a dough. Knead the dough till it is smooth and doesn't stick on the board. Transfer it to a bowl greased with olive oil. Cover the bowl with a damp cloth or cling wrap and let it ferment till it doubles in size.
In a bowl, add butter, cilantro, parsley and squeeze in the roasted garlic. Mix it well till it all combines evenly.

Transfer it to a board/Table dusted with flour, give it a knockback. Cover it and let it rest for another 30 minutes. Roll out the dough into a sheet not too thin. Apply the garlic butter on it generously from end to end and reserve some of it. Roll it into a log.

Cut the dough evenly and place it on a greased baking tray horizontally. Apply the remaining butter on top of each roll. Let it rest for 10 minutes. Bake it in a preheated oven at 180 degrees for 25-30 minutes. Till it rises and turns golden brown. Cool it down till it is warm and serve.

title: Peanut Tomato Chutney
cooking_instructions: In a pan, heat oil and add cumin, dry red chilli, ginger and curry leaves. Saute for a few seconds till it turns aromatic.
Add peanuts and roast on medium-low heat for 3-4 minutes, until slightly golden.
Add tomato and red chilli powder. Saute for 4 minutes or until the tomatoes soften. Turn off the heat and allow the mixture to cool. Grind into a paste and transfer to a bowl.

In a small pan, heat oil and splutter the mustard seeds. Add the curry leaves and dry red chilli, and turn off the heat. Pour this tempering over the chutney. Serve with dosa, idli or other breakfast items.

title: No Bake Biscuit Cupcake
cooking_instructions: Grease the cupcake molds with butter and dust with cocoa powder.
Blend the sugar, cocoa, baking soda and biscuits until fine in a mixer grinder.
Add the milk and pulse to get a batter consistency. Rest for 10 minutes.
Divide the mixture equally among the molds. Add chocolate in the molds and level the top of the mixture.
Preheat salt in a kadai for 10 mins on high flame. Place the molds and cook on a moderate high heat for 15 mins.
Cool for 10-15 mins before serving.

title: Phirni
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the basmati rice for 20 minutes. Strain it and spread it out in the strainer to dry. Once the rice is dry, transfer it to a blender and blend it to a coarse powder. Transfer the rice powder to a bowl, add a cup of milk to it. Mix it till there are no lumps and keep it aside.
In a pan, add cardamom and slightly toast it. Add it to a blender and grind it into a powder.
In a pan, add milk and bring it to a boil and reduce the flame. Keep stirring the milk till it reduces a little.
Add saffron, mix it till it is fragrant and the milk gets some colour.
Add the milk and rice powder mixture to the hot milk and stir it till it dissolves without lumping. Keep stirring till the mixture starts to thicken.
Add sugar, cardamom powder, salt and ghee. Mix it well till all the ingredients combine evenly. Transfer the mixture to mud cups/bowls. Garnish it with sliced almonds, pistachios and saffron strands. Let it set in the refrigerator and serve

title: Moru Moru Stick Chicken
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, mix the chicken with all the ingredients for the marination. Rest for 20 minutes.
Soak the bamboo skewers in water for at least 20 minutes. Meanwhile, you can marinate the chicken. Skewer each chicken strip on a bamboo skewer.
Keep the maida, beaten eggs and breadcrumbs ready in separate plates. Coat the chicken strips in maida first, then eggs and then finally in breadcrumbs.
Deep-fry the chicken on medium heat until crispy and golden brown. This will take around 5 minutes.

title: Mutton Gilli Biryani
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes.
Heat oil and ghee in a pot, add the whole spices
Add half of the slit green chillies to the pot and add the thinly sliced onions. Cook until the onions are translucent.
Add the ginger garlic paste and continue to cook until the raw smell goes away.
Add 1 cup each of coriander and mint leaves, cook for 1 minute. Reserve the remaining coriander and mint leaves for later use.
Add the tomatoes and saute until mushy.
Add Garam masala, kashmiri red chili powder, coriander powder, salt and curd. Mix well and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the mutton, lemon juice to the pot and saute for 5 minutes
Add 3 Cups of water and cook the mutton for 25 minutes on medium high heat.
Add 2 ½ cups of water and the soaked rice.

Add the remaining green chili, coriander leaves and mint leaves. Cover the pot, seal with aluminum foil and Cook for 10 mins on low heat and remove from the heat. Let it rest for 5 mins before opening the pot. Serve hot with onion raita.

title: Sweet and Spicy Crunchy Noodles
cooking_instructions: Heat a pan on medium flame and dry roast the peanuts and sesame seeds till they turn golden brown, keep it aside.
Slice the garlic, cut ginger into thin juliennes and cut the spring onion whites and greens diagonally.
In another bowl or glass, add soy sauce, honey, red chilli flakes and brown sugar. Mix it till they evenly combine.

Bring water to a boil in a pan, add salt. Add the noodles and boil it till it is cooked. Strain it and keep it under running cold water. Drain off the excess water from the noodles, add oil to it and mix to avoid the noodles from sticking. Keep it aside
Hear oil in a pan, add ginger and garlic and saute for a few seconds. Add the spring onion whites and toss it on a high flame for a few seconds.

Add the noodles and the prepared sauce mixture. Toss it till the noodles is coated evenly in the sauce. Add a part of the roasted peanuts and sesame seeds and a part of the spring onions greens. Toss it well. Transfer it to a bowl, garnish it with the remaining peanuts, sesame seeds and spring onion greens. Serve it hot.

title: Hot Garlic Crispy Chicken Strips
cooking_instructions: Deseed and boil the chillies. Strain it, blend it to a fine paste and keep it aside.
Mix the chicken with the maida, cornflour, salt, pepper, msg and little water and mix it till it is coated evenly.
Heat oil in a Kadai, deep fry the chicken till it becomes crispy and keep it aside.
In another pan, heat oil, add chopped garlic, chilli paste and mix it till oil separates from it.
Add tomato ketchup and a little water. Bring it to a boil.
Add the prepared cornstarch, salt, pepper and mix it well till it starts to thicken
Add the fried chicken strips, toss it till it is coated evenly with the sauce. Serve it hot immediately.

title: Chicken Fajita
cooking_instructions: Add the ingredients for the seasoning to the chicken breast, add oil and rub the seasoning on the chicken breast till it is coated evenly evenly.
Prepare the salsa and sour cream with the required ingredients and keep it aside
Heat a pan, add oil and sear the chicken breast to a golden brown colour on both sides and the chicken is cooked. Take the chicken off the pan and shred them.
In the same pan, add oil, add the garlic onion and bell peppers one after the other and saute them on a high heat.
Add the shredded chicken, toss it till it mixes evenly. Season the mixture. And add the roughly chopped coriander, sprinkle lemon juice.
Serve it along with tortilla/chapati, salsa and sour cream

title: Kung Pao Cauliflower
cooking_instructions: Soak cauliflower in hot water for 10 minutes and then add the ingredients required to marinate the cauliflower.
Heat Oil in a kadai, deep fry the cauliflower to a golden brown colour. Keep it aside
Heat oil in a pan, add the chopped ginger and garlic and saute them for a minute
Add the red chillies and saute for a minute.
Add the soy sauce, brown sugar and mix it till the sugar dissolves
Add water and let it boil, and then the cornstarch and mix till the sauce becomes thick
Add the cauliflower and mix it till it is coated evenly with the sauce. Then add the fried cashew nuts and mix well.
Transfer it to a bowl, garnish it with spring onions. Serve it hot.

title: Ratha Poriyal
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add onions, dry red chillies, green chillies, curry leaves and saute for 4-5 minutes.
Add the goates blood and keep mixing it till it starts to clump up like a scrambled egg. Cook it a little more if you prefer it to be dry and crumbly.
Add grated coconut, and coriander leaves mix it well
Add salt and black pepper powder and mix well. Serve it hot

title: Unniyappam
cooking_instructions: Wash the rice and soak for 3 hours.
In a pan, melt the jaggery along with 1 cup of water. Strain it and let it cool.
In a mixer jar, add the soaked rice, banana and half of the melted jaggery. Blend into a paste that is still a bit coarse.
Add the remaining melted jaggery, salt and baking soda. Blend again to combine. Allow it to rest for 30 mins.
In a pan, heat ghee and fry the sesame seeds for 30 seconds on low flame. Add this to the batter along with cardamom powder.
In a Paniyaram pan, fill each cavity with 1 tbsp of oil. Pour the batter up to halfway through in each cavity. Cook on a medium flame for 2 minutes.
Flip it using a skewer or a fork. Cook for 2 more minutes. This can be eaten immediately or can be stored for up to 2 days.

title: Cookd Paneer Butter Masala
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add the butter masala curry paste and saute for a minute
Add water, mix it well and simmer the gravy for 5 minutes
Add the paneer cubes and cook it in the gravy for 2 minutes
Add fresh cream, butter and coriander leaves, and remove the pan from the stove
Garnish it with fresh cream, butter and coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Schezwan Paneer
cooking_instructions: Prepare a thick batter with maida, cornflour, salt, pepper and water. Mix till there are no lumps. Add the paneer to it and coat it well.
Heat oil in a kadai. Deep fry the paneer to a golden brown colour. Keep it aside.
Blend the boiled chillies to a fine paste.
Heat a pan, add oil, garlic and celery. Saute for 2 minutes
Add the chilli paste and cook till it releases oil. Add tomato sauce, salt and mix well till all ingredients combine evenly.
In a pan, add oil, curry leaves and dry red chillies.
Add onion and saute it until it turns translucent
Add water if necessary. Add salt, prepared schezwan sauce, tomato ketchup, fried cashew nuts and coriander leaves.
Add the fried paneer and toss it on a high flame till it is coated with the sauce. Garnish it with spring onions. Serve it hot.

title: Peri Peri Corn Fries
cooking_instructions: Make the peri-peri masala by combining all the ingredients together in a mixer.
Cut the corn into 3-inch pieces.
Insert a toothpick into each row of corn. Take it out carefully using your fingers.
Toss the corn with corn flour powder
Fry it until it turns crisp.
Toss it with the masala.

title: White Chicken Pulao
cooking_instructions: Grind everything together for the paste, into a smooth paste. Add it to the chicken along with all the ingredients for the marination. Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
Soak Basmati rice in water for 30 minutes.
Heat oil and add cardamom, bay leaves and cloves. Add onion and saute until translucent.
Add green chilli, tomato and coriander leaves. Saute for 4-5 minutes or until the tomato softens.
Add the marinated chicken and mix. Cover and cook on medium-high heat for 10 minutes.
Add water and salt. Bring it to a boil.

Drain the soaked rice and add it to the pot. Allow it to boil so that the level of rice almost comes up to the level of the water. Cover with a tight lid, reduce the flame to low and cook for 15 minutes. Drizzle ghee over the top and serve.

title: Cheese Paratha
cooking_instructions:
Knead a smooth and semi-firm dough using the flour, oil, salt and water. Rest for 10 mins.
In another bowl, combine the cheese, chillies, coriander leaves and chaat masala to make the filling.
Divide the dough into even sized roundels. Flatten them and make the edges a bit thinner than the center.
Stuff the dough with the cheese mixture, Place the mixture in the center and seal the edges by pinching together. Dust with flour and roll the roundels flat, gently. 
Cook on a preheated tava on medium heat, applying ghee/ oil and till golden brown on both sides.

title: Mushroom Chukka
cooking_instructions: Heat a pan, add all the spices required for the masala and dry roast it till it gives out an aroma. Blend it to a coarse powder
Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds, curry leaves, green chilli and let it crackle
Add garlic and saute it for a few seconds
Add the sliced onions and saute till it turns translucent
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute on a medium flame
Add the dry powders and saute for a  minute till it is rid of any raw flavor.
Add the mushrooms and saute till it is almost cooked and add 2 tbsp of the chukka masala and mix well.
Add salt and mix well. Add chopped coriander leaves, give it one final toss on a high flame. Transfer it to a bowl, garnish it with coriander leaves, serve it hot.

title: Delhi Street Style Butter Chicken
cooking_instructions: To the chicken, add  salt, pepper, lemon juice, and garam masala. Mix it well and let it marinate for 30 minutes
Dry roast the spices required for the spice marinade till it turns aromatic. Add the dry roasted spices to a blender along with curd, ginger and garlic. Blend it into a fine consistency.
Add the spice mix to the marinated chicken. Mix it well till the chicken is evenly coated with the marinade. Let the chicken marinate in the refrigerator for 2-3 hours.
Once the chicken is marinated, place a bowl with a hot piece of coal on it. Add a tbsp of butter to it and seal the bowl tightly. Let the chicken smoke for 5 minutes.
Heat a grill pan, add 1 tbsp oil. Grill the chicken on the pan evenly on  all sides till grill marks appear.
Transfer the cooked chicken to a bowl. To it, add chaat masala, fresh cream, melted butter and coriander leaves. Toss it till the chicken is coated evenly. Serve it hot with roti and onion rings.

title: Andhra Gobi 65
cooking_instructions: Cut the cauliflower stem and cut it into florets. Wash them.
Bring a pot of water to a boil and add turmeric powder and salt. Add the cauliflower pieces, cover and boil for 1 minute only. Strain it and allow the water to drain.
For the marination, add all the ingredients together. Add water gradually and form it into a smooth batter.
Heat oil for deep-frying. Coat the cauliflower pieces with the batter and fry on medium heat until crisp, around 6-8 minutes. Remove from the oil and set aside.
Mix together the curd, cornflour and tomato ketchup. Set aside.
Heat oil in a pan. Add garlic, ginger, green chilli and curry leaves. Saute for 30 seconds.
Add salt and red chilli powder, and mix on low heat. Add the curd and mix. Add the fried cauliflower and coriander leaves. Toss for 2 minutes on high heat. Serve as an appetizer.

title: Masala Egg Dosa
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds. Add the curry leaves, onion and green chilli, and saute until the onion turns translucent.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute. Add tomato, salt and all the spice powders. Cook for 3 minutes.
Add the eggs and cook for just 1 minute. Let it still be a little runny.

Heat a tawa on medium-high heat and grease it with oil. Add a large ladle of Dosa batter and spread it a little. It should still be thick like an uthappam. Once bubbles start to appear lightly on top, add some of the egg mixture and spread it around using a spoon. Drizzle gingelly oil around the edges. Cook for a minute and then flip it. Sprinkle onion, coriander leaves and lemon juice on top. Cook for another minute. Remove it from the tawa. Serve it on its own, or with any gravy or chutney.

title: Chocolate and Walnut Cookies
cooking_instructions: In a Bowl, mix butter and both sugars till it is creamy.
Add the egg, vanilla essence and mix it till it all combines.
Sieve the flours, corn flour, baking soda and fold it in just till it combines.
Add the chocolate chips and walnuts. Fold it in. Let the cookie dough Rest for an hour.
Grease a baking tray. Scoop the cookie dough using an ice cream scooper and place it on the tray with even gaps between each cookie dough.
Bake it at 200 degrees celsius for 10 minutes and let it rest for another 10 minutes.

title: Tsing Hoi Potato
cooking_instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a pan and add the chopped onion, ginger and garlic. Saute until light brown.
Add the celery, cashew nuts and sugar and mix well. Saute for 2 mins. Add the red chilli paste, soya sauce, vinegar and ketchup and mix well.
Add the water and fried potato dices and bring to a boil. Boil until thickened.
Finish with chopped spring onion.

title: Mushroom and Cheese Burger
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add garlic and saute for a few seconds. Add the onions and saute till the onions turn translucent.
Add the chopped mushroom and saute it till it is cooked. Let it cool down
In a bowl add the mashed potatoes, mushroom mixture and the rest of the ingredients. Mix it till all the ingredients combine evenly. Divide it equally and shape them into balls.

For crumbing, in a bowl mix maida, water into a thick batter. And keep bread crumbs in another bowl. Coat the mushroom balls in the maida batter first and then in the bread crumbs and shape it into patties. Repeat the procedure till all of the mixture is used.
Heat oil nicely in a kadai and deep fry the mushroom patties till the coating turns golden brown in colour.

Toast burger buns, spread mayonnaise on  each side. To assemble the burger, place lettuce, tomato roundeles and sprinkle a little salt on it. Place the patty and then a slice of cheese and close the burger. Serve it hot with ketchup or any dip of your choice.

title: Badami Paneer Tikka
cooking_instructions:
Blanch the badam, peel off the skin and blend it to a fine thick paste.
Mix the ingredients required for the marination till they combine evenly. Add the badam paste to it and mix it well. Add the diced onion, capsicum and paneer cubes to it. Mix well till the paneer is coated with the marination. Let it marinate for 30 minutes
Place a piece of hot coal on the marinated paneer, add ghee and cover the bowl tightly. Let the paneer smoke for 5 minutes.
Skewer the paneer onion and capsicum alternatively.
Heat a grill pan and cook the skewered paneer till grill marks appear on all sides. Serve it hot with mint chutney.

title: Mushroom Butter Masala
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add the butter masala curry paste, and saute for a minute
Add water, mix it well and simmer the gravy for 5 minutes
Add the mushrrom and cook it in the gravy for 2 minutes
Add fresh cream, butter and coriander leaves, and remove the pan from the stove. And finally Garnish it with fresh cream, butter and coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Butter Chicken Masala
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add the butter masala curry paste and saute for a minute
Add chicken boneless cubes to the paste and mix it well
Add water, mix it well and simmer the gravy for 5 minutes
Add fresh cream, butter, and coriander leaves, and remove the pan from the stove. Then garnish it with fresh cream, butter, and coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Prawn Butter Masala
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add the butter masala curry paste, and saute for a minute
Add Prawns and saute it for 3 minutes
Add water, mix it well and simmer the gravy for 5 minutes
Add fresh cream, butter, and coriander leaves, and remove the pan from the stove. Then garnish it with fresh cream, butter, and coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Dragon Paneer
cooking_instructions: Cut the paneer into batons (long pieces).

Make a batter by mixing together corn flour, maida, salt, pepper and adding water gradually. Coat the paneer in the batter and drop each piece individually into hot oil. Fry until crisp and golden brown. This would take around 4 minutes. Remove from the oil and set aside.
In a bowl, combine all the ingredients for the sauce. Set this aside.
Heat oil in a pan and add the cashews on medium heat. Stir continuously and fry until it turns golden brown. Remove this from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add dry red chilli, garlic and onion. Saute on high heat for 1 minute.
Add Kashmiri chilli powder and saute for a few seconds.
Add sauce and capsicum. Mix until everything is combined. Add water to adjust the consistency and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the fried paneer and spring onion. Mix until well coated. Serve it hot.

title: Paneer Pollichathu
cooking_instructions: Cut the paneer into thick slices. Coat it with salt and turmeric powder.
Heat oil in a pan, preferably non-stick. Add curry leaves to prevent sticking. Add the paneer and fry it for 30 seconds on each side. Remove it from the pan.
You can continue making the masala in the same pan. Add the shallots, ginger, garlic, curry leaves and green chilli. Saute until the shallots turn translucent.
Add all the spice powders and salt. Add the tomatoes and saute until it turns mushy.
Add the coconut milk and vinegar. Saute just until it turns into a thick paste. Set aside.
Heat the banana leaf over a direct flame to make it flexible and to prevent tearing.

Add some curry leaves to the banana leaf. Spoon some of the prepared masala onto the centre of the banana leaf. Place the fried paneer on it and then cover it again with more masala. Fold in the sides of the leaf and tie it tightly using a banana fiber/kitchen twine.
Heat oil in a pan/tawa and place the paneer. Sprinkle some water on the sides, cover and cook for 5 minutes, flipping halfway through.

title: Masala Egg Roll
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Add the chopped onions, and green chillies and saute for a minute.
Add the dry masala powder and cook them for another minute.
Add the tomato, beaten eggs, salt, pepper and coriander leaves. Scramble the eggs till it becomes fluffy. Take it off the flame.

Cook the chapati with oil on a tawa. Transfer the chapati to a cutting board or a plate. Gently add the scrambled egg on top of the cheese and spread it slightly. Roll it normally or like a burrito. Cut it diagonally in the middle and serve it hot.

title: Dal Shorba
cooking_instructions: Wash the dal.
Pressure cook the mixed dals for 2 whistles with salt.
Add a cup of water and Mash/ Puree the dal.
Heat ghee in a pot and add the cumin seeds, once aromatic add the ginger-garlic paste and green chillies and saute for 2mins.
Add the powdered spices and mix well.
Pour the dal and simmer for 5 mins.
Finish with lemon juice and chopped coriander leaves. Garnish with fresh cream.

title: Baked Creamy Mushrooms
cooking_instructions: Heat a pan, add oil and butter. Let it melt. Add the chopped garlic and saute till it turns light brown
Add the onions and thyme and saute till it turns translucent
Add the mushrooms and saute for 3-4 minutes.
Add maida and mix till the mushrooms are coated with the maida and mix it till the maida is rid of the raw flavour
Add milk and mix till the maida is dissolved in the milk and keep mixing till the mixture starts to thicken
Add grated cheese and mix well. Add salt, pepper and mix it well
Transfer the mixture to an oven safe bowl. Add bread cubes to it and press it in a little. Top it off with mozzarella and bake it in the oven till the cheese turns brown.

title: World’s Easiest Mutton Curry
cooking_instructions: Mix all the ingredients together in a pressure cooker (off the stove).
Place it on the stove and pressure cook for 1 whistle on high heat. Reduce the heat to low, cook for 25 minutes. Once the pressure settles, remove the lid. Serve with rice, roti/chapthi or parotta.

title: Sweet and Spicy Glazed Sticky Chicken
cooking_instructions: Wash and drain the chicken. Marinate it with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet or a pan, Add oil. Sear the chicken to a golden brown colour on both sides and transfer it to a plate.
In the same pan, add oil, saute ginger and garlic.
Add the brown sugar, soy sauce, honey, chilli flakes, lemon juice and water. Mix it well, bring it to a boil and cook it till it becomes thick and sticky.
Add the chicken to the sauce. Coat it evenly on both sides. Garnish with chopped spring onions and sesame seeds. Serve it hot.

title: Cookd Fried Chicken
cooking_instructions: Add the Secret Marinade Blend to the chicken. Mix well till the meat is coated evenly with the marinade
Prepare a batter using 5 tbsp of the Ultra Crispy Fry Mix and 150ml of water.

Coat it evenly with the dry Ultra Crispy Fry Mix first. Dip it in the batter and coat it throughout. Coat it with the Ultra Crispy Fry Mix again and dust it in a downward motion to form the crust (crinkles)

Deep fry it in medium hot oil at first for 4 minutes and then increase the flame and let it fry till it turns golden brown and crispy. Sprinkle the Cookd Seasoning in the fried chicken and toss it well. Serve it hot with a dip of your choice on the side.

title: Phulka
cooking_instructions: Add salt to the whole wheat flour and mix to combine.

Add hot water to the dough and mix with a spoon. Once it is cool enough to handle, knead using your hands. If more water is required, add only 1 tsp of water at a time. Keep kneading until a smooth dough forms, 3 to 5 minutes.
Apply ½ tsp of oil on the dough. Cover with a wet towel and rest for 10 minutes.
Take a small portion of the dough. Roll it out thin (around 18 cm diameter).

Cook it on a Tawa on medium-high heat until bubbles start to appear. Flip and cook for a further 6-8 seconds. Cook it on a direct high flame for 6-8 seconds until it starts to puff up, flipping halfway through.
You can also finish cooking it completely on the Tawa itself, until light brown spots start to appear.
Spread butter/ghee over each roti. Keep the cooked Phulkas/Rotis covered to prevent them from drying out.

title: Kerala-Style Soya Roast
cooking_instructions: Soak the soya chunks in hot water with salt. Cover and let it rest for 5 minutes. Once soaked, drain the soya chunks completely.
Add the ingredients for the marination and mix. Set this aside.
Heat coconut oil in a pan and add fennel seeds, coconut chunks, curry leaves, ginger, garlic, green chilli and curry leaves. Saute for 2 minutes or until the ingredients start to brown.
Add onion and shallots. Saute until they start to brown.
Add red chilli powder, coriander powder and salt. Saute for 2 minutes.

Add the marinated soya chunks and mix. Add water, cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Open the lid and add black pepper powder and garam masala powder. Stir and cook until the remaining moisture dries up. Cook for 3-4 minutes without the lid to allow the soya to get slightly crisp. Remove from the heat and serve with rice or parotta.

title: Cookd Crispy Fried Paneer Bites
cooking_instructions: Marinate the paneer with the marinade.
Combine 5 tbsp of dry mix along with 10tbsp (150ml) of water to form a smooth batter
Place the remaining fry mix in the separate bowl. Coat the protein with fry mix lightly, dip in the wet batter and coat in the fry mix again. Dust off the excess for best results
Fry in medium-hot oil until it turns golden brown.
Sprinkle the seasoning on the fried paneer and toss it till it is coated well with the seasoning and serve it hot with a dip of your choice on the side.

title: Cookd Crispy Fried Fish
cooking_instructions: Marinate the fish slices with the marinade.
Combine 5 tbsp of dry mix along with 10tbsp (150ml) of water to form a smooth batter
Place the remaining fry mix in the separate bowl. Coat the fish slices with fry mix lightly, dip in the wet batter and coat in the fry mix again. Dust off the excess for best results
Fry in medium-hot oil until it turns golden brown
Sprinkle the seasoning on the fried fish and toss it till it is coated well with the seasoning and serve it hot with a dip of your choice on the side.

title: Cookd Crispy Fried Prawns
cooking_instructions: Marinate the prawn with the marinade.
Combine  5 tbsp of dry mix along with 10 tbsp (150ml) of water to form a smooth batter.
Place the remaining fry mix in the separate bowl. Coat the prawns with fry mix lightly, dip in the wet batter and coat in the fry mix again. Dust off the excess for best results.
Fry in medium-hot oil until it turns golden brown.
Sprinkle the seasoning on the fried prawn and toss it till it is coated well with the seasoning and serve it hot with a dip of your choice on the side.

title: Chicken Dhaba Curry
cooking_instructions: Heat oil and saute the dhaba curry paste for 1 minute
Add water and cook for 1 minute
Add chicken to the pan, cover and cook it for 15 minutes and simmer it for 5 minutes. Season to taste if needed.
Garnish with Coriander leaves. And serve it hot

title: Mushroom Dhaba Curry
cooking_instructions: Heat oil and saute the dhaba curry paste for 1 minute.
Add mushroom to the pan, saute it for 3 minutes.
Add water and cook for 5 minute. Season to taste, if needed
Garnish with Coriander leaves. And serve it hot.

title: Paneer Dhaba Curry
cooking_instructions: Heat oil and saute the dhaba curry paste for 1 minute.
Add water and cook for 1 minute.
Add paneer to the pan, cook it for 5 minutes. Season to taste if needed.
Garnish with Coriander leaves. And serve it hot.

title: Creamy Paneer Dhaba Curry
cooking_instructions: Heat oil and saute the dhaba curry paste for 1 minute.
Add water and cook for 1 minute.
Add paneer to the pan, cook it for 5 minutes on a medium to low flame.
Add fresh cream, ghee and garnish it with coriander leaves. Season to taste, if needed. Serve it hot

title: Mutton Dhaba Curry
cooking_instructions: In a pressure cooker, Add 1 tsp of oil and saute the dhaba curry paste for 1 minute.
Add mutton to the cooker and saute for 5 minutes.
Add water and pressure cook on a medium flame for 25 minutes.
Garnish with coriander leaves. Season to taste, if needed and serve it hot.

title: Aloo Matar Dhaba Curry
cooking_instructions: Heat oil and saute the dhaba curry paste for 1 minute.
Add water and cook for 1 minute.
Add potato to the pan, cover and cook it for 5 mins on low flame.
Add green peas, simmer for 5 mins. Season to taste, if needed
Garnish with Coriander leaves. And serve it hot.

title: Kung Pao Chicken
cooking_instructions: To the boneless chicken cubes, add the soy sauce, egg, black pepper powder and salt. Mix well.
Add the cornstarch and mix again to ensure that the chicken is evenly coated.
Deep fry the chicken over medium heat for 5 minutes. Remove from the oil and set aside.
In a bowl, combine the dark soy sauce, vinegar, brown sugar and water.
In a wok/pan, heat sesame oil and saute the ginger, garlic and red chillies for 1 minute.
Add the fried chicken and the sauce mixture. Allow it to come to a boil and simmer for 1 minute.
Make a slurry by combining the cornstarch and water in a bowl. Add this to the pan.
Add roasted peanuts and spring onions. Mix well and turn off the heat.

title: Creamy Garlic Chicken
cooking_instructions: Marinate the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Heat a pan with oil, add the chicken breasts to the pan and grill it on a medium flame for 5 minutes each on both sides. Keep it aside.
Add butter in the same pan. Add chopped garlic and saute till it turns golden brown.
Add the chopped onions and saute till the onions turn translucent.
Add water and bring it to a boil.
Add the fresh cream and mix it till it combines well. Bring it to a soft boil.
Season the mixture, add the chicken breast to the sauce and coat it with the sauce. Take the pan off the flame, garnish it with chopped parsley, serve it hot with herbed rice or toasted bread

title: Mangalore Chicken Ghee Roast
cooking_instructions: Add the Cookd Ghee Roast Paste onto a pan with ½ cup of water and bring it to a boil.
Add chicken, cover and cook on medium heat for 15 minutes.
Finish it off with ghee and fried curry leaves. Serve it hot.

title: Mushroom Ghee Roast
cooking_instructions: Add the Cookd Ghee Roast Paste onto a pan with ¼ cup of water and bring it to a simmer.
Add mushroom, cook on medium heat for 5 minutes.
Finish it off with ghee and fried curry leaves. Serve it hot.

title: Paneer Ghee Roast
cooking_instructions: Add the Cookd Ghee Roast Paste onto a pan with ½ cup of water and bring it to a boil.
Add paneer, cook on medium heat for 3 minutes until the gravy becomes thick.
Finish it off with ghee and fried curry leaves. Serve it hot.

title: Mutton Ghee Roast
cooking_instructions: In a pressure cooker, add Cookd Ghee Roast Paste, mutton and water. Cover and pressure cook on medium heat for 25-30 minutes.
Finish it off with ghee and fried curry leaves. Serve it hot.

title: Football Chicken
cooking_instructions: Mix the chicken mince with all the other ingredients for the marination. Set this aside.
Cut the cheese cubes into small pieces.
Apply oil on your hands. Take a small portion of the chicken mixture. Flatten it and place the cheese in the centre. Cover the cheese and form roundels.
Cut off the crust from the bread. Cut the bread into small cubes (around 1 cm).
Roll the chicken roundels in the bread pieces. If there are any gaps, place bread pieces there. Press it lightly with your hands to make them stick properly.

Fry on medium-low heat for 6-7 minutes or until the chicken is fully cooked inside. Do not overcrowd the pan while frying. While frying, leave it untouched for around 30 seconds after putting it into the oil. You can move it around after that.  Serve as a snack or a starter.

title: Paneer Shashlik
cooking_instructions: In a bowl mix all the ingredients required for the marinade.
Add the paneer and onions, mix them well and let it marinate for 1 hour.
Skewer the Marinated paneer and onions alternatively.

Heat oil in a grill pan and grill the paneer skewers evenly on all slides till grill marks appear. Transfer it to a plate, garnish it with coriander leaves and lemon wedges. Serve it hot with any flatbread or salad.

title: Cookd Masala Pav
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan and add the dhaba curry paste. Saute it for 1 minute to heat it up.
Add capsicum and saute for 2 minutes.
Add water and continue to cook for 2 minutes.
Add coriander leaves and pav bhaji masala & mix. Remove the masala from the pan.
In the same pan, melt some butter. Cut the pav in half horizontally and toast it, with the cut side down.
Turn the pav and toast the other side on low heat. At this point, add some of the prepared masala on one side of the pav.
Add onion, coriander leaves and grated cheese. Cover the pav and remove it from the pan. Add more masala on top, followed by grated cheese, onion and coriander leaves. Serve with a lemon wedge.

title: Cookd Crispy Popcorn Chicken
cooking_instructions: Add the hot and spicy marinade to the chicken. Mix well till the meat is coated evenly with the marinade.
Prepare a batter using 5 tbsp of the 3 in 1 breading and 150ml of water.
Coat it evenly with the breading first. Dip it in the batter and coat it through out. Coat it with the breading again and dust it in a downward motion to form the crust.

Deep fry it in medium hot oil at first for 2 minutes and then on a high flame for another 3-4 minutes till golden brown. Sprinkle the seasoning in the fried chicken and toss it well. Serve it hot with a dip of your choice on the side.

title: Cookd Crispy Fried Cauliflower
cooking_instructions: Soak the cauliflower in hot water for 10 minutes and mix the cauliflower with marinade till nicely coated.
Combine 5 tbsp of dry mix along with 10tbsp (150ml) of water to form a smooth batter.
Place the remaining fry mix in the separate bowl. Coat the cauliflower with fry mix lightly, dip in the wet batter and coat in the fry mix again. Dust off the excess for best results.
Fry in medium-hot oil until it turns golden brown.
Sprinkle the seasoning on the fried cauliflower and toss it till it is coated well with the seasoning and serve it hot with a dip of your choice on the side.

title: Kulkul
cooking_instructions: Combine the maida, semolina, powdered sugar, baking powder and salt. Add the ghee and combine using your fingers.
Add the egg and mix with your fingers. Add the coconut milk a little at a time until the dough is soft, but not sticky.
Knead for 2 minutes. Cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Divide into small balls. Flatten it and shape it using a comb or a fork. Roll from one end using your finger.
Deep fry on medium flame until golden brown.
To prepare the glaze, heat the sugar and water until it reaches a thick consistency.

Drop the cooled down kulkuls in the sugar syrup and mix. Remove it from the syrup and spread it on a flat tray. Make sure that there is sufficient gap so that they don’t stick to each other. Store in an airtight container.

title: Easy Prawn Noodles
cooking_instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add salt and add the broccoli pieces. Boil for 2 minutes and then strain it out of the water.
In the same water, add the noodles and cook until softened. Drain out the water. Apply oil to the noodles and set aside.
Heat a pan or wok until very hot. Add oil, ginger, garlic and spring onion whites. Saute on high heat for 30 seconds.
Add red chilli flakes and saute lightly for a few seconds until the oil changes colour. Add the prawns, salt, pepper and soy sauce. Saute for 3 minutes.
Add the broccoli and saute for 1 minute.
Add the cooked noodles and saute for 2 minutes. Add the spring onion greens, give it a toss and serve.

title: Veg Makhanwala
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add the butter masala curry paste and saute for a minute
Add potato, carrot, beans, baby corn, cauliflower and saute it for 2 minutes.
Add water, mix it well, cover and simmer the gravy for 10 minutes
Add green peas and saute for 3 minutes.
Season to taste if needed. Add fresh cream, butter and garnish it with coriander leaves. Server it hot.

title: Cookd Butter Chicken Pasta
cooking_instructions: Heat water in a pan, bring it to a boil. Add salt. Add the pasta, mix it occasionally to avoid letting it stick. Boil it for as long as the instructions on the pasta packet. Strain the pasta, keep it under running cold water, strain it. Add oil to  the pasta, toss/mix till the pasta is coated with oil and keep it aside.
In a pan, add oil and then the butter masala curry paste. Mix it on a medium flame for a  minute.
Add the boneless chicken pieces, and mix it for 2-3 minutes.
Add water, mix it well, bring it to a boil and cook the chicken for 10 minutes.
Add fresh cream, mix it well.
Add the boiled pasta, mix it till it is coated with the sauce/gravy. Add kasuri methi, mix it well. Transfer it to a plate, garnish it with coriander leaves, serve it hot.

title: Spicy Butter Garlic Prawns
cooking_instructions: Marinate the prawns with salt, pepper, lemon juice and parsley.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan. Grill the prawns on both sides for a minute each. Take it off and keep it aside.
In the same pan, heat oil. Add chopped garlic and saute till it turns light brown.
Turn the flame down to low, add paprika and red chilli flakes. Mix it for a few seconds and add water.
Add butter and let it melt slowly. Stir continuously.
Add the prawns. Mix it till it is coated with the sauce. Bring it to a soft boil. Add the chopped coriander, salt, pepper, sugar and mix it well. Serve it hot.

title: Cookd Korean Chicken Wings
cooking_instructions: Add the Secret Marinade Blend to the chicken. Mix well till the meat is coated evenly with the marinade
Prepare a batter using 4 tbsp of the Ultra Crispy Fry Mix and 120ml of water.
Coat it evenly with the dry Ultra Crispy Fry Mix first. Dip it in the batter and coat it throughout. Coat it with the Ultra Crispy Fry Mix again and dust it in a downward motion to form the crust
Deep fry it in medium hot oil at first for 4 minutes and then increase the flame and let it fry till it turns golden brown and crispy (around 2 more minutes). Remove from the oil and set aside.

For the sauce, combine all the ingredients except garlic. Cook it until it comes to a boil. Add garlic and turn off the flame. Add the fried chicken wings and mix until evenly coated. Serve, garnished with white sesame seeds.

title: Boneless Chicken Biryani
cooking_instructions: Set aside 1 tbsp of the Mangalore Ghee Roast paste for cooking the rice.
Heat oil and add the boneless chicken cubes. Saute on high heat for 2 minutes.
Add the remaining Mangalore ghee roast, mint leaves, coriander leaves, tomato puree and curd. Mix well and cook for 4 minutes.
Add water and bring it to a boil. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Open the lid, add fresh cream and remove from the heat.
Heat oil in a pan and add the whole spices, 1 tbsp of the ghee roast paste, green chilli, coriander leaves and mint leaves. Saute lightly until aromatic.
Add water and bring it to a boil. Season with salt.

Add the soaked Basmati rice and cook on high heat, uncovered, until the level of rice almost matches the level of the water. Cover with a tight lid, reduce the flame to low and cook for 12 minutes. Open the lid and drizzle ghee on top. The rice is then ready to serve!

title: Coconut Fish Curry
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add mustard, cumin and fenugreek seeds and let them crackle
Add the curry leaves and green chillies and let it splutter.
Add the dhaba curry paste, cook it on a medium flame for a minute. Add a cup of water, bring it to a simmer.
Add the fish slices. Let it sink into the gravy. Bring it to a boil, cover and cook it for 10 minutes on a medium flame.
Add the coconut milk, mix it gently to avoid breaking the fish. Bring the gravy to a simmer.
Garnish it with coriander leaves. Serve it hot with rice.

title: Cookd Malai Kofta
cooking_instructions:
To a pot, add the potatoes and enough water to cover them. Bring it to a boil and add salt. If the potatoes are large, prick them with a fork for faster cooking. Cover with a lid and cook until the potatoes are soft enough to be pierced with a fork. This would take 15-20 mins. Peel the potatoes and mash them in a bowl. 
Grate paneer and add it to the potatoes. 
Add all the other ingredients and mix to form a uniform mixture. Make small kofta balls from the mixture. Roll it gently. 
Heat oil for frying. Add the kofta on medium heat without overcrowding the pan. Don’t mix them for at least 1 minute. Turn them around occasionally and fry until it is brown on all sides. Remove from the oil and set aside. 
In a pan, heat oil and add the curry paste. Saute for a minute. 
Turn the heat to low and add the milk. Mix continuously until fully mixed, then increase the heat to medium. Allow the mixture to come to a boil.
Add water and boil for 2 minutes. Add cream, mix and remove from the heat. To serve, pour the gravy into a bowl and add the fried Kofta. Garnish with some fresh cream and chopped coriander leaves. Serve with roti, naan or rice.

title: Cookd Paneer McSpicy Burger
cooking_instructions:
For the mayonnaise: Combine store bought veg mayonnaise with ketchup, chilli sauce and red chilli powder for a punchy spicy sauce.  
Cut the paneer into steak slabs. Apply the marinade and marinate the paneer.
Combine the fry mix with some water and make a batter. Dip the paneer in the dry mix, in the batter and again in the fry mix. 
Deep fry in hot oil to make ultra crispy paneer patties. Sprinkle the seasoning after straining it. 
For the assembly, cut the buns, with butter toast on a hot pan until golden. Apply the mayonnaise on both the bun halves, on the inside. Place some lettuce on the lower half and place the patty. Close with the top half and serve hot.

title: Ghee Pongal
cooking_instructions: Dry Roast the Moong Dal in a pan until aromatic.
Wash the Rice and Moong dal, drain and keep aside.

Heat a pan, add 2 tbsp of Ghee, add the peppercorns and allow it to splutter. Then add the Asafoetida, curry leaves, and cashews. Once the cashews turn golden brown, add the cumin seeds and remove them from the heat. Set this aside.
In a pressure cooker, add 1 tsp of ghee and saute the ginger and asafoetida.
Add 4 cups of water, bring water to a boil. Add salt to taste.
Add the drained rice and dal.
Pressure Cook for 4 whistles.

Once the pressure settles, open the pressure cooker, add the tempering ingredients, 2 tbsp of ghee and mix well. The rice and dal have to be in a mashed consistency. Keep mixing until the rice and dal are mashed.

title: No-Oven Wheat Cookies
cooking_instructions: Sieve the flour, baking powder and powdered sugar together. Add salt to the mixture, and mix to combine. Add ghee and gently combine with your fingers, to form a crumbly texture
Once the ghee is evenly distributed and the texture resembles breadcrumbs, add 2 tbsp of milk and knead gently. The dough should look smooth on the exterior, but be crumbly

Place on a butter paper laid on a work surface. Roll out the dough into a 1-cm thick sheet. Cut out cookies using a cookie-cutter.Garnish each cookie with an almond on top.Place the cookies on a greased Idli utensil or a tray

To preheat the baking utensil, fill enough salt in a heavy-bottomed utensil to cover the bottom. Place a small bowl or metal ring to elevate from the surface of the salt. Heat on a medium flame for 10 minutes
Place the cookies in the preheated utensil and cook for 20 minutes on medium-low heat, or until the edges start to become a dark brown
Remove from the tray and allow to cool

title: Cookd Drums of Heaven
cooking_instructions: Cut the tip of the chicken drumstick. Using a knife, scrape the meat towards one side. Do this for all the drumstick pieces.
Marinate the chicken pieces with the Madras 65 masala.
Deep-fry on medium heat until it is fully cooked, around 8-10 minutes. Remove from the oil and set aside.
For the sauce, mix all the ingredients together until smooth.

In a pan, add the sauce and heat it until it starts to thicken, stirring continuously. Add the fried chicken drumsticks and mix to coat evenly with the sauce. Garnish with chopped spring onions, and serve.

title: Cookd Paneer Makhani Biryani
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the basmati rice for 30 minutes
Heat a pan add little oil, add the curry paste and cook it for 2 minutes.
Add ⅔ Cup water, bring it to a simmer and add the paneer cubes. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add fresh cream, mix it well and take it off the flame.
Bring water to a boil in a deep pan, add salt. Add the soaked and strained basmati rice. Boil the rice exactly for 4 minutes and strain it immediately

Place a pan on a preheated tawa. Add ghee, spread it around the pan. Add the rice, paneer makhani, coriander and mint leaves, fried onions and cashew nuts. Repeat the same process for two more layers and finally add ghee and kewra water. Cover the pan tightly and keep it on a low flame for 10 minutes. Open the pan, fluff the biryani and serve it hot.

title: Roadside-Style Kaalan
cooking_instructions: Combine the mushroom, cabbage, ghee roast curry paste, gram flour, maida, cornflour, salt, red chilli powder and garam masala, and mix well to form a slightly wet mixture. Add a few drops of water if required.

Heat oil and keep the temperature at medium. Take small portions of the mixture using your hands and drop it into the oil. The shape does not matter. Do not stir it for the first couple of minutes. Once it starts to solidify, move it around gently so that it cooks evenly. Fry until it turns crisp. Remove it from the oil and set aside.
In another pan, heat oil and add the chopped curry leaves. Add the remaining curry paste, tomato ketchup, soy sauce and saute for 30 seconds.
Add the water and bring it to a boil. Mix the cornstarch and water, and add it to the pan.
Cook for 1 minute while stirring continuously, for it to thicken.
Crush the fried mushroom and add it to the thickened liquid. Cook for 2 minutes on low heat. Serve it in a bowl, topped with corn flakes, black pepper powder, onion and coriander leaves.

title: Creamy Pink Sauce Pasta
cooking_instructions: Heat water in a pan, add salt and bring it to a boil. Add the pasta and boil it according to the instructions on the packet. Strain it. Keep it aside
In a mixer grinder, puree 3 tomatoes and keep it aside.
In a pan, add butter and maida. Mix it till they both combine and turn into a sandy texture.
Add milk and keep whisking it till there are no lumps and the mixture starts to thicken. Keep it aside.
Heat a pan, add oil, add garlic and saute it for a few seconds. Add the onions and saute till it turns translucent
Add the pureed tomatoes and cook till it is rid of its raw flavour.
Add the tomato mixture to the white sauce, mix it till they combine
Season the sauce. Add the cooked pasta and mix it till it is coated with the sauce. Add grated cheese, mix it well. Garnish it with oregano, serve it hot.

title: Cookd Street Style Mushroom 65 Fried Rice
cooking_instructions: Take the chopped mushroom and cabbage in a bowl, add the madras 65 masala, sprinkle some water and make the mixture come together.
Deep fry small roundels in hot oil, fry on a medium flame until crispy. Strain and set aside.
Heat oil in a wok, add ginger, garlic, green chillii, spring onions and saute for a few seconds.
Add the vegetables. Toss them on a high flame for a few seconds.
Add the cooked rice. Toss it till all ingredients combine evenly. Add the seasonings, masalas and sauces.
Add the fried mushroom, toss it. Add Spring Onions. Add the fried mushroom, toss it. Transfer it to a bowl. Garnish it with spring onions. Serve it hot.

title: Dhaba Chilli Chicken
cooking_instructions: To the chicken, add maida, cornflour, salt, black pepper powder and an egg. Mix well till the chicken is coated evenly with it. Let it marinate for 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a kadai, Deep fry the chicken till golden brown and crispy.
Heat another pan, add oil, garlic, green chilli, onion and capsicum. Toss them for a minute.
Add the dhaba curry paste, mix it well on a medium flame for a minute. Add water, mix well and bring it to a simmer.
Add tomato ketchup, mix it well.
Add the fried chicken and toss it till it is coated well with the sauce. Transfer it to a bowl and garnish with chopped coriander leaves. Serve it hot.

title: Dhaba Egg Kheema Masala
cooking_instructions:
Heat water in a pan, add salt and bring it to a boil. Add the eggs and boil it for 12 minutes and transfer it to a bowl of ice water and peel the eggs.
Grate the eggs with the biggest fitting and keep it aside.
Heat oil in a pan, add green chillies and curry leaves. Let them splutter.
Add the dhaba curry paste, cook it on a medium flame for a minute. Add water, bring it to a simmer and let the gravy thicken
Add the grated eggs, mix it well till the mixture thickens. Transfer it to a bowl, garnish it with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Nallampatti Rice
cooking_instructions: Soak the Basmati rice in water for 20 minutes. In a pot, bring water to a boil along with the other ingredients. Add Basmati rice and cook it, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Drain off the water and transfer the rice to a flat dish. Allow it to cool down.
In a pot, add chicken, turmeric powder, salt, ginger garlic paste and black peppercorn, and mix. Add water and mix. Bring it to a boil.

Reduce the flame, cover and cook for 20 minutes. Turn off the heat. Take out the chicken pieces and allow it to cool slightly. Take off the meat from the bones and shred into smaller pieces, and set it aside. Reserve the water also for later.
Use a kadai or wok to cook the rice. Heat the pan and add gingelly oil. Add dry red chilli, curry leaves and shallots. Saute until the shallots turn translucent.
Move the shallots to the side of the pan. In the centre of the pan, add the egg along with a pinch of salt. Allow it to cook slightly for 15 seconds, then scramble the egg.
Add the shredded chicken and saute for a minute on high heat.
Add chicken masala, salt and water. Bring it to a boil and allow it to cook until the liquid thickens. Add the cooked rice and mix. Stir-fry for 2 minutes. Garnish with coriander leaves, and serve.

title: Crumbed Vegetable Burger
cooking_instructions:
Heat oil in a pan. Add garlic and saute it for a few seconds. Add the chopped onion and saute till it turns translucent
Add the rest of the vegetables and keep sauteeing them till they cook. Mix it well
Add the vegetable mixture to the mashed potatoes and mix it well till they all bind together. Season the mixture with salt. Add the grated cheese and mix it till it combines evenly. Divide the mixture and shape them into sphere
Coat it in maida batter and then in the breadcrumbs. Shape them into patties and keep it aside.
Heat oil in a kadai and fry the patties in hot oil till golden brown.
Toast the buns to a golden brown colour.
Apply mayonnaise on both the toasted sides. Place a piece of lettuce on it and tomato roundeles on top of it. Sprinkle salt on it and place the patty on top of it. Place a slice of cheese and close the burger. Serve it hot.

title: Aslam Butter Chicken
cooking_instructions: To the chicken, add  salt, pepper, lemon juice, and garam masala. Mix it well and let it marinate for 30 minutes.
Dry roast the spices required for the spice marinade till it turns aromatic. Add the dry roasted spices to a blender along with curd, ginger and garlic. Blend it into a fine consistency.
Add the spice mix to the marinated chicken. Mix it well till the chicken is evenly coated with the marinade. Let the chicken marinate in the refrigerator for 2-3 hours.
Once the chicken is marinated, place a bowl with a hot piece of coal on it. Add a tbsp of butter to it and seal the bowl tightly. Let the chicken smoke for 5 minutes.
Heat a grill pan, add 1 tbsp oil and 2 tbsp butter. Grill the chicken on the pan evenly on  all sides till grill marks appear. Baste is with a little more butter if necessary.
Transfer the cooked chicken to a bowl. To it, add chaat masala, fresh cream, melted butter and coriander leaves. Toss it till the chicken is coated evenly. Serve it hot with roti and onion rings.

title: Churros
cooking_instructions: Heat the water in a saucepan, add the salt, sugar, butter and vanilla essence. Let it boil and the sugar completely dissolve.

Add the flour all at once and mix using a spatula. Cook for 5 mins, until the mixture leaves the sides of the pan. Remove for a gas range, transfer to a bowl and set aside to cool slightly, for 5 mins.
Add one egg and stir until well combined and smooth. Repeat the process after adding the second egg, until the mixture is uniform and smooth. Fill the mixture in a piping bag fitted with a star tip.
Pipe 2 inch length churros on a plate lined with greaseproof paper (parchment/ butter sheet). Refrigerate for 20 minutes.
Mix sugar and cinnamon for coating in a shallow bowl and set aside.
Heat oil in a pot. Fry the churros on a medium flame until golden brown. Coat in cinnamon sugar.

title: Tandoori Mushroom Rolls
cooking_instructions: Heat water in a pot, bring it to a boil. Add the mushroom to it and boil it till it becomes a little soft and doubles in size. Strain the mushrooms well
Prepare chilli oil by bringing mustard oil to a smoking point, cooling it down a little. Add the kashmiri chilli powder and mix it well for a few seconds. Then add the besan flour and mix it well.
Prepare the marination by mixing all the ingredients required. Add it to the tandoori marinade and mix it well.
Mix it well and let it marinate for 20 minutes. Place a bowl with a heated piece of coal, add a tbsp of ghee and cover the bowl and seal it all around with foil. Let the mushroom smoke for 5 minutes
Skewer the mushrooms.
Heat a grill pan, add oil. Grill the mushrooms evenly and take it out.

Heat a chapathi, cook it on both sides.Place it on a board and evenly spread, mayonnaise, mint chutney and ketchup. Top it with the tandoori mushrooms. Add sliced onions on top of it. Top it off with more mint chutney and roll it tightly. Wrap it with butter paper , serve it hot.

title: Broccoli and Cheddar Stuffed Grilled Chicken
cooking_instructions: Heat butter in a pan, add onion, garlic and saute it for a few seconds.
Add thyme, chopped broccoli, salt and pepper and mix it well till the broccoli cooks. Keep it aside and let it cool down.
Add grated cheddar to the broccoli mixture. Mix it well.
Make pockets by slitting the chicken breast in the centre lengthwise but keep the sides intact. Stuff the pockets with the broccoli mixture.
Marinate the chicken with the ingredients mentioned for the marination. Let it marinate for an hour.
Heat a grill pan, add oil. Grill the chicken on both sides till grill marks appear and the chicken is cooked through. Slice the chicken. Serve it hot.

title: Greek Chicken and Lemon Soup
cooking_instructions: Prepare Chicken stock by boiling the chicken in water. Add a teaspoon of thyme to it and let it absorb the flavour. Bring it to a boil and cook it for 10 minutes. Turn off the heat.
Take the chicken out and Cut/shred it. Keep the stock and chicken aside.
Beat eggs in a bowl. Slowly add the lemon juice while whisking the eggs. Add a cup of chicken stock to it while whisking it simultaneously.

Pour the mixture back into the chicken stock. Add the chicken to it. Simmer it for a few minutes. Add cream and mix it well. Season it with salt and pepper. Transfer it to a soup bowl, Garnish it with chopped parsley. Serve it hot.

title: Beef Chukka
cooking_instructions: In a pressure cooker, add the beef, water, salt, turmeric powder and let is cook on a high flame for 2 whistles and on a low flame for 5 whistles
Heat a pan, dry roast the spices required for the chukka masala till it is aromatic and blend it to a fine paste
Heat a pan, add oil, cumin, and curry leaves and let it crackle. Add the onions and cook it till it turns translucent.
Add ginger garlic paste and cook it for a minute.
Add the dry powders and cook it for a minute on a medium flame till its raw flavor is gone.
Add the beef and a little bit of the water used to cook the beef. Mix it well till it is coated evenly with the masala.
Add the chukka masala and mix it with the beef till the mixture turns dry and aromatic. Garnish it with coriander leaves, Serve it hot.

title: Beetroot Pachadi
cooking_instructions: Add ½ tsp salt to the curd. Whisk well and set aside.
Peel and grate the beetroot.
In a pan, heat the oil. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter.
Then add the split urad dal, curry leaves and chopped green chillies.
Add the grated beetroot and ½ tsp salt and cook for 2 minutes. Add this into the curd and mix well. Adjust salt to taste. Beetroot pachadi is ready to serve!

title: Paneer Changezi
