cooking_instructions: For the gravy paste, heat oil in a pan, add the green chillies, cashew nuts and onions, saute until golden brown. Add some water and blend into a fine puree.
Marinate the paneer with the given marinade ingredients for 20 mins.
Heat ghee in a pan and pan-fry the paneer until it forms a crust on all sides. You can also use a grill pan for this. Set this aside.
For the gravy, heat oil and add ginger garlic paste, saute for 2 mins.
Add the tomato puree and cook until thick and no longer raw in aroma, around 5 minutes.
Add the powdered spices and the onion paste. Saute until the oil releases.
Add the paneer, milk, water and simmer. Finish with crushed kasuri methi and chaat masala.

title: Corn and Cheese Balls
cooking_instructions: Blend the corn to a coarse texture.
Mix the remaining ingredients with the corn and mix it well till they combine evenly.
Divide the mixture into little balls and shape them.
Dip them in maida batter and coat it in panko crumbs.
Heat oil in a kadai, Deep fry the nuggets till they turn golden brown. Transfer it to a plate. Serve it hot with ketchup or any kind of dip on the side.

title: Chocolate Chip Muffins
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, add butter and sugar, beat it till it turns fluffy.
Add the eggs one by one, whisking it in between adding the second egg. Add vanilla Essence, whisk well.
In a sieve, add flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt and sieve it into the egg mixture. Mix it using the whisker.
Add the Chocochips and fold it in till it combines evenly.

Line a cupcake mould with parchment muffin paper. Spoon the batter into each mould (not fully). Bake it in a preheated oven at 180 degrees for 25 minutes. Take it out and let it cool down completely before serving.

title: Paneer Nuggets
cooking_instructions: Grate Paneer,Add the remaining ingredients and mix it till it is combined evenly.
Divide the mixture and roll it into even sized balls.
Mix maida, water and salt and whisk it to a thick batter. Dip them in maida batter and coat it in panko crumbs.Shape them into a square, like nuggets.
Heat oil in a kadai, Deep fry the nuggets till they turn golden brown. Transfer it to a plate. Serve it hot with ketchup or any kind of dip on the side

title: Pancake
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, measure and combine the wet ingredients.
In another bowl, combine the dry ingredients.
Combine the wet and dry ingredients. Whisk until uniform. Rest for a minimum time of 30 minutes in the fridge.
Heat a non-stick pan on medium flame. Pour the batter with a round ladle. Wait for bubbles to appear on the top, flip the pancakes and cook for a minute. Dust with icing sugar and serve warm.

title: Deep Dish Pizza
cooking_instructions: Mix the dry ingredients for the dough, add water and knead it to a soft and elastic dough. Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it ferment for an hour, till the dough rises.

In the meantime, blanch the tomatoes in boiling water for 10-15 seconds and put them in a bowl of cold water. Peel off the tomato skin, cut it into wedges, take off the seeds and chop the pulp nice and fine.
Heat oil in a pan, add garlic and saute for a few seconds. Add the herbs and saute for a few seconds.
Add the chopped tomatoes, tomato puree and cook it well till the raw flavour of the tomatoes is gone. Let the sauce cool down.
Take a part of the dough sheet and spread it into a thin sheet. Cook the rolled sheet on a tawa for a minute on each side.

Grease a skillet with oil, place the dough and spread it using your hands. Add the tomato sauce, spread it evenly. Add mozzarella cheese evenly all around. Place the ingredients required for the topping.Bake the pizza in a preheated oven at 200 degrees for 25 minutes. Slice and serve it hot

title: Bhai Biryani
cooking_instructions: Soak the basmati rice for 30 minutes to 1 hour (maximum).
Slice onions thinly. To the onions, add cinnamon, cardamom and cloves.
Slice the tomatoes. Add it into a bowl along with curd, ginger paste, rock salt, mint leaves, coriander leaves and green chilli.
Heat oil and add the onions. Saute until golden brown.
Add garlic paste and red chilli powder. Saute lightly for 20-30 seconds. Add the tomato mixture. Saute until the tomatoes soften. Add water, cover and boil for 10 minutes.
Add the mutton, cover and cook on medium-low heat for 45 minutes.
Bring water to a boil. Add salt and then the rice. Cover and cook for a total of 5 minutes. Strain out the rice. Save the excess water in a large bowl.
Add the strained rice to the mutton. Spread the rice around and make holes in the rice using the back of a ladle (as to not break the rice).

Some of the water should be visible from the top, just below the level of the rice. If needed, add some of the remaining water from earlier. Cover with a lid. Place the bowl of the hot water on top and cover that with a lid

When steam starts coming from the sides, reduce the flame to low and keep on dum for 15 minutes. Remove the lid and carefully mix from the sides. Drizzle the ghee around the rice. Serve with onion raita and brinjal curry.

For Brinjal Gravy:

Roughly cut the brinjal and add it to a bowl along with curry leaves and green chilli. Wash it well with water.

In a pot, heat oil and add black peppercorn, cumin and mustard seeds. Strain the brinjal and add it to the pot. Add the tomato and mix. Add water, cover and cook for 15 minutes on medium heat. Add garlic paste, red chilli powder, tamarind water and rock salt. Mix and cook for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and serve with biryani.
In a bowl, add all the ingredients together. Mix until evenly combined.

title: Cookd Fish Fingers
cooking_instructions:
Cut the boneless fish fillets into 4-inch long pieces. Cut it again into strips (around 2-cm thick).  
Add the Secret Marinade Blend to the fish, and mix gently. Set aside to marinate for 10 minutes, while you prepare the other ingredients. 
Add 4 tbsp of the Ultra Crispy Fry Mix to a bowl. Add water and mix to form a batter/paste. Add the remaining Fry Mix into another plate/bowl. Add the marinated fish pieces to the Fry Mix and coat with a thin layer. Add it to the batter and coat, then coat it again in the fry mix. 
Deep-fry it on medium-high heat for 4-5 minutes or until crispy. Remove from the oil and set aside on tissue paper. For the sauce, add all the ingredients into a bowl. Mix it until combined. Serve with along with the fried fish fingers.

title: Lemon Pound Cake
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, add butter, sugar and whisk it till it becomes creamy. Add the eggs and whisk it well.
Add the lemon juice, lemon zest and mix it well till it combines.
Add the flour and baking powder, mix it in and finally add the milk and fold the mixture till it all combines well and there are no lumps.
Grease a loaf mould or a bundt mould with butter, pour the batter into the mould, level it out. Bake it at 180 degrees for 45 minutes.
In another bowl add sugar and lemon juice. Mix it well
In another bowl add icing sugar and lemon juice, mix it till it combines together like a glaze.
Take the cake out once it is done, brush the sugar syrup on it while it is still hot and let it cool down completely. Pour the icing on top of the cake. Cut it into slices and serve it.

title: Spicy Garlic Chicken
cooking_instructions: Marinate the chicken with all the required ingredients. Set aside for 10 minutes.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan. Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes, flipping it occasionally. Set this aside.
Heat oil in another pan. Add the garlic and saute on medium heat until golden brown.  Add water, red chilli powder, pepper powder, salt, ketchup and soy sauce.
Add the chicken and cook until the sauce coats the chicken well. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve.

title: Moong Dal Mathri
cooking_instructions:
Soak the moong dal for a minimum of 2 hours. Blend into a fine paste with some water. 
Combine the dry ingredients in a bowl, crush and add the ajwain. Add the hot oil and mix well into the dry ingredient blend. 
Add the moong dal paste and knead a semi-soft dough. Add 1 tbsp of oil and incorporate into the dough. Cover and rest the dough for 20 mins. 
In another bowl, combine maida and oil to make a paste. 
For the preparation, divide the dough into 2 larger portions. Roll out one portion thinly and apply the maida paste, dust with some dry maida and fold like a book.
Apply more of the paste and dust with flour and fold again into the book in the other direction. Roll out this square into a thin and larger rectangle. Apply the paste and dust with dry flour. Roll over 2 times to form the final structure and cut into pieces of desired thickness. 
Fry in pre-heated medium hot oil until crispy and golden brown. Drain and cool completely, for ideal texture. Store airtight for upto 10 days.

title: Watermelon Peel Poriyal
cooking_instructions: Peel the green out skin of the watermelon rind. Use only the white parts. Cut it into cubes.

Heat oil in a pan and crackle mustard seeds. Add the urad dal, chana dal and dry red chilli. Saute until the colour of the urad dal just begins to change. Add the ginger, garlic, green chilli and curry leaves. Saute for 30 seconds. Add the onion and saute until translucent.
Add salt, turmeric powder and red chilli powder. Saute for a minute.
Add the watermelon peel and saute for 2-3 minutes until it begins to release moisture.

Cover and cook on low heat for 20 minutes. Add a sprinkle of water if it gets too dry, and continue cooking. Open the lid, turn the flame to high and reduce any remaining excess water. Add coconut and coriander leaves. Stir and serve with lemon rice, plain rice or any flavoured rice.

title: Paneer Reshmi Masala
cooking_instructions: Heat Oil in a pan, add onions and saute till it turns translucent
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute. Add the tomatoes and capsicum and saute on a high flame for a minute and keep it aside
Heat oil in a pan, Add cumin seeds and let it crackle.
Add the masala powders and cook it on a low flame for a few seconds.
Add tomato puree and cook is for 5 minutes.
Add cashew nut paste and mix well. Cook the tomato puree and cashew nut paste till oil separates from it.
Add water, mix well.
Add the paneer and mix gently till it is submerged in the gravy. Add salt, mix well and bring the gravy to a boil.
Add the sauteed vegetables, mix gelty till all the ingredients combine evenly. Transfer it to a bowl. Garnish with fresh cream and coriander. Serve it hot.

title: Kaima Idli
cooking_instructions: Chop the idlis into ½ inch cubes.
Add oil in a pan, shallow fry the idli until golden brown on all the sides. Remove from the pan, set aside.
Add oil in the pan (if needed), add fennel seeds and slit green chili. Add the finely chopped onions and saute until translucent.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a couple of minutes.
Add the tomato and saute until mushy.
Add salt, kashmiri red chili powder, garam masala and coriander powder, mix well.
Add the capsicum cubes, cooked green peas, tomato ketchup and cook everything for 3 mins.
Add the shallow fried idlis and mix gently. Add some finely chopped coriander leaves and lemon juice, and remove from the heat.

title: Mughlai Egg Korma
cooking_instructions: Hard boil the eggs. Peel them.
Soak saffron in 1 tbsp warm water. Boil the cashew nuts in water for 5 minutes, strain it and set aside.
Heat oil in a kadai and fry then until golden brown, set aside. Cut in halves.
In the same kadai add ghee and the whole spices. Saute until aromatic. Add ginger and garlic, chopped followed by the onions. Saute until golden brown.
Add the tomatoes and cook until the tomatoes begin to mash. Set this masala aside to cool. Blend the mixture, smooth with the cashew nuts and half a cup of water. Strain the mixture.
In a pan, heat ghee and transfer the onion-tomato mixture. Whisk maida in the curd and gently whisk into the gravy.
Add powdered spices, salt, sugar and half a cup of water. Let it simmer for 5 mins. Add the kasuri methi. Finish with kewra essence, saffron and add the fried eggs. Garnish with fried cashew nuts.

title: Broccoli Masala Curry
cooking_instructions: Cut the broccoli into florets. Wash and clean them, and strain the water. Set aside to dry.
Grind the tomato into a puree. Set aside.
Heat oil in a pan. Fry the broccoli for 2 minutes on high heat. Remove from the pan and set aside.
Add oil in the same pan. Once it heats up, add cumin and black peppercorn. Add onion and green chilli. Saute until the onion turns golden brown in colour.
Add ginger garlic paste, salt, turmeric powder and red chilli powder. Saute for 2 minutes. Add the tomato puree, cover and cook on low heat for 5 minutes.

Add beaten curd, garam masala powder and sugar. Stir and cook on high heat for 2 minutes. Add the broccoli, cover and cook for 2 minutes. Finish with chopped coriander leaves and fresh cream (if using). Serve with rice or chapathi.

title: Sabudana Vada
cooking_instructions: Add 2 Cups of sabudana to a bowl, add water till it submerges and let is soake for upto 6 hours or overnight. Strain the sabudana well.
Transfer the strained sabudana to another bowl, add the remaining ingredients and mix well till the all combine evenly and bind well.
Oil your palms and shape the mixture into small patties. Heat oil in a kadai and fry the sabudana patties on a medium flame till it turns golden brown. Serve it hot

title: Iced Coffee
cooking_instructions: Mix together the coffee powder, sugar and hot water together until completely dissolved.
Add water to it and mix.
Pour this into the bottom of a tall glass. Fill the rest of the glass with ice cubes.
Pour fresh cream gently to form a layer. Add milk gently to fill the glass. Serve it cold. Stir and enjoy!

title: Easy Sesame Tofu
cooking_instructions: Marinate the Tofu with salt, pepper, ginger garlic paste, maida  and cornflour.
In a separate bowl, mix the ingredients required for the sauce and keep it aside.
Heat oil in a kadai, deep fry the marinated chicken to a golden brown colour. Keep it aside
Heat another pan, add oil, add chopped garlic, diced onions, diced capsicum and saute for a few seconds.
Add the sauce, simmer it till it starts bubbling.
Add the fried tofu and spring onion batons. Toss well till the tofu is coated evenly with the sauce. Garnish it with toasted sesame seeds and chopped spring onions. Serve it hot.

title: Paneer Kheer
cooking_instructions: Add milk to a pan and bring it to a soft boil
Add sugar and mix it well for around 30 seconds.
Add the nuts and bring the milk to a boil and lower the flame.
Add saffron strands and mix till the milk gets some colour.

Add the grated paneer and khoya and mix well till the khoya dissolves. Mix well till it starts to become thick and take it off the flame. Garnish with fried almonds and cashews and saffron. Serve it hot

title: Mutton Chops Pepper Masala
cooking_instructions:
Heat oil in a pressure cooker, add the mutton chops and sear for a few seconds on a high flame. Add the remaining ingredients, mix well. Pressure cook the mutton for 6 whistles. Take it off the flame and let the steam reduce gradually.
Heat oil in a pan, add cumin, peppercorns and let it crackle. Add garlic and saute for a few seconds. Add the onions and saute till they turn translucent. Cool the mixture down and blend it to a fine paste.
Heat a kadai, add oil. Add fennel seeds, curry leaves and let them crackle.
Add the masala paste and cook it on a medium flame for 2 minutes.
Add the pressure cooked mutton along with the water and mix well till all ingredients combine evenly. Cover and cook the mutton on a low flame for 10 minutes.
Check the seasoning and add salt if necessary. Add Black Pepper Powder. Mix well. Add coriander leaves, mix well once and take it off the flame. Serve it hot with rice or parotta or any tiffin item.

title: Creamy Cold Coffee
cooking_instructions: Mix together the coffee powder and hot water until dissolved. This is the decoction.
In a blender, add the decoction and all the other ingredients. Blend for 20-30 seconds until lightly foamy on top. Serve it in a tall glass. Add extra ice, if needed.

title: Triple Schezwan Fried Rice
cooking_instructions: Soak the kashmiri red chilli in hot water and blend it into a paste.
For the schezwan sauce, heat oil in a pan, add chopped ginger, garlic and saute for a few seconds.
Add the chopped celery and saute for a few seconds.
Add the red chilli paste and cook it till oil separates from it.
Add soy sauce, vinegar and tomato ketchup. Mix well and let the sauce sizzle. Keep it aside
Heat oil in a pan and fry a quarter of the amount of boiled noodles and keep it aside.
Heat a wok, add oil, ginger, garlic and saute for a few seconds.
Add dry red chillies, cashew nuts and saute for a few seconds. Add spring onion whites and saute for a few seconds.
Add the chopped carrots and beans and saute on a high flame for 20-30 seconds.

Add the boiled rice, noodles, 2tbsp of the prepared schezwan paste, salt and black pepper powder and mix and toss well till all the ingredients combine evenly. Add spring onions and toss well on a high flame again. Transfer it to a bowl, garnish it with spring onions and serve it hot.

title: Shahi Paneer
cooking_instructions:
Add all the ingredients required for the puree to a pot, add a little butter and cook it till all the ingredients become soft. Cool the mixture and transfer it to a blender. Blend it to a fine paste and strain it.
Heat a pan, add ghee. Add garlic and green chillies and saute for a few seconds.
Add the paneer cubes and cook it for a minute till it gets golden brown marks on it. Mix it gently to avoid breaking the paneer.
Add the blended puree. Mix gently. Add water, bring it to a boil and season the mixture. Mix gently till all the ingredients combine evenly. Finish it with a spoon of ghee. 
Cover and let it cook for 3-4 minutes. Add fresh cream and mix gently. Transfer it to a bowl, garnish with coriander leaves and fresh cream.

title: Khaja
cooking_instructions: To a bowl, add the maida, salt and ghee. Rub it with your fingers to form a slightly coarse dough.
Add water and knead to form a dough. Cover and rest until the remaining ingredients are ready.
For the paste, mix maida and ghee together. Set aside.
For the sugar syrup, add water and sugar to a pan. Cook it until the sugar dissolves. Add saffron, lemon juice and cardamom powder. Cook until it thickens, on low heat for 4-5 minutes.
Divide the dough into balls. Roll each ball thin like a chapathi.

Apply some of the maida paste on the dough and spread another piece of rolled dough. Once 4-5 pieces of dough are stacked, roll it tightly into a cylinder. Seal the edges well so that they won’t open up while frying.

Using a sharp knife, cut it into pieces around 2 cm thick. Deep-fry it in oil on medium-low heat until golden brown. While it is still hot, add it to the sugar syrup. Mix gently to coat it fully. Remove from the syrup and serve!

title: Blooming Onion
cooking_instructions: Make deep incisions in the onion, leaving the eye intact, into a minimum of 12 parts and separate the petals.
In a bowl, combine the dry ingredients.
In another bowl, combine the wet ingredients.

Dredge the onion in the dry ingredient mix. Make sure to coat in between layers. Dip the onion in the bowl of wet ingredients and make sure it is thoroughly coated, drain the excess. Repeat the process, coat thoroughly with the dry ingredients for a thick and crispy crust.
Deep fry, submerged in oil until golden brown and crispy, about 4 mins.

title: Custard Cookie Bites
cooking_instructions: Preheat the oven at 180C.
Cream butter, vanilla and sugar until pale, light and fluffy.
Add the flour and custard powder and mix well.
Add the milk to adjust the consistency to a thick but piping consistency.
Fill the mixture in a piping bag fitted with a star nozzle. Pipe the mixture on a baking tray lined with parchment paper, with a star nozzle.
Bake for 15-18 mins and cool completely before serving.

title: Paneer Lollipop
cooking_instructions: Grate the paneer into a bowl.
Add the corn into a mixer jar and pulse blend it until it is chunky paste. Add all the ingredients for the paneer mixture together and mix until evenly combined.
Portion the mixture into balls and then flatten it to form a round shape. Insert the ice cream stick. Freeze it for 20 minute for the shape to set.
For the batter, mix together maida, salt and water to form a slightly thick batter. Keep the breadcrumbs in a separate plate.
Dip the lollipop first in the batter and then in the breadcrumbs.
Shallow fry in oil until it is golden brown on all sides. Turn it occasionally so that the colour is even. Serve it with tomato ketchup or a dip of your choice.

title: Desi Mac n' Cheese
cooking_instructions: Bring water to boil in a deep pot. Add salt to it. Add the macaroni and boil it for the required amount of time mentioned in the packet. Strain it, run it under cold water and strain it well again. Coat the pasta with oil to avoid letting it stick. Keep it aside.
In another pot, add oil, add garlic, green chilli and saute for a few seconds.
Add the chopped onions and saute till it turns light brown.
Add the tomatoes and saute for a few minutes.
Add the masala powders and cook it for a minute.
Add butter, let it melt completely. Add the maida, let it combine well to form a roux-like texture.
Add milk and mix it well till there are no maida lumps.
Add a little water and mix well till the sauce thickens. Add the macaroni, mix it well till it is coated evenly with the sauce.
Add the cheddar and processed cheese slices, cover the pot on a low flame and let the cheese slices melt. Mix the pasta till the cheese dissolves.
Transfer the pasta to an oven proof dish, top it with mozzarella cheese and chopped bell peppers.

Bake it in the oven at 200 degrees till the cheese is melted and golden brown. Garnish it with coriander leaves and serve it hot. If you don't have an oven, add mozzarella cheese directly to the pot and mix it till it dissolves.

title: Chicken Jalfrezi
cooking_instructions: Marinate the chicken with all the ingredients. Set aside.
Heat oil in a pan and saute the vegetables- onion and capsicum on a high flame for 2 mins. Set aside.
Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds, ginger and garlic. Saute for a minute.
Add coriander powder, red chilli powder, turmeric powder and garam masala powder. Saute for a minute on low heat. Add the marinated chicken and mix. Cover and cook for 10 minutes on medium-low heat.
Add tomato ketchup, green chilli and the sauteed vegetables. Cook uncovered for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve.

title: Chilli Baby Corn
cooking_instructions: To a bowl, add the diced babycorn, maida, cornflour, salt, black pepper, water and mix well till the baby corn is coated with the batter and all the ingredients combine evenly.
Heat oil in a kadai, deep fry the baby corns to a golden brown color and keep it aside.
Heat a pan/wok, add oil, ginger and garlic and saute for a few seconds.
Add the diced onion and capsicum and toss it on a high flame for a few seconds.
Add the red chilli paste and cook it for 20-30 seconds.
Add ketchup, soy sauce and water. Mix well till all the ingredients combine evenly.
Add the baby corn and toss till it is coated evenly with the sauce. Add spring onions and mix well. Transfer it to a bowl, garnish it with chopped spring onions and serve it hot.

title: Lahori Mutton Curry
cooking_instructions: To a blender, add coriander leaves, mint leaves and green chillies and blend it to a fine paste.
Heat oil and ghee in a pan, add ginger garlic paste, cook it for a few seconds
Add the mutton, keep mixing it on a medium flame for 5 minutes.
Add green chillies, masala powders and cook for a minute.
Add the green paste, cook it with the mutton for a minute.
Add water, mix it well. Cover and let it cook on a medium to low flame for 40 minutes. Stir it occasionally. Season the dish with salt and pepper. Garnish with coriander leaves and Serve it hot.

title: Red Velvet Brownies
cooking_instructions: Preheat an oven at 180C. Prepare a greased mold with parchment paper.
Combine the melted warm butter and white chocolate in a bowl, mix to melt.
Add the sugars in the bowl. Mix until the sugar dissolves.
Add the eggs, red colour and whisk well. Mix until uniform and glossy. Add the vanilla essence
Add the dry ingredients and mix well. Add the chocolate and mix to combine.
Transfer the batter to the the mold and top with some chocolate, if needed.
Bake for 20 mins. Cool completely. De-mold and cut into squares.

title: Tender Coconut Chicken
cooking_instructions: Add the chicken to a cooking pot. To the chicken, add all the ingredients for the marination, and mix. Add the tender coconut water.
Pour coconut oil on top. Without mixing, place it in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.
Place the pot on the stove and cook until it starts to simmer.
Open the tender coconut and spoon the chicken mixture into it. Cover it with a piece of banana leaf, and seal it with some maida dough/chapathi dough.
Place it on the stove and cook on medium-high heat for 25 minutes. Remove the dough and serve it with parotta/kal dosa/plain uthappam.

title: Mushroom Dum Biryani
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the rice for 30 minutes
Heat oil in a pot, add cinnamon, cardamom, cloves and a bay leaf. Let it crackle
Add the onions and saute till it turns golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste, coriander and mint leaves. Saute for a minute.
Add the kashmiri chilli powder, mix well till its raw aroma is gone.
Add the tomatoes and curd and mix well. Cook the tomatoes till it turns mashy.
Add the mushrooms and saute till it lets out water. Cover and let it cook on a slow flame.
In the meantime, bring water to boil in a pot, add salt to it and add the soaked and strained rice to it. Boil the rice for 4 minutes exactly. Strain it well.
If the water evaporates, add ½ Cup of water. Take half of the mushroom masala separately in a bowl.
Start layering the dish with rice, fried onions, coriander and mint leaves, cashew nuts. Add a layer of the mushroom masala and repeat the same process.
Finally add the remaining fried onion, coriander and mint leaves, cashew nuts, ghee and  kewra water. Seal the pot tightly with silver foil and a fitting lid.
Place it on a preheated tawa for dum on a medium flame for 5 minutes and low flame for 5 minutes. Open the pot, fluff up the biryani gently. Serve it hot with rita and any sides of your choice.

title: Vegetable Kurma
cooking_instructions: In a pressure cooker, add the carrot, green peas, carrot, potatoes, chow chow and beans. To the vegetables, add salt, turmeric powder and water. Pressure cook for 1 whistle on high flame.
In a blender jar, make a paste of grated coconut, cashew nuts, poppy seeds and fennel seeds. Add ½ cup of water and blend into a fine paste.

Heat oil in a pan and add cardamom, cinnamon, cloves and stone flower. Saute the spices and then add the sliced onions and cook until the onion turns translucent. Add curry leaves and ginger garlic paste and saute for 2 minutes.
Add the chopped tomato, mint, red chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin powder and salt. Saute and cook for 5 more minutes until the raw taste of the masalas disappears.
Add ¾ cup of water. Add the cooked vegetables along with any excess water. Add the coconut paste. Cover and cook on medium-low flame for 5 minutes.
Add the whisked curd and coriander leaves and mix well. Turn off the heat. Serve hot with Parotta, Chapathi or Idiyappam.

title: Chicken Tangdi Kebab
cooking_instructions: To the chicken Legs, add ginger garlic paste, lemon juice and green chilli. Mix it well and let it marinate for 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, to a pan, add the spices required to make the masala and dry roast it till it gets aromatic. Transfer the spices to a blender and blend it to a fine powder
Prepare the second marination by mixing hung curd, lemon juice, cheese, besan flour,mint leaves, the masala and red chilli powder. Mix well till all the ingredients combine evenly.
Add the marination to the chicken drumsticks and mix well till it is coated with the marinade. Add a tablespoon of the ground masala to the marinade. Let the chicken marinate for 90 minutes.
Pour ghee on it and cover the bowl immediately. Let the chicken smoke for 5-7 minutes.
Heat a grill pan and grill the chicken on a medium flame turning in over at regular intervals to make sure it is cooked thoroughly.
Cover the pan and pour a little water into the pan to create some steam to cook the chicken.

Once the chicken is cooked completely, show it over the flame directly to get some smoky char marks on it. Garnish it with coriander leaves and serve it hot with a side of onion rings and lemon wedges.

title: Rose Coconut Ladoo
cooking_instructions: Make sure that the grated coconut pieces are not too large in size. If they are big, pulse grind them in a mixer to make smaller even-sized pieces. Heat ghee in a pan and add the coconut. Saute for 5 minutes on low heat, while mixing continuously, so that the colour does not darken.
Add sugar and cook until the sugar melts. This step would take 3-4 minutes.
Add milk powder, cardamom powder and rose syrup. Continue to cook on medium-low heat until the mixture is fully combined and leaves the side of the pan. Allow it to cool down slightly.

Mix it well using your hands to make the mixture slightly smooth. Shape it into ladoos. Roll it in the desiccated coconut while it is still moist. Serve it immediately or store for up to 3 days in the refrigerator.

title: Meghana-Style Boneless Chicken Biryani
cooking_instructions: Wash the Basmati rice 3 times and soak for 30 minutes.
Marinate the boneless chicken pieces with all the ingredients for the marination.
Heat oil in a pot and fry the chicken pieces for 5 minutes on high heat. Remove from the pot and set aside.
In the same oil, add onion and green chilli. Saute for 2 minutes.
Add ginger garlic paste, Kashmiri chilli powder, turmeric powder, garam masala powder, salt, mint leaves and coriander leaves. Saute for 2 minutes.
Add the tomato puree, mix and cook on medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the fried chicken and mix. Stir in the fresh cream, close the lid and remove from the heat.

Heat ghee in the pan. Add whole spices followed by green chilli, ginger garlic paste, turmeric powder, mint and coriander leaves. Mix to combine. Add curd, water and salt. Cover and bring the water to a boil.
Drain the soaked rice and add it to the water. Cook until the rice level rises and is almost visible from the top. Turn the heat to low, cover and cook for 12 minutes. Fluff up the rice gently.
To serve the biryani, add the rice to the bottom of a bowl. Add some of the chicken masala on top. Garnish with chopped mint & coriander leaves, and serve.

title: Namak Para
cooking_instructions: To a bowl, add the maida, ajwain, salt and ghee. Mix using your fingers until it turns crumbly, similar to fine breadcrumbs.
Add water gradually and knead it into a stiff dough. Cover and rest for 20 minutes.

Roll out a piece of dough flat, but make it thicker than a roti/chapathi. Cut it into 1-inch wide strips. Then cut it diagonally to make diamond shapes. Run a knife or spatula underneath to release the pieces.

Heat oil for deep-frying. Once hot, add the dough pieces and then reduce the heat to medium. Fry until the colour is light golden brown. This can be cooled and then stored in an airtight container for up to a month.

title: Jaggery Sandesh
cooking_instructions: Bring the milk to a boil. Turn off the flame.
In a bowl, combine vinegar and water together. Add it gradually to the milk and mix until the milk starts to curdle.
Strain it into a muslin cloth placed in a strainer. Then hang it and allow it to rest for 30 minutes.
Take the milk solids and knead it continuously for 5 minutes or until it becomes smooth.
In a pan, heat the jaggery over low-medium heat until it softens.
Add the kneaded chena (milk solids) and cardamom powder, and mix until fully combined.
Continue cooking on low heat for 5 minutes or until the mixture is smooth and starts to leave the sides of the pan. Transfer it to a mixer jar and blend it for 5-10 seconds.
Fold small roundels of it and then flatten it slightly on the top, to form the shape. This is best eaten on the same day itself, or can be stored in the refrigerator for 2 days.

title: Kadalai Urundai
cooking_instructions: Grind the peanuts into a coarse powder and add it into a mixing bowl.
Blend the jaggery into a fine paste and add it to the peanuts along with cardamom powder.
Add the ghee and mix thoroughly.
Apply some ghee in your palm before rolling it. Roll the mixture into balls of your desired size and serve.

title: No Cream Paneer Butter Masala
cooking_instructions: Empty the contents of the gravy paste into a pan. Heat it for around 30 seconds, while stirring.
Add milk and mix well. Bring it to a simmer and heat for 2 minutes.
Add the paneer cubes and cook for 2 more minutes.
Add the butter, mix and turn off the heat.

title: Karupatti Mysore Pak
cooking_instructions: Melt 1 ½  cups of ghee. Do not heat it up
Sieve besan flour into a bowl and add ¾ cup of the melted ghee and mix it well to avoid lumps. Reserve ¾ Cup of the melted ghee separately
In a Pan, add palm jaggery and ¾  cup of hot water and let the jaggery dissolve. Strain the dissolved jaggery to a pan and heat it up and boil it to single string consistency
Add the besan flour and ghee mixture to the jaggery. Mix it well till all the ghee is absorbed and the mixture combines evenly.

Keep adding the remaining ghee in small batches and mix till it all combines evenly. Keep stirring the mixture till it becomes thick and all the ghee is absorbed. Take a small piece of the mixture, cool it for a few seconds and check if you can roll it into a ball. If you can, turn off the flame immediately.
Line a pan with parchment paper and transfer the mixture to the pan and spread it out evenly. Let the mixture cool down well. Cut it into even rectangles and serve.

title: Dry Fruit Roll
cooking_instructions: Soak the figs in water for 15 minutes. Grind the figs and dates together into a slightly coarse paste.
Place a pan on the stove. Over medium heat, add poppy seeds and toast for 1-2 minutes. Remove from the pan and set aside.
Heat ghee in the same pan and add the chopped nuts and saffron. Toast on medium heat until it turns aromatic and just starts to turn golden. Remove it into a bowl and let it cool.
Add ghee into the same pan and add the dates and fig paste. Saute on medium heat until the moisture has evaporated, and it leaves the sides of the pan without sticking.
Remove from the pan and allow to cool lightly, until you can handle it comfortably. Take 2 tbsp of this mixture and add it to the nuts mixture. Mix it to combine evenly.
Roll out the fig mixture lightly using your fingers or a rolling pin.
Add the nuts mixture in the centre and roll it into a log, pinching the edges slightly to seal it.

Slightly wet your hands and give the log a final roll. Then coat it with the poppy seeds. Refrigerate for 30 mins. Slice it and serve! You can store it at room temperature for a few days, or in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

title: Kara Sev
cooking_instructions:
To a bowl, add all the ingredients and mix it well till it combines and forms a soft dough like texture. Let the dough rest for 10 minutes.
Grease a murukku press with oil and place some of the dough in the press and close it. Test it to see if the dough comes out of the press properly.
Heat oil in a kadai and press the dough into hot oil. Fry it on a low flame till it turns golden brown.Take it out of the oil and break it into small sticks. Let it cool down and serve it.

title: Kesar Badam Barfi
cooking_instructions: In a kadhai add the almond and pour in water to blanch the badams
Bring it to a boil and cook it for 5 mins, take it off the heat and let it cool
Peel off the skins and add them to a mixer along with saffron-infused milk and blend it into a fine paste
In a pan add the sugar and badam paste and cook it on a medium flame for 10 minutes or until it forms a ball
Let the mixture completely cool down and place it in between two parchment papers using a rolling pin roll it to a flat sheet (around ½ inch thick)
Add the badam and the reserved saffron and sprinkle it on top of the sheet and roll it down further more (around ¼ inch thick)
Cut it into your desirable shape and serve

title: Thaen Mittai
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl add the flour, baking powder, baking soda, yoghurt, food colour and ghee and mix it thoroughly
Pour in the water and knead it into a supple dough.
Let it rest for 3 hours.
Once the dough is rested roll it into a thick sheet and using a small piping nozzle or a small cap cut it into circles.
In a kadhai add the sugar, water and let it come to a boil.
Once it reaches a boil reduce the flame to a sim and cook for 5 minutes.
Fry the dough in a medium flame until crispy
Immediately dunk the balls into the warm sugar syrup and let it soak for at least 10 mins. Let it come to room temperature and serve

title: Watermelon Halwa
cooking_instructions: Blend the watermelon pulp from one medium sized watermelon and strain the juice. Add 2 tbsp of cornflour to the strained juice and whis well till there are no lumps.
Heat a pan, add ghee, add cashew and badam and saute for a few seconds.
Add the watermelon juice mixture and start cooking it on a low flame till the mixture starts to thicken. (around 7-8 minutes)
Add sugar and keep mixing till it dissolves.

Add 3 tbsp of ghee and mix well for another 3-4 minutes till the mixture combines evenly and thickens to a smooth texture and doesn't stick to the pan. Take it off the flame. Let it cool down a little and serve it warm.

title: No Cream Butter Chicken
cooking_instructions: In a pan add the butter masala gravy and heat it for 30 seconds.
Add chicken to the paste, mix it well and saute it for 2 minutes.
Add water, mix it well. Cover and cook low heat for 15 minutes.
Add milk and cook continuously for 4 minutes.
Add 1 tbsp of butter, mix it well and take it off the heat. Serve it hot!

title: Cookd Prawn Ghee Roast
cooking_instructions: Add the Cookd Ghee Roast Paste onto a pan with ¼ cup of water and bring it to a simmer.
Add prawns, cover and cook on medium heat for 3 minutes.
Finish it off with ghee and fried curry leaves. Serve it hot.

title: Kootanchoru
cooking_instructions: Wash the rice and dal together until the water runs clear
Add it to a pressure cooker and add 2.5 Cups of water and cook for 3 whistles on a medium flame and set aside.
In a mixer jar add the coconut, garlic, shallots, fennel and red chillies and blend into a smooth paste.

In a kadhai pour peanut oil and coconut oil, throw in the mustard seeds and once it crackles add in the cumin seeds and fenugreek seeds along with the urad dal. Saute until the urad dal turns golden. Add the green chillies and onion and saute until it turns translucent, Now add the moringa leaves and saute until it wilts.
Add the drumsticks and saute for 2 minutes, add potatoes and plantain, saute it for 2 minutes, then add the brinjal and saute.
Add tomatoes, salt, turmeric and chilli powder to the vegetables and cook the tomatoes until soft.
Add the ground paste to the vegetables and cook until the raw smell goes away(around 2 minutes)
Add the cooked rice and dal to the vegetables, mash the rice and cook for a few more minutes. Adjust seasoning and serve

title: Chilli Mushroom Bao
cooking_instructions: Add the yeast to the lukewarm water and let it bloom for 15 to 20 minutes.
In a bowl, add maida, cornflour, salt and sugar. Mix it well.

Add the bloomed yeast water and mix it well till it forms a soft dough. Knead the dough till it becomes elastic (it well become sticky, add flour if necessary and knead it). Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it ferment for 1 ½ hours.
In a pan, heat oil, add ginger and garlic. Saute them for a minute.
Add onions and saute till it becomes translucent. Add the mushrooms, mix it well till it lets out a little water.
Add soy sauce, tomato ketchup and mix till it combines evenly.
Add the chopped spring onions, mix well. Keep the mixture aside and let it cold down.
Place the fermented piece of dough on a flat surface and roll it into a thick sheet. Do not roll it too thin.
Use any round lid or bowl and cut circles out of the dough. Gently take out the excess dough. Apply oil on each disc and fold it into a half moon.

Set up a steamer, line it with parchment paper on the bottom. Place the buns in the steamer and let it steam for 10 minutes. Keep a check on the water level. Take it out of the steamer and let it rest for 2 minutes. Gently open the bao and add the filling into it. Garnish it with spring onions and serve it hot.

title: Old Delhi Mutton Biryani
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak basmati rice for 30 minutes. Strain it and keep it aside.
Heat a pot, add oil and ghee. Add cinnamon, black cardamom and let it crackle.
Add the onions and saute till it turns golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute.
Add kashmiri red chilli powder and saute for a few seconds.
Add the mutton pieces and saute on a high flame for 2-3 minutes.
Add curd, mint leaves, garam masala and mix well for a minute. Add water, salt, mix well and bring it to a boil. Cover the pot and cook it for 40 minutes on a low flame.
Meanwhile heat a pot, add oil and ghee. Add bay leaves, star anise, black cardamom and black peppercorns and let it crackle.
Add the sliced onions and saute till it turns golden brown.
Add water, lemon juice and salt. Bring it to a boil.
Add the soaked rice and boil the rice for 4 minutes. Take out some of the peppercorns. Strain the rice.

Layer the rice over the biryani with fried onions, coriander, mint and cashewnuts. Top it of with ghee and cover the pot tightly. Place it on a preheated tawa for dum for 5 minutes on a medium flame and 10 minutes on a low flame. Open the pot, fluff the rice and serve it hot

title: Achari Chicken Masala
cooking_instructions: Marinate the chicken with the ingredients listed for marination. Mix well till all the ingredients combine evenly. Marinate the chicken for 1 hour.
Heat a piece of coal, put it in a small bowl and place it on top of the chicken. Add a spoon of ghee to the coal and cover the bowl immediately. Let the chicken smoke for 5-7 minutes.
Heat a pan, add oil and ghee, add cinnamon, cardamom and cloves. Let it crackle.
Add onions and saute till it turns golden brown.
Add the tomatoes and cook it till it is mushy.
Add the marinated chicken and cook it with the onions and tomatoes for 5 minutes.
Add water if necessary. Mix well
Cover and cook the chicken on a low flame for 10 minutes. Finish it with a little fresh cream. Serve it hot with rice/roti.

title: Mahabalipuram Tawa Fish Fry
cooking_instructions: Wash the fish and make a few slits on both sides of the fish

Heat oil in a pan to shallow fry, once the oil is hot, add the fish to the pan. Ensure caution, oil might splatter. Cook each side for 3 minutes or until the fish is crispy and cooked. Remove from the oil and set this aside.
In a pan, add oil, finely chopped onion and saute until the onions turn translucent.
Add the ginger garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder and salt. Add 1 cup of water and cook the masala for 3 minutes.
Add the lemon juice and curry leaves.
Add the fried fish to the pan and coat the masala on the fish, flip and cook for 1 minute each side.
Remove from the pan, serve hot with a refreshing cold drink.

title: Restaurant Style Chicken Lababdar
cooking_instructions: Marinate the chicken with curd, lemon juice, and salt. Let it rest for 1 hour.
Heat oil in a pan, add oil and ghee. Add cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, mace, and let it crackle.
Add onion paste and cook it till it starts to turn golden brown. Add ginger garlic paste and saute for few seconds
Add the tomato paste and masala powders. Cook it well for 2 minutes.
Add water, the marinated chicken and mix well. Cover and cook the chicken for 10 minutes on a medium to low flame.

Add cashew paste, kasoori methi, cream, coriander and mix well till it combines well with
the chicken mixture. Garnish it with coriander leaves and cream. Serve it hot with rice or roti

title: Honey Cake
cooking_instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c. In a bowl, mix together the curd and sugar until the sugar has dissolved.
Add oil and vanilla essence. Whisk for a few seconds until it is well mixed.
Place a sieve over the bowl. Add in maida, baking powder and baking soda. Sieve it into the bowl. Whisk just until it is all mixed together. Do not overmix.
Add the milk and mix it to a smooth consistency.
Pour it into a baking pan lined with baking paper. Bake at 180°c for 25 mins. Allow the cake to cool completely.
To make the honey syrup, add sugar and water to a pan. Cook until the sugar dissolves.
Add the honey, mix and remove from the heat. Spread this over the cake to soak the cake.
Heat Jam in a pan over low heat until it melts. Add a splash of water if required.
Spread this in an even layer over the cake. Sprinkle desiccated coconut to decorate the cake. Slice and serve!

title: Tandoori Paneer Pizza
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl add the cubed paneer along with all the spice and mustard oil, marinate it and set aside
Take a pizza base and spread the Cookd Butter Masala Gravy evenly
Add the cheese then add the toppings and the marinated paneer.
Transfer the pizza into a baking tray and bake it at 210°c for 12 mins or until the cheese attains some colour.

title: Karuveppillai Yera Thokku
cooking_instructions: Add the ingredients for pureeing to a blender and blend them to a fine paste.
Heat oil in a pan, add fennel, cumin seeds, curry leaves and let them crackle.
Add the onions and saute till they turn golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste and cook it for a few seconds.
Add the tomatoes and masala powders and cook it till the tomatoes start to mash. Add the curry leaf paste and cook it well for a minute.
Add a little water, mix it and cover the pan. Let it cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Add the prawns to the thokku, add salt and mix well and mix well for another 7-10 minutes till the prawns are completely cooked. Garnish it with fried curry leaves and serve it hot with rice, parotta or any tiffin item.

title: Spinach and Corn Lasagna
cooking_instructions: Prepare a dough by mixing maida, salt, water and olive oil. Knead it well. Cover the dough and keep it aside.
Heat a pan, add butter and let it melt. Add onions and garlic and saute till the onions turn translucent.
Add corn and saute for 2 minutes.
Add spinach and mix till it is cooked.
Add maida and mix well till the whole mixture turns crumble and cook the maida on a low flame till it doesn't smell raw anymore.
Add milk and mix on a medium flame till it starts to turn thick like white sauce.
Season the mixture and add cheese if you’d like.
Add oregano and mix for a few seconds. Keep the mixture aside.
Dust a flat top with maida, roll out the dough into a thin sheet and dust flour on it.
Cut it into even squares or rectangles depending on the shape of the pan.

Grease the baking pan with oil or butter, place the lasagna sheets at the bottom of the pan till all of the space is covered and sprinkle mozzarella cheese. Top it with the spinach and corn mixture and spread it evenly. Repeat the same process for 2 more layers.
Cover the pan with silver foil and bake it for 25 minutes at 180-200 degrees.
Once it bakes, take off the foil, sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top and bake it uncovered till the cheese on top turns brown. Cut it and serve it hot. Enjoy!!

title: Nasi Goreng
cooking_instructions: Heat a wok, add oil, garlic, and ginger. Add dried shrimp paste and saute for a minute.
Add shallots and saute on a high flame for a few seconds.
Add shrimp/prawns and saute for a minute.
Add red chilli paste and cook it for a few seconds.
Make a small gap in the middle of the mixture, add the eggs, let it cook and scramble it well.
Add boiled rice and toss it till all the ingredients combine evenly.
Add fish sauce, brown sugar, soy sauce and mix till they all combine evenly. Check the taste and season it accordingly.
Add spring onions, give it a final toss and transfer it to a bowl. Top it with a sunny side up, garnish with spring onions and serve it hot.

title: Mutton Ghee Roast Tacos
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pressure cooker. Add the mutton pieces and allow it to cook for 2-3 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Add the Mangalore Ghee Roast paste and saute lightly. Add the water, cover and pressure cook for 1 whistle on high heat. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 35 minutes.
Once the pressure settles, open the lid and take out the mutton pieces. Reserve the remaining liquid for later.
Shred it using a fork or using your hands. To it, add cabbage (if using).
In another bowl, mix together the onion and coriander leaves. Set this aside.
Take a mini chapathi and place some of the shredded mutton in it. Add some of the onion & coriander leaves mixture. Add mozzarella cheese and then cover it in half.
Grease a pan lightly with oil. Place the folded tacos and toast it on medium heat for 1 minute on each side. Serve it with the gravy from the pressure cooker. Dip the tacos in it and enjoy!

title: Aloo Matar
cooking_instructions: Heat  oil in a pan, add cumin, ginger, garlic, green chillies and let it crackle.
Add the onions saute till it turns light brown. Add green chilli and saute for a few seconds.
Add the masala powders and cook it for a minute on a low flame.
Add the potatoes, mix it well and let it fry on a high flame for 2 minutes while mixing continuously.
Add the tomatoes and saute till they get soft.
Add water, Mix it well. Cover and let it cook till the water almost evaporates.
Add the green peas when there is little water remaining. Mix it well.
Season the mixture with salt and sugar. Add the chopped coriander leaves, mix it well. Transfer it to a bowl, garnish it with a coriander sprig. Serve it hot with rice/roti.

title: Chicken Ghee Roast Kebab
cooking_instructions: Add boneless chicken pieces/chicken mince to a mixer jar. Grind it until it turns smooth.
To a bowl, add chicken mince and ghee roast paste. Mix until fully combined.
Make a space in the centre, then place a metal bowl with a hot charcoal. Pour some ghee on it, and cover it immediately once smoke starts coming out. Cover for 4 minutes, then remove the charcoal.

Take a small portion of the mixture and shape it around a skewer/seekh. Wet your hands and form the shape and then freeze it for 20 minutes. Take it out and shape it once more. It becomes easier to handle once it is frozen.

Heat a pan or grill pan and grease it lightly with oil. Place the kebabs on it and cook on medium-low heat for 10 minutes, flipping it regularly and brushing it with ghee. Serve it with a squeeze of lemon along with thin onion slices.

title: Corn Cutlets
cooking_instructions: Heat groundnut oil in a pan and add the onion and garlic. Saute for 3 minutes or until the onion turns translucent.
Add the coriander powder, red chilli flakes, salt and black pepper powder. Add the corn and mix. Cook until the corn has softened, then remove from the heat.
Grind 3/4th of the mixture and add it to a bowl.
Add the remaining corn too. Add flour and baking powder, and mix to form a mixture.
Using wet hands, make cutlets out of the corn mixture. Place them on a greased plate.
Heat oil in a frying pan. Cook for 3 minutes on each side, then remove from the pan. Serve with tomato ketchup.

title: Kung Pao Spaghetti
cooking_instructions: Bring salted water up to a boil. Add the spaghetti and cook until al-dente for about 7 mins.
Strain the pasta, add oil to prevent sticking and set aside some of the boiled pasta water, about ¾ Cup.
Combine the ingredients for the sauce and set aside in a separate bowl.
In a wok, heat oil and add the red chilli, ginger and garlic.
Add the peanuts and cashew nuts, fry until golden.
Add the spring onion whites, onions and capsicum and toss on a high flame.
Add the pasta and the sauce.
Add some of the pasta water to adjust the consistency.
Finally add spring onions and serve immediately.

title: One Pot Mexican Rice
cooking_instructions: Wash and Soak the rice for 30 minutes
Heat oil in a pot, add garlic and saute for a few seconds.
Add the chopped onions and jalapenos and saute till it turns translucent.
Add paprika and cumin powder and cook it for a minute on a medium flame.
Add tomato puree, mix well. Cook the tomato puree on a medium flame till its raw aroma goes.
Add boiled rajma, sweet corn and bell peppers and mix well.
Add the soaked rice and mix gently for a minute.
Add water, bring it to a boil, cover and cook it on a low flame till all the water is absorbed. Fluff up the rice. Garnish with coriander leaves. Serve it hot or you can make burritos with it.

title: Garlic Kuzhambu
cooking_instructions: Soak the tamarind in water for 15 mins. Set aside. You can continue with the remaining steps while it is soaking.
Heat oil in a pan and add cumin, black peppercorn, fenugreek seeds, garlic and curry leaves. Cook on low heat until the garlic starts to brown lightly.
Turn off the heat and allow it to cool down slightly. Then add it to a mixer jar along with tomatoes. Grind it into a paste.
Heat gingelly oil in a pan and crackle mustard seeds. Then add small onion, curry leaves, garlic and salt. Cook for 5 minutes on medium heat, or until the onion and garlic softens.
Add turmeric powder, coriander powder and Kashmiri chilli powder. Saute on low heat for 2 minutes.
Add the ground paste and saute for a minute.
Drain and add the tamarind pulp. Cook it on low heat until the oil starts to float on top.
Add jaggery and mix. Remove from the heat and serve with rice, idli or kal dosai/uthappam.

title: Chicken Poppy Seeds Masala
cooking_instructions: Soak all the ingredients except ginger garlic paste for 30 minutes in warm water.
Grind it into a paste along with ginger garlic paste and set aside.
To a pan, heat oil and add clove, cinnamon and cardamom, followed by onion, green chillli and ginger garlic paste. Saute for 2 minutes.
Add chicken, turmeric powder and salt. Saute for 5 minutes.
Add red chilli powder and mix for a minute. Then add water and bring to a boil. Cover and cook for 15 minutes on low heat.
Add the previously prepared paste and mix. Continue cooking for 5 minutes. Garnish with coriander leaves, and serve.

title: Apple Cake
cooking_instructions: Crumble the cake using your fingers. Set this aside. This will give around 3 cups of cake crumbs.
In a pan, heat sugar and water together till the sugar dissolves.
Add milk and cook until it starts to thicken, around 3-4 minutes.
Turn the heat to low. Add butter, cocoa powder and desiccated coconut. Mix until there are no lumps.
Add the cake crumbs and mix well. Continue to cook on low heat for 5 minutes or until the mixture turns thick and the excess moisture is removed.

Turn off the heat and allow it to cool down. Roll it into balls and coat it in the desiccated coconut. Serve it as it is, or chilled in the refrigerator. This will last for up to 2 days in the fridge.

title: Shahi Mutton Korma
cooking_instructions: Soak the almonds and poppy seeds in hot water for 30 minutes.
Boil onions and green chillies. Let it cool down.

Peel the skin of almonds. Add the soaked almonds and poppyseeds to a blender, add a little water and blend it to a thick fine paste. Also, blend the boiled onions and green chilli into a fine pure and keep it aside.
Heat oil in a pan, add the whole spices, mix well for a few seconds.
Add ginger garlic paste, mutton and saute for a few minutes.
Add the ground onion paste and saute for a minute.

Add curd mix well for a minute till it has combined with the meat. Add water, mix well and bring it to a boil. Cover and cook the mutton for 30-40 minutes on a medium to low flame, stirring occasionally.

Open the pot, give it a stir and check if the mutton is cooked. Cover and cook it for a while longer if it isn’t cooked. Add water if necessary. Add the almond paste to the mixture, mix it till it has dissolved and combined with the gravy. Mix well till the fat starts floating on top.
To fresh cream, add nutmeg powder, garam masala, cardamom powder and milk. Mix it well and keep it aside
Add the cream mixture, season it, add ghee and mix well till all the ingredients combine evenly. Transfer it to a bowl, garnish with coriander leaves. Serve it hot with roti, naan or rice.

title: Healthy Chickpea Salad
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the chickpeas for 6 hours and strain it.
Transfer the chickpeas to a cooker, add enough water till the chickpeas are submerged. Add ½ tsp of salt and pressure cook it for 5 whistles. Let the steam reduce gradually and strain the chickpeas.
Heat a pan, add very little oil and add the chickpeas.
Add kashmiri chilli and cumin powder. Mix well on a medium flame for 2 minutes.
To prepare the dressing, mix olive oil, honey and black pepper powder together.
To a mixing bowl, add lettuce, onion, tomato, cucumber, chickpeas and the dressing. Mix well till all of it combines evenly. Season the salad with salt. Mix well and serve.

title: Sweet and Sour Chicken
cooking_instructions: To the chicken, mix the remaining ingredients required to coat and mix it well till it is combined evenly.
Heat oil in a kadai and fry the chicken to a golden brown colour on a medium flame.
Heat a wok, add oil. Add chopped ginger and garlic. Saute for a few seconds.
Add the diced onions and bell peppers and saute on a high flame for 10-15 seconds.
Add the sauces and mix well.
Add the chicken and toss it with the sauces, onions and bell peppers on a high flame. Transfer it to a bowl. Garnish with chopped spring onions and sesame seeds.

title: Dates and Walnut Cake
cooking_instructions: Chop the seedless dates, and let it soak with lukewarm milk in a bowl.
Add sugar and oil to a bowl and blend till it combines well.
Add eggs and whisk till it starts to get fluffy. Add vanilla essence and wisk them mixture again till the eggs turn fluffy and flows like a ribbon.
Sieve in the dry ingredients and fold the mixture till it becomes a smooth batter.

Transfer it to a baking pan lined with parchment paper. Add the chopped walnuts. To bake it in the oven, preheat the oven to 180 degrees and bake it for 25 minutes. Check with a toothpick if the cake is done.  Let it cool down and then demould it.

For a no oven method, preheat a pot on a medium flame, Place a small vessel or stand at the bottom of the vessel. Place the baking pan on the vessel inside and close the pot tightly. Bake it on a medium flame for 45 minutes. Do not open the pot during the course of the baking.
Let the cakes cool down. Demould it carefully. Cut and serve.

title: Cookd Fried Chicken Burger
cooking_instructions: Cut the chicken breast in two to get thinner slices. Add the Secret Marinade Blend to the chicken. Mix well till the meat is coated evenly with the marinade
Prepare a batter using 5 tbsp of the Ultra Crispy Fry Mix and 150ml of water.

Coat it evenly with the dry Ultra Crispy Fry Mix first. Dip it in the batter and coat it throughout. Coat it with the Ultra Crispy Fry Mix again and dust it in a downward motion to form the crust (crinkles)
Deep fry it in medium hot oil at first for 2 minutes and then increase the flame and let it fry till it turns golden brown and crispy.
For the seasoning oil, add the seasoning to a bowl. Take the hot oil and add it, and mix. Immediately coat the chicken with the seasoning oil.
Make the sauce by mixing the mayonnaise and tomato ketchup together.
Assemble the burgers using a toasted bun. Spread some of the sauce and place the fried chicken piece on it. Place some lettuce and tomato on it. Cover with the bun and it’s ready!

title: Tandoori Paneer Maggi
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan on high heat. Add onion, capsicum, paneer and red chilli powder. Saute on high heat for 1 minute.
Add the butter masala paste and saute for 30 seconds.
Add the water and bring it to a simmer. Then remove from the heat.
Place a metal bowl in the centre with a hot charcoal. Pour a few drops of oil on it and cover with a lid for 3 minutes. Remove the charcoal.
Bring water to a boil in a pot. Add the maggi and boil for 1 minute.
Strain out the maggi and add it to the butter masala gravy. Mix well and add butter, coriander leaves and sprinkle chaat masala. Mix and serve hot!

title: Batter Fried Squid
cooking_instructions: Clean the squid rings, pat dry. Add Salt, Pepper and Maida. Mix well.
Add all the ingredients to form a light batter.
Heat oil in a pan for deep frying. Coat the squid with the wet batter and deep fry in hot oil until golden brown and crispy. Serve hot.

title: Burnt Garlic Vegetable Fried Rice
cooking_instructions: Heat a wok, add oil and garlic. Saute the garlic till it turns brown but not burnt.
Add spring onion whites and saute for a few seconds.
Add the vegetables and toss it on a high flame for a few seconds.
Add the rice, salt, black pepper and soy sauce. Toss it well till all the ingredients combine evenly.
Add spring onions and give it a final toss. Transfer it to a bowl/place, Garnish with spring onions and serve it hot.

title: Dhaba Chana Masala
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the channa in water for 6 hours and strain it. Transfer the strained channa to a pressure cooker, add 1 cup water and ¼ tsp salt. Pressure cook the channa for 5 whistles and turn off the flame. Let the flame reduce gradually
Open the cooker, add 1 packet of the highway dhaba curry and start cooking it on a medium flame. Keep cooking till the gravy starts to thicken.
Add sliced chillies, coriander and dry mango powder. Mix well for a minute. Transfer it to a bowl and serve it hot with roti/parotta etc,.

title: Meen Kozhambu
cooking_instructions: Grind the tomato and shallots together into a paste.
In a pan, add oil, once the oil is hot, add mustard seeds, and fenugreek seeds and let it splutter. Add dry red chillies, curry leaves.
Add the ground shallot and tomato paste, garlic and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the red chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, turmeric powder salt and continue to cook.
Add the extracted tamarind juice and cook for 10 minutes adding some water. Add the jaggery. Add the fish and cook for 2 mins. Remove from heat and garnish with coriander leaves.

title: Chicken Bhuna Masala
cooking_instructions: To the chicken, add lemon juice, salt and turmeric powder. Cover and rest until the other steps are done.
Place a pan on the stove over medium-low heat. Add all the spices and saute for a few minutes until it turns aromatic. Allow it to cool down slightly, then grind it into a fine powder.
Heat oil in a kadai/pan. Add onion and saute until it starts to turn golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste and green chilli. Saute for 2 minutes. Reduce the heat to low and add the red chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and the prepared spice mix. Saute for a minute.
Add the tomato and continue to cook until the tomatoes soften.
Add the chicken and saute on high heat for 3-4 minutes.
Reduce the flame to low, cover and cook for 5 minutes.

At this point, the chicken will start releasing water. Add beaten curd and mix well. Cover and cook for 5 more minutes on low heat. Open the lid and cook on high heat, while stirring continuously, until the excess liquid gets evaporated.
Add coriander leaves and Kasuri methi. Give it a final stir and remove from the heat. Serve with rice, roti or any Indian bread.

title: Mutton Pot Biryani
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the rice for 30 minutes. Bring the water to a boil. Add, ghee and salt , then add the soaked and strained rice, boil it for exactly 4 minutes and strain the rice.
In a pot, add the mutton and the remaining ingredients required for the marination. Mix it well till all the ingredients combine evenly and let the mutton marinate for 2 hours.
Prepare a soft dough by mixing and kneading atta and water together.
Once the mutton is marinated, keep the pot on a medium flame, add ghee and start cooking the mutton.
Add water, mix it well. Cover and cook the mutton for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add a part of the rice, then add the fried onion, coriander and mint leaves, fried onion, cashew nuts. Repeat the same process for one more layer and finally add ½ tsp of kewra water.
Close the pot, and seal the top tightly all around with the prepared dough and cook the biryani on a low flame for 10 minutes. Open the pot after dum and serve it hot along with raita.

title: Spicy Hyderabadi Paneer
cooking_instructions: Heat a pan, add garlic cloves, green chilli, diced coconut, sesame seeds and peanuts and saute on a medium flame for a minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook till it becomes soft.
Add red chilli powder, turmeric powder and saute for a few seconds.
Add water, mix well. Cover and cook the mixture on a low flame for 5 minutes. Let the mixture cool down. Transfer it to a blender and blend to a fine paste.
In another pan, add ghee and oil. Add cinnamon, cardamom, and cloves. Let it crackle.
Add cumin and let it crackle.
Add the chopped onions and saute till it turns light brown. Add dried Kashmiri red chillies. Add Ginger Garlic Paste and saute for a few seconds.
Add the prepared tomato paste and cook it on a low flame for 2 minutes.
Add water and mix well till is becomes a smooth gravy. Add red chilli powder, salt and sugar. Mix it well.

Add the paneer cubes. Add extra water if the gravy thickens too much. Mix well till the paneer is coated with the gravy. Cook it on a low flame for 2 minutes. Take it off the flame, garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot with rice, parotta or roti.

title: Cooker Chocolate Cake
cooking_instructions: Add eggs to a bowl, beat the eggs till it starts to become fluffy.
Add half of the powdered sugar to the eggs first and whisk it for a few seconds.
Add the remaining sugar and oil and whisk till the mixture become fluffy and creamy.
Sieve in the maida, cocoa, baking powder and soda. Use an spatula and fold in the mixture till all the ingredients combine evenly.
Add milk and fold the mixture gently till it all combines evenly into one smooth batter.
Grease a pressure cooker with oil, and place a sheet of parchment paper. Brush some oil on the parchment paper. Pour the batter into the cooker. Tap the cooker on the table to burst any air pockets.

Cover the cooker tightly and place it on a preheated tawa and bake it on a low flame for 40 minutes and let the cake cool down completely. Poke it with a toothpick to check if it is cooked throughout. Use a knife and release the cake gently from the sides.
Place a plate on the cooker, turn the cooker over along with the plate and demould the cake. Take off the parchment paper gently. Add topping of your choice and enjoy

title: Kathirikai Podi Fry
cooking_instructions: Add all the ingredients i.e., mustard seeds, cumin seeds,urad dal,Fenugreek seeds, Hing, turmeric powder, coriander seeds,Bengal gram,red chillies ,garlic cloves & curry leaves. Roast all, till the seeds become golden brown , in a low or medium flame. Keep it aside and let it cool.
Then in a food processor or Grinding mixer add all the roasted ingredients and add salt in it. Make a fine powder.
Cut and slit the Brinjal into four halves( do not cut till the end).
Now stuff the powder into the Brinjal.
Now add 5 tbsp oil into a pan or kadai. Add the stuffed brinjals one by one into the kadai.
Close the lid and cook it in a low -flame, until the brinjals turn soft. Ready to serve.Hope u try and enjoy it. It can be served with rice and as a side dish.

title: Hariyali Chicken Tikka
cooking_instructions: Marinate with the ginger garlic paste, salt, mustard oil, and 1 tbsp of lemon juice. Marinate for 20 minutes.
Grind mint, coriander leaves, green chilli and 1 tbsp of lemon juice to a fine paste, adding water as required to grind.
To a bowl, add the hung curd. Add the coriander paste along with turmeric powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder, amchoor powder and ½ tsp of chaat masala. Whisk until smooth.
Add this marinade to the chicken and mix well to combine. And refrigerate for at least 20 minutes.
Heat a grill pan and grease with oil. Add the chicken pieces, making sure not to overcrowd the pan. Cook on a medium-high flame. Turn over after 4 minutes and cook for a further 4 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pan into a bowl. Add melted butter and ¼ tsp of chaat masala. Mix well.

title: Mushroom Risotto
cooking_instructions: In a pan melt the butter and add the herbs, garlic and onion, saute for 30 seconds.
Add sliced mushroom and salt, and saute until well browned( around 2 minutes).
Add the unwashed jeera rice and mix it well, pour the water and milk gradually and whisk vigorously.
Once all the liquid is absorbed and a pongal like texture is attained, switch off the flame and the chopped coriander, and processed cheese.

title: Hyderabadi Majestic Chicken
cooking_instructions: Add the chicken strips to a bowl, add maida, cornflour, egg, salt, pepper, ginger garlic paste and  mix well till the chicken is coated well with the batter.
Heat oil in a kadai, deep fry the chicken to a golden brown colour and keep it aside.
Heat a pan, add oil,garlic, curry leaves and green chilli. Saute for a few seconds.
Add mint leaves and saute for a few seconds.
Add the masala powders and cook them on a low flame for a minute.
Add soy sauce and fried chicken, mix well.
Add the whisked curd, season it and toss till it is coated with the sauce. Transfer it to a bowl, garnish with chopped coriander leaves. Serve it hot.

title: Cookd Ambur Chicken Biryani
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
In a pressure cooker, add the Cookd ambur biryani paste and the washed chicken pieces. Mix it for a few seconds. Add water, and mix till they combine.
Once it starts to heat up, add the soaked and strained rice. Mix it gently till the rice is submerged.

Cover the cooker and pressure cook it for 2 whistles on a medium flame. Turn off the flame after 2 whistles and let the steam reduce gradually for about 10 minutes. Open the cooker, add the seasoning oil, fluff up the rice and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Wedding Chicken Biryani
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak basmati Rice for 20 mins
In a pressure cooker add the Cookd Wedding Biryani Paste and Chicken. Saute the chicken for 2 minutes, pour water. Once the water starts to heat up, add the soaked and strained rice.
Pressure cook on a medium flame for 2 whistles. Let the steam reduce gradually for about 10 mins. Open the pressure cooker, add the seasoning oil, fluff up the rice. Serve it hot with raita

title: Cookd Wedding Veg Biryani
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak basmati Rice for 20 mins.
In a pressure cooker add the Cookd Wedding Biryani Paste and add the vegetables along with it. Saute the vegetables for 2 minutes, pour 2 cups of water and let it heat up

Add the soaked and strained rice and pressure cook on a medium flame for 2 whistles. Let the steam reduce gradually for 10 mins. Open the cooker, add the seasoning oil, fluff up the biryani and serve it hot with raita.

title: Chicken Seekh Kebab
cooking_instructions: Divide the chicken mince into 2 equal parts. To one half, add all the ingredients except coriander, mint, salt and besan flour. Mix the ingredients till they combine evenly.
Transfer it to a blender and blend them to a fine pasty texture. Mix the blended mixture with the remaining chicken mince. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well till they all combine.
Place a heated piece of coal on top of the mince mixture. Add ghee, cover the bowl tightly and let it smoke for 5-7 minutes. Refrigerate the mixture for about 30 minutes.
Oil your palms and press the chicken on a skewer till it is set.
Heat a grill pan, add oil and grill the kebabs on a medium to low flame for 6-7 minutes on each side. Serve it hot with naan, lemon, onion rings and mint chutney.

title: Oats Baby Corn Salt and Pepper
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl add the cut baby corn along with oats and corn flour, add salt, pepper and water. Combine everything thoroughly, it should be a thick batter.
Fry the baby corn and set aside.
In a wok or kadhai add oil, ginger, garlic, green chilli and spring onion bulbs. Saute for 30 seconds on a medium flame.
Add the onion and capsicum petals and saute for 30 more seconds.
Now pour in the fried baby corn and mix thoroughly, add salt, pepper and soy sauce and give it one final mix and serve.

title: Nawabi Paneer
cooking_instructions: Soak a pinch of saffron in ¼ cup of milk.
In a pan add ghee and whole spices and cook until aromatic.

Add roughly chopped onions, green chillies, almonds, cashews and ginger garlic paste and saute. Pour 2 cups of water, curd, cover and cook for 15 minutes. Cool down the mixture and blend it into a fine paste
In a kadai pour in the paste, add milk and salt.
Lower the flame and add fresh cream and kasuri methi.
Mix thoroughly and add the paneer mix gently and cook for 2 minutes. Add garam masala and pour the saffron infused milk as a garnish.

title: Tawa Fish Fry
cooking_instructions: Mix all the the ingredients together to make a paste, keep it aside.
Wash, clean and prep the fish, make slits on the sides with a knife. Apply the paste to fish until it is evenly coated and refrigerate it for an hour.
Heat the pan, add oil and once the oil is hot, add the fish and let it cook for 3 mins before flipping to the other side and cook for further 3 minutes.

title: Crab Roast
cooking_instructions: In a mixer grinder, add all the ingredients in the masala paste and grind it into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a pan, add onion and saute until golden brown.
Add tomato and cook until it's mushy.
Add the masala paste and cook for 2 mins. Add turmeric powder, chilli powder, coriander powder, and salt and mix well.
Add the crab, mix well and add water. Cover and Cook for 10 minutes.
Add the black pepper powder and curry leaves, mix well and remove from the heat.

title: Instant Tomato Dosa
cooking_instructions: Grind all the ingredients in a mixer.
Add it to a bowl. Add water, rava, rice flour, wheat flour and mix well. Allow it to rest for 10 minutes. Add salt and water, as needed. It should be a thin consistency.

Heat a pan to high and grease with oil lightly. Pour the batter from a height. Do not fill up the holes that form, except very large gaps. The preparation is similar to rava dosa. Pour oil around the edges and cook until you see brown spots start to appear. Reduce the flame to medium-low. Cover and cook for 30 seconds.
Sprinkle onion and coriander leaves around the dosa. Remove from the pan. Serve hot with chutney, podi or plain.

title: Cookd Wedding Mutton Biryani
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes.
To  a pressure cooker add the biryani paste and mutton curry cut and mix for a few seconds.
Add 1 Cup of water, mix it and let the water start to heat up. Close the cooker and pressure cook the mutton on a medium flame for 7-9 whistles. Turn off the flame and let the steam reduce gradually.

Open the cooker and check if the mutton is cooked. If it isn't, close the cooker and cook it for 2 more whistles if necessary and let the steam reduce gradually. Open the cooker, and ½ Cup (125ml) of water. Add the soaked and strained rice, give it a gentle mix

Cover the cooker and pressure cook it for 2 whistles on a medium flame. Turn off the flame after 2 whistles and let the steam reduce gradually for about 10 minutes. Open the cooker, add the seasoning oil, fluff the rice and serve it hot with raita.

title: Cookd Ambur Mutton Biryani
cooking_instructions:
To  a pressure cooker add the Cookd ambur biryani paste and mutton curry cut and mix for a few seconds. Add 1 Cup (250ml) of water. Mix it and let the water start to heat up. Close the cooker and pressure cook the mutton on a medium flame for 7-9 whistles . Turn off the flame and let the steam reduce gradually. Open the cooker and check if the mutton is cooked.
If it isn't, close the cooker and cook it for 2 more whistles if necessary and let the steam reduce gradually

Add the soaked and strained rice, and add ½ Cup (125ml) of water.
Cover the cooker and pressure cook it for 2 whistles on a medium flame.Turn off the flame after 2 whistles and let the steam reduce gradually for about 10 minutes.Open the cooker, add the seasoning oil, fluff the rice and serve it hot with raita.

title: Veg Hot Pot Rice
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak basmati rice for atleast 20 mins. Add the rice to a cooker and add 1.5 times the quantity of water (1 ½ Cups). Pressure cook for 2 whistles and allow the steam to release naturally.
For the gravy: Heat oil in a wok and add the finely chopped aromatic vegetables.
Saute for a minute and add the mix vegetables of choice. Saute for 2 mins and add the sauces and seasonings.
Pour 2 cups of water and bring to a boil. Allow the vegetables to cook but still retain a crunch, about 6 mins.
Combine cornstarch in some water and add it to the gravy to thicken.
Allow the gravy to come to a boil and add the paneer/ tofu and finish with spring onion greens.
In a hot pot, add the rice and the gravy, garnish with sesame seeds and spring onion. Serve hot.

title: Tandoori Chicken
cooking_instructions: Make slits on the chicken pieces. This helps it absorb masala and also cook faster.

Apply all the ingredients for the 1st marination. Set aside for 30 minutes. This tenderizes the chicken and also helps get rid of excess moisture. You can also refrigerate it for longer or upto overnight.

Meanwhile, you can prepare the 2nd marination. For this, heat oil in a pan until it starts smoking. Then turn off the flame and allow it to cool down slightly, until the smoking stops. Add the red chilli powder and mix immediately, then transfer it into a bowl immediately.
To this bowl, add all the ingredients for the 2nd marination. Whisk until smooth and well combined.
Take the chicken and drain off any excess water. Add it to the 2nd marination and mix well to coat. Refrigerate again for at least 30 minutes, or even overnight.

To cook, you can use a flat pan or a grill pan. Heat oil in the pan and add the chicken. Cook on high heat for 1-2 minutes on each side, until it starts to cook and form a crust outside. Then reduce the flame to medium-low and continue cooking for around 20 minutes, flipping regularly.
Remove the chicken from the pan and place it in a bowl. Place a metal bowl inside with a hot charcoal. Add oil and immediately cover the bowl with a lid/aluminium foil. Rest for 2-3 minutes.

Open the lid and remove the charcoal. Add melted butter and chaat masala. Gently toss to coat the chicken. Serve it along with lemon wedges, onion rings and Tandoori mint chutney (we already have a recipe for you!

title: Cookd Ambur Veg Biryani
cooking_instructions: Wash the rice and soak it for 20 minutes
To a pressure cooker, add the Cookd ambur biryani paste and the vegetables and saute for a minute. Add water, let it heat up.
Add the soaked and strained rice and close the cooker tightly.

Pressure cook for 2 whistles on a medium flame. Turn off the flame after 2 whistles. Let the steam reduce gradually for about 10 minutes. Open the cooker, add the seasoning oil, fluff up the rice and serve it hot with raita.

title: Veg Shami Kebab
