cooking_instructions: In a bowl, add the rice flour, salt and ghee. Mix it lightly. Add hot/boiling water and mix it first using a spoon. Once it is cool enough to handle, knead it using your hands. Make small balls from the dough and set it aside.
Chop the Karupatti jaggery and heat it along with water till it melts. Strain it into another pot. Add more water to dilute it, then bring it to a boil.

Add the dough balls and cook it for around 10 minutes on low heat. Do not stir for the first 4-5 minutes. Mix rice flour with some water to form a slurry. Add this to the pot along with cardamom powder, and mix.
Turn off the heat, and add the milk and coconut milk. Mix it continuously in the remaining heat itself. Top it with grated coconut.

title: Pav Bhaji (OT)
cooking_instructions: Add the vegetables to a pressure cooker along with salt and water. If you don’t have any of the veggies, you can substitute it with more potato or any other vegetable. Pressure cook it for 3 whistles on medium-high heat. Once the pressure releases, strain out the vegetables from the water. Mash it using a potato masher or you can even use a fork/ladle.

Heat the Cookd Onion Tomato Masala in a pan. Add the capsicum and pav bhaji masala. Saute for 2 minutes. Add the mashed vegetables and mix. Add water and mix to get a smooth consistency. Add tomato ketchup and simmer for 3-4 minutes. Add butter and coriander leaves, and turn off the heat.
To serve, toast the buns with some butter until lightly golden brown. Serve with chopped onions, lemon wedge and a cube of butter.

title: Cookd Mutton Pallipalayam
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pressure cooker. Add curry leaves and onion. Saute until the onion turns soft and translucent. Add the mutton and Cookd Pallipalayam masala. Saute for 2 minutes.

Add water and mix. Cover and pressure cook for 15 minutes on medium heat (7-9 whistles). Allow the pressure to release gradually. Add the coconut chunks and curry leaves. Saute on medium-high heat until the mixture starts to thicken. Serve it hot with rice or parotta.

title: Cookd Chicken Pallipalayam
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan and add curry leaves. Add finely chopped onion and saute until it is soft and translucent. Add the chicken and the Cookd pallipalayam masala. Saute for 2 minutes.

Add water, cover and cook on low heat for 20 minutes. Open the lid and add coconut chunks and curry leaves. Continue to saute on high heat till the gravy is thick/at your desired consistency. Serve hot with rice.

title: Cookd Soya Pallipalayam
cooking_instructions:
To a bowl add the soya chunks, turmeric powder, salt. Add hot water and press it down and let it soak for 10 minutes. Strain and wash the soya. Squeeze out the water completely.
Heat oil in a pan, then add the curry leaves and onion. Saute until it is soft and translucent. Add in the soya and the Cookd pallipalayam masala. Saute for 2 minutes. 
Add water, cook for 5 minutes. Add the coconut chunks and curry leaves. Saute on medium heat until the gravy has thickened to your desired consistency. Serve it hot with rice.

title: Cookd Prawn Pallipalayam
cooking_instructions:
Heat oil in a pan. Add curry leaves and onion. Saute until translucent. Add Cookd Pallipalayam Masala and mix. Add the prawns and saute for 2 minutes. 
Add water, cover and cook for 3-4 minutes. Open the lid add the coconut chunks, open the lid and cook on high heat till the gravy thickens and reaches the desired consistency.

title: Cookd Mushroom Pallipalayam
cooking_instructions:
Heat oil in a pan. Add curry leaves and onion. Saute until the onion turns soft and translucent.  Add the Cookd pallipalayam masala and mix. Add the mushrooms and saute for 2 minutes. 
Add water, cover and cook for 5 minutes. Open the lid, add coconut chunks and cook on high heat until the gravy thickens and reaches the desired consistency. Serve hot with rice or as a starter!

title: Saiva Meen Kuzhambu
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, soak one lemon sized portion of tamarind with hot water. Keep it aside.
In another bowl, add besan flour, chilli powder, rock salt, turmeric powder, water and whisk it into a smooth batter.

Heat a pan, add oil. Add poppy seeds, fennel seeds and let it crackle. Add the cashew and coconut and saute on a medium flame till it starts to turn golden. Transfer it to a blender and blend it to a fine paste.

Heat a tawa, and make dosas out of the batter and roll them into logs forming a spiral on the inside and cut it into thick slices. Heat oil in a kadai and fry the pinwheels till it turns golden brown and crispy and keep it aside.

Heat a kadai/pan, add oil and ghee. Add the cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, fennel seeds and fenugreek seeds and let it crackle. Add the garlic and saute for a minute. Add the shallots and saute till it starts to turn soft. Add the green chillies and saute well for another minute or 2. Add the tomatoes and saute till it turns soft and mushy.
Add the masala powders, curry leaves and mix on a medium flame for a minute. Add water and bring the gravy to a boil. Add the tamarind water and mix well.

Add the coconut paste and mix till all the ingredients combine evenly. Simmer the gravy for 5 minutes. Add the fried pinwheels (saiva meen) to the gravy and let it simmer and soak in the gravy for 5 minutes. Garnish it with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Chicken Jollof Rice
cooking_instructions: Char the bell peppers, tomatoes, garlic and onion and set aside. Let it cool down and blend it into a fine paste.

In a deep pot add 1 tsp oil, peppercorns, bay leaves and thyme. Add water and chicken. Simmer the stock for 20 minutes and remove the scum that forms on the top. Remove the chicken and strain the stock.

In the same pot add 3 tbsp oil and add bay leaves and thyme along with finely chopped onions. Let the onions develop some colour and add tomato paste, cook these together until they caramelise and add the capsicum paste.

Cook until the paste thickens considerably then add the soaked and drained rice and mix it gently without breaking the grains. Add 1 ¾ Cups of the stock and cover and cook on a simmer for 12 minutes. Let the rice rest for 10 minutes then fluff it up.
Deep fry the chicken pieces until golden brown then salt immediately. Serve the chicken and rice together.

title: Udupi Vellai Kurma
cooking_instructions: To a pressure cooker, add the vegetables, whole garam masala, water and salt. Pressure cook the vegetables for 3 whistles and keep it aside.

To make the paste, heat a pan, add oil, cumin, fennel and green chillies. Let them crackle. Add the grated coconut and cashew nuts. Mix on a low flame for 2 minutes and turn off the flame. Let the mixture cool down. Transfer it to a blender, add a little water and blend it to a fine paste.
Heat a pan, add oil , green chillies and curry leaves. Let them crackle. Add the shallots  and cook till it turns translucent. Add ginger garlic paste and cook for a minute.

Add the cooked vegetables along with the water and mix well. Bring the mixture to a boil. Add the coconut paste and mix till it combines well. Season the kurma if necessary. Add the green Peas in the end and simmer the gravy till it starts to thicken. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot with dosa, idli or appam.

title: Paneer Khurchan
cooking_instructions: Prepare the marinade for the paneer tikka. To a bowl, add curd, mustard oil and kashmiri red chilli powder and mix till it oil absorbs the red colour for the chilli powder. Add the remaining ingredients for the marinade and mix it till it combines evenly. Add the paneer batons to it and mix till it is coated with the marinade and let it marinate for 25-30 minutes
Heat a pan/tawa, add oil and grill the paneer evenly on all sides and keep it aside.
In the same pan, add the diced capsicum and onion and saute for a minute and keep it aside.
Heat a pan, add oil. Add cumin seeds and let it crackle. Add the onions and saute till it starts to change colour. Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute.
Add the masala powders and saute for a few seconds. Add the chopped tomatoes and saute for 2 minutes. Add water, mix well and bring it to a boil.
Add the tomato puree and cook it for 2 minutes. Simmer the mixture for 5 minutes. Open the pan mix till the mixture becomes thick. Add salt and mix well.
Add the grilled paneer and sauteed onion and capsicum. Add coriander leaves, toss for a few seconds and take it off the flame. Garnish with coriander sprigs and serve it hot.

title: Dal Gosht
cooking_instructions: Add the mutton pieces and dal to a pressure cooker along with turmeric powder, ginger, garlic, salt and water. Pressure cook it for 15 minutes on a moderate flame and set aside
In a pan pour ghee, add the whole garam masalas and brown the onions until golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste, salt, coriander powder, turmeric powder, red chilli powder and tomatoes. Cook until the tomato turns mushy.
Add the cooked dal and mutton to the onion-tomato mixture. Finish with sliced green chilli, coriander and mint leaves.

title: Paneer Butter Masala (No oil, no butter, no cream)
cooking_instructions: Add all the ingredients to a pressure cooker. Cover and pressure-cook on medium heat for 5 whistles (around 15 minutes).
Allow it to cool down, then grind it into a smooth paste. Optionally, you can strain the gravy for a smoother texture. Add it into a pan and heat it up.
Add milk, mix and bring it to a boil. Cover with a lid, turn the flame to low and cook for 10 minutes. Stir occasionally.
Add the paneer cubes, Kasuri methi, garam masala powder and honey. Cook for just 2 minutes and turn off the heat. Serve it hot with pulao/naan/roti.

title: Vazhakkai Kola Urundai (Raw Banana)
cooking_instructions: In a pressure cooker, add the plantain/raw banana along with salt and enough water to cover it. Pressure cook for 1 whistle on high heat. Allow the pressure to release naturally. Peel the skin and then mash it using a masher/fork. It can be slightly chunky, and does not have to be a smooth mixture. Set this aside.
In a mixer, grind the fried gram to a fine powder. Set this aside in a bowl.

Heat oil in a pan. Add fennel seeds, cumin seeds, dry red chilli, shallots, garlic and curry leaves. Add salt and cook until the shallots start to turn golden brown. Add turmeric powder and coriander powder. Saute for 1 minute.
Add the coconut, cook for 1 more minute. Add the coriander leaves and mix. Add this to mixer and blend into a coarse mixture, without adding any water.
To a bowl, add the mashed raw banana and the prepared spice mixture together. Gradually add the fried gram powder, as needed, till you get a thick consistency.
Once evenly combined, roll into evenly sized balls (around 1 to 1 ½ inch). Deep-fry on medium heat until crispy and golden brown. Serve as a starter/snack.

title: Sweet Potato Kheer
cooking_instructions: Peel the sweet potatoes and grate them.
Heat ghee in a pan and saute the sweet potato for 5 minutes on low heat. Set this aside.
Heat milk in another pot along with crushed cardamom and saffron. Bring it to a boil. Add the sweet potatoes. Cook on medium heat for 15 minutes, stirring regularly.
Add sugar and cook until the sugar dissolves, around 5 minutes. Add condensed milk and cook for 3-4 more minutes. Allow it to cool before serving. Serve garnished with chopped nuts.

title: Eggs Kejriwal
cooking_instructions: For the chutney, grind all the ingredients together until smooth. Add water only if required while grinding.
Heat oil in a pan and add the onion. Saute for 30 seconds. Add the turmeric powder, salt, red chilli powder, tomato, green chilli and coriander leaves. Cook for a minute, then remove it from the pan.

Heat some more oil in a pan. Add an egg without breaking the yolk (if possible haha!). Add salt and around a teaspoon of the prepared masala around the egg. Cover and cook for a minute. Remove and set aside.

Apply butter on the bread/bun. Toast the top side first until golden brown. Then flip it and add the cheese. Cover and cook for 30 seconds. Remove it from the pan. Apply some green chutney on the bread, followed by the prepared onion masala. Place the egg on top, and serve!

title: Therattipal
cooking_instructions: To a pan, add milk and let it heat up. Start stirring the pan to avoid milk from burning at the bottom of the pan. Once the milk starts to boil, reduce the flame to medium and keep mixing the milk gently. As it starts to reduce, scrape off the milk solids sticking to the sides of the pan. Keep mixing and scraping the sides off on a medium flame patiently till the milk starts to thicken (at this point it would have reduced to ¼ of it original quantity)

At this point add jaggery and keep mixing till the jaggery dissolves. As the jaggery keeps dissolving, the milk will start to curdle. Keep mixing continuously. Add cardamom powder and keep mixing till the excess moisture evaporates. Finally add ghee, give it one final mix and take it off the flame. Let it cool down. Serve it garnished with chopped cashew nuts and enjoy.

title: Mushroom and Cheese Pops
cooking_instructions: Bring water to boil in a pot. Add Salt to it. Add the Diced potatoes and boil it till it becomes soft and mashy. Strain the potatoes and mash them while they are still hot and keep it aside.

Heat a pan, add oil. Add chopped garlic and onion and saute till the onion turns translucent. Add the chopped mushrooms, salt, oregano seasoning and pepper and saute till the mushrooms are completely cooked and the mixture is dry. Let the mixture cold down
Add the mushroom mixture and grated cheese to the mashed potatoes and mix well till they combine evenly. Shape them into even sized spheres.
Prepare a thick batter using maida, water,salt and pepper. In another bowl add bread crumbs. Coat the shaped mixture in the maida batter first and then in the bread crumbs.
Heat oil in a pan, make sure it is hot. Fry the crumbed pops in hot oil till golden brown. Serve it hot with a dip of your choice.

title: Kari Vadai
cooking_instructions: In a pan pour ghee and add whole garam masalas, saute for 20 seconds and add sliced onion and cook until they turn translucent. Add the mutton mince and saute for 20 seconds.
Add the powdered spices and salt and mix thoroughly, Pour water to make sure the masalas don’t burn and cook on a medium low flame until the water evaporates and the mince mixture is dry.
Cool the mixture down and blend it into a smooth paste. Add it to a mixing bowl and add the roasted gram flour and mix until homogeneous and make it into flat vadais.
Pan fry until golden brown and serve hot.

title: White Chicken Karahi
cooking_instructions: In a kadhai add ghee and let it heat up. Add the whole garam masalas and saute until aromatic.
Add the chicken pieces and saute for 2 minutes. Add the onion paste, salt, cumin seeds, and ginger garlic paste, and saute for 5 minutes.

Add garam masala, black pepper powder, whipped curd, cream and milk. Give it a good mix and cook covered for 10 minutes on a low flame. Add the sliced green chillies and take the kadhai off the flame.

title: Chappati/ Phulka
cooking_instructions: Combine the salt, oil and flour in a bowl. Add the water and wet the flour using your finger tips. Use some extra water if there are any leftover dry flour bits. Clump together a rough dough. Cover and rest for 10 mins.

Once rested, knead the dough for 1-2 mins until it is non-sticky and smooth. Cover and rest again for 10 mins. Roll out the dough into a log and cut into even sized pieces. Roll each piece into roundels. Using some flour to dust, roll them into thin and large discs.
For chapati: cook on a preheated tava, until small bubbles appear on both sides. Use the spatula then to apply some pressure even on the roti until it cooks and puffs up on both sides.

For phulka: cook on a preheated tava, until small bubbles appear on both sides. Then use tongs and place the phulka on an open high flame, it will puff up. Flip it after a few seconds and take it off the flame. Apply ghee/ butter and serve hot.

title: Shahi Cauliflower Gravy
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, mix together the curd, salt, Kashmiri chilli powder, turmeric powder and cauliflower. Heat oil in a pan. Add the cauliflower and fry for 3-4 minutes. Remove it from the pan and set aside.

In the same pan, add more oil. Add all the whole spices and saute for a few seconds until aromatic. Add the garlic, ginger and onion. Saute for 3-4 minutes or until the onion’s colour starts to change.

Add tomato, salt, turmeric powder, cashew and saute for 2-3 minutes. The tomato should start to soften and break down. Add water, cover and cook on medium-low heat for 15 minutes. Stir occasionally. Allow it to cool down slightly. Remove any visible whole spices, then blend into a smooth paste. Optionally, you can strain this mixture for a smoother gravy.
Heat butter in a pan on low heat. Add cumin, green chilli and the red chilli powder. Saute for 10-15 seconds only, then add in the prepared gravy.

Add sugar and cook for 5 minutes, stirring regularly. Add the fried cauliflower, cover and cook for 5 minutes. Add the garam masala powder, fresh cream, Kasuri methi and coriander leaves. Mix well and turn off the heat. Serve with roti, Basmati rice or pulao.

title: Nethili Meen Kuzhambu
cooking_instructions: Soak the tamarind in a cup of hot water.

Heat a pan, add groundnut oil. Add mustard, cumin, fenugreek, black peppercorns and let it crackle. Add curry leaves, green chillies and let it crackle for few more seconds. Add the garlic cloves and saute for a few seconds. Add the shallots and saute till it turns translucent.

Add the masala powders and mix for a minute. Add the tomatoes and saute for 2 minutes. Cook the tomatoes till the tomatoes turn mashy. Add water and bring it to a boil. Dissolve the tamarind and add the water to the mixture and mix gently.

Add the fish. Add salt, mix well. Cover and cook the mixture for 5 minutes. Bring the mixture to a boil, add coriander leaves and take it off the flame. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot with rice.

title: Sticky Date Muffins
cooking_instructions: Add the dates to a bowl of hot milk.
In another bowl, add butter, caster sugar and whisk it till it becomes creamy. Add the eggs one at a time and whisk it till it combines evenly. Add the vanilla essence and mix it well.
Sieve maida and baking powder and baking soda into the mixture and whisk till all ingredients combine to form a thick batter .
Mash the soaked dates with a fork and add the dates mixture and fold it till it combines evenly.

Line a muffin mould with butter and paper muffin cups. Evenly spoon the batter into each muffin cup. Bake it at 180 degrees for 25 minutes. Take it out of the oven, place the muffins on a wire rack to cool down. Serve at room temperature.

title: Kambu Koozh
cooking_instructions: Grind the whole Kambu in a coarse powder

Bring 6 cups of water to a boil. Add the coarsely ground Kambu into the water. Cook by continuously stirring it for 15 mins on a medium high flame. Once it cools down and starts to thicken, add water and cover it with water and let it rest for 5 hours. Store it in the refrigerator and use it within 3 days.

To make the Koozh, whisk the curd, add it to the cooked Kambu, add salt and combine everything. Adjust the thickness of the Koozh by adding the water in which the Kambu had been sitting in. Serve with Shallots, Raw Mango Mor Milagai and Fryums.

title: Beans Masala Gravy
cooking_instructions: To prep the beans, cut the ends off first. If the beans are older/dry, you can peel off the fibers from the ends too. Then hold a few beans in a bunch and chop them to around 1-inch length.

In a pan, add peanuts and saute on low heat for 2-3 minutes. Then add the white sesame seeds, green cardamom, black peppercorn, clove and cinnamon. Continue to cook for 3 minutes on low heat, until everything is crisp and aromatic. Grind it into a powder. Add curd and coriander stems, and grind to form a paste. Set this aside.
In a pan, heat oil and add the beans. Fry on high heat for 2-3 minutes, then remove the beans and set aside.
Add oil to the same pan and add cumin seeds, garlic and green chilli. Saute until the garlic turns light golden brown. Add the onion and saute until it turns golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste, tomato, salt and all the masala powders. Saute until the tomato starts to soften, 3-4 minutes. Add the prepared masala paste, mix well and cook for 3 minutes.

Add the beans and mix well. Add water, cover and cook on low heat for 5 minutes, or until the beans are cooked to your liking. Add garam masala powder and coriander leaves. Stir and turn off the heat.

title: Palak Papad Gravy
cooking_instructions: Bring water to a boil in a pot, add the cleaned palak spinach and blanch for only 15-20 seconds. Immediately transfer to a bowl of cold water to cool down. Strain and squeeze out the excess water, add to a blender with ¼ Cup of water and blend to a smooth paste.

In a pan, heat oil and ghee and add the cumin seeds, fry for a few seconds until aromatic. Add the chopped garlic and green chillies and fry until the garlic turn golden brown. Add the onions and saute until they turn slightly golden in colour and add the ginger garlic paste. Saute until the raw aroma goes.

Add the tomatoes and cook until soft and mushy. Add the powdered spices and seasonings- turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala, salt and sugar. Add a splash of water, if needed. Cook the masalas for a few minutes.
Add the palak spinach puree and mix. Adjust the consistency by adding the milk and water and simmer for 2-3 mins, until it reached the desired consistency.
Add the fried pappadum bits and Kasuri methi. Bring to a boil and switch off the heat. Serve it in a bowl. Garnish with crushed fried papad/appalam.

title: Pallipalayam Fried Rice
cooking_instructions: Heat gingelly oil in a pan. Add the dry red chilli, cashew, curry leaves, coconut chunks and shallots. Saute until it start to change colour.
Add the chicken pieces along with Cookd pallipalayam masala. Then saute for 2 minutes. Add water and cook for 3 more minutes.
Add cooked Basmati rice, boiled egg and coriander leaves. Toss for 2-3 more minutes, then serve.

title: Chicken Mandi
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes.
Prepare the mandi Masala by dry roasting the mentioned ingredients till it turns aromatic and let it cool down. Blend the dry roasted spices to a fine powder and keep it aside.
Prepare saffron water by soaking a pinch of saffron strands in 3 tbsp of hot water to absorb colour.

Prepare the marinade for the chicken by mixing kashmiri chilli powder, 2 tbsp of the mandi masala, ginger garlic paste, chaat masala, oil, lemon juice, salt and 3 tbsp of the saffron water. Mix till all ingredients combine into a thick paste. Score the chicken legs. Apply the marinade on the chicken legs and rub it in gently. Let the chicken marinate for 30 minutes. Heat a kadai with oil for shallow frying. Deep fry the marinated chicken on a medium flame for 6 minutes on each side. Keep it aside.

To make the mandi rice, Heat a deep pot, add oil and ghee. Add cinnamon, bay leaves and let it crackle. Add the sliced onions and green chillies. Saute till the onions turn golden brown. Add ginger garlic paste and mix for a few seconds. Add chilli powder, turmeric powder and the mandi masala and mix for a minute.

Add 1.75L of water and mix well. Add salt and lemon juice. Bring the water to a boil.
Add the soaked and strained rice and keep stirring gently to avoid letting it stick to the bottom. Cook it till the rice and water are level. Cover the pot and seal it tightly.

Place the pot on a preheated tawa for 10 minutes on a low flame. (if the tawa isn’t preheated, keep the flame on high for 5 minutes and then on low for 5 minutes). After 10 minutes, turn off the flame and let it rest for 10 minutes. Open the pot, create small gaps using a thin stick. Place the chicken on top of the rice leaving some space in the middle. Place a bowl with a piece of hot charcoal in the middle. Pour some ghee over it and seal the pot immediately. Let it smoke for 5 minutes. Open the pot, take out the chicken separately, fluff up the rice. Serve the rice on a big plate, garnish it with fried nuts and raisins, fried onion and chopped coriander. Place the chicken legs on top and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Chettinad Prawn
cooking_instructions: Heat a pan, add oil. Add curry leaves and let it crackle. Add the chopped onions and saute till it turns soft and translucent.

Add the prawns and Cookd chettinad masala. Mix the prawns with the masala for 2 minutes. Add water, mix well and bring it to a  boil. Cover and simmer the masala for 5 minutes. Open the pan, mix well and cook till the masala starts to thicken. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Chettinad Chicken
cooking_instructions: Heat a pan, add oil. Add curry leaves and let it crackle. Add the chopped onions and saute till it turns soft and translucent. Add the chicken and Cookd chettinad masala. Mix the Chicken with the masala for 2 minutes. Add water, mix well and bring it to a  boil.
Cover and cook on a low flame for 20 minutes. Open the pan, mix well and cook on a high flame till the gravy starts to thicken. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Chettinad Paneer
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Add curry leaves and let it crackle. Add the onions and saute till it turns soft and translucent. Add the Cookd Chettinad Masala and saute for a few seconds. Add water, mix well till it combines with the masala. Bring it to a boil and lower the flame.

Add the paneer, mix till it is coated with the masala. Cover and cook it on a low flame for 5 minutes. Open the pan, increase it to high flame and mix till the gravy starts to thicken. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Madurai Chicken Chukka
cooking_instructions: Heat 2 tsp oil in a pan, add curry leaves and let it crackle. Add the chopped onions and cook it till it turns soft and translucent. Add the chicken and the cookd madurai chukka masala. Mix well till the ingredients combine evenly.

Add water, give it a mix and bring it to a boil. Cover and cook it on low flame for 20 minutes. Stirring occasionally. Check the taste and season the mixture if necessary. Cook it till the gravy becomes thick and it is a nice thick masala. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Madurai Mushroom Chukka
cooking_instructions: Heat 2 tsp oil in a pan, add curry leaves and let it crackle. Add the chopped onions and cook it till it turns soft and translucent. Add the mushroom and the cookd madurai chukka masala. Mix well for 2 minutes.

Add water, give it a mix and bring it to a boil. Cover and cook it on low flame for 5 minutes. Stirring occasionally. Check the taste and season the mixture if necessary. Cook it till the gravy becomes a nice thick masala. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot .

title: Cookd Madurai Prawn Chukka
cooking_instructions: Heat 2 tsp oil in a pan, add curry leaves and let it crackle. Add the chopped onions and cook it till it turns soft and translucent.

Add the Prawn and the Cookd Madurai Chukka Masala. Mix well till the ingredients combine evenly. Add water, give it a mix and bring it to a boil. Cover and cook it on low flame for 5 minutes. Stirring occasionally. Check the taste and season the mixture if necessary. Cook it till the gravy becomes thick masala. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Madurai Soya Chukka
cooking_instructions:
To a bowl, add the soya, salt, turmeric powder and hot water and press it down. Let the soya soak in hot water for 10 minutes. Strain and squeeze the extra water out of the soya and keep it aside
Heat oil in a pan, add curry leaves and let it crackle. Add onions and saute till it turns soft and translucent. Add the soya and the cookd madurai chukka masala, mix and cook it for 2 minutes.
Add water and mix well. Bring the mixture to a boil. Cook the mixture till the mixture becomes a thick masala and coats the soya. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Madurai Mutton Chukka
cooking_instructions: Heat 2 tsp oil in a pressure cooker, add curry leaves and let it crackle. Add the chopped onions and cook it till it turns soft. Add the Mutton and add the Cookd Madurai Chukka masala. Mix well till the ingredients combine evenly

Add water, give it a mix and bring it to a boil. Cover and pressure cook the mutton for one whistle on a high flame and for 15 minutes on a medium flame (8-10 whistles). Let the steam reduce gradually. Open the cooker and check if the mutton is cooked. Check the taste and season the mixture if necessary. Cook it till the gravy becomes a nice thick masala. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Watermelon Peel Curry
cooking_instructions: Peel the green out skin of the watermelon rind. Use only the white parts. Cut it into cubes. Marinate the watermelon rind with all the ingredients and set aside.
Heat oil in a pan and add the peanuts. Fry on medium-low heat until golden brown. Remove the peanuts from the pan and set aside.

In the same pan, add mustard seeds and cumin seeds. Once it crackles, add dry red chilli and garlic. Saute for around 30 seconds. Add onion and curry leaves. Saute until the onion turns translucent. Add coriander powder, red chilli powder and salt. Saute for a minute, on low heat to not burn the masalas.
Add the tomato and saute for 3-4 minutes, until it softens. Add the marinated watermelon rind. Mix well, then cover and cook on medium heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add water and bring to a boil, then simmer for 5 more minutes. Add garam masala powder and coriander leaves. Add the fried peanuts and mix. Serve with chapathi or rice.

title: Harissa Grilled Chicken Legs
cooking_instructions: Prepare chilli paste by soaking dry red chillies in hot water. Save some of the boiled water in a bowl to use it while blending the chillies.

Roast the red capsicum on a direct flame, cover it in a bowl and let it cool down. Remove the skin and seeds. Strain the chillies, cool it down and puree it in a blender till it turns to a fine paste and transfer it to a mixing bowl. To the chilli paste, add the rest of the ingredients, mix it well and check the seasoning.
Rub the marinade evenly on the chicken and let it marinate for 45 minutes to an hour.

Heat a grilling pan or a nonstick pan, add oil. Grill the chicken on a hot pan. Make sure the chicken cooks evenly all around and has grill marks on it. Garnish it with coriander sprigs and lemon wedges. Serve it hot.

title: Fish Podimas
cooking_instructions: In a pot, add fish, water, salt and turmeric powder. Cook for 5 minutes, or until the fish is partly cooked and becomes solidified. Remove from the water. Once it cools slightly, separate the bones, if any. Shred the fish into small pieces.

Heat oil and add mustard seeds and cumin. Once the mustard crackles, add green chilli, curry leaves and onion. Saute until the onion starts to change colour and brown. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder, salt and black pepper powder. Saute for a minute.

Add the shredded fish and mix. Cook for 4-5 minutes or until some of the fish pieces start to turn crispy. Finish with lemon juice and coriander leaves. Mix it and serve! It tastes great when eaten with rice.

title: Cookd Chettinad Mushroom
cooking_instructions: Heat 2 tsp oil in a pan, add curry leaves and let it crackle. Add the chopped onions and cook it till it turns soft and translucent. Add the mushroom and add the Cookd chettinad masala. Mix well for 2 minutes.

Add water, give it a mix and bring it to a boil. Cover and cook it on low flame for 5 minutes. Stirring occasionally. Check the taste and season the mixture if necessary. Cook it till the gravy becomes thick and it is a nice thick masala. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Chettinad Mutton Masala
cooking_instructions: Heat a pressure cooker, add oil. Add curry leaves and let it crackle. Add the chopped onions and saute till it turns soft and translucent. Add the mutton and Cookd chettinad masala. Mix the mutton with the masala for 2 minutes.

Add water, mix well and bring it to a  boil. Cover and cook on medium flame for 15 minutes (8-10 whistles). Open the pan, mix well and cook till the masala starts to thicken. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Chettinad Mixed Vegetables
cooking_instructions: Heat a pan, add oil. Add curry leaves and let it crackle. Add the onions and saute till it turns soft and translucent. Add the carrot, beans, potato and the cookd chettinad masala and saute for 2 minutes.

Add water, bring it to a boil and cover the pan. Cover and cook the vegetables for 20 minutes on a low flame. Open the pan, give it a good mix. Add the green peas, mix well and cover and cook it for 5 more minutes on a low flame. Open the pan, mix till the masala starts to thicken. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Shahi Paneer (OT)
cooking_instructions: Heat a pan. Add the Cookd Onion Tomato Masala and cook on a medium flame for two minutes. Add water, bring it to a boil and reduce the flame to low. Add the garam masala powder, mix and cook it with the gravy for 20-30 seconds.

Add the paneer cubes, coat it with the gravy. Cover and cook the mixture on a low flame for 5 minutes. Add fresh cream, kasuri methi, coriander leaves and mix till all ingredients combine evenly. Season the mixture if necessary. Garnish it with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Channa Masala (OT)
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak channa for 6 hours or overnight.  In a pressure cooker, add 3 cups of water along with a bay leaf and salt. Pressure cook for 4-5 whistles on a medium flame and set aside.

In a kadhai, add the Cookd Onion Tomato Masala and saute for 10 seconds. Add channa masala and salt, cook for an additional 10 seconds. Add the boiled channa along with the water and let it reduce until it reaches your desired consistency. Mash half of the channa to give the gravy body & thickness. Once it reaches the desired consistency, add the finely chopped capsicum, green chilli and coriander leaves and turn off the flame. Squeeze a wedge of lime before serving.

title: Kadai Chicken (OT)
cooking_instructions: In a mortar & pestle, lightly crush together dry red chilli, coriander seeds and fennel seeds.
Heat oil in a pan until very hot. Add the onion and capsicum. Saute for just 1 minute, then remove from the heat.

Add more oil to the same pan, then add the crushed spices and mix for a few seconds to release the aroma. Add the chicken and salt. Saute on high heat for 2 minutes. Add the Cookd Onion Tomato Masala and mix well.

Add water, cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the cooked capsicum & onion, garam masala powder and coriander leaves. Cook for 5 more minutes or until it reaches the desired consistency. Turn off the heat, and serve hot!

title: Nutella Bread Bombs
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl, add the flour, salt and baking powder, keep it aside. In a mixing bowl add all the wet ingredients along with sugar and yeast. Let the yeast bloom for 5 minutes( this step is to make sure the yeast is alive). Mix the wet ingredients with dry ingredients and let it rise for 2-3 hours or double in size.
While the dough is kept for fermentation, spoon small blobs of Nutella into a plate and freeze.

Once the dough is doubled in size, beat it down and give it a quick knead( this is to redistribute the yeast inside the dough). Divide the dough into small balls and flatten them out, place the frozen Nutella blob in the middle of the flattened dough and wrap it with the dough. Shape the dough into spheres and let it proof for 30 minutes.

Bake in a preheated oven at 180-degree celsius for 20- 25 minutes or until completely baked. While still hot brush it with melted butter and sift powdered sugar. Let it cool for 10 minutes then serve warm.

title: Naan
cooking_instructions: Combine the salt, sugar, baking powder, oil and flour in a bowl. Add the milk and wet the flour using your finger tips. Use some extra milk if there is any leftover dry flour bits. Clump together a rough dough. Cover and rest for 10 mins.
Once rested, knead the dough for 2-3 mins until it is non-sticky and smooth. Dust some dry flour, if needed. Cover and rest again for 10 mins.
Roll out the dough into a log and cut into even sized pieces. Roll each piece into roundels.

Using some flour to dust, roll then into slightly thick and medium sized discs and elongate one side to make the characteristic cycle seat shape of naans. You can add toppings of your chioce and gently press it to stick on the dough. Apply water on one side and stick it on a cast iron/ steel pan that has been pre-heated. Allow bubbles to develop for a few seconds and then upturn the pan carefully over an open flame to cook the top and develop the characteristic char marks. Apply ghee/ butter and release it using a spatula from the pan. Serve hot.

title: Gongura Mutton
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pressure cooker and add the whole spices (cloves, cinnamon, fennel). Add the green chilli and onion. Saute until the onion turns translucent. Add the ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute.

Add the tomato, salt, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder and cumin powder. Saute for 2-3 minutes. Add the mutton and saute for 2 more minutes. Add water, cover and pressure cook for 1 whistle. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 15 more minutes.

While the mutton is cooking, you can prepare the paste. Heat oil in a pan and add the gongura leaves. Saute slightly, then cover and cook on low heat until it shrinks and becomes soft, around 3-5 minutes.
Add the Palak/spinach leaves and saute for 2 more minutes. Allow it to cool slightly. Grind it into a paste.
Once the pressure has released, open the lid and add the prepared Gongura paste and garam masala powder.
Cover and cook for 5 more minutes or until the oil floats on top. Add coriander leaves and ghee. Mix and turn off the heat. Serve with rice, roti or phulkas.

title: Custard Cake
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, sieve in the maida, custard powder,powdered sugar, baking powder and baking soda.
Add vegetable oil and half the quantity of milk and mix till there are no lumps. Add the remaining milk and whisk till a smooth batter forms. Add the tutti frutti and mix till it combines.
Grease a baking pan with oil and dust it with flour. Pour the batter into the mould, top it with some tutti frutti. Tap the pan on the table to clear out any air pockets.

Keep a deep pot on a medium flame, invert a plate and place it at the bottom and close the pot. Let the pot heat up for 5 minutes. Place the cake mould carefully inside the pot and close it tightly. Bake it on a medium flame for 50 minutes. Poke it with a thin stick to check if it is cooked through. Take it out carefully and demould the cake. Let it cool down completely. Cut it after it has cooled down.

title: Palak Paneer Dosa
cooking_instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil and add salt. Add the spinach and cook for just 20 seconds. Remove it from the pan into a bowl of cold water.
Grind into a smooth paste. Add it to the dosa batter and mix well.

Heat the oil in a pan and add the urad dal, chana dal and dry red chillies. When the dals start to change their colour, add the garlic and onion. When the onion turns translucent, add the tomatoes and salt. Cook until the tomatoes have softened.
Add the tamarind and turn off the stove. Allow it to cool, then blend into a paste.

Spread the dosa batter on a tawa, just like a regular dosa. Cover and allow it to cook for 45 seconds on medium heat. Open the lid and apply some ghee around the edges. Apply a spoon of the chutney and then grate some paneer on top. Fold in half and then remove the dosa from the pan. Serve hot & enjoy!

title: Mayonnaise Chicken
cooking_instructions: In a mixer jar add all the ingredients for the mayonnaise and blend until well-emulsified and thick and set aside.
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the marinade, add the chicken, mix well and marinate for 30 minutes. In a pan, pour oil, fry the chicken until golden brown, and set aside.
Add sliced onion, and saute until translucent, then add tomatoes, and curry leaves and cook for another 4- 5 mins or until the tomatoes turn mushy.
Add the fried chicken and mayonnaise and gently mix until everything is well combined and cohesive. Garnish with Coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Chicken Angara
cooking_instructions: Dry roast the ingredients required to make the angara masala till it is aromatic and blend it to a fine powder.

In a big bowl, add the chicken, the masala powder and the other ingredients required for the marination and mix it well till all the ingredients combine evenly. Let the mixture marinate for about 1 hour.
Transfer the chicken to a pan and start cooking it on a medium flame, mixing it regularly. Cover and let it cook on a medium flame for 25 minutes till the chicken is cooked.
Place a piece of hot coal in a bowl and place it on the gravy. Add a tbsp of ghee, cover it immediately. Let it smoke for 5 minutes. Transfer it to a bowl. Serve it hot.

title: Coconut Cream and Dark Chocolate Pudding
cooking_instructions: In a pan add the coconut cream, cocoa powder, sugar and agar agar, whisk until homogeneous.
Bring the mixture to a boil and the dark chocolate, whisk until the chocolate melts, add the vanilla essence and switch off the flame.
Pour it into the mould of your choice and let it set for 3 hours in a refrigerator. Top it with whipping cream and a berry of your choice and serve cold.

title: Cilantro Pesto Pasta Salad
cooking_instructions: Heat water in a pot and bring it to a boil. Add salt. Add the macaroni and boil it according to the time mentioned on the pack. Strain the pasta immediately, run it under cold water and strain it well. Coat the strained pasta with oil.
To prepare Cilantro pesto, to a mixie jar, add coriander leaves, cashew nuts, grated cheese, salt and olive oil. Blend it to a coarse paste.
Add the dressing to the pasta, mix till it combines evenly, transfer it to a bowl and refrigerate it. Serve it cold

title: Sweet Chilli Pasta Salad
cooking_instructions: Heat water in a pot and bring it to a boil. Add salt. Add the macaroni and boil it according to the time mentioned on the pack. Strain the pasta immediately, run it under cold water and strain it well. Coat the strained pasta with oil. Divide the pasta into three equal portions.

Add oil, chilli flakes, paprika/kashmiri chilli powder, sauteed mushroom and corn, boiled macaroni and mayonnaise, coriander leaves. Mix well till all the ingredients combine evenly, transfer it to a bowl and put it in the refrigerator

title: Boiled Egg Pasta Salad
cooking_instructions:
Heat water in a pot and bring it to a boil. Add salt. Add the macaroni and boil it according to the time mentioned on the pack. Strain the pasta immediately, run it under cold water and strain it well. Coat the strained pasta with oil. Divide the pasta into three equal portions.
fully boil 5 eggs, and separate the yolks from it and dice the egg whites. To the yolks, add mayonnaise, dijon mustard, salt and mix and mash the yolks well till it combines well. Add the diced egg whites, iceberg lettuce and the pasta, Mix well till they combine evenly and the pasta is coated with the dressing. Transfer it to a bowl, refrigerate it and serve it cold.

title: Paruppu Podi
cooking_instructions: In a kadhai roast all the dals separately until golden and add them to a bowl. Roast all the other ingredients until aromatic, making sure you don’t burn the chillies.
Add the ingredients into a mixer jar along with salt and blend into a fine powder. Add it to an airtight container and store it in the fridge.

title: Muskmelon Mastani
cooking_instructions: Cut the top of the muskmelon. Scoop out the seeds from the centre and discard. This is optional, but you can use a scooper to get a few melon balls which can be used for garnish. Scoop out the rest of the fruit, without damaging the outer skin.
In a blender, blend together the muskmelon, ice cubes, ice cream, sugar and milk. Add it back into the muskmelon. Top with the melon balls, pista, almonds, tutti frutti and saffron.

title: Home Style Potato Roast
cooking_instructions: Wash the potatoes and add them to a pressure cooker along with water and salt and pressure cook for 2 whistles on a medium flame. Cool down the potatoes and peel the potatoes, cut them into cubes and set aside.
In a pan pour oil and add mustard seeds, let it splutter then add urad dal, once the dal is golden brown add the curry leaves and asafoetida.

Add the potatoes and give them a good mix. Saute the potatoes until they develop some colour on them, then add the powdered spices and salt. Give them a good mix and cook for additional 3-4 minutes to develop a crispy crust.

title: Hyderabadi Chicken Haleem
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, combine the broken wheat, barley/oats and the lentils. Wash well until the water runs clear.

To a heavy-bottomed pressure cooker, add the washed grains (strained) and water. Pressure cook on high heat for 1 whistle, then cook on low heat for a further 30 minutes. Grind into a smooth paste after it cools down.
Marinate the chicken with all the ingredients for the marination, for at least 30 minutes (till overnight).
Heat ghee in a pressure cooker and add all the whole spices. Saute for a few seconds to release its aroma. Add the onion and green chillies. Fry until golden brown.

Add the marinated chicken and saute on high heat for 4 minutes. Add the rose petals and water. Cover and pressure cook for 1 whistle. Reduce the heat to low and continue cooking for another 35 minutes.

Once the steam settles, open the cooker and remove some of the fat and set aside. Remove the chicken pieces out of the cooker. 
Remove the bones from the meat. Discard the bones and reserve the shredded meat. In a large pot or in the same cooker, heat the cooker liquid and meat along with the cooked wheat & lentil mixture. Add the mint and coriander leaves. Mash it with a masher/wooden spoon and cook on low heat for at least 20 minutes. Adjust the consistency with hot water if required. Serve hot topped with cut boiled eggs, fried onion, mint leaves, lemon wedge and fried cashews. Spoon some of the previously reserved fat on top.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
cooking_instructions:
To boil Rice : 
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes. Bring water to boil in a deep pot, add salt and vinegar to it. Add the soaked and strained rice and boil it for 6-7 minutes and strain it immediately. Transfer the rice to a wide pan or tray and let it cool down completely. Refrigerate or let the rice sit about 2-3 hours, preferable overnight. This will ensure that the rice isn’t moist of fluffy anymore. Heat a wok/pan, make sure its super hot. Add oil, beat the eggs and scramble it on a high flame till it is fluffy. It doesn’t need to colour. Transfer the egg to another bowl.

In the same wok/pan, add oil. Add the chopped ginger and garlic and saute till they start to turn light brown. Add the spring onion whites and saute for a minute. Add the carrot and beans and saute for 2 minutes.
Add the boiled rice, boiled chicken pieces, salt, pepper, soy sauce and MSG. Mix and toss till all ingredients combine evenly.

Add the scrambled eggs and toss till it combines with the rest of the ingredients. Add spring onion greens, give it one final toss and take it off the flame. Garnish it with spring onions and serve it hot.

title: Vagharela Bhaat
cooking_instructions: Heat oil and add mustard seeds, allow it to splutter. Add the cumin seeds, asafoetida, dry red chilli, curry leaves, ginger, garlic and green chilli. Saute for a few seconds until aromatic.
Add the onion and saute until it turns translucent. Add the turmeric powder, red chilli powder, garam masala powder and salt. Saute for 30 seconds. Add the sugar and mix well
Add the cooked rice. Toss for 2-3 minutes. If needed, add more salt to the rice. Finish with coriander leaves and lemon juice. Give it a final toss and serve.

title: Peanut Chaat
cooking_instructions: Heat up the oil on low heat and add the chilli powder, turmeric powder, Hing powder, pepper powder. Add the curry leaves and saute for 30 seconds on low heat. Add the peanuts to this mixture and cook for 1 minute.
This is the masala peanuts for the dish. Transfer it into a bowl.
To this bowl, add the chopped onions, chopped tomatoes and chopped coriander leaves. Add the lemon juice and chaat masala. Mix well. Adjust salt to taste.

title: Hara Bhara Kebab
cooking_instructions: Heat water in a pot and add salt to it. When it comes to a boil, add the peas. Cook until the peas have softened. Add the palak leaves, and boil for just 20 seconds more, then immediately transfer it into a bowl of cold water. When it cools down, squeeze out the water and transfer it to a mixer jar. Blend into a smooth paste.

In a pan, heat ghee and add the ginger and green chilli. Saute for a minute, then add carrot and beans. Season with salt and saute for 4-5 minutes, then add the prepared green paste and saute for saute for 3-4 minutes on high heat. Turn off the heat.

Once it has cooled down enough to handle, add paneer, potato and all the other seasonings and mix. Add roasted gram powder as needed to get the required consistency. You should be able to shape it properly. Take out small portions and shape it into cutlets/patties. Place a piece of cashew on top.

For Pan-Frying:
Apply oil on a flat pan. Once it is hot, add the kebabs and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side. Remove and serve.

For Air-Frying:
To air-fry, first preheat the air-fryer to 200°c. Then grease the tray and place the kebabs. Apply some oil and air-fry for 12 minutes, turning it halfway through.

title: Amritsari Chicken Curry
cooking_instructions:
For the Chicken Marination : 
To a bowl, add chicken and the remaining ingredients required for the marination. Mix till all the ingredients combine evenly and the chicken is coated well. Let the chicken Marinate for 30 minutes.

For the masala : 
Heat a pan, add the spices required for the masala and dry roast them till it turns aromatic. Transfer it into a mixer jar and make a fine powder. Keep it aside for further use.
Heat a pan, add oil. Once the pan is hot, add the chicken and grill it on a medium flame for 5 minutes on each side till grill marks appear on it. Transfer the chicken to a plate and keep it aside.

Heat a kadai, add oil and ghee. Add a bay leaf, green chillies and chopped onion. Saute till the onion starts to turn golden brown. Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute. Add 1 ½ tbsp of the dry roasted masala and mix for a minute.

Add the tomatoes and saute for 4-5 minutes. Add ¼ Cup water and keep mixing on a high flame till the tomatoes turn soft and mushy. Add curd and mix well for a minute. Add ¾ Cup Water, mix well. Add salt and mix well. Bring the gravy to a boil.

Add the grilled chicken and mix till it combines well with the gravy. Bring it to a boil, cover and simmer it for 10 minutes. Stirring occasionally. Add butter, cover and simmer it till the butter melts. Open the pot, give the mixture a mix. Add chopped coriander leaves, mix well. Give it one final boil and take it off the flame. Serve it hot with roti or rice.

title: Double Chocolate Overnight Oats
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl add the oats, brown sugar, coffee powder, cocoa powder, chia seeds and mix thoroughly. Add the milk and mix until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a glass and pour melted chocolate over the oats and place in the fridge for at least 4 hours to set. Break the chocolate layer and enjoy.

title: Poori
cooking_instructions: Combine the salt, oil, rava and flour in a bowl.
Add the water and wet the flour using your finger tips. Use some extra water if there are any leftover dry flour bits. Clump together a rough dough. Cover and rest for 10 mins.

Once rested, knead the dough for 1-2 mins until it is non-sticky and smooth. Cover and rest again for 10 mins. Roll out the dough into a log and cut into small, even sized pieces. Roll each piece into roundels. Using some flour to dust, roll then into thin discs. Deep fry in medium hot, preheated oil for a few seconds until it has puffed up. Then flip and fry until both sides are golden. Serve hot.

title: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
cooking_instructions: In a pot add water and salt, and bring it to a boil. Add the pasta to the water and cook as per the package instructions. Strain the pasta and run it through cold water and set aside.

In a pan pour olive oil and let it heat up, add the onions and cook for 30 seconds or until translucent. Add the mushrooms and dried herbs, and cook until they develop colour, then add the garlic, and sun-dried tomatoes and cook for 30 more seconds.

Pour water and bring it to a boil then add cream, and mix until everything turns homogeneous. Add the pasta, salt and pepper and give it a good toss. Garnish with finely chopped parsley and serve hot.

title: Coconut Kola Urundai
cooking_instructions: Blend the grated coconut and besan into a fine mixture without adding any water.
Transfer the blended mixture into a bowl and add all the other ingredients. Mix thoroughly and shape it into balls.
Pan-fry the balls until golden brown and serve hot.

title: Honey Walnut Shrimp
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl add prawn and all the other ingredients for the marinade except the flour and let it rest for 10-15 minutes.
In a pan add sugar and water, let the sugar heat up to soft ball stage then add the walnuts and toss until completely covered, set aside and let cool.
Add both the flours to the prawns along with soda water and deep fry until golden brown.
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the sauce and give it a good mix, add the prawns and walnuts and toss until completely covered. Garnish with sesame seeds and spring onions and serve hot.

title: Sankarankovil Mutton Biryani
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes

To a pressure cooker, add the washed mutton, water and salt. Mix it and close the pressure cooker. Pressure cook the mutton on a high flame till the first whistle and then on a medium flame for 15 minutes. Let the pressure reduce gradually.
Heat a pan, add the spices required for the masala, dry roast them till it turns aromatic. Blend it to a fine powder.
To a bowl, add curd, ginger garlic paste and the ground masala. Mix it and keep it aside
Heat a pot, add groundnut oil. Add cinnamon, cardamom, cloves and bay leaf. Let it crackle. Add the onions, garlic and ginger and saute the onions till it turns golden brown, add green chillies.
Add turmeric powder, coriander leaves and mint leaves and saute for a few seconds. Add the curd mixture and mix well.

Strain the mutton from the pressure cooker and add it to the pot. Saute the mutton with the masala for 5 minutes. Measure the mutton water and add it to the mixture. Add 200ml coconut milk and ¾ Cup (180ml) of water.

Add salt, mix well and bring it to a boil. Add the soaked and strained rice. Start mixing it gently on a high flame till the rice and water are almost level. Cover the pot tightly with a fitting lid. Place it on a preheated tawa for 20 minutes on a low flame. If the tawa is not preheated, keep it on a high flame for 5 minutes and on a low flame for 15 minutes. After 20 minutes, turn off the flame and let the biryani rest for another 10 minutes. Open the pot, add ghee and fluff the rice. Serve it hot with raita.

title: Eggless Hot Chocolate Pudding
cooking_instructions: In a bowl mix sugar, brown sugar and cocoa powder and set aside.
In another mixing bowl add sugar and all the wet ingredients and give it a good mix.
Sift in the maida, cocoa powder and baking powder and gently mix until well combined and set aside.

In a baking dish add the batter and sprinkle the sugar mixture on top of the batter and pour boiling water on top. Without mixing the batter, place it in a preheated oven for 25-30 minutes at 180-degree Celsius.

title: Oats Pongal
cooking_instructions: Dry roast the moong dal and oats separately until aromatic and set aside
Pressure cook the moong dal for 3 whistles on a moderate flame and let the pressure release naturally.
In a pot, pour water and add the toasted oats, let the oats cook until thickened then add the cooked moong dal and salt, and give it a good mix until well combined.

In a tadka pan add ghee and heat it up, add cumin seeds and let it crackle, then peppercorn, asafoetida and cashews, once the cashews turn golden brown add the curry leaves and add them to the Pongal.

title: Ragi Koozh
cooking_instructions:
Dissolve the ragi in ½ cup water and keep it aside.
To a saucepan, add 3 cups water and let it heat up. Add the dissolved ragi mixture to the saucepan and keep stirring it on a medium flame. Keep stirring it till the mixture starts to thicken. Add sugar and salt and mix for a minute.
Add milk and mix well till it combines and let it thicken. Bring it to a boil, turn off the flame and let it cool down. Serve it warm or cold according to your preference and enjoy.

title: Chicken Lasagna
cooking_instructions: For the dough, to a bowl, add maida and olive oil and mix till the mixture becomes crumbly. Add salt and water and mix till a dough forms. Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it rest.
Heat a pan, add oil/butter, add chopped garlic and onion and saute till it turns translucent.
Add the minced chicken and saute on a high flame. Season the mixture with salt, pepper and oregano. Mix well and cook till the mixture is dry and keep it aside.

For the white sauce, heat a pan, add butter and let it melt. Add maida and mix on a low flame till the maida and butter form and crumbly texture. Cook it for a few seconds. Add milk and start whisking it till there are no lumps.Keep whisking it till the mixture starts to thicken. Turn off the heat, add a cube of butter on top of it and keep it aside.
Take the dough and roll it out till it is thin. Divide and cut the sheet evenly according to the baking pan you are using.

Take a baking pan/mould, apply white sauce at the bottom. Place the lasagna sheets, Top it with the minced chicken mixture, mozzarella cheese and some white sauce. Layer it one more time the same way. Finally, cover it with a layer of lasagna sheets, apply white sauce on it and cover the pan with foil.
Bake it covered, at 180 degrees for 30 minutes. Take the pan out, open it, top it with mozzarella cheese. Bake it uncovered at 200 degrees till the cheese turns golden brown. Cut and serve it hot.

title: Aloo Beans Subzi
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan and add cumin, asafoetida, crushed garlic and ginger. Saute for a minute. Add the onions and saute until it turns translucent.
Add the diced potato and saute for 2 minutes. Add salt, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder and cumin powder. Mix & saute for a minute.
Add the tomato and saute for another minute. Then add water, cover and cook for 6-7 minutes or until the potato starts getting soft but not mashy.

You can test if the potato is cooked by cutting it with a spoon or fork. It should get cut but with some resistance. At this point, add beans along with a splash of water. Cover and cook for 5-7 more minutes or until the beans is cooked. Add garam masala powder and chopped coriander leaves. Mix well and serve!

title: Tea Kadai Onion Bonda
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add onions, green chilli, curry leaves, ginger, turmeric, Kashmiri chilli powder and salt. Mix everything until thoroughly combined and let it sit for 10 minutes. (this is to bring out the water from the onions)
Add the maida and rice flour and shape it into balls and deep fry, but make sure the oil is moderately hot so that the insides also cook through. Serve with hot Chai and enjoy.

title: Thai Veg Panang Curry
cooking_instructions: Soak the dry red chillies in hot water. Strain it and reserve the water. Add all the ingredients required to a blender and blend it to a coarse paste by adding the required amount of reserved water.
Heat oil in a pan, add the curry paste to it and cook it till it loses its raw flavour and gives out an aroma.
Add the vegetables except for the broccoli and bell pepper, and saute with the paste for 5 minutes on a medium flame.
Add water, and bring it to a boil. Cover and simmer the mixture for 3 minutes, and the broccoli and let it cook for 30 seconds more.

Add coconut milk, and simmer the mixture till it starts to thicken. Season the dish and mix it well. Transfer it to a bowl. Garnish it with spring onion greens and chopped peanuts. Serve it hot along with some rice.

title: Palak Gobi Manchurian
cooking_instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil, and season it with salt. Add the cleaned spinach and boil for 20-25 seconds. Remove it into a bowl of cold water. Once it cools down, squeeze out the spinach and blend it into a smooth paste.

In a bowl, add the cauliflower florets along with salt and turmeric powder. Immerse it in hot water, cover and rest for 5 minutes. Drain out the cauliflower from the water. Add 3 tbsp of the prepared palak paste and all the other ingredients and mix to coat evenly. Sprinkle water as needed.
Deep-fry on high heat for around 3 minutes until crisp. Remove from the oil and set aside.
In another pan/wok, heat oil and add ginger, garlic and green chilli. Saute for a few seconds until the colour starts to brown.

Add onion and saute for a minute, followed by tomato ketchup, soy sauce, black pepper powder and salt. Add the palak paste and saute for 3-4 minutes on high heat. Add a splash of water if it gets too dry. Add the fried gobi and coriander leaves. Mix & toss to coat evenly. Serve it as a starter/snack with toothpicks for an authentic street-food feel.

title: Kongunadu Vellai Chicken Biryani
cooking_instructions: For the paste add all the ingredients into a blender and blend it into a smooth paste.

In a deep pan add the peanut oil and ghee, add the whole garam masalas, and once aromatic add the sliced onion and green chillis and saute for 30 seconds. Add the paste and cook until the raw flavour goes away, then add tomatoes, coriander leaves. Saute until the leaves wilt.
Add the chicken and cook for 2 minutes. Add mint leaves, coconut milk, salt, water, and lemon juice and bring it to a boil.

Add soaked jeera samba rice and mix gently making sure the chicken doesn’t break. Bring it to a boil and simmer the flame and cook on low heat for 12-14 minutes. Rest the biryani for at least 15 minutes, fluff up the rice and serve.

title: Easy Milk Burfi
cooking_instructions: In a pan, add milk powder and ghee and mix it till it becomes a crumbly Mixture. Keep it aside.
In another pot, add sugar and water. Slowly melt the sugar to a single string consistency.
Add the milk powder mixture to the sugar syrup and mix it till it dissolves in the syrup. Stir it for 5 more minutes on a low flame and take it out.

Line a tray with parchment paper and sprinkle chopped nuts and raisins. Pour the milk powder mixture on it and level it. Let it rest/cool down for 2-3 hours. Once it is set, Demould it and cut it into even sized pieces and serve it.

title: Ragi Dosa
cooking_instructions: To make the batter, add the ragi, rice flour and rava to a bowl. Add water and whisk till a smooth thin batter forms.
Add the onions, curry leaves, green chillies, salt,  coriander and mix well.
Heat a tawa, pour over the batter, add oil and cook it on a medium flame till crispy. Flip it and cook it for a minute. Transfer it to a plate and serve it hot with chutney.

title: Kesar Badam Milk Pre-Mix
cooking_instructions: Pour water and add the badam. Bring the water to a boil, and continue cooking for 2 more minutes.
Strain the badam and de-skin it, pat dry with a clean towel.
Add the peeled badam to a pan and dry roast until all the moisture has evaporated, and set aside.
In a mixer jar add the sugar, cardamom and turmeric powder and blend it into a fine powder
Now add the roasted badam to the mixer and blend it into a fine powder again. Store it in an air-tight container and refrigerate for up to 6 months.
Now add 3 tbsp of this powder to 2 ½ Cups of hot milk, give it a good mix and serve either hot or cold.

title: Cookd Chettinad Mayonnaise
cooking_instructions: In a blender, add  all the ingredients and pulse blend until smooth and thick. Store air tight/ refrigerated for 5 days or enjoy with fried snacks.

title: No-Cheese White Pasta
cooking_instructions: Bring water to boil in a pot, add and cook the pasta in the boiling water for 5-7 mins, until cooked but still firm (al-dente). Drain the pasta and add oil to prevent the pasta from sticking on to each other. Reserve some of the water which can be used to adjust the consistency of your pasta.
In a pan, melt the butter and saute the garlic & onion until aromatic.

Add the maida and cook for a minute. Add the milk gently and stir continuously to prevent the formation of lumps in the sauce. Add the seasonigs and flavourings- salt, sugar, nutmeg, oregano seasoning and white pepper, and mix well. Simmer until the sauce has thickened.
Add the boiled pasta and adjust the consistency with the pasta water, if needed. Simmer for 1-2 mins and switch off the flame. Garnish optionally with grated cheese and red chilli flakes. Serve hot.

title: Thokku Biryani
cooking_instructions: Open the Cookd Wedding Bhai Biryani Kit, soak the rice for 20 mins.

Add the biryani paste from the Cookd Wedding Bhai Biryani Kit in a pressure cooker. Saute the paste for 1 minute. Add Water and bring it to a boil. Add the soaked rice, pressure cook for 2 whistles and let it rest for 10 mins.
In a pan add oil, add the onions and saute until translucent, add curry leaves and tomatoes, saute for a couple of minutes.
Add the chicken pieces and the Cookd Madurai Chukka Masala. Mix well. Add water, mix well. Cover and Cook for 15 minutes. Open and simmer until the gravy thickens.

title: Tiffin Sambar
cooking_instructions: Wash the toor dal until the water runs clear and then soak it for 20-30 mins. Add all the ingredients under “for the dal” and pressure cook for 4 whistles. Mash well and set aside.
In a pan, dry roast the ingredients under “for the masala” until aromatic and golden. Blend them into a fine powder once cooled and set aside.

In a pot, add the coconut oil and ghee followed by the mustard seeds, wait until the crackle. Add the split urad dal. Then add the dried red chillies, asafoetida, curry leaves, and shallots. Saute for 2 mins.
Add the cooked dal mixture, jaggery and salt. Bring to a boil and add the tamarind water. Boil for 2-3 mins.
Add the masala powder and simmer for 7-10 mins until it has thickened. Finish with the coriander leaves and a tsp of ghee. Serve hot with tiffin items/ rice.

title: Vegan Mushroom Curry Pasta
cooking_instructions: Boil the pasta according to the package instructions run it in cold water and set aside.
In a mixer jar add all the ingredients for the sauce and blend it into a smooth paste.
In a pan pour oil, add mushrooms and saute for 3 minutes until it develops colour, sprinkle the italian seasoning and saute.
Add diced baby corn and saute for 2 more minutes, then add the blended sauce and cook for 3-4 minutes until the raw flavour disappears.
Add the onion, water and bell peppers, saute for another minute then add the boiled pasta. Cook for 1 minute and turn off the flame, finish with chopped coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Chicken Basil Soup
cooking_instructions: Heat a pan, add butter, let it melt. Add garlic, onion and saute until it turns translucent.
Add the chopped carrot, celery and basil leaves. Saute it till they shrink.

Add the maida and mix it till the mixture becomes like roux and the raw flavour of the maida is gone. Add water, whisk the mixture till the roux dissolves and it starts to thicken slightly. Strain the mixture, keep it on the flame and bring it to a slight boil.

In another pan, heat butter, add the chicken cubes and basil and saute them together till the chicken cooks. Add it to the thickened soup base. Season it with salt and pepper. Add a tablespoon of fresh cream, mix it well. Portion the soup evenly in soup bowls, garnish with parsley and fresh cream. Serve it hot.

title: Aloo Paratha
cooking_instructions: Combine the salt, oil and flour in a bowl. Add the water and wet the flour using your finger tips. Use some extra water if there are any leftover dry flour bits. Clump together a rough dough. Cover and rest for 10 mins.
Once rested, knead the dough for 1-2 mins until it is non-sticky and smooth. Cover and rest again for 10 mins.
To make the filling: Mash the potatoes and combine the vegetables and seasonings ad mix well. Portion the mixture evenly to roughly the size of the dough roundels.
Roll out the dough into a log and cut into even sized pieces.
Flatten each piece into thick discs. Stuff the filling into the dough carefully without any gaps or holes.

Using some flour to dust, roll them into discs gently while slowly, the thickness is of choice. Cook on a preheated tava, until small bubbles appear on both sides. Then apply ghee/ butter and cook until golden brown on both sides and serve hot.

title: Mix Veg Thoran
cooking_instructions: Remove the ends of the beans and chop it finely. Peel the carrot and then grate it or chop it finely using a knife. You can either grate the cabbage or chop it finely using a knife.
Heat oil in a pan and then add mustard seeds. Allow it to crackle. Add dry red chilli, shallots, green chilli, salt and turmeric powder. Saute it for a minute.
Add the chopped vegetables and mix well to combine. Drizzle the water over the vegetables.

Sprinkle the coconut and curry leaves over the vegetables evenly, then cover with a lid and cook on medium-low heat for 2-3 minutes. Open the lid, then stir and cook for 2 minutes. The dish is ready to serve with rice!

title: Nasi Lemak
cooking_instructions: In a mixer jar add all the ingredients except the fish and blend it into a coarse paste.

In a pan pour oil and add the paste and cook for 5-6 minutes on a moderate flame while stirring continuously until the raw flavour disappears. Add ½ Cup water to prevent the paste from burning. Add the optional mushroom powder, Kashmiri red chilli powder and soy sauce and give it a good mix. Add the dried fish and another ½ Cup water and cook for 4-5 minutes on a moderate flame until the fish is hydrated and the pungent flavour reduces and set aside.
In a pan add oil and all the aromatics and saute for 30 seconds.

Then add the soaked rice to it and saute gently for 30 more seconds. Pour coconut milk, water and salt, mix gently and bring it to a boil. Once it reaches a boil, reduce the flame to simmer and cook cover for 12 minutes.
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients and let it marinate for 30 minutes.
Deep fry until golden brown in a moderate flame.

title: Peanut Chutney
cooking_instructions: In a pan roast the peanuts for about 5 mins on a medium flame, ensuring the skin doesn’t burn. Let it cool and peel off the skin.

In a pan, add some oil, cumin seeds, coriander seed, shallots, whole red chillies and tamarind. Saute this for a couple of minutes. Add the peanuts and salt. Transfer all of this to a blender, add water and blend it into a paste.

title: Potato Bonda
cooking_instructions: Mash 3 boiled potatoes and keep it aside.

Heat oil in a pan and crackle mustard seeds and cumin. Add ginger, green chilli, curry leaves, cashew, asafoetida,  and turmeric powder. Saute for a minute to remove the raw taste of the ginger, then add lemon juice and salt.
Add the boiled potato, mash and combine to mix evenly. Add coriander leaves, mix and turn off the heat.
Combine together besan, rice flour, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, salt, asafoetida and baking powder. Mix and then add water gradually until it forms a thick batter.

Once it cools, make small roundels of the potato mixture (around 2 inches in diameter). Heat oil in a kadai. Once the oil is hot, dip the potato roundels in the batter then add it to the hot oil. Fry on medium-high heat until it turns crips and golden, around 4 minutes. Remove from the oil and drain on kitchen tissue. Serve with coconut chutney, or any other chutney of your choice. It can also be served on its own.

title: Butterscotch Bread Pudding
cooking_instructions: In a non-stick pan add the sugar and let it turn amber, Immediately add the almonds and give it a good mix. Transfer it to a parchment sheet and let it cool down completely before grinding it into a coarse powder.
In a non-stick pan add sugar and let it turn amber, immediately add butter and cream whisk continuously until thickened and set aside.
In a mixing bowl add the whipping cream and whisk using a hand mixer until it reaches soft peaks and set aside.

Cut the crusts off the bread slices. Dip the bread slices into the caramel sauce and place it on a dish. Add the whipped cream and spread it evenly and sprinkle the almond praline. Repeat this process again and refrigerate covered for 4-5 hours and serve.

title: Karuvepillai Podi Sadham
cooking_instructions: Dry roast the curry leaves and set it aside.
Dry roast all the lentils until golden brown and set aside.
Dry roast all the other ingredients until they lose moisture and set aside to cool down. Add all the ingredients to a blender jar then add salt and asafoetida, grind it into a coarse powder.

In a pan pour oil and add peanuts and cashews, saute until they turn golden brown. Add onion, green chilli and garlic and saute until the onion turns translucent. Add the cooked rice to the pan and add 3 tbsp of the podi along with a tablespoon of ghee. Thoroughly mix the rice and serve hot, optionally garnish with more ghee.

title: Tandoori Baby Potatoes
cooking_instructions: Boil the baby potatoes in salted water until fork tender and set aside.

In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the marinade and mix thoroughly, add the boiled potatoes and gently mix until thoroughly combined. For a more authentic tandoor flavour smoke the marinated potatoes for 30 minutes.
Air fry the baby potatoes for 20 minutes at 200 degrees Celsius. Once hot and crispy transfer the potatoes to a bowl, add ghee and sprinkle chaat masala and serve hot.

title: Quinoa Kichadi
cooking_instructions: Let the quinoa and moong dal soak for 30 minutes.

In a pressure cooker add ghee whole garam masalas, and mustard seeds, once it splutters add urad and channa dal. Add curry leaves, green chilli, tomatoes and onions after the lentils turn golden brown, saute until the tomato turns.
Drain the quinoa and moong dal add it to the cooker and toast for 30 seconds then add ginger garlic paste and turmeric powder.
Give it a good mix and pour water, once it boils add the lid and cook for 3 whistles or 10 minutes on a moderate flame. Let it rest for 10 minutes and finish with some coriander and mint leaves.

title: Karuveppillai Chicken Varuval
cooking_instructions: Add the ingredients for pureeing to a blender and blend them to a fine paste.
Heat oil in a pan, add fennel, cumin seeds, curry leaves and let them crackle. Add the onions and saute till they turn golden brown.
Add the masala powders and cook it for a minute. Add the curry leaf paste and cook it well for a minute.
Add the chicken pieces and cook it for 2-3 minutes on a high flame, mixing continuously.
Add water, salt and mix well. Cover and cook on a low flame for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Open the pot, add black pepper powder and mix well. Cook the mixture till it is dry. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Snow Pudding
cooking_instructions:
In a saucepan pour milk and immediately add cornflour and sugar. Whisk the milk continuously until thickened
Pour vanilla essence and add cardamom powder, give it a good mix
Transfer it into containers and refrigerate for 3 hours or until set. Once set, de-mould it, coat it in desiccated coconut, and garnish with the sprinkles.

title: Jowar Roti
cooking_instructions: In a large vessel, bring the water to a boil with salt and 1 tsp of ghee. Add the jowar flour and mix until all the water has been absorbed. Switch off the flame, cover and set aside for 10 mins.

Tip the dough on to a larger work surface if needed and use a steel vessel to knead the warm dough. Use water to prevent it from sticking. Once the dough is cool enough to handle, knead with your palm ends again, moistened with water to prevent sticking.

Portion only the quantity of dough to be used for each bhakri. Knead the individual portion until smooth - there are two ways to flatten the dough. Method 1 - dust rice flour and roll out using a rolling pin, ensure it is even and thinly rolled out, bring together the cracks on the ends.

Cook it on a preheated tava on low flame, add some water on the top side. Once the bottom has dried out, flip the bhakri and cook until dry on both sides. Make the flame medium and apply gentle pressure to encourage it to puff up/ put it on a high flame until it puffs up - flip and cook on both sides. Remove it from the flame and apply ghee, if needed.

title: Mutton Urundai Curry
cooking_instructions: Add the mutton mince, salt, ginger garlic paste, masala powders to a blender and blend till smooth. Transfer the mutton to a bowl and add the remaining ingredients for the urundai. Mix well till all ingredients combine evenly.
Roll and shape them into even sized spheres. Heat oil in a pan and shallow fry the mutton on a medium flame for 10 minutes till it turns golden brown. Keep it aside.
Heat a kadai, add oil, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, star anise, kalpasi, fennel seeds , green chillies, curry leaves and let it crackle.
Add the onions and saute till it turns light brown. Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute.
Add the masala powders and saute for another minute. Add the tomatoes and and mix till it becomes mushy.

Add water, bring it to a boil. Season it with salt and black pepper powder and mix well. Add the fried mutton urundai and mix gently. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Cook till the gravy thickens. Garnish with chopped coriander leaves and serve it hot with rice.

title: Prawn Pickle
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl add the prawns, red chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, mix it thoroughly and let it marinate for 30 minutes.
Dry roast all the ingredients for the pickle powder and blend it into a fine powder.
Blend the shallots into a fine paste with ginger garlic paste and set aside.
In a kadhai pour oil, once hot add curry leaves, add the marinated prawns to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, remove the prawns and set aside.
Add the shallot paste and cook until the raw flavour disappears. add red chilli and turmeric powder along with the roasted pickle powder and cook for a minute more.
Pour the vinegar, boil it, and cook for 2 more minutes. Cool down the pickle, jar it and store it in a fridge.

title: Pappad Paneer Cigars
cooking_instructions: Soak the pappad for 2-3 minutes until soft
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the filling and mix thoroughly.
Add a tablespoon of the filling to the soaked pappad and roll it like a burrito and deep fry until golden brown. Serve hot.

title: Mutton Yakhni Pulao
