cooking_instructions: Wash and soak rice for 30 minutes.
In a mixing bowl add the mutton along with all the ingredients except the water and marinate for 30 minutes

Add the marinated mutton to a pressure cooker, add water and cook it on a high flame for the first whistles and for 8 whistles or 15 minutes on a moderate flame. Take out the mutton pieces and keep it in a separate bowl and strain the liquid. Measure 3 ¼ cups (800ml) of water from the cooker. Add extra water if the mutton water doesn't come up to the required quantity.
In another pot add ghee and the cooked mutton and pour the mutton stock and bring it to a boil and add salt. Add the soaked rice, cook uncovered till the rice and water are almost level

Keep it on a preheated tawa for dum on a low flame for 15 minutes. If the tawa isn’t hot, keep it on a high flame for the first 5 minutes and on a low flame for the next 10 minutes. Turn off the flame, and let it rest for 10 minutes. Open the pot, add 2 tbsp of saffron water and cover the pot for 2 more minutes. Open the pot, fluff the pulao and serve it hot with raita.

title: Black Pepper Crab
cooking_instructions:
Heat a wok/kadai, add oil. Add chopped garlic and onions and saute for a few seconds.
Add black pepper powder and the crabs. Mix and toss on a high flame for a minute. Add water, soy sauce and bring it to a boil.
Add butter. Cover and cook the crab for 10 minutes. Open the pot and give it a good mix. Mix it on a medium flame till it forms a thick sauce. Bring it to a soft boil and take it off the flame.

title: Muttai Milagu Masala
cooking_instructions: Heat water in a pot and bring it to a boil. Add the eggs gently and boil it for 12 minutes. Transfer the eggs to a bowl of ice water immediately. Peel the eggs, cut it into halves.
Heat a pan, add oil and fry the boiled eggs in it.
To a blender, add the ingredients required for the puree and blend it to a fine paste.
Heat a kadai, add oil. Add curry leaves, green chilli and let it crackle. Add the onions and saute till it turns light brown. Add the blended paste to it and cook it for 2 minutes.
Add the dry masala powders and cook it for a minute.Add tomatoes and cook till it becomes soft and mushy.

Add water, bring it to a boil. Cover and simmer the gravy for 5 minutes.
Season the gravy. Add the fried egg and mix gently. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot with dosa.

title: Paneer Sabudana Vadai
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl add boiled potatoes and mash until disintegrated. Mix all the other ingredients thoroughly until completely combined and shape it into vadais.
Deep fry the vadais until golden brown and serve hot.

title: Chilli Garlic Prawns
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a large pan. Add the garlic and saute till it starts to turn light brown.
Add the chilli flakes, let it crackle and immediately add prawns and mix well.
Add soy sauce, salt and mix well. Cook on a high flame till all the water has evaporated and only oil remains at the bottom.
Garnish with sesame seeds, coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Karuvepillai Kozhambu
cooking_instructions: Dry roast all the ingredients for the masala powder and set aside to cool down
Soak the tamarind in hot water for 15-20 minutes.
Add the curry leaves and roasted ingredients to a mixer bowl and blend it into a smooth paste (add a splash of water if required) and set aside.

In a kadhai pour sesame oil and add all the ingredients for the tempering and add garlic. Saute until aromatic and add finely chopped tomato, cook for 30 more seconds and add the paste, asafoetida and turmeric powder.

Add the ground paste. Cook on moderate heat for 3-4 minutes or until the raw flavour totally disappears, then add the tamarind water and boil for a few minutes. Once thickened remove from the heat and serve over rice. Imperative to pour ghee over the rice and eat it with sutta appalam.

title: Sweet Garlic Chicken Stir Fry
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl add the chicken and all the other ingredients for the chicken and let it sit for 30 minutes.
Deep fry the chicken until golden brown and crispy and set aside.

In a pan pour 2 tbsp oil and add finely chopped garlic, saute for 10 seconds and add the honey. Cook for 10 more seconds and add the corn starch slurry. Cook the slurry for 10 seconds and pour water and let it reduce to a syrup.
Add the deep-fried chicken and add a little bit of salt and pepper. Garnish it with sesame seeds and serve hot.

title: Cold Cocoa
cooking_instructions: In a pan add milk, cornstarch and cocoa powder and whisk until combined, then heat the mixture
Once thickened add sugar, chocolate and coffee and mix continuously until the chocolate completely melts and the mixture thickens.
Crush the ice and add it to your serving vessel of choice, pour the cocoa mixture and serve.

title: Desi One Pot Chicken and Rice
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl add the chicken and all the spices and marinate for 30 minutes.
In a deep pan pour ghee and once hot enough add the marinated chicken and cook on one side until golden brown and take it out.
In the same pan add onions and curry leaves and saute until it turns light golden add the soaked and drained rice and toast until it slightly develops colour.

Pour water and bring it to a boil, place the chicken back and reduce the flame to simmer, cover and cook for 12 minutes. Let it rest for 10 minutes and fluff it up and finish it with chopped coriander and mint leaves.

title: Tandoori Roti
cooking_instructions: Combine the salt, oil and flour in a bowl. Add the water and wet the flour using your finger tips. Use some extra water if there is any leftover dry flour bits. Clump together a rough dough. Cover and rest for 10 mins.
Once rested, knead the dough for 1-2 mins until it is non-sticky and smooth. Cover and rest again for 10 mins.
Roll out the dough into a log and cut into even sized pieces. Roll each piece into roundels. Using some flour to dust, roll then into slightly thick and medium sized discs.

Apply water on one side and stick it on a cast iron/ steel pan that has been pre-heated. Allow bubbles to develop for a few seconds and then upturn the pan carefully over an open flame to cook the top and develop the characteristic char marks. Apply ghee/ butter and release it using a spatula from the pan. Serve hot.

title: Sticky Coconut Rice with Mango
cooking_instructions:
In a pan pour water bring it to a boil and add the unwashed jeeraga samba rice.
Add a pinch of salt and add the coconut milk and sugar, cook covered for 12-14 minutes on a simmer
Once cooked let it cool completely. And serve it with sliced mango

title: Coriander Chutney
cooking_instructions: Saute the dals in oil until golden. Add the remaining ingredients except the coriander and saute until soft.
Finally add the coriander leaves and turn off the flame. Cool down slightly and blend into a smooth paste with some water.
For the tempering: splutter mustard seeds in the oil and add the remaining ingredients. Cook further for 20 seconds. Add this tempering into the chutney paste and mix well.

title: Cashew Uthappam
cooking_instructions: Heat a dosa tava well. Add a ladle full of dosa batter and do not spread too much, it must be a thick. Add the cashew nuts as a topping, liberally. Add a generous amount of ghee to make the edges crispy. Flip and cook until both sides are crispy.

title: Choco-Banana Wheat Cake
cooking_instructions:
To a bowl, add the bananas and smash it with a fork to a smooth texture. Add sugar, coconut oil and give it a good whisk till the sugar dissolves
Add curd and whisk till it combines. Add the wheat, cornflour, cocoa powder, baking powder and baking soda and sieve it into the bowl and fold the mixture with a spatula
Add milk and mix till it combines to form a a batter. Add chopped chocolate and fold it in.
Bake it in a preheated oven at 180 degrees celsius for 55 minutes. Check with a toothpick to see if it is cooked through.
Take it out of the oven and let it cold down completely. Cut and serve

title: Oats Paniyaram
cooking_instructions: To a bowl add oats and water, and let it soak for 20 minutes.
Heat a pan, add oil. Add mustard, cumin seeds, green chilli and let it crackle. Add onions and saute till it turns translucent.
Add the chopped carrots and saute for 2 minutes. Add asafoetida, salt, and coriander leaves. GIve it a good mix.
Transfer the soaked oat mixture to a blender and blend it to a coarse texture. Transfer the mixture to the oats batter.

Heat a paniyaram pan. Add oil and spoon in the oats mixture and cook it on a medium low flame for 5 minutes and flip it over with a stick. Cook it for 2-3 more minutes and make sure it is cooked through. Transfer it to a plate, serve it hot with chutney of sambar.

title: Maggie Pakoda
cooking_instructions: Chop the onions and green chilli and set aside. Cook the noodles without the tastemaker and set aside to cool.
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the pakoda and mix until thoroughly combined. Shape it into balls and deep fry until golden brown, serve it with ketchup.

title: Karuvepillai Thogayal
cooking_instructions: In a pan pour peanut oil, once hot add coriander seeds and cumin. Once aromatic add channa dal, urad dal, and white sesame seeds and tamarind. Saute for 20 more seconds or until golden brown and aromatic.
Add the curry leaves and cook until the leaves wilt and turn aromatic. Take it off the heat.
Add it to a blender and add grated coconut, black peppercorns, green chilli and dry red chilli and salt. Blend into a coarse paste and serve with hot white rice. Store refrigerated for up to a week.

title: Muradabadi Chicken Biryani
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, add the washed chicken. To the chicken add all the ingredients required for the marination. Mix till all ingredients combine evenly and the chicken is coated evenly. Let the chicken marinate for 40 minutes to an hour.
Wash and soak the basmati Rice for 20 minutes.
Heat a pot, add oil and ghee. Add the sliced onions and green chillies. Saute till the onions turn golden brown.

Add the marinated chicken to the pot and mix on a medium flame for 2 minutes. Mix well. Cover and cook the chicken on a medium flame for 10 minutes on a medium flame, stirring occasionally. (At this point the chicken would leave little water.)

Open the pot, add 750ml (3 cups) of water. Add 2 tsp salt to it and bring it to a boil. Once the water starts boiling, add the soaked and strained basmati rice. Mix it gently and cook on a high flame till the rice and water are level.

Cover the pot tightly and place it on a preheated tawa for 15 minutes on a low flame. After 15 minutes, turn off the flame,  open the pot, top the biryani with fried onions, saffron water, chopped coriander leaves, ghee and kewra water.
Cover the pot again and let the biryani rest for 10 more minutes. Open the pot, fluff the biryani and serve it hot along with raita.

title: Lunchbox Special Carrot Rice
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes.

Heat a cooker, add oil. Add mustard, cumin seeds, dry red chillies, curry leaves and let it crackle. Add the cashew nuts and saute for a few seconds. Add the chopped onions and saute till it turns translucent.
Add turmeric powder and the grated carrots and mix well for 2-3 minutes. Add water and salt. Mix well and bring it to a boil.
Add the soaked and strained rice. Cover and pressure cook for 4 whistles. Turn off the flame and let the steam reduce gradually. Open the cooker, fluff the rice and serve it hot.

title: Crispy Cajun Potatoes
cooking_instructions: Pressure cook the potatoes for 4 whistles with a cup of water and a tsp of salt.
Mix all the ingredients for the sauce in a bowl until well combined and in a pouring consistency.
Strain and smash them with the skin-on. Sprinkle salt to season them.
Coat them with cornstarch. Fry them until crispy and golden brown on a medium high flame. Pour the sauce over the fried potatoes and then garnish with chopped coriander leaves and onions.

title: Bread Omelette
cooking_instructions: Chop the onion, green chilli, coriander leaves and set it aside.

In a mixing bowl break and whisk three eggs until homogeneous. Add salt, pepper, finely chopped onion, green chilli and coriander leaves. Whisk until thoroughly combined, in a buttered non-stick pan pour the eggs.

Once the omelette is set(around 10 seconds) add the bread and cook for 10 more seconds and flip. Once cooked take it off the heat and garnish it with mayo, ketchup and finely chopped coriander leaves.

title: Carrot and Coconut Burfi
cooking_instructions: Heat a pan, add ghee to it. Add the grated coconut and carrot and saute till it is rid of the raw aroma.
Add sugar, cardamom powder and mix. Add 1 tbsp ghee and mix well.
Transfer it to a greased tray and spread it out evenly from end to end. Let it cool down and set at room temperature for 6 hours. Demould it, cut and serve.

title: Trivandrum Chicken Fry
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl add chicken, Kashmiri red chilli powder, salt and turmeric, mix and let it marinate for 30 minutes.
In a kadhai pour oil and sliced onion, Once golden brown immediately add ginger garlic paste, dry red chillies and green chillies. Add cumin and fennel seeds and cook for 10 more seconds.

Add the marinated chicken and saute for 2 minutes on high heat. Pour water and cook uncovered for 10 more minutes on a moderate flame until the chicken is cooked through and the water evaporates. Serve hot with roti or parottas.

title: Techa Prawns
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl add the prawns and add ginger garlic paste and turmeric powder. Marinate the prawns for a minimum of 30 mins.

In a pan pour oil and add the green chillies and garlic cloves. Once they turn golden brown and become blistered take them off the heat and let it cool. In a mortar and pestle pound them into a coarse paste and set aside

In a pan pour oil and saute the marinated prawns for 1 minute on high heat and add the prepared techa to the prawns add salt and saute for a minute more. Turn off the heat and add coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Easy Parotta
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl, add maida, salt, sugar and water. Mix well. Add water and mix to bring together a rough dough. Cover and rest for 10 mins.

Knead the dough until smooth and rest again for 10 mins. Apply 1 tbsp of oil. Knead the dough until it comes together. Rest for 5 mins. Knead again until smooth and rest again for 10 mins. Apply some oil.
Roll into a log, cut and shape into roundels. Apply 1 tbsp of oil and rest again for 10 mins.
Roll out until flat, even and thin discs. Apply 1 tsp of oil. Cut into threads and gather them, roll into a disc and tuck into the bottom. Roll out thick and small discs.

Cook on a preheated tava with some extra oil on a medium flame until golden brown on both sides and cooked through. Remove them from the tava and press them firmly between your palms on a table surface to release the layers. Serve hot or store covered.

title: Channa Pulao
cooking_instructions: In a pressure cooker add the soaked channa along with water and salt. Pressure cook for 3 whistles and set aside.
In a pot pour oil and add all the whole garam masalas, once aromatic add the sliced onions and saute until the onions turn translucent, add the chilli powder and turmeric powder.
Add the soaked rice and saute gently for 30 seconds and pour water and bring it to a boil.
Add the drained channa and add it on top of the rice, sprinkle garam masala on top and cover. Cook for 12 minutes on a simmer, once cooked garnish with coriander leaves and serve.

title: One Pot Pepper Mutton Chukka
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl add the Mutton, Ginger Garlic Paste, Kashmiri Red Chilli Powder, Turmeric Powder, Garam Masala, Cumin Powder, Fennel Powder and Salt. Mix until thoroughly combined and let it marinate for at least an hour in a refrigerator.

In a pressure cooker, add butter and onions, green chilli and shallots. Saute until the onions are translucent and add the fennel seeds and add the marinated mutton. Saute for 2-3 minutes on a high flame and pour 1⁄2 Cup water and pressure cook on moderate heat for 20 mins or 9 whistles.

Let the cooker rest until all the pressure releases, open the lid and cook on a high flame until the water evaporates. Add curry leaves and black pepper powder at the end and cook for 2 more minutes on a high flame. Serve hot with parotta or rice.

title: Chicken and Veggies Stir Fry
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the sauce and mix thoroughly and set aside.
Coat the chicken in maida and salt, and set aside. In a wok, pour oil, cook the chicken until it’s golden brown and strain it out of the pan.

In the same pan add carrots, baby corn and mushrooms and saute until the veggies turn slightly soft. Add broccoli florets, onion, bell peppers and minced garlic, give it a good toss and pour the prepared sauce.
Add the stir fried chicken and saute until the stir fry turns glossy and garnish with chopped coriander leaves. Serve hot along with rice.

title: Masala Corn Toast
cooking_instructions: Heat a pan, add oil. Add garlic and saute for a few seconds. Add onion and saute till it turns translucent.
Add the sweet corn kernels and mix it. Add the masala pastes and cook for a few seconds. Add the fresh cream, processed cheese and mix till it combines well.

Heat a tawa, keep it on a low flame. Add butter and place a slice of bread on it.
Add the corn mixture. Grate cheese on it and cover it till the cheese starts to melt. Take it out, garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: No Churn Mango Ice Cream
cooking_instructions: Peel the mangoes and add them to a blender jar along with the condensed milk. Blend it into a smooth paste and set aside.
In another mixing bowl whip the cream for 2-3 minutes or until a lot of air is incorporated. Add the mango paste to the cream, whip the mixture until thoroughly combined and add it to a mould.
Freeze for 2-3 hours or until semi-set and blend it again until nice and smooth. Add back the ice cream mixture to the mould and freeze for 5-6 hours or until completely set.

title: Gongura Chicken Pulao
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add the chicken, add all the ingredients for the marination and marinate the chicken for 1 hour.
In a pan pour oil and saute the gongura leaves until they wilt and blend them into a smooth paste and set aside.
In a pan, pour oil and add all the whole garam masalas and onion, saute until they are almost golden brown and add ginger garlic paste. 
Cook until the raw flavour disappears and add the marinated chicken to the pot, saute for 2-3 minutes on high flame and add the gongura paste. Mix everything and cook for another minute. Pour water and bring it to a boil. Add the soaked and drained basmati rice, bring it to a boil add salt, give it a good mix and reduce the flame to a simmer. Cover and cook for 12 minutes.
Let the rice rest for 10 minutes then garnish with coriander leaves and ghee. Fluff up the rice and serve hot.

title: Vegan Cream of Mushroom Soup
cooking_instructions:
In a pan pour olive oil,add the dried herbs and saute on low heat,  add the sliced mushrooms and saute on high heat until all the water is evaporated and the mushrooms start to develop some colour.
Add minced garlic and onions and saute until the onions turn aromatic and translucent. Take half the mixture and add it to a blender along with cashew nuts and water, blend into a smooth paste and add it back to the pot. 

Pour water and bring it to a boil. Add salt, soy sauce and black pepper powder.Cook soup for 2 -3 more minutes or until the raw flavour of cashews disappear.Turn off the heat and garnish with spring onion greens.

title: Schezwan Fish
cooking_instructions:
Heat water in pan, add water and bring it to a boil. Add the kashmiri chillies and boil it for 5 minutes. Reserve a little chilli water. Strain the chillies and transfer it to a blender. Add water if necessary and blend it to a fine paste and keep it aside.
To a bowl, add the fish cubes, maida, cornflour, salt, sugar, msg and black pepper powder. Mix till the fish is coated well
Heat oil in a kadai and deep fry till it is golden brown and keep it aside
Heat a wok, add oil
Add chopped ginger and garlic and saute for a few seconds
Add the cashew nuts, diced onion and capsicum and toss well on a high flame for a few seconds
Add the chilli paste and cook it well for a minute
Add soy sauce, ketchup, salt and pepper. Mix well till all ingredients combine evenly
Add the fried fish,  and toss till it is evenly coated with the sauce.
Add chopped spring onions and toss on a high flame and take it off the flame.
Serve it hot garnished with spring onions

title: Lamb Vindaloo
cooking_instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a pan. Add all the ingredients needed for the paste, except the vinegar. Cook until it is fragrant.
Once they cooled down a little, add them to a mixer jar. Add vinegar and grind to a paste.
Marinate the mutton with the paste for at least 2 hours. It tastes best when marinated overnight.
In a pan, heat 4 tbsp oil and add the chopped onions and saute until it starts to brown.
Add the marinated mutton. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add 2 tsp of salt and sugar.

Add water and bring it to a boil. Cover and simmer on medium-low heat for 45 minutes, or until the mutton is well cooked and tender. Stir occasionally to make sure it is not sticking to the bottom of the pan.

title: Godhumai Upma
cooking_instructions:
Add groundnut oil to a pan and add the mustard seeds, urad dal and chana dal. Once the mustard seeds splutter, add the finely chopped ginger, green chilies and red chili. 
Add onions and saute until translucent, add the tomatoes and cook until mushy. Add salt
Add water and bring it to a boil. Add the broken wheat and cook on a medium high flame for about 6 mins, stirring continuously. Add the coriander leaves.
Remove from the heat, cover and let it rest for 10 mins.

title: Triangle Paratha
cooking_instructions:
Combine the salt, oil and flour in a bowl. Add the water and wet the flour using your finger tips. Use some extra water if there is any leftover dry flour bits. Clump together a rough dough. Cover and rest for 10 mins. 
Once rested, knead the dough for 1-2 mins until it is non-sticky and smooth. Cover and rest again for 10 mins. Roll out the dough into a log and cut into even sized pieces.Roll each piece into roundels. 
Using some flour to dust, roll then into thin and large discs. Apply ghee on one half and sprinkle some dry flour. Fold the paratha in half and then repeat the ghee and flour on one side, fold again by half into a triangle shape. Use dry flour to dust and roll our each side evenly to stretch out a larger triangle paratha. 
Cook on a preheated tava on both sides by applying ghee and cooking until golden brown on a medium-high flame. Serve hot.

title: Almond Chocolate Spread
cooking_instructions:
Heat a pan, add almonds. Dry roast the almonds for 10 minutes on a low flame. Blanch the almonds in boiling water for a minute.
Peel and separate the almonds and the skins.Transfer it to a blender and blend it to a fine powder
Keep pulsing it till it lets out oil Add the remaining ingredients and blend till it is smooth and combined.Transfer it to a jar and store it in a cool and dry place or the refrigerator

title: Butter Garlic Mushroom Rice
cooking_instructions:
Heat a pan, add oil and butter. Add garlic and saute till it turns light brown. Add onion and saute till it turns translucent
Add the mushrooms and saute on a high flame till it is cooked completely. If it lets out water, cook it till it is dry. Add the cooked rice,   salt, pepper and oregano. Mix and toss on a high flame till all the ingredients combine evenly
Add chopped coriander or parsley and give it a good mix.. Serve it hot

title: Tender Coconut Mango Milkshake
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer jar add diced mangoes, tender coconut water and ice cream. Blend until very smooth
Add extra tender coconut water to adjust the consistency. Serve chilled

title: Taiwanese Basil Fried Popcorn
cooking_instructions:
In a pan dry roast all the spices until aromatic and let it cool. Blend it into a fine powder and set aside
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the marination and mix thoroughly. Let the chicken sit for 30 minutes
Bread the chicken in corn starch
Fry chicken and basil leaves until crispy and add it to the fried chicken.
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the sprinkler and sprinkle on top of the chicken

title: Dahi Toast
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the curd mixture and whisk until thoroughly combined. Take the bread sliced and dip them in the curd mixture
Add it to a pan and cook until the bread turns golden brown and crispy. 
In a tadka pan pour ghee add mustard seeds, curry leaves and slit green chillies.Pour the tadka on top of the bread and serve hot.

title: Chocolate Rice Pudding
cooking_instructions:
In a pan add the rice and toast it slightly for 10 seconds and add water, bring it to a boil and reduce the heat to a simmer. Cover and cook for 12 minutes
Add ¼ Cup milk, cocoa powder and jaggery. Mix all the ingredients until combined
Add cream and Let it cook for 1-2 more minutes or until the jaggery completely dissolves and serve either chilled or warm

title: Banana Dosai
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add banana, coconut, cardamom powder and brown sugar. Mix well until thoroughly combined
Add Whole Wheat Flour, milk and baking Soda and mix until thoroughly combined
In a non-stick Tawa add the batter and brush the edges with ghee. Cook on a low flame for 1 minute and while still undercooked add chopped pistachios to the dosa and flip. Cook for a minute more and serve hot

title: Walnut Moon Cookies
cooking_instructions: Preheat an oven at 180°c.
Carefully pulse blend walnuts until powdered.
Whisk the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add the remaining ingredients and mix well to form a dough.
Cover it in cling wrap and rest the dough for 30 mins, refrigerated.
Roll out into roundels and into a log and bending them to form crescent moon shapes.
Bake in a preheated oven at 180C for 15-18 mins until lightly golden brown. Cool completely prior to serving and dust with icing sugar.

title: General Tso's Chicken
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add boneless chicken thigh, cornflour, salt, egg, black pepper powder, minced garlic and oil. Mix thoroughly and let it sit for 30 minutes.
Add corn flour and baking soda to the marinated chicken
Deep fry the chicken for 2-3 minutes on moderate flame, and remove from the heat. Increase the flame to high, let the oil heat up then double fry until crispy and cooked through and set aside.
In a pan pour oil and saute spring onion whites, ginger, garlic and celery and saute until aromatic.
Add the honey, oyster sauce, vinegar and soy sauce and let it cook for 30 seconds on a high heat.
Add salt, red chillies and pepper, pour the cornstarch slurry and let it thicken.
Add the fried chicken and toss. Garnish with spring onion green and sesame seeds.

title: Homemade Frooti
cooking_instructions:
Peel and dice the mangoes into rough cubes and cook the raw mangoes until they are fork-tender
Blend them into a fine paste along with the ripe mangoes, sugar and lemon juice.
Serve Chilled

title: Shrimp Fried Rice
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add the shrimp and all the other ingredients for the marination and give it a good mix.
Marinate the shrimp for 30 minutes
In a pan add oil and scramble 2 eggs, and set them aside
In the same pan pour a little more oil and saute the prawns on high heat, once cooked through set aside
In the same pan pour, add carrots and beans and saute for 10 seconds on high heat. Add ginger, garlic and cook for 10 more seconds
Add all the sauces, diced capsicum, and dry red chillis. Saute for 10 seconds
Add the soya sauce, cooked basmati rice, scrambled eggs and the cooked shrimp, salt and white pepper powder
Give it a good mix and garnish it with spring onions and serve hot

title: Peri Peri Baked Fish
cooking_instructions:
Add all the ingredients required for the peri peri sauce to a blender and blend it to a fine paste
Grease a baking pan, place parchment paper on it. Place the fish on it and sprinkle salt on both sides.. Pour over the peri peri sauce over the fish fillet and spread it out evenly. Top it with onions or any other topping of your choice. Drizzle some oil
Bake it at 180 degrees for 25 minutes.Take it out of the oven, garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot

title: Easy Mango Pudding
cooking_instructions:
Wash and cut the mango and take out the pulp alone.
Transfer it to a blender and add milk and sugar. Blend it till it combines in to a smooth mixture
Mix milk with cornflour in a separate bowl and keep it aside
Heat a pan, add the mango mixture and start mixing it on a low flame till it heats up and starts to bubble
Add the cornflour slurry and whisk well to avoid any lumps
Once the mixture thickens, transfer it to greased moulds and let it cool down completely.
Refrigerate it for 3 hours, demould it carefully and serve it cold

title: Goan Egg Chops
cooking_instructions:
Pressure cook the potatoes for 3 whistles on a medium flame or until fork tender and mash them completely
To the mashed potatoes add pepper powder, salt and coriander leaves, mix thoroughly 
In a pan pour oil and let it heat up, once hot add turmeric and chilli powder making sure not to burn them, add the cut eggs and fry them until golden brown. Add salt and pepper at the end and take it off the flame.
Divide the mash into equal portions and Flatten the mash and add an egg and cover it completely with the mash. 
Shape it as you desire and roll the mash in fine rava
Pan fry the chops until golden brown.

title: Manchow Soup
cooking_instructions: For Manchow Soup, the characteristic garnish is fried noodles. To prepare this, add 1 tbsp cornflour to the cooked noodles. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown, and set aside.
Heat a Wok or a Kadai until it is very hot. Then add in oil, and add in the finely chopped ginger, garlic and green chillies. Saute until they start to change colour.
Add in the finely chopped cabbage, beans, coriander stems and the carrot. Add 1 tsp of salt. Cook for 2 minutes or until the vegetables have softened.
Add soy sauce, chilli sauce and White Pepper powder. Mix well and add in the vegetable stock, vinegar and sugar. Taste and add salt, if needed. Let it simmer, covered, for 5 minutes.
Make a paste of 1 tbsp of cornflour with some water. Add it to the soup and continue cooking it till it thickens to the desired consistency. Add the chopped coriander leaves and turn off the heat.
Serve in a bowl and garnish with the fried noodles.

title: Christmas Yule Log
cooking_instructions: Combine the maida, cocoa powder and baking powder together. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the eggs along with sugar until it turns light and fluffy.
Add oil, instant coffee powder and salt. Mix until just combined.
Fold in half of the flour mixture. Add in the remaining after it is completely incorporated.
Line a large baking tray with baking paper. Pour the batter and spread evenly using a spatula. Bake in a preheated oven at 180c for 13-15 minutes.
On another baking sheet, sprinkle icing sugar. Overturn the cake onto this baking sheet and remove the top sheet. Roll it while it is still warm. Allow it to cool completely at room temperature.
For the frosting, add the cream and chocolate into a heatproof bowl. Place the bowl over a pot of boiling water and mix until it melts completely.
Whip cream in a bowl until it forms stiff peaks. Add half the chocolate ganache and mix well.
Apply this cream evenly over the sponge and roll it into a log.
Cut it diagonally at one end and stick it to the side to make it look like a branch of the log.
Spread the other half of the chocolate ganache over the log. Cool in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.
Make crooked lines with the back of a knife or a skewer. Sprinkle cocoa powder and icing sugar on top just before serving.
As a decoration, you can use crushed biscuits to resemble the texture of soil. You can also use herbs and cherries for decoration. Slice and serve.

title: Tandoori Peanut Butter
cooking_instructions:
Dry roast the peanuts and peel off the skin. Transfer it to a blender and blend it to a fine powder.
Keep pulsing it  till it starts to leave oil. Add the remaining ingredients and blend till all the ingredients combine evenly and forms a smooth butter
Smoke the butter with a hot piece of coal and some ghee for 7 minutes.Transfer it to an airtight and store it. Serve with toast etc.,

title: Mutton Thala Kari
cooking_instructions: In a pressure cooker, pour oil and add the shallots and dry red chillis, saute until they turn translucent
Add the ginger garlic paste and saute until the raw flavour disappears

Add the meat, turmeric powder, salt and garam masala.
Cook the mutton along with some water for 15-16 whistles on a moderate flame
Finish with curry leaves and coriander leaves

title: Mutton Kozhambu
cooking_instructions:
In a pan roast all the ingredients until golden brown and aromatic and let it cool down completely.. Once cooled blend into a fine paste and set aside
In a pressure cooker add oil and saute shallots and onion until translucent. Add tomato, turmeric powder and salt and cook until it turns mushy. Add the prepared paste and saute for 10 seconds.
Add mutton, pour water into the pressure cooker and cook on a moderate flame for 10- 11 whistles. Finish the gravy with curry leaves and coriander leaves.

title: Mutton Liver Pepper Fry
cooking_instructions: In a kadai add oil, shallots and green chilli. Saute until translucent and add the tomato along with all the masalas and cook until the tomato turns mushy
Add the cleaned offals and cook for 5 minutes on a moderate flame
Finish with black pepper powder and coriander leaves

title: Mutton Ratha Poriyal
cooking_instructions:
In a pan pour oil and saute the shallots and green chilli until aromatic and translucent
Add curry leaves and the goat’s blood, Saute on a moderate flame for 4-5 minutes or until the blood thoroughly cooks and turns black. 
Once the blood is completely cooked, add the coconut and coriander leaves.

title: Mutton Brain Fry
cooking_instructions: In a pan add oil, onion and dry red chilli and saute until it turns translucent

Add the cleaned brain to the masala along with salt and cook without adding any water to the brain.
Saute until completely cooked
Finish with black pepper powder and coriander leaves

title: Mutton Kothu Kari
cooking_instructions:
In a pan pour oil
Add curry leaves and green chilli
Add onion and saute the onion until translucent
Add ginger garlic paste and saute until the raw flavour disappears
Add all the masalas and saute on moderate flame

Add tomato and cook until the tomato turns mushy 
Add the mutton mince and mix till it combines with the remaining ingredients
Add little water and mix well
Cover and cook on a low flame for 10 minutes
Season with salt and pepper and mix well
Cook till it mixture is almost dry 
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve

title: American Chopsuey
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a wok. Add the ginger and garlic and saute. Add the spring onion, onion, capsicum, carrot and cabbage. Saute on high heat for 1 minute.
Add the coriander stems, vinegar, soy sauce, schezwan sauce, tomato ketchup, salt and black pepper powder. Mix well.
Add water and bring it to a boil.
Make a slurry by combining water with cornstarch. Add this to the sauce to thicken it. Add the green spring onion and turn off the heat.
For the fried noodles, combine the cooked noodles and cornstarch in a bowl.
Heat oil in a pan. Make sure the oil is very hot before adding the noodles. Add the noodles and cook until crispy, flipping it to cook both sides evenly.
To serve, place the fried noodles in a bowl. Pour the vegetables and sauce over the noodles.

title: Mutton Elumbu Kozhuppu Rasam
cooking_instructions:
Prepare the masala by adding cumin, black peppercorns, garlic, coriander seeds and dry red chilli in a blender and blend it to a coarse texture
Heat a pan, add a little oil. Add the dry red chillies and curry leaves and let it crackle. Add the shallots and saute till it turns translucent. Add the ground rasam paste and mix it for a few seconds
Add the mutton bone and fat and start cooking it on a medium flame till the fat starts rendering (leaves out oil).
Add the tomato and masala powders and mix it well for a minute
Add water and mix. Bring it to a boil. 
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.Open the pot, season the mixture. Add roughly chopped coriander leaves and stem. Mix and take it off the flame. Serve it hot with rice

title: Spinach Vepudu
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, add the dry red chilli. Heat it for 15 seconds.
Then add the urad dal and cumin seeds. Cook it until the urad dal starts to change colour. Transfer it into a bowl. 
In the same pan, heat the white sesame seeds on low heat, until they start popping and start turning brown in colour.
You can cover with a lid at this time, as they usually splutter around the pan. 
Remove from heat and add all the toasted spices to a mixer jar and grind it into a powder
Grind the green chilli, ginger and garlic into a paste. 
Set it aside.
Heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds and when it splutters, add the curry leaves. 
Keep the heat on low to prevent it from burning.
Add the garlic, ginger and green chilli paste and add it to the pan. 
Cook for 1 minute
Add turmeric powder and salt. 
You can also add a dash of water to prevent it from burning. 
Add the roughly chopped spinach to the pan. 
Cook it for around 4 minutes or until the spinach has shrunk well.
Add the spice powder that you have prepared previously. Stir well and take off the heat.
Serve with rice

title: Avarakkai Muttai Poriyal
cooking_instructions:
Heat oil in a pan
Add mustard cumin, dry red chillies, curry leaves and let it crackle
Add chopped onions and let it crackle
Add ginger garlic paste and cook it for a minute
Add turmeric powder and mix well
Add the shredded avarakkai and mix well
Add salt and pepper and mix well
Add water, bring it to a boil
cover and cook it on a medium flame for 5 minutes
Open the pot, cook the mixture till it is dry.
Separate the vegetables to the sides leaving a gap in the middle.
Add oil and eggs. Start scrambling it.
Slowly start mixing it with the vegetable and cook till it all combines evenly
Take it off the flame. 
Serve it hot

title: Hyderabadi Chicken Korma
cooking_instructions:
Heat a pan, add the spices required for the masala and dry roast it till it is aromatic. Transfer it to a blender and blend it to a fine powder
Heat a kadai, add oil and ghee. Add the onions and saute till it turns light brown. Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute
Add the ground masala and saute for a few seconds. Add the tomatoes and saute till it turns mushy. Take the mixture off the flame and let it cool down slightly. Transfer it to a blender and blend it to a fine paste
Transfer the paste back to the pan and saute for a few seconds. Add the chicken pieces and mix it with the masala for 2 minutes. Add curd, 1 tbsp at a time and mix it till the curd combines with the mixture. Add water, bring it to a soft boil 
Cover and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes. Open the pot, add coriander leaves , mix and take it off the flame. Serve it with rice, naan or roti.

title: Memoni Mutton Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes. Heat a deep pot, add oil and ghee. Add the whole spices and let it crackle.
Add the onions and saute till it turns golden brown. Add ginger garlic paste and cook for a minute   
Add the mutton and mix on a medium flame for 3-4 minutes
Add the tomatoes, green chilli and bay leaves and cook till the tomatoes turn soft
Add the masala powders and crushed chilli flakes and cook them for a minute
Add curd and lemon juice. 
Add water and salt. Let it heat up.
Add the potatoes, mix and bring it to a boil. Cover and simmer the mutton for 30 minutes
To boil rice, heat up water in a pot. Add the spices and salt. Bring it to a boil. Add the soaked and strained rice and boil it for 4 minutes and strain it immediately. Add the soaked and strained rice and boil it for 4 minutes and strain it immediately. Once the mutton has cooked for 35 minutes, open the pot and add the rice on top and spread it evenly.

Top it with fried onions and coriander and seal the pot tightly. Keep it on a preheated tawa for dum on a low flame for 15 minutes. After 15 minutes turn off the flame and let it rest for 10 more minutes,
Open the pot, fulff the rice and serve it hot

title: Jerk Chicken
cooking_instructions: In a blender jar add all the ingredients for the marinade and blend into a fine paste
Add the marinade to the chicken and marinate for 3 hours
In a greased pan add the marinated chicken and cook until they develop some colour on both sides
Rest for 5 minutes and serve hot

title: Paneer Bhurji Rolls
cooking_instructions:
Heat oil in a pan
Add onions and green chillies and saute for a minute
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a few seconds
Add the tomato and saute for a few seconds
Add the masala powders and cook it for a minute
Add ¼ Cup of water and cook for a few seconds
Add the paneer and mix well
Add another ¼ cup of water and keep mixing
Mash the paneer with the ladle
Season the mixture, mix some coriander leaves and take it off the flame
Cook chapatis on a hot tawa
Spread mayonnaise, add the filling and place the cheese slice on top and roll it tightly 
Serve it hot

title: Dhaba Style Kaju Curry
cooking_instructions:
In a pan pour water and add the sliced onion and cashews, cook on a moderate flame for 10 minutes, strain the onions and cashews, and blend into a smooth paste. Roast the cashews on a moderate flame until golden brown. 
In a kadhai pour ghee, add whole garam masalas and once aromatic add diced onions and cook until lightly browned, add ginger garlic paste and cook until the raw flavour disappears. Then add chopped tomatoes,
Add powdered spices and cook on a moderate flame until the tomato turns mushy. Add the onion paste and water, and cook for 2-3 minutes on a moderate flame.
Add the roasted cashews to the gravy and finish the gravy with kasoori methi and coriander leaves.

title: Mughalai Chicken Pakora
cooking_instructions:
In a pan pour milk and add all the garam masalas and bring it to a boil. 
Add Chicken and cook for 4-5 minutes or until halfway done remove from the milk and set aside
Reduce the milk until it’s half the volume, strain and cool it down completely.
Add the reduced milk to besan and add all the other ingredients for the batter.
Whisk into a smooth batter.
Dunk the chicken in the batter and deep fry until golden brown and crispy.
Garnish with Chaat masala and serve hot

title: Brazilian Chocolate Truffles
cooking_instructions:
In a pan add butter and condensed milk, cook for 10 seconds on a moderate flame. Add the cocoa powder and mix until the mixture is smooth, and releases easily from the pan.
Refrigerate covered for 1 hour and roll it into balls, coat it with chocolate sprinkles and serve.

title: Creamy Spinach and Corn Toasties
cooking_instructions: Take the corn-on-cob and cut the kernels vertically.
Liberally butter both sides of the bread slices and toast them until golden and crisp.
For the topping, heat butter in a pan. Add the onions and garlic and saute until the onions turn translucent.
Add the corn kernels and saute until tender, season with salt.
Add the maida and saute until mixed well and add the milk into the pan. Mix well to make a smooth sauce and prevent the formation of lumps.
Add the shredded spinach and cook for 3-4 mins until the spinach wilts.
Finish with grated cheese. Top the filling on the toasted bread slices and cut them into triangles, add chilli flakes as needed.

title: Madurai Thanni Chutney
cooking_instructions:
In the oil, saute the onion, garlic and green chillies until soft. Add the salt and asafoetida. Add the mixture into a mixer grinder with water and the bengal gram and make a thick but smooth paste. 
In a pot, heat oil and prepare the tempering by spluttering mustard seeds then adding the urad dal. Fry until golden and then add the red chillies and curry leaves. Add the chopped onions and saute for 2 mins until tranlucent. Add the thick chutney paste and mix well. Thin down the chutney with water and switch off the flame. Serve hot with podi dosa.

title: Dal Amti
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the toor dal in water for 20 mins.
Pressure cook the toor dal with 2 cups of water, turmeric and ½ tsp of salt for 2 whistles. Let the steam escape naturally.
In a kadai, heat ghee and add the mustard seeds. Let them splutter. Add the curry leaves and slit green chilli.
Add the goda masala, red chilli powder, asafoetida. Mix well.
Add the boiled toor dal and stir well. Boil for 3 mins.
Add the tamarind pulp, jaggery and salt to season. Add grated coconut, ghee and chopped coriander leaves.

title: Hawaiian Chicken Salad
cooking_instructions: Combine the ingredients of the marinade.
coat the chicken thoroughly and refrigerate for 20 mins minimum, combine olive oil, salt and pepper, lemon juice, honey, minced garlic, and chopped coriander.
Grease the pan with oil, Pan sear the chicken until there are char marks and slice the chicken.
Slice the onion, slice de-seeded tomato and shred the carrot. Cut the pineapple into dices,Plate the salad and place the grilled chicken slices.

title: Machini Kizhangu Kooni Kootu
cooking_instructions:
Soak the tamarind in water for 20 miniutes
Peel the tapioca and cut them into small bits.
Pressure cook the tapioca for 1 whistle and let the pressure settle.
Strain the tapioca into another pot and set aside.
In a mixer jar, add all the ingredients for the paste and blend into a very fine paste.
Add the paste to the cooked tapioca and mix until thoroughly combined and cook the tapioca mixture until the raw flavour of the paste disappears. 
Add the cleaned prawns and cook for 3-4 minutes or until prawns are cooked.
In a tadka pan pour coconut oil, mustard seeds, dry red chilli and curry leaves
Once aromatic add the tadka to the tapioca mixture and give it a good mix.
Serve Hot.

title: Dhaba Style Sunny Leone Burger
cooking_instructions:
Heat butter in a pan and saute the capsicum for 2 minutes. 
Add the Dhaba curry paste and mix it well. 
Add schezwan sauce, paneer, chaat masala and processed cheese, and mix until the cheese melts. 
Add mozzarella cheese and just mix until it is evenly combined. Turn off the heat. 
Cut a bun in half, but don’t cut it all the way through. Fill the cheese stuffing inside each bun.
In a tawa, heat butter on low heat. Add the schezwan sauce, Kashmiri chilli powder, chaat masala and coriander leaves. 
Add the buns to the pan and coat on all sides. Toast lightly until the colour becomes slightly darker. 
Serve hot, garnished with chopped onions and coriander leaves.

title: Cooker Mushroom Matar Pulao
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
Heat a pressure cooker, add oil and ghee.
Add the whole spices and let it crackle
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute
Add the curd and saute for a few seconds
Add the mushrooms and saute on a high flame for a few minutes till it lets out water
Add the green peas and saute for a few seconds
Add water, salt and let it heat up.
Add the soaked and strained rice and mix well till the mixture starts to boil
Close the cooker and pressure cook on a medium to high flame for 2 whistles.
Turn off the flame after 2 whistles and let it rest while the steam reduces gradually
Open the cooker, add ghee and fluff the rice

title: Lentil and Vegetable Soup
cooking_instructions:
In a pan pour oil and add all the dried herbs, carrot, onion and leeks, saute until aromatic and add the tomato paste. Cook until the raw flavour disappears
Add potatoes to give it a good mix. Add all the masalas and saute, once they turn aromatic add the lentils and give it a good mix. Pour water, 
Simmer for 20 minutes, once the lentils turn soft add spinach and cook until they wilt garnish with coriander leaves, and serve hot.

title: Masala Vadai
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the channa dal in water for 2 hours.
Strain and add the dal to a mixer blend and pulse blend until coarse.
Transfer the dal to a bowl and add the remaining ingredients and mix well.
Form small lemon-sized roundels of the mixture and flatten them. Deep fry the vadai in medium hot oil until golden brown and crispy.

title: Chilli Cheese Nuggets
cooking_instructions:
Add water to a pan and heat it up. Add salt and diced Potatoes and boil it till it is cooked. Strain the potatoes and mash them immediately and let it cool down. Transfer the mashed potatoes to a bowl.
To the potatoes, add salt, pepper, oregano, green chillies, mozzarella cheese and processed cheese. Mix till all the ingredients combine evenly
Prepare a maida batter by mixing maida, water, salt and pepper into a thick mixture.
Divide and shape it into small squares. In another bowl add the breadcrumbs. Coat the shaped potatoes in the maida batter and then in the breadcrumbs

Heat oil in a kadai and deep fry the nuggets in hot oil till golden brown. Serve it hot with a dip of your choice

title: Varuthuaracha Chicken Curry
cooking_instructions: In a pan pour oil, add grated coconut and garlic cloves and curry leaves, and saute until the coconut turns golden brown.
Switch off the flame and add all the powdered spices, give it a good mix and blend into a smooth paste

In a kadhai, pour coconut oil, add fennel seeds and the sliced onions, saute until the onions turn translucent and add tomato. 
Saute until the tomato turns mushy and add the coconut paste
And add the chicken, pour some water and cook for 10 minutes or until the chicken is thoroughly cooked.

title: Easy Eggless Crepe and Blue Berry Compote
cooking_instructions:
In a blender jar add maida, corn flour, milk, melted butter, sugar and vanilla extract. Bend until smooth.
Add 1 ladle of the batter to a non-stick pan and swirl the pan to make a thin crepe. Cook on a simmer until completely cooked and remove from the pan.
In a pan add all the ingredients for the compote and cook until the blueberry turns mushy and soft. Remove from the heat add a squeeze of lemon juice, and cool completely. Add cream and berry compote for garnish and serve.

title: Mexican Grilled Chicken
cooking_instructions:
Mix all the ingredients required for the marinade in a bowl.
Score the chicken breasts and apply the marinade on it. 
Let it marinate for an hour
Preheat an air fryer at 200 degrees celsius.
Place parchment paper on the base
Place the chicken on the parchment paper
Air fry the chicken at 200 degrees celsius for 20 minutes
Brush some oil on it after 10 minutes
Serve it hot with some salad on the side

title: Store bought batter - Crispy Dosa
cooking_instructions:
Add salt, sugar and baking powder to the dosa batter and mix it well.
Set it aside for 10 mins
Pre-heat a tava on medium flame. Sprinkle a little water and wipe it dry.
Increase to a high flame and add ghee.
Cook until golden and serve

title: Instant Tomato Chutney
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, add oil and heat. Add and saute onions, garlic, red chillies and tamarind for 5 mins until soft. Season with salt. Transfer to a blender and add tomato ketchup. Blend until smooth. 

In hot oil splutter mustard seeds. Add urad dal and fry until light brown. Add the curry leaves, red chilli bits and wait for 5-10 seconds. Add to the chutney and mix well. Serve with hot and crispy dosas/ fluffy uthapams & idlis.

title: Chocolate French Toast
cooking_instructions:
Spread the chocolate spread on one slice of bread.
Cover it with another slice of bread and trim off the crust
Cut the sandwich into 2
Mix sugar and cinnamon powder and keep it aside.
To a bowl, add milk, eggs, vanilla essence and sugar.
Whisk till the mixture combines evenly
Heat a tawa/pan, grease it with butter
Coat the bread in the milk mixture
Place it on the pan. Toast all the sides on a low flame to a golden brown colour
Coat the toasted bread in the cinnamon sugar while it's still hot
Serve it warm

title: Chicken Nirvana
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, marinate the chicken with red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, salt, ginger garlic paste and coconut oil. Let it rest for 10 minutes
Heat a pan, add coconut oil and sear the marinated chicken on a medium flame for 4 minutes on each side. Keep it aside
Heat a mud pot, place a banana leaf on it and add coconut oil. Let it heat up.
Add curry leaves and the chicken. And let it sit in the heat for 2 minutes.
Add coconut milk, ginger and green chillies.
Add black pepper powder and bring it to a soft boil.
Simmer the chicken in the coconut milk for 15 minutes
Turn off the flame and serve it hot.

title: Air Fryer Vegetable Samosas
cooking_instructions:
To prepare the dough, in  a mixing bowl add the maida, salt, sugar, cumin seeds and oil.
Mix till the mixture becomes crumbly.
Add water and mix well till a dough is formed.
Knead well till the dough is smooth and soft.
Apply oil and rest it for 10 minutes.
Heat a pan, add oil.
Add cumin and green chilli and let it crackle.
Add the onions and saute till it is translucent.
Add the vegetables and saute on a high flame.
Add the masala powders and cook till the raw aroma is gone.
Add salt and water and mix well. 
Cook till the mixture is dry.
Take it off the flame and cool it down.
Divide the dough, roll it into a thin sheet
Trim off the edges and cut it into 3 even sized triangles.
Fold it and shape it link a cone, add the vegetable filling and cheese.
Apply water on the loose end and fold it and seal the corners.
Apply oil in the airfryer pan and place the samosas on it.
Brush oil on the samosas.
Air fry it at 200 degrees for 18-20 minutes.
Serve it hot along with a dip.

title: Crispy Baked Potatoes
cooking_instructions: Preheat an oven to 200C with a baking tray inside.
Peel and cut the potatoes into 8 pieces. Soak them in cold water for 10 mins.
Place the potatoes in a pan with salt and baking soda and top it off with sufficient water. Bring the water to a boil and continue to boil further until the potatoes are tender but not breaking.
Strain the potatoes and allow them to steam dry for 5 mins. Rough up and mix the potatoes for the edges to fluff up.
Heat the oil with the garlic and pour it over the potatoes, coat them well.
Tip the potatoes into the preheated baking tray and top it off with softened butter. Sprinkle some salt to season the potatoes.
Bake them until golden brown and crispy, about 45 mins.

title: Sicilian Watermelon Pudding
cooking_instructions:
In a blender jar add watermelon cubes and blend until smooth.
Strain the juice
Add the cornstarch and strawberry syrup to it. 
Cook until thickened and finish with vanilla extract and lemon juice.
Add the mixture to a container of choice and set covered overnight.

title: Tandoori Malai Paneer Gravy
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer jar, add all the ingredients for the sauce and blend to a smooth paste. 
Add some ghee in the pan and fry the paneer until it develops some colour, allow it to char a bit and get golden brown. 
Pour in the sauce, cover and simmer for 15 mins. 
Use a piece of coal to smoke the gravy for about 2 mins. 
Finish with butter and fresh cream. Garnish with chopped coriander leaves.

title: Desi Garlic Prawns
cooking_instructions:
Mariante the prawns with the given ingredients and set aside. 
In a pan, heat butter and add the chopped onion and garlic. Saute until translucent on a medium-low flame.
Add all the powdered spices and mix well. 
Add the tomato puree and cook until the oil releases. 
Finish with butter, fresh cream and chopped coriander leaves. 
In another pan, heat some butter and saute the prawns for 2 mins. 
Add the prawns into the gravy and simmer for 2 mins. Serve hot with fresh bread.

title: Kollu Paruppu
cooking_instructions:
Add water, horsegram lentil, turmeric powder, tomato, dry red chilli, green chilli, garlic, shallots, tamarind and oil to a pressure cooker. Cover and pressure cook for 5 whistles. Separate the water and keep it aside for making the rasam.
Make a tempering by heating some oil. Add mustard, cumin, coriander seeds and curry leaves and let it crackle nicely. Add the tempering to the boiled kollu mixture and mix well. Transfer the mixture to a blender and blend it to a coarse texture. Serve it warm with rice

title: Kollu Rasam
cooking_instructions:
To a pressure cooker add water, kollu, Turmeric powder, tomato, dry red chilli, green chilli,garlic, shallots, tamarind and oil. Cover and pressure cook for 5 whistles. Separate the water and keep it aside for making the rasam.
Heat a kadai, add all the ingredients required for the paste, saute for 2 minutes. Transfer it to a blender and blend it to a coarse paste
Heat oil in a kadai, add oil, mustard seeds, dry red chillies, curry leaves and let it crackle. Add the separated water and the blended paste. Bring it to a boil for 5 minutes and take it off the flame. Serve it hot with rice

title: Manga Pachadi
cooking_instructions:
Cut the raw mango into small cubes, then saute until they turn soft.
Add jaggery, salt, turmeric powder and red chilli powder.
Add ½ cup water and stir until the jaggery completely dissolves and the mixture reaches a jammy consistency.
For the tadka add 1 tsp oil and add mustard seeds, once it splutters add urad dal, green chillies and curry leaves.
Add the tadka to the pachadi and mix it thoroughly.

title: One Pot Peri Lamb and Rice
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer jar add all the ingredients for the paste and blend into a smooth paste
Add the prepared paste to mutton and let it marinate for atleast 1 hour. In a pressure cooker, pour 2 tbsp oil and add the marinated mutton, saute for 2 minutes and pressure cook on a moderate flame for 8 whistles or for 15 minutes.
Let the cooker rest and once the pressure releases add soaked basmati rice and pour water, bring it to a boil and pressure cook for 2 more whistles. Let the cooker rest for atleast 10 minutes and fluff up the rice.

title: Din Tai Fung Beans
cooking_instructions:
In pan pour oil and let it heat up, once hot add beans and deep fry until the outer skin blisters. Set the beans aside, In the same pan drain off the extra oil and add 2 tbsp oil. Once hot add the minced garlic and saute until aromatic. Add back the fried beans
Add salt, pepper, black pepper powder, MSG and soy sauce. Give it a good saute and serve hot.

title: Marshmallow
cooking_instructions: Combine the powdered sugar and cornstarch and set aside in a bowl.
Grease the lined-mold with oil and coat completely with the mixture of sugar and corn starch.
Soak the gelatin in water and set aside.
Boil water and sugar until it reaches the softball stage.
Reduce the flame and add the gelatin. Mix well to dissolve and add orange essence. Transfer it into a bowl.
Whisk the mixture until it reaches a very thick ribbon stage.
Transfer half the mixture into the greased pan.
Add colour as needed to the remaining mixture and mix.
Transfer to the mold and dust liberally with the dry mixture. Chill it for 6-8 hours.
Carefully peel and cut the marshmallows dusting liberally with the dry mixture.

title: Roadstyle Muhsroom Soup
cooking_instructions:
In a deep pot pour oil and saute the mushrooms until they turn golden brown and add onion and ginger garlic paste.
Cook until the onions turn translucent and add all the powdered spices, cook on a moderate flame until they turn aromatic and pour water. Bring it to a boil and cook for 5 minutes. Pour cornstarch slurry and bring it to a boil. 
Once thickened add black pepper powder and coriander leaves, give it a good mix and switch off the flame. Serve hot, optionally you could garnish it with cornflakes.

title: Lentil Burger
cooking_instructions:
In a pan add butter and saute the mushrooms until they develop some colour. Add the tomato paste and cook until it caramelizes, add carrot, and onion and saute for 5 seconds.
Add mixed herbs, capsicum and garlic give it a brief mix and turn off the flame and cool completely. In a pressure cooker add masoor dal and water, and pressure cook on a moderate flame  for 3 whistles.
Once both ingredients cool down mix them with bread crumbs, mushroom soup powder, salt and paprika powder. Shape the mixture into patties.
Pan fry them until golden brown on one side, Flip the patty, add a slice of cheese, cover and cook for another 3 minutes on a simmer.
To a toasted burger bun add spicy mayo, and lettuce and place the burger, add the onion and tomato slice close the burger and serve.

title: One Pot Pudina Pulao and Mushroom Pepper Fry
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl add mushrooms and all the ingredients for the marination and let it sit for 30 minutes
In a mixer jar add all the ingredients for the paste and blend into a smooth paste and set aside
In a pressure cooker, add ghee,all the whole garam masalas, sliced onions and ginger garlic paste, saute until the onion turns translucent, then add sliced tomatoes and cook until it turns mushy

Add the prepared paste, salt, red chilli powder and turmeric powder to the cooker, saute until the raw flavour disappears.
Add the soaked rice to the cooker and gently mix it around.
Pour water and once it reaches a boil, close the lid and pressure cook on a moderate flame for 2 whistles.
Let the cooker rest for at least 10 minutes before opening.

In a kadai add butter, and the marinated mushrooms, add sliced onions and saute on high flame.
Add salt, curry leaves and saute until the water evaporates.

Finish the dish with black pepper and serve hot.
Fluffing up the rice.

title: Apple Halwa
cooking_instructions:
Peel the apples, remove the core and blend it into a smooth paste and set aside
In a kadai pour ghee and fry the cashews until golden brown and remove from the pan.
Pour the apple paste and cook until the paste leaves out the ghee.
Add sugar and cook on moderate heat for 3-4 minutes making sure you don’t overcook the sugar.
Once the halwa becomes thick, add cardamom powder and the fried cashews, mix thoroughly and serve once cooled.

title: Easy Green Chicken Kebab
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer jar add all the ingredients for the paste and blend into a fine paste.
Add the chicken drumsticks and paste along with lemon juice, egg whites and corn flour in a bowl.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 1 hour
Deep fry the drumsticks until golden brown.
Serve hot.

title: Sticky Toffee Pudding
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add dates and boiling water and let it sit for 15 minutes
In another mixing bowl add brown sugar and butter and whip until the mixture lightens in colour, add curd and vanilla extract, and whisk until creamy.
Sift in the dry ingredients with the butter and mix gently until
Mash the soaked dates along with the water and add it to the cake mixture, making sure you’re not over-mixing it.
Bake it for 30 minutes at 180 degrees Celsius in a preheated oven.
In a saucepan add brown sugar, and butter and let it melt completely, then add cream and whisk until thick, and set aside.
In a pan pour water and brown sugar and whisk until fully dissolved.
Once baked, poke holes in it while still hot, and pour the brown sugar soak into the cake.
Serve the pudding along with the sauce and vanilla ice cream.

title: Sirukeerai kothukari masala
cooking_instructions:
Add all the spices required for the masala and dry roast it till it is aromatic. Transfer it to a blender and blend it to a fine powder
Heat a kadai, and add oil. Add the curry leaves and green chilli and let it crackle. Add the onions and saute till it turns translucent. Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute. Add the masala powders and saute for a minute. Add the tomatoes and cook it till it turns soft and mushy
Add the spinach and mutton and mix till they combine evenly. Add the ground masala powder and mix well. Cook the spinach and mutton in the water it lets out. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add salt and coriander leaves and mix it well for a minute. Take it off the flame and serve it hot

title: Roasted chicken Legs with Butter Masala Gravy
cooking_instructions:
In a Bowl, mustard oil and kashmiri red chilli powder and mix till the oil absorbs the chilli powder’s colour.
Add the remaining ingredients and mix well till the ingredients combine evenly
Score the chicken legs and brush the marinade on both sides of the leg evenly.
Transfer the legs to an airfryer and brush the residual marinade/oil on it.
Set it at 180 degrees for 20 minutes and let it cook.
Heat a pan, add 1 packet of the butter masala gravy. Mix it for a few seconds.
Add water and milk. Mix till the mixture turns into once smooth gravy.
Add butter, mix well till it melts.
Bring the gravy to a boil and take it off the flame.
Pour the butter masala gravy into a bowl, place the roasted legs over it and drizzle some more gravy on top of the legs.
Garlish with a cube of butter, coriander leaves and some fresh cream.
Serve it hot with naan.

title: Cookd Border Parotta Style 65 Gravy
cooking_instructions:
Heat oil in a pan. Add cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, star anise, bay leaf, green chilli and curry leaves. Let them crackle.
Add onions and saute till it turns golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and saute till it is mashed well.
Add the madras 65 masala and cook it for a few seconds.
Add water, bring it to a boil and simmer the gravy.
Add coriander, salt and mix it well.
Simmer it for 2 minutes more and take it off the flame.
Serve it hot with parottas.

title: Karupu Ulundhu Kali
cooking_instructions:
In a pan dry roast the urad dal until golden brown and aromatic. Blend the urad dal into an extremely fine powder.
Add jaggery and 2 ½ Cups water in a pan and mix on a moderate flame until completely dissolved. Add the urad dal powder to it and whisk until smooth and thick.
Add ghee, cardamom, and nutmeg powder and mix continuously until thick and serve hot.

title: Prawn Murungai Keerai Poriyal
cooking_instructions: In a mixer grinder, add all the ingredients under “for masala” and grind it into a coarse mixture.
Heat oil in a Kadai, add mustard seeds and let it splutter. Add urad dal, dried red chilli and satue for a minute.
Add sliced shallots, crushed garlic and saute till it turns translucent.
Add the drumstick leaves and saute for a minute.
Add the small prawns, salt and cook for 3 mins.
Add the ground masala mixture and stir for 2 mins. Remove from the heat. Best served with Rasam rice / Fish curry.

title: Cookd Street Style Chicken 65 Fried Rice
cooking_instructions:
To a bowl, add the boneless chicken, cookd madras 65 masala and some water.
Mix till the chicken is coated with the masala.
Heat oil in a kadai, deep fry the marinated chicken cubes till it is crispy and cooked.
Keep it aside.
Heat a wok, add oil.
Add the eggs and scramble it.
Add the onions, capsicum, carrot, cabbage and beans and saute for a few seconds on a high flame.
Add the cooked basmati rice, salt, sugar, Red Chilli powder, garam masala, black pepper powder, soy sauce and red chilli sauce.
Mix and toss till all the ingredients combine evenly.
Add the fried chicken 65,  and toss on a high flame.
Add spring onions, give it one final toss and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Masala 65 Peanuts
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, add peanuts and Madras 65 masala. Sprinkle 1 tbsp of water and mix lightly to combine. 
Add besan and rice flour. Toss to coat evenly. Sprinkle a few drops of water and continue tossing until the coating is even around the peanuts. 
Heat oil and fry over medium-low flame. Fry until it turns crispy. Remove from the oil.
Add the curry leaves for a few seconds, then remove it from the oil. To the fried peanuts, add the curry leaves, black pepper powder, Kashmiri chilli powder, chaat masala and powdered sugar.

title: Cookd Kurkure Spring Rolls
cooking_instructions:
In a pan add oil and let it heat up, add the ginger, garlic and green chillies, saute for 30 seconds and add the shredded vegetables.
Add the shredded vegetables and saute on a high flame
Add soy sauce, chilli sauces, vinegar, MSG, salt and saute till it all combines evenly.
Do not let the vegetables go soggy, to retain some texture cook until 75% done and set aside.
Fold the spring roll sheets, add the filling, roll it tightly and seal the edges with maida batter.
Prepare a batter using 5 tbsp of the cookd fry mix and 150 ml of water. Transfer the remaining dry fry mix to another bowl. 
Coat the rolls in the dry mix first and then in the batter and then in the dry mix again and dust off any excess flour. 
Deep fry until golden brown and crispy.
Sprinkle the cookd seasoning and serve it hot

title: Cookd Fried Chicken Tikka Masala Burger
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, mix together the onions, vinegar, red chilli powder, chaat masala and coriander leaves. 
Cut the chicken breast into two. Mix it with the secret marinade blend and set aside. 
Take 3 tbsp of the fry mix in a bowl. Add water and form a smooth batter. Dip the chicken lightly in the fry mix. Then dip it in the batter and again in the fry mix. Dust off the excess in a downward motion to form the crust. 
Deep fry it in hot oil until crispy and golden brown, around 5 minutes. Remove from the oil and set aside. 
In a pan, heat the butter masala gravy and add milk. Cook for 2 minutes or until it starts to thicken, stirring continuously. For assembling, toast the buns and place the lettuce, fried chicken and then the onions. Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Cookd Crispy Fried Momos
cooking_instructions:
Marinate the momos with the cookd secret marinade and mix till it coats evenly.
Add the cookd ultra crispy fry mix to  a bowl.
Take 5 tbsp from it and put in a separate bowl and add 150ml water to it. Mix until a smooth batter is formed.
Coat the momos in the dry mix first, then in the batter and in the fry mix again.
Dust it in a downward motion to form the crust.
Heat oil in a kadai and deep fry it till golden brown and crispy.
Transfer the fried momos to a bowl, add the cookd seasoning and toss till the fried momos are coated with the seasoning.
Serve it hot.

title: Cookd Schezwan Fried Momos
cooking_instructions:
Marinate the momos with the cookd secret marinade and mix till it coats evenly. Add the cookd ultra crispy fry mix to  a bowl. Take 5 tbsp from it and put in a separate bowl and add 150ml water to it. Mix until a smooth batter is formed
Coat the momos in the dry mix first, then in the batter and in the fry mix again. Dust it in a downward motion to form the crust. Heat oil in a kadai and deep fry it till golden brown and crispy.
Heat a wok, add the schezwan sauce and saute for a few seconds. Add water and mix it till it combines
Add the momos and toss till it is coated with the sauce. Add chopped spring onions, give it one final toss. Garnish with sesame seeds and spring onions.Serve it hot.

title: Cookd Fried Baby Corn
cooking_instructions:
Cut the babycorn into strips. You can cut the smaller ones in half, and the larger ones into quarters. Cover it in hot water and rest for 5 minutes. 
Prepare a batter using 5 tbsp of the Crispy Fry Mix and 10 tbsp (150ml) of water. Put the remaining Crispy Fry Mix on a plate. Strain out the water. 
Coat it in the Hot & Spicy marinade. Coat the marinated baby corn evenly with the Crispy Fry Mix first.
Dip it in the batter and coat it through out. Coat it with the breading again and dust it in a downward motion to form the crust. Deep fry in hot oil till it turns golden brown. 
In a bowl, toss together the fried baby corn and the Cookd seasoning. Serve it with a dip of your choice (mayonnaise, ketchup, etc).

title: Dhaba Mushroom Pepper Fry
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl with mushrooms, add cornflour, maida, salt, pepper, water and mix well till all the ingredients combine evenly and the mushrooms are coated well with the batter.
Heat oil in a kadai, deep fry the mushrooms to a golden brown and crispy texture.
Heat oil in another pan, add ginger, garlic, green chillies and saute for a few seconds.
Add the highway dhaba curry paste and cook for a few seconds.
Add soy sauce, water and mix well till it combines well.
Add the fried mushrooms, black pepper powder and toss till it is coated with the sauce.
Add spring onions, toss for a few seconds.
Serve it hot

title: Easy Singapore Biryani
cooking_instructions:
In a pan add ghee, whole garam masalas, onion, pandan leaves, and lemon grass.
Add the basmati rice, raisins, and cashews in the mixture. Saute until the mixture turns aromatic and set it aside.
In the same pan add some more ghee and add the whole garam masalas, onion, curry leaves and tomato. Add salt and cook until the mixture turns mushy, add the powdered spices, saute until the raw flavour disappears.
Add the chicken and saute for 2 minutes on high heat.
Add back the rice and pour the water and milk mixture, saffron milk. Bring it to a boil, reduce the heat to a simmer, and cook for 12-14 minutes or until the rice is thoroughly cooked. Add the coriander and mint leaves along with the fried cashews and serve hot.

title: Cookd Lehsuni Paneer Gravy
cooking_instructions: Cut the paneer into cubes.
Marinate it with kashmiri chilli powder, kasuri methi, and salt.
Pan sear the paneer until golden and set aside.

In a kadai add oil, garlic, and ginger. Saute until golden brown. Add the Cookd Highway Dhaba Curry Paste and saute for a minute. Add whisked curd and mix thoroughly, cook until the oil separates. Add the cream and cook for a minute.
Take it off the heat and blend it into a smooth paste. In the same kadhai add the paste along with some water and cook for 2 minutes. Either combine or place the paneer on top of the gravy and serve.

title: Chilli Chicken
cooking_instructions: Bring 1 Cup of water to a boil. Add the red chillies and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the cooked red chillies to the mixer grinder and grind it into a smooth paste.
In a pan, heat 2 tsp of oil. Add the ground chilli paste. Cook this until the oil separates from the chilli paste.
In a mixing bowl, add cornflour, maida, salt, pepper and water. Mix to form a batter to deep-fry the chicken pieces.
Add chicken pieces to the batter.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan and deep-fry the chicken pieces for around 3-4 mins or until it is cooked. Keep Aside.

In another pan, to make Chilli sauce, heat oil, add the chopped garlic and ginger. Saute this until the garlic turns golden brown. Add the chopped green chilli. Add the cubed onions and cubed capsicum and continue to saute for a minute.
Add the chilli paste, chilli sauce, tomato sauce, soy sauce, vinegar, salt and pepper. Mix well and cook for 2 minutes.
Mix 2 tsp of cornflour in ¼ cup of water to form a slurry. Add the cornflour slurry to the pan.
Mix well, once the sauce is in the desired consistency, add the batter-fried chicken cubes and toss for a minute.
Add the chopped spring onions and remove from heat. Serve hot as an appetizer.

title: Cookd Dhaba Curry Chimichangas
cooking_instructions:
Crumble the paneer
Add the shallots and saute for a few seconds. Add the crumbled paneer and cook it for a minute. Add the Cookd Dhaba Curry Paste and mix well till it combines with the paneer.
Cook the mixture for a minute
Prepare a dough by mixing maida, salt, sugar, water, and olive oil. Mix and knead till a soft and smooth dough is formed. Grease the dough with oil and spread it into a thin sheet.
Cut it into an even square

Place the paneer filling in the middle and top it with mozzarella cheese. Roll it tightly and seal the edges. Deep fry it in hot oil till golden brown.Top it off with mayonnaise/sour cream and serve it hot

title: Cookd Omelette Masala Curry
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, mix together eggs, onion, green chilli, coriander leaves, salt and pepper. Mix until well combined. 
Heat oil in a pan and then pour the egg mixture. Cook it for a minute and then flip it. Cook for 1 more minute and then remove it from the pan. Roll the omelette and then cut into pieces. 
In a pan, heat the Cookd dhaba curry paste. Add water and bring it to a simmer. Add the coconut paste, cover and cook for 5 minutes. This step is optional. You can also use curd instead of coconut paste. Add green chillies and coriander leaves. 
Finally add the omeltte pieces. Cover and cook for 1 minute, then turn off the heat. Serve with rice or chapati.

title: Healthy Hung Curd and Chicken Sandwich
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl add all the ingredients for the grilled chicken and let it marinate for 30 minutes.
Sear the chicken breast for 3 minutes on each side on a moderate flame and set aside.
Once the chicken cools down shred it into little bits.
In the same mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the filling and give it a good mix.
Toast the bread slices until golden brown, add the filling between two slices and serve.

title: Malvani Chicken Curry
cooking_instructions:
In a pan pour oil and let it heat up, Add all the ingredients for the masala and roast in a moderate flame until aromatic.
Let it cool down and blend it into a fine powder.
In a kadai pour oil and add grated coconut and sliced onion, saute until the coconut develops some colour and let it cool down.
Blend it into a fine paste and set aside.
In a kadai pour oil and let it heat up, add the finely chopped onions and saute until it develops some colour.
Add red chilli and turmeric powder, add the chicken and saute for 2 minute.

Add the coconut paste and cook for 2 minutes, add the malvani masala, pour water and simmer until the chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve with toasted pav.

title: Coconut Milk Fried Rice
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl the chicken cubes and add all the ingredients for the marinade and let the chicken sit for at least an hour in the refrigerator.
In a pan add the soaked basmati rice, coconut milk and water, bring it to a boil, reduce the flame to a simmer and cook covered for 12 minutes.
In a pan/wok, pour oil and add the marinated chicken, saute until it’s cooked through and set aside.
Add the mushrooms to the same pan and cook until all the water evaporates and they develop some colour. 
Add the beans, carrots, green chilis and garlic and saute for 30 seconds on high heat. Add the diced capsicum and saute for a few seconds.
Add the cooked and cooled rice to the pan, add soy sauce, salt and black pepper powder, and add back the cooked chicken.
Give it a good saute, garnish it with spring onion greens, and serve hot.

title: Cookd Ambur Mutton Biryani (open pot)
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes.
Heat a pot, add the Cookd Ambur biryani paste and saute for a few seconds.
Add the  mutton and cook for 2 mins. Add 2 cups (500 ml) water and bring it to a boil. 
Cover and simmer on a medium flame for 45-60 mins (until the meat is cooked and tender).
Open and boil until the gravy becomes thick and back to the paste consistency, about 5-10 mins.
