Add 1 1/2 Cups (375 ml) water and bring it to a boil.

Add the soaked and strained rice. 
Mix gently and boil until the rice and water are level, about 5 mins.
Cover and place on a hot tawa.
Keep it on a dum for 15 mins on a low flame.
Switch off the flame and allow it to rest for 10-15 mins.
Open the pot, add the seasoning oil and break the dum/ fluff the rice. Serve hot with raita.

title: Cookd Ambur Chicken Biryani (open pot)
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
Heat a pot add the cookd ambur biryani paste and mutton curry cut and mix for a few seconds.
Add 1 ½ Cups of water. 
Mix it and let the water start to boil.
Add the soaked and strained rice, give it a gentle mix.
Keep mixing and cooking till the rice and water are level.
Cover the pot, and keep it for dum on a preheated tawa for 15 minutes on a low flame.
Turn off the flame and let it rest for 15 minutes.
Open the pot, fluff the rice and serve it hot with raita.

title: Cookd Ambur Fish Biryani (open pot)
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes

In a mixing bowl add the fish and 2 tablespoons of biryani paste and ¼ tsp of salt.
Let the fish marinate for 20 minutes
Pan fry on a high flame for 2 minutes and set aside.

In a pot add the remaining cook biryani paste and add the soaked rice seeraga samba and saute for 2 minutes on a high flame, pour water and bring it to a boil and reduce the heat to a simmer, once the water and rice are level, add the fried fish to the pot and cook cover for 15 minutes.
Pour the cookd Seasoning oil and fluff up the biryani and serve hot.

title: Healthy Alfredo Pasta
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients form the marintaion and mix thoroughly and let it marinate it for at least 30 minutes. In a deep pan add the marinated chicken and cook until the chicken is well browned and cooked through (around 5 minutes) . Remove the chicken and set aside
In the same pan add minced garlic and flour, saute until the raw flavour of the flour disappears. Pour milk in batches making sure you whisk continuously. 
Once the mixture thickens add the boiled paste and toss until completely coated. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Cookd Ambur Prawn Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
Heat a pressure cooker.
Add the cookd ambur biryani paste and saute for 2 minutes.
Add water and let it start to boil.
Add the soaked and strained rice and give it a mix.
Cover and pressure cook it for 2 whistles on a medium flame.
Turn off the flame and let the steam reduce gradually (10 minutes).
Open the cooker, add the seasoning oil, fluff up the biryani and serve it hot.

title: Indian Banana Pancake
cooking_instructions: Chop the dry fruits and nuts into small pieces.
In a pan, take jaggery and ¼ cup of water and bring it to a boil and simmer until the jaggery is completely melted.
Filter the jaggery syrup using a metal strainer to remove impurities.
In a bowl, take the bananas and mash using a potato masher.
Into the mixing bowl, add wheat flour, salt, jaggery syrup, cardamom powder, water and beat this into a thick batter.
Heat a non-stick pan, add some ghee and scoop one ladle of batter and pour it on the pan.
Spread some dry fruits and nuts on top of the pancake. Flip and cook the other side.
Serve hot as a snack with honey.

title: Cookd Wedding Prawn Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
Heat a pressure cooker. Add the Cookd Biryani Paste, add prawns, and saute for 2 minutes. Add water and let it start to boil
Add the soaked and strained rice and give it a mix. Cover and pressure cook it for 2 whistles on a medium flame. Turn off the flame and let the steam reduce gradually (10 minutes). Open the cooker, add the seasoning oil, fluff up the biryani and serve it hot

title: Cookd Wedding Mutton Biryani (Open Pot)
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
Heat a pot, add the Cookd wedding bhai biryani paste and saute for a few seconds.
Add the  mutton and cook for 2 mins. Add 2 cups (500 ml) water and bring it to a boil.
Cover and simmer on a medium flame for 45-60 mins (until the meat is cooked and tender).
Open and boil until the gravy becomes thick and back to the paste consistency, about 5-10 mins.
Add 1 1/2 Cups (375 ml) water and bring it to a boil.
Add the soaked and strained rice. 
Mix gently and boil until the rice and water are level, about 5 mins.
Cover and place the pot on a hot tawa.
Keep it on a dum for 15 mins on a low flame.
Switch off the flame and allow it to rest for 10-15 mins.
Open the pot, add the seasoning oil and break the dum/ fluff the rice. Serve hot with raita.

title: Cookd Wedding Chicken Biryani (Open Pot)
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
Heat a pot add the Cookd Wedding Biryani Paste and Mutton and mix for a few seconds. Add 1 ½ Cups of water. Mix it and let the water start to boil
Add the soaked and strained rice, give it a gentle mix. Keep mixing and cooking till the rice and water are level. Cover the pot, and keep it for dum for 15 minutes on a low flame. Turn off the flame and let it rest for 15 minutes. Open the pot, fluff the rice and serve it hot with raita.

title: Cookd Wedding Fish Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
In a plate add the fish and 2 tablespoons of biryani paste and ¼ tsp of salt.
Let the fish marinate for 20 minutes, pan fry on a high flame for 2 minutes and set aside.
In a pot add the remaining biryani paste and saute for 2 minutes.
Add water and let it heat up / Bring it to a boil
Add the soaked and strained rice and mix it till it combines.
Once the water and rice are level, add the fried fish to the pot and cook covered for 15 minutes on a low flame. Turn off the flame and let it rest for 10 minutes
Open the pot, pour the cookd Seasoning oil and fluff up the biryani and serve hot.

title: Cookd Dindigul Chicken Biryani (Open Pot)
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
Heat a pot add the cookd dindigul biryani paste and chicken curry cut and mix for 2 mins
Add 1 ½ Cups of water. Mix it and let the water start to boil
Add the soaked and strained rice, give it a gentle mix
Keep mixing and cooking till the rice and water are level
Cover the pot, and keep it for dum on a preheated tawa for 15 minutes on a low flame
Turn off the flame and let it rest for 15 minutes
Open the pot, fluff the rice and serve it hot with raita.

title: Cookd Dindigul Mutton Biryani (Open Pot)
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
Heat a pot, add the Cookd Dindigul biryani paste and saute for a few seconds.
Add the  mutton and cook for 2 mins. Add 2 cups (500 ml) water and bring it to a boil.
Cover and simmer on a medium flame for 45-60 mins (until the meat is cooked and tender).
Open and boil until the gravy becomes thick and back to the paste consistency, about 5-10 mins.
Add 1 1/2 Cups (375 ml) water and bring it to a boil.
Add the soaked and strained rice.
Mix gently and boil until the rice and water are level, about 5 mins.
Cover and place on a hot tawa.
Keep it on a dum for 15 mins on a low flame.
Switch off the flame and allow it to rest for 10-15 mins.
Open the pot, add the seasoning oil and break the dum/ fluff the rice. Serve hot with raita.

title: Cookd Dindigul Fish Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
In a mixing bowl add the fish and 2 tablespoons of biryani paste and ¼ tsp of salt.
Let the fish marinate for 20 minutes, pan fry on a high flame for 2 minutes and set aside

In a pot add the remaining biryani paste and saute for 2 minutes.
Add water and let it heat up / Bring it to a boil
Add the soaked and strained rice and mix it till it combines.
Once the water and rice are level, add the fried fish to the pot and cook covered for 15 minutes on a low flame
Pour the cookd Seasoning oil and fluff up the biryani and serve hot.

title: Cookd Dindigul Prawn Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
Heat a pressure cooker
Add the cookd biryani paste, prawns and saute for 2 minutes
Add water and let it start to boil.
Add the soaked and strained rice and give it a mix
Cover and pressure cook it for 2 whistles on a medium flame
Turn off the flame and let the steam reduce gradually (10 minutes)
Open the cooker, add the seasoning oil, fluff up the biryani and serve it hot

title: Maasi Sambal
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer jar add all the ingredients for the sambal. 
Blend into a coarse paste.
Squeeze lemon juice and serve along with hot idiyappam, chapati or even rice.

title: Avocado Toast
cooking_instructions: Cut and mash a ripe avocado.
Add the chopped onions, tomato, salt, juice of half a lemon and olive oil.
Mix to combine until creamy.
Toast the brown/ multigrain bread slices until crispy and golden brown.
Top with the avocado mixture and garnish with pomegranate, melon seeds and mint sprigs.

title: Cookd Chicken Chukka Kuzhambu
cooking_instructions:
Heat a kadai, add oil.
Add fennel seeds, curry leaves green chilli, garlic and let it crackle
Add onion and saute till it turns light brown.
Add tomatoes and cook till it turns soft and mushy.
Add the chicken and cookd madurai chukka masala.
Mix well for two minutes.
Add water, bring it to a boil.
Cover the pot and simmer the mixture for 15 minutes.
Open the pot, season if necessary and garnish with coriander leaves.
Serve it hot with parotta.

title: Cookd Pallipalayam Chicken Kuzhambu
cooking_instructions:
Heat a kadai, add oil.
Add garlic, dry red chillies, curry leaves and let it crackle
Add shallots and saute till it turns translucent
Add the chicken and the Cookd pallipalayam masala and mix well for 2 minutes
Add water, mix well till it combines evenly.
Bring it to a boil. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Open the pot, pour the coconut milk and mix until combined
Add sliced coconut, coriander leaves and seasoning if necessary.
Mix well, bring it to a boil and take it off the flame and serve it hot

title: Cookd Chettinad Veg Kuzhambu
cooking_instructions:
Heat oil in a pan, add the whole spices, curry leaves, green chilli, fennel seeds and let it crackle
Add the onions and saute till it turns light brown.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a few seconds.
Add tomatoes and saute till it turns soft and mushy.
Add the Cookd chettinad masala and saute for a minute.
Add the diced vegetables and saute for a minute with the masala.
Add water, mix well, bring it to a boil.
Cover and simmer the mixture for 15 minutes.
Open the pot, add the coconut paste and mix till it combines.
Bring it to a soft boil.
Garnish it with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Chicken 65 (25 grams)
cooking_instructions:
Mix the Madras 65 masala with water to form a thick paste. Add the chicken to it and mix well till it is coated with the masala
Heat oil in a kadai and fry the chicken for 5-7 minutes (small pieces) till it becomes crispy and is cooked throughout. Finally, fry a sprig of curry leaves along with the chicken before taking it out. Drain off the excess oil and serve it hot with lemon wedges.

title: Cookd Egg 65 (25 grams)
cooking_instructions:
In a sauce pan, pour water and bring it to a rolling boil. Once it reaches a rolling boil reduce to flame to sim and add the eggs gently and cook for 12 minutes. Once done peel the eggs and cut them into halves
In a mixing bowl add the cookd madras 65 masala pour 100 ml of water and whisk into a smooth batter dip the eggs in the batter and fry until crispy. Fry curry leaves until crisp, around 15 seconds

title: Cookd Paneer 65 (25 grams)
cooking_instructions:
Prepare a batter by mixing water with one sachet of the madras 65 masala

Add paneer cubes. Mix it till the paneer is coated evenly with the masala
Heat oil in a kadai and fry the paneer for 2 minutes 
Finally, fry a sprig of curry leaves along with the paneer before taking it out.
Drain off the excess oil and serve it hot with lemon wedges and onion rings

title: Cookd Fish 65 (25 grams)
cooking_instructions:
Mix the Madras 65 masala with water to form a smooth mixture.Add the fish pieces and mix to coat well. 
Heat oil in a kadai and fry the fish for 5 minutes on medium-high heat till it becomes crispy and is cooked throughout. Finally, fry a sprig of curry leaves until crispy, then add it to the fried fish. Drain off the excess oil and serve it hot with lemon wedges.

title: Cookd Gobi 65 (25 grams)
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, add one packet of the madras 65 masala.
Add half a cup of water to it and make it into a batter.
Add the cauliflower florets to it and mix it using a spoon/fork till it combines evenly.
Sprinkle the remaining masala and mix using a spoon.
Deep fry in hot oil till it is crispy. (2minutes)
Garnish with fried curry leaves and serve it hot.

title: Idli Podi
cooking_instructions: Dry roast the chana dal and urad dal on a low flame for 4 minutes until browned and set aside.
In the same pan, dry roast the chillies until crisp for about a minute in a medium flame and keep with the roasted dal.
Roast the cumin and sesame seeds until aromatic, 4 minutes on a low flame. And add salt and asafoetida to the bowl and mix well
Transfer all the roasted ingredients to a mixer grinder, add the salt and blend to a fine powder. Store the Idli Podi in an air-tight container

title: Mangalore Kori Sukka
cooking_instructions: In a pan, dry roast the grated coconut until golden brown and set aside.
In a pan, dry roast the coriander seeds, black peppercorns, fenugreek seeds, fennel seeds, cumin seeds, cinnamon and cloves.
Once the spices start to emit aroma, add the Kashmiri red chilli and the normal red chilli.
Add oil, garlic cloves and thinly sliced onions. Saute this until the onions are translucent. Add the turmeric powder, mix well and remove from the heat.
Once the mixture cools down, add half of the grated coconut, tamarind and grind the mixture into a smooth paste adding ¾ Cup of water. Set this paste aside.
Heat oil in a pan, add the thinly sliced onion and fry until the onions turn golden brown.
Add the cleaned and washed chicken pieces, curry leaves, salt and saute on high flame for 2 mins.
Add the ground paste, water, mix well, cover and cook for 7 mins.
Add the remaining grated coconut and mix well. Cook for a further 2 minutes.
Add chopped coriander leaves and remove from heat.

title: Cookd Mushroom 65 (25 grams)
cooking_instructions:
Add 1 sachet of the madras 65 masala to a bowl and add water to it. Mix it well till it becomes a paste without any lumps. Add the Mushroom and mix well till it is evenly coated with the masala. 
Heat oil in a kadai and fry the mushrooms for 5 minutes till it becomes crispy and is cooked throughout. Make sure the oil is hot before frying the mushroom. Finally, fry a sprig of curry leaves along with the Mushroom before taking it out. Drain off the excess oil and serve it hot with lemon wedges and onion rings.

title: Cookd Soya 65 (25 grams)
cooking_instructions:
To a bowl, add the soya chunks, hot water, turmeric powder and let the soya soak it in for 10 minutes till it softens and doubles in size. Strain it and squeeze out the extra water and transfer it to another bowl. Add the cookd madras 65 masala and water and mix well till the soya is coated with the masala
Heat oil in a kadai and fry the soya chunks on a medium flame till it becomes crispy on the outside (4-5 minutes). Add a sprig of curry leaves to the oil before taking it out and transfer it to a plate lined with tissue. Serve it hot

title: Cookd Prawn 65 (25 grams)
cooking_instructions: Add 1 sachet of the madras 65 masala to a bowl and add 100 ml water to it. Mix it well till it becomes a paste without any lumps
Add the prawns and mix well till it is evenly coated with the masala

Heat oil in a kadai and fry the prawns for 5 minutes till it becomes crispy and is cooked throughout
Finally, fry a sprig of curry leaves along with the prawns before taking it out.
Drain off the excess oil and serve it hot with lemon wedges and onion rings.

title: Ulutham Soru
cooking_instructions:
Add the black urad to a kadhai and saute it on a low-medium flame until thoroughly browned and set aside. In a pressure cooker, pour peanut oil and add cumin seeds, garlic green chilli and add the soaked and drained rice to the cooker and saute for 30 seconds along with salt until aromatic.
Pour water and bring it to a boil and pressure cook on a moderate flame for 2 whistles. Let the cooker rest for 10 minutes and fluff up the rice. Serve hot.

title: Nei Podi Idli & Getti Chutney
cooking_instructions:
Deep fry the idlis until golden brown and set aside
In a mixing bowl pour ghee and add the idli podi, and coriander leaves and toss until thoroughly mixed
In a mixer jar, add all the ingredients for the chutney and blend into a coarse paste
In a tadka pan pour all the ingredients for the tempering and add it to the chutney. Serve hot

title: Caramel Masala Tea
cooking_instructions:
In a saucepan, add the sugar and let it caramelize on a medium-low flame( around 3 minutes)
Once caramelized immediately pour water and mix thoroughly.
Add all the ingredients and mix thoroughly.
Boil the mixture for 2 minutes and pour scalded milk into it. 
Once the tea reaches a boil switch off the flame, strain and serve hot.

title: Chilli Oil Egg Rice
cooking_instructions:
Add all the ingredients required for the chilli oil to a heat proof bowl/vessel
Heat up oil and add it to the bowl/vessel with the ingredients and let it sizzle well.
Mix till all ingredients combine evenly and reserve 2 tbsp of the oil
Heat a wok, add oil
Add the beaten eggs and scramble till it fluffs up
Add the cooked rice, soy sauce, salt, the chilli oil and MSG
Mix and toss on a high flame till it all combines evenly.
Transfer the rice to a bowl
Fry a sunny side up and place it on top of the rice.
Top it off with the reserved chilli oil and chopped spring onions.
Serve it hot.

title: Tandoori Chicken Gravy
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer jar, add mustard oil, kashmiri red chilli powder, ginger garlic paste, salt, curd, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, kasuri methi (powdered), chaat masala
tomato, cashew nuts and cardamom pods and blend to a smooth paste. 
Add some butter in the pan and saute the chicken until it develops some colour, allow it to char a bit. 
Pour in the sauce, cook for 2 mins. Add milk to adjust the consistency, cover and simmer for 20 mins, stir occasionally. 
Use a piece of coal to smoke the gravy for about 2 mins. Finish with butter and fresh cream. Garnish with chopped coriander leaves.

title: Paneer Milk Shake
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer jar add all the ingredients for the milkshake except the ice cubes and blend into a smooth paste, make sure to scrape down the sides and blend so that the paste is smooth evenly.
Add the chilled milk and blend until smooth and serve.

title: Paneer Pepper Fry Roll
cooking_instructions:
In a pan heat coconut oil and add onion, ginger garlic paste, tomato and add all the ground spices and saute for 2 minutes on moderate flame or until the onion turns translucent and the tomato turns mushy.
Add the paneer to the pan and saute for 3-4 minutes on a high flame until it develops some colour.
Finish the dish with curry leaves, and black pepper powder
In a parotta apply a tablespoon of mayonnaise and add the filling according to your discretion, add cucumber and bell pepper roll and serve hot.

title: Avil Milk
cooking_instructions: Toast the aval on a medium flame for 2 minutes to make it crispy. Remove from the pan into a bowl.
Cut the banana into pieces and add to a bowl.
Add sugar to the bananas and mash them with a fork.
In a glass, add the mashed bananas in the bottom, then the toasted aval. Then add the peanuts.
Fill up the glass with cold milk. You can optionally add a scoop of vanilla ice cream on top. Stir before consumption.

title: Choco Lava Cookie
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add sugar and softened butter and whip until the mixture turns white and fluffy. Add the eggs one by one and whip thoroughly. Add the cocoa powder and mix it lightly. Add sifted flour and baking soda and mix gently until combined. Keep the dough covered in the freezer for 10 -15 minutes or until slightly hardened.
Shape the dough into balls and flatten it out in your palms, fill the centre with dark chocolate and fold gently making sure the filling remains in the centre. Bake the cookies for 12-13 minutes at 180 degrees Celsius in a preheated oven. Or alternatively, shape and freeze up to 2-3 months for later use.

title: Mughalai Egg Curry
cooking_instructions:
Heat water in a pot, bring it to a boil and add salt to it.
Add the eggs to the water and boil it for 12 minutes, strain it, peel the shell and keep it aside.
Boil the cashew nuts for 5 minutes and keep it aside
Heat a pan, add oil and ghee.
Add cinnamon, cardamom and cloves and let it crackle.
Add the onions and saute till it turns golden brown.
Transfer the onions, cashew nuts to a blender. Add curd and green chillies to it.
Blend it to a fine paste.
Heat oil and ghee in a pan.
Add the blended paste and saute on a medium flame for 5 minutes.
Add kashmiri red chilli powder, garam masala and mix along with the paste for a minute.
Add water and mix till it combines with the paste.
Add salt and sugar and mix well.
Bring the mixture to a soft boil and let it thicken.
Score the eggs gently and add it to the masala and mix till it is coated with the gravy.
Cover and simmer it for 5 minutes.
Add chopped coriander, fresh cream, kasuri methi, mix till it combines evenly and take it off the flame.
Serve it hot with naan or rice.

title: Spanish Chicken and Lemon Rice
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl, add the chicken thighs and all the ingredients for the marination.
Mix thoroughly, cover and let it marinate for 1 hour.
In a blender jar add all the ingredients for the paste and blend into a fine paste and set aside.
In a deep pan pour olive oil and cook the chicken on a high flame for 2 minutes on each side and set aside.
In the same pan add the soaked basmati rice and saute on a high flame until the rice is browned.
Add the paste and mix gently making sure you’re not breaking the rice.
Cook for 4-5 minutes on a moderate flame until the raw flavour disappears.
Add salt and pour water, and bring it to a boil.
Place the cooked chicken on top add the lemon slices on top of the chicken, Cover and cook on a simmer for 12-14 minutes.
Let it rest for 10 minutes and fluff it up gently and serve hot.

title: Mutton Kola Urundai
cooking_instructions:
In a pan pour oil and add all the whole garam masalas, once aromatic add the sliced onion and garlic.
Add all the powdered spices and saute until the onion turns translucent and the raw flavour disappears. 
Add the mutton mince and cook for 20 minutes on a moderate flame.
Cover and cook for the first 5 minutes, remove the lid and cook for the remaining 15 minutes.
Once the mixture dries out completely, remove it from the heat and let it cool down completely.
Once cooled, add the mixture to a blender, and blend into a smooth paste.
Add the paste to a mixing bowl and add the roasted channa dal powder and egg.
Mix thoroughly and shape it into balls.
Deep fry the kola urundai until golden brown and serve hot.

title: Mushroom Carbonara
cooking_instructions:
Firstly, set a pot with water for cooking the pasta
In a pan with olive oil, saute the mushrooms until they are deeply golden brown. Then you can add the crushed garlic and thyme
Once fragrant, remove the pan from the heat and strain the oil from the mushrooms. Reserve the oil
At this point you can add the pasta to the pot of boiling water
In a separate mixing bowl, beat together the eggs, parmesan and crushed black peppercorn. While whisking with a fork, stream in the oil to combine,Once the pasta is cooked, reserve 1 cup of the cooking water and strain the rest. 
Add the pasta and the mushrooms to a pan that is not on a flame. This is to prevent the eggs from curdling. 
Add the egg mixture along with some of the reserved pasta water and mix thoroughly to ensure the egg mixture emulsifies into a creamy sauce. 
Add more pasta cooking water as needed. 
Garnish with more parmesan cheese and optionally some shredded basil.

title: Ridge Gourd Milk Curry
cooking_instructions:
Ridge gourd is also known as Peerkangai/Beerakaya/Peechinga/Turai. 
Using a peeler, remove the sharp edges of the ridge gourd. Cut it lengthwise in 4, chop it and set aside. 
In a pan, heat oil and splutter mustard seeds. Add cumin seeds, onion and green chilli. 
Once the onion turns translucent, add the salt and red chilli powder. Add the chopped ridge gourd and mix well. Cook for 3 minutes.
Add the milk and mix well continuously for at least 30 seconds or at least it is combined well. 
Cover and cook on a medium flame for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally until the gourd has softened. 
Add the coriander leaves, stir and cook on high flame until the excess liquid has evaporated.

title: Eggless Crinkle Cookies
cooking_instructions:
First, add the sugar, cocoa, powder, salt, coffee powder and mix to combine. To this mixture add the milk, oil, vanilla extract and whisk thoroughly. Add the maida and baking powder, and fold until just combined. Remember to not overmix. 
Place it in the freezer for half an hour to chill. Once chilled, use oiled hands to shape 40g balls of dough. Coat these balls thoroughly with icing sugar and place in a baking sheet. Slightly flatten the balls to make discs.
Bake in a preheated 180 C oven for 13-14 minutes. Let it cool for 10 minutes before enjoying

title: Cookd Jackfruit Ghee Roast
cooking_instructions:
Boil the raw jackfruit for 30 minutes, and keep it aside. In a pan, add the Cookd mangalore ghee roast, and add 50 ml of water to it.
Add the boiled jackfruit to the gravy and cook it for 3-5 minutes. Garnish with fried curry leaves and ghee on top.

title: Red Velvet Panna Cotta
cooking_instructions: Soak the gelatin in water for 10-15 mins.
In a saucepan, heat the milk, cream, sugar and vanilla essence just until it comes up to a boil.
Pour this mixture into the bowl of chocolate.
Add the gelatin and mix until well combined. Add food colour as needed and mix again.
Pour into small portion bowls and chill for 3-4 hours.
De-mould and serve them chilled.

title: Cheesy Chicken with Mint Mayonnaise
alternate_titles: Cheesy fried chicken with mint mayonnaise
cooking_instructions:
Butterfly the chicken breast and flat it down with a hammer/roller. Cut the flattened chicken  breast into circles.Marinate the cut out breast pieces with Mustard, salt and pepper  and keep them in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Prepare the crumbing for the marinated chicken ( With beaten egg and bread crumbs). Crumb the marinated chicken 
Pan fry it for 3 minutes a side or till it reaches golden color on each side.Grated cheese should be sprinkled on top of the fried chicken and baked for 3 minutes at 180 degrees.

title: Naati Chilli Chicken
cooking_instructions:
Marinate the chicken with turmeric and salt, set aside to marinate. Grind up 10 to 12 green chilies into a coarse paste. Slit the remaining into quarters.
In a pan, heat up the oil and Sautee the paste and slit green chili until the raw smell is gone. Add the chicken and sautee on high flame
Add 1 cup of water and let the chicken cook for 10 minutes or until the chicken is almost cooked (about 80%). Add the vinegar and soya sauce and adjust seasoning if required. Serve this dish and enjoy.

title: Healthy Granola Bars
cooking_instructions:
Toast the almonds in a dry pan. Then add the oats and continue to toast. Add the salt, cinnamon powder and nutmeg powder. Make a well in the center of the pan and the ghee. Once melted, add peanut butter and honey. Mix well and add the vanilla extract right at the end, along with the raisins
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and pour the mixture onto the tray, flattening it into an even layer. Bake in a preheated oven at 170 Celsius for around 10-15 minutes or until lightly toasted on the surface. Remove from the oven and let it cool completely before breaking into pieces. Can enjoy it plain or with warm milk

title: Fish Chammanthi Perattu
cooking_instructions:
Marinate the fish with turmeric powder, ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, Kashmiri chili powder, and salt as required.
Mix well and set it aside for 15-20 minutes.

Take a tablespoon of tamarind and soak it until it becomes soft.
Roast 15-20 shallots until they turn slightly brown. Add 6 to 7 dried red chilies and roast them for 2 minutes on low flame.
Grind the roasted shallots and chilies into a fine paste along with the tamarind water.
In a pan, add coconut oil and fry the marinated fish to a golden brown colour on all sides and keep it aside.

In another pan, heat 1 ½ tbsp of coconut oil.
Add 5 chopped shallots, ½ tsp of finely chopped garlic, ½ inch of finely chopped ginger, and a sprig of curry leaves. Stir for about a minute.
Add the ground paste and mix it over low flame.
Add the fried fish to the mixture and mix till it is coated well with the masala.
Give it one final toss, garnish it with coriander leaves and serve it hot with rice.

title: Nethili Meen Avial
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add the tamarind and pour water. Soak the tamarind for 30 minutes. For the paste add shallots, curry leaves, black pepper, cumin seeds, and coconut and blend into a coarse paste and set aside.
In a clay pot, add the ground paste, tamarind water and fish. Mix all the ingredients together and cook on a moderate flame for 10 minutes. Shake the vessel gently to mix, avoid using a spatula.Once the gravy thickens set aside.
Temper cumin seeds, shallots and pounded garlic in coconut oil. Add the tempering to the cooked avial and mix. Serve hot.

title: Bagara Rice and Keema Masala
cooking_instructions:
In a pan pour ghee and add the whole garam masalas.
Once aromatic, add the onions and ginger garlic paste, saute until the onions turns translucent.
Add the tomato and saute for 15 seconds.
Add the drained soaked basmati rice and gently saute without breaking the rice.
Pour water and add salt, bring it to a boil and lower the flame to a simmer, cover and cook for 12 minutes.
Rest the rice for at least 15 minutes and fluff up the rice and serve hot.
In a pressure cooker add ghee and mutton fat, add the whole garam masalas, once aromatic, add the sliced onions and green chillis.
Add salt and saute until the onions turn golden brown, add sliced tomato and ginger garlic paste, mint and coriander leaves.
Saute until the tomato turns mushy.
Add the mutton mince and give it a goox mix, add salt, turmeric powder, kashmiri red chilli powder and garam masala along with some curd and mix until completely combined .
Pour water, bring it to a boil and pressure cook on a moderate flame for 4 whistles or for 10 minutes.
Let the pressure release and finish the masala with some black pepper powder and kasoori meethi.

title: Paneer Lettuce Tomato
cooking_instructions:
For the pesto, add all the ingredients except the cheese and blend. 
Once a rough paste has formed, add the cheese and blend until incorporated. 
The paste should not be completely smooth.
For the sandwich, cut slices of paneer and toast them in a pan until deeply golden on both sides.
In the same pan, toast two slices of bread in a pan with butter on both sides. 
Spread pesto on both the bread slices. Then add a layer of lettuce, followed by sliced tomato, and finally, the paneer. 
Close your sandwich and use toothpicks to keep it stable.

title: Air Fryer - Tandoori Chicken Legs
cooking_instructions:
Add all the ingredients required for the marinade to a bowl and mix it till it combines evenly.
Score the chicken legs and add the marinade to it.
Mix well till the chicken legs are coated evenly with the marinade.
Let the chicken marinate in the fridge for 1 hour.
Preheat the airfryer at 200 degrees for 10 minutes.
Add the chicken to the airfryer and apply oil on it.
Air fry the chicken at 200 degrees for 20 minutes.
Take it oil of the fryer.
Place a bowl with a piece of hot coal on the chicken.
Add ghee to it and cover it tightly and let it smoke for 5 minutes.
Garnish with coriander leaves, lemon wedges and serve it hot.

title: Sabudana Popcorn
cooking_instructions:
Place the sabudana in a bowl and add enough water to cover it.
Let the sabudana soak for about 4-5 hours or until it becomes soft and fluffy. Drain any excess water using a strainer and set it aside.
Add the soaked sabudana, finely chopped onions, green chili, garlic, crushed peanuts, mashed potatoes, curry leaves, coriander, salt, pepper, turmeric, red chili powder, and chat masala to a bowl.
Mix all the ingredients together until well combined. Adjust the seasoning according to your taste.
Take a portion of the mixture and shape it into a ball of your desired size, Repeat this with the remaining mixture.
Roll each ball in breadcrumbs, ensuring they are evenly coated on all sides. 
This coating will give a crispy texture when frying.
Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Once the oil is hot enough (around 350°F or 180°C), gently place the popcorn into the pan, a few at a time.
Fry the popcorn until they turn golden brown and crispy on both sides. This should take about 3-4 minutes per side.
Once cooked, remove the popcorn from the pan and place them on a plate lined with paper towels to absorb any excess oil.
Season with chat masala and enjoy.

title: Guntur Chicken
cooking_instructions: In a pan, dry roast all the ingredients except cashew nuts until aromatic.
Add cashew nuts and water. Grind into a fine paste.
Heat oil in another pan and add the onion, dried red chillies and curry leaves. Saute until the onion starts to brown.
Add the ginger garlic paste and saute for 1 minute.
Add the previously prepared spice mix and cook for a few minutes until the oil starts to separate from the sides.
Add the chicken, turmeric powder and salt. Saute for 5 minutes on high heat.
Cover and cook for 20 minutes on medium heat or until the chicken is cooked.
Add the coriander leaves. Mix and serve hot.

title: Italian Chocolate Custard
cooking_instructions:
In a saucepan add the egg yolks and whisk until completely smooth. Pour cream and whisk until completely combined, turn on the heat and whisk continuously until thickened. Add dark chocolate and instant coffee, whisky until thoroughly combined
Strain to make sure it’s completely smooth. Transfer the custard to a container of your choice and set covered for 3-4 hours.

title: One Pot Chicken Fajita Rice
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the basmati rice for 20 minutes. Heat a pot and add oil. Add garlic and sliced onions. Saute for a few seconds
Add the sliced onions and bell peppers and saute for a minute. Add the chicken pieces and the fajita seasoning and mix well for a few minutes. Add the tomato puree and mix it along with the mixture for a 2 minutes
Add water, salt, black pepper and bring it to a boil. Add the soaked and strained rice and bring it to a boil.
Once the rice and water are level, cover the pot tightly and let it simmer for 15 minutes. Let it rest for 10 more minutes. Open the pot, garnish with chopped coriander leaves and fluff the rice. Serve it hot.

title: Cookd Madurai Kari Dosa
cooking_instructions:
Heat a pan, add oil.
Add curry leaves and chopped onions and saute till the onions turn soft and translucent.
Add the minced mutton and saute for few minutes
Add the Cookd  Madurai Chukka masala and mix it for 2 minutes.
Add water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add coriander leaves and cook till the mixture is almost dry and keep it aside.
Heat a tawa, add dosa batter like an uthappam.
Add an egg and mix the batter and egg together and shape it round. Keep it on a low flame.
While the batter is still moist, add the mutton mixture on the dosa and and press it down.

title: Tomato Pappu
cooking_instructions:
Wash your toor dal and let it soak in water. While it's soaking, you can get started on slicing the onion and chopping the tomato. Add the dal to a pressure cooker along with the water, the chopped vegetables, slit green chillies and crushed garlic. Turn the flame on. Add the turmeric powder along with the red chilli powder and allow it to come to a boil. Once its boiling, close the lid and allow it to cook for 2 whistles on medium high flame and 2 whistles on a low flame. Once the pressure has released naturally, open the lid and give it a stir
For the tempering, first add crushed garlic to ghee and allow it to become fragrant. Then add the urad dal, and mustard seeds. Once the mustard seeds have popped, add the cumin seeds and curry leaves, and turn the flame off to prevent any burning. Add the tempering to the dal and mix to incorporate

title: Aloo Cheese Sandwich
cooking_instructions: In a pan pour ghee, add ginger, green chilli and onion, and saute until the onion turns translucent.
Add boiled potatoes, salt, turmeric, red chilli powder and mash until completely smooth. Add curry leaves and give it a good mix and set aside.
Take a sandwich bread slice and coat one slice with mint chutney and the other side with tamarind chutney. Add the aloo mixture, place a slice of processed cheese.
Grill until golden brown and serve hot

title: Tea Kadai Onion Samosa
cooking_instructions:
Prepare a soft dough by mixing and kneading, maida, salt, sugar, oil, water. Cover the dough and let it rest for 30 minutes  Heat oil in a pan, add curry leaves and let it crackle. Add the chopped carrots and thinly sliced onions and saute for 2 minutes. Add salt and sugar and let the onions caramelize a little.Add the masala powders, give it a good mix. Keep it aside. 
Divide the dough into 3-4 equal sized pieces. Roll each one out and apply oil on top and dust it with flour. Place the discs on top of each other and roll it flat. Heat a tawa, and cook the rolled out pile together on a low flame for 1 minute on each side. Take it off the pan, trim off the round parts to form a square. Cut it into long logs and peel off each sheet. Fold it like a cone and add the onion filling inside. Apply maida batter on the loose end and close the open end and seal it tightly. Heat oil in a kadai, deep fry the samosas till golden brown and crispy.

title: Banana Muffins
cooking_instructions:
Mash the ripe bananas well. Mix with sugar, oil, vanilla and cinnamon powder. Chop the chocolate and cashew nuts into small bits. 
Add the maida, baking powder, chocolate and cashews into the wet mix. Mix until well combined.Transfer to cupcake mold but only fill halfway. Bake in a preheated oven for 20 mins at 180C.

title: Beijing Mutton Stir Fry
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the marination and mix completely.
Let the mutton sit for 30 minutes (this ensures the mutton becomes tender).
Deep fry the marinated mutton until golden brown and crispy and set aside 
In a wok or kadhai, pour oil and add the diced onion, capsicum and garlic.
Saute for 10 seconds or until soft and aromatic and add the sauce.
Cook the sauce for 30 seconds on a high heat.
And add the mutton and toss.
Garnish with sesame seeds and spring onion greens.

title: Flourless Chocolate Cake
cooking_instructions:
Double boil the butter and chocolate together.
When both the chocolate and butter are melted, add the sifted cocoa powder and sugar.
With that add the coffee, sugar, salt and eggs together and whisk well.
Pour in the batter to the cake pan, and preheat the oven to 180 degree celsius.
Bake for 22-25 minutes at 180 degree celsius.
Garnish with powdered sugar.

title: Mutton Maada
cooking_instructions:
To a pan with oil, on a medium high flame, add your slit green chillies. 
After they start to blister, add your lamb and let it sear. 
Flip once a nice golden colour has appeared on one side, and add the salt
Once the lamb is golden brown on all sides , reduce the flame to low and add ginger garlic paste, red chili powder and turmeric. 
Stir to incorporate. 
Once the spices are toasted, add enough water to come halfway up the lamb.
Let the lamb simmer, covered, for 40-45 minutes or until tender. If the water evaporates before the lamb is tender, keep adding more bit by bit.
Once the lamb is cooked, remove the lid and allow all the water to evaporate.
Garnish with crispy curry leaves and coriander leaves.

title: Bread Lasagna
cooking_instructions: Melt the butter in a heavy bottomed pan. Add the flour and cook on low heat for 3-4 minutes or until the colour barely begins to turn golden.
Add the milk gradually and keep whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Once it has thickened to the required consistency, season with salt, pepper, oregano and add the cheese. Mix and set aside.
Heat the olive oil and saute the garlic and onion until translucent.
Add all the other ingredients and mix. Cook for 5 minutes or until the raw taste of the tomatoes disappears.
Heat the butter and oil in a pan. Add all the vegetables and saute on high heat for 3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper. Remove from the heat.
Cut the crust off the bread. Roll it thin using a rolling pin.
Grease an oven-proof pan with butter. Spread a thin layer of the white sauce followed by the tomato sauce.
Place the flattened bread on it. Spread another layer of both the sauces.
Place some of the vegetable filling on top followed by cheese.
Repeat this process again twice.
On the top, spread a final layer of white sauce. Sprinkle cheese, red chilli flakes and oregano on top.
Bake at 180c for 20 minutes or until the cheese has melted and turns golden brown. Garnish with chopped parsley.

title: Japanese Fried Chicken
cooking_instructions:
Cut the chicken thighs to medium sized pieces.Marinate with salt, pepper, grated ginger and garlic, soy sauce, vinegar mixed with water. Let it rest for 30 minutes 
Add a little water to the corn flour and make it into crumbs. Crumb the marinated chicken in the corn flour and fry them in oil. For the sauce, add mayonnaise, lemon juice, grated garlic and salt and mix well.

title: Spicy Butter Garlic Spaghetti
cooking_instructions:
Boil the pasta for 6 minutes or until al dante.
Fry the sliced garlic in the olive oil and keep it aside. For the sauce, add the butter to the pan and let it melt and then add garlic, chilli flakes, veg oyster sauce and the soy sauce and let it reduce.

Add the pasta and give it a stir and add the grated parmesan cheese and give it a mix. Garnish with chopped spring onions. Serve it hot and sprinkle the fried garlic on top of the pasta.

title: Moong Dal Mughalai
cooking_instructions:
In a pressure cooker add ghee and shahi jeera, once aromatic add the sliced onions and garlic cloves and saute until aromatic.
Add the moong dal and saute for 2 minutes.
Add the spices and salt and saute until the raw flavour disappears.
Pour water and pressure cook the moong dal for 6 whistles on a moderate flame(around 6-7 minutes). Once the pressure is released, open the lid and mash the moong dal mixture and set aside.
In a kadhai, pour ghee and add the minced ginger and onions, saute until the onions turn translucent.
Reduce the flame to a simmer and add whisked curd, and immediately whisk thoroughly until thoroughly combined.
Add fried onions and all the spices and saute until the raw flavour disappears.
Add the boiled moong dal mixture to the kadhai and mix thoroughly.
Mash and cook until the mixture is thickened (around 5 minutes).
Pour cream and mix thoroughly, finish the gravy with kasoori methi and coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Assorted Kola Urundai
cooking_instructions:
In a deep pan add all the ingredients for the mutton mince mixture and cook covered for 30 minutes on a medium-low flame. Cool the mixture and blend into a smooth paste and transfer it into a mixing bowl. Add the roasted gram flour and mix thoroughly.  Take boiled eggs and cut them into quarters.
Take a handful of mutton mince and flatten it, place an egg quarter in the middle and wrap it tightly into a cylinder. Shape the keema mixture into your desired shape (balls, diamonds, vadai). Deep fry on a high flame until golden brown. (1-2 minutes)

title: Heeraikai Rava Fry
cooking_instructions:
Add gram flour, curd, chilli powder, salt and turmeric to bowl along with curd and mix well. Add water to form a  thick batter.
Add the ridge gourd and mix thoroughly.
Let marinate for 30 minutes.
In a vessel, heat oil over medium heat.
On a plate, Add rava, salt and chilli powder and mix well.
Coat your marinated ridge gourd in your rava mixture and deep fry until golden brown.
Strain onto tissue paper and sprinkle with chaat masala and enjoy.

title: Egg Lollipop
cooking_instructions:
Hard boil the 8 eggs for 12 minutes and shred them.
Add chopped onions, green chili, coriander leaves and grated ginger and garlic.
Add salt, paper and chili powder and mix well.
Roll the mixture into small balls.
Crumb coat the sphere using beaten eggs and bread crumbs.
For the sauce mix mayonnaise, tomato ketchup and grated garlic.
 
Fry the egg lollipops

title: Baby Corn Pepper Salt
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add baby corn,rice flour, corn flour, water and mix well.
Heat up oil on a medium high flame and deep fry the baby corn until golden brown.
In another pan heat up 1 tbsp of oil and add the onions and garlic and cook until translucent.
Add salt, pepper, soya sauce and toss in the babycorn.
Saute on high heat for 2 minutes , garnish with spring onions and serve hot.

title: Cookd Ambur Paneer 65 Biryani
cooking_instructions:
wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes.
In a pressure cooker, add the cookd wedding biryani paste and saute for 1 minute, or until aromatic.
Add the water to the pressure cooker and bring it to a boil.
Once boiling, add in your soaked and drained rice, and stir once before putting the lid on.
Allow the it to cook for 2 whistles on a medium flame.
Turn off the flame and let the steam reduce gradually for 10 minutes.
Open the cooker, add the seasoning oil and fluff the rice.
To make the Paneer 65, combine the powder with 50g of water to make a paste. Add the paneer to this paste and coat thoroughly. 
Deep fry the Paneer in hot oil for 2 minutes or until crispy.
Serve the Paneer 65 with the biryani.

title: Thai Chicken Green Curry
cooking_instructions:
Dry roast cumin, coriander seeds and white pepper until aromatic.
Add it to a blender along with all the ingredients for the paste and blend into a smooth paste and set aside.
In a pan pour coconut oil and saute the prepared paste on a moderate flame until the raw flavour disappears.
Add the chicken thighs, potato and salt. 
Mix and and cook for 10 minutes on moderate heat or until thoroughly cooked.
Pour coconut milk, mix till it combines and bring it to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the sliced brinjal and cook for 2-3 minutes on a high flame or until cooked.
Serve hot along with some rice.

title: Kerala Duck Roast
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan and add ginger, garlic, shallots, onion, green chilli and curry leaves. Saute until the onion turns translucent.
Add green chilli and curry leaves, and saute lightly.
Add coriander powder, turmeric powder and crushed black pepper. Saute for 1 minute on low heat.
Add the tomato and saute for 2 minutes or until it turns mushy.
Add the duck, salt and water. Bring it to a boil, cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add the diced potato and cook for a further 15 minutes.
Add the garam masala powder, pepper powder and fennel powder. Mix well.
Finally add coconut milk and curry leaves. Turn off the heat when it comes to a simmer.

title: Cookd Dindigul Biryani Eral Oon Soru
cooking_instructions:
In a pressure cooker add the cookd biryani paste and saute for 10 seconds
Add soaked rice and saute for 20 seconds in the paste. Pour water and pressure cook for 2 whistles on a moderate flame and let it rest for 10-15 minutes.
In a pan pour ghee and add dry red chillies, onions and curry leaves.
Saute until the onion’s turn translucent and add the prawns, pour water and cook until the prawns are completely done and the water has reduced.
Add the cooked biryani and mix thoroughly. Garnish with finely chopped coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Cookd Chettinad Muttai Sadham
cooking_instructions:
Heat a pan/wok, add oil.
Add cumin seeds, green chillies and curry leaves. Let it crackle.
Add the onions and saute on a moderate flame for 1 minute or until translucent.
Add the Cookd chettinad masala and mix for a few seconds.
Add the eggs and scramble it.
Add the cooked rice, coriander leaves.
Mix and toss till all the ingredients combine evenly. Serve it hot.

title: Cookd Wedding Egg 65 Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes.
In a pressure cooker, add the Cookd wedding biryani paste and saute for 1 minute, or until aromatic.
Add the water to the pressure cooker and bring it to a boil
Add the soaked and strained rice, and stir once before putting the lid on
Cook it for 2 whistles on a medium flame
Let the pressure released naturally before opening the lid
Add the seasoning oil and fluff the rice
To make the egg 65, boil your eggs for 12 minutes. 
Once cooked and cool enough to handle, peel the eggs and slice in half lengthwise
To make the Madras 65 mix, combine the powder with 50ml of water to make a paste. Add the eggs to this paste and coat thoroughly. 
Fry the eggs in hot oil for 2 minutes or until crispy
Serve the Egg 65 with the biryani

cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes.

title: Paneer Makhani Pasta
cooking_instructions:
Heat the pan and add the butter.
Add the onion and bell pepper and saute in the butter for 2 minutes.
Add the Cookd butter masala gravy to the pan and saute for a minute
Add water, mix well and adjust the consistency.
Add the boiled pasta to the gravy and mix well.
Add the paneer to the pasta and let it cook for 2 minutes.
Add the kasuri methi to the pasta.
Finish the pasta with the cream.
Give it a toss and serve it hot.

title: No Bake Vanilla Sponge Cake
cooking_instructions:
Start whisking the egg whites until they get foamy. Start slowly adding the sugar in batches and keep beating till it forms stiff peaks. This process should take around 7-9 minutes. Whisk in the egg yolks and the vanilla extract. Next, whisk in the melted butter and the butter and slowly mix it until all the wet ingredients are incorporated. Sieve the maida, baking powder, baking soda and salt. 
Slowly fold in the dry ingredients into the wet mixture, mix well and set aside. Grease the pressure cooker with melted butter and place butter paper at the bottom of the cooker. Pour the batter into the pressure cooker. Keep a flat surfaced pan or a tawa on medium heat and leave it for 5 minutes. Place the pressure cooker on the pan and reduce the heat to the lowest setting.Make sure you don't add the whistle to the cooker. Leave the cooker for 30-40 minutes until a toothpick inserted comes out clean. Once cooked, let it cool for 15 minutes before running a butter knife along the edges of the cake so it comes out easily.

title: Eggless French Toast
cooking_instructions: Melt the ice cream completely. Keep the slices of bread ready, preferably thick slices.
Heat a flat pan and add butter. Allow the butter to melt.
Dip the bread slices into the melted ice cream. Make sure that it is completely coated.
Lay the soaked bread on the pan. Cook until it is golden brown on both sides.
Garnish with nutella and banana or any toppings of your choice, and serve!

title: Cookd Wedding Veg Semiya Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Heat a pan, add ghee and add the vermicelli. 
Mix it on a medium flame for 5 minutes. Take it off the flame and keep it aside.
Heat a pan/pot, add the cookd wedding biryani paste and saute for 30 seconds.
Add the vegetables, and mix it along with the paste for 2 minutes.
Add water, bring it to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Open the pot, add the roasted vermicelli  and mix it till all the water is absorbed.
Turn off the flame, cover and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Open the pot, add the seasoning oil, fluff the biryani and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Ambur Veg Semiya Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Heat a pan, add ghee and add the vermicelli. 
Mix it on a medium flame for 5 minutes. Take it off the flame and keep it aside.

Open the pot, add the seasoning oil, fluff the biryani and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Wedding Chicken Idiyappam Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Crumble the idiyappam and keep it aside
Heat a pan/pot, add the cookd wedding biryani paste and saute for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and mix it along with the masala for 2 minutes.
Add water, mix it and bring it to a boil. Cover and simmer it for 15 minutes.
Open the pot, add the crumbled idiyappam and spread it out evenly.
Top it with chopped coriander leaves, mint leaves and a tablespoon of ghee.
Cover and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes. 
Turn off the flame and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Open the pot, add the seasoning oil, fluff the biryani and serve it hot.

title: Military Rasam
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer jar add red chilli, black pepper, jeera, green chilli , garlic , tamarind, tomato and coriander and blend into a coarse paste.
In another vessel, add oil, jeera curry leaves and red chilli and saute till fragrant.
Add tomatoes and saute for 2 minutes.
Add the paste, turmeric, salt and water and let it reach a boil.
Once it boils, turn off the heat and enjoy this military rasam with white rice.

title: Salted Caramel Ice Cream
cooking_instructions: Melt the sugar in a pan till it becomes amber in color. Once the sugar is completely melted add in the butter and whisk it well. Turn off the heat and carefully whisk in the cream (be careful as the cream causes the sugar to bubble). Lastly, whisk in the salt and set it aside to cool.
Using a hand blender, whip the cream until it forms stiff peaks. Fold in the condensed milk followed by the salted caramel and set it for 8 hours or overnight.

title: Aloo Methi
cooking_instructions:
Soak the dry Kasuri methi in hot water for 10 minutes. In a pan, add oil and cumin and saute and then add the raw potatoes and mix well. Add a little water and close the pan and let it cook.
Add turmeric and coriander powdeand add a little water to it. Let the masala cook for 3-5 minutes and then add the kasuri methi. End it with red chilli powder and garam masala and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the kasuri methi. End it with red chilli powder and garam masala and cook for 3 minutes.

title: Spicy Honey Chicken Strips
cooking_instructions:
To a bowl, add the chicken strips, cornflour, maida, salt, black pepper, msg and water. Mix well till the chicken is coated well with the batter. Heat oil in a kadai, deep fry the chicken till golden brown and crispy
Heat a wok, add ginger and garlic. Saute till it turns light brown. Add the red chilli paste and cook it for 2 minutes on a medium flame. Add water and honey and mix till a thick sauce is formed. Add the fried chicken, spring onions and toss on a high flame till the chicken is coated completely with the sauce. Transfer it to a bowl, garnish with spring onions and sesame seeds and serve it hot.

title: Kuthiraivali Arisi Pongal
cooking_instructions:
Wash and strain the kuthiraivali (horsetail millet) and moong dal.
Add it to a pressure cooker along with 3 ½ cups of water and salt.
Cover and pressure cook it for 4 whistles.
Let the steam reduce gradually.
For the tempering, heat a pan and add ghee.
Add the cumin seeds, Green Chilli, ginger and let it crackle.
Add the cashew nuts and let it start to brown.
Add the tempering to themixture in the cooker and give it a good mix.
Serve it hot with chutney.

title: Jackfruit Payasam
cooking_instructions:
Heat water in a saucepan, add the jackfruit and boil it for 6 minutes
Transfer it to a blender and blend it to a fine
Add the jaggery into the saucepan and add 1/2 of water and let the jaggery melt..
Add chopped jackfruit and mix for a few seconds.
Add the jackfruit puree into the jaggery syrup, mix it well and then keep the flame low and add the coconut milk.
Mix it all together well and add cardamom powder, keep it in low flame for 2-3 mins & switch off the flame. 
Heat the ghee in a pan and add the coconut bits and roast till they are nicely brown and then add into the payasam.
Garnish with fried cashews.

title: Carrot Lemon Salad
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl, add all the ingredients one by one.
Mix it well using a spatula.
Serve it immediately.

title: Bharwa Shimla Mirch
cooking_instructions:
Cut the Capsicums in half, deseed them and keep aside. 
In a pan, Add the oil and fry the cumin till it starts to crackle. 
Add in the Onion and cook till the onion turns translucent
Add the ginger garlic paste and the green chili. 
Add turmeric powder, Asafoetida and saute for few minutes
Add the potatoes. 
Mix the potatoes well and add the Garam Masala, Amchur Powder, Coriander powder, Chaat Masala and salt. 
Mix everything well and set aside to cool. 
Now carefully stuff the potatoes in the capsicum. 
In the same pan add some oil and roast the Capsicums for 15 minutes on low flame till the outer covering is charred and fully cooked. 
Make sure you place the capsicum with the potato filling uswards.  
Garnish with finely chopped coriander and serve hot.

title: Cookd Ambur Chicken Idiyappam Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Crumble the idiyappam and keep it aside.
Heat a pan/pot, add the cookd ambur biryani paste and saute for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and mix it along with the masala for 2 minutes.
Add water, mix it and bring it to a boil. Cover and simmer it for 15 minutes.
Open the pot, add the crumbled idiyappam and spread it out evenly.
Top it with chopped coriander leaves, mint leaves and a tablespoon of ghee.
Cover and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes. 
Turn off the flame and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Open the pot, add the seasoning oil, fluff the biryani and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Dindigul Chicken Idiyappam Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Crumble the idiyappam and keep it aside.
Heat a pan/pot, add the cookd dindigul biryani paste and saute for 30 seconds.

Once boiling, add in your soaked and drained rice, and stir once before putting the lid on
Allow the it to cook for 2 whistles on a medium flame.

title: Cookd Bang Bang Paneer
cooking_instructions:
In a pan pour oil, and when it’s still cold, add minced garlic and spring onion greens, once they start to sizzle and turn slightly golden brown, add the sesame seeds and switch off the flame. Add the cookd seasoning sachet, give it a good mix, and set aside.
Divide the cookd breading mix into two parts, 175 g for the dry dredge and 75 g (5 tbsp) for the wet dredge pour ½ Cup water and whisk until super smooth. 
Crumb the paneer using the cookd breading mix, following the dry-wet-dry method. Coat it in the dry mix first, then in the batter and then in the dry mix again. 
Dust off the excess fry mix.
Deep fry the paneer until golden brown and set aside.
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the sauce and mix thoroughly. 
Add the fried paneer and toss until completely coated.
Garnish with spring onion greens and serve.

title: Cookd Korean Spicy Fried Cauliflower
cooking_instructions:
Soak the cauliflower florets in hot water for 5 minutes and strain it.
Prepare the chilli paste by soaking kashmiri red chillies in hot water for 10 minutes. 
Transfer the chillies to a blender, add some of the soaked water, chopped ginger and garlic and blend it to a fine paste
Add the hot and spicy marinade to the cauliflower. Mix well till the cauliflower is coated evenly with the marinade.
Prepare a batter using 5 tbsp of the cookd ultra crispy fry mix and 150ml of water. 
Coat it evenly with the breading first.
Dip it in the batter and coat it through out.
Coat it with the dry mix again and dust it well.
Deep fry it in hot oil till it turns golden brown, transfer it to a plate and keep it aside.
Heat oil in a pan/wok, add chopped garlic and saute for a few seconds.
Add the chilli paste and cook it for a minute on a medium flame.
Add the sauces and mix for a minute till they combine evenly.
Add the fried cauliflower. Toss it on a high flame till it is coated with the sauce.
Garnish with chopped spring onions and sesame seeds and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Fried Plantain Fritters
cooking_instructions: Peel and cut your plantains on a bias into ¼ inch slices.

Coat the plantain in the secret marinade .
Ready your dredging station by readying the Fried Chicken for battering and dusting. 
First, coat the plantain in the dry mix, before dipping it in the batter, and then bring it back to the dry mix for a final coating.
Once all the plantains have been coated, deep fry them until they are golden brown

title: Cookd Fried Onion Rings
cooking_instructions:
Cut the onions into thick slices.
Mix the onion rings with the cookd secret marinade.
Take 5 tbsp of the fry mix and add 150 ml of water and make it into a smooth batter.
Transfer the remaining fry mix to a bowl.
Use the dry, wet and dry method.
Coat the onions with the dry mix then dip it in the batter and then again coat it with the dry mix.
Fry until golden brown and crispy.
Add the Cookd seasoning and toss till the onions are coated.
Serve it hot.

title: Rasgulla
cooking_instructions:
Let the milk boil, mix the vinegar and water in a cup and add it to the milk.
Let it cuddle, use a muslin cloth and remove the water from the curdled milk and separate the chenna.
Rub the chenna for 10 minutes and make it into a smooth dough.
Roll out small balls from the chenna and set aside
For the sugar syrup, boil the water and sugar and add the cardamom powder, let the sugar melt.
Drop the balls into the boiling sugar syrup and let it cook for 12 minutes.
Garnish with a few sprigs of saffron.

title: Drumstick Sambar
cooking_instructions:
In a pressure cooker, pour water and add turmeric powder and toor dal.
Pressure Cook it for 5 whistles on a moderate flame (around 7-8 minutes)
Mash the dal until completely smooth and set aside.
In a kadhai or mud pot, pour oil and add drumsticks, salt and water, cook the drumsticks for 2-3 minutes on a high flame (this will make sure the salt is absorbed by the drumstick)
Add the shallots and tomato, saute for 30 seconds and add asafoetida and sambar powder.
Cook on a low medium flame for 1-2 minutes or until the raw flavour disappears.
Pour tamarind water along with regular water, cover and cook for 5-6 minutes on a moderate flame or until the drumsticks and shallots are cooked thoroughly. 
Add the mashed dal to the sambar and cook for another 2-3 minutes on a high flame or until the sambar is cohesive.
For the tempering, add ghee and mustard seeds, once they crackle add curry leaves and let them splutter. 
Add the tempering to the sambar and serve hot.

title: Peerkangai Thogayal
cooking_instructions:
Wash and drain the ridge gourd/peerkangai skin. Heat a pan and dry roast the grated coconut. 
Dry roast  the ridge gourd skin, dry red chillies and dal separately.
Transfer them to a blender, add the tamarind, salt and little water. Blend it to a coarse texture. Prepare the tadka by heating oil and adding mustard, urad dal, curry leaves, dry red chillies and asafoetida. Let it crackle and immediately transfer it to the thogayal and mix till it combines.Make some crispy hot dosas and enjoy it along with some chutney

title: Kit Kat Milkshake
cooking_instructions:
In a blender jar add crushed kit kat, milk and vanilla ice cream. Blend until smooth and there are no bits of kit kat.
Garnish with chocolate sauce and enjoy

title: Vazhakkai Aloo Tikki
cooking_instructions:
Add the raw bananas and potatoes in a pressure cooker, fill it with just enough water to cover them. Pressure cook it for 3 whistles. Dry roast the Peanuts on a pan for 3-4 minutes on medium flame until golden brown. Peel the potatoes and bananas once cooled, and start mashing them in a bowl. 
Add the- green chilies, ginger garlic paste, amchur powder , red chili powder, salt and pepper. Now mix in the coriander, peanuts and the breadcrumbs and mix it well. Shape this mixture into small 35g patties 
Shallow fry them until golden brown on both sides. Garnish the tikkis with Chaat Masala. Serve hot with tomato sauce or mint chutney.

title: Soy Honey Chicken
cooking_instructions:
To a pan on medium flame, add the soy sauce oyster sauce, star anise, cinnamon and whole black peppercorn. Add the slit chillies and grate in the garlic and ginger. Once the mixture comes to a simmer, add in the honey and stir. Let it come to a boil and switch off after 1 minute and let it cool. As the sauce cools, it should thicken. Once the sauce has cooled sufficiently, add it to the chicken thighs and allow to marinate for at least 10 minutes
Once marinated, heat a wide saucepan over medium flame and add the chicken to sear, reserving the marinade. Once the chicken is 90 percent cooked add in the marinade and let it cook for 5 minutes. Mix the cornstarch with water to make a slurry and add it to the pan while mixing. The sauce should thicken considerably. Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and spring onion. Serve with steamed rice

title: Choco Mousse Oats
cooking_instructions:
Take a jar and add the oats, milk, chia seeds, vanilla essence and honey. Mix well and refrigerate it for 12 hours.
For the choco mousse, take curd, cocoa powder and honey. Mix it till it becomes a smooth texture. Layer the mousse on top of the oats and garnish with cocoa powder and chopped chocolate.

title: Mathura Peda
cooking_instructions:
On a pan, heat 1 tbsp of ghee, add the milk powder and roast it on low flame for about 5-7 minutes stirring continuously. Add another 1 tbsp of ghee. Now roast this mixture till it becomes brown in color. Keep stirring continuously. Keep breaking lumps, if any. Once the mixture has browned, switch off the heat and stir in the milk in portions to avoid lumps.
Set it aside to cool completely for 10 minutes. Add in the sugar and cardamom powder and mix lightly.
Shape the mixture into rectangular shaped pedas.Coat the pedas in sugar and garnish with chopped nuts.

title: Royyala Vepudu
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, add ghee and the whole spices. Once aromatic, add the curry leaves and fry until they become crispy Then add the slit chillies along with the onion and saute. 
Once the onions have become lightly golden, add the ginger garlic paste, salt and all the spice powders. Stir and cook until fragrant, on a medium heat
Just as the onions are about to stick to the pan, add in the prawns and cook on a medium high heat. The prawns will leave water, preventing and burning. Cook the prawns until they form a lightly crispy exterior. Garnish with chopped coriander and lemon wedges

title: Firecracker Chicken
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, add the chicken, cornflour, salt, white pepper powder, ginger-garlic paste and the egg. 
Mix well till all the chicken is completely coated and set aside. 
In another bowl, mix together the chili sauce, sriracha sauce, vinegar, red chili flakes and brown sugar and keep it aside. 
Heat a pan with oil and shallow fry the chicken till golden brown and crispy on all sides. For about 5 minutes on low heat.
Remove the excess oil and now in the same pan add the chicken and toss it in the sauce for 2-3 minutes. 
Remove it from the pan and garnish with sesame seeds and serve hot.

title: One Pot Alfredo Pasta
cooking_instructions:
Heat a large saucepan on a low flame and add the butter. Once foaming, add the garlic. Once fragrant, add the water and milk. Once it comes to a simmer add the dried herbs and stir. 
When the mixture starts to boil, add in your pasta, along with salt. Stir to ensure even cooking. As the pasta cooks, the liquid in the pan should reduce and slightly thicken. Once the pasta is 90 percent cooked, and in the cream and stir. Turn the flame off and add in your cheese while mixing thoroughly. Garnish with crushed black pepper and chopped parsley

title: Prawn Pepper Perattal
cooking_instructions:
Add prawns, minced garlic and all the ground spices except the black pepper powder and salt in a mixing bowl. Mix thoroughly and set aside.
In a saute pan, pour coconut oil and add the onions, saute on a moderate flame until the onions turn translucent (around 45 seconds). Add the prawn mixture and salt, and cook on a high flame for 3-4 minutes (making sure not to overcook it). Add the curry leaves and black pepper powder, give it a good toss and serve hot.

title: Chicken Stronganoff and Buttered Rice
cooking_instructions:
Marinate the boneless chicken with salt, pepper, lemon juice and paprika powder
Heat a pan, add oil and sear the chicken to a golden brown colour and keep it aside
Heat a pan, add butter and let it melt Add the chopped garlic and saute for a few seconds. Add the chopped onions and saute till it turns soft and translucent. Add the mushrooms and mix till it starts to cook and leaves water. Add water and bring it to a boil. Season the mixture and mix well.
Add the seared chicken and fresh cream. Mix till all ingredients combine and the sauce thickens. Take it off the flame. Heat a pan, add butter and let it melt. Add chopped garlic and saute for a few seconds. Add the cooked rice, salt, pepper and chopped coriander and toss till all ingredients combine evenly. Serve the chicken or the side with the buttered rice and enjoy

title: Easy Beetroot Hummus
cooking_instructions:
Sear the beetroot in olive oil until they’ve softened
Add the cooked chickpeas, beetroot and all the other ingredients except water and into a mixer/food processor. Add ice water gradually if needed and blend into a fine paste.

title: Makhana Kheer
cooking_instructions:
Heat ghee in a pan and add the fox nuts. Saute on medium heat for 4-5 minutes on medium-low heat until crispy, but not browned. 
Remove ¼ cup into a bowl and set aside. Add the remaining into a mixer grinder. Pulse-blend it into a coarse powder. 
In the pan, add milk, green cardamom and saffron. Mix continuously and cook until the milk has reduced to 3/4th of its original quantity.  
Add the crushed makhana mixture and continue to cook until it has thickened. 
Add the sugar and cook for 5 minutes, till the sugar is completely dissolved. 
Add the chopped nuts. At this stage, you can add the condensed milk (optional). Mix well and then turn off the heat. Allow it to cool to room temperature. 
Mix again, incorporating the fat layer that would have accumulated on top. Chill it in the fridge until ready to serve. Serve with some of the reserved roasted makhana.

title: Potato Salad
cooking_instructions: Add the potatoes to a saucepan with 1 tsp salt and enough water to cover the potatoes. Bring them to a boil and cook until they can be pierced with a fork, around 15 minutes.
Peel the potatoes and cut them into 1-inch sized cubes. Set aside.
Add the egg into a pan of hot water, along with ½ tsp salt and simmer for 12 minutes. Once cooled, peel the eggs and chop into small pieces.
In a large bowl, add the potato cubes. Add vinegar, salt and pepper and mix well.
Add the mayonnaise, chopped eggs, onion, mint, and spring onion. Mix well.
This salad can be served warm or chilled in the refrigerator.

title: Easy Kumbakonam Kadappa
cooking_instructions:
In a pressure cooker add the potatoes, moong dal and water, and pressure cook it on a high flame for 6 whistles ( around 6 minutes). Once the pressure releases, mash the mixture and set aside.
In a mixer jar, add all the ingredients for the paste, blend into a smooth paste, and set aside.
In a kadhai, pour oil and add mustard seeds, once they splutter (around 15 seconds) add the onions and curry leaves, and saute until they turn translucent (Around 2 minutes). Add the tomatoes, turmeric powder and cook until they turn mushy (4 minutes). Add the paste and cook on a moderate flame until the raw flavour disappears (around 5 minutes). Add the boiled potato and moong dal mixture, pour water and boil the mixture for 5 minutes on a medium-high flame. Once the raw flavour disappears, add coconut oil and curry leaf sprigs and bring it off the heat.

title: Carrot Hummus
cooking_instructions:
Sear the carrots in olive oil until they’re golden brown and have softened
Add the cooked chickpeas, carrot and all the other ingredients except water and into a mixer/food processor. 
Add ice water gradually if needed and blend into a fine paste.

title: Honey Hummus
cooking_instructions:
Add the cooked chickpeas, honey and all the other ingredients except water and  into a mixer/food processor. 
Add ice water gradually if needed and blend into a fine paste.

title: Egg Sando
cooking_instructions:
In a pan pour water and add salt, bring it to a boil and add 6 eggs.
Reduce the flame to a simmer, after 8 minutes take out two eggs and cook the other 4 for another 4 minutes.
Peel the eggs hard-boiled eggs and separate the yolks and whites.
In a mixing bowl add the yolks, mayonnaise, soy sauce, mixed herbs, coriander leaves and spring onions. Mix everything until homogeneous add the chopped egg whites.
Fill the sandwich generously with the filling and serve.

title: Pyazi Malai Paneer
cooking_instructions:
Heat the oil and add cinnamon, cardamom, mustard seeds, bayleaf, cumin and red chillies to it. Add sliced onions and cook with salt and turmeric powder. Cover and cook for 3-5 minutes or until soft.
Add the tomatoes and again cook it for 2-3 minutes. Once the tomatoes are cooked add all the spices, basen, mix well, cook for 3 minutes.
Add water, and add the cream as well, once the gravy becomes thick, add the paneer, dry mango powder and garam masala and mix well. Garnish with chopped coriander.

title: Poondu Sadham
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer jar, add ⅓ Cup of shallots, ⅓ cup of Garlic and blend. 
Heat up a Non Stick kadai and add gingelly oil.
When hot add mustard seed, and when spluttering add the dry red chillies, curry leaves and saute till aromatic.
Add the Sliced Shallots and saute till golden brown.
Add the Whole Garlic cloves and saute well.
Add tomatoes and saute till soft.
Once soft add the chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, black pepper powder, salt and garam masala; Saute continuously to make sure the masala dont burn.
Add in the soaked rice, and saute on high heat.  
After 2 minutes of continuous sauteing add in the hot water,saute well, add coriander  cover and reduce the heat to the minimum.
After 15 minutes turn off the heat, and fluff up the rice from the side.
Serve hot and enjoy.

title: Keeranur Mutton Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
Add the spices required for the masala powder and blend it to a fine powder. Keep it aside
To a mixie, add coriander, mint leaves and green chillies. Blend it toa fine paste and keep it aside
Heat a pot, add ghee.Add cinnamon, cardamom, cloves and let it crackle. Add the onions and saute till it turns golden brown. Add ginger garlic paste and mix for a few seconds. Add the blended coriander mint paste and mix for a few seconds
Add kashmiri red chilli powder and the spice masala and mix for a minute. Add the mutton and mix it with the masala for 5 minutes on a medium flame. Add water, salt and bring it to a boil. Cover and simmer the mutton for 35 minutes
Open the pot, add the soaked and strained rice. Keep mixing it on a medium flame till the rice and water are level. Seal the pot tightly and place it on a preheated tawa for 15 minutes on a low flame. Turn off the flame, let it rest for 10 minutes. Open the pot, add ghee and fluff the rice. Serve it hot

title: Thenga Thenga Sadham
cooking_instructions:
In a pan pour the coconut milk and once it comes to a mild boil add the washed and soaked basmati rice and salt. Bring it to a boil and turn down the flame to a simmer and cook covered for 12 minutes, let the rice rest for 10 more minutes before fluffing it up.
In a kadhai, pour coconut oil, add the mustard seeds, and once they splutter add the urad dal and cashew nuts, and saute until they turn golden brown. Add the onion, green chillies, curry leaves and garlic, and saute for 30 seconds on a moderate flame or until the onions turn translucent. Add the cooked rice, salt and grated coconut. Toss the rice until completely mixed. Garnish the rice with coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Paneer Lababdar
cooking_instructions:
Add oil to a pan, and add the ginger and garlic paste.
Add the onion and tomatoes to the pan and saute for 3-4 minutes.
Add bayleaf, black pepper, cashew, green chili  and cardamom to the pan.
At the end add the kashmiri red chili powder and give it a good mix.
Add water and let it cook for 2-3 minutes or until everything is soft.
Let it cool, and blend it into a fine paste and keep it aside.
For the base masala, add oil, cumin seeds, onion and saute it for 2 minutes.
Let the onion cook well and then add all the dry masalas to it and add a little amount of water so that it doesn't get burnt.
After the masalas are cooked, add the tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the base gravy to the pan and mix well. 
Add pepper powder, garam masala and salt.
Let it cook for 3-4 minutes and garnish with coriander.

title: Ram Ladoo
cooking_instructions:
Soak the chana dal, moong dal and urad dal for 4 hours.. 
Once soaked, remove all the water from the dals and add them to a grinder or mixer. Add in the Salt and the hing. 
Without adding any water, grind the dal into a coarse paste and make sure it’s not liquidy. 
Remove the batter in a bowl and add in the hing and salt. Beat this batter vigorously for 6-8 minutes until the color changes from pale yellow to white. 
The Batter will be aerated and fluffy.
Wet your hands with water and start scooping the batter into small portions and directling put them in the hot oil, continue frying on medium heat until all the sides are golden and crispy. 
Add in the coriander, onion, green chili, salt and lemon juice in a blender. 
Paste it with the water into a fine chutney. 
Sprinkle the amchur powder and drizzle the coriander chutney, serve hot!

title: Cookd Chicken Kothu Parotta
cooking_instructions:
Heat oil in a kadai, add curry leaves and let it crackle. Add the chopped onions and saute till it turns translucent. Add the chicken and mix for a minute. Add the Cookd Madurai Chukka Masala and mix it with the chicken for 2 minutes. Add water, bring it to a boil. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Open the pot, add coriander leaves, give it a good mix and keep it aside.
Heat up the parottas on a tawa, beat it and shred it with your hands
In the same tawa, add oil, curry leaves, onions and saute for a minute. Add the tomato and cook for 2 minutes. Add eggs and scramble it well. Add the parotta, chicken pieces and the gravy. Start mincing it with a flat ladle/tumbler. Add come of the chukka gravy keep mincing (kothifying) it till all ingredients combine evenly. Serve it hot with salna and raita.

title: Air Fried Choco Lava Cake
cooking_instructions:
Melt the chocolate with the butter on a double boiler. 
Beat the sugar into the eggs and whip until fluffy and pale.
