Fold the chocolate mixture with the egg mixture.
Once fully incorporated, add vanilla extract and the rest of dry ingredients i.e flour, baking powder, salt.
Fold gently.
Butter your ramekins and optionally coat with granulated sugar to add a crunch to the finished product.
Pour your batter into the ramekins, only ¾ the way to the top.
Bake at 190C for 7-8 minutes.
After removing, let it cool for 5 minutes before running a butter knife around the edge to release.
Demould onto a plate and top with icing sugar.

title: Instant Aval Payasam
cooking_instructions:
Heat a pan, add ghee and saute the aval for 3 minutes.
Add the milk to it and let it boil.
Add the condensed milk to it and give it a good mix.
Add the cardamom powder and mix it.
The consistency can be adjusted with required milk.
Fry the cashew with ghee and add it to the payasam.
Garnish with saffron.

title: Fried Modak
cooking_instructions:
For the dough, in a bowl add the whole wheat flour, maida and salt. 
Heat the ghee till it starts to bubble, pour in the hot ghee to the dry flour mixture and gently mix it. Add the water in portions to form a firm and smooth dough. 
Let the dough rest for 20 minutes. 
In the meantime, in a pan add the ghee and grated coconut. Roast the coconut for 2-3 minutes and add in the jaggery. 
Cook the mixture till the jaggery completely melts and add in the chopped dry fruits and the cardamom powder. 
Transfer the Coconut mixture to a plate and spread it out evenly and let it cool completely. 
Take small portions of the dough and start rolling it into a small thin circle. You can also use a glass or cup to cut out the circle. Make sure to cover the remaining dough with a moist cloth. 
Add a tsp of the coconut mixture in the middle of the dough and starting from one side start pinching the edges of the dough, bring it together in the middle and seal it properly so that no oil goes in while frying. You can also wet your fingers and run it through the top of the modak to make sure all the edges are well sealed. 
Fry the modaks in hot oil, on low flame for 5-7 minutes until golden brown and crispy on all sides.

title: Loaded Shuwa Fries
cooking_instructions:
Add all the ingredients for the marination, to the chicken and combine. Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes and up to overnight
Sear the chicken on a medium high flame until cooked and lightly charred on both sides. Slice the chicken up into small bite sized pieces 
Heat your oil for deep frying your french fries. Once the oil has become hot, add your french fries in two batches and cook until golden brown. Once golden, remove and drain on a paper towel. While they’re still hot, toss with salt to season

To assemble your loaded fries, place a layer of fries as the base and top with the chicken, diced jalapenos, and cheese. Repeat this one more time to fill the bowl. Apply both the sauces to the top along with diced onions

title: Paneer Butter Masala Fried Rice
cooking_instructions:
Heat a wok, add oil.
Add the chopped ginger and garlic and saute till it turns light brown.
Add the carrot, beans, capsicum and saute on a high flame for a minute.
Add the paneer and toss for a few seconds.
Add the cookd butter masala gravy and mix and toss for minute.
Add the cooked rice, salt and kasuri methi.
Mix and toss till the rice is coated with the masala.
Add spring onions, give it one final toss and take it off the flame.

title: Kaala Channa Sandwich
cooking_instructions:
Add all the ingredients for the filling in a bowl and mash them well.
Add the remaining ingredients
Layer them with roundels of onion and tomato and then the black channa filling.

title: Oreo Parfait
cooking_instructions:
In a saucepan sieve together the cornflour and cocoa powder, add in the sugar. Pour in the milk in two halves to avoid lumps and mix well. Place the saucepan on medium heat and stir constantly until the mixture starts to thicken, this process should take about 5-6 minutes.Once it starts bubbling and thickening add in the cream and the chocolate. 
Now take a chilled bowl and add the whip cream, whip it till it forms stiff peaks. Pour in the coffee decoction and slowly fold it into the whipped cream. For assembling the parfait, pour the chocolate pudding at the bottom of the glass, forming the first layer. Roughly crush some oreos using your hands and add it on top of the chocolate pudding, forming the second layer. Top the oreos with the chilled coffee cream and dust it with some grated oreo biscuit. Serve it chilled

title: Moti Mahal Butter Chicken
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl Add the mustard oil, kashmiri red chilli powder, Ginger garlic paste, coriander powder, salt, garam masala, jeera powder,turmeric chaat masala, hung curd and lemon. Mix well and make sure there are no lumps before adding the chicken. Marinate and let sit for a minimum of 1 hour.
Optionally you can also place a piece of hot coal, add a little ghee and cover for 10 minutes.Heat a pan, once hot, add butter, oil and spread across. Add the chicken into the hot pan and char for 4 minutes on each side. Remove the chicken from the pan, along with the butter/ oil/ juices that's left on the pan.
Add the tomatoes , ginger, garlic,green chilli, red chilli, turmeric, salt, cashews into a vessel with 1tbsp of Oil. Cook covered on low heat for 45 minutes or until the tomatoes are completely cooked. Cool it down completely and then blend into a fine paste.(You can add a tbsp of water if necessary). In a vessel over medium heat, add 1 tbsp of butter, add your paste, (optionally you can strain it to ensure there isn't any lumps/ ungrinded pieces). Cook the gravy for 10 minutes before adding sugar and garam masala.
Add the chicken along with all the dripping and oil that you got while frying the chicken. Stir for 2 minutes and let it continue boiling. Add kasuri methi, cream and let it cook for another minute. Serve hot with Roti or rice and enjoy.

title: Prawn Sambal
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer jar add all the ingredients for the paste, blend into a smooth paste and set aside. In a pan pour oil, saute the paste and cook for 3-4 minutes on a moderate flame until raw flavour disappears. Add all the sauces and jaggery and cook for another minutes. 
Add the prawns and saute for 2-3 minutes on a high flame, Finish the dish with salt and serve hot.

title: Chia Seed Pudding
cooking_instructions:
In a blender add chia seed, milk, cocoa powder, honey and vanilla essence. Give it a quick blend, it should not be smooth, little coarse will do.
Pour it in a cup and let it set in the fridge for 4 hours. Garnish with chocolate syrup and mint.

title: Cookd Chettinad Rasam
cooking_instructions: Heat ghee in a pot, add the mustard seeds and let them splutter. Add the cumin seeds, curry leaves, crushed garlic and hing. Saute for 2 mins. Add the tomatoes and cook until soft. Add salt
Add chettinad masala, tamarind pulp made from 1 tbsp of tamarind and ½ cup of water and 2.5 cups of water and simmer for 6 mins. Finish with chopped coriander leaves and ghee.

title: Mushroom Crispy Rice
cooking_instructions:
To a pan with oil add the mushrooms and salt and cook them until all of their liquid evaporates and they become golden and crispy.
Then add the spring onions and the minced garlic. 
Once fragrant, deglaze the pan with soy sauce and let it slightly thicken.
Then add the oyster sauce and sugar and let it thicken until it just coats the mushroom mixture. Right at the end at the vinegar and stir.
Flatten your leftover rice into an even layer and chill in the fridge for an hour.
Once your rice has formed into one block, cut it into rectangles or squares.
In a separate pan, add oil and let it heat up. Add in the rice squares and sear until they become golden brown and crunchy on one side. Flip and repeat on the other side. 
Top the rice squares with the mushroom mixture and serve hot.

title: Dates and ChocolateTruffles
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer jar add all the ingredients for the truffles and blend until completely smooth.
Shape the mixture into balls and roll them over cocoa powder

title: Eggless Chocolate Cupcakes
cooking_instructions:
Combine all the ingredients for the wet ingredient mix together in a bowl and whisk until the sugar melts completely. 
Place a sieve on top of the bowl and add all the dry ingredients. 
Sieve the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients and mix well until thoroughly combined. 
In a muffin pan/ tray, place cupcake liners and fill half with the batter. 
Bake in a pre-heated oven at 180C for 18 mins until a skewer comes out clean. 
Cool and store, but they can be had fresh and warm!

title: Aloo Cheese Paratha
cooking_instructions:
Pressure cook the potatoes for 3 whistles on moderate flame. (Around 6 mins)
Start by adding atta, maida, salt and ghee together and mix well. Once the ghee is well incorporated with the dry ingredients slowly start adding the water in intervals. Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes till it's smooth and soft and set aside. 
In another bowl, add the potatoes and mash them completely and add the spices- red chili powder, cumin powder, salt and amchur powder and mix well. Now add in the chopped coriander,green chillies and onion, mix well and set aside. 
Roll a small portion of dough into a 4-inch thick circle. Place the aloo stuffing inside and then add the grated mozzarella on top of the potato stuffing and cover the stuffing by sealing the circumference of the dough. Flatten and roll using a rolling pin. Cook the paratha in a Tawa adding ghee on both sides till golden brown and crispy. Serve hot with a little more grated cheese on top.

title: Milk Maggi
cooking_instructions:
In a Pan over medium heat add butter , onions and let cook till translucent and light golden brown. Add the green chillies and tomatoes and cook until the tomatoes are soft. Add the turmeric, jeera powder, chilli powder and salt.
Saute well for 2 minutes before adding the milk. Let it reach a boil and add the taste maker from the maggi along with the noodles. Cook for 4 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve hot and enjoy :)

title: Chicken Skin Chips
cooking_instructions:
Scrape excess fat off the chicken skin. Add salt to the skin
Place between two trays and bake in a preheated 150 C oven for 30 minutes

title: Cookd Chettinadu Fried Rice
cooking_instructions:
In a wok, pour oil and add the chicken cubes, add salt and saute on high flame for 3 minutes or until cooked and browned. Strain the chicken from the pan and set it aside.
In the same wok, add cashew nuts and saute till it turns golden brown, add dry red chillies and cook for 5 more seconds. Add the carrots and beans, and saute on a high flame for 10 seconds. Add the minced garlic and onion, cook for 10 more seconds and add the cabbage and capsicum. Once sauted, add the curry leaves. 
Add the cooked basmati rice, black pepper powder and soy sauce. Add back the cooked chicken and sprinkle the cookd chettinad masala. Toss it over high heat and serve it with a fried egg on top.

title: Omelette Fusion
cooking_instructions:
Crack all eggs in a bowl and add the onion and chilli to it and give it a good mix.
Cook the omelette well. Blend both onion and tomato separately into a paste.
Add oil to a kadai, add the onion puree and cook it till its brown or loses its raw flavour. Add the tomato paste and let it cook for 5 minutes. Add the dry spices and mix well.
Adjust the consistency and add the cut omelette to you close it with a lid. Serve it hot and garnish with chopped coriander.

title: Chole De Pyaaz
cooking_instructions:
In a Bowl add chickpeas and water to soak the chickpeas.Soak overnight for a minimum of 8 hrs. Take a pressure cooker and on medium flame add your soaked chickpeas, tomatoes and pressure cook for 6 whistles.
In a Jar add the fried onions, cashew and curd. Blend into a fine paste.
In a pan over medium heat add oil, once hot add elaichi,cumin seeds, bay leaf, cinnamon and saute well. Add the onions and saute until golden brown.
Add the paste and saute on high heat for 2 minutes stirring constantly. Add the salt, chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric and saute well. Add your cooked chickpeas along with any water that was left after cooking.
Cover and simmer on medium heat for the flavors to combine for 2 minutes. Add garam masala, black pepper and saute until the raw smell disappears. Garnish with ginger and serve hot with pooris/ rice/ paratha and enjoy.

title: Chemmeen Undaputtu
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, marinate the prawns with turmeric powder, ginger garlic paste, red chili powder, Kashmiri chili powder, and salt. Mix well and let it rest for 15-20 minutes. In another pan, heat oil and sauté finely chopped onions until they turn brown.
Add chopped tomato, ginger, and garlic. Sauté until the tomatoes soften.
Heat oil in a pan and shallow fry the marinated prawns. Cook for 5 minutes until prawns are cooked through. Set aside.  Add the cooked prawns into the mixture. Add 1 tbsp coriander leaves, 1 sprig curry leaves, and 1 tsp of salt. Mix well. Using a fork, roughly mash the prawns and combine them with the onion tomato mixture. Set aside.
In a separate bowl, combine rice flour and 1 tsp of salt. Mix well. Gradually add about 2 cups of boiling water to the rice flour and knead it into a smooth dough. Divide and roll the dough into equal sized portions. Gently flatten the balls using your fingers to create a base. Place the prawn filling in the center of each flattened rice dough. Carefully close the dough around the filling, ensuring all corners are sealed properly. Roll the stuffed dough balls again to ensure the contents are completely enclosed. Coat the stuffed dough with grated coconut. Steam cook the stuffed undaputtu for 15 minutes until they are cooked through.

title: Easy Gongura Mutton Curry
cooking_instructions:
To a pressure cooker add oil, along with the whole spices. Once the whole spices become fragrant, add in your mutton and let it cook until it develops some colour. Then add in the ginger garlic paste, red chili powder and the turmeric. Mix to incorporate. Once there is some slight stickage to the bottom of the pan, deglaze with water and scrape the bottom of the pressure cooker. Pressure cook for 7-8 whistles. After it finishes cooking, let the steam release naturally. To make the gongura paste, to a pan add oil and onion. Saute the onion until it becomes soft and translucent

Then add the green chillies along with salt. Once the chillies blister, add the ginger garlic paste. Once aromatic, add in the gongura (sorrel leaves) and cook until they wilt  Transfer the gongura mixture to a blender and blend to form a smooth paste. Add water as required. Add the gongura paste to the mutton and stir to incorporate. Cook until the oil separates from the gravy. Serve hot with white rice or parotta

title: Kaalan Poondu Varuval
cooking_instructions:
In a pan saute black peppercorn, coriander seeds & cumin seeds separately, once aromatic take off flame and cool. In the same pan add sauf and curry leaves, saute until the curry leaves are dry. Blend into a fine powder.
In a pan over medium high heat add cumin seeds, once spluttering add chopped garlic and saute until golden brown. Add whole garlic cloves and saute for 2 minutes. Add your mushrooms, saute until combined, cover with lid and cook. Open the lid and let the water evaporate. Add the shallots and saute until translucent.
Add the curry leaves and saute until combined. Add the masala powder and saute well. Add chilli powder, turmeric powder, garam masala, salt and saute to ensure it doesn't burn. Add water and mix to bring everything together. Garnish with coriander leaves and enjoy.

title: Lemon Bars
cooking_instructions:
To make the base, combine all the ingredients to make a crumbly dough that just comes together. When squeezed, the dough should hold its shape
Spread the dough into an even layer and bake in a preheated 180 C oven for 7-10 minutes or golden brown
To make the filling, whisk the eggs and the sugar until the color of the mixture becomes a little pale. The mixture will also slightly thicken.
Add the lemon juice to this mixture and whisk to combine.
Finally, add in the maida and fold it in with a spatula.
Strain the mixture and pour it into the baking pan with the base.
Tap the baking pan onto the table to remove and errant air bubbles.
Bake in a preheated 160 C oven for 45 minutes or until set but the center slightly wobbles.

title: No Paruppu Dhideer Sambar
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer jar, add all the ingredients for the paste, blend into a smooth paste, and set aside.
In a pressure cooker, pour oil, saute the drumsticks for 10 seconds on a high flame, and add carrot and beans, saute for 10 more seconds, and add the brinjal.
Saute for 10 seconds and add salt, turmeric, red chilli and sambar powder. Cook until aromatic and add the prepared paste. 
Saute until the raw flavour disappears and pour water. 
Pressure cook on a moderate flame for 3 whistles.
In a tadka pan pour ghee, mustard seeds, dry red chilli and curry leaves, once aromatic add the tadka to the sambar.
Garnish with finely chopped coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Amritsari Aloo Kulcha
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, add warm milk. Add the yeast and Sugar and set it aside for 10 minutes until foamy. 
In a separate bowl add the maida and salt. Add the milk mixture and slowly knead a soft dough. Rest this dough for 1 hour. 
For the stuffing in a bowl, mash the potatoes.
Now mix together the potatoes, coriander, green chili, and all the masalas and mix well. 
Roll a small portion of dough into a 4-inch thick circle. 
Place the aloo stuffing inside and then add the grated mozzarella on top of the potato stuffing and cover the stuffing by sealing the circumference of the dough. Flatten and roll using a rolling pin. 
Cook the paratha in a Tawa, sprinkle some red chili powder and kasoori methi.
Add ghee on both sides till golden brown for 5 minutes on medium flame.

title: Bengali Egg Curry
cooking_instructions:
Heat the oil in a pan and add kashmiri red chilli and coriander powder, fry the eggs for a few minutes and keep them aside. Heat the oil, temper the whole spices.
Add onion in the remaining oil and fry them with a pinch of salt. Add ginger and garlic paste and saute for a minute. Add the tomatoes followed by sugar and cook until soft. Add all the dry spices and saute for 45 seconds, add little water to stop it from burning and cover it while cooking. Mix it well and cook it well for 2 minutes.
Add the boiled potatoes, cover the pan and cook on medium heat. Add a cup of water and add the eggs to it, cover and cook it till the gravy thickens. Finish it with some ghee. Serve it hot and garnish with some chopped coriander leaves.

title: Shrimp Ceviche
cooking_instructions:
In a Bowl Add the prawn and and squeeze lemon juice until it covers the shrimp. Mix it thoroughly and ensure every prawn is coated with lemon juice. Close it and keep it in the refrigerator for 30 minutes minimum.
Cut your onions into slices and keep aside. Cut your tomatoes into slices and keep aside. Cut your green chillies and garlic finely and keep aside. Cut your coriander leaves finely and set aside.
After 30 minutes remove your prawns from the fridge, you can notice that they will have turned opaque in color just as if they have been cooked. Add all your cut vegetables into your prawns and season with salt and black pepper. Serve with nachos and enjoy.

title: Chicken Steak With White Wine Sauce
cooking_instructions:
In a Bowl Add chicken, 1 tbsp of butter, Pepper, Salt , garlic and rosemary.
Massage the meat with the marination and set aside for 60 minutes.
In a stainless steel pan over medium heat add i tbsp of butter and spread across the pan.
Add your marinated chicken and let sear for 4 minutes per side.
Flip and let cook for 4 minutes.
Add 1 tsp of butter along with a stem of rosemary and continuously baste the chicken with the hot melted butter.
Keep doing this step until the chicken is cooked throughout.
Remove the rosemary sprig.
Once cooked. Remove from heat in the same pan add 1 tbsp of garlic along with the chopped onions.
Cook until translucent.
deglaze the pan with wine.
Cook until the wine has evaporated and incorporated with the onions.
Add your cream and stir continuously.
Cook until it reaches a sauce-like consistency.
Remove from heat. 
In a stainless steel pan add 1 tsp of butter, your beans, carrot and saute for a minute.
Add 1 tbsp of water and let cook until water completely evaporates.
Add ½ tsp of salt and pepper and toss until coated.
Serve the vegetables along with the chicken and pour the sauce on your chicken and serve hot.

title: Chilli Cheese Dosa
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, pour water and add the garlic and red chillies.
Cook on a moderate flame until the garlic and chilli turn soft (around 5 minutes).
Blend the chillies and garlic into a fine paste.
Add it to the dosa batter.
Mix until thoroughly combined.
Make dosas and add processed cheese slice in the middle and cook until melted.
Serve hot along with chutney or sambar.

title: Everything Subzi
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, heat some oil and add the cumin. Add the finely chopped onion once the cumin seeds start to crackle. 
Cook the onion till translucent in color, and add the ginger garlic paste followed by the finely chopped green chili. 
Puree the tomato and add them, cook them for 3- 5 minutes on medium heat. 
Add all the spices- Red Chili Powder, Turmeric, Garam Masala, Coriander Powder, Cumin Powder, Salt, Sugar, and Kasoori methi.
Add the water and cover it for 10-12 minutes on medium- low flame until the masalas are fully cooked and the mixture has released the oil. 
Add in the carrot, capsicum, and beans and coat it evenly in the masala and cook it for another 5 minutes until everything is cooked well together. 
Garnish with coriander and serve hot.

title: Kasundi Fish Curry
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl add besan, corn flour, turmeric, Red chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala, salt, kasuri methi, kasundi paste, ginger garlic paste & mustard oil.
Mix well and add water to make a smooth paste.
Coat the fish with the marinade.
Marinate for 30 minutes.
Heat up oil over medium heat.
In a pan, heat mustard oil and add mustard seeds.
Once spluttering add onions and saute until translucent  
Add green chilli and tomatoes.
Saute until the tomatoes are soft, add the ginger garlic paste and saute until the raw smell disappears.
Add the kasundi paste and saute until the raw smell disappears.
Add water , and add the turmeric, red chilli powder, garam masala, coriander powder, kasuri methi and salt.
Bring to a boil and cook until the masalas are cooked and the raw smell disappears.
Once hot, add the marinated fish and fry on both sides until golden brown.
Add your cooked fish into this gravy and let it reach a boil.
Remove off heat, garnish with coriander leaves.
Serve with white rice and enjoy.

title: Chicken Pongal With Chilli Oil
cooking_instructions:
Dry roast the moong dal in a pan until aromatic but a colour shouldn’t develop.
Wash the rice and moong dal, drain and soak for 10-20 mins.
Add the drained rice and dal with water and salt into a pressure cooker. 
Pressure cook for 4 whistles. Allow the steam to settle naturally. 
Dry roast the whole black pepper and cumin for a minute and grind to a coarse powder.
Add all the ingredients required for the chilli oil to a heat proof bowl/vessel.
Heat a kadhai, add 2 tbsp of Ghee, add the chopped ginger, curry leaves, asafoetida, and cashews nuts. 
Once the cashews turn golden brown, add the chicken cubes, salt and saute until cooked, about 5 mins. 
Add the spice mixture and mix well. 
Once the pressure settles, open the pressure cooker, and mix well to mash. 
Add the rice mixture into the chicken, 1 tbsp of ghee and mix well. Remove from the heat. 
Heat up oil and add it to the ingredients and let it sizzle.
Mix till all ingredients combine evenly and top on the pongal while serving.

title: Junglee Paneer Sandwich
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the filling.
Spread the filling into the bread and sandwich it.

Grill the sandwich until golden brown and serve with green chutney

title: Coconut Date Frappe
cooking_instructions:
Add all the ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth
Fill a glass with ice and pour the frappe into the glass.
Garnish with desiccated coconut.

title: Maggi Pizza
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the paneer marination, mix and set aside
In a cooker, pour water and add the maggi masala and bring it to a boil.
Add the maggi masala and cook it until the noodles are cooked through and the water evaporates.
In a pan pour oil and heat it up.
Add the cooked maggi to the pan and spread it out like a pancake.
Cook on a medium flame till golden brown and till it holds shape.
Flip it carefully and turn the flame to low.
Add the pizza sauce and spread it evenly
Add the diced onions, diced capsicum and the marinated paneer.
Cover and cook till the cheese melts.
Transfer it to a cutting board, cut and serve it hot.

title: Mushroom Spinach Quesadilla
cooking_instructions:
In a pan over medium heat add 1 tsp of butter and olive oil. Once hot, add in your mushrooms and saute on high heat.
Add the garlic once the mushroom sweats completely. Add in the spinach, salt, pepper, basil and oregano and cook for 5 minutes over high heat. Saute until the spinach is cooked through and remove off heat.
Place your mixture in a bowl and add in cream cheese. Take one parotta and cut it into two equal halves. Add your mixture in one half and add cheese.
Heat a pan on medium heat and add 1 tsp of butter and place the stuffed parotta inside. Cook on one side until golden brown and then flip. Once golden brown on both sides, cut and serve.

title: Amla Pickle
cooking_instructions:
Make a light slit in all the gooseberry segments so it soaks all the flavor properly. 
In a pot, add the gooseberry to boiling water. Cover it and leave it on low flame for 15-17 minutes. Till a fork can be easily inserted and the gooseberry segments are opening up on their own.  
Drain the water and let it cool.
Separate all the segments into individual pieces and place them on a paper towel. Cover these segments using another paper towel and pat dry. 

In a pan, individually dry roast the mustard seeds and the fennel seeds for a minute each and add them in a bowl. Dry roast the fenugreek seeds in the same hot pan, toss the fenugreek just once or twice and take it out, don’t let the fenugreek turn brown or else the masala will taste bitter. Once cool, add them to a mixer grinder and grind it to a fine powder.
Heat mustard oil in a pan, add the mustard seeds and hing till they start cackling.
Add the dried gooseberry and toss it well, now add in the turmeric powder, red chili powder, salt and sugar, saute for a minute.
Add 1 tsp of the grinded masala and let it cook for another minute.
Once cool, store it in an airtight container.

title: Chicken Rayalseema
cooking_instructions:
To a pan with oil, on a medium-high flame, add your slit green chillies.  After they start to blister, add your Chicken and let it sear. Flip once a nice golden color has appeared on one side, and add the salt
Once the chicken is golden brown on all sides , reduce the flame to low and add ginger garlic paste, red chili powder and turmeric. Stir to incorporate.  Once the spices are toasted, add enough water to come halfway up the lamb. Let the Chicken simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until tender. If the water evaporates before the Chicken is tender, keep adding more bit by bit
Once the Chicken is cooked, remove the lid and allow all the water to evaporate. Garnish coriander leaves and enjoy

title: Bharwan Dum Aloo
cooking_instructions:
Wash and peel the potatoes. 
Cut the potatoes into roundel halves, and carefully scoop out the center of each potato making a hole in the middle. Make sure to keep the scooped out potatoes. 
Pressure cook the leftover scooped potatoes for two whistles.
Now add oil to a pan and shallow fry the potatoes till they cook on all sides and keep it aside. 
In a big bowl, mix together the grated paneer, boiled potatoes, coriander powder, salt, red chili powder, and kasoori methi. 
Take the paneer mixture and start stuffing it in the shallow fried potatoes.
In a kadhai, add the oil and the cumin, once the cumin starts to crackle add the ginger-garlic paste and the bayleaf. 
Paste the onion in a mixer and add it to the kadhai, cook this for 10 minutes on medium flame, till the onion starts becoming golden brown. 
Paste the tomato and add it to the kadhai and keep mixing till the tomato cooks completely. 
Add in all the spices-Crushed Black pepper, Cumin, Garam masala, Red chili powder, Salt, and coriander powder and cook it for 5 minutes. 
Add in the cashew paste and mix well, this will thicken the gravy. 
Now add in the water and wait till everything is incorporated well together, wait for the gravy to start boiling and then place the stuffed potatoes on the gravy carefully. 
Cover it and let this cook for another 10 minutes. 
Add the kasoori methi and turn off the heat. 
Garnish with coriander and serve hot.

title: Paneer Chilli Fried Rice
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl over medium high heat add oil and add the paneer.
Fry until golden brown.
Take off heat .
In a wok over medium high heat add oil, chopped onions, garlic,ginger and green chilli and saute until translucent. 
Once aromatic add water and let it reach a boil.
Add your sauces in stages and stir continuously.

Add salt, pepper and sugar and mix well.
Once boiling add cornstarch slurry and mix vigorously.
Let thicken up into sauce like consistency .
Add bell peppers, onion,spring onion whites and spring onion.
Mix until everything is well coated.
Add your cooked rice and mix until coated thoroughly.
Garnish with spring onion and enjoy :)

title: Korean Egg Sandwich
cooking_instructions: To a bowl, add the cut vegetables, eggs, salt and pepper. Mix till it combines.

Heat a flat pan/tawa, add a little oil.
Pour the egg mixture and shape it into 2 squares.
Cook it well on both sides.
Toast bread to a golden brown colour and keep it aside

Place one square of the egg on one slice of bread.
Apply mayonnaise and ketchup on top and close the sandwich.
Repeat the same for the second sandwich and serve it hot.

title: Easy Coconut Chocolate Cups
cooking_instructions:
To a blender add the digestive biscuits and blend it to a fine powder.
Transfer the biscuit powder to a bowl, add melted butter and mix till it turns to a crumbly texture.
Line a muffin mould with muffin cups, add the biscuit mixture and pres it down to form the base.
Refrigerate it for 30 minutes
Add the chopped chocolate and coconut oil in a bowl.
Place it on a double boiler and mix well till it melts and combines.
Add desiccated coconut and mix well.
Layer the cups with desiccated coconut and the molten chocolate.
Freeze it for another 10 minutes. Serve it cold.

title: Kozhi Chips
cooking_instructions:
Freeze the chicken breast for 1 hour or until the breast is frozen solid.
Take a very sharp knife and cut the chicken into thin slices.
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the chips except the chicken and mix thoroughly.
Dip the chicken in corn flour mixture, shake off the excess.
Deep fry on a high flame for 1-2 minutes or until golden brown and crispy. 
Toss the chicken in ghee, idli podi, coriander leaves and chaat masala while hot and serve.

title: Mashed Potato Fries
cooking_instructions:
In a vessel add water, potato and  salt, bring to a boil.
Once the potato is fork tender, remove it from the water and place it in a mixing bowl.
In the same bowl add corn flour,garlic parsley, salt, cheese, pepper and mash well.
Form a dough like ball and take it off the bowl and divide it into smaller portions. Add flour if needed
Dust your surface with flour and with the help of a rolling pin, roll your mixture to ½ inch thickness.
Once Rolled out, trim the edges and cut into batons (french fries).
Heat oil over medium heat, add your cut fries into the oil and fry till golden brown.
Remove the fries from the oil onto a tissue paper to remove any excess oil if anything.

title: Cookd Pallipalayam Egg Roast
cooking_instructions:
Heat water in a pot, being it to a boil. Add the eggs gently and boil them for 12 minutes, transfer them to a bowl of ice water and peel them and cut into halves. Heat a pan, add oil, add curry leaves and dry red chillies. Let it crackle. Add the onions and saute till it turns translucent
Add the Cookd Pallipalayam Masala and mix with the onions for a few seconds. Add water and mix till it combines. Add the eggs, yolk side down and let it cook on a medium flame for 1 minute and flip it over. Add coconut slices, coriander leaves and give it a mix and take it off the flame. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot with rice or parotta

title: Tomato Rice and Egg Roast
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes.
Heat a pressure cooker and add oil.
Add cumin, fennel, curry leaves, green chilli and let it crackle.
Add the chopped onions and saute till it turns light brown.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a few seconds.
Add the masala powders and mix for a few seconds.
Add the chopped tomatoes and saute till it turns soft.
Add water, salt and bring it to a boil.
Add the soaked and strained rice, give it a good mix and tightly close the cooker.
Pressure cook for 4 whistles on a medium flame and turn off the flame.
Let the steam reduce gradually.
Bring water to boil in a pot and boil eggs for 12 minutes. 
Peel the eggs and cut it into halves.
Heat a pan, add oil.
Add curry leaves and let it crackle.
Add onions and saute for a minute.
Add the masala powders, add a pinch of salt and mix well.
Add the eggs yolk side down and sear on a low flame for a minute.
Give it a toss till it is coated with the masala and take it off the flame.
Serve both side by side and enjoy.

title: Fish Vepudu
cooking_instructions: Marinate the fish with all the ingredients mentioned. Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes.

Heat a pan with oil on high flame. 
Once hot, place the fish onto the pan and press down gently.
After 2 minutes or deeply golden brown on one side, flip the sear the second side.

title: Fish Pulusu
cooking_instructions:
In a kadai, heat some oil on a medium flame. Add in your whole spices and fenugreek seeds. 
Once aromatic, add in the drumsticks, green chillies and onions. Cook until the drumsticks slightly soften.
Then add in your tomatoes along with salt and the spice powders, and saute for 1-2 minutes.
Add in water and bring it to a boil. Close with a lid and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the drumsticks have completely cooked.
Add in the tamarind water and mix to incorporate.
Lower in the fish gently and cover with a lid. Allow it to cook for 8 minutes or until the fish goes opaque.
Garnish with coriander and serve hot with a bowl of rice.

title: Fish Igguru
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, heat some oil on a medium flame. Add in your whole spices. 
Once aromatic, add the onions and the green chillies.
Cook until the onions have softened and have turned lightly brown.
Add in the spice powders along with salt and mix to incorporate.
Cook off the spices for 5 minutes, adding a little water as needed.
Once the oil separates from the onion, spread the onion masala into an even layer and place the fish on top. Sprinkle salt on top of the fish.
Close with a lid and allow it to cook for 5 minutes or until the fish goes opaque.
Flip the fish along with the onions so that the onions end up on top of the fish once flipped.

title: Fried Egg Curry
cooking_instructions:
Blend the onion, tomato, ginger and garlic into a fine paste and keep it aside.
In a hot pan, add the oil, cardamom, cumin, bayleaf and let it cook.
Add the blended paste and let it cook for 3 minutes.
Add all the dry powders and mix well.
Adjust the consistency of the gravy.
Break the eggs one by one into the gravy.
Cover the pan and let it cook for 5 minutes.
Garnish with chopped coriander leaves.

title: Veggie Noodle Salad
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add peanut butter, mayonnaise, honey, soy sauce, assorted dried herbs and minced garlic, give it a good mix.
Add the vegetables and noodles.
Mix gently to prevent the noodles from breaking.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve cold.

title: Coconut Jam Toast
cooking_instructions:
To bread, apply mixed fruit jam, close it (cut out the crusts if needed)
In another bowl, mix coconut milk, powdered sugar.
Dip the jam sandwich in the coconut milk mixture, drain off the excess milk.
Heat a tawa, add coconut oil.
Cook it on a medium flame till golden on all sides.
Coat the toasted bread in desiccated coconut.
Serve it warm.

title: Chicken Keema Paratha
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl mix together the Atta, Maida, Ajwain, Salt and Oil.
Add the water and form a dough and let it sit for 30-40 minutes.
Add tomatoes, spices (turmeric, garam masala, red chilli powder, coriander, amchur, salt)

Add the minced chicken. Cook for 5 minutes until the chicken is tender.
Turn off the heat, and let it cool completely.
Roll out the dough into 3-inch circles.
Place a portion of chicken keema filling in the centre seal, and roll into a paratha.

Cook the paratha on a skillet with a little oil or ghee. Flip a few times to ensure even cooking until both sides are browned and crisp.
Serve hot. Enjoy your Chicken Keema Paratha.

title: Butter Garlic Noodles
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl break in two eggs and add 1 tsp of soy sauce. Whisk well until well incorporated. Heat up a wok on high heat and add oil. Once heated add the eggs and mix until fully cooked.Take the cooked eggs off the wok
Add butter the garlic, and ginger. Saute until aromatic. Add the onions, capsicum, cabbage , carrot and saute well. Add the soy sauce, salt and pepper.
Add the noodles and saute well untill fully coated and yummy. Add the eggs back into the finished noodles. Saute well, garnish with spring onion and enjoy :)

title: Kosha Mangsho
cooking_instructions:
Marinate the mutton with all the ingredients mentioned. Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes and up to overnight
In a pressure cooker, heat up mustard oil until it starts smoking. Then turn the flame off and let it cool until the smoking subsides.
Once the smoke has dissipated, add in the whole spices and saute them.
Once aromatic, add in the onion and the green chili. Cook them until the onion softens and becomes slightly golden.
Follow that by adding ginger garlic paste, and the dry masala. Keep stirring to prevent any burning. 
Once the raw smell disappears, add in the marinated mutton and let it cook on a medium high flame until it releases almost all of its water. You will know this happens when a thin layer starts to form on the bottom of the cooker.
When this happens, add in the water and stir to scrape the bottom.
Once the water has come to a boil, close with the lid and cook for 5 whistles on a medium flame.
Let the pressure naturally release before opening the lid.
On a low flame, bring the mutton up to a simmer and add in the whipped curd and immediately stir. This prevents the curd from splitting.
Serve with warm ghee bath.

title: Titanic Fried Rice
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, add the oil and the chopped garlic and saute for 2 minutes.
Break the 2 eggs in the and scramble them.
Add all the vegetables to the pan and saute for 3 minutes.
Add the cooked rice to the pan and saute for 2 minutes.
Add all the spices and the soy sauce and mix them thoroughly.
Add the Chicken 65 to the rice and give it a good mix.

title: Coconut Chocolate Ladoo
cooking_instructions:
Add the heavy cream and the chocolate in a bowl. 
Put this bowl on a double boiler till the chocolate melts completely. 
Refrigerate the bowl for an hour till the ganache sets firmly. 
In a pan add the desiccated coconut and roast it for a minute. 
Don’t let the coconut brown and add the condensed milk. 
Take the pan off the heat once the condensed milk stops sticking to the bottom of the pan. 
Cool the coconut mix, and roll it out into small roundels.
Gently press the ball in the center filling it with a scoop of the chocolate ganache, cover it with the coconut mix and roll into a ladoo. 
Coat the ladoo with the remaining desiccated coconut.

title: Dynamite Spring Roll
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl combine all the ingredients for the filling and set aside.
Take the bajji chillies and scoop out the seeds and fill the mutton mixture and set aside.
Wrap the spring roll sheets around the filled bajji chillies making sure to use the slurry to seal the warp shut.
Deep dry until golden brown.
Serve hot with sweet chilli sauce.

title: Karuvadu Thokku
cooking_instructions:
Add and Pound the ginger and garlic thoroughly
Wash and soak the dried fish in hot water for at least 10 minutes.
In a pan heat oil, add the mustard seeds and let it splutter. Add the pound ginger and garlic and cook for a minute.
Add the shallots and continue to cook on a moderate flame until translucent. Add the curry leaves.
Add Red Chilli powder, Turmeric powder and Coriander powder and garam masala powder.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook until it's mushy.
Add the dried fish and cook for 2 minutes.
Add water, cover and cook for 10 minutes.
Add lemon juice, jaggery and black pepper powder.
Add coriander leaves and remove from the heat.

title: Mushroom Pepper Fry Kuzhi Paniyaram
cooking_instructions:
In a Pan over medium heat add coconut oil.
Once hot, add garlic and saute until golden brown.
Add Onions,Curry leaves and saute until onions are translucent.
Add the mushrooms and saute until all the water has evaporated.
Once evaporated add soy sauce and saute for a minute.
Add Salt and pepper, saute and take it off heat.
Heat up a Paddu/ Paniyaram pan over medium heat.
Brush oil and add 1 tbsp of the batter.
Add a tsp of the mushroom mixture and then add another layer of the batter.
Cover and let cook for a minute until bubbles are formed on the top.
Turn the paniyaram and let cook until nice golden brown.

title: Sprouts Sundal
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl soak the mung dal in the water for 8 hours.
Strain the soaked dal onto a colander.
Cover and let sit for 5 hrs or until it sprouts.
In a vessel heat up some oil and add mustard seeds.
Add the curry leaves, green chilli , turmeric  and asafoetida.
Add your sprouted dal, coconut, salt and mix well.

title: Cookd Chicken Kizhi Parotta
cooking_instructions:
Heat oil in a kadai, add curry leaves and let it crackle.
Add the chopped onions and saute till it turns translucent.
Add the chicken and mix for a minute.
Add the Cookd Madurai Chukka Masala and mix it with the chicken for 2 minutes.
Add water, bring it to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Open the pot, add coriander leaves, give it a good mix and keep it aside.
Heat up the parottas on a tawa and keep it aside.
Heat up a banana leaf and place it on a table.
Place a parotta on it and layer it with the chicken chukka and repeat the process one more time and top it off with a parotta.
Wrap the leaf tightly and tie it with a rope.
Heat up a tawa, add oil and place the wrapped banana leaf parcel on it and cook it on a medium flame. Add water to create steam and cook it well.
Flip it and cook it for a few more minutes and take it off the flame.
Open the leaf and serve it hot.

title: Rajasthani Dahi Tadka
cooking_instructions:
Heat the oil in a pan, saute onions and tomatoes for 3 minutes.
Add the whole spices and give it a good mix and add the asafoetida to it and mix.
Add the dry chilli and saute for 2 minutes.

Add salt and all the powdered spices and cook them well.
Cook everything together for 3 minutes and set it aside.
In a bowl, add the curd and whisk it well.
In the same bowl add the masala and mix it well.
Garnish with chopped coriander.

title: Aloo Chutney Sandwich
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, mix together the Mashed potatoes, onions, tomatoes with the coriander chutney.
Take both the bread slices, spread the chutney mixture on one side, add a cheese slice on the chutney and cover it with the other slice.

Heat a pan with the butter on it, melt the butter and add the sandwich. 
Cook it for 3-4 minutes on low flame on each side, till both the sides are golden brown.

title: Charred Corn Salad
cooking_instructions:
In a stainless steel pan over high heat, add your sweet corn kernels and let char.
Once charred nicely on all sides, remove from heat and set aside.
In a bowl add olive oil, chilli flakes, lime juice and honey.
Whisk well until well incorporated.

In a mixing bowl add your chopped vegetables, shredded lettuce along with your charred corn.
Add your prepared dressing on the vegetables along with salt and pepper.

title: Mediterranean Fried Rice
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, combine the olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper. Add the Lamb pieces and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the marinated Lamb pieces and cook until they are browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. 
Remove the Lamb from the skillet and set it aside.

In the same skillet, add a bit more olive oil if needed. Add the chopped red onion and sauté until it becomes translucent.
Add the diced red and yellow bell peppers and cook for 2-3 minutes until they begin to soften.
Stir in the cooked rice,salt pepper, oregano  and mix well with the vegetables.
Add Soy Sauce and mix well.
Return the cooked Lamb to the skillet and mix well.
Push the rice mixture to one side of the skillet, and eggs into the other side. Scramble the eggs until they are fully cooked.
Combine the scrambled eggs with the rice mixture and toss everything together.

Add the halved cherry tomatoes and Kalamata olives. Stir-fry for another 3-4 minutes until everything is heated through.
Sprinkle the crumbled feta cheese over the top of the fried rice.
Serve the Mediterranean fried rice hot, garnished with fresh basil leaves for a burst of flavor.

title: Microwave Chocolate Cake
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, Sieve together the Maida, Cocoa powder and baking soda. 
Whisk in the sugar, egg, oil, curd and vanilla essence. 
Lastly, add in the hot milk and slowly mix it in for about 3-4 minutes. 
Microwave this for 9 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean. 
Let the cake cool completely for another 1 hour and enjoy!

title: Chicken Cheese Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 mins.
In a biryani pot, heat oil and add bay leaf, cardamom, cloves and saute.
Add chopped ginger, garlic and saute for a minute.
Add onions and saute until translucent.
Add the coriander leaves, mint leaves and the tomatoes and cook for 2 mins.
Add the kashmiri red chili powder and garam masala.
Add the chicken pieces and saute on a moderate flame for 5 mins.
Add water, cover and cook for another 5 mins.
Add the soaked rice, milk and mix gently.
Cover the pan and cook for 12 mins.
Open the pan, add the grated cheese and cover to cook for another 3 mins or until the cheese is melted.

title: Cookd Tandoori Chicken Tikka
cooking_instructions:
Combine the tandoori tikka marinade and the cookd tandoori oil with 1/2 cup (125 g) of curd.
Add 750 g of chicken, diced onion, tomato and capsicum to the mixture and mix well till evenly combined and coated.
Refrigerate for 20-30 minutes or upto 4-6 hours for best results.
Skewer the chicken and vegetables alternatively.
Heat a pan/ grill pan, add/ brush 1 tbsp of oil and grill accordingly till cooked.
Sprinkle the Cookd Tangy Seasoning on it.
Serve it hot.

title: Cookd Malai Chicken Tikka
cooking_instructions:
Combine the Malai tikka marinade and the Cookd Tandoori oil with 4 tbsp (90 g) of curd
Add 500 g of chicken to the mixture and mix well till evenly combined and coated
Refrigerate for 20-30 minutes or upto 4-6 hours for best results 
Skewer the chicken, onion, tomato and capsicum alternately
Heat a pan/ grill pan, add/ brush 1 tsp of oil and grill accordingly till cooked.
Sprinkle the Cookd Tangy Seasoning on it.
Serve it hot.

title: Cookd Tandoori Paneer Tikka
cooking_instructions:
Combine the tandoori tikka marinade and the cookd tandoori oil with 1/2 cup (125 g) of curd.
Add 700 g of paneer, diced onion tomato and capsicum to the mixture and mix well till evenly combined and coated.
Refrigerate for 20-30 minutes or upto 4-6 hours for best results.
Skewer the paneer and vegetables alternatively.
Heat a pan/ grill pan, add/ brush 1 tbsp of oil and grill accordingly till cooked.
Sprinkle the Cookd Tangy Seasoning on it.
Serve it hot.

title: Cookd Malai Paneer Tikka
cooking_instructions:
Combine the Malai tikka marinade and Cookd Tandoori Oil with 4 tbsp (90 g) of curd.
Add 500 g of paneer to the mixture and mix well till evenly combined and coated.
Refrigerate for 20-30 minutes or upto 4-6 hours for best results.
Skewer the paneer, onion, tomato and capsicum alternately.
Heat a pan/ grill pan, add/ brush 1 tsp of oil and grill accordingly till cooked.
Sprinkle the Cookd Tangy Seasoning on it.
Serve it hot.

title: Cookd Tandoori Chicken Tikka Roll
cooking_instructions:
Combine the tandoori tikka marinade and the cookd tandoori oil with 1/2 cup (125 g) of curd
Add 750 g of chicken, diced onion, tomato and capsicum to the mixture and mix well till evenly combined and coated 
Refrigerate for 20-30 minutes or upto 4-6 hours for best results 
Skewer the chicken and vegetables alternatively.
Heat a pan/ grill pan, add/ brush 1 tbsp of oil and grill accordingly till cooked.
Sprinkle the Cookd Tangy Seasoning on it.
Heat up the parottas, cook it till golden on both sides

Transfer it to a cutting board, spread mayonnaise on it
Place a skewer of the tikka on the parotta and remove the stick.
Top it off with sliced onions and roll it tightly and cut it into 2.
Serve it hot

title: Cookd Tandoori Paneer Tikka Roll
cooking_instructions:
Combine the tandoori tikka marinade and the cookd tandoori oil with 1/2 cup (125 g) of curd
Add 700 g of paneer, diced onion, tomato and capsicum to the mixture and mix well till evenly combined and coated
Refrigerate for 20-30 minutes or upto 4-6 hours for best results 
Skewer the paneer and vegetables alternately.
Heat a pan/ grill pan, add/ brush 1 tbsp of oil and grill accordingly till cooked.
Sprinkle the Cookd Tangy Seasoning on it.
Heat up a parotta, cook it till golden on both sides.

Transfer it to a cutting board, spread mayonnaise on it.
Place a skewer of the tikka on the parotta and remove the stick.
Top it off with sliced onions and roll it tightly and cut it into 2.
Serve it hot.

title: Soya Kadai Masala
cooking_instructions:
Saute the soaked soya with the given ingredients.
For the kadai masala, dry roast the given ingredients and blend them into a fine powder.
Saute the onion in a pan with oil and let it brown and blend it with water and set it aside.
For the masala base, heat up a pan with oil and add the bay leaf, onions and tomatoes.
Add salt and saute them for 3 minutes. 
Add all the powdered spices and mix it thoroughly.
Add the onion paste and soya to the pan and mix it well.
Add the kadai masala to the pan and saute everything for 2 minutes.

title: Madurai Muttai Shakchukka
cooking_instructions:
Heat oil in a pan, add curry leaves, green chilli and let it crackle.
Add the onions and saute till it turns translucent.
Add the tomatoes and cook till it is mushy.
Add the cookd madurai chukka masala and mix for a few seconds.
Add water, mix it and bring it to a boil.
Break and add the eggs into 4 corners of the pan.
Reduce the flame to low and cover the pan and cook for 5 minutes.
Open the pan, garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Maggi Biryani
cooking_instructions:
In a Bowl wash and soak rice for 30 minutes.
In a Vessel over medium heat add oil, ghee and add the whole spices.
Once aromatic add in onions and saute until golden brown.
Once golden brown add ginger garlic paste and saute until the raw smell disappears.
Add in tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder,salt and saute well.
Add maggi masala and saute for few minutes.
Add the eggs and saute for a couple of seconds.
Add the rice and saute for 2 minutes.
Add the water and reduce the flame to the lowest temperature.
Mix once and cover and let cook for 15 minutes.
After 16 minutes bring off the heat and fluff the rice.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Cookd Malai Chicken Roll
cooking_instructions:
Combine the Malai tikka marinade and the Cookd Tandoori Oil with 4 tbsp (90 g) of curd
Add 500 g of chicken to the mixture and mix well till evenly combined and coated
Refrigerate for 20-30 minutes or upto 4-6 hours for best results 
Skewer the chicken, onion, tomato and capsicum alternately.
Heat a pan/ grill pan, add/ brush 1 tsp of oil and grill accordingly till cooked.
Sprinkle the Cookd Tangy Seasoning on it.
Heat up a parotta, cook it till golden on both sides.

Transfer it to a cutting board, spread mayonnaise on it.
Place a skewer of the tikka on the parotta and remove the stick.
Top it off with sliced onions and roll it tightly and cut it into 2.
Serve it hot.

title: Cookd Chicken Tikka Masala
cooking_instructions:
Combine the tandoori tikka marinade and the cookd tandoori oil with 1/2 cup (125 g) of curd.
Mix till combined.
Add 750 g of chicken, diced onion, tomato and capsicum to the mixture and mix well till evenly combined and coated 
Refrigerate for 20-30 minutes or upto 4-6 hours for best results 
Skewer the chicken, onion, tomato and capsicum alternately.
Heat a pan/ grill pan, add/ brush 1 tbsp of oil and grill accordingly till cooked.
Brush the tandoor oil on the tikkas and sprinkle the Cookd Tangy Seasoning on it.

Heat a pan, add the Cookd Butter Masala Gravy and saute for a minute.
Add water and bring it to a soft boil.
Add the cooked chicken tikka and mix for a minute.
Add fresh cream and kasuri methi (optional) and give it one final mix.
Serve it hot.

title: Cookd Paneer Tikka Masala
cooking_instructions:
Combine the tandoori tikka marinade and the cookd tandoori oil with 1/2 cup (125 g) of curd.
Mix till combined.
Add 700 g of paneer, diced onion, tomato and capsicum to the mixture and mix well till evenly combined and coated.
Refrigerate for 20-30 minutes or upto 4-6 hours for best results.

Skewer the paneer, onion, tomato and capsicum alternately.
Heat a pan/ grill pan, add/ brush 1 tbsp of oil and grill accordingly till cooked.
Heat a pan, add the Cookd Butter Masala Gravy and saute for a minute.
Add water and bring it to a soft boil.
Add the cooked paneer tikka and mix for a minute.
Add fresh cream and kasuri methi (optional) and give it one final mix.
Serve it hot.

title: Dan Dan Noodles
cooking_instructions:
Mix all the ingredients required for the sauce (except for the hot water) together.
Bring a pot of water to a boil.
Once boiling, blanch the bok choy for 30 seconds and immediately place in a bowl of cold water.
In the same boiling water, cook your noodles as per package instructions.
Take 2 tbsp of the boiling water and add to the sauce. Whisk to incorporate thoroughly.
To plate, pour the sauce in the bottom of the bowl. Place the cooked noodles on top. 
Garnish with spring onions, crushed black pepper and a spoon of chilli oil.
To eat, use a fork or chopsticks and incorporate the sauce with the noodles.

title: Kai Kari Mandi
cooking_instructions:
Add tamarind to a bowl and add water. Let it soak for 10 minutes and then dissolve it.
To a bowl of rice, add water and wash it, let is soak and reserve the water.
Heat oil in  a pan, add mustard, urad dal, curry leaves, green chilli and let it crackle.
Add the shallots and saute till it turns translucent.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute.
Add the drumstick, potato and saute it for 2 minutes.
Add turmeric powder and mix it well for a few seconds.
Add the tomato and cook it for a minute.
Add salt and mix well.
Add water and rice water, mix it well. 
Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Open the pot, add the tamarind pulp, brinjal and mix it well.
Cover and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the coconut paste, simmer it to a soft boil and turn off the flame.
Garnish it with chopped coriander. Serve it hot.

title: Diwali Marundhu
cooking_instructions:
Dry roast every ingredient separately in a pan.
Using a mortar and pestle, mash the dried ginger and dried galangal.
Blend all the dry roasted ingredients other than ginger and galangal and after a few pulses, add the ginger and galangal to the blender and make it into a powder.
Melt the jaggery with water and add it to the powder and give it a good mix.
Cook it on low heat and let it come to a paste consistency.
Add the ghee and oil to the paste and let it cook for 2-3 minutes.
Take it out of the heat and let it cool down before adding the honey to it and give it a good mix.
Shape it into small spheres

title: Til Ke Ladoo
cooking_instructions:
In a pan Dry roast the sesame seed on low flame for 2-3 minutes. 
In the same pan dry roast the peanuts till they become slightly brown
Lastly, dry roast the Grated Coconut on low flame till it turns slightly golden. 
In a mixer-grinder, mix together the roasted sesame seeds, peanuts, coconut, and jaggery. 
Pulse blend these ingredients together, 3-4 times for a duration of 5-7 seconds. 
Transfer it to a plate and add in the ghee and cardamom powder. 
Apply a little bit of ghee/oil on your hands and shape into bite sized roundels.

title: Cookd Malai Paneer Tikka Roll
cooking_instructions:
Combine the Malai tikka marinade and the Cookd Tandoori Oil with 4 tbsp (90 g) of curd.
Add 500 g of paneer to the mixture and mix well till evenly combined and coated.
Refrigerate for 20-30 minutes or upto 4-6 hours for best results.
Skewer the paneer, onion, tomato and capsicum alternately.
Heat a pan/ grill pan, add/ brush 1 tsp of oil and grill accordingly till cooked.
Sprinkle the Cookd Tangy Seasoning on it.
Heat up a parotta, cook it till golden on both sides.
Transfer it to a cutting board, spread mayonnaise on it. Place a skewer of the tikka on the parotta and remove the stick. Top it off with sliced onions and roll it tightly and cut it into 2. Serve it hot.

title: Neer Dosa
cooking_instructions: Wash the rice and soak for at least 3 hours.
Grind the rice along with coconut, salt and ½ cup of water into a fine paste.
Add the batter into a bowl and add the remaining water. Whisk until smooth. The batter should resemble the consistency of milk.
Heat a non-stick Tawa. Add a ladle of the batter and swirl the pan.
Cook on medium flame for 40 seconds.
Fold into quarters and set aside. Serve with any gravy or chutney.

title: Sugar Free Kaju Barfi
cooking_instructions:
Add the water, along with the stevia and honey and bring it to a boil.
Once its boiling, add the cardamom.
Let it simmer for 6-7 minutes or until slightly thickened.
Add the cashew powder to the sugar syrup and mix to combine on a low heat.
Once combined into a dough, add in the hot ghee and mix to combine.
The dough is ready when it doesn't stick to the side of the kadai.
Place the dough in a lined baking tray and spread out into an even layer.
Press the top of the dough to form a flat and even surface.
Let the kaju barfi cool completely. 
Once cooled, cut the barfi into diamonds and serve.

title: Erachi Soru
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl, add all the ingredients.
Add all the ingredients for the mutton marination
Let it sit for 1 hour, add the marinated mutton into a pressure cooker along with water and cook on a moderate flame for 9 whistles and let it rest for 10 minutes. 
In a deep pan, pour ghee and add the soaked and sliced rice and drained rice and saute for 1 minute on a high flame until lightly toasted.
Add the cooked mutton to the rice and mix gently making sure the mutton pieces don’t break.
Cover and cook on a simmer for 12 minutes and let it rest for 10 more minutes.
Finish with ghee and serve hot.

title: Fig and Coconut Burfi
cooking_instructions:
Soak the figs in water for 20 minutes
Grind it to a coarse paste
Heat a pan, add ghee to it.
Add the ground fig and mix till 
Add the grated coconut and saute till it is rid of the raw aroma
Add cardamom powder and mix
Add 1 tbsp ghee and mix well

Transfer it to a greased tray and spread it out evenly from end to end
Let it cool down and set at room temperature for 6 hours
Demould it, cut and serve

title: Paneer Cigar Rolls
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, add the grated paneer, onion, green chilies, salt, pepper, red chilli powder, cumin powder, and coriander. Mix well.

Take a few bread slices and cut off the edges. 
Flatten out each slice using a rolling pin. 
Add the paneer filling on one side of the bread slice and tightly roll it. 
Brush a little bit of cornflour slurry on the edges to stick the bread together.
In a pan, heat up some oil and carefully add the cigars and fry them until crispy and golden brown on all sides.

title: Cookd Classic Fried Chicken Sando
cooking_instructions:
Cut the chicken breast in two to get thinner slices. 
Take out the Cookd Fried Chicken Kit. 
Add the Secret Marinade Blend to the chicken. Mix well till the meat is coated evenly with the marinade.
Prepare a batter using 5 tbsp of the Ultra Crispy Fry Mix and 150ml of water. 
Coat it evenly with the dry Ultra Crispy Fry Mix first. 
Dip it in the batter and coat it throughout.
Coat it with the Ultra Crispy Fry Mix again and dust it in a downward motion to form the crust (crinkles).
Deep fry it in medium hot oil at first for 2 minutes and then increase the flame and let it fry till it turns golden brown and crispy.
In a pan, add the mushrooms and dry saute them for 5-7 minutes. 
Now add the onions and continue sauteing for another 10 minutes. 
The onions will start to become brown in color, keep adding 1 tbsp of water if it starts sticking to the bottom of the pan. 
Cook it till the onions and mushrooms are caramelized fully. 
In a bowl add purple cabbage, vinegar, water, salt and sugar and keep it aside for 15 minutes. 
Take 2 slices of bread, apply mustard on one side and mayonnaise on the other, and spread well. 
Take one of the slices and spread a layer of the caramelized onions, add the fried chicken, grated cheese and the pickled red cabbage. 
Add the second slice and toast it on a pan with butter on the sides, till both the sides are golden and crispy.

title: Rajma Tikki
cooking_instructions:
In a pan dry roast the peanuts till they become golden brown and set aside. 
In the same pan, add oil and onions and saute them till they become translucent in color. 
Add in the green chilli and cook it for 5 minutes on medium flame. 
Add the Besan and cook everything together for another 3-4 minutes on medium flame. 
Add in the Rajma, mashed potato and mash this mixture until everything comes together. 
Add in all the spices- red chili powder, amchur powder, white pepper powder, and salt. Mix well till combined.
Add the peanuts and the coriander mix well and take it off the flame.
Add black salt and bread crumbs and mix till combined.
Divide and and shape them into 3 inch roundels.
Add 2 tbsp of oil on the pan and fry the tikki for 2-3 minutes till golden brown on both sides.

title: Desi Nachos
cooking_instructions:
In a pressure cooker add your soaked kidney beans , 1 tsp of salt and pressure cook for 6 whistles or until soft.
In a bowl add your cut vegetables , cooked beans, salt cumin powder, chaat masala and red chilli powder.
Mix well.
Cut the masala papad into 8 equal Nacho sized triangles.
Using a tong, place the cut papad on the flame, flipping continuously until fully cooked.
You can also place the papad on a pan over high heat and let cook on each side, flipping continuously .
Serve the papad nachos with your desi salad, garnishing with a wedge of lemon.
Enjoy :)

title: Cookd Andhra Chicken 65
cooking_instructions:
Mix the Madras 65 masala with water to form a thick paste.
Add the chicken to it and mix well till it is coated with the masala.
Heat oil in a kadai and fry the chicken for 5-7 minutes (small pieces) till it becomes crispy and is cooked throughout.
Heat a pan, add oil.
Add chopped ginger and garlic.
Add curry leaves, green chilli and saute for a few seconds.
Add tomato ketchup, soy sauce and mix well.
Finally, add the beaten curd, mix till it combines.
Add the fried chicken 65, toss till it is coated well with the sauce.
Serve it hot.

title: Air Fried Aloo Samosa
cooking_instructions:
To prepare the dough, in a mixing bowl add the maida, salt, sugar, ajwain seeds and oil.
Mix till the mixture becomes crumbly
Add water and mix well till a dough is formed
Knead well till the dough is smooth and soft
Rest it for 10 minutes
Heat a pan, add oil, cumin and green chilli and let it crackle.
Add the onions and saute till it is translucent.
Add the mashed potatoes and saute on a high flame.
Add the masala powders and cook till the raw aroma is gone.
Cook till the mixture is dry.
Take it off the flame and cool it down.
Divide the dough, roll it into a thin sheet, trim off the edges and cut it into 3 even sized triangles.
Fold it and shape it like a cone, add the potato filling. 
Apply water on the loose end and fold it and seal the corners.
Apply oil in the airfryer pan and place the samosas on it.
Brush oil on the samosas.
Air fry it at 200 degrees for 18-20 minutes.
Serve it hot along with a dip.

title: Foxnut Ladoo
cooking_instructions:
Grind the Roasted Chana dal, foxnuts and dates separately. . 
Mix together the cashews, almonds, and walnuts and grind them together and keep it aside. 
Now take a wok and heat a little bit of ghee, mix the whole wheat flour and keep stirring it for 7-10 minutes on low heat, until you can smell the flour, and it's browned a little in color. 
To this add the powdered roasted chana and continue cooking it for another 4-5 minutes until everything is properly incorporated together. 
Finally add in all the dry nuts and powdered fox nuts and continue cooking it for 2-3 minutes on low heat 
Remove it from the heat and spread the mixture on a plate and let it cool for 10 minutes. 
Once cooled, add the powdered sugar, dates paste and the cardamom powder
Mix well and tightly bind it together in your hand for the mixture to come together. 
Shape the ladoos into small circles.

title: Weight Loss Biryani
cooking_instructions:
In a deep pan, pour ghee and all the whole garam masalas, once they turn aromatic, add the sliced onions.
Saute on a moderately high flame until the onion turns golden brown (around 6 minutes).
Add ginger garlic paste, mint and coriander leaves and saute for 2 minutes or until the raw flavour disappears.
Add the sliced tomato, salt and all the powdered spices.
Cook the mixture until the tomato turns mushy (around 4 minutes).
Add the whisked curd, and thoroughly mix, add the chicken and saute on a moderate-high flame for 3 minutes.
Pour water and bring to a boil, add the soaked basmati rice and bring it back to a boil.
Cover and cook on a simmer for 12 minutes.
Let the biryani rest for 10 more minutes and break the dum.
Serve hot with raita.

title: Spicy Paneer Gujiya
cooking_instructions:
Add the ghee to the maida and mix it well.
Add the Ajwain and water and make it into a soft dough.
Let the dough rest for 15 minutes.
In a pan, add oil and chilli oil and Corn, Green peas and paneer to it and give it a good mix.
Let it cook for 5 minutes and let it cool.
Roll the dough into small discs and fill the paneer filling and close it.
Adding the mozzarella is optional. 
Air fry the gujiyas for 25 minutes at 165°C

title: Cinnamon Sugar Muffins
cooking_instructions:
In a large bowl, whisk together the dry ingredients. 
Set this aside.
In a small bowl, beat one egg, and then add milk, vanilla extract, and melted butter. 
Mix until well combined.
Add the wet mixture to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Avoid overmixing.
Spoon the muffin batter into the prepared cups, filling them about halfway to three-quarters full.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes at 180 degrees celsius. Allow the muffins to cool in the pan for 5 minutes before removing them.
For the topping, mix cinnamon and sugar in a small bowl.
In another small bowl, melt butter.
Roll the warm muffins in the melted butter and coat them with the cinnamon-sugar mixture.

title: Makhani Rice Bowl
cooking_instructions:
Add the Cookd Butter Masala gravy in a pan and saute.
Add all the vegetables and paneer, give it a good mix and adjust the consistency with water.
Add the Kasuri Methi and mix it thoroughly.
For the herbed rice, Add butter into a hot pan and add the chopped garlic to it.
Saute for 1 minute, add the rice and give it a good mix.
Add all the dried herbs and chopped coriander leafs mix it thoroughly.

title: Ragi Pakoda
cooking_instructions:
To a bowl add the ragi flour, Roasted Gram powder, Red Chilli powder, moringa leaves, salt, Cumin seeds and water and mix it into a thick batter.
Heat oil in a kadai.
Take little parts of the batter with your hands and drop them in to the oil.
Deep fry them for 3-4 minutes on a medium flame .
Transfer it to a plate lined with tissue.
Garnish it with some fried curry leaves and serve it hot.

title: Murg Mumtaz
cooking_instructions:
In a pan dry, roast the masala ingredients on a low flame until golden brown and aromatic.
Blend it into a fine powder.
In a mixing bowl, add chicken, curd, ginger garlic and the prepared masala, mix thoroughly and let it marinate for 1 hour.
In a pan, pour water, add all the ingredients for the paste, and let it cook on a moderate flame for 10 minutes.
Blend into a smooth paste and set aside.
In a pan pour ghee and add the whole garam masalas and the marinated chicken along with salt, cook for 2-3 minutes on a high flame.
Add the ground paste.
Cook for 10 minutes on a moderate flame and finish the gravy with kasoori methi, green chillies and coriander leaves.

title: Masala Bhaingan Fry
cooking_instructions:
Cut the eggplant into slices and keep it aside.
In a bowl, make the marination with all the dry spices and oil, mix them well.
Take a bowl, add the ingredients for the coating and give them a through mix.
Spread the marination on the sliced eggplant on both sides.
Coat the marinated eggplant with the rava mixture well.
In a pan, add oil and let it heat up in medium flame.
Add the well coated eggplant to the pan and cook for 3 minutes on each side.

title: Mutton Thanni Kozhambu
cooking_instructions:
To a pressure cooker on medium flame, add the ghee along with the whole spices.
Once fragrant add the onions and cook until they turn lightly brown.
Add in the tomatoes and cook until they become mushy and turn into a chunky paste.
Add in the salt, crushed black pepper and ginger garlic paste and mix to combine.
Once aromatic and the paste starts to lightly stick to the bottom, add in the mutton.
Cook the mutton until almost all of its water evaporates.
Add the water and bay leaf and bring it to a boil.
Close the lid and let it pressure cook for 6 whistles on a medium heat.
Once finished, let the pressure release naturally.
Garnish with coriander and mint.

title: Hangover Wrap
cooking_instructions:
To make the salsa, toss all the ingredients together and keep in the fridge to marinate 
Preheat a non stick pan on medium heat and add a little oil. Once hot, add in your bacon strips and cook until they turn deeply golden brown on one side. 
Flip and repeat on the other side. Once you’re done cooking the bacon, do not discard the pan or the fat in the pan.
To make the scrambled eggs, crack your eggs into a bowl, add salt and whisk until homogenous. 
Add them to the same pan that the bacon was cooked in. The pan should be on a low heat
Gently mix with a wooden spatula just as the curds set.
Once all the eggs are cooked, remove them from the pan.
To make the roti, cook it on a dry tawa over medium heat until lightly charred and puffed.
To assemble the wrap, lay your roti down as the base. Spoon on a hefty amount of scrambled eggs, followed by the paneer, and the chicken bacon. To top it off, add your mozzarella, feta and salsa. 
Close the wrap by rolling it and secure it in aluminum foil.

title: Easy Mutton Soup
cooking_instructions:
Dry roast and grind peppercorns and jeera into a powder and keep aside.
Crush the ginger and garlic in a pestle and mortar.
In a pressure cooker, add gingelly oil and finely chopped shallots and saute for 2 minutes on medium heat.
Add the crushed ginger and garlic it to the pressure cooker, cook until raw smell goes.
Add the chopped tomato and cook for another 30 seconds.
Now add the washed and cleaned Paya to the cooker.
Add turmeric powder, salt and ground powder, cook for a further 5 minutes.
Add 750 ml of water and pressure cook for 10 whistles or 20 minutes.
Open the pan, add pepper powder, garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Chemmeen Choru
cooking_instructions:
Marinate the prawns in red chilli powder, turmeric powder, crushed black pepper, salt and lemon juice. Let it marinate for 30 minutes
Heat the coconut oil on a medium heat. Once hot, add in the curry leaves, urad dal and mustard seeds.
Once they splatter, and the urad dal turns golden, add the garlic, ginger, dry red chilli.
Once aromatic, add in your prawns and cook for 2 minutes or when the prawns turn opaque .
Add in the cooked rice and toss to coat thoroughly. 
Garnish with coriander leaves.

title: Ulta Vada Pav
cooking_instructions:
Add all the ingredients for the batter in a mixing bowl and whisk until it's smooth.  
Let the batter sit for at least 30 minutes.
Add all the ingredients for chilli garlic paste and grind it into a fine paste.
In a tadka pan pour oil and add all the ingredients for the tadka, once aromatic add the Prepared Green Chilli Paste and the potatoes, Mash thoroughly and give it a good mix. 
Set it aside to cool.
Heat up oil over medium heat. Once hot, drip the batter into the oil and fry until golden brown. Strain over tissue to remove excess oil. This is your Churra.
Deep fry your whole garlic cloves for 2 minutes until light color appears, Strain onto a tissue paper.
Add 1 Cup of your prepared Churra, Fried garlic, salt and Red chilli powder.
Pulse it into a coarse Powder.
Cut the Pav in half and apply 1 tsp chutney powder to each portion of the cut pav.
Take a big spoon of the potato mixture prepared and place it on top of the chutney powder-ed pav, press it slightly to ensure its intact.
Dip it into the batter and deep fry it until golden brown on all sides.
Cut it in half and serve it with fried green chilli as garnish. 
Enjoy hot.

title: Chilli Lamb Noodles
cooking_instructions:
Mix all the ingredients required for the sauce together in a bowl
Marinate the mutton with all the ingredients required. Let it marinate for 30 minutes
Preheat a pan on medium flame.
Add the oil in and place the mutton strips in the pan individually.
After 2 minutes or one side has turned deeply golden brown or crisp, flip the mutton and repeat on the other side.
Once both sides are crispy, remove from the pan.
In the same pan, add a little more oil and cook the onions.
Ensure to scrape off the golden bits from the bottom of the pan.
Once the onions have soften and turned lightly brown, add in the garlic and cook for another 1 minute or until aromatic.
Add in the sauce along with the mutton and allow the sauce to cook until the raw flavour disappears, or about 8 minutes. Add water as needed.
Add in the cooked noodles and toss to coat with the sauce.
Garnish with chopped coriander.

title: Leo Chocolate Coffee
cooking_instructions:
In a saucepan pour milk, instant coffee powder, and sugar and bring it to a boil.
Add chopped dark chocolate and mix until melted thoroughly! 
Turn off the heat and add the vanilla essence 
Serve hot with whipped cream.

title: No Bake Garlic Bread
cooking_instructions:
Start by taking some warm water, add the sugar and the yeast and set aside for 10 minutes. This allows the yeast to bloom. 
In the meantime, in a bowl add the maida, milk powder, salt, oregano seasoning, chili flakes, garlic, and olive oil and mix well. 
Make a well in the center and add the yeast mixture in the middle. Start adding a little bit of flour into the wet mixture. Continue doing this until all the flour is mixed in, and a shaggy dough is formed. 
Knead well until a smooth dough forms.
Brush a little more olive oil on the smooth dough, cover with a damp cloth and allow it to rise for 1 and a half to 2 hours. 
In the meantime, in a bowl add the softened butter, oregano, chili flakes and garlic. Mix it well and set aside. This is garlic butter for our bread.  
After resting the dough for 2 hours, it would’ve doubled in size. 
Lightly knead the risen dough again. Divide into 4 portions.
Sprinkle the sooji rava on the base and continue to roll each portion of the dough out into a 2 cm thick disc. 
Spread some garlic butter on one side of the dough.
Fill with shredded cheese, bell peppers, jalapenos, onions, and corn. Add a little more shredded cheese and fold in half to form a semi-circle shape.
Brush the top generously with garlic butter and sprinkle mixed herbs. Cut the bread gently into 2-inch thick slices, without cutting all the way to the bottom.
Place butter paper at the bottom of the cooker. Gently place the garlic bread into the pressure cooker. 
Keep a flat surfaced pan or a tawa on medium heat and leave it for 5 minutes. Place the pressure cooker on the pan and reduce the heat to the lowest setting. Make sure you don't add the whistle to the cooker.
Leave the cooker for 30-40 minutes on low flame, once cooked remove it from the cooker.

title: Ice Cream Sandesh
cooking_instructions:
Bring the milk to  a boil.
Pour the vinegar mixture into the boiled milk and let it curdle.
Remove the chenna and wash it so that the vinegar taste is gone.
In a blender, add the chenna, powdered sugar, milk powder and the rose essence and milk to adjust it into a pouring consistency.
Layer your tin with foil paper.
Pour the batter on the plate and steam it for 20 minutes.
Let it cool before keeping it in the freezer for 2 hours.

title: Achari Aloo
cooking_instructions:
Add all the ingredients for the mixture to the curd and whisk thoroughly.
In a hot pan, add oil and all the spices and let it cook for 30 seconds or until aromatic.
Add the potatoes, asafoetida and salt to the pan, and let it cook for 5 minutes.
Lower the flame to a simmer and add the curd mixture into the pan and mix it well.
Add coriander leaves and red chilli powder and mix thoroughly until combined.
Cover and let the potatoes cook for 5 minutes on a medium flame or until the gravy thickens.

title: Cookd Chettinad Chicken Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
