Heat a deep pot, add oil
Add cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, bay leaf and let it crackle
Add the onions and start sauteeing it
Add curry leaves, green chillies and saute till the onions turns golden brown
Add chopped coriander and mint leaves and saute for a few seconds
Add the tomatoes and cook till it turns soft
Add the chicken and the cookd chettinad masala and mix for 2 minutes
Add curd and give it a good mix.
Add water, bring it to a boil. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Open the pot, add the soaked and strained rice.
Cook till the rice and water are level.
Cover the pot with a fitting lid.
Keep it on a preheated tawa for 15 minutes on a low flame.
Turn off the flame after 15 minutes and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Open the pot, add ghee, fluff the biryani and serve it hot.

title: Pulled Chicken Chukka Burger
cooking_instructions:
To a pan with a little oil, add your curry leaves,
Once they've crisped up, add in your onions and cook until they soften and turn lightly golden.
Then add in the chicken and stir.
Add in your Cookd Madurai Chukka Masala and mix to combine thoroughly.
Add in the water and allow it to come to a simmer.
Close with a lid and let it cook for 10 minutes.
Once the chicken is cooked, shred it using two forks.
Slice your buns in half and toast with butter until they’re golden brown.
Spread a layer of mayonnaise on the bottom bun, followed by a generous pile of the meat filling.
Top that with shredded cabbage and close with the top half of the bun

title: Onion 65 Pakoda
cooking_instructions:
Add 1 sachet of the madras 65 masala to a bowl and add 100 ml water. 
Add in the cornflour and mix it well till it becomes a paste without any lumps.
Add the onion and mix well till it is evenly coated with the masala. 
Heat oil in a kadai and fry the Onion for 5 minutes till it becomes crispy and is cooked throughout.
Finally, fry a sprig of curry leaves. 
Drain off the excess oil and sprinkle chaat masala, serve it hot with lemon.

title: Cookd Desi Ratatouille
cooking_instructions:
Slice all of the vegetables to a thickness of a ¼ of an inch.
To make the sauce, add the Cookd Butter Masala Gravy paste to a pan and let it cook on a medium heat for 1 minute before adding the water. 
Once the sauce has slightly thickened, add the butter and the cream while stirring.
To make the vinaigrette, add olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, salt and black pepper to a bowl and whisk
To arrange the Ratatouille, apply the sauce to the base of the pan and spread into an even layer.
Shingle all the vegetables one by one, alternating between each vegetable and place into the pan.
Once the pan is filled, sprinkle salt over the vegetables along with the vinaigrette.
Bake the Ratatouille in a preheated 180C oven for 40 minutes.

title: Cookd Aloo 65
cooking_instructions:
Pour water and add potato to a pressure cooker and cook it for 5 whistles on a high flame or until fork tender.
Let the pressure release and peel the potatoes.
Let the potatoes rest in the refrigerator for 1 hour.
In a mixing bowl add the Madras 65 masala, pour water and whisk into a smooth thick batter.
Add the cooled potatoes to the batter and mix gently.
Deep fry until deep red and crispy.

title: Cookd Paneer Changezi
cooking_instructions:
In a Pan over medium heat, add mustard oil and cumin seeds.
Once crackling add cardamom, cloves, bay leaves and saute until aromatic.

Add onion, garlic and ginger and cook till translucent.
Add tomatoes and saute until cooked throughout.
Add green chilli and saute for 2 minutes. Add turmeric, Red chilli powder, coriander powder, salt and saute.
Add water to ensure it doesn't burn. Add the Cookd Butter Masala to the mixture and mix thoroughly4.
Add the paneer and stir for 2 minutes until the gravy starts to thicken.
Add chaat masala and saute one last time. Serve hot with naan/chapati/rice and enjoy

title: Cookd Dindigul Soya Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Soak your Soya chunks in hot water for 10 to 15 minutes until doubled in size.
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes.
In a pressure cooker, add the cookd dindigul biryani paste and saute for 1 minute, or until aromatic.
Add the soya chunks and saute for a minute. Let the paste come to a boil.
Add in your soaked and drained rice, and stir for a minute.
Add your water to the cooker and stir once before putting the lid on.
Allow it to cook for 2 whistles on a medium flame.
Let the pressure be released naturally before opening the lid.
Add the seasoning oil and fluff the rice.
Serve hot and enjoy.

title: Paneer Burji Sandwich
cooking_instructions:
In a Pan over medium heat, add Coconut oil, add coconut chunks and mix for a few seconds.
Add in your onions and saute until Golden brown.
Add curry leaves and saute until aromatic.
Add paneer and crush it down into the onions.
Add the Cookd pallipalayam masala and mix well.
Add water to ensure it doesn't burn and the masala is incorporated completely.
Take off heat once the water has evaporated.

In another pan over medium heat, melt your butter and add your bread slices.
Toast your bread until golden brown on both sides.
Assemble your sandwich by placing bread slices and adding your sliced onions.
Add your prepared burji, top it off with some chopped coriander and close the sandwich.
Dish up and enjoy this easy to make sandwich

title: Healthy Carrot Sandwich
cooking_instructions:
In a pan over medium heat, heat up some oil, once hot add mustard seeds and urad dal.
Once spluttering add the green chilli and hing, saute until aromatic.
Add turmeric powder and carrots and saute well.
Add grated coconut and season.
Mix well and remove from heat, this is your filling.
Toast your bread with butter until golden brown on both sides.
Place your toasted slices on a cutting board and add around 2 tbsp of your filling.
Close the bread and enjoy this super easy sandwich.

title: Korean Chicken Lollipop
cooking_instructions:
Add All the ingredients For Coating and Mix well until well combined.
Add the Chicken lollipop.
Mix well and marinate for 30 mins.
Heat up Oil over medium heat, one hot,Deep fry the marinated chicken until golden brown.
Add all the ingredients for sauce in a bowl and mix well until combined evenly
In a wok/pan Over medium heat add oil,Garlic , ginger and red chilli flakes.
Saute until Aromatic.
Add your Prepared Sauce and saute until thick. 
Add your Fried chicken and saute until coated thoroughly. 
Add the green onions and mix once.
Serve hot and enjoy.

title: Muttai Thakkali
cooking_instructions:
Heat a kadai, add oil
Add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, green chillies, curry leaves and let it crackle
Add chopped onions and saute till it turns translucent.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a few seconds
Add the chopped tomatoes, mix and cook till the tomatoes turn soft and mushy
Add the masala powders and mix for a minute.
Add water and mix till it combines. Bring it to a boil
Add the eggs, salt and black pepper powder.
Gently start scrambling it till it combines with the rest of the mixture.
Add chopped coriander leaves, give it one final mix and take it off the flame.

title: Chinese Pepper Chicken Soup
cooking_instructions:
Heat a pan/wok, add oil.
Add ginger, garlic and saute for a few seconds.
Add the onions and saute till it turns translucent.
Add the carrots and chicken cubes and saute for a minute.
Add water and bring it to a boil.
Season the soup and mix it well.
Add cornflour slurry and mix well till the mixture thickens.
Add chopped coriander leaves, give it one final mix and take it off the flame.
Serve it hot.

title: Daangar Pachadi
cooking_instructions:
In a pan pour in sesame oil and add the urad dal, peppercorn, red chilli and sesame seeds
Saute until the urad dal turns golden brown and set aside to cool
Grind the cooled mixture into a fine powder
Add the powder to a bowl and add the curd mix until thoroughly combined
For the tempering pour the sesame oil add the mustard seeds and let it crackle, then add urad dal, curry leaves, cumin seeds and asafoetida
Pour the tempering into the curd mixture and combine
Chill and serve

title: Lamb  Burger
cooking_instructions:
In a Bowl Add 2 tbsp of mayonnaise and ½ tbsp of mustard and mix well.
In a Pan over medium low heat, add 1 tbsp Olive oil and 1 tbsp of butter, once melted add Onions, garlic and saute until translucent.
Once cooked, keep aside to cool.
In a large bowl add Lamb mince, sauteed onion mixture, rosemary, salt and pepper.
Mix well and set aside to marinate for 30 minutes.
Make rough ball-shaped patties.
On a Stainless Steel pan add 1 tsp of butter and let melt.
Toast your bread until light Golden Brown and set aside.
To the same pan over medium heat add 1 tsp of olive oil and add your patty.
Let sear for 5 minutes and flip.
With the help of a ladle press down until the size of your burger, you can even use two ladles to press down better.
Flip and Add your cheese Slice on your burger and Add water to the edges of your pan.
Cover and cook until your cheese is melted. (Let cook for 3 minute )
Assemble the burger by adding your sauce to both the sides of the bun.
On the Lowder Side add your Patty close it.
Serve hot with fries and enjoy.

title: Hot Garlic Paneer Bites
cooking_instructions:
Deseed and boil the chillies. Strain it, blend it to a fine paste and keep it aside.
Mix the paneer with the maida, cornflour, salt, pepper, msg and little water and mix it till it is coated evenly.
Heat oil in a kadai, deep fry till it becomes crispy and keep it aside.
In another pan, heat oil, add chopped garlic, chilli paste and mix it till oil separates from it.
Add tomato ketchup and a little water. Bring it to a boil.
Add salt, pepper and mix it well till it starts to thicken.
Add the fried paneer, toss it till it is coated evenly with the sauce.
Serve it hot immediately.

title: Mushroom Pepper Rice
cooking_instructions:
In a pan pour oil and add fennel seeds and dry red chillies.
Once fragrant add onions and saute on a moderate flame until translucent. (around 1 minute)
Add ginger garlic paste, mushroom and all the powdered spices except salt.
Cook on a high flame for 3-4 minutes or until all the water evaporates.
Add masalas and then salt, black pepper, curry leaves and the cooked basmati rice. 
Toss gently and serve hot.

title: Chettinad Chicken Wrap
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, add oil and saute the onion till translucent.
Add the curry leaves and give it a mix.
Add the chicken, and saute it for 2 minutes.
Add the Cookd Chettinad Masala and saute it thoroughly.
Add water to adjust the consistency.
Add the beaten eggs to a pan, place the parotta on top, and let it cook.
Make the chettinad mayonnaise by mixing Cookd chettinad masala and mayonnaise.
And to make the wrap, spread the mayonnaise onto the wrap and add the chettinad mayonnaise.
Add the Chettinad chicken, add the pickled onions, and wrap it up.

title: Thuthuvalai Rasam
cooking_instructions:
Dry roast the whole spices on a low flame. Blend to make a powder
To a preheated pan, add oil along with shallots, garlic and ginger. Cook until the shallots soften and the mixture becomes aromatic, around 6 minutes on a moderate flame.
Add curry leaves and let them splatter. 
Add the Thuthuvalai leaves and saute them until they wilt.
Blend the mixture into a smooth paste along with the previously made powder.
Mix the paste with the tamarind water.
Add the salt and turmeric powder and mix to combine.
In a kadai, add ghee along with hing.
Once hot, add cumin seeds and mustard seeds. Let them splatter.
Right at the end, add your torn  dry red chillies. 
Once the tempering is aromatic and toasted, pour in your paste and tamarind water mixture.
Bring the entire mixture to one boil and immediately turn it off.
Serve it with a bowl of hot steamed rice.

title: Brinjal Podi Fry
cooking_instructions:
Blend all the ingredients mentioned for the podi until slightly coarse.
Make a slit lengthwise on the eggplant.
Stuff the podi into the slit 
In a pan on high heat, add some oil.
Once shimmering, add in the eggplant and cook until it just begins to soften.
Lower the flame to a medium heat and add water.
Cover the pan and let it cook for 10 minutes.
Once the eggplants have cooked, add the podi and toss to coat the eggplant in it.
Garnish with coriander.

title: Best Ever Chilli Oil
cooking_instructions:
Deseed and blend the dry red chillies to a coarse texture
Finely chop the ginger, garlic, spring onion greens and whites.
Transfer it all to a bowl, add soy sauce, msg and sesame seeds.
Heat up oil (not too hot) and add it to the remaining ingredients and lit it sizzle and mix it well.
Let it cool down, transfer it to an airtight container and store it in the fridge.

title: Palak Paneer Bhurji
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, make the besan mixture with the given ingredients.
In a pan, add jeera to the hot oil, and saute.
Add onion, tomato and salt to the pan and saute them well for 3 minutes on high flame.
Add the besan mixture.
Add water to the pan to adjust the consistency.
Add spinach to the pan and mix them well.
Add the shredded paneer to the pan and mix them thoroughly.

title: Orange Mogu Mogu
cooking_instructions:
In a saucepan, combine coconut water and sugar, bring the mixture to a simmer.
Stir in the agar agar and continue to cook the mixture for 1-2 minutes on low heat. 
Strain and pour the mixture into a shallow container and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow it to set.
After it has set, cut the jelly into cubes and place them in a glass.
Pour in freshly squeezed orange juice, and your delightful homemade Mogu Mogu is ready to enjoy!

title: No-Knead Ciabatta
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, add the water, sugar, salt, yeast and olive oil. Mix and set aside for 5 mins. 
Add the flour and mix with a spatula until all the flour has hydrated. 
Cover and rest for 30 mins. 
With wet hands, make folds from the outside to the inside to form a sort of rough ball - roughly 7-8 folds. 
Cover and rest again for 30 mins. 
With wet hands, make a book fold by gently lifting the dough and folding it over itself.
Cover and rest again for 30 mins and repeat the book folds - these folds help develop gluten in a dough without kneading. 
Place the dough in the fridge overnight - 12 hours or up to 24 hours.
Tip the dough out on to a floured surface and cut them evenly into four. 
Place on a baking sheet and allow it to double in size. 
Bake at 250C for 15 mins. Spray some water to generate steam. 
Reduce the temp to 220C and bake until golden brown and crusty, another 7-8 mins. 
Cool completely, slice and serve.

title: Nawabi Chicken Curry
cooking_instructions:
Make a cashew paste using the given ingredients and keep it aside.
Fry the onion till it turns brown and blend it into a coarse paste and keep it aside.
In a bowl, add the chicken, curd, cashew paste, brown onion paste, ginger garlic paste and all the given spices powder.
Mix everything together thoroughly and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Heat up a pan, add oil and add the marinated chicken to it.
Let it cook for 5 minutes, keep mixing it frequently.
Let it cook on low heat for 20 minutes.
Garnish with chopped coriander leaves.

title: Chicken Paan
cooking_instructions:
Add all the ingredients For Filling in a bowl and mix well. 
This is your stuffing.
Take a Betel Leaf and turn it around.
From the thinner end, leave around 1 inch of space and place 1 tbsp of your filling on the leaf.
Roll it tightly and use the stalk to secure the roll.
Take a pan and brush oil.
Add the rolled paan leaves and grill until grill marks are visible on all sides.
Enjoy it while it's hot.

title: Chilli Prawn
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl add all the ingredients For Coating in a bowl and mix well.
Add your prawns in the mixture and let marinate for a minimum of 30 minutes.
Heat up oil to deep fry; Deep fry until golden brown.
Heat up a wok/kadai on high heat and add oil, once smoking hot, add ginger, garlic and green chilli and saute on high heat until aromatic.
Add all the sauces along with salt and pepper.
Add water and let it reduce for 2 to 4 minutes, or until it starts to thicken.
Add all the diced vegetables and saute for 2 minutes.
Add the fried up prawns and add your spring onion whites.
Saute on high heat until coated thoroughly.
Finish off with green onions and serve hot.

title: Tomato Kulambu
cooking_instructions:
Heat oil in a kadai, once hot, add in your whole shallots. 
After 2 minutes, or slightly softened, add in your ginger and garlic.
Once fragrant, add the dry red chili and curry leaves.
Once the onions have softened and turned slightly brown, remove them from the kadai and place into a plate.
In the same kadai, add a little more oil. 
Add in your channa dal and roast it on a low flame until it just starts to turn golden brown.
Once starting to turn lightly golden brown, add in your cumin seeds and whole black pepper.
Add in the poppy seeds, fennel seeds, cinnamon and cloves right at the end.
Once the spices have all been toasted and are aromatic, remove from the kadai and place in a plate.
To the same kadai, add in your tomatoes. Cook the tomatoes on a medium flame until they soften and start to turn mushy. Add salt to help cook the tomatoes faster.
Once the tomatoes have cooked, add in the coconut, coriander powder and turmeric. Turn the flame off and cook with the residual heat of the pan. 
Once combined, remove the mixture from the kadai. 
Grind all three toasted mixtures together to form a smooth, thick gravy.
In a fresh kadai, add in peanut oil and heat on a medium flame. 
Once heated, add mustard seeds and cumin seeds. Let them splatter.
Then add the channa dal, along with the onions, curry leaves and dry red chillies.
Cook until the onions have softened and are starting to turn translucent. 
Pour in the blended paste and add some water. Mix to combine everything in the kadai. 
Bring the kozhambu to a boil and add salt to season. Simmer it for 8-10 minutes or until it slightly thickens.
Finish the curry by garnishing with coriander leaves.

title: Crispy Egg Rolls
cooking_instructions:
Heat a pan, add oil and add the chopped garlic and saute for a few seconds.
Add the sliced onions and saute till it turns golden.
Add the masala and let it cook  for a minute.
Season it with salt and sugar, mix well till combined and keep it aside.
Cut the boiled eggs into halves lengthwise and keep it aside
To a bowl mix maida and water to form a smooth batter. 
Place a spring roll sheet on a board and cut it into half lengthwise.
On one end, add a spoon of the sauteed onion mixture and place a boiled egg on top.
Apply batter on the sides roll it tightly and seal the sides.
Heat oil in a kadai.
Fry the rolls in hot oil on a low flame till golden brown.
Serve it hot with ketchup.

title: Shawarma Rice Bowl
cooking_instructions:
Add all the ingredients required for marination to a bowl. 
Gently massage the marinade into the chicken and let it marinate for at least 30 minutes and up to overnight.
To make the sauce, add the egg to a tall container. Add the garlic, mustard and salt. 
While tilting the container, gently pour the oil into the container, making sure it forms a layer above the egg.
Gently submerge the immersion blender into the container and start blending. It should immediately emulsify.
Preheat a griddle pan on high heat. Add a little oil and then add in your chicken thighs.
Press them down gently and cook them for 3 minutes or until deeply charred.
Flip and repeat on the other side. 
Once cooked, remove and let them rest before cutting.
Once the chicken has rested, chop it into chunks. 
To make the herbed rice, toss the cooked basmati rice with mint, dried basil and dried parsley.
To plate, place the rice in a bowl, and top it with chicken and salsa.
Drizzle to sauce on top.

title: Aloo Bhaja
cooking_instructions:
In a pan over medium heat add mustard oil, and mustard seeds and let them splutter.
Add in the potatoes, salt, and saute.
Mix well and reduce the heat to the lowest.
Cover and let cook until the potatoes are fork-tender.

Add turmeric and red chilli and saute until the raw smell disappears.
Serve hot and enjoy.

title: Crab Pepper Masala
cooking_instructions:
In a pan over medium heat add oil,cumin seeds, fennel seeds, red chilli and curry leaf.
Let splutter.
Add the shallots and saute until translucent.
Add the ginger garlic paste and saute until the raw smell disappears.
Add the tomato and saute until soft.
Add turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder and saute until the raw smell disappears.
Add water and let it boil covered for 10 minutes or until the crab’s shell changes color.
Add the crab and mix well.

Take over the lid and let the water evaporate until it reaches a semi gravy consistency.
Add black pepper powder and mix well until combined.
Finish off with coriander leaves as garnish and serve hot.

title: Lasuni Palak Paneer
cooking_instructions:
Blanch the spinach for 30 seconds in hot water.
To a blender add the blanched spinach, coriander leaves, ginger and green chillies.
Blend it into a fine paste and keep it aside.
In a hot pan, add oil and ghee and saute cumin, onion and garlic for 3-4 minutes.
Add the dry spices mix well and let it cook for 2 minutes.
Add the tomato pure and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the spinach paste and cream and mix it well.
Add the paneer cubes and let it cook for 2 minutes.
At the end add the garam masala and cook it well.

title: Dhaba Style Chicken Pepper Fry
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl add chicken, add cornflour, maida, salt, pepper, water and mix well till all the ingredients combine evenly and the mushrooms are coated well with the batter.
Heat oil in a kadai, deep fry the Chicken till golden, crispy and cooked.
Heat oil in another pan, add ginger, garlic, green chillies and saute for a few seconds.
Add the highway dhaba curry paste and cook for a few seconds.
Add soy sauce, water, black pepper powder and mix well till it combines well.
Add the fried chicken and toss till it is coated with the sauce.
Add spring onions, toss for a few seconds.
Serve it hot.

title: North Indian Dal Tadka
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the moong dal for 20 mins. 
Add the dal to a pressure cooker with salt, turmeric powder and water. 
Pressure cook for 4 whistles. Allow the pressure to release naturally. Mix well and mash slightly. 
In a pan, heat some ghee and add the cumin seeds. 
When the seeds sizzle, add dry red chilli, asafoetida and chopped garlic, cook until light golden in colour. 
Add the chilli powder and the boiled dal. Allow it to come to a boil. 
Adjust the seasoning and consistency, if needed.
Finish with fresh chopped coriander leaves and lemon juice (optionally).

title: South Indian Dal Tadka
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the moong dal for 20 mins. 
Add the dal to a pressure cooker with salt, turmeric powder and water. 
Pressure cook for 4 whistles. Allow the pressure to release naturally. Mix well and mash slightly. 
Heat oil in a pan and splutter the mustard seeds. 
Add the asafoetida, curry leaves and dry red chillies.
Add the boiled dal and bring to a boil. Add 1 slit green chilli. Add 1 tsp of ghee to finish. 
Adjust the seasoning and consistency, if needed.

title: Baked Mac and Cheese
cooking_instructions:
Add butter to a pan on medium flame. Once it melts and starts to foam, add the onion and garlic and saute until fragrant.
Once the onions are lightly golden, add the maida and stir constantly to prevent any burning. 
Once the raw flour smell dissipates, add in your milk little by little while constantly mixing. Add your milk only once the previous batch has been completely mixed in and is lump-free.
Season the sauce with salt, nutmeg and paprika.
Turn the flame off once the sauce has slightly thickened and add in the cheese while stirring. Put the sauce aside and start boiling your water to cook the pasta.
Cook the pasta 2 minutes shy of the package recommendation.
Mix in the pasta with the sauce and pour into a baking dish.
To make the topping, lightly blend coriander with breadcrumbs until they turn green.
Spread the topping over the surface of the pasta and bake in a preheated 200C oven for 15 minutes or until the topping becomes golden. 
Remove from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Easy Kunafa
cooking_instructions:
Boil the plain vermicelli in water for 2 mins until tender but not mushy. 
Strain the vermicelli and wash with cold water. 
In a pan, bring the sugar and water to a boil. Add the crushed cardamom pods and vanilla essence. 
Boil for 4-5 mins, until a little thick and store warm (if it gets too thick, add 2 tbsp of water). Remove the whole cardamom pods. 
In a non-stick pan, apply some ghee on the pan and layer half the cooker vermicelli. 
Layer with soft cream cheese, followed by the grated mozzarella cheese. 
Add the remaining vermicelli on top and pat to level. 
Pour some ghee on the sides and apply some on the top layer. 
Cover and cook for 5-7 mins in a simmer until the bottom forms a golden brown crust.
Carefully flip and repeat - simmer until the bottom forms a golden brown crust.
Serve warm with the sugar syrup and crushed pistachios.

title: Coimbatore Chicken Thokku
cooking_instructions:
To a kadai, add the oil and heat on a medium flame. Once hot, add in the cinnamon, cardamom and cloves.
Then add the fennel seeds, cumin seeds.
Once the spices splutter and are fragrant, add in the onion, garlic and ginger.  
Cook until the onions start to soften, add in the coriander and mint along with turmeric powder.
Once the onions are around half cooked, add in the cashew nuts.
Cook for another 5-6 minutes and add the tomatoes. 
Cook until the tomatoes start to soften and the onions are completely cooked and softened. 
Remove the mixture from the heat and let it cool completely before blending into a paste. Add water as necessary to blend into a smooth paste.
In another kadai, add some oil and heat on a medium flame. 
Add the chicken to a kadai and add salt and turmeric.
Once the chicken is half cooked, add in curry leaves.
Once they splutter, add red chilli powder, coriander powder, chicken masala and turmeric powder. 
Mix to combine.
Once aromatic, add in the blended paste. 
Add little water and mix till combined.
Season with salt.  
Cook until the oil separates from the gravy.

title: Egg Karam
cooking_instructions:
Add water to a pot and bring it to a boil
Gently lower in your eggs and cook them for exactly 10 minutes
Once the time has passed, remove the eggs and plunge them into cold water
After peeling the eggs, place shallow slits around the egg, this allows the masala to penetrate the egg
In a preheated pan, add some oil.
To the pan add your garlic and cook until softened and fragrant.
Then add in the urad dal. Toast it for 1-2 minutes on a low heat or until it starts to turn lightly golden brown.
Then add the cumin seeds, mustard seeds and curry leaves.
After the spluttering stops, add the red chilli powder and salt. At this point, turn the flame off.
Toss the coat the eggs thoroughly in this masala.

title: Kali Mirch Panner
cooking_instructions:
Marinate the paneer with the given ingredient and let it rest.
In a pan saute the marinated paneer and let it rest.
In a hot pan add oil to it and saute ginger, garlic and onions with coriander thoroughly.
Blend the sauted ingredients with curd and keep it aside.
Add salt, all the powdered spices to the curd mixture and mix them well
In another pan, add oil, whole dry spices and saute them well.
Add the curd mixture to the pan and let it cook for 6 minutes.
Add the marinated paneer to the curry and let it cook for 5 minutes.
Adjust the consistency of the gravy with water if needed.
Garnish with chopped coriander and serve it hot.

title: Masala Dosa
cooking_instructions:
Add all the ingredients for Red Chutney into a blender and make a coarse paste.
In a pan over medium heat add oil, once hot add mustard seeds and cashew nuts.
Once splutter add curry leaves, hing, green chilli  and saute until aromatic.
Add the potato and mash it down.
Add salt, turmeric and mix well.
Using a ladle of batter make yourself a dosa.
Add 1 tsp of your red chutney and spread it around the dosa.
Add 1 tsp of ghee on the dosa.
Add 2 tbsp of your prepared potato filling in the center of the dosa.
Close the dosa by half and serve with some coconut chutney.

title: Fish and Chips
cooking_instructions:
Make the dredge by mixing in all the dry ingredients together
Make the batter by whisking together all the ingredients.
Dip the fish in the dredge and then into the batter and then immediately drop it carefully into the hot oil to deep fry.
Once golden, remove and drain on a paper towel.
Once the fish has been fried, keep warm in a low oven, while frying the french fries.

Deep fry until golden brown

title: Cookd Taco 65
cooking_instructions:
Mix the Madras 65 masala with water to form a thick paste.
Add the chicken to it and mix well till it is coated with the masala.
Heat oil in a kadai and fry the chicken for 5-7 minutes (small pieces) till it becomes crispy and is cooked throughout.
In a bowl, mix together the onion, tomato, green chili, olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. 
Add the Madras 65 to the taco shells and layer it with mayonnaise and onion and tomato salsa.

title: French Hot Chocolate
cooking_instructions:
Bring the milk to a simmer. 
Once its simmering, add the cocoa powder, coffee powder, sugar and whisk until smooth and dissolved.
Once the milk comes back to a simmer, add in the cream and whisk to incorporate.
Finally, add in the chocolate and whisk to melt. 
Bring the mixture to one final boil and then take it off the heat.

title: Bang Bang Cauliflower
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl add the milk, flour, cornflour, salt, pepper,and paprika powder and mix well.
The batter should not be too thick as well.
Add the cauliflower to the batter and add the breadcrumbs to it and give it a good mix.
In a baking tray arrange the coated cauliflowers and bake it in the oven which is already preheated at 230° for 25 minutes.
For the sauce mix mayonnaise, sweet chilli sauce and chopped coriander in a bowl and mix well.
After baking the cauliflower, cool it for a while and then toss it in the sauce till it coats the baked florets.

title: Egg Ghee Roast
cooking_instructions:
Add the Cookd Mangalore Ghee Roast Paste to a pan, add water and bring it to a boil. 
Let it cook for 2-3 minutes on medium flame.
Add the boiled eggs and mix well till the eggs are coated with the masala. 
Let it cook for a minute and add in the ghee. 
Cover and simmer it for 5 minutes.
Garnish with curry leaves and serve hot.

title: Parsi Fish Curry
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer jar add all the ingredients for the paste and blend into a fine paste.
In a pan pour ghee, and add cumin seeds, once it crackles add maida and saute for 10 seconds on a simmer, 
Add the paste and cook for 5 minutes on a moderate flame or until the raw flavour disappears and the oil separates.
Pour water and bring it to a boil, add all the spices and salt
Reduce it to a simmer and add the fish. Cook covered for 5 minutes on a moderate flame.
Finish the gravy with a mixture of egg yolk and vinegar along with chopped coriander
Serve hot along with rice.

title: Cookd Chettinad Mushroom Ambur Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the Seeraga samba rice for 20 minutes.
In a pressure cooker add the Cookd Ambur Biryani Paste
Saute for 30 seconds and add water and mix.
Add the soaked rice.
Pressure cook on a moderate flame for 2 whistles.
Let it rest for 10 minutes.
Add the seasoning oil and fluff up the biryani.
In a pan pour oil and add onions and curry leaves.
Saute on a moderate flame until the onion turns translucent (around 2 minutes).
Add the mushrooms and saute for 3 minutes on a high flame. 
Add the Cookd Chettinad Masala.
Saute on a high heat until the water reduces and becomes a thokku.
Serve the thokku with biryani.

title: Paneer 65 Katsu Sandwich
cooking_instructions:
Add all the ingredients required for the sauce to a bowl, mix it together and keep it aside.
Cut the paneer into steaks.
Using the Cookd Madras 65 Masala, make a batter by adding the water to it and mixing to combine
Coat the paneer thoroughly with the batter and then coat it in panko bread crumbs. Make sure it’s completely covered
Shallow fry the paneer until it is golden and crispy
Arrange the sandwich by smearing a layer of sauce on the bottom bread slice.
Place the paneer 65 katsu on the sauced bread, followed by a layer of shredded cabbage. 
Add a layer of sauce to the top bread slice and close the sandwich. 
Cut the crusts of and serve.

title: Cookd Chettinad Chicken, Dindigul Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for at least 20 minutes
To make the chettinad thokku, heat a pan on medium flame.
Once hot, add oil along with curry leaves. Once they splatter, add the onions and saute for 5-6 minutes or until softened and lightly browned.
Add in the chicken and saute for 2 minutes.
Add in the Cookd Chettinad Masala and mix to coat the protein.
Add the water to the pan and bring it to a simmer on a medium heat.
Cook it covered for 10-12 minutes.
Let the gravy reduce on a high heat, while mixing continuously, to make a thick gravy.
In a preheated pressure cooker, add your biryani paste and saute it for 2 minutes on a medium heat.
Then add in the water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Add in your soaked rice and give it a mix.
Close the cooker and cook on a medium heat for 2 whistles.
Once cooked, allow the pressure to release naturally, this also allows the biryani to rest.
Add the seasoning oil to the biryani and fluff.
Serve the biryani topped with the thokku.
Enjoy hot!

title: Cookd Chicken 65 Parotta Roll
cooking_instructions:
Mix the Madras 65 masala with water to form a thick paste.
Add the chicken to it and mix well till it is coated with the masala.
Heat oil in a kadai.
Fry the chicken for 5-7 minutes (small pieces) till it becomes crispy and is cooked throughout
Heat up parottas till golden brown.
Place it on a cutting board and fluff it up.
To make the aioli, add eggs, fried curry leaves, salt and garlic to a blender and blend till it combines.
Add oil little by little and pulse it till a smooth, thick dip forms.
Apply the aioli on it and spread it evenly.
Add the fried chicken 65, sliced onions and top it off with little more aioli.
Toll it tightly and wrap it with foil.
Cut and serve it hot.

title: Pacha Pattani Fry
cooking_instructions:
In a kadhai, pour oil and let it heat up
Once moderately hot, add the washed and pat-dried green peas
Deep fry on a moderate flame until crispy (around 3 minutes)
Deep fry whole garlic until crispy and fragrant (30 secs)
Deep fry the curry leaves
Add all the ingredients in a bowl and mix until well combined.
Serve hot.

title: Marble Cake
cooking_instructions:
Preheat the oven at 180°C for 15 minutes. 
In a bowl, sieve the flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt. 
In another bowl beat the butter until smooth and fluffy, add the sugar and beat using a hand/stand mixer. 
Add in the eggs one at a time and beat well. 
Add the yogurt and vanilla extract to the batter. 
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients in three portions and mix well.
Separate ½ of the batter and shift it to another bowl and fold in the cocoa powder. 
Grease the baking dish with some unsalted butter and dust it with some flour, pour both the batters layer by layer alternately, insert a toothpick and swirl it through the batter. 
Bake for 40-50 minutes at 180°C, let it cool for 10-15 minutes and Enjoy!

title: Chicken Caesar Sandwich
cooking_instructions:
Add the egg yolks to a tall, narrow container. Next, include the garlic cloves and mustard.
Tilt the container at a 45-degree angle and slowly pour in the oil, allowing it to form a separate layer on top of the eggs.
Gently insert your immersion blender to the bottom of the container and turn it on.
The mixture should emulsify immediately.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and add in the rest of the ingredients needed for the dressing.
Whisk to combine.
Marinate the chicken with the listed ingredients.
Sear in a pan on medium heat until deeply golden brown.
Cut your chicken into small chunks.
Cut your lettuce and tomatoes into small pieces and place them into a bowl along with the chicken.
Add in your olives along with your dressing.
Toss to coat all the vegetables in dressing.
Toast your bread in a dry pan on a medium heat until deeply golden brown.
To assemble, place a toasted slice as the base. Pile up the salad, add another toasted slice, add another layer of salad, and close with the final slice of bread.
Optionally secure with toothpicks and aluminum foil.

title: Peanut Butter Bites
cooking_instructions:
In a preheated pan on medium heat, add your oats and salt,let them toast for 5-6 minutes while mixing continuously.
Add your raisins and cashew nuts and toss to toast with the oats.
After 4 minutes add your chia seeds and turn the flame to low.
Make a well in the centre and add the ghee followed by the honey.
Turn the flame off and mix to combine and slightly cool the mixture.
Add the vanilla extract and peanut butter and mix to combine. The residual heat will soften the peanut butter and make it easy to incorporate.
Once combined, oil your hands and grab a small chunk of the mixture and roll into a ball.
Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes so they can set.

title: Kasundi Creamy Paneer
cooking_instructions: In a bowl add all the ingredients for marination
Mix well until well incorporated

Heat up a pan on medium low heat and add mustard oil.
Add the marinated paneer and saute until the paneer is soft and juicy.

title: Fish Pepper Fry
cooking_instructions:
Heat coconut oil on a medium heat
Add the curry leaves. Once they splatter add in the onions 
Add salt and cook on a medium heat until the onions turn golden brown and have softened
Add the spice powders to the onions and let the cook for 30 seconds before adding the garlic and ginger. 
Once aromatic, add the crushed whole black pepper along with the fish
Mix once
Add the water and cook until all the water has been reduced to form a thick semi dry gravy
Add the rest of the crushed black pepper and mix gently to combine
Garnish with lemon juice and coriander leaves

title: No Oven Plum Cake
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl add- Black raisins, raisins, cashews, almonds, dates, figs and tutti frutti. Add the orange juice and keep it aside for 1 hour to soak. 
In a pan add the brown sugar along with 1 tbsp of water. 
Do not touch the pan until the sugar has completely dissolved.
Add the ½ cup water and mix until well combined and let it boil for another 5-7 minutes. Until it reaches a syrup consistency. And set it aside to cool. 
In a bowl, add the butter and milk and whisk well. 
Sieve the maida, baking powder, baking soda, cardamom powder, cinnamon powder, and ginger powder. 
Mix it all together, add in the brown sugar syrup.
Add the orange juice. 
Pour the cake mixture into a well greased pressure cooker. 
Place a pan/ tawa on the stove and let it heat for 5 minutes. 
Don’t add the whistle to the pressure, so that the steam can escape from the pressure cooker. 
Place the pressure cooker on the pan for 50 minutes on low heat.

title: Kerala Prawn Roast
cooking_instructions:
Add everything For Marination and Mix well.
Let marinate for a minimum of 30 minutes.
Heat up a pan over medium high heat and add oil and your marinated prawns.
Continue sauteing for  5 minutes until the prawns are fully cooked.
Add black pepper powder and coriander leaves and mix until fully combined.
Serve with rice or parotta and enjoy.

title: Rose Milk Cake
cooking_instructions:
Separate the egg whites from the yolks. 
Beat the egg whites with the sugar. Whip it until it forms stiff peaks. 
In another bowl, combine the maida, baking powder and salt. 
In a separate bowl, beat the egg yolks with sugar until pale and at ribbon consistency. 
Add the milk and vanilla essence, and mix just to combine. 
Add the flour mixture to the yolks and whisk again. 
Fold in the egg whites gently into the egg yolks. 
Pour the cake batter into a cake pan lined with greased and lined with baking paper. 
Make streaks in the batter using a skewer to remove any air bubbles.
Bake at 180c for 30 minutes. 
For the milk mixture, combine all the ingredients together and whisk. 
Set aside. 
Once the cake has cooled down, make several holes on it using a skewer or toothpick.
Pour the rose milk over it and let it soak.  
Refrigerate for 4 hours. 
To a bowl add whipping cream and whip it till stiff peaks form. 
Add rose syrup and whip till combined
Trim the sides and cut into pieces. Decorate with whipped cream, rose petals and pistachios. 
Serve cold. 
You can pour more of the milk mixture while serving too.

title: Cashew Halwa
cooking_instructions:
Grind the cashew nuts, by pulse blending, into a fine powder. 
Set aside. 
In a pan, roast the besan for 3-4 mins until aromatic. Allow this to cool for a few mins. 
Add the milk and whisk into a fine paste. 
Turn the heat on and add the saffron, sugar and the ghee in 4 parts. 
Cook on a low flame, adding ghee every 3-4 mins until done. 
The halwa is done when you used wet hands and can make a soft ball with the mixture. 
Wrap them individually into small portions and allow to cool completely.

title: Popeyes Spinach Pasta
cooking_instructions:
In a kadai, add the water and bring it to a boil. 
Add the salt and oil, followed by the pasta. 
Let it cook for 9-10 minutes on medium heat. 
Remove the pasta from the water and save 1 cup of pasta water for later. 
In a bowl mix together the chicken, salt, white pepper, and garlic. Combine everything well together and set aside. 
In a pan, add the butter and oil and let it melt. Add in the chicken and cook it till golden brown on medium heat for 4-5 minutes. 
Once fully cooked, remove the pan from heat and keep the chicken aside. 
Now in the same pan, add the butter, oil and maida and mix well till golden brown in color. 
Now add in the cream and the pasta water and mix it together until everything is well combined. 
Add in the chicken and cook it for another minute on medium heat. 
Lastly, add in the spinach and cook it for 2-3 minutes till the spinach is well coated. Add in the pasta and toss it until evenly coated. 
Top it with some grated cheese and oregano and enjoy!

title: Frozen Yoghurt Bars
cooking_instructions:
Add the curd and condensed milk to a bowl and whisk to combine
Pour this mixture into an ice tray and place in the freezer to freezer for at least 3 hours
Once frozen, add the cubes to a blender and blend until a thick paste forms
Pour the paste into a mould and spread it into an even layer.
Sprinkle on the fruits and place the tray in the freezer for at least 4 hours and up to overnight.

title: Cumin Lamb
cooking_instructions:
Mix all the ingredients required for the marination and let it marinate for at least 30 minutes and up to 2 hours
Dry roast whole black pepper and coriander seeds until fragrant. Blend together to form a powder that isn't too fine
In a wok, heat up oil on high flame and sear the marinated lamb in batches until a golden crust forms on one side. Flip and repeat on the other side. Remove from the pan once the lamb is seared
To the same pan, add in the onions until softened and aromatic
Add the cumin seeds and saute on high heat and then add in your red chillies and toss
Immediately add in your mutton along with the seasoning powder and toss once again to combine.

title: Corn and Peas Pulav
cooking_instructions:
In a pan over medium heat add ghee, bay leaves, cloves, cardamom and saute until aromatic.
Add the sliced onion and saute until translucent.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute until the raw smell disappears.
Add your corn & peas and saute for a minute.
Add salt and your soaked rice.
Mix for two minutes until thoroughly combined.
Add water and reduce flame to the lowest
Cover and let cook for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes turn off the heat, and fluff up the rice from the sides.

title: Prawn Spring Rolls
cooking_instructions:
On a cutting board, cut your prawn until finely chopped. All the pieces don't have to be uniform but the pieces should be small
Optionally, you can pulse in a food processor
To the prawn, add all the ingredients required for the filling and mix to combine well
Set the filling aside and prepare your spring roll sheets. On a clean surface, lay out the spring roll wrapper and place the filling near the top corner. Roll tightly to form a spring roll
To seal the spring roll, mix the maida with the water to form a paste and apply a small amount to the final corner and stick
In a pan, add enough oil to cover the surface
Once hot, add in the spring onions and fry until golden brown and crispy on one side, around 2-3 minutes
Rotate the spring rolls and repeat the process until the entire exterior is deeply golden brown and crispy
To make the dipping sauce, mix all the ingredients listed

title: Dragon Lollipop
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, add cornflour, maida, salt, pepper, red chilli powder and water to form a batter. 
Add the chicken to the batter.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan. Fry the chicken pieces until crispy. Remove from the oil and set aside on a tissue paper to drain any excess oil.
In the pan, add and heat 1 tsp of oil. Add finely chopped garlic, green chilli ,chopped celery stem and stir fry.
Add Spring onion whites and continue to stir fry.
Add the water.
Add tomato sauce, red chilli sauce, chilli powder and continue to cook. Once the sauce starts to thicken, add honey. Add the chopped celery leaves and spring onion.
Add the fried chicken pieces.Stir fry until the sauce coats the chicken pieces.
Remove from heat and optionally wrap silver foil on the bone end of the lollipop.

title: Fruit Custard
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, separate 2 egg yolks from the eggs. We only need egg yolks for this recipe. Mix the cornstarch with the egg yolks to form a paste.
Add the milk and sugar to a saucepan and bring it to a boil. Take this off the heat.
Pour in a ladle of the milk into the egg yolk mixture and whisk well. Add approximately half of the milk into the egg yolk mixture, a ladle at a time. Whisk well.
Add this mixture back into the milk. Heat the saucepan again over low heat, stirring continuously. Cook for 3 minutes on a low flame, until the mixture, has thickened. Add Vanilla essence to it.
Turn off the heat, transfer the custard into another bowl. Cover it with cling wrap and poke a few holes to allow the heat to escape.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Whisk the custard well after it is chilled.
Cut the bananas and half an apple into small pieces. Cut each grape in half. Slice the Kiwi and half an apple.
Fill the bottom layer of the serving dish with the chopped bananas, apples and grapes.
Pour the chilled custard on top of the fruits.
Pour the chilled custard on top of the fruits. Arrange the remaining fruits on top. It can be served immediately, or chilled further in the refrigerator and then served.

title: Cookd Schezwan Fried Chicken
cooking_instructions:
Soak the chillies and star anise in hot water for 10 minutes
Marinate the chicken with the cookd secret marinade and mix till it is coated evenly
Make a smooth batter with 5 tbsp of the cookd ultra crispy fry mix and 150 ml water
Add the remaining fry mix to another bowl.
Coat the chicken in the dry mix first, then in the batter and in the fry mix again.
Dust in it a downward motion to get the crust.
Heat oil in a kadai, deep fry the chicken for 5 minutes in hot oil till golden and crispy
Drain off the excess oil and keep it aside
Heat a pan/wok, add oil
Add the chopped ginger and garlic and  saute till it turns golden
Add the celery and saute for a few seconds
Add the chilli paste and cook till oil separates
Add soy sauce, tomato ketchup and mix well.
Add little water, bring it to a boil
Add the fried chicken and toss it on a high flame for a few seconds
Transfer it to a bowl, garnish with sesame seeds and serve it hot immediately

title: Erode Chicken Thanni Kulambu
cooking_instructions:
Roast all the whole spices in a little bit of groundnut oil until fragrant .
To a little oil, add the channa dal and rice. Toast until lightly golden for 1-2 minutes on a low heat. Remove the chana dal and rice mixture and reserve the oil in the pan.
In the remaining oil add the dry red chillis and the curry leaves. Saute it for 1 minute on a medium heat until fragrant. Remove from the pan.
Blend all the broiled ingredients into a powder and aside.
In a preheated kadai, add groundnut oil. Once hot, add your shallots and saute on a medium heat for around 5-6 minutes or until it starts to soften.
Once the shallots have sufficiently softened, turn the flame off and add the grated coconut along with the spice powder. Keep stirring for 1 minutes and remove from the kadai.
Blend this mixture into a fine paste. 
Add water as needed.
In a fresh preheated kadai, add groundnut oil. Once hot, add the shallots and cook on a medium heat for around 5 minutes or until they start to soften. 
Then add the curry leaves, dry red chillies and ginger garlic paste.
Once the raw flavour of the ginger garlic paste has abated, add in the chicken and saute for 2 minutes. Let all the water from the chicken evaporate .
Add salt, turmeric the remaining spice powder and the shallot paste and mix to combine
Add water and bring to a simmer. Cook the chicken for 10 minutes.

title: Hot n Sour Soup
cooking_instructions:
To a preheated pan on medium heat, add oil, followed by the onions.
Let them saute for 3-4 minutes or until translucent.
Add your carrots and beans and saute for another 3-4 minutes.
The onions should start to turn lightly golden and the carrots should slightly soften.
Add the ginger and garlic and toast for 1 minute on a medium heat.
Just before adding the stock, add the sweet corn.
Once fragrant, add the stock and bring to a simmer.
Add salt, black pepper, soy sauce and vinegar.
Bring the soup to a boil and then add the corn starch slurry while mixing.
Once the soup has thickened, turn the flame off .
Serve hot!

title: Malai Chicken Handi
cooking_instructions:
In a preheated kadai, add ghee, and the whole spices
Once fragrant, add the onion, green chilli.Saute for 7-8 minutes on a medium high heat, or until they start to turn golden brown
Add cashews and ginger garlic paste and the spice powders and cook until the raw flavour dissipates, around 2 minutes on a low flame
Add the chicken and saute for 2 minutes on a high heat. Follow that up with water and bring to a simmer
Once simmering, add in the whisked curd
Cook on a low heat until the oil separates from the gravy, around 10 minutes
Right at the end, add kasuri methi and garnish with ghee

title: Crab Fry
cooking_instructions:
Blend the onion and tomato together to form a smooth paste
In a preheated kadai, add oil. Once hot, add garlic and saute it until it starts to turn golden
Then add the curry leaves and cumin seeds, immediately followed by the ginger garlic paste
Cook for 1 minutes on a medium heat until the raw small disappears
Then add the onion tomato paste and cook it for 10-12 minutes on a medium heat, adding water as needed
The colour of the paste should considerably darken
Add your spice powders and cook for another 3-4 minutes before adding the crab
Mix to coat the crab in the masala
Cover and Cook for 10 minutes on a medium heat, mixing a few times to ensure it isn’t burning at the bottom. Add water as needed
After 10 minutes, the majority of the water will have evaporated and the crab would have turned orange

title: Akkaravadisal
cooking_instructions:
Toast the rice and moong dal gently and add them to a pressure cooker. 
Add all the other ingredients for the rice and pressure cook for 4 whistles or 10 minutes on a low-medium flame.
In a pan pour water and add the jaggery, melt and make it into a syrup.
In a kadhai add the milk, cooked rice and the jaggery syrup.
Cook the mixture until mushy and soft, add all the other ingredients mix thoroughly.
Pour all the ghee in batches making sure you add the nest batch only when the first batch is absorbed.
In a pan pour ghee and toast the pista, cashew and raisins until golden brown and add the tempering to the akkaravadisal.
Mix gently and serve.

title: Chocolate Bread Bomb
cooking_instructions:
Take 2 slices of bread and cut them into a circle using a glass/cutter/bowl. 
Take 3 pieces of chocolate and keep it in the center of the bread. 
Brush the egg on the edges of the bread and cover it with the second slice on top. 
Pinch the edges of the bread together making sure it has stuck together properly.
In a pan add butter, and melt it. Add the bread and toast it till golden brown and crispy on both sides for 2-3 minutes on low flame.

title: Garlic Tadka Khichdi
cooking_instructions:
In a pressure cooker add in the rice, toor dal, masoor dal and chana dal. 
Sprinkle some salt and cook it for 4-5 whistles on low heat. 
In a pan add ghee, and cumin seeds and let it crackle. 
Add the sliced onions and cook until translucent. 
Add the ginger garlic paste and the chopped green chilli and cook it till the raw aroma is gone. 
Add all the spices and cook it for another 4-5 minutes along with the rice and cook it on low heat until well combined. 
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Vazhaithandu Soup
cooking_instructions:
To a preheated pressure cooker, add oil along with the whole spices. Let them toast until fragrant, around 2-3 minutes
Once they start to sizzle, add the banana stem. Saute it for 6-7 minutes on a medium flame
Then add the ginger garlic paste, salt turmeric. Cook until the raw smell of the ginger garlic paste dissipates
Cover with water and pressure cook for 3-4 whistles on a medium heat.
Once cooked, let the pressure release naturally before opening
Strain the solids from the liquid, do not discard the liquid
Reserve around ½ Cup of the solids and blend the rest into a smooth paste
Add the paste back to the cooker along with the cooking liquid and the reserved solids
Once the soup has thickened, garnish with coriander leaves and cornflakes

title: Eggless Tiramisu
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl add in melted butter, sugar and vanilla. Mix this really well. 
Add in milk and combine everything together.
In the same bowl, add in all purpose flour and baking powder and bring the ladyfinger dough together.
Transfer this in a piping bag with a round nozzle and pipe out ladyfinger on your baking tray. 
To even out the edges, dip your finger in water and smooth out the edges lightly.
Bake this on 180 degree celsius for 25 minutes till golden brown. 
To make the filling, in a bowl mix together the icing sugar and mascarpone until smooth. 
Fold in the whipped cream until well combined. 
Next we make our coffee syrup. In a bowl add in water and coffee powder. Mix this really well and set it aside.
Take a square tin, start dipping each lady finger in the coffee mixture, and set it as a layer at the bottom of the square tin. 
Add a few more spoons of the coffee mixture to the lady fingers and set them in a refrigerator for 15-20 minutes or until the filling is done. 
Layer the filling on the ladyfingers and repeat the entire layering process again with the leftover ladyfingers and filling. 
Refrigerate this till 4 hours to overnight. 
Dust it with cocoa powder before serving.

title: Cookd Chizza
cooking_instructions:
Using the Cookd Fried Chicken Kit, marinate the chicken with the cookd secret marinade and mix till it is coated evenly
Make a smooth batter with 5 tbsp of the cookd ultra crispy fry mix and 150 ml water
Add the remaining fry mix to another bowl.
Coat the chicken in the dry mix first, then in the batter and in the fry mix again.
Dust in it a downward motion to get the crust.
Heat oil in a kadai, deep fry the chicken for 5 minutes in hot oil till golden and crispy
Drain off the excess oil and keep it aside.
On the fried chicken add pizza/ pasta sauce, mozzarella cheese, diced capsicum and oregano seasoning.
Sprinkle with the cookd seasoning. 
Place it in the oven for 2 minutes/ in a pan with the lid on low flame until the cheese is melted.

title: Spaghetti all’Assasina
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add the tomato puree and water, and mix until the tomato puree is diluted and watery.
In a saute pan, pour olive oil and add the chopped garlic, onion and red chilli, saute for 10 seconds on a moderate flame.
Add one to two ladles of the tomato puree and add the spaghetti, cook until the water evaporates.
Add all the dried herbs and saute for 10 more seconds.
Ladle in the puree in gradual intervals until all the water is absorbed and the spaghetti starts to brown. 
Serve hot.

title: Vada Curry
cooking_instructions:
Soak the gram dal, dried red chilli and fennel together in water for 2 hours.
Grind into a coarse paste.
Add salt and asafoetida, fry it in hot oil until it turns golden brown. A particular shape is not required as it will be broken up later anyway.
Heat oil in a pan. Add cinnamon, clove, cardamom, bay leaves and fennel seeds. 
Add curry leaves, onion and green chilli. Saute until the onion turns translucent. 
Add the ginger garlic paste and saute for 1 minute. 
Add the Kashmiri chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder and salt. Add the tomatoes. 
Cook until the tomatoes turn mushy and the oil starts floating from the sides, around 4 minutes.
For the paste, grind the coconut and poppy seeds together with adequate water.  
Add the coconut paste, stir well and cook for 2 minutes. 
Add water and bring it to a boil. Cook for 4 minutes to bring the flavours together. 
Add the fried Vada and simmer for 3 minutes. Garnish with chopped coriander leaves and turn off the heat.

title: Vizhinjam Chicken Fry
cooking_instructions:
Add dry red chilli, fennel seeds and curry leaves to a mixer jar. Pulse and blend it into a very coarse mixture. Remove it from the jar.
For mix 2, add all the ingredients to the mixer jar pulse and blend it again into a coarse mixture. Be careful not to grind it into a paste. 
Wash the chicken legs and make slits on them.
Add salt, turmeric powder, Kashmiri chilli powder, coarse mixes, and lemon juice to the chicken. Mix well using your hands. 
Allow it to marinate in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
To fry, heat up coconut oil,fry for 10-12 minutes on moderate heat. 
Add the remaining coarse mix from the marinade to the oil.

title: Instant Focaccia
cooking_instructions: In a bowl sieve the flour, baking soda and salt

Add the yogurt and mix until a dough is formed
It will be wet but not very sticky
Take a muffin tray and grease it with olive oil, and fill 1 tbsp of the dough to each mold
Top it with cherry tomatoes and rosemary and bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celcius for 35-40 minutes until golden brown on the top

title: Murungakeerai Soup
cooking_instructions:
In a pressure cooker add all the ingredients for the dal and pressure cook it on a moderate flame for 6 whistles or 15 minutes.
In a kadhai add oil and cumin seeds, once they splutter add the smashed ginger, garlic, curry leaves and onion.
Saute on a moderate flame for 30 seconds on a moderate flame or until fragrant.
Add the powdered spices and saute for 30 more seconds or until aromatic.
Add the moringa leaves and saute for 10 seconds or until they start to wilt. 
Strain the moong dal water into the kadhai, add salt and cook for another 5 minutes or until lightly thickened.
Strain the soup and mash the cooked veggies.
Add back half the mashed veggies, add pepper powder and mix.
Serve hot.

title: Purple Payasam
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak your rice for 30 minutes.
Add the rice along with the water to a pressure cooker and bring to a boil.
Close the pressure cooker and cook on a medium heat, for 4 whistles. The rice at this point should be 80% cooked.
Heat 2 tbsp of ghee in a pan, add the cashews and raisins, once the cashews turn brown and the raisins puff, switch off the heat and keep aside.
Heat a thick-bottomed kadai, add the milk and bring it to a boil and continue simmering on a medium-low flame.
Add the cardamom to a mortar and pestle, along with 1 tbsp of the sugar and pound to infuse the sugar with the cardamom.
Add sugar to the milk and continue simmering for 10 mins, while stirring from time to time to prevent the bottom from scorching. 
Strain the rice and add it to the milk. Cook it on a low heat for 20 minutes, the milk should be imbued with a light purple colour. 
Once the rice is fully cooked and the milk has reduced by 30%, add the cashews and raisins to the payasam and remove it from the heat.
Serve it hot or chill it in a refrigerator and serve cold.

title: Oreo No-Bake Cheesecake
cooking_instructions:
To make the crust, crush Oreos in a food processor, mix with melted butter, and press on a baking tin. 
Chill this base in the refrigerator.
For the filling, beat cream cheese, powdered sugar, and vanilla until smooth.

Whip heavy cream separately until stiff peaks form. 
Fold whipped cream and chopped Oreos into the cream cheese mixture.
Spread the filling over the chilled crust in the cake tin. Freeze for 4-5 hours or overnight. 
Once cheesecake is set, prepare ganache.
Pour cream into a small saucepan and heat over medium heat until it just begins to simmer.
Add in the chopped chocolate and start whisking. 
Keep whisking till the chocolate has melted and immediately remove it from heat. 
Cool for a minute and pour it over the cheesecake.  
Remove from the pan, slice, and enjoy!

title: Prawn Pineapple Stir Fry
cooking_instructions:
Add all the ingredients for marination into a bowl and mix well.
Let marinate for 30 minutes in the refrigerator.
Heat up oil and deep fry the marinated prawns until golden brown and cooked throughout. 
In a pan over medium heat add oil, ginger, garlic, red chilli and spring onion whites.
Saute until aromatic and flavourful.
Add in the pineapple and saute until it starts turning soft.
Add in the diced onions and capsicum and saute for a minute on high heat.
Add salt and black pepper and mix well.
Add in the pineapple juice, soy sauce and oyster sauce.
Mix well and combine until the sauce starts to thicken.
Add in the fried prawns and mix well until well coated. 
Finish off the dish with spring onion greens and garnish with sesame seeds.

title: Indian Bruschetta
cooking_instructions:
Mix all the ingredients required for the tomato mixture in a bowl. 
Toss thoroughly to let the flavours mix and get to know each other.
Toast your bread in a dry pan on a medium low heat until deeply golden brown.
Rub the bread with a garlic clove to lightly perfume it.
Spread a layer of cream cheese on the bread before adding a heaping spoonful of the tomato mixture.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
cooking_instructions:
To a preheated pot, add your oil along with onions.
Saute the onions for 4-5 minutes on a medium heat or until the onions start to turn translucent.
Then add the carrot and beans and saute with the onions.
Add the ginger garlic paste and cook until fragrant, around 2 minutes
Add the chicken and saute on a moderate flame for a minute.
Add the corn kernels and saute for 10 seconds on a moderate flame.
Add the stock and simmer it for 10 minutes.
Let the soup simmer for 10 minutes.
Turn the flame off before adding the noodles.

title: Moru Moru Macaroni
cooking_instructions:
Boil the pasta as per package instructions.
Drain the pasta, pour the oil mix thoroughly and set aside.
Deep fry the macaroni until golden brown and crispy (around 4 minutes)
Add all the other ingredients, toss thoroughly and serve.

title: Mutton Chops Cutlet
cooking_instructions:
Using the back of the knife, flatten out each piece of mutton chops until flattened throughout.
In a bowl add the ingredients for marination along with the mutton and mix well and let marinate for 30 minutes in the refrigerator.
Take your marinated mutton dip it in the egg mixture and in the panko ensuring that it is completely coated.
Deep fry the mutton on medium low heat until golden brown and cooked throughout.(around 6 minutes on each side)
Serve it with mustard sauce and enjoy.

title: Hara Bara Pulao
cooking_instructions:
In a pan pour water, add vinegar and sugar. 
Bring it to a boil. 
Blanch all the ingredients for the paste for 10 seconds and blend it into a fine paste along with some oil.
In a deep pan pour ghee, add the whole garam masalas and onion. 
Saute until the onion turns translucent and aromatic (around 1 minute) add the ginger garlic paste and saute for 30 seconds or until the raw flavour disappears.
Add the soaked rice. 
Gently mix the rice without breaking it. 
Add the prepared paste.
Pour water, add salt and bring it to a boil.
Reduce the flame to a simmer, cover and cook for 12 minutes. 
Let the rice rest for 10 minutes, fluff it up and serve hot.

title: Breakfast Egg Sandwich
cooking_instructions:
Heat a frying pan, add oil and fry the egg well on both sides.
To assemble the sandwich, apply mayonnaise on 2 slices of bread.
Add the sliced onion, tomato, cucumber.
Place the fried egg on top, add a cheese slice and close the sandwich.
Heat a pan/tawa, add butter and toast the sandwich on a medium flame till golden and crispy.
Add butter to the pan, flip the sandwich and repeat the same.
Cut and serve hot. Enjoy.

title: Pomegranate Shikanji
cooking_instructions:
In a grinder Blend together- pomegranate seeds, lemon, Cumin seeds, black pepper powder, black salt and mint leaves. 
Grind the mixture completely.
Pass the juice through a strainer. 
Top it with ice, club soda, and lemon juice, and serve cold.

title: Apple & Walnut Salad
cooking_instructions:
For the dressing, in a bowl mix together extra virgin olive oil, vinegar, honey, mustard, salt and pepper. 
Mix it well together and keep it aside. 
In a bowl mix together lettuce, apple, onion, walnuts, feta cheese and pomegranate. 
Combine everything together and drizzle the dressing over the dressing. 
Serve cold and enjoy!

title: Maggi Manchurian
cooking_instructions:
Prepare a mixture by mixing all the ingredients listed under batter and add the crushed maggi and vegetables in the batter, add the maggi masala too
Make this into roundels. 
Deep fry them in hot oil until they turn crispy. Keep aside. It will take approximately 6 mins
To make the Manchurian sauce, in a hot pan add oil, finely chopped garlic and fry for a minute. Add the finely chopped onion, green chilli, capsicum and continue to stir fry. 
Once the onion turns light golden and the capsicum is cooked, add soy sauce, tomato sauce, chilli powder, salt and sugar
Mix cornflour and water in a small bowl to make a slurry and add this to the pan. The sauce will start to thicken once the cornflour slurry is added. Add the chopped spring onion. 
Add in the fried manchurian and toss for 30 seconds. Remove from heat and serve it hot as an appetizer

title: Mint Chicken
cooking_instructions:
To the chicken, add maida, cornflour, salt, pepper, MSG, and water
Mix till the chicken is coated with the batter
Prepare a fine paste by blending coriander, mint, green chillies, garlic, shallots, and a little water.
Heat oil in a kadai, deep fry the chicken till golden brown and crispy.
Heat a wok, add the ginger and garlic and saute till it turns light brown.
Add the cashews, curry leaves, dry red chillies and saute for a few seconds.
Add soy sauce and let is sizzle.
Add the mint paste and saute on a high flame for a minute.
Add very little water and mix well.
Add the fried chicken, toss on a high flame till the chicken is coated with the sauce.
Serve it hot and enjoy.

title: Chilli Basil Noodles
cooking_instructions:
In a pan over medium heat add sesame oil, garlic, and red chilli flakes.
Saute until aromatic and the garlic is slightly golden.
Add in cabbage, paneer, and capsicum and saute until softened.
Add the cooked noodles and mix well.
Add soy sauce, red chilli sauce, salt, and black pepper powder.
Mix well until combined.
Add basil leaves, and saute until everything is well combined.
Garnish with spring onions and serve hot.

title: Godhumai Rava Mutton Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Heat oil and ghee in a pot, and add the whole spices.
Add half of the slit green chillies to the pot and add the thinly sliced onions. Cook until the onions are translucent.

Add the ginger garlic paste and continue to cook until the raw smell goes away, around 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and saute until mushy, around 6 minutes on a medium flame. 
Add the coriander and mint leaves and mix to combine. 

Add garam masala, kashmiri red chili powder, coriander powder, salt and curd. Mix well and cook for 2 minutes.
Add lemon juice, and mix well.
Add the kheema and saute until all the water from the kheema has evaporated.
Add 1¼ cups of water and cook the mutton for 10 minutes on medium high heat. 
Once the kheema is 90 percent cooked and almost all the water has evaporated, add 4 cups of water and bring it to a boil. Once boiling, add the samba rava.
Cook for 10 minutes on low heat while stirring gently.
Then turn the flame of and cover, allowing it to rest for 10 mins before opening the pot.
Serve hot with onion raita.

title: Cookd Chettinad Spatchcock
cooking_instructions:
To spatchcock the chicken, remove the backbone with kitchen shears or a knife.
Pat the chicken dry with a paper towel. The drier it is, the crispier the chicken will be
Drizzle oil all over the chicken.
Sprinkle on the Cookd Chettinad Recipe mix and massage the chicken to coat evenly.
Place the lemon slices below the chicken so they can perfume the chicken while baking.
Place the chicken on a baking tray lined with a wire rack.
Bake in a preheated 200ºC oven for 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Vellai Salna
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer jar, add all the ingredients for the paste, blend into a smooth paste, and set aside.
In a Kadhai add all the whole garam masalas, once aromatic (around 10 seconds), add the green chilli, mint and coriander leaves once wilted, add the onions and saute on a moderate flame for 3 minutes or until the edges turn golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste and tomatoes then saute for 2 minutes on a moderate flame or until they turn soft.
Add the chicken saute for 2-3 minutes on a high flame, pour water and bring it to a boil.
Add the prepared paste
Pour water again cover and cook on a low-medium flame for 10 minutes.
Finish the salna with curry leaves and serve hot with dosa, idli or chapathis

title: Aloo Stuffed Paniyaram
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, add the ghee, mustard seeds, curry leaves, and cumin seeds. Let them pop.
Add in the onion and ginger garlic paste and cook till the onion is translucent in color for about 4-5 minutes on medium heat. 
Add the green chillies and mix, followed by turmeric powder, red chili powder, hing, salt, and pepper. 
Let the spices cook on low heat for 3–4 minutes until the raw aroma is gone.
Lastly, add in the potatoes and cook until soft.
well combined for another 3–4 minutes on low heat. Remove it from the heat and keep it aside.
Heat up a Paddu/ Paniyaram pan over medium heat.
Brush oil and add 1 tbsp of the batter.
Add a tsp of the potato mixture and then add more batter to cover it.
Cover and let cook for a minute until bubbles are formed on the top.
Turn the paniyaram and let cook until nice golden brown.
Top it with some melted ghee and podi mixture and serve hot.

title: Italian Fried Rice
cooking_instructions:
In a wok, pour oil and add the sausage, saute until nice and golden brown, remove and set aside.
In the same pan add the diced vegetables(except olives and capsicum) and saute for 30 seconds on a high flame.
Add the rice, sausage, remaining vegetables, seasoning and toss until thoroughly combined. 
Garnish with Parsley and Basil and serve hot.

title: Two Ingredient Chocolate Mousse
cooking_instructions:
Pour the boiling water over the chocolate.
Whisk until the chocolate melts.
Whisk the mixture until thickened, around 8 minutes.

title: Mallika Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
Add the spices required for the masala powder and blend it to a fine powder. Keep it aside
To a mixer grinder, add coriander, mint leaves and green chillies. Blend it to a fine paste and keep it aside
Heat a pot, add ghee.
Add Fennel seeds, cardamom, and Star Anise and let it crackle
Add the onions and saute till it turns golden brown (5 minutes)
Add the Kasuri Methi and Saute for a few seconds

Add ginger garlic paste and mix for a few seconds
Add the blended coriander mint paste and mix for a few seconds
Add kashmiri red chili powder and the spice masala and mix for a minute
Add the mutton and mix it with the masala for 5 minutes on a medium flame
Cover and simmer the mutton for 35 minutes
Open the pot, add the soaked and strained rice.
Seal the pot tightly and place it on a preheated tawa for 15 minutes on a low flame
Turn off the flame, and let it rest for 10 minutes

title: Cookd Tandoori Chicken Tikka (pan)
cooking_instructions:
Combine the tandoori tikka marinade and the cookd tandoori oil with ½ cup (125 g) of curd
Add 750 g of chicken and the diced vegetables to the marinade and mix well till evenly combined and coated.
Refrigerate for 20-30 minutes or upto 4-6 hours for best results 
Heat a pan, add/ brush 1 tsp of oil and pan fry accordingly till cooked throughout.
Sprinkle the Cookd Tangy Seasoning on it.
Serve it hot

title: Cookd Tandoori Paneer Tikka (pan)
cooking_instructions:
Combine the tandoori tikka marinade and the cookd tandoori oil with 1/2 cup (125 g) of curd
Add 700 g of paneer and diced onion and bell peppers to the mixture and mix well till evenly combined and coated.
Refrigerate for 20-30 minutes or upto 4-6 hours for best results.
Heat a pan/ grill pan, add/ brush 1 tsp of oil and grill accordingly till cooked.
Sprinkle the Cookd Tangy Seasoning on it.
Serve it hot.

title: Gajar Ka Halwa Ladoo
cooking_instructions:
Toast the grated coconut in a pan for 5-7 minutes on low heat until golden. 
In a Kadhai, heat the ghee and add the grated Carrots, saute the carrots until they soften, about 5-7 minutes on a medium flame.
Add the milk with the crushed cardamom and continue cooking until the carrots absorb the milk for about 12-15 minutes on low heat.
Mix and cook till the sugar melts and the mixture becomes sticky and the milk is completely absorbed for another 10 minutes on low heat, and add in the freshly grated coconut. Mix well.

Lastly, add in the chopped dry fruits and cook it for another 1-2 minutes. 
Let it cool completely before forming the ladoos and enjoy!

title: Cinnamon Toastie
cooking_instructions:
Take two slices, apply butter on one side and cream cheese on the other. 
Sprinkle the brown sugar and cinnamon powder and spread it evenly. 
Cover with the second slice
Apply butter on both sides. 
Toast it on a pan for 2-3 minutes on each side on a low flame or till golden brown.

title: Cookd Madurai Potlam Kari Soru
cooking_instructions:
To a pan with a little oil, add your curry leaves.
Once they've crisped up, add in your onions and green chillies and cook until they soften and turn lightly golden.
Then add in the mutton and sauté on a high heat. 
Once almost all the water from the mutton has evaporated, add in your Cookd Madurai Chukka Masala and mix to combine thoroughly.
Add in the water and allow it to come to a simmer.
Cook for 35 minutes or until the mutton is completely cooked and tender.
Reduce the gravy until it is very thick.
Add the rice to the pan and toss to coat with the gravy.
Add salt, black pepper, ghee, lemon juice, and coriander leaves. Mix the rice to combine the flavour.
Over an open flame, heat the banana leaf until it becomes malleable and flexible. 
Place the kari soru on the banana leaf and wrap it tightly to encompass the rice. 
Place the wrapped rice on a hot tawa and cook it for 5 minutes on each side, on a medium high heat. 
Once lightly browned on both sides remove from the heat and let it rest for 2 minutes before cutting it open and enjoying!

title: Soya Kheema
cooking_instructions:
Mince your soaked soya until it forms small, chunky pieces.
To a preheated pan, add your oil and whole spices.
Once they’re fragrant, add in the onion, green chili, and salt. Saute on medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes or until they start to turn golden brown.

Add the ginger garlic paste and cook on a medium heat for 2 minutes or until the raw smell disappears.
Add in the soya mince and mix to combine. Cook until almost all the water from the soya evaporates, around 5-6 minutes on medium-high heat.
Then add in the spice powders and mix to coat the soya.
Add water and bring to a simmer. Simmer covered for 10 minutes.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve with rice

title: Shawarma Rice Bowl (diet friendly)
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the marinade and mix thoroughly.
Let the chicken marinate for 30 mins 
Grill the chicken on a medium flame for 8 minutes 
In a blender jar add all the ingredients for the sauce and blend until fine
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the salad and mix thoroughly 
In a kadhai or deep pan, pour olive oil add the whole garam masalas and saute for 10 seconds on a moderate flame.
Add the soaked basmati rice and saute gently making sure you don’t break the grains
Pour water and add turmeric powder, salt and saffron.
Bring it to a boil and reduce the heat to a simmer.
Cover and cook for 12 minutes.
Serve the chicken along with the rice and sauce.

title: Cookd Malai Chicken Tikka (Pan)
cooking_instructions:
Combine the Malai tikka marinade and the Cookd tandoori oil with 1/4 cup (90 g) of curd.
Add 500 g of chicken to the mixture and mix well till evenly combined and coated.
Refrigerate for 20-30 minutes or upto 4-6 hours for best results.
Heat a pan/ tawa, add/ brush 1 tsp of oil and grill the chicken and vegetables accordingly till cooked.
Sprinkle the Cookd Tangy Seasoning on it.
Serve it hot

title: Cookd Malai Paneer Tikka (pan)
cooking_instructions:
Combine the Malai tikka marinade and the cookd tandoori oil with 1/4 cup (90 g) of curd
Add 500 g of paneer, diced onion and capsicum to the mixture and mix well till evenly combined and coated
Refrigerate for 20-30 minutes or upto 4-6 hours for best results 
Heat a pan/ tawa, add/ brush 1 tsp of oil and grill accordingly till cooked.
Brush the tandoor oil on the tikkas and sprinkle the Cookd Tangy Seasoning on it.
Serve it hot.

title: White BBQ Chicken Wings
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, add all the ingredients for the sauce, mix thoroughly, and set aside.
In a mixing bowl add chicken wings and salt, and marinate for 1 hour in a refrigerator.
