Deep fry the chicken on a moderate flame for 8 minutes, increase the flame to high, and deep fry for 2-3 more minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
In a mixing bowl add the chicken and white sauce, toss until thoroughly combined and serve.

title: Jam Cookies
cooking_instructions:
To a bowl, add the butter and sugar and whisk till creamy and combined.
Add the egg yolk and vanilla essence and mix till combines.
Sieve in the flour and salt and mix till a dough forms.
Cover and refrigerate the dough for 30 minutes.
To a bowl, whisk jam.
Take out the dough, divide and roll it into even sized balls.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the dough balls spaced out. 
Flatten it slightly and create a crater in the middle with your thumb.
Add 1 tbsp of the whisked jam to the crater in the cookie.
Bake the cookies at 180 degrees Celsius for 12 minutes.
Take it out and let it cool down.
Garnish it with the toppings of your choice (powdered sugar, sprinkles etc,.)

title: Spicy Chilli Paneer
cooking_instructions:
To a bowl, add dry red chillies and hot water. Immerse the chillies and let it soak for 10 minutes
Transfer the soaked chillies to a blender, add chopped ginger and garlic. Add a little bit of the chilli soaked water and blend it to a fine paste
To a bowl, add the diced paneer, cornflour, maida, salt, black pepper powder and water. 
Mix till the paneer is coated with the batter.
Heat oil in a kadai and deep fry the paneer till golden and crispy.
Heat a pan/wok, add the chopped ginger and garlic. Saute for a few seconds
Add the spring onion whites and saute for a few seconds.
Add the chilli paste and cook on a medium heat till for 2 minutes.
Add the diced onion and capsicum and toss on a high flame for a few seconds.
Add soy sauce and ketchup, mix till combined.
Add water, salt, mix and bring the sauce to a boil.
Add the fried paneer and toss on a high flame till it is coated with the sauce.
Add chopped spring onions, give it one final toss and take if off the flame.
Serve it hot.

title: Eggless Vanilla Muffins
cooking_instructions:
Combine ¾ cup of yogurt and ¼ cup of oil in a large bowl.
Add vanilla extract to the mixture and whisk until smooth.
In another bowl, sift together flour, powdered sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and a pinch of salt.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the yogurt-oil mixture, stirring well to combine.
Pour in ¼ cup of water and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Fill cupcake liners two-thirds to three-quarters full with the batter.
Tap the filled liners twice to level the batter and remove air bubbles.
Bake the cupcakes at 180°C (356°F) for 15 minutes.
Allow the cupcakes to cool completely before serving.
Enjoy your delicious vanilla cupcakes whenever desired!

title: Creme Brulee
cooking_instructions:
In a pot, add cream and sugar.
Once hot but not boiling, remove the cream from the heat.
In a separate bowl, whisk your egg yolks.
Gently pour the hot cream, in a slow stream, into the bowl of egg yolks while whisking. This is called tempering.
Once all the cream has been added, pass the mixture through a sieve to remove air bubbles and any eggs that might have curdled.
Add the vanilla extract and mix with a spatula to combine.
Prepare a tray with ramekins. 
Pour the creme brulee mixture to the top of the ramekins and place the tray in a preheated 150°C oven.
Pour boiling water around the ramekins and into the tray to make a water bath.
Bake for 35–40 minutes, or until just set in the centre.
Once baked, let cool and then place in the fridge for at least 4 hours and up to overnight
To make the brulee topping, add some sugar and water to a pan and cook on a medium flame until amber in colour. 
Remove the caramel from the flame and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Remove the cooled creme brulee from the fridge and pour the caramel over the surface of the ramekin.
Let the sugar completely cool and harden before serving.

title: Pirandai Chutney
cooking_instructions:
String the Pirandai and cut it into small pieces. 
In a kadhai, pour oil, add the shallots, and green chillies, and saute on a moderate flame for 2 minutes or until the shallots turn translucent. 
Add the tamarind, cumin seeds and coriander seeds, saute on a moderate flame until the raw flavour disappears (around 3-4 minutes), and set aside.
In the same kadhai, add the cut Pirandai and saute on a medium heat until it turns golden brown, around 6 minutes. Then add the grated coconut and saute for 30 seconds. 
Transfer all the ingredients into a blender along with salt and blend into a paste.
Add water when required.
Enjoy with steaming hot idlis!

title: Chocolate Cake Pressure Cooker
cooking_instructions:
Sieve the maida, cocoa powder and baking soda together. Add the powdered sugar and salt. 
Make a hole in the center and add oil, vinegar, vanilla essence, and warm water. 
Mix until there are no lumps. 
Pour the cake mixture into a well greased pressure cake mould. 
Add salt to the cooker and add a base to keep the cake mould. 
Don’t add the whistle to the pressure, so that the steam can escape from the pressure cooker. 
Place the pressure cooker on low heat for 45 minutes. 
For the frosting, add the chocolate and cream to a bowl. Place the bowl over a pot of boiling water and mix it until it melts. 
Take off the heat and allow it to refrigerate for 1 hour or until it thickens. 
Apply it over the cake. 
Additionally, you can also decorate it with strawberries or chocolate decorations.

title: Pacha Puli Rasam
cooking_instructions: In a bowl add tamarind along with water and let it soak for 15-20 minutes
In a pestle and mortar crush the peppercorns, cumin seeds, shallots, and garlic with rock salt.

Once the tamarind is soaked, squeeze out the pulp, strain the water, and set aside.
Finely chop the coriander leaves and green chilli. 
Mix these ingredients to the strained tamarind water and serve with rice.

title: Kettle Egg Fried Rice
cooking_instructions:
Turn the kettle on and add oil and the garlic. It should start to sizzle.
If its getting too hot, turn the kettle off and the eggs.
Keep mixing the eggs with a spoon to scramble them.
Once the eggs have set, add the cooked rice, close the lids and shake.
Add the salt, ketchup and soy sauce and shake once more to evenly coat the rice with the seasonings.

title: Cookd Wedding Chicken Biryani (Instant Pot)
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak basmati Rice for 20 mins.

Turn on an instant pot, click on saute mode.
Add the cookd wedding biryani Paste and let it heat up.
Add the chicken pieces and mix till combined.

Add the soaked and strained rice.
Add 1 ½ Cup (375 ml) water.
Give it a gentle mix.
Close the pot, set it on biryani mode or set the timer to 15 minutes on medium cooking mode.
Once the timer is done let it rest for 10 minutes.

Release the pressure from the instant pot and open it.
Add the seasoning oil and fluff the rice.

title: Banana Leaf Fish Fry
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl add everything for marination and mix well until fully mixed.
Add your fish filet mix with your prepared marination.
Let it marinate for 15 minutes in the fridge.
Heat up a banana leaf and place it on a table.
Add one fish filet and place a sprig of curry leaf on top.
Wrap the leaf tightly and tie it with a rope.
Heat up a tawa, add oil and place the wrapped banana leaf parcel on it and cook it on a medium flame. Add water to create steam and cook it well.
Flip it and cook it for a few more minutes and take it off the flame.
Open the leaf and serve it hot.

title: Fig Jam
cooking_instructions:
In a pan over medium heat add the fig and sugar.
Keep mixing it until the sugar fully dissolves.
Keep stirring until the fig is cooked throughout and soft.
Add the vinegar, lemon juice and mix properly.
Optionally add thyme and mix throughout.
Finish off with salt and store it in an airtight container.

title: Mushroom and Spinach Pasta
cooking_instructions:
In a pan add the mushroom, saute them till they release all the moisture. 
Add the onion, oil and butter and saute it till the onion is translucent. 
Add in the garlic and continue to saute for another 3-4 minutes on medium flame. 
Add the cream along with the pasta water and incorporate well. 
Add the spinach and coat it evenly with the sauce and cook for 2-3 minutes of  high flame while constantly stirring. 
Add the pepper, salt, oregano 
Add boiled pasta and give everything a good mix. 
Finish it off with grated cheese and enjoy hot.

title: Salem Thatta Vadai
cooking_instructions:
Toast the urad dal in a pan on medium heat until deeply golden brown. 
Allow it cool for a minute before adding it to a blender along with roasted channa dal. 
Blend until it is a fine powder.
In a bowl, add all the ingredients required for the thatta vadai. Then strain the urad dal mixture and add it to the bowl.
Add the water and knead it into a smooth dough. 
Portion out the dough into small, even sized balls. 
Lightly oil 2 small banana leaves. Place one of the balls between the two leaves and apply even pressure using a flat surface like a dabrah. 
Press down into a circle that is of an even thickness of around ½ cm.
Deep fry them in hot oil until they are deeply golden brown and crispy.
Remove them from the oil and drain on paper towels.
To a mortar and pestle, add garlic, shallots and dry red chilli. Process them until they have been crushed and are fragrant. 
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and add sesame seeds and salt. 
In a pan, heat up coconut oil until it is hot and just smoking. Pour this hot oil into the bowl and let it steep. 
To a pan, add oil. Once hot, add the shallots and garlic. Saute for 3 minutes, or until lightly golden and starting to soften. 
Then add the dry red chilli and toast for 30 seconds, until fragrant. 
Add the tomatoes and cook on a high heat for 5-6 minutes. The tomatoes will become soft and mushy. 
Remove from the heat and let it cool slightly before blending into a smooth paste.
Add all the ingredients required into a blender and blend until a smooth chutney is formed. 
Grate everything and toss.

title: Kunukku
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl, add all the dals and rice, pour water wash it thoroughly, and let them soak for at least 1 hour, preferably overnight. 
Add the soaked dals and rice to a mixer jar along with ¼ cup water and the dry red chillies and blend into a coarse paste.
Add all the other ingredients to the batter and mix thoroughly.
Portion it into small pieces and deep fry until golden brown and crispy. 
Serve hot.

title: Hariyali Paneer Tikka Gravy
cooking_instructions: In a mixer jar, add all the ingredients for the sauce and blend to a smooth paste.
Add some ghee in the pan and fry the paneer until it develops some colour, allow it to char a bit and get golden brown.

Pour in the sauce, cover, and simmer for 10 mins. 
Add the paneer and simmer for a minute. 
Use a piece of coal to smoke the gravy for about 2 mins. 
Finish with chaat masala, butter and fresh cream.

title: Pressure Cooker Pizza
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl, pour water and add yeast, let it bloom for 15 mins
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the dough and knead for 10 minutes until a smooth and supple dough forms, (add flour if the dough is very sticky)
Cover and let the dough rise for 1 hour or until doubled in size.
Once the dough has risen, punch it down to release the air and divide it into 4 portions for individual pizzas.
Roll out each portion into a round shape on a floured surface.
Spread pizza sauce evenly over each rolled-out dough.
Sprinkle-grated mozzarella cheese, Italian seasoning, corn, diced onion, tomato, and capsicum over the cheese. 
Shift this pizza to a floured butter paper and keep that butter paper on a pressure cooker-safe base/plate. 
Add a base to the pressure cooker and keep the pizza on that additional base. 
Cook this on high flame for 8 minutes and the next 8 minutes on low heat. 
Make sure not to add a whistle to the cooker. 
Cook completely and enjoy hot!

title: Gym Bro Chicken Pizza
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the chicken base and mix thoroughly. 
In a non-stick pan apply oil and shape the prepared chicken into a circle.
Cook one side on a high flame for 2-3 minutes or until browned. 
Flip the chicken.
Add the pizza sauce, add the veggies, sprinkle the red chilli flakes and pizza seasoning, and finally add cheese.
Cover and cook on a simmer for 5 minutes or until the cheese is completely melted and the chicken is cooked through. 
Slice and serve hot.

title: Cookd Ambur Chicken Biryani (Instant Pot)
cooking_instructions:
Turn on an instant pot, click on saute mode.
Add the Cookd Ambur Biryani paste and let it heat up.
Add the chicken pieces and mix till combined.
Add 1 ½ Cup (350 ml) water and bring it to a boil.
Add the soaked and strained rice.
Give it a gentle mix.
Close the pot, set it on biryani mode or set the timer to 15 minutes on medium cooking mode.
Once the timer is done let it rest for 10 minutes.
Release the pressure from the instant pot and open it.
Add the seasoning oil and fluff the rice.

title: Cookd Dindigul Chicken Biryani (Instant Pot)
cooking_instructions:
Turn on an instant pot, click on saute mode.
Add the Cookd Dindigul Biryani paste and let it heat up.
Add the chicken pieces and mix till combined.
Add 1 ½ Cup (350 ml) water and bring it to a boil.
Add the soaked and strained rice. Give it a gentle mix.
Close the pot, set it on biryani mode or set the timer to 15 minutes on medium cooking mode.
Once the timer is done let it rest for 10 minutes.
Release the pressure from the instant pot and open it.
Add the seasoning oil and fluff the rice.

title: Pressure Cooked Tandoori Chicken
cooking_instructions:
In a large bowl, add the curd, Cookd Tandoori Oil and Cook Tandoori Tikka Marinade. 
Whisk it until its combined well.
Add the chicken to the bowl and apply the marinade all over the chicken. 
Optionally, tie the chicken up using butcher’s twine. 
Let it marinade in the fridge for at least 30 minutes and upto overnight.
In a pressure cooker, place a small stand to elevate the chicken from the base of the cooker
Pour water into the cooker so the base is just covered with water.
Place the chicken on the stand and place the cooker on the stove. 
Once steam has started to form, close the cooker and place the whistle.
Cook on a medium flame for 25 minutes. 
Once 25 minutes have passed, turn the flame off and let the pressure release naturally.
Open the cooker and carefully remove the chicken, making sure to drain any liquid from the cavity.
Place the chicken on a chapati grill and chargrill the chicken for 5 minutes on each side, or until lightly charred.
Sprinkle some Cookd Tangy Seasoning on the Tandoori Chicken.

title: Mochaikottai Mutton Kurma
cooking_instructions:
In a pan over medium heat add oil, cinnamon, cardamom, clove, fennel seeds, cumin seeds.
Saute for a minute until aromatic.
Add the onions and saute until translucent.
Add the green chilli  and saute. 
Add the coriander leaves and mint leaves.
Saute until the leaves wilt and soften.
Turn off the heat and add poppy seeds and coconut.
Mix it until everything combines.
Let cool and blend into a fine paste.
In a cooker add mutton, water, salt, turmeric powder and ginger garlic paste.
Mix well and let it cook on a medium heat for 4 whistles/ until the mutton is tender and cooked.
Once cooked, retain all the liquid from the cooking.
In a pan add oil, bay leaf and onion.
Saute until the onion is light golden brown.
Add the mochai and saute on high heat for 10 minutes or until the mochai is splitting into two.
Add the prepared paste and saute for a minute.
Add the cooked mutton along with any cooking liquid that is left behind.
Mix everything until combined.
Add water and let it reach a boil.
Add salt, tomato and let it boil for 5 minutes.
Remove it from heat and serve hot.

title: Cookd Pallipalayam Rice & Chicken Thokku
cooking_instructions:
In a pan pour peanut oil and add the onion, saute for 10 seconds. 
Add the chicken and saute for 30 seconds on a moderate flame.
Add the cookd madurai chukka masala and saute for 10 seconds.
Pour water and curry leaves, and cook on a moderate flame for 12 minutes or until the chicken is tender and set aside.
In a kadai or wok, pour coconut oil.
Add mustard seeds and let it splutter, add urad dal and saute until golden brown.
Add the dry red chilli, green chillies and onion, saute for 10 seconds or until the onion is translucent.
Add the cooked rice, curry leaves and give it a mix.
Add the Cookd Pallipalayam Masala and mix thoroughly.
Add salt, coriander leaves, give it one final mix and take it off the flame.
Serve it hot side by side.

title: Cookd Tandoori Tikka Pasta
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl, add the chicken, curd, cookd tandoori tikka marinade and tandoori oil.
Mix till combined and marinate for at least 30 mins.
In a pan, pour oil and grill the chicken on a high heat (you don’t have to cook the chicken thoroughly) and set aside
In a pan pour ghee, add the capsicum and saute for 10 seconds on a moderate flame.
Add the cookd butter masala gravy, and saute for 10 seconds. 
Pour water and bring it to a boil.
Add the cooked pasta and the cooked tikka to the pan and mix thoroughly. 
Finish the pasta with cream and coriander leaves.

title: Cookd Dindigul Tawa Mutton Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the basmati rice for 30 mins.
In a pressure cooker add the cookd dindigul biryani paste and saute for 10 seconds.
Pour water and bring it to a boil.
Add the soaked rice and pressure cook on a moderate flame for 2 whistles (10 minutes) and set aside.
In a pressure cooker add the cookd dindigul biryani paste and saute for 10 seconds.
Pour water and bring it to a boil.
Add the soaked rice and pressure cook on a moderate flame for 2 whistles (10 minutes) and set aside.
In a pressure cooker, pour peanut oil and onion, saute for 10 seconds.
Add the mutton and the cookd madurai chukka masala, pour water and pressure cook on a moderate flame for 8 whistles or until tender.
To make the tawa biryani, pour ghee on a tawa.
Add the onion, tomato and curry leaves, and saute for 10 seconds on a moderate flame.
Add the prepared kuska and mix thoroughly.
Pour the prepared chukka gravy and pound the tawa biryani together.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Garlic Kebab
cooking_instructions:
In a blender, add garlic, ginger, green chilli , cinamon, cloves, and curry leaves.
Blend until a thick coarse paste is formed.
In a bowl add Rice flour, Corn flour, Maida, gram flour, turmeric powder, salt, kasuri methi, oil, curd and egg.
Add your prepared paste and mix well until everything is incorporated.
Add your chicken and mix well.
Let marinate in the fridge for a minimum of 60 minutes.
Heat up oil over medium heat and fry the marinated chicken until golden brown, crispy, and cooked throughout.
Garnish with fried curry leaves and serve hot.

title: Selavu Rasam
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, add gingelly oil along with the shallots. 
Saute for 3 minutes, or until lightly golden and starting to soften. Then add the whole spices, curry leaves and garlic. 
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until fragrant. 
Transfer the mixture to a blender along with the gundu chilli, turmeric and water. 
Blend into a smooth paste. 
In a kadai, heat gingelly oil.
Add mustard seeds and curry leaves, and let them splatter.
Add the paste and water and mix to combine well. 
Bring the rasam to a single boil before switching it off and garnishing with coriander leaves. 
Serve hot with ghee rice!

title: Oats Fried Rice
cooking_instructions:
Dry roast the oats until a nutty aroma comes; keep mixing it for 3-4 minutes on low flame. 
Sprinkle some water over it, cover it, and keep it for the oats to cook. Open in 2 minutes and continue cooking for another minute until all the water is absorbed. 
Remove it from heat and keep it aside. 
Heat the oil in a pan and add the crushed garlic. 
Add in the onions and cook it until translucent, then add in the carrot and cabbage and cook them for another 3-4 minutes on medium flame or until they shrink. 
Add the capsicum, carrot, and cabbage and mix it well
Add the oats, soya sauce, salt, and pepper. 
Mix well, and serve hot.

title: Thakkali Thokku Pasta
cooking_instructions:
Heat water in a deep pot, add salt, and bring it to a boil.
Strain the pasta, and reserve some of the water.
Coat the pasta with oil and keep it aside.
Heat Oil in a kadai, add mustard, cumin, green chilli and curry leaves. Let it crackle.
Add the sliced onions and saute till it turns golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute.
Add the tomatoes and let it cook till it is mashed and oil is released from the sides.
Add the spice powders and saute till it loses its raw flavour.
Season it with salt, black pepper powder and tomato ketchup. Mix it well.
Add chopped coriander leaves. Mix well and serve it hot.

title: No-Dal Tadka
cooking_instructions:
Peel and chop the potato into large chunks. 
Add 1 cup water, salt and turmeric powder. Pressure cook for 5-6 whistles. 
Open the cooker after the pressure settles and then mash the potatoes completely. 
In a tadka pan, heat ghee and splutter mustard seeds. 
Add dry red chilli, curry leaves, asafoetida and mix. Add this into the no-dal. 
You can adjust the salt and consistency with ½ Cup water, if needed. 
Bring the no-dal to a boil. 
Finish with fresh, chopped coriander leaves and more ghee, if desired. 
Serve hot with rice and ghee.

title: Kettle Chicken Thokku
cooking_instructions:
Turn the kettle on and add the oil, the onion, and the green chilli. It should start to sizzle.
If its getting too hot, turn the kettle off and stir with a spoon. 
Once the onions have softened, around 1 minutes, add salt, followed by the tomato. 
Keep cooking the onion tomato mixture until the tomatoes become soft and mushy.
Then add the chicken, rasam powder and red chilli powder. Give it a quick stir and add water. 
Allow the kettle to boil for 10-15 minutes. Once the chicken and the spices have cooked, keep boiling until the gravy becomes thick, like a thokku
Turn the kettle off and enjoy hot!

title: Bachelor Chicken Masala
cooking_instructions:
Add all the ingredients for marination and mix it well until everything combines with the chicken. Set aside.

In a cooker over medium heat add gingelly oil, once hot add green chillies, red chillies, cloves, cumin seeds, green cardamom, black peppercorn, cinnamon and bay leaf.
Saute until aromatic.
Add the onions and saute until golden brown.
Add the ginger garlic paste and saute until the raw smell disappears.
Add the tomatoes and saute until soft.
Add all the powdered spices and continue cooking until the oil starts to separate.
Add the chicken and mix well until everything is mixed throughout.
Add water and salt and cook it for 2 whistles or until the chicken is cooked throughout.
Optionally you can garnish with coriander leaves and enjoy.

title: PCOS Friendly Energy Boosters
cooking_instructions:
Toast the oats in a dry pan on a medium low heat for around 4 minutes.
Add all the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth and combined.
Roll the mixture into even sized balls

title: Meen Semiya
cooking_instructions:
Add the dry red chili, ginger and garlic to a bowl. Pour hot water into the bowl and let the chillis steep and soften until the water cools. 
Transfer the solids to a blender along with a little bit of the soaking liquid and blend into a smooth but thick paste. 
Add 3 tablespoons of the marinade to a plate along with the fish and marinate for at least 30 minutes and upto overnight.
Reserve the remaining marinade and add a little water to thin it out. 
In a hot non-stick pan, add oil followed by the marinated fish steaks. 
Sear on a medium high heat for 3 minutes on each side, or until deeply golden brown on both sides.
In a hot iron tawa, add oil, followed by onion, green chilli, and curry leaves.
Saute for 5-6 minutes on a medium heat, or until the onions start to turn lightly golden. 
Then add the tomatoes and start to chop them with the spatula. 
Add the fish marinade and cook until tha raw taste goes.
Once the tomatoes become mushy, make a well in the centre and crack an egg. Let the egg set for 10 - 15 seconds before scrambling it. 
Tear and add the idiyappam and chunks of the fish fry. Chop and combine using the spatula, to ensure everything is evenly coated. 
Cook the mixture for an additional 2 minutes before garnishing with coriander leaves.

title: Curry Leaf Prawn
cooking_instructions:
Deep fry the curry leaves until crispy and set aside.
In a mixer jar, add all the ingredients for the paste, blend into a paste, and set aside.
In a wok/ kadhai, pour oil and add the onion, green chilli, curry leaves, and ginger garlic paste cook on a high flame for 2 minutes or until the onions turn translucent and fragrant. 
Add the prawns and cook on a high flame for 30 seconds 
Add the prepared paste and salt, and cook for another 2 minutes.
Finish the dish with black pepper and coriander leaves, and serve hot.

title: Cookd Tandoori Tikka Biryani
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl, add all the required ingredients for the tandoori tikka, mix and marinate for at least 30 mins.
In a pan, pour oil and grill the chicken on a high heat (you don’t have to cook the chicken thoroughly) and set aside.
In a pressure cooker, add the cookd wedding biryani paste, and saute for 30 seconds.
Add the soaked basmati rice, pour water and bring it to a boil. 
Add the seared chicken, and pressure cook on a moderate flame for 2 whistles (around 10 mins).
Open the cooker, gently fluff the biryani and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Chettinad 65 Fried Rice
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the chicken 65 and mix thoroughly. 
Deep fry on a high heat for 3 minutes until crispy and set aside.

In a wok, pour oil add cashews and dry red chilli, and saute on a moderate flame for 30 seconds or until golden brown.
Add ginger, and garlic, and saute for 10 seconds or until aromatic
Break in 2 eggs and scramble.

Add the carrot, cabbage, and onion, and saute for 20 seconds.
Add the capsicum and soya sauce and mix it well

Add the cooked rice, Cookd Chettinadu masala, and black pepper powder and mix thoroughly.
Garnish with spring onion greens and coriander leaves.

title: Green Chutney Powder
cooking_instructions: Add all the ingredients for the chutney powder in a mixer grinder and blend to a fine powder by pulse blending and mixing inbetween to ensure it is even.

For the tempering, in a small vessel add a small qty of oil. Add the mustard seeds and let them splutter. Add the curry leaves and the red chilli bits. Mix and switch off the flame. 
Add the tempering in the powder and mix well. 
Add 1 tbsp of the powder for ¼ Cup of water and mix to make chutney. You can adjust the consistency as desired. 
Store for 2-3 weeks in the fridge.

title: No-Oven Dominos Garlic Bread
cooking_instructions:
In a glass, mix together water, yeast, and sugar. Mix well and set it aside for 10 minutes.
In a bowl, mix maida, garlic, salt, and olive oil. 
Make a well in the center, and add the yeast mixture in the middle. Start adding a little bit of flour to the wet mixture. 
Continue doing this until all the flour is mixed in, and a shaggy dough is formed. 
Knead well until a smooth dough forms, about 10 mins. 
Brush a little more olive oil on the smooth dough, cover with a damp cloth, and allow it to rise for 1 ½ to 2 hours. 
In the meantime, in a bowl add the melted butter and garlic. Mix it well and keep it aside. 
In a separate bowl, mix all the ingredients to make the oregano seasoning. Mix well, and keep the dry spice mix aside.
It would've doubled in size after resting the dough for 2 hours. 
Lightly knead the risen dough again. Divide into 4 portions.
Roll out into thick discs. 
Spread some garlic butter on one side of the dough and fold in half to form a semi-circle shape.
Brush the top generously with garlic butter and the prepared oregano seasoning. 
Cut the bread gently into 2-inch thick slices, without cutting all the way to the bottom.
Place the pressure cooker on high flame for 5 minutes to preheat the cooker, without the whistle and the lid ring. 
Place a base to the pressure cooker and keep the garlic bread on that additional base. 
Cook this on low flame for 18-20 minutes. 
Make sure not to add a whistle and the lid ring to the cooker. 
Tilt the cooker and take out the garlic bread with the help of a flat spatula. 
For the cheese spread, add all the ingredients in a mixer, pulse, and blend until smooth and well combined. 
Enjoy hot garlic bread with a homemade cheese spread.

title: Butter Garlic Chicken
cooking_instructions:
Score and marinate the chicken with salt, black pepper powder, and lemon juice.
Heat a pan, add butter and sear the chicken on a medium-low flame for 4 minutes on each side and take it off the pan.
Heat a pan, butter and let it melt.
Add chopped garlic and saute till it turns light brown.
Add water, mix it till the residue sticking on the pan is clear.
Add salt, black pepper powder, and more butter, and mix in a low flame till it combines and becomes a sauce.
Add the seared chicken and baste it with the sauce. Cook it for 5 minutes on a low flame and take it off the flame.
Serve it hot with bread or buttered rice.

title: Chicken Samosa
cooking_instructions:
In a pan heat oil, add the onions and saute until translucent for 3-4 minutes on medium heat. 
Add the green chili along with the ginger garlic paste. Combine well, and reduce the flame to low. 
Add in all the powdered spices. 
Mix well ensuring they don’t burn.
Add in the chicken and mix well until everything is coated evenly. 
Cover it for 5-7 minutes on low flame and let the chicken cook and release its water. 
If your chicken starts to touch at the bottom of the pan, add ½ cup water. 
Once you open the Kadhai, if there is still any water in the Kadhai, increase the flame to high and reduce all the water. 
Keep it aside. 
Take a samosa sheet, place a tbsp of the filling on one end and start folding the sheet like a triangle, as shown in the video. 
Dip your finger in water and apply it on the edges to seal the samosa. 
Heat oil in a kadhai, and add the samosas carefully to the oil.
Fry until crispy and golden brown on the outside for 4-5 minutes on low heat.

title: Hot Crispy Wings
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, add everything for marination and mix well.
Add the chicken wings and marinate for a minimum of 60 minutes or up to overnight.
Take a wing, coat it with maida, dip it back in the marinade, and finally cover it with maida. 
Dust downwards to ensure there is no excess flour and to form the crispy coating.
Heat oil on a medium flame and add the coated chicken wings and fry until golden brown and crispy. 
About 6-7 mins. 
Serve hot and enjoy.

title: Cheesy Chicken Kebab
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl combine all the ingredients for the chicken mixture.
Mix until thoroughly combined. 
Shape the mixture into balls, and flatten it into circles.
Fill the center with a tablespoon of mozzarella cheese, close the kebab and flatten gently.
In a pan, pour ghee and cook on a moderate flame for 3 minutes on each side. 
Serve hot.

title: Kettle Cupcake
cooking_instructions:
Add the egg and sugar to a bowl and beat thoroughly with a fork. Beat it for around 3 minutes, or until the mixture becomes thick, fluffy and pale. 
Add the oil the the bowl and whisk to incorporate.
Add the maida and coffee powder to the mixture and gently mix to incorporate. At this point the mixture should become nice and thick.
Add half the banana and mash it into the mixture. Once combine, pour in the milk and whisk to incorporate it. The batter should be nice and loose.
Once the batter has come to the correct consistency, add the chocolate and eno. Mix to combine well.
Grease a small metal vessel that fits inside the kettle and pour the batter halfway up the vessel.
Gently tap the vessel against a flat surface to even out the surface.
Pour some water into the kettle and place the cupcake into the kettle. The water should just barely come up the side of the vessel. 
Turn the kettle on and let the cupcake steam for 8 minutes. 
Once it is done cooking, the surface should be smooth and when poked, the cupcake should feel springy.

title: Cheesy Spring Rolls
cooking_instructions:
To a bowl, add cheese, mint, salt and sesame seeds. Mix them well to combine.
Set the filling aside and prepare your spring roll sheets.
On a clean surface, lay out the spring roll wrapper and place the filling near the bottom corner. Roll tightly to form a spring roll.
To seal the spring roll, apply a small amount of slurry to the exposed corner and stick.
In a pan, add enough oil to cover the surface. 
Once hot, add in the spring rolls and fry until golden brown and crispy on one side, around 2-3 minutes.
Rotate the spring rolls and repeat the process until the entire exterior is deeply golden brown and crispy.

title: Chicken & Cheese Kebab
cooking_instructions:
To a blender, add all the ingredients and pulse them until combined and becomes a smooth mixture.
Transfer it to a bowl, add besan flour and mix till combined.
To a bowl add eggs, add maida to it and whisk till combined.
Add Breadcrumbs to another bowl.
Oil your palms, take a portion of the chicken mixture, stuff it with a cheese dies and shape it into a cylinder.
Coat it in the egg mixture and then in the bread crumbs.
Repeat the same till all the mixture is used up.
Heat oil in a kadai.
Deep fry the kebabs on a medium flame till golden brown and crispy.
Serve it hot with a dip of your choice.

title: Bangalore Sambar
cooking_instructions:
Wash the toor dal until the water runs clean.
Add water and set it aside to soak for a minimum of 30 minutes.
After soaking, drain and add the dal in a pressure cooker. Add water and let cook for 4 whistles, or until the dal is soft and can be mashed with ease.
Mash your dal and set it aside.
In a pan, add oil, once warm, add Cinnamon, coriander seeds, chana dal, and all your chillies. 
Saute it on low heat until aromatic. Set aside to cool.
In the same pan, add shallots and tomatoes, and saute it until mushy and soft.
Blend this with the spices into a fine paste,
In a bowl, add tamarind and water, and let it soak for 15 mins.
In a kadai/ pan, add oil, shallots and saute until soft , add the prepared paste and saute along with the shallots.
Strain the tamarind paste, add it to the kadai and let it reach a boil. 
Add jaggery and keep stirring it until completely dissolved.
Add the mashed dal and mix everything together.
Add salt and let it reach a boil.
Garnish it with coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Liquid Pizza
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the batter.
Whisk into a thick but smooth batter.
In a non-stick pan, pour olive oil and add the batter. 
Spread it evenly, cover and cook on a low flame for 3 minutes.
Once cooked and golden brown, flip the pizza.
Add the tomato sauce and spread it into an even layer, add the toppings of your choice and add cheese. 
Cover and cook on a simmer for 3 minutes or until the cheese is melted. 
Serve hot.

title: Falooda
cooking_instructions:
In a pot, add water and bring it to a boil. 
Add the vermicelli and let it cook for 5-7 minutes on high heat. Drain the water and keep it aside to cool. 
In a bowl add the basil seeds and water and keep it aside for 5 minutes until the basil seeds bloom. 
In another bowl, add the milk and the rose syrup. Give it a mix and keep it aside. 
In a glass, add a tbsp of vermicelli, followed by apple, grape, tutti fruity, and basil seeds. You can add them in your desired quantity, or else add a tablespoon of each in the glass. 
Add a tbsp of rose syrup, along with 1 scoop of Ice cream, Add ¼ cup of the prepared rose milk, and repeat this process. 
Add the tutti frutti, jelly, vermicelli, ice cream, apple, grape, basil seeds, rose milk, rose syrup and tutti frutti. 
Serve this cold and enjoy!

title: Dumroot Halwa
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the dal for 2 hours.
Soak the cashew and almonds for 20 minutes.
Blend them into a fine paste.
Heat a kadai. Add Rava and roast it till the raw flavour is gone.
Add milk and mix till it combines and the mixture becomes thick.
Add sugar and mix till it dissolves and the mixture becomes slightly liquidy again.
Keep mixing till all the sugar has dissolved.
Add ghee and mix till combined. 
Add food colour (optional) and mix till combined evenly.
Keep mixing continuously till the mixture doesn’t stick to the pan.
Transfer it to a mould.
Bake it at 180 degrees for 20 minutes till a crust has formed on top.
Let it cold down slightly.
Serve it warm.

title: Rasam Thukpa
cooking_instructions:
In a large stock pot add the oil. Once hot, add the garlic and ginger. 
Let it sear on a medium heat for 2-3 minutes or until lightly golden.
Then add the whole spices and dry red chilli and toast for 1 minute.
Once fragrant, add the onions and curry leaves and saute for 5-6 minutes or until they become lightly golden brown. 
Add the carrots, green chilli and chicken. 
Saute the chicken on a high heat for 5 minutes or until the chicken starts to brown.
Just as the chicken starts to stick to the bottom of the pan, add the tomatoes. This will start to deglaze the pan. 
Add hing and coriander stems. 
Just as the bottom of the pot starts to turn deeply golden, pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the pan. 
Bring the water to a simmer, and simmer it for 60 minutes on a low heat. 
Add all the ingredients required (except for the oil) for the chilli oil into a heat safe bowl.
Heat up the oil until it just starts to smoke and immediately pour it over the bowl containing the ingredients.
Let it steep until the oil has fully cooled down.
Cook the noodles according to package directions.
Once finished simmering, strain the broth, reserving both the solids and the broth. 
Shred the chicken while it's still hot.
To plate, add the noodles to the centre of the bowl and gently pour in the broth.
Add all the garnishes along with the shredded chicken in a decorative pattern
Serve Hot!

title: Tomato Rice and Egg Podimas
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
Heat a pressure cooker and add oil.
Add cumin, fennel, curry leaves, green chilli and let it crackle.
Add the chopped onions and saute till it turns light brown.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a few seconds.
Add the masala powders and mix for a few seconds.
Add the chopped tomatoes and saute till it turns soft.
Add water, salt and bring it to a boil.
Add the soaked and strained rice, give it a good mix and tightly close the cooker.
Pressure cook for 4 whistles on a medium flame and turn off the flame.
In a pan/ Kadai, add oil, green chilli and onions.
Saute until the onions are soft.
Add the tomato, and saute until soft throughout.
Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, and salt.
Saute until the raw smell disappears.
Add the eggs and mix along with everything.
Let the eggs set for a minute and then stir it.
Keep sauteeing it until the eggs are fully cooked.
Let the steam reduce gradually.
Fluff up the rice and let it sit for 5 minutes.

title: Pressure Cooker Choco Lava Cake
cooking_instructions:
Fold a piece of foil paper into 4 quarters. Cut off the access to form a perfect square. 
Place a glass in the middle of the square foil. 
Fold the edges of the foil upwards and press it at the edges tightly, forming a cup. 
Keep a bowl on a double boiler, make sure that the bottom of the bowl does not touch the hot water. 
Mix, dark chocolate and butter and let it melt completely till the dark chocolate is smooth and shiny. 
Take it off the heat, add the milk and mix well. 
Sift in the Maida, cocoa powder, and baking powder. 
Make sure there are no lumps. 
Lastly, add in the powdered sugar, and vanilla essence and pour this mixture into the greased foil cups. 
Add 1-2 pieces of chocolate to each cup. 
Add this to the preheated pressure cooker, and remove the gasket and the whistle from the cooker. 
Place a stand or an idli holder in the cooker and place all the choco lava cakes in each section of the idli mold. 
Close the lid and let this cook for 20-22 minutes on a low- medium heat. 
Let them cool for 5 minutes and enjoy the gooey choco lava cakes!

title: Vazhakkai Fry
cooking_instructions:
To a hot pan, add oil. Once the oil is hot, add the crushed garlic.
Once the garlic starts to turn lightly golden, add the curry leaves, urad dal, and cumin seeds.
Saute for 1 minute and add the vazhakai/green banana.
Saute the vazhakai/green banana on a medium high heat, for around 10 minutes. adding more oil if necessary.
Once the vazhakai/green banana is deeply golden and crispy, add the spice powders and salt.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes on a medium heat.
Serve hot.

title: Chilli Paneer
cooking_instructions: Mix the ingredients under batter to form a batter, coat the cubed paneer in the batter and deep fry. Set this aside.
In a pan add oil, garlic, ginger and saute for 30 seconds.
Add spring onion whites, cubed onion and capsicum, green chilli and saute for 1 minute.
Add Soy Sauce, Red chilli sauce, tomato ketchup, chilli powder, vinegar, sugar, pepper powder and salt. And add Spring Onion (greens)

Mix cornflour and water to prepare the thickening agent. 
Add the thickening agent to the sauce mixture and prepare the sauce to the desired thickness
Add the batter-fried paneer cubes and toss.
Garnish with chopped spring onion greens and serve as an appetizer

title: Banoffee Trifle
cooking_instructions: Heat granulated sugar in a saucepan over medium heat, allow it to caramelize to a deep golden amber colour, stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon.
Over a low heat, add the butter all at once and stir well, mind the rapid bubbling.
Gently add the cream and mix well until combined. Set aside to cool.
Crush the biscuits to a fine powder by blitzing in a mixer grinder.
Add melted butter and form a crumble with a spatula.
Whip the cold cream with sugar and vanilla essence until it forms soft peaks.
For layering: in a cup add a spoonful of the crumble followed by the caramel, bananas and cream. Repeat until the cup is full. Garnish with chocolate shavings.

title: Chettinad Mutton Curry
cooking_instructions: In a pan, dry roast all the spices for the masala paste over low heat (all ingredients except poppy seeds and coconut).
Once it turns aromatic, add the poppy seeds and coconut. Saute lightly until dry and the colour just starts to change.
Cool down the mixture and grind it to a paste, adding water as required.
Add this paste to the mutton and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan and add stone flower, curry leaves, shallots and onions. Saute until the onion turns translucent.
Add ginger garlic paste, turmeric powder and tomato. Saute for 3 minutes.
Add the marinated mutton and rock salt. Saute for 2 minutes.
Add water and pressure cook for 25 minutes. Reduce the heat to medium after the first whistle.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve.

title: Lady's Finger Chutney
cooking_instructions:
In a pan add oil, channa dal, cumin seeds, and mustard seeds, and saute until the colour starts changing.
Now add shallots, ginger, garlic, and dried red chilli.
Saute until there are char marks on the shallots.
Remove it from the pan and let it cool on a plate.
Now, in the same pan, add curry leaves and lady finger.
Keep sauteing until there are char marks on the lady fingers.
Turn off the heat and add salt, green chilli, and tamarind.
Let it cool, once fully cool, add it all into a blender and blend it into a fine paste.
Serve it with hot rice, dosa, or idli, and enjoy.

title: Kettle Maggi
cooking_instructions:
Add the water to the kettle and bring it to a boil.
Shake the kettle to mix well.
Once the noodles have cooked, turn the kettle off and let the mixture cool for 2 minutes.
Add the maggi noodles along with the tastemaker masala, chilli flakes and oregano.
Crack in an egg and immediately shake the kettle vigorously.
The mixture should greatly thicken and lighten in colour.
Add a cheese slice and close the lid of the kettle. Let the cheese melt for 2 minutes and then mix with a fork.

title: Pasta Puttanesca
cooking_instructions:
In a pot saute garlic and green chilli in extra virgin oil. 
Once aromatic, add the dried oregano and dried rosemary and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and basil leaves. Cook on a medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes. The tomatoes will soften and start to become mushy.
Add the sugar and salt to balance the flavours. 
Once the sauce is done cooking, add the olives. 
To a deep pot, add water to cook the pasta.
Once the water is boiling, add the salt along with the pasta. 
Cook the pasta 1 minute less than package instructions.
Add the pasta to the sauce and finish cooking the pasta for 1 minute, adding pasta water as needed. 
Toss the pasta well to emulsify the sauce.
Grate in parmesan cheese and toss once again to combine well.

title: Raw Banana Rava Fry
cooking_instructions:
Steam the raw banana whole for 5 mins. Peel the skin. 
Slice the raw banana diagonally and make a small hole in the center (optionally). 
Mix all the ingredients for the marination together. 
Add water as needed to form a smooth and thick paste. 
Coat the raw banana in the marination. Marinate for a few minutes. 
Place the rava in a plate/bowl. Coat the raw banana in the rava. 
Shallow fry in oil until cooked and crisp on both sides, a total of 5-7 minutes, depending on the size of the pieces. 
Add the curry leaves for a few seconds before removing from the pan.

title: Potato Fried Rice
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, add oil, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, ginger garlic paste, and chicken masala. 
Saute well until everything combines and raw smell disappears. 
Add in the potato and mix well on low heat. 
Cover and let cook for 20 to 30 minutes, while sauteing in intervals!
Add curry leaves and saute well. 
Once the potatoes are cooked, add in the rice and saute it for one last time, until everything is incorporated and mixed throughly. 
Serve hot and enjoy.

title: Mukkani Payasam
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, dry roast the rice and moong dal separately until light golden brown and set aside. 
In a pressure cooker, add all the ingredients for pressure cooking, cook on moderate heat for 15 minutes or 5 whistles, and set aside. 
In a pan, pour ghee add the diced fruits, and saute on a moderate flame for 20 seconds or until the fruits slightly caramelise and set aside. 
In a kadhai, add the cooked rice and dal mixture, add in jaggery and saffron. Cook on a moderate flame until the jaggery dissolves (around 30 seconds)
Adjust the consistency of the payasam by adding milk. 
Add in the sauteed fruits and mix thoroughly. 
In a tadka pan pour ghee and saute the cashews and raisins until golden brown
Finish the payasam with the prepared tadka and cardamom powder. 
Serve either hot or cold.

title: Chidambaram Kalkandu Pongal
cooking_instructions:
Bring the water to a boil. Then add the rice.
Mix well to combine, and cover with a lid. Place a heavy weight on the lid and cook for 45 minutes.
Once cooked, add saffron and mash the rice well.
On low heat, add the kalkandu and continuously mix until combined well. 
The mixture will loosen first before thickening up again.
In a separate pan, add ghee. Once hot, add the cashews and fry until lightly golden brown. 
Then add the raisins, and immediately turn the flame off. 
As soon as the raisins puff, add the mixture to the rice mixture and combine.

title: Allam Pachadi
cooking_instructions:
First, heat up the oil until just smoking and then turn the flame off and let it cool almost completely.
Place the tamarind in a bowl and pour the boiling water over it. Let the tamarind soak until the water cools down.
Once the water has cooled down, squeeze the tamarind into the water to make a thick pulp. Make sure to remove the seeds and throw the tamarind skins away.
To a blender, add the ginger, garlic, red chilli powder, salt and jaggery. Blend to roughly combine.
Then add the tamarind pulp, fenugreek seeds, and turmeric powder. 
Blend until smooth, slowly adding in the heated and cooled oil to help blend.
Once all the oil has been added, the resulting paste should be smooth and shiny. Remove this paste from the blender and place into a bowl.
To make the tempering, add some oil to a pan. 
Once hot, add the garlic and saute it until it starts to turn lightly golden.
Then add the channa dal and let it fry until it starts to turn golden.
Then add the curry leaves and dry red chillis. 
Once the curry leaves have splattered add the mustards seeds and turn the flame off.
Add the entire tempering to the ginger pachadi and mix to combine well. 
This can be served with any breakfast item, i.e: idli, dosa, pessaratu etc

title: Gemini Fish
cooking_instructions:
Marinate the fish in the ingredients mentioned, except for the cornstarch and maida. 
Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes and upto overnight.
Just before deep frying, coat the fish in cornstarch and maida to make a thick, pasty coating.
Deep fry on high heat, until crispy, around 3 minutes.
In a separate pan, add oil. Once hot, add onions and green chillies. 
Saute for 4-5 minute or until soft and translucent.
Add the ginger garlic paste and cook until the raw smell disappears.
Add the red chilli powder, turmeric powder and coriander powder. 
Saute for 2 minutes on a medium heat. 
Deglaze with soy sauce. 
Add the fried fish pieces and toss to combine well.
Turn the flame off before adding lemon juice.

title: Pavakai Mixture
cooking_instructions:
Peel ridges of the bitter gourd completely.
Slice thinly and add salt. 
Rest for 10 mins and squeeze out the water.
Coat with rice flour.


Fry thinly sliced onion until light golden.
Fry thinly curry leaves for a few seconds.
Fry thinly peanuts for a few seconds.
Fry thinly red chilli  for a few seconds.
Fry in hot oil for 4-5 mins, until lightly golden and crispy.
Combine the seasonings.
Add the fried ingredients to a bowl and add the prepared seasoning, toss to coat well.
Store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.

title: Chicken Patiala
cooking_instructions: Marinate the chicken with all the ingredients for the marination. Rest for at least 30 minutes.
In a pan, heat oil and add cinnamon, cardamom and cumin seeds. Add the onion and saute until golden brown.
Add the ginger garlic paste and saute lightly to remove the raw taste. Add the spice powders, salt and tomatoes. Cook until the tomatoes turn mushy, around 4 minutes.
Remove ⅓ of the quantity of masala from the pan. Set aside for later.
Add the marinated chicken and saute on high flame for 2 minutes.
Add ½ cup of water. Reduce the heat to low, cover and cook for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat another pan and add oil. Add garlic and ginger. Saute until the colour barely changes.
Add the previously reserved masala. Mix well.
Add the diced onion and capsicum. Saute for 1 minute and then add the cashew paste.
Add the cashew paste, saute for 1 minute.
Add water and allow it to simmer for 2 minutes.
Add this gravy to the 1st gravy. Mix well and allow it to simmer for 5 minutes or until the chicken is completely cooked.
Add the garam masala powder, kasuri methi, butter, cream and coriander leaves. Turn off the heat as soon as it comes to a simmer.
Serve it with an omelette topping.

title: Pressure Cooker Brownie
cooking_instructions:
Sift maida, cocoa powder, and salt, set aside.
In a medium-large bowl add sugar, and melted unsalted butter, and whisk it until the mixture is airy and everything is well incorporated. 
Add the room-temperature eggs one at a time, and mix well.

Mix in the flour mixture with the wet ingredients until nice, smooth, and glossy.
Fold in dark chocolate.
Add mixture to a greased parchment-lined baking pan. 
Add this to the preheated pressure cooker, and remove the gasket and the whistle from the cooker. 
Add salt at the bottom of the cooker and place a stand on top of the salt, keep the baking pan on the stand. 
Close the lid and let this cook for 35-40 minutes on a low- medium heat or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean. 
Let them cool for 30 minutes and enjoy!

title: Lady Finger Mutton Curry
cooking_instructions:
In a cooker add mutton, water, salt, turmeric powder and ginger garlic paste.
Mix well and let it cook on a medium heat for 4 whistles/ until the mutton is tender and cooked.
Once cooked, retain all the liquid from the cooking.
In a pan over medium heat add oil, cinnamon, cardamom, clove, fennel seeds, cumin seeds.
Saute for a minute until aromatic.
Add the onions and saute until translucent.
Add the green chilli  and saute. 
Add the coriander leaves and mint leaves.
Saute until the leaves wilt and soften.
Turn off the heat and add poppy seeds and coconut.
Mix it until everything combines.
Let cool and blend into a fine paste.
Set aside.
In a pan add oil, bay leaf and onion.
Saute until the onion is light golden brown.
Add your diced vegetables and saute well until it starts to sweat.
Add your prepared paste and cook it on high flame for 2 minutes.
Add your mutton with all its liquid and continue cooking.
Add in your tomatoes, salt and let it reach a boil.
Add water as per your desired consistency and serve hot with rice/ idlys.

title: Erachi Paruppu Kulambu
cooking_instructions:
In a pressure cooker, add oil. 
Once hot, add the whole spices and saute for 1 minute or until fragrant.
Then add the green chilli, onion and salt. Saute for 5-6 minute on a medium heat, or until it starts to turn golden brown. 
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for 1 minute until the raw smell disappears.
Add the mutton and stir well. 
Cook until most if the water from the mutton  has evaporated.
Add the red chilli powder and turmeric powder and saute for 1 minute.
Once the mutton starts sticking to the bottom of the pan, add the toor dal.
Gently scrape the bottom of the pan.
Add water and bring it to a boil. 
Close the lid and pressure cook for 5 whistles on medium heat.
To make the coconut paste, dry roast all the ingredients in a pan until fragrant and lightly toasted.
Blend with a little water to make a fine paste.
Once the pressure from the cooker naturally releases, add the coconut paste and jaggery, and bring the mixture to a simmer. 
To make the tempering, heat some oil in a pan and add the ingredients required. 
Add the tempering along with coriander leaves  to the mutton and stir to combine well.
To make the ghee rice, heat up ghee in a pressure cooker.
Add the whole spices and saute for 1 minute or until fragrant.
Then add the onions and green chilli and sauté for 3-4 minutes or until soft and translucent. 
Then add the ginger garlic paste and cook until the raw smell disappears.
Add the water and coconut milk and bring to a boil.
Add the washed rice and salt, and stir to combine well. 
Bring to a boil again and close the lid, and pressure cook for 2 whistles on a medium heat.
Once done, let the pressure naturally release before opening. 
Gently fluff the rice and serve hot with the Mutton.

title: Ileana Chicken
cooking_instructions:
In a large mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the marinade and mix thoroughly until combined. 
Add the chicken legs and mix thoroughly. Cover and let it marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours. 
In a kadhai pour oil and deep fry the chicken on a medium flame for 8-9 minutes or until thoroughly cooked and golden brown. 
While still hot, sprinkle chaat masala and serve.

title: Garlic Knots
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl, add all the ingredients for the dough and knead for 10 minutes until a smooth and supple dough forms
Cover and let the dough rise for 1 hour or until doubled in size.
Once the dough doubles in size, punch it and portion the dough into 4 equal sized balls. 
Start rolling the dough into a 6-7 inch long line. Roll into circular roundels. 
Put a knot in the dough and tuck both the ends under the dough.
Apply milk/eggwash and bake it for 20-25 minutes on 180°C or until the top is golden brown. 
Apply the prepared garlic oil

title: Kattu Pappu (Andhra style)
cooking_instructions:
Add the washed toor dal to a pressure cooker along with 2 cups of water.
Slowly bring it to a boil.
Add the slit green chilli, red chilli powder, turmeric powder and onion.
Once the water is boiling, close the lid and pressure cook for 6 whistles on a medium heat.
Once the pressure has naturally released, open the lid and mash the dal along with adding 1 cup of water to thin out the consistency. 
Bring the dal to a simmer and add salt. 
For the tempering, heat the ghee in a small pan. Add the garlic and saute until it starts to turn lightly golden brown. 
Then add the urad dal and cumin seeds. 
Once the urad dal is lightly golden, add the mustard seeds, curry leaves, hing and dry red chillies
Cook for another 30 seconds before adding it directly to the dal. 
Mix to combine well.

title: Chilli Soya Chaap
cooking_instructions:
Add water to a pan, add the soya chaap sticks to it and let it boil for 5-7 minutes on high flame. 
Once out of the water, pat dry with a paper towel and remove the ice cream sticks from each stick. 
Cut it into diagonal shapes. 
Place the cut pieces on a plate.
In a kadhai/wok, heat oil over medium flame. 
Fry the soya chaap until it turns crispy and golden brown. 
Remove and place it on a tissue-lined plate.
In the same kadai, add chopped garlic, ginger, green chilies, and spring onions. 
Sauté over a high flame for a minute.
Add in the ​​green capsicum, red bell pepper, and yellow bell pepper. Sauté well.
Season with salt, soya sauce, green chili sauce, tomato ketchup, black pepper powder, red chili powder. 
Add in the Cornflour slurry, and let the sauce thicken. 
Continue to toss and cook for another 1-2 minutes on medium to high flame. 
Make sure to keep mixing it so it doesn’t burn. 
Add in the Chaap sticks and toss it till the chaap is covered with the sauce.

title: Biryani Vaada
cooking_instructions:
Soak the leftover biryani in enough water to cover. 
Let it soak for 30 minutes.
Add salt and turmeric powder to your prawns and let them marinate for 30 minutes.
To a pan, add oil. Once hot, add the onion and saute them until golden brown, around 7-8 minutes on a medium heat. 
Then add the green chilli and saute for an additional 1 minute. 
Remove the mixture from the pan and set aside to cool.
Drain all the water from the biryani rice and add the biryani rice to the same pan with a little bit of oil.
Cook the biryani on a medium heat for around 6-7 minutes, until the rice starts to soften and slightly mash.
Transfer the biryani to a blender and pulse it until slightly chunky.
Add the mixture to a bowl
Add salt, red chilli powder, coriander leaves, curry leaves, rava,rice flour and the cooked onion mixture to the rice.
Mix well to combine before adding 4 tbsp of water.
Once the dough has been made, take a small portion of dough and shape it into a vada.
Place 2 prawn pieces on the vada.
Deep fry the vada until deeply golden brown, around 4 minutes.

title: Garelu and Chicken Curry
cooking_instructions:
Soak the urad dal for at least 2 hours but no more than 3 hours.
Drain the urad dal and blend it in a mixie along with ginger, in batches, making sure the previous batch is fully blended before adding more. 
Add water bit by bit to ensure a smooth batter is formed.
Add the rest of the ingredients into the batter and mix to form a cohesive batter.
To shape the garelu, take a banana leaf and wet it with a little water.
Wet your hands, take a small portion of batter, and place it in the centre of the banana leaf. 
Gently flatten it into a disc and poke a hole in the centre.
Take the leaf in your hand and slowly peel it away from the formed garelu.
The garelu should easily slide off your hand at this point. Slide it into the hot oil and deep fry for 3 minutes on each side. 
The end result should be deeply golden brown and crispy. 
To make the chicken curry, heat oil in a kadai. Once hot, add the whole spices.
Toast them for 1 minute on a medium heat.
Once they are fragrant, add the onions, salt and green chilli to the kadai and saute on a medium high heat for 6 - 7 minutes or until they start to turn lightly golden. 
Then add the ginger garlic paste and cook it until the raw smell disappears. 
Add the chicken and mix to combine it well. 
Add the powdered spices and cook on a medium high heat for 3-4 minutes.
Once the chicken starts to stick to the bottom of the pan, add the water and scrape the bottom of the pan. 
Simmer and cook the chicken for 8-10 minutes.
The gravy should have significantly thickened and the chicken should be cooked.
Garnish with the coriander leaves and serve hot with the Garelu.

title: Soya Cutlet
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add the soya chunks and pour hot water, let it hydrate for 5 mins or until soft. 
Squeeze out excess water and add the soya chunks to a mixer jar. 
Add all the other ingredients and blend into a coarse paste without adding any water. 
Shape the mixture into cutlets and set aside in the fridge for 10 mins. 
In a non-stick pan pour oil and seer the cutlets on low medium heat until golden brown and crispy. 
Serve hot.

title: Mughlai Chicken
cooking_instructions: Take the thinly sliced onions in a bowl, add ½ tsp of salt, mix well and let it rest for 5 minutes.
In a saucepan, add ½ cup of water and cashews. Cook for 3 mins
In a pan, add 1 tbsp of ghee. Once the ghee is hot, add the onions after squeezing excess water and stir fry. Keep stirring the onions until they turn dark brown in colour.
Once the onions are browned, transfer them to a mixer grinder along with the cooked cashew nuts, garlic, ginger, green chillies and ¼ cup of water. Grind this into a smooth paste.
Add 2 tbsp of ghee to a Kadai. Add Bay leaf, cinnamon, cardamom and cloves. Saute for a minute. Add the onion paste and cook for 5 minutes on medium heat.
Add the powdered spices (turmeric, coriander, Kashmiri chilli, garam masala), salt and saute for another 3 minutes.
Add the cleaned and washed chicken. Add 1 ½ Cup of water. Cover and cook the chicken for 10 mins stirring occasionally.
Open the lid and cook for another 3 mins or until the gravy reaches desired consistency.
Add cream, simmer for a couple of minutes and switch off the flame. Remove from the heat and serve hot with Parathas, Naan, Roti or Jeera Rice.

title: Lady's Finger Vada
cooking_instructions:
Soak chana dal in water for 30–45 mins.
Grind coarsely chana dal with Cinnamon, Cloves ,green chillies and ginger. (should NOT be very smooth and soggy. Should be dry with minimal water) 
Mix cut coriander, mint, lady finger, onions, rice flour and salt.
Heat oil in a pan.
Take small balls of ground vada Mix and pat it to get shape like cutlet and fry it.
Deep Fry on low heat until golden brown and crispy. 
Serve hot and enjoy.

title: Ragi Kali
cooking_instructions:
Pour 1 cup water into a mixing bowl.
Add the salt and 1 tsp of oil to the water.
Add the Ragi flour and mix it continuously and quickly so that there are no lumps. 
Stir continuously and cook for 3 minutes
When all the flour is mixed in properly, reduce the heat to medium-low, cover it and cook for 4 minutes.
After 4 minutes, turn off the heat and let it sit covered for 10 minutes, or until it has come down to a manageable temperature.
Oil your hands. Divide this dough into three equal portions. Roll them into a ball. 
If it is still sticking to your hand, apply a little bit of oil on your hands, and then roll them. 
Serve with any gravy or lentil dish.

title: Beetroot Red Velvet Cake
cooking_instructions:
Add all the dry ingredients to a bowl and mix to combine well.
Beat the eggs with the sugar until pale and the volume has more than doubled in size. 
Add the oil and keep beating until incorporated completely.
Fold in the dry ingredients gently, ensuring not to deflate the batter too much.
Add in the grated beetroot and the lemon juice and mix to combine. 
Pour the cake batter into a greased cake tin and place in a preheated 180 C oven for 50-60 minutes. 
When an inserted toothpick comes out almost cleanly, you can remove the cake to let it cool. 
To make the cream cheese frosting, beat together the cream cheese and the butter until soft and fluffy, around 3-4 minutes.
Gently add in the sugar bit by bit, while beating the cream cheese mixture.
Add the vanilla extract and whisk to incorporate.
Once the cake has cooled, you can ice it with the cream cheese frosting.

title: Cookd Chettinad Paneer Tikka
cooking_instructions:
Add curd, finely chopped curry leaves and the cookd malai tikka kit into a bowl. Mix well to form a paste.
Add the Cookd chettinad masala and mix well into the marination. 
Add the paneer cubes, onion, deseeded tomato and capsicum. 
Mix gently to coat the marinade on all veggies and paneer.
Grill the paneer on a pan/ grill or even open flame until all sides are cooked and until you could see charred marks all over the paneer.
Brush some ghee over the grilled paneer and serve hot.

title: Magic Sugarcane Juice
cooking_instructions:
Blend everything until smooth. 
Strain it and serve cold.

title: Pudhu Chicken
cooking_instructions:
To make the thogayal, add the ingredients required for the thogayal to a blender and blend until cohesive.
In a mortar and pestle, add all the ingredients required for the paste and pound well. The ingredients should be nice and crushed but not pasty.
To a hot pan, add oil. Once very hot, add the shallot mixture and saute on a high heat for 7-8 minutes, until the shallots are deeply golden brown and crispy. 
Then add the chicken along with the thogayal. 
Toss to combine well and cook on a high heat for another 6-7 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked and the raw flavour of the coconut is gone.
Turn the flame off and add lemon juice along with the crushed mor molaga. 
Mix to combine well.

title: Easy Pesarattu Upma
cooking_instructions:
Soak the green moong dal for 5-7 hours. 
Add all the ingredients required for the pesarattu into a blender and blend until a smooth thick batter is formed.
To make the upma, add some oil into a pan. Once the oil is hot, add the cashew nuts and saute them until they are lightly golden brown.
Then add the curry leaves, onion, green chilli and ginger. Saute for 5 minutes or until aromatic. 
Add the carrots, followed by the rava. 
Toast the rava for 5 minutes before adding the water.
Cook on a low heat while stirring, until the upma starts to thicken. 
To make the pesarattu, preheat a non-stick or iron tawa until very hot. Take a ladle of batter and spread it into a thin even layer, like a dosa.
Add a little oil around the edges and the centre and let it cook on a medium heat. 
Once the edges and centre start to turn golden and the edges start to release, you can add the upma to one half of the pesarattu and fold the other half over it. 
Serve hot with Ginger Chutney or Coconut Chutney.

title: Instant Mango Kulfi
cooking_instructions:
Cut the top of the mango and keep it aside. 
Using a knife, make slits along the sides of the seed to release it. 
Use tweezers/ tongs to remove the seed without damaging the mango. 
Make the mango bases stand in rice or in small bowls. 
For the Kulfi mixture, add all the ingredients in a blender and pulse until the palkova mixes into the mixture. 
Add the chopped nuts and mix well. 
Pour this mixture into the mango and place the top piece. 
Freeze them overnight or for a minimum of 8 hours until frozen solid. 
Using a peeler, peel the frozen mangoes and then slice them into thick slices. 
Serve immediately garnished with chopped nuts or store frozen.

title: Nongu Elaneer
cooking_instructions:
To a blender, add the tender coconut water along with the ice apple and jaggery powder.
Blend until smooth and combine well. 
Pour the juice into a glass filled with ice and garnish with chopped tender coconut flesh.

title: Paruppu Kola Urundai
cooking_instructions:
Wash and Soak the Toor Dal for at least 30 minutes
Pour 1 Cup water and pressure cook the dal for 3-4 whistles on a moderate flame.
The cooked dal should not be watery, make sure the mixture is thick and dry.
In a kadhai pour sesame oil and saute the shallots on a moderate flame until it’s golden brown (around 3 minutes), remove and set it aside. 
In the same kadhai add all the whole spices,red chillies, garlic and cook on a moderate flame until super fragrant (around 3 minutes).
Add back the shallots and the cooked dal, add in curry leaves and coriander leaves.
Mix thoroughly. 
Add turmeric and salt and mix thoroughly. 
Let the mixture cool down completely, and blend into a coarse paste (add small splashes of water if required). 
Add the roasted gram flour and mix, shape into smooth balls (make sure no cracks are present)
Deep fry on a medium high flame until golden brown.

title: Vatha Kozhambu
cooking_instructions: Soak the tamarind in 1 cup of water and extract the tamarind juice.
In a pan, heat gingelly oil, add channa dal, urad dal, fenugreek seeds, fennel seeds, cumin seeds, black peppercorns until aromatic.
Once the spices emit aroma, add the shallots and garlic. Saute until the shallots are translucent. Add the curry leaves.
Add the chopped tomatoes and saute for a minute. Add the turmeric powder, chilli powder and coriander powder and continue cooking for 2 more minutes.
Add the grated coconut and saute for a minute.
Grind this into a smooth paste in a mixer grinder.
In another Kadai, heat 4 tbsp of Gingelly oil. Add the Vathal and saute for 1 minute. Remove the Sundakkai Vathal from the Kadai.

To the same oil, add the mustard seeds and urad dal. Allow the mustard seeds to splutter. Add the dried red chillies and curry leaves. Add 1 thinly sliced onion and saute until the onions are translucent.
Add the ground masala paste, salt to taste and continue to cook. Add 2 cups of water and simmer for 5 mins.
Add the salt, tamarind juice, jaggery. Cover and simmer for 10 mins.
Add the Sundakkai Vathal and simmer for 2 more minutes. Remove from heat and serve hot with Rice.

title: Manga Kimchi
cooking_instructions:
Cut the mango, carrot, and radish into juliennes.
Cut the spring onions into batons that are the same length as the mango juliennes. 
Place all of these vegetables into a bowl and heavily salt them. Massage the salt into the vegetables. 
Leave the vegetables to rest while you make the other components. 
Add the chilli flakes to a blender and blend until they become finer in texture but not powdered. 
Add all the ingredients required to make the paste to a blender and blend until smooth and combined well.
Once the vegetables have wilted and have released their liquid, thoroughly wash them with clean filtered water. 
Once washed, drain them in a colander. 
Using clean sanitised hands, or gloved hands, add the vegetables to a clean glass bowl. Then add the onion paste, followed by the kashmiri red chilli powder, chilli flakes and vinegar. 
Mix it well, coating the vegetables thoroughly with the paste. 
Once everything is coated and combined well, press the kimchi down, removing any air gaps. Flatten it into an even surface. 
Clean the sides of the bowl and place plastic wrap directly on the surface of the kimchi, followed by another layer of plastic wrap covering the bowl.
Place the kimchi in a dark place and allow it to ferment for a couple of days.

title: Instant Benne Dosa
cooking_instructions:
In a blender, add all the ingredients listed in the recipe, except the baking soda. 
Blend to a smooth, fine, and runny consistency, similar to dosa batter. 
Add the baking soda and a tsp of water, whisk to mix well. 
Heat a non-stick dosa tava and make the heat even by sprinkling water. 
Spread the batter thin and even like you would normally make dosa. 
Add butter/ ghee as desired for cooking and cook only on one side until golden brown and crispy on a medium-high flame. 
Serve hot with chutney/ sambar and an extra cube of butter.

title: High Protein Chapathi
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer jar add the soya chunks and blend into a fine powder and set aside. 
In the same mixer jar add the paneer, curd and egg whites and blend in a fine paste. 
In a mixing bowl, add all the ingredients and knead into a smooth and soft dough.
Let it rest for 15 mins. 
Seperate into small balls and roll into chapathis
In a hot tawa add the rolled dough and cook for 45 seconds on each side.

title: Dosa Battered Onion Rings
cooking_instructions:
Peel and slice your onions into thick rings. 
Add your dosa batter into a bowl for dipping. If the dosa batter is too runny, add some rice flour to make it slightly thicker. 
Dip the onion rings into the dosa batter.
Directly add it to some hot oil to deep fry.
Once they turn golden brown, remove from the oil and drain on some paper towels.
Sprinkle some idli podi on top, while they are still hot.

title: Cookd Chicken Monica
cooking_instructions:
To a bowl, add the ingredients required for the marination and mix to combine well. 
Let it marinate for 30 minutes. 
Heat oil in a kadai and fry the chicken for 5 minutes. The exterior should be crispy but still slightly soft.
In a non-stick pan, add some oil along with the green chilli. Saute for 2 minutes or until the green chillis have blistered and softened. 
Turn the heat off and let the pan cool for 2 minutes. 
Once slightly cooled, add the curd to the pan along with the red chilli powder and salt. 
Turn the heat up to a low flame and keep stirring.
Add the curry leaves.
Once the curd starts to thicken and split, add the chicken 65 and increase the flame to a medium heat.
Keep tossing until the curd starts to coat the chicken pieces.

title: Egg Halwa
cooking_instructions: Remove the crust from the bread, soak in water for 15 mins, squeeze out the water and mash the bread.
Soak the saffron strands in ¼ Cup of hot milk and keep aside.
Blanch almonds in hot water for 5 mins, remove the skin, and grind into a paste.
Beat the eggs in a bowl
Blend the bread, egg, almond paste, saffron milk in a mixer grinder to a smooth consistency.

Heat a pan, add ghee and add raisins. Once they puff up, add the blended egg mixture and stir. As soon as the halwa reached boiling point, reduce heat, add sugar and continue to stir for 15 mins so that the halwa does not stick to the sides of the vessel. Serve hot.

title: Aloo Tikki Burger
cooking_instructions: Peel and grate the whole-boiled potatoes.
In a pan, heat butter and add the green peas along with the masala powders. Add the ginger garlic paste and saute on a low flame.
Add the grated potatoes and mix well. Use a potato masher if required to smoothen the mixture.
Add lemon juice and coriander leaves and turn off the flame. Allow the mixture to cool.
Wash the poha with water and strain it. Add this to the mixture to absorb the excess moisture.
Make equal sized portions of the mixture. Flatten them into patties.
Whisk together the maida, cornstarch, salt, pepper and water to form a thick batter.
Coat the patties with breadcrumbs, then the batter and again in the breadcrumbs.
Fry the patties in oil until golden brown.
Apply butter on the burger buns and toast them.
To make the sauce, mix the mayonnaise, ketchup and chilli sauce together.
Assemble the burger by placing a patty, cheese slice, onion slices, tomatoes and the sauce on top.

title: Uppukari Tacos
cooking_instructions:
For the sauce add Coriander leaves, Spring onion, red chilli flakes, soy sauce and salt into a bowl.
Pour in hot oil, and continue mixing everything until well incorporated.
Let it cool aside while you prepare the filling.
In a pan add Gingelly oil, once hot, add red chilli & shallots, saute until soft,
Add chicken, salt and mix everything together.
Add water, cover and let cook until the chicken is fully cooked.
In a pan add Gingelly oil, once hot, add red chilli & shallots, saute until soft,
Add chicken, salt and mix everything together.
Add water, cover and let cook until the chicken is fully cooked.
Remove the lid and let the water completely evaporate.
OPTIONALLY You can cut your chapatis into small taco sizes and cook them.
Layer the taco with the bottom being chapati/roti followed by the chicken filling.
Finish off the tacos by applying your prepared sauce as desired.
Serve it with a lemon wedge and enjoy this Indian fusion.

title: Chicken Egg Roll
cooking_instructions: Heat the oil in a pan and add the onions. Saute until it turns golden brown.
Add all the spice powders and ginger garlic paste. Saute for 1 minute on low heat.
Add the boneless chicken pieces and saute on high heat for 2 minutes.
Cover and cook for 5 minutes or until the chicken is completely cooked.
If there is any excess liquid, cook without the lid until it has evaporated.
To make the chilli vinegar, combine the vinegar and chopped chillies in a bowl.

Heat oil in a flat pan and place the parotta/chapathi. Once it has heated through, add the beaten egg on top. Once it starts to cook, flip and cook until the egg is cooked through, around 20 seconds. Remove it from the heat.
Add the chicken filling, sliced onion, coriander leaves, chilli vinegar and sprinkle chaat masala on top. Roll it up and enjoy!

title: Coconut Sambol
cooking_instructions: Pound the dry red chillies till it becomes flaky
Pound the ginger and garlic and shallots till it is crushed finely

Add all the ingredients to a bowl, add salt and lemon juice
Mix till combines
Serve with hot rice

title: Kurkure Upma
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer jar, add the leftover upma and blend until fine.
Add the prepared mixture into a bowl and add the other ingredients and mix thoroughly until combined. 
Add the prepared mixture into a piping bag with a moderate-sized mouth or use a clean zip lock bag.
Pipe the mixture into moderately hot oil and deep fry for 3 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
Serve with coconut chutney and enjoy.

title: Thaen Mittai
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl, add the rice and urad dal. 
Wash and soak them for at least an hour
For the sugar syrup, add sugar, water and cardamom and bring it to a boil. Cook until the sugar is slightly thickened. 
Add the lemon juice at the end to prevent the sugar syrup from seizing
Blend into a smooth paste adding about 2 tablespoons of water. 
Make sure the mixture is thick.
Add the baking soda and food colour and mix thoroughly
Deep fry on a moderate for 3-4 minutes or until golden brown and crispy. 
Add the fried mittai into the sugar syrup while it’s still hot. 
Let it soak for 1 hour and let it rest covered overnight

title: Curd Semiya
cooking_instructions:
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Once boiling, add the semiya and cook it for around 6 minutes, or until cooked.
Once cooked, wash and rinse the semiya in cold water
