In a pan, add ghee. Once hot, add mustards seeds, chana dal, shallots, ginger, green chilli, curry leaves, hing and cashew nuts. Saute and set aside once golden and fragrant, around 2-3 minutes.
In a bowl, add the drained semiya along with curd, milk, and salt. Mix to combine well.

Add the tempering to the curd semiya mixture and mix to combine well. 
Add the pomegranate seeds and the grapes and mix to combine
Optionally, you can let it set for an hour in the fridge

title: Chicken 555
cooking_instructions:
Cut the chicken breast into strips and then add them into a bowl.
Add the rest of the ingredients required for the marination and mix to combine well.
Shallow fry the chicken until golden and crispy, around 2 minutes per side on a medium high heat.
In a kadai, add some oil. Once hot add the onion, curry leaves and green chilli. 
Saute for 3-4 minutes or until soft and just starting to turn golden. 
Add the ginger garlic paste and cook until the raw smell disappears.
Add the garlic.
Add the turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder, salt and the crushed fennel seeds. 
Mix and cook on a medium heat, until the onions start to stick to the pan, around 4 minutes. 
Once a sauce has formed, add the fried chicken along with soy sauce and lemon juice. 
Toss well to coat the chicken in the sauce.

title: Muttai Halwa
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer jar add eggs, milk powder, cardamom powder, sugar and maida. 
Blend until smooth. 
In a kadhai, pour ghee and add the cashew nuts. Cook on a moderate flame for 30 seconds or until golden brown. 
Remove and set aside. 
In the same pan pour full-fat milk and the the mixture. 
Whisk continuously on a low flame for 4-5 minutes or until a smooth, creamy halwa forms. 
Add back the cashews and mix. 
Serve warm.

title: Mini Masala Vadai
cooking_instructions:
Soak the Chana Dal for an hour and strain it well.
Add the soaked dal, dry red chillies, curry leaves, fennel seeds to a mixie and coarsely blend it
To the coarsely blend mixture, add salt, asafoetida and chopped onion.
Mix it till combined evenly
Heat oil in a kadai.
Shape the mixture into mini even sized patties and deep fry on a medium flame till golden and crispy.
Serve it hot.

title: Nalli Fry
cooking_instructions:
To a pressure cooker, add some oil.
Once hot, add the mutton and sear for 2 minutes. 
Then add water, along with turmeric powder and salt.
Bring to a boil and close the lid. Pressure cook on a medium heat for 8 - 10 whistles, depending on the mutton’s quality.
Let the pressure naturally release before opening.
In a pan, add all the ingredients needed for the masala and dry roast them until fragrant, around 2 minutes on a low heat. 
Blend into a fine powder
In a pan, add gingelly oil. Once hot, add the fennel seeds, followed by the shallots and curry leaves. 
Once the shallots brown, add the green chilli and the onion.
Cook the onions for around 6 - 7 minutes until they start to turn golden brown. 
Add the ginger garlic paste and saute until the raw smell disappears. 
Then add the masala powder and saute for an additional 2 minutes. 
Once the onions start to stick to the bottom of the pan, add the tomatoes and scrape the bottom of the pan.
Once the tomatoes have softened and become mushy, add the cooked mutton nalli along with the liquid it was cooked in, to the pan and mix to combine well. 
Add an additional ½ cup of water and simmer for 10 - 15 minutes until almost all the liquid has evaporated.
Garnish with coriander and serve hot with rice!

title: Sathak chutney
cooking_instructions:
In a kadhai, pour oil and add the dry red chillis, saute on a moderate flame until the chillies turn dark brown and crispy (around 20 seconds) and set them aside
In the same kadhai,  add the mustard seeds and urad dal, and saute until they turn aromatic (around 10 seconds).
Add the onion, garlic and tomato and saute until the onion turns light golden brown (around 5 mins)
Add salt and mix thoroughly and let it cool down. 
Once cooled, blend into a fine paste and serve.

title: Smash Masala Vadai Roll
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the channa dal for 30 mins with 2 dry red chillies. 
In a blender jar, add the soaked chana dal and chillies, garlic, fennel seeds, rice flour curry leaves and salt. 
Pulse blend to a coarse texture. 
On a chapati, spread this mixture as one even layer.
On a hot non-stick tava, add some oil and place the roll mixture side down.
Cook until golden brown, on a low flame. About 2 mins. 
Flip and cook until the chappati develops some colour, 30 secs - 1 minute. 
Place some mayonnaise and veggies in the centre and roll it up, gently. 
Food wrap can be used to secure this. Serve hot or as a lunch box meal!

title: Cookd Guntur Chicken
cooking_instructions:
Saute the onions till it turns translucent
Saute the chicken with the masala for 2 minutes
Bring it to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes

Cook to your desired consistency

title: Tomato Ketchup
cooking_instructions: Add the tomatoes to a pressure cooker along with the onion, garlic and water. Pressure cook for 15 minutes, reducing the flame to medium after the first whistle.
Blend into a smooth puree using a mixer or a hand blender.
Strain and add the puree into a pan.
Add sugar, vinegar, salt and red chilli powder. Cook on a medium heat until it thickens, around 20-25 minutes.
To check if the ketchup is cooked, add some of the ketchup to a plate. The water should not run separately. If you make a line using your finger, the shape should remain.

title: Cookd Guntur Mutton
cooking_instructions:
Heat oil in a pan/kadai.
Add curry leaves and let it crackle.
Add chopped onions and saute till translucent.
Add the washed mutton pieces and saute for a minute.
Add the Cookd Guntur Masala and mix for 2 minutes with the mutton.
Add water, mix till combined and bring it to a boil.
Cover and pressure cook the mutton for 1 whistle on a high flame and for 15 minutes (8-10 whistles) on a medium flame. 
Let the steam reduce gradually before opening the cooker.
Open the cooker, cook to your desired consistency and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Fish Fry
cooking_instructions:
Add 1 pouch (50g) masala to a bowl with 5 tbsp (75 ml) water, add juice from 1 lemon and mix to form a thick paste.
Apply the marinade on the fish and spread it evenly. let it marinate for 30 minutes for better results.
Heat a tawa, add oil and sear the fish on a medium flame for 3 minutes on each side.
Serve it hot with fried curry leaves, onion rings and lemon wedges.

title: Cookd Kerala Chicken Fry
cooking_instructions:
Add the Cookd Kerala Chicken Fry Masala to a bowl, along with water. 
Mix it to form a thick paste. 
Add the chicken pieces, mix to coat thoroughly. 
Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes for better results. 
Deep fry in hot oil on a medium flame, until crispy, around 8-10 minutes. 
Add the curry leaves and the green chilli to the hot oil to crispen.
Remove the chicken from the oil and drain on paper towels.

title: Cookd Prawn Fry
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, add all the ingredients required for the marinade and mix them well to combine. 
Add the prawns to the marinade and mix to coat well. 
Let them marinate for at least 30 minutes or overnight for better results. 
In a pan, add oil.
Once hot, add the prawn and fry on a high heat for 2 minutes per side, or until seared.
After flipping, add the curry leaves.
Once the prawns are cooked, remove and serve hot!

title: Cookd Guntur Mushroom
cooking_instructions:
Heat a pan, add oil.
Add the onions and curry leaves and saute till it turns soft and translucent.
Add the mushrooms and saute for 5 minutes on a high heat. 
Add the Cookd Guntur masala and mix the mushroom with the masala. Saute for 2 minutes on a medium heat.
Add water, mix well and bring it to a simmer.
Simmer for 5 minutes, or until the mushrooms are cooked.
Cook until the masala starts to thicken.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Kerala Paneer Fry
cooking_instructions:
Add the Cookd Kerala Chicken Fry Masala to a bowl, along with water. 
Mix it to form a thick paste.
Add the paneer cubes, mix to coat thoroughly. 
Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes for better results. 
Deep fry in hot sunflower oil/ coconut oil on a medium flame, until crispy, around 4-5 minutes. 
Add the curry leaves and the green chilli to the hot oil to crispen.
Remove the paneer from the oil and drain on paper towels.

title: Chappati Noodles
cooking_instructions:
Cut the cooked chapatis into thin strips. 
Heat a pan or wok until smoking hot. 
Add oil and then add ginger and garlic followed by all the vegetables. 
Saute for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce, salt, sugar, ketchup, chilli sauces, black pepper powder and MSG. 
Toss together on high heat for 2 minutes. 
Add the chappati noodles, and chopped spring onions and toss gently. 
Garnish with chopped spring onions and serve hot.

title: Kizhangu Bonda
cooking_instructions:
Boil and mash the potatoes while it is still hot
Heat a kadai, add oil.
Add mustard, cumin, curry leaves and let it crackle.
Add onion and green chilli. Saute till the onion turns translucent.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a few seconds.
Add the masala powders and extra oil if necessary and mix till combined and the raw aroma is gone.
Add the mashed potato and mix well till it combines with the rest of the mixture. Let it be a thick mixture.
Season the mixture, add coriander leaves and mix till combined.
Take it off the flame and let it cool down.
Make a thick batter with the required ingredients and mix till there are no lumps and the batter is smooth.
Heat oil in a kadai.
Oil your palm, take a bit of the potato mixture, shape it round.
Dip the shaped potato ball into the batter, coat it well and drain off the excess batter.
Deep fry them in hot oil on a medium flame till golden and crispy.
Serve it hot with any chutney or dip of your choice.

title: Fish Rava Fry
cooking_instructions: Mix all the ingredients for the marination together. Add water as needed to form a smooth and thick paste.
Coat the fish in the marination. Marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Combine the rava with salt in a plate/bowl. Coat the fish in the rava.
Shallow fry in oil until cooked and crisp on both sides, a total of 5-7 minutes depending on the size of the fish pieces.

title: Papaya Pakoda
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients and mix thoroughly. 
Cover and let the mixture sit for 5 mins. 
Deep fry the pakodas on a medium flame until golden brown about 3-4 minutes

title: Kathrika Varuval
cooking_instructions:
In a preheated pan, add oil. Once hot add the Urad dal. Fry it until golden, around 1 minutes on a medium heat. 
Then add the onion and garlic and saute for 4 minutes, or until softened and translucent.
Add the eggplant and mix to combine. 
Add the red chilli powder and salt, mix it well. Add a little bit of water to prevent any burning and close with a lid. 
Cook it for 10 minutes on a medium heat. 
After the eggplant has softened, add the coconut and saute on a medium high heat for 2 - 3 minutes.

title: Cookd Vazhakkai Fry
cooking_instructions:
Mix till a smooth batter is formed
Spread the marinade on the vazhakkai evenly using the side of your palm
Sear on a medium flame for 3 minutes on each side or till fully cooked

title: BBQ Chicken Wings
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, add the butter and add the garlic and shallots/onions. 
Saute until the onions turn translucent (about 1 minute). 
Add the all other ingredients and cook on a medium flame for 3-4 minutes or until the sauce thickens. 
Let the sauce cool down and blend it into a fine paste.
In a flat bowl add the corn flour, black pepper powder and salt, and mix thoroughly. 
Keep the sauce warm. 
Dip the chicken wings in the prepared flour mixture and deep fry on a medium-high flame for 4-5 minutes or until golden brown and crispy. 
Toss the fried chicken in the sauce and serve hot.

title: Meen Kozhambu Pasta
cooking_instructions:
In a pan pour oil and add the whole spices, let it crackle for 30 seconds. 
Once aromatic, add the garlic, ginger, carrots, chillies and shallots.
Saute on a moderate flame for 2-3 minutes or until the shallots turn translucent. 
Add all the spice powders and cook on a low medium flame for 30 seconds or until the raw flavour disappears.
Cool down the mixture and blend into a fine paste. 
Add the paste, and tamarind water, and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the raw flavour disappears. 
In a mixing bowl add the fish cubes and all the spice powders, cover and marinate for 30 minutes. 
In a non-stick pan, pour oil and sear the fish cubes on a high flame for 30-40 seconds on each side or until golden brown, strain and set aside. 
Add the boiled pasta to the sauce and mix thoroughly. 
Garnish with coriander and curry leaves and serve hot along with the seared fish.

title: Madurai Kizhangu Potlam
cooking_instructions:
Mash the boiled potatoes until all the big lumps are broken down. 
In a kadhai, pour sesame oil and add all the whole spices and cook on a medium flame until it becomes light golden brown and aromatic. (Around 15 seconds) 
Add the chopped shallots, ginger, garlic, green chilli and dried red chilli. 
Cook until the shallots turn very light golden brown. 
Add the mashed potatoes, powdered spices and salt and mix thoroughly. 
Add the gram flour and cook on a low medium flame for about a minute until all the raw flavour disappears. 
Pour water and cook until the mixture until it thickens again (about 30 seconds).
Garnish it with coriander leaves and serve hot with curd rice.

title: Kondakadala Kozhambu
cooking_instructions:
In a pressure cooker, pour oil and add cinnamon and fennel seeds. 
Cook on a moderate flame for 30 seconds or until fragrant. 
Add the onion and garlic and cook on a medium-high flame for 2 minutes or until translucent. 
Add the tomato and cook on a moderate flame for 2-3 minutes or until mushy. 
Add the soaked black channa dal and add the chilli powder and salt. 
Cook for 1-2 minutes on a low flame or until the raw flavour disappears.
Pour water and pressure cook on a moderate flame for 4 whistles or for 10 minutes
In a mixer jar add the coconut and gram flour and blend into a fine paste. 
Once the pressure releases, open the lid add the prepared coconut paste and water, cover and boil for 10 minutes or until the oil separates. 
Serve hot with vada.

title: Bubble Shrimp
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl combine all the ingredients for the batter. 
Whisk into a smooth batter.
Dip the prawns into the batter and deep fry on a medium-high flame for 30-40 seconds or until golden brown and crispy. 
Serve hot with the dip of your choice.

title: Mixie Chappati
cooking_instructions:
Combine the salt, oil and flour in a mixie jar. 
Add the water, in a single go. 
Pulse blend in a mixie, in short burst to clump together a dough, it should not be sticky. 
Cover and rest for 5 mins. 
Roll out the dough into a log and cut into even sized pieces. 
Roll each piece into roundels. 
Using some flour to dust, roll them into thin and large discs. 
For chapati: cook on a preheated tava, until small bubbles appear on both sides. Use the spatula then to apply some pressure even on the roti until it cooks and puffs up on both sides. 
For phulka: cook on a preheated tava, until small bubbles appear on both sides. Then use tongs and place the phulka on an open high flame, it will puff up. Flip it after a few seconds and take it off the flame. 
Apply ghee/ butter and serve hot.

title: Ghee Rice
cooking_instructions: Wash & Soak Basmati Rice in water for 30 minutes
In a pressure cooker, add 3 tbsp of ghee and fry the cashews and raisins. Drain and keep aside.
In the same pan add the onions and fry until golden brown. Drain and keep aside.
Pour 1 more tbsp of ghee to the pressure cooker, add the whole spices and fry for a minute till everything is aromatic. And then add green chilli.
Add the soaked and drained basmati rice and 2 ¼ cups of water. Add salt to it.
Pressure cook for 1 whistle and turn off the gas and do not open until the steam goes down.
Transfer the rice to a serving bowl and garnish with cashews, raisins and fried onions.

title: Pepper Chicken
cooking_instructions: Combine the chicken with the egg, cornstarch, maida and seasoning.
Shallow fry the chicken until golden, about 3 mins a side. Strain and set aside.
In a pan add some oil, add the ginger, green chilli and garlic. Saute until golden.
Add the spring onions and saute for a minute further. Add soya sauce and tomato ketchup, salt and pepper to season.
Mix well and add cornstarch slurry made with ½ Cup of water and 1 tbsp cornstarch. Mix to make a thick gravy.
Add and toss the chicken.
Garnish with spring onion greens.

title: Paccha Payaru Vadai
cooking_instructions:
Remove the skin of the split and soaked green moong using your palms under running water and set aside. 
In a mixer jar add shallots, dry red chillies, green chillies, curry leaves, ginger, garlic and cumin seeds. 
Blend it into a coarse paste. Add the de-skinned moong dal to the prepared paste and blend into a coarse paste. 
Add the sliced shallots and coriander leaves to the prepared paste and mix thoroughly. 
Shape it into small vadais and deep fry on a moderate flame for 3-4 minutes or until golden brown and crispy. 
Serve hot.

title: No Carb Chicken Bread
cooking_instructions:
In a non-stick pan pour oil and sear the chicken on a moderate flame for 3 minutes on each side or until thoroughly cooked.
Cut the chicken into small cubes.
In a mixter grinder add the chicken cubes.
Add all the other ingredients and blend the mixture into a smooth paste.
In a parchment-lined loaf tin, pour the prepared mixture and bake at 180 degrees Celsius for 20- 25 minutes or until thoroughly cooked. 
Alternatively, grease a tin and add it to a preheated pressure cooker cover the lid without the gasket and the whistle and cook on an elevation on a low- medium flame for 20- 25 minutes or until done. 
Let the “bread” cool down before cutting into it. 
Additionally, Sear the Chicken slices and serve along with a dip for better palatability

title: Fudgy Eggless Brownie
cooking_instructions:
In a double boiler or microwave, melt the butter and sugar. Do not overheat. 
Add the cocoa powder and mix well. 
In another bowl, combine the sugar, vanilla, curd, and espresso (you can also use 60ml hot water with 1 tsp of instant coffee powder). 
Whisk until the sugar dissolves. 
Combine the curd-sugar mixture with the chocolate mixture and mix. 
Sift in the maida, cornstarch, and salt. 
Gently combine by folding, do not over-mix. Add the walnuts at the end. 
Pour this batter into a square tin, lined with parchment paper and level the top. 
Rest on the counter for 10 mins, undisturbed. 
Bake in a preheated oven at 180C for 15 mins with the top and bottom heat, switch off the top rod, and bake further for 10-15 mins. 
Cool for at least 1 hour before de-molding and cutting. 
Serve as is or reheat in a microwave for 10-15 secs and serve with vanilla ice cream.

title: Instant Fried Rice
cooking_instructions:
Wash the flattened rice/ poha/ aval. 
Leave on a strainer.

In a pan add some more oil, add finely chopped garlic, onion, carrots, beans, and capsicum. 
Saute this for 3 minutes.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, salt, sugar and pepper. Now increase the flame to high and stir fry by tossing it.

Fluff and add the soaked aval to the pan.
Add the spring onion greens and continue to stir fry. 
Remove from heat and serve hot.

title: Manga Paruppu
cooking_instructions:
Wash your toor dal and let it soak in water. 
Add the dal to a pressure cooker along with the water, the chopped vegetables and slit green chillies. Turn the flame on. 
Add the turmeric powder along with the red chilli powder and allow it to come to a boil. 
Once its boiling, close the lid and allow it to cook for 6 whistles on medium flame. 
Once the pressure has released naturally, open the lid and give it a stir.
For the tempering, first add crushed garlic to ghee and allow it to become fragrant. Then add the urad dal, and mustard seeds. 
Once the mustard seeds have popped, add the cumin seeds, dry red chilli and curry leaves, and turn the flame off to prevent any burning. 
Add the tempering along with salt, to the dal and mix to incorporate

title: Mutta Vadai
cooking_instructions:
Add grated coconut, shallots, garlic, cinnamon, fennel seeds in a mixer and blend it until a fine paste.
Transfer that blended paste into a bowl

Grind the roasted gram into a fine powder.
Add 3 eggs, chilly powder, salt and roasted gram powder and mix until a smooth batter forms.

Using a spoon, scoop the batter and drop it into hot oil. 
Deep fry it for 3 minutes on medium flame until its golden brown and crispy.

title: High Protein Curd Rice
cooking_instructions:
Wash the rice 5-6 times or until the water runs clean. 
Pour a lot of water and pressure cook for 4-5 whistles on a medium-high flame or until the rice is cooked through and soft. 
Drain the rice, cover and set aside. 
Add the low-fat paneer to a mixer jar, blend it into a super fine paste, and set aside. 
In a mixing bowl, add the hung curd, paneer paste, rice, and skimmed milk and mix thoroughly. 
In a tadka pan, prepare the tempering by adding all the ingredients and add it to the curd rice. 
Finish it with salt and coriander leaves and let it chill for 30-40 minutes. 
You loosen it by adding a little more skimmed milk later.

title: Vazhaipoo Veg Meen Kuzhambu
cooking_instructions: Clean the banana flower by removing only the thicker centre stem with the round top (stamen/ stigma part of the flower)
Make a batter with the maida, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, salt and water.

Coat the banana flowers with the batter and deep fry in hot oil until crispy, 1-2 mins on a high flame. 
Strain and set aside on tissue paper.
For the masala paste: Blend together all the ingredients into a smooth paste

To make the gravy: Heat oil in a pot/ pan, add the chopped ginger, garlic and sliced shallots. Add the curry leaves and saute until the onions start turning light brown. 
Add some red chilli powder to bring out a good colour in the gravy. 
Add the coconut paste and cook for 2 mins until it becomes thick. Add water and boil for 5 mins, covered.

Soak tamarind in ½ cup of warm water. 
Add soaked tamarind, by straining, into the gravy. Add jaggery. Cover and simmer for 8 mins until the oil floats on top.

For the tempering: In a small pan/ tempering pan, heat oil and splutter mustard seeds. Add fenugreek seeds and chopped shallots. Add the curry leaves. Once the onions turn brown, add red chilli powder and pour the tempering into the gravy. 
Add the fried banana flowers and mix gently. Serve hot.

title: Roadside Chicken Pakoda
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the pakoda, mix thoroughly until combined.
Cover and let it marinate for 1 hour.
Deep fry the chicken in a moderately low flame for 10 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
Sprinkle pepper powder and serve hot with sliced onion.

title: Nombu Kanji
cooking_instructions: Soak the basmati rice and moong dal together for 20 minutes. After it soaks, lightly break the rice grains by crushing them with your fingers.
Heat oil and ghee in a pressure cooker and all the whole spices. Add onion and saute until it turns translucent.
Add the green chilli and minced mutton. Saute for 2 minutes on high heat.
Add the ginger garlic paste, chopped tomatoes, mint and coriander leaves. Saute for 2 minutes.
Add the soaked rice and dal. Saute for 1 minute, then add the water. Cover and pressure cook for 5 whistles.
Once the steam settles, open the lid and add salt and coconut milk. Mix well and serve hot.

title: Mutton Birria Tacos
cooking_instructions:
Dry roast the whole spices
Dry roast the chillies
In a pressure cooker, add ghee, followed by the onions and salt. Saute them for 6-7 minutes or until golden brown. 
Then add the whole garlic and the tomatoes. 
Cook for another 5-6 minutes or until the tomatoes are soft and mushy. 
Add the roasted spices and chillies to the cooker followed by water (1 cup) and let it boil for 2-3 minutes, or until the chillies have softened.
Transfer everything to a blender and blend until smooth.
Add the paste back to the pressure cooker and add water (1 Cup).
Add the mutton and a bay leaf to the cooker and bring it to a boil.
Close the pressure cooker and pressure cook for 12-15 whistles on a medium low heat. 
Once the pressure has naturally released, open the lid and add jaggery and salt. 
Mix to combine well and then remove the mutton pieces and place onto a plate.
Shred the mutton
Add water (1 Cup) to the remaining gravy and simmer for 3 minutes.
To assemble, first dip the parotta and the gravy and then place it in a pan
Add cheese and the shredded mutton, followed by the salsa.
Close the taco and let it sear on a medium heat for 2 minutes before flipping and searing for an additional 2 minutes,

title: Suvarotti Masala
cooking_instructions:
Add Oil to a pan.
Add onion, garlic and saute for 2 minutes.
Add tomato and saute for 2 minutes.
Add chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and add little water and cook for around 5 minutes, or until the raw smell goes. 
Add the suvarotti/spleen and add water.
Cover and cook it for 20 mins, on a medium heat.

title: Kothamalli Thogayal
cooking_instructions:
In a pan pour oil and add the whole black pepper, cumin seeds and the channa and urad dal. 
Saute on a medium-low flame until the dals turn light golden brown. 
Add the green chillies, dry red chillies, garlic, shallots and asafoetida and saute for 2-3 minutes or until the shallots turn translucent. 
Add curry leaves, salt and the coriander leaves and cook on a medium flame for 4 minutes or until the coriander leaves wilt completely. 
Add the tamarind, cook for another 2-3 minutes, and let it cool. 
Add the prepared mixture into a mixer jar and blend until a coarse paste forms.
Add the grated coconut and add it to the paste and bland until thoroughly combined. 
Serve with hot rice and ghee.

title: Nellore Prawn Vepudu
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, add all the ingredients except the coconut to a pan and toast on a medium heat for around 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Then add the coconut and saute for an additional minute, until the coconut starts to turn lightly golden.
Remove the spices from the heat and blend into a powder. 
In a pan, add oil. Once hot, add the onions, curry leaves and the green chillies. 
Saute until the onions start to turn golden, around 6 - 7 minutes on a medium high heat. 
Then add the ginger garlic paste and cook for an additional minute, or until the raw smell goes. 
Increase the flame to a high heat and add the prawns along with the prepared spice powder. 
Saute on a high heat for around 3 - 4 minutes, while constantly mixing or tossing, until the prawns have cooked.

title: Podalanga Podimas Sandwich
cooking_instructions:
In a pan add oil, fennel Seeds, urad dal and saute for 1 minute.
Add onion and saute for 3 minutes, on a medium heat.
Add tomato and saute for 2 minutes.
Add red chilli powder, turmeric, salt and mix it well and cook it for 3 minutes.
Now add Snake guard, saute and add water.
Cover and cook it for 10 minutes on a medium high flame.
Add egg and cook it for 3 minutes, on a medium heat.
Toast the bread until golden brown, on both sides.
Place the egg and snake gourd mixture on one of the toasted slices and then cover with the second toasted slice of bread.

title: Raw Jackfruit Biryani
cooking_instructions:
To clean the jackfruit, use some oil on your hands and a sharp knife to peel the knife and dice it, remove any larger seeds. Soak the jackfruit in water after cleaning. 
Marinate the jackfruit with all the other ingredients mentioned under marination. Marinate this for 30 mins, if you have the time. 
In a pressure cooker, heat the oil and ghee. Add bay leaf, cinnamon, cloves, cardamom and fry for 30 seconds. Add the cashew and raisins and fry till golden.  Add the onions and fry until golden. Add the green chillies. 
Add the marinated jackfruit, and water and cook until 75% cooked, about 6-8 mins. 
Add the coconut milk. Add the salt and bring it to a boil. 
Wash and soak the basmati rice for 20 mins.Add the soaked rice and pressure cook this for 2 whistles and switch off/ for 15 mins on a low flame. Let the pressure settle down on its own.
Open the pressure cooker, add 1 tbsp of melted ghee, and fluff the rice. Garnish with fried onions and serve hot with raita.

title: Lakshmi Kozhambu
cooking_instructions:
Extract the tamarind water and set aside.
In a mixer jar add grated coconut, pepper, fennel seeds, half cup water and grind to a fine paste.
In a bowl add the coconut paste, tamarind water, red chili powder, turmeric powder, salt and mix it well and set aside.
In a pan add groundnut oil, coconut oil, urad dal, fenugreek and mix it for a while.
Add shallots, Garlic and saute for 5 mins.
Add tomato and saute for 5 mins.
Now add the coconut mixture to the pan, add 2 cups of water and mix it well.
Simmer it for 20 mins on a medium flame.
Serve hot

title: Kothamalli Podi
cooking_instructions:
In a kadhai, pour oil and add the dals, sesame seeds, black pepper, chillies and garlic. 
Saute until the dals turn deep golden brown and aromatic. 
Add in all the other ingredients and saute until the coriander leaves are completely wilted and the mixture turns dry. 
Let the mixture cool completely. This will make sure the mixture once blended does not  turn into a paste. 
Once thoroughly cooled, add it into a mixer jar and blend it into a coarse powder. 
Transfer the podi into an airtight container and store upto 3 weeks in the refrigerator.

title: Susiyam
cooking_instructions:
Soak the Chana dal in water for 60 mins.
Heat a pan, add 1 tsp of ghee and 2 tbsp of grated coconut. Saute this till coconut turns golden brown.
Cook the soaked chana dal with 2 Cup of water in a pressure cooker on a medium flame for 5 whistles. 
Remove the pressure cooker from heat and let the pressure settle down. 
Drain out the water from the Chana. 
Transfer the cooked chana dal to a mixer grinder jar. Grind the chana dal with cardamom powder and jaggery.
Transfer the ground mixture to a pan and saute for 5 mins to remove moisture. 
Set this aside to cool
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients for the batter and whisk until a smooth batter is formed.
Make lemon sized balls out of this cooled mixture.
Dip the dal balls into the batter and deep fry on a moderately hot oil until light golden brown and crispy. 
Serve hot

title: Kerala Egg Roast
cooking_instructions: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes with some water and 1 tsp of salt.
Peel and make shallow slits on the sides. Set aside.
Heat oil in a pan and crackle mustard seeds. Add the fennel seeds, ginger, garlic, onions, green chilies, curry leaves, and ½ tsp salt.
Add curry leaves and ½ tsp salt. Saute and cook on medium heat until the onions turn golden brown.

Add the turmeric powder, red chili powder, Kashmiri chili powder, coriander powder, and black pepper powder. Saute and cook for 4 minutes, or until the raw smell of the spices disappear. If it gets too dry, add 1 tbsp more of oil.
Add the tomatoes and Garam masala, saute and cook for 5 more minutes.
Add the coconut milk and cook for a further 3 minutes.
Add the eggs mix gently to coat the eggs with the onions.
Turn off the heat, cover, and let sit for 3 minutes.

title: Home-Style Kadala Curry
cooking_instructions:
Soak the brown channa in water overnight. 
In a pressure cooker, add the channa, onion, ginger, garlic, green chilli, curry leaves and salt. Add water and pressure cook for 6 whistles. 
Dry roast the whole spices, and coconut and add them in a mixie with the powdered spices and some water. Grind into a smooth paste. 
Add the paste to the boiled channa and bring to a boil. 
In a tempering pan, add coconut oil and splutter the mustard seeds. Add the remaining ingredients and saute until the shallots and coconut chunks turn golden brown. 
Add the tempering to the gravy, mix well and serve hot.

title: Cookd Kerala Fried Mushroom
cooking_instructions:
Add the Cookd Kerala Fry Masala to a bowl, along with water. 
Mix it to form a thick paste. 
Add the mushrooms and mix to coat  thoroughly.
Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes. 
Deep fry in hot oil, until crispy, around 4 - 5 minutes. 
Add the curry leaves and the green chilli to the hot oil to crispen.
Remove the mushrooms from the oil and drain on paper towels.

title: Cookd Kerala Prawn Fry
cooking_instructions:
Add the Cookd Kerala Fry Masala to a bowl, along with water. 
Mix it to form a thick paste. 
Add the prawns and mix till it is coated evenly. 
Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes. 
Deep fry in hot oil, until crispy, around 3-4 minutes. 
Add the curry leaves and the green chilli to the hot oil to crispen.
Remove the prawns from the oil and drain on paper towels.

title: Cookd Prawn Rava Fry
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, add all the ingredients required for the marinade and mix them well to combine. 
Add the prawns to the marinade and mix to coat well. 
Let them marinate for at least 30 minutes, and up till overnight. 
Right before frying the prawns, toss the prawn in rava, and coat them thoroughly.
In a pan, add oil.
Once hot, add the prawn and fry on a high heat for 2 minutes per side, or until seared.
After flipping, add the curry leaves.
Once the prawns are cooked, remove and serve hot!

title: Cookd Vizhinjam Chicken Fry
cooking_instructions:
Add the Cookd Kerala Chicken Fry Masala to a bowl, along with water. 
Mix it to form a thick paste. 
Add the chicken pieces, mix to coat thoroughly. 
Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes for better results.
Deep fry in hot oil on a medium flame, until crispy, around 8-10 minutes. 
Add the curry leaves and the green chilli to the hot oil to crispen.
Remove the chicken from the oil and drain on paper towels.

title: Cookd Paneer Manchurian
cooking_instructions:
Make a batter with the chinese fry mix by adding it to a bowl, along with ¼ Cup of water. 
Add the paneer to the batter and mix it well, ensuring it is well coated.
Add the coated paneer to the hot oil and deep fry for 3 - 4 minutes or until lightly golden and crispy. 
Remove from the oil and drain the excess oil.
Add the Cookd Manchurian Paste to a pan along with ¼ Cup of water and mix to combine well. 
Add the capsicum and onions and saute for 2 - 3 minutes, until the capsicum slightly softens. 
Add the deep fried paneer to the sauce and toss to coat well.
Garnish with spring onions greens and serve hot.

title: Cookd Paneer Hot Garlic
cooking_instructions:
Make a batter with the chinese fry mix by adding it to a bowl, along with ¼ Cup of water. 
Add the paneer to the batter and mix it well, ensuring it is well coated.
Add the coated paneer to the hot oil and deep fry for 3 - 4 minutes or until lightly golden and crispy. 
Remove from the oil and drain the excess oil.
Add the Cookd Hot Garlic Paste to a pan along with ¼ Cup of water and mix to combine well. 
Add the capsicum and onions and saute for 2 - 3 minutes, until the capsicum slightly softens. 
Add the deep fried paneer to the sauce and toss to coat well.
Garnish with spring onions greens and serve hot.

title: Cookd Paneer Black Pepper
cooking_instructions:
Make a batter with the chinese fry mix by adding it to a bowl, along with ¼ Cup of water. 
Add the paneer to the batter and mix it well, ensuring it is well coated.
Add the coated paneer to the hot oil and deep fry for 3 - 4 minutes or until lightly golden and crispy. 
Remove from the oil and drain the excess oil.
Add the Cookd Black Pepper Paste to a pan along with ¼ Cup of water and mix to combine well. 
Add the capsicum and onions and saute for 2 - 3 minutes, until the capsicum slightly softens. 
Add the deep fried paneer to the sauce and toss to coat well.
Garnish with spring onions greens and serve hot.

title: Cookd Chicken Black Pepper
cooking_instructions:
Make a batter with the chinese fry mix by adding it to a bowl, along with ¼ Cup of water. 
Add the chicken to the batter and mix it well, ensuring it is well coated.
Add the coated chicken to the hot oil and deep fry for 5 - 6 minutes or until lightly golden, cooked and crispy. 
Remove from the oil and drain the excess oil.
Add the Cookd Black Pepper Paste to a pan along with ¼ Cup of water and mix to combine well. 
Add the capsicum and onions and saute for 2 - 3 minutes, until the capsicum slightly softens. 
Add the deep fried chicken to the sauce and toss to coat well.
Garnish with spring onions greens and serve hot.

title: Deviled Eggs
cooking_instructions: Hard boil the eggs for 12 mins, in salted water.
Peel and cut them in half. Keeping the halves intact, remove the yolks and place them in a bowl.
In the bowl of yolks, add mustard, vinegar, mayonnaise, salt, and pepper. Whisk until smooth and well combined.
Fill this egg yolk mixture in a piping bag with a star nozzle.
Pipe the mixture back into the hollow egg halves. Garnish with red chili powder and chopped spring onion greens.

title: Cookd Chicken Hot Garlic
cooking_instructions:
Make a batter with the chinese fry mix by adding it to a bowl, along with ¼ Cup of water. 
Add the chicken to the batter and mix it well, ensuring it is well coated.
Add the coated chicken to the hot oil and deep fry for 5 - 6 minutes or until lightly golden and crispy. 
Remove from the oil and drain the excess oil.
Add the Cookd Hot Garlic Paste to a pan along with ¼ Cup of water and mix to combine well. 
Add the capsicum and onions and saute for 2 - 3 minutes, until the capsicum slightly softens. 
Add the deep fried chicken to the sauce and toss to coat well.
Garnish with spring onions greens and serve hot.

title: Cookd Chicken Manchurian
cooking_instructions:
Make a batter with the chinese fry mix by adding it to a bowl, along with ¼ Cup of water. 
Add the chicken to the batter and mix it well, ensuring it is well coated.
Add the coated chicken to the hot oil and deep fry for 5 - 6 minutes or until lightly golden and crispy. 
Remove from the oil and drain the excess oil.
Add the Cookd Manchurian Paste to a pan along with ¼ Cup of water and mix to combine well. 
Add the capsicum and onions and saute for 2 - 3 minutes, until the capsicum slightly softens. 
Add the deep fried chicken to the sauce and toss to coat well.
Garnish with spring onions greens and serve hot.

title: Vaazhaipoo Vadai
cooking_instructions:
Separate the florets from the Banana Flower making shore to keep them in the same bunch. 
Do not throw away the core, fine-chop it and add it to your vadai. 
Rub the florets on your palm to expose the stigma and remove it. 
Finely chop the florets and add it to plain buttermilk (this prevents it from going black)
In a mixer jar add the garlic, dried red chilli, and channa dal. 
Before adding the banana florets to the blender wash them in clean water, Reserve some to add later 
Blend the ingredients until a thick very coarse paste forms
Add in all the other ingredients and the banana florets and mix thoroughly
Shape the mixture into vadais and deep fry on a moderate flame until golden brown (around 4 minutes). 
Serve super hot with coconut chutney

title: Kothamalli Kozhambu
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer jar, add all the ingredients for the paste and blend until smooth. Set aside. 
In a kadhai pour, add sesame oil and the cumin seeds, fenugreek seed, and mustard seeds. Once the mustard seeds splutter and the fenugreek turns golden, add in the garlic. 
Saute the garlic on a moderate flame until golden brown, soft and aromatic. 
Add in the prepared paste, and saute on a moderate flame for 3 minutes until the raw flavour disappears. 
Add the tomatoes, and turmeric powder and saute on a moderate flame until the raw flavour disappears and the tomatoes turn soft and mushy. 
Pour water and bring it to a boil. 
Let the kozhambu cook until nice and thick (around 4-5 mins)
Serve hot with ghee and rice.

title: Pakistani Mutton Korma
cooking_instructions: In oil, fry the onions until golden brown and drain on tissue. Crush them and set aside.
In a bowl, combine and whisk the curd, with the powdered spices and rose water.
In a pot, add the ghee and sear the mutton pieces. Remove the pieces.

Add the whole spices. 
Add the ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute. 
Reduce the flame, add the curd mixture, and continuously stir.

Once the gravy starts to form, add the mutton pieces. 
Add 2 cups of water, cover and simmer for 40 mins. 
Remove the whole spices, if possible. Serve hot with naan/ kulcha or sheermal.

title: Egg Velluli Karam
cooking_instructions: To make the masala paste, add all the ingredients required to a mortar and pestle and crush until smooth.
Make slits into the hard boiled eggs

In a pan, add some oil. Once hot, add the garlic, urad dal, mustard seeds, and curry leaves. Saute for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and saute for 5 - 6 minutes or until lightly golden.
Add the eggs to the pan and toss to coat well.

title: Vellai paniyaram
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice and urad dal for 1 Hour.

Blend the rice and urad dal using a little bit of the soaked water. 
Blend into a smooth batter.
Now add salt and sugar to the batter and mix it well.
Rest the batter for half an hour.
In a kadai, heat oil for deep frying.
Using a ladle, pour the batter into the hot oil and fry it for 1 minute.
Serve it hot with some spicy chutney.

title: Kadapa Karam Dosa
cooking_instructions:
To make the podi, add all the ingredients required for it, to a blender, and blend until a fine powder is formed.
Add the dry red chillies and the garlic to a bowl and pour boiling water to cover. Let them steep for 15 - 20 minutes or until the chillies have softened. 
Add the soaked chillies and the garlic to a blender along with a tablespoon of the soaking water. 
Add the onion, cumin seed and salt to the soaked chillies and blend until a smooth thick paste is formed.
In a separate bowl, dissolve the besan in water and add the tamarind pulp. 
To make the Bombay chutney, add oil to a pan. Once hot, add the garlic. Once lightly golden, add the urad dal, cumin seeds and mustard seeds. 
Once the mustard seeds pop, add the ginger, green chilli, turmeric powder and salt. 
Saute on a medium heat for 30 seconds
Add this besan mixture to the pan and mix continuously, on medium low flame. 
After 5 minutes, the mixture will significantly thicken. Turn the flame off
Heat up a dosa pan on a medium flame. Once hot, add a ladle of dosa batter and spread into a thin even layer. 
Add a spoon of ghee and spread it around. 
Add a spoon of bombay chutney along with a spoon of chilli paste and spread all over the dosa. 
Sprinkle the podi all over the dosa.
Once the dosa is crispy and golden fold and remove from the pan.

title: Orange Payasam
cooking_instructions:
Heat ghee in a pot, and add the cashews and raisins, once the cashews turn brown and the raisins puff, remove and keep aside.
In the same pot, add the rice and stir for 30 seconds on medium heat.
Add and bring the milk to a boil and continue simmering on a medium-low flame for 25 mins, while stirring occasionally. Scrape the cream gathered on the sides. 
Add sugar and vanilla essence. Continue simmering for 10 mins or until the quantity is reduced by 30%. 
Chill it for about 30 mins.
Remove and add the entire pulp of the orange (remove skins, seeds etc…) and the zest. 
Add the orange pulp, zest and fried nuts into the payasam. 
Serve immediately or chilled.

title: Avial
cooking_instructions: For the paste, combine the grated coconut, cumin, shallots, garlic, turmeric powder, and green chilly and make a coarse paste. Then add the curd and blend it until just combined, to form a coarse paste. Set this aside.
Add all the vegetables to a pressure cooker along with turmeric, salt, and ½ cup of water.
Cook it for 1 whistle. Allow the pressure to release naturally before opening the lid.
Bring the cooker back on the stove. Add the paste. Once the paste is added, stir and cook for only 1 minute.
Add curry leaves and coconut oil on top, cover with a lid and turn off the stove. Cover with a lid and let it sit for 2 minutes. Avial is ready to be served with rice or Adai.

title: Kothu Idli
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, pour oil and add in the whole garam masalas and saute until aromatic. 
Add in the onion, garlic, and ginger garlic paste and saute until the onion turns translucent. 
Add in the tomato and curry leaves and saute until the tomato turns mushy (around 3 mins)
Add in all the powdered spices and cook until aromatic (around 2 mins)
Tear in the idli and add onion, tomato, curry leaves, salt and pepper. 
Mix that in until thoroughly combined. 
Garnish it with coriander leaves and serve hot

title: Ratha Koottu
cooking_instructions:
In a cooker add onion, tomato, and channa dal and cook it for 5 whistles on a medium flame. (around 15 mins)
Add coconut and fennel seeds in a mixer jar and blend it until coarse. 
Once the pressure dissipates, open the cooker and add the red chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt, and goat’s blood. Close the cooker and cook it for 5 minutes without the whistle. 
Add oil, fennel seeds, cinnamon, and bay leaf, and saute for 1 minute in a kadai.
Now add the cooked blood mixture to the kadai.
Add the coconut paste, and half a cup of water and simmer it for 5 minutes.

title: Korean Stir Fried Rice Balls
cooking_instructions:
To a bowl, add the dry red chillis and 2 cloves of garlic. Pour boiling water and let them steep until the chillis soften, around 20 minutes. 
Add the soaked chillis and garlic to a blender along with some of the soaking liquid to make a smooth paste. 
To make the rice balls, add salt and pepper to cooked rice. Mix it well.
Transfer the mixture to a blender and blend until the rice becomes slightly pasty and sticky. 
Oil your hands along with a plate and roll the rice in a round shape. 
Place in the fridge for 10-15 minutes to set. 
To make the batter, add all the ingredients required and mix it well to dissolve. 
Dip the rice balls in the batter and add directly to hot oil for deep frying. 
Deep fry for 4 - 5 minutes or until lightly golden brown. 
To a pan, add some oil. Once hot, add the chilli paste, grated ginger and grated garlic  to the pan and cook it for 15 - 20 minutes, adding water if the paste sticks to the pan. 
The paste should have significantly darkened and the rawness of the chillis should be gone. 
Then turn the flame off and add water to loosen the paste along with soy sauce, honey, salt and vinegar. Mix to combine well. 
Add the deep fried balls to the sauce and toss to coat well
Garnish with sesame seeds and spring onion greens.

title: High Protein Pongal
cooking_instructions:
In a pressure cooker add the dals and rice one by one and saute on a medium flame until golden brown and set aside. (around 2 minutes each)
Add the roasted dals and rice to a mixing bowl. 
Pour water and wash it thoroughly. 
In the same pressure cooker add the roasted and washed dals and rice, pour water and pressure cook on a medium flame for 5-6 whistles (around 15 mins). 
Once fully cooked, mash everything until mushy. 
In a tadka pan pour ghee, add ginger, green chillies, cumin seeds, whole black pepper, curry leaves and asafoetida. 
Add it to the Pongal. Serve hot.

title: RaMONE (Kerala Ramen)
cooking_instructions:
To a deep pot, add oil. Once hot, place the onion and the ginger flat side down. 
Add the garlic and the curry leaves and sear until deeply golden, around 5 - 6 minutes on a medium heat.
Then add the whole spices and salt and saute for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and saute on a high heat, or until the mushrooms starts to brown and almost all the water has evaporated, around 7 - 8 minutes.
Pour in the water to prevent burning and scrape the bottom of the pan. 
Bring the water to a boil and then lower the flame to a simmer. 
Simmer it for 30 - 40 minutes on a medium low flame, to maintain a simmer.
Then add the coconut milk along with salt and the honey. Mix to combine well and simmer for 5 minutes on a medium heat.
Strain the broth.
To make the noodles add all the ingredients to a bowl and mix until a shaggy dough forms. 
Knead the dough for around 6 - 8 minutes until a smooth soft dough forms.
Cover the dough and rest for 30 minutes. 
Add a piece of dough to a murukku press and press it directly into boiling water. 
Cook the noodles for 2 minutes or until they float.
Remove from the boiling water and dunk into cold water. 
To make the mushroom steak preheat a stainless steel pan. Once hot, add oil. 
Add the mushrooms slit side down and press for 10 seconds. 
Once deeply golden brown on the slit side, flip the mushrooms, lower the flame to low and add butter, garlic, curry leaves and coconut slits to the pan. 
Once the butter melts and becomes foamy, baste the mushrooms by spooning the melted butter over them. 
Keep basting for 2 - 3 minutes. 
Remove the mushrooms from the pan and let them rest. 
To plate the dish, place the noodles in a bowl, followed by the broth. 
Place the fried coconut, mushrooms, garlic and lemon wedges along the side of the bowl followed by a sprinkling of coriander leaves. 
Serve hot!

title: MLA Potlam Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Add ghee and oil to a pot. Once hot, add the whole spices and saute for 1 minute on a medium heat or until fragrant. 
Add the onions, salt, curry leaves and green chilli and saute for 8 - 10 minutes or until golden and soft. 
Then add the ginger garlic paste and saute for an additional 2 minutes. 
Add the coriander leaves and mint leaves and mix to combine well.
Once the leaves have wilted add the mutton kheema and cook on a high heat for 10 minutes, until all the water from the kheema has evaporated.
Add the spice powders along with the curd, water and mix to combine well. 
Cook for an additional 10 minutes until the kheema is fully cooked. 
Add the prawn to the pot and mix to combine well. 
Cook for 2 minutes before turning the heat off and covering. 
To make the rice, bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the whole spices and salt once its boiling. 
Add the rice and stir gently. 
Cook for 8 - 10 minutes or until the rice is 80 percent cooked. It should start floating to the top.
Strain all the rice. 
To the pot with the kheema prawn mixture, add half of the rice and spread into an even layer. 
Add mint leaves, coriander leaves and fried onions. 
Add the rest of the rice and repeat by adding mint leaves, coriander leaves and fried onions. 
Add the red oil along with ghee and cover with a lid.
Dum cook for 18 minutes, on a low heat
Once finished, turn the heat off and rest for 15 minutes
While resting, add all the ingredients required for the omelette into a bowl and mix well.
Add the egg mixture to a large nonstick pan and spread into a thin layer.
Cook on a low heat until nicely set. 
Remove from the pan and place on a plate. 
Break the dum of the biryani and add some to the centre of the omelette. 
Wrap tightly like a burrito.

title: Cookd Gobi Manchurian
cooking_instructions:
In the Kit there should be one packet of Chinese Fry Mix and one packet of the Stir Fry Sauce 
Make a batter with the chinese fry mix by adding it to a bowl, along with ¼ Cup of water. 
Add the cauliflower to the batter and mix it well, ensuring it is well coated.
Add the coated cauliflower to the hot oil and deep fry for 5 - 6 minutes or until lightly golden and crispy. 
Remove from the oil and drain the excess oil.
Add the Cookd Manchurian Paste to a pan along with ¼ Cup of water and mix to combine well. 
Add the capsicum and onions and saute for 2 - 3 minutes, until the capsicum slightly softens. 
Add the deep fried cauliflower to the sauce and toss to coat well.
Garnish with spring onions greens and serve hot.

title: Pav Bhaji
alternate_titles: Bhaji-Pav, Mumbai Pav Bhaji, Street Style Pav Bhaji
cooking_instructions: Dry roast all the ingredients except dry mango powder.
Add dry mango powder to the hot ingredients.
Once cool, grind it into a fine powder using a mixer grinder.
Add cauliflower florets, potatoes, peas to a pressure cooker and pour 2 ½ cups of water to partially cover them and 1 tsp of salt and pressure cook for 3 whistles.
Strain the vegetables from the water. Mash the veggies using a potato masher.
Heat a pan, add 2 tbsp of butter, add finely chopped onions and fry until they turn translucent.
Add ginger-garlic paste, green chili, and sauté till it becomes fragrant.
Add capsicum, chopped tomatoes, salt to taste and sauté until tomatoes get soft and mushy.
Add chili powder, turmeric powder, and pav bhaji masala powder and saute for another 2 minutes.
Add boiled and mashed veggies. Mix until well combined.
Make a hole in the centre. Add the butter and once it melts, add Kashmiri chilli powder. Mix well to form a bright red colour, then mix the masala together.
Add water to get the correct consistency. Add lemon juice, Kasuri methi and cook until it reaches the desired consistency.
Add water to get the correct consistency. Add lemon juice, Kasuri methi, and cook until it reaches the desired consistency.
Heat butter on a pan. Open the buns and sprinkle some pav bhaji masala powder on the butter. Place the pav and toast them for a minute.
Serve the toasted Pav with the prepared Bhaji. Garnish with some onions, lemon wedges, and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Gobi Hot Garlic
cooking_instructions:
In the Kit there should be one packet of Chinese Fry Mix and one packet of the Stir Fry Sauce 
Make a batter with the chinese fry mix by adding it to a bowl, along with ¼ Cup of water. 
Add the cauliflower to the batter and mix it well, ensuring it is well coated.
Add the coated cauliflower to the hot oil and deep fry for 5 - 6 minutes or until lightly golden and crispy. 
Remove from the oil and drain the excess oil.
Add the Cookd Hot Garlic Paste to a pan along with ¼ Cup of water and mix to combine well. 
Add the capsicum and onions and saute for 2 - 3 minutes, until the capsicum slightly softens. 
Add the deep fried cauliflower to the sauce and toss to coat well.
Garnish with spring onions greens and serve hot.

title: Cookd Gobi Black Pepper
cooking_instructions:
In the Kit there should be one packet of Chinese Fry Mix and one packet of the Stir Fry Sauce 
Make a batter with the chinese fry mix by adding it to a bowl, along with ¼ Cup of water. 
Add the cauliflower to the batter and mix it well, ensuring it is well coated.
Add the coated cauliflower to the hot oil and deep fry for 5 - 6 minutes or until lightly golden, cooked and crispy. 
Remove from the oil and drain the excess oil.
Add the Cookd Black Pepper Paste to a pan along with ¼ Cup of water and mix to combine well. 
Add the capsicum and onions and saute for 2 - 3 minutes, until the capsicum slightly softens. 
Add the deep fried cauliflower to the sauce and toss to coat well.
Garnish with spring onions greens and serve hot.

title: Duplicate kolambu
cooking_instructions:
In a cooker, pour oil and add the fennel seeds, once they crackle add the onion, tomato and saute it for 3 minutes.
Now add the red chili powder, turmeric powder, salt and saute it for 3 minutes.
Now close the lid and in a medium flame leave it for 5 whistles until it gets mashed.
In a kadai, pour oil and add black pepper seeds, cumin seeds and roast it for a minute.
Add these roasted things to a mixer jar along with the coconut and grains to a fine paste.
Transfer the ingredients from the cooker into the kadai and pour the coconut paste into it.
Add water and simmer it for 10 mins.
Now add garlic , curry leaves , coconut slits and simmer it for 5 minutes.

title: Cookd Guntur Chicken Kuzhambu
cooking_instructions:
Heat oil in a pan/kadai
Add curry leaves and let it crackle
Add chopped onions and saute till translucent
Add the washed chicken pieces and saute for a minute
Add the Cookd Guntur Masala and mix for 2 minutes with the chicken.
Add water, mix till combined and bring it to a boil.
Cover and simmer the chicken for 15 minutes.
Open the pan, cook to your desired consistency and serve it hot.

title: Veg Muttai Podimas
cooking_instructions:
Combine the gram flour, salt, pepper, powdered spices, baking powder, and maida into a thin batter with water. The batter should be thin and runny.
Heat oil in a pan, splutter mustard seeds, and add curry leaves. 
Add the onions, green chillies, and tomatoes. Saute until soft. 
Pour a ladle full of the batter, allow it to set. Then stir continuously it to break it up, it must not set in large lumps. 
Finish with chopped coriander leaves.

title: Perugu Toast
cooking_instructions:
Add the curd to a bowl. To the same bowl, add salt, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, besan, chopped green chilli, salt, grated ginger, grated garlic and mix well. 
Once combined, spread the mixture on both sides of the bread. 
To a hot nonstick pan, add oil. Then add the bread on cook on a medium low heat for 3 minutes on both side. The bread should be golden brown.
In a separate pan, add ghee. Once hot, add the garlic and saute for 2 minutes, or until fragrant and starting to turn golden brown. 
Then add the urad dal and cashews. 
Add the curry leaves, mustard seeds and red chillies.
Cook for 30 seconds or until the aromatic. 
Pour the tempering onto the bread and serve hot!

title: Kachayam
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, mash the banana and all the ingredients - Maida, Rava, Rice Flower, Sugar, Coconut, Cardamom Powder
Salt and Baking Soda. Add the water and make it into a batter

Add the batter as small roundels in hot oil and deep fry until golden brown.
Serve hot

title: Sev Tamatar Bhaji
cooking_instructions:
Heat ghee and oil in a pot, splutter the mustard seeds and add the cumin seeds. Add the asafoetida. 
Add garlic and cook for a minute until light golden brown. 
Add onions and cook until they are soft and translucent.
Add the powdered spices and cook further for a minute.
Add tomatoes and salt, and cook until they are soft and completely mashed. 
Add hot water and mix, and cook for 5 minutes, until the oil separates.
Add garam masala and sugar, and mix well. 
Add thick sev/ gaati sev to the gravy and bring it to a boil, and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Finish it with some freshly chopped coriander leaves.
Serve hot with roti or bhakri.

title: Raju Gari Chicken Pulao
cooking_instructions: Make the paste from the green chillies and fried onions. Set aside.
Wash the rice and soak for 15 minutes.
In a pressure cooker, heat ghee and oil together. Add all the whole spices.
Add the cashew nuts and the shallots. Saute until golden brown.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and the previously prepared paste. Add the turmeric powder, red chili powder, salt, and garam masala.
Add the chicken and mix well. Saute for 2 minutes.
Add the curd, coriander leaves, and mint leaves. Mix well. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add water to the pan and bring it to a boil. Add the soaked rice.
Pressure cook on high heat for 1 whistle, then low heat for 1 more whistle.

title: Gobi Hot Garlic Gravy
cooking_instructions:
Make a batter with the chinese fry mix by adding it to a bowl, along with ¼ Cup of water. 
Add the cauliflower to the batter and mix it well, ensuring it is well coated.
Add the coated cauliflower to the hot oil and deep fry for 5 - 6 minutes or until lightly golden and crispy. 
Remove from the oil and drain the excess oil.
Add the Cookd Hot Garlic Sauce to a pan along with 1 Cup of water and mix to combine well. 
Add the capsicum and onions and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, until the capsicum slightly softens. 
Add the cornstarch slurry and mix well to combine and thicken
Add the deep fried cauliflower to the sauce and toss to coat well.
Garnish with spring onions greens and serve hot.

title: Cookd Gobi Manchurian Gravy
cooking_instructions:
Make a batter with the chinese fry mix by adding it to a bowl, along with ¼ Cup of water. 
Add the cauliflower to the batter and mix it well, ensuring it is well coated.
Add the coated cauliflower to the hot oil and deep fry for 5 - 6 minutes or until lightly golden and crispy. 
Remove from the oil and drain the excess oil.
Add the Cookd Manchurian Sauce to a pan along with 1 Cup of water and mix to combine well. 
Add the capsicum and onions and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, until the capsicum slightly softens. 
Add the cornstarch slurry and mix well to combine and thicken
Add the deep fried cauliflower to the sauce and toss to coat well.
Garnish with spring onions greens and serve hot.

title: Vegetable Manchurian
alternate_titles: Cabbage Manchurian, Manchurian Balls, Veg Manchurian
cooking_instructions: Add the cabbage, carrot, beans, and capsicum to a bowl. Add salt, soy sauce, and black pepper powder, and mix well. Press the vegetables a bit so that they release some of their excess moisture.

Add the Maida and cornflour, and mix well. You should be able to form them into roughly shaped balls. Adjust accordingly. If it is too dry, you can sprinkle some water and mix again. If it is too wet, adjust with a little bit of cornflour.
Deep fry on medium heat until it is golden brown. Cut open one piece to ensure that it is cooked inside. Set them aside.
In a wok or a Kadai, heat up oil and add the garlic and ginger and saute for 30 seconds. Add onion and cook until it turns translucent.
Add ketchup, soy sauce and chilli sauce. Mix well and add ½ cup of water. Bring it to a boil.
Add the salt and vinegar, then the fried Manchurian balls, and cook for 1 minute.
Make a slurry paste by mixing the cornflour with some water. Add this to the pan, along with the spring onions, and cook until the sauce thickens and coats the Manchurian. Garnish with spring onion.

title: Ragi Biscuts for baby
cooking_instructions:
In a blender, blend Almonds, Cashews and Sugar into a fine powder.
Mix this with softened butter and mix well
Add the Ragi flour, Baking Soda with Milk and mix everything together.
In a baking pan lined with butter paper, pipe the batter into small rounds and flatten it.
Set Up an makeshift oven with salt in a large heavy bottom pan and heat it.
Place a metal stand in the center of the pan and place the baking pan on it.
Cover the pan with lid and bake on medium high heat for 22 mins.

title: Onion Tomato Chutney
cooking_instructions: In a mixer jar add the onion, tomato and blend it to a fine paste.

In a kadai, pour oil and add mustard seeds, urad dal and let it crackle.
Now add the onion tomato paste into the kadai.
Add red chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and cook it for 10 minutes until the raw smell goes out.

title: Ginger Chutney
cooking_instructions: In a kadhai, pour oil and add the dry red chillis, saute on a moderate flame until the chillies turn dark brown and crispy (around 20 seconds) and set them aside.
In a mixer jar add these roasted chilies, ginger, garlic, salt and blend it to a fine paste.

title: High Protein Masala Dosa
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl, add all the dry ingredients for the dosa batter wash and let it soak for at least 1 hour.

Add the soaked ingredients and blend them into a super fine paste without adding any water. 
Add the other ingredients to the dosa batter and mix thoroughly.
In a pan pour oil and add all the ingredients for the tempering, onion, green chillies and ginger and saute until the onion turns translucent.
Add the spice powders, the mashed potatoes and the hung curd and mix thoroughly.
In a pan pour and spread the batter and pour 1 tsp of ghee, once the dosa is cooked and crispy add the prepared masala in the middle of the dosa fold it in half and serve hot

title: Homemade Bread Rolls
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, add the lukewarm milk and water. Add the sugar and mix to dissolve
Add the yeast and rest for 5 mins, this is to bloom/ activate te yeast and check if it active
Measure and add the flour, salt, and melted butter. 
Use a spoon to bring together a rough dough. Clump it together and rest for 5 mins to make it easier to knead. 
On a floured surface, knead the dough non-stop for 10 mins. Outward to inward in circular motions is easy to follow
Grease a bowl with oil, rest the dough for 40 mins or until double in size
Divide the dough into 8 equal parts, flatten them out, and roll them tightly into a log
Rest again for 40 mins
Brush with milk and bake in a preheated oven at 180C for 25 mins, until golden brown. 
Brush with butter while hot and cool completely before cutting/ serving.

title: Mysore Bonda
cooking_instructions:
Add all the ingredients required for the bonda, to a bowl and mix to combine well. 
Mix until a thick smooth batter forms (around 2 minutes)
Let the batter rest for 5 minutes. 
Using your hand or spoon, add small balls of batter into hot oil and deep fry until golden brown, around 5 minutes. 
Remove from the oil and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with coconut chutney!

title: Cookd Pasta Biryani
cooking_instructions:
In a pot add water and bring to a boil, 
Add pasta and cook it for 10 minutes.
Once cooked, strain the pasta and add oil. Toss to coat and keep it aside.
In a kadai add the Cookd Wedding bhai biryani paste and saute it for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken and saute it for 2 minutes.
Now add the water and cover and cook it for 8 minutes.
Now add the pasta and mix it gently.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Plastic Chutney
cooking_instructions: Peel and cut the raw papaya into small thin slices
Blanch the raw papaya in boiling water for 2 minutes before straining and transferring to an ice bath

Add the water and sugar to a pot and bring to a boil. Cook for 10 minutes on a medium heat.
Strain the blanched raw papaya and add it to the mixture. 
Bring to a boil and then reduce the heat to a medium heat. The mixture should be simmering. 
Cook for an additional 25 minutes, or until the raw papaya turns translucent.

Add the lemon juice, salt and carom seeds. 
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and refrigerate for 2 hours. 
Serve chilled!

title: Arachivitta Sambar
cooking_instructions:
For the dal, wash it until the water runs clear, add it to a pressure cooker along with turmeric powder and water, and pressure cook on low medium heat for 4-5 whistles (around 10 mins) and set aside.
In a bowl add the tamarind and water, mix it and let it sit for 10-15 mins
In a pan saute all the ingredients for the paste except the shallots until golden brown and aromatic. 
Let it cool for 5 minutes and blend it into a fine paste along with the shallots.
In a deep kadhai, pour oil, add the shallots and drumsticks along with the salt, and saute until the shallots are soft and translucent. 
Pour the strained tamarind water to the kadhai and bring it to a boil. 
Add the asafoetida, and sambar powder and mix thoroughly. 
Once the drumsticks are cooked through, add the prepared paste and the toor dal, bring it to a boil, and add water if necessary.
In a tempering pan, pour oil mustard seeds and curry leaves, once they splutter add it to the sambar. 
Garnish it with coriander leaves and serve it hot.

title: Papad ki Sabzi
cooking_instructions: Dry roast the papad on a Tawa. Alternatively, you can also use fried papads or you can microwave the papad for between 30-45 seconds depending on the size of the papad.
Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds. After 10 seconds, add chopped onion and cook.
Meanwhile, take a small bowl and add the ginger-garlic paste, turmeric powder, chili powder, coriander powder, and add one tablespoon of water to form a paste.
When the onions are starting to turn golden brown, add this paste to the onions and add salt.
Beat the curd to make it smooth, and add whisked curd to the pan. Stir continuously and cook until the oil begins to separate and float on the sides of the pan.
Add 1 cup of water and cook, covered with a lid, for 3 minutes
Break each piece of papad into 4-5 pieces and add them to the pan. Add some crushed Kasuri Methi and turn off the heat.

title: Sooji Appam
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl add maida, salt, water and mix to combine well.
Add oil and knead into soft dough and rest for 2 hours.
In a pan roast the rava for 5 minutes in a medium flame until it’s aromatic.
In a kadai add water, kesari color, salt, cardamom powder and mix it well. Bring it to a boil. 
Now add the rava and mix it for 2 minutes without creating any lumps.
Add the sugar to it and mix it well.
Shape it into small balls while it’s still hot
Now take a small amount of the dough, spread it into a thin even layer, place a sooji ball and wrap the dough around it.
Flatten the dough into an even layer
In medium hot oil deep fry it for 1 minute, or until lightly golden brown.
Drain on paper towels.

title: Pongal Cookies
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, dry roast the cumin seeds, and peppercorns. 
Dry roast the curry leaves until crispy. 
In a mixie, grind the cumin and pepper coarsely. Add the curry leaves and pulse blend 1-2 times.
In a bowl, add the maida. Add the spices, cashew bits and salt. Mix well. 
Add the ghee 1 tbsp at a time and make a rough crumble-like texture. 
Add 2-3 tbsp of cold water and form a dough. Roll this into a log and freeze for 30 mins. 
Cut into even discs and place on a baking tray with parchment paper. 
Bake in a preheated oven for 20-15mins at 180°C, the edges and bottom must be golden. 
Cool completely and store in an airtight container for up to 10 days.

title: Suthu Koluppu
cooking_instructions:
Add pepper seeds,cumin seeds to a mixer jar and blend into fine powder.
In a kadai, add oil, cumin seeds, cloves, cardamom, cinnamon, curry leaves and saute for a minute.
Now add shallots, green chili and saute for 3 minutes.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute.
Add kashmiri red chili powder, garam masala powder, turmeric powder, salt and mix it well.
Add the mutton fat and mix it well.
Add water, cover and cook it for 15 mins.
Add the blended powder
Add coriander leaves, and serve it only when it's hot.

title: Biryani For Babies
cooking_instructions:
Add some ghee to the pressure cooker. 
Add the onions and saute for 3 - 4 minutes or until lightly golden.
Add the ginger garlic paste, followed by the tomatoes. 
Cook for 4 minutes or until the tomatoes are cooked.
Add the mint leaves and the coriander leaves. 
Add the spice powders and mix to combine. 
Saute for an additional 30 seconds before adding curd and mixing to combine well. 
Add the vegetables, and stir. 
Add the kheema and mix.
Add water and bring to a boil.
Pressure cook for 2 whistles.
Add the soaked rice, dal, water and bring to a boil.
Close the lid and pressure cook for 5 whistles. 
Let the pressure naturally release before opening and adding the green peas. 
Stir well to combine.

title: Thaenkuzhal
cooking_instructions:
In a pan dry roast the urad dal until light golden brown. 
Let it cool down and blend it into a fine powder
In a mixing bowl add all the ingredients and knead it into a tight dough
Add the dough to a murukku press, and press it into big murukkus
Deep fry the prepared murukku in medium-low heat for 3-4 minutes or until light golden brown and crispy

title: Tea Mushroom Curry
cooking_instructions:
Add the coconut milk to a pan and bring to a simmer. 
Add the tea leaves to the coconut milk and steep for 10 minutes. The coconut milk should have darkened slightly. 
Strain the coconut milk to remove the tea leaves.
In a pan, add oil. Once hot, add the cardamom and the cinnamon. 
Fry for 1 minute on a medium heat, or until aromatic.
Add the onion, green chilli and salt and saute for 8 - 10 minutes on a medium heat, or until deeply golden brown. 
Add the ginger garlic paste and saute for 1 minute, or until the raw smell goes. 
Add the spice powder and mix to combine well. 
Add the mushrooms and saute on a high heat. 
Cook for 10 minutes, or until all the water from the mushrooms has evaporated.
Add the tea infused coconut milk along with the water and stir to combine well. 
Bring it to a boil, and simmer for 5 minutes. 
Add the jaggery powder and mix to combine well. 
Once done, take the curry off the heat and garnish with coriander leaves.

title: Honey Chilli Lotus Stem
alternate_titles: Sweet and spicy lotus stem chips
cooking_instructions:
Peel the skin of the lotus stem and slice thinly. Drain on tissue to dry.
Dust it with cornflour. 
Fry in hot oil for a minute and drain it on tissue. 
Fry again in hot oil until crispy. Drain and keep aside.
In a pan, heat oil, add chopped garlic, chilli flakes, sesame seeds.
Add tomato ketchup, vinegar, soy sauce, salt, MSG, honey and stir.
Once the sauce thickens, add the fried lotus stem. Toss to mix well.
Garnish with chopped spring onions and sesame seeds. 
Serve immediately so that it’s crispy.

title: Tumbler Tea Cake
cooking_instructions:
Add the salt to a deep pan, cover and let it pre-heat on a moderate flame. 
In a mixing bowl add the eggs and sugar and whisk until light and foamy (around 10 mins).
In another mixing bowl, add the flour, baking powder and salt sling with the butter and mix until the butter is completely incorporated. 
Add the flour to the egg mixture in batches, and whisk lightly until you get a smooth batter. 
Grease and flour the mould with the butter and maida. 
Add the prepared batter and add it to the pre-heated pan. 
Cover and cook on low-medium heat for 30 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean. 
Let the cake rest on a cooling rack for 10-15 minutes and serve.

title: Non-Veg Tamarind Rice
cooking_instructions:
Soak Tamarind in warm water for 10 mins and extract tamarind Juice.
In a pressure cooker, pour oil and sear the chicken bones until they turn light golden brown. 
Add the soaked and drained rice to the pan, gently mixing everything together. 
Pour water add salt and bring it to a boil. Cover and pressure cook for 1 whistle on a medium flame and cook it on a simmer for 10 mins. 
In a pan, dry roast the ingredients under spice powder and grind it into a fine powder.
Heat 3 tbsp of oil in a pan, add split urad dal, Bengal gram, peanuts and red chilli. Fry until the dal and peanuts turn golden brown. Add tamarind juice and salt. Let this cook for 10 mins.
Add the spice powder to the cooking tamarind juice. Reduce the flame to low and Keep stirring the pan to incorporate the spices in the tamarind juice. Once the paste thickens, remove the pan from heat.
In another pan, heat the oil and add the tempering ingredients. Once the tempering splutters, add the tempering to the puliodharai mix. Once the mix is cooled, we can store this in an airtight container.
To assemble the puliyodharai, take 2 cups of cooked rice, add sesame oil, a little salt and some puliyodharai mix. Mix well, rest for 15 mins and serve.

title: Kaadai Varuval & Soup
cooking_instructions:
In a preasure cooker add water, quail, bay leaf, turmeric powder, salt ,onion and tomato.
Pressure cook it for 3 whistles, on a medium heat.Once pressure downs open the lid and separate the quail.
Transfer the soup to a bowl and now shred the quail after it cools down.

In a pan add oil, urad dal, fennel seeds and saute for a few seconds.
Add onion, garlic and saute until it turns golden brown.
Add the quail, red chili powder, turmeric, salt, and saute until it becomes crispy.
Add curry leaves and pepper powder to the bowl and serve it with hot rice along with the soup.

title: Erissery
cooking_instructions: Wash the black-eyed peas and soak for at least 5 hours.
Grind ½ cup of grated coconut along with cumin seeds, black peppercorns and green chillies. Add water as needed and grind to a thick paste.
In a pot, add the peas with 1 cup of water, 1 tsp of salt and ¼ tsp of turmeric powder and boil for 10 minutes.
Add the pumpkin dices and boil for another 10 minutes, or until the pumpkin has softened.
Add the ground coconut paste. Cook for 3 minutes. Remove from the heat.

In a small pan, heat coconut oil and add mustard seeds. When the mustard seeds start to splutter, add the urad dal, dry red chillies, grated coconut and curry leaves. Saute until the coconut turns golden brown.
Add this to the Erissery. Mix well and serve.

title: Egg Butter Masala
cooking_instructions:
Add the ingredients listed under gravy and blend into a fine paste. With only 1 tsp each of kasuri methi and Kashmiri red chilli powder. 
To make egg cubes, whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and strain the eggs. Pour it into a greased and lined mold and steam for 10 mins, until firm. 
Cut this into even cubes. 
In a pan, heat butter and add 1 tsp of red chilli powder. Strain and add the gravy, Wash the blender with 1 cup of water and strain with the gravy so that you don’t waste any. 
On a medium flame, cook for 10-15 mins covered, stirring occasionally. It will thicken. 
Add the milk and balance 1 tsp of kasuri methi. Simmer for a further 5 mins. 
Add the egg cubes and cook for 2 mins. Serve hot with a knob of butter.

title: Kutti Onion Chutney
cooking_instructions:
Add oil to a pan on medium heat.
Once hot, add in urad dal and channa dal along with the curry leaves. 
Once the curry leaves have splattered, add dry red chilli, and garlic. 
Once fragrant, add the shallots along with the cumin seeds and salt. 
Cook it until the shallots have softened and a nice aroma can be smelt 
Add the mixture into a blender and blend until smooth. Add water as required. 
To make the tempering, add some oil to a small pan on medium heat. 
Add the urad dal first. Once it starts to turn golden. Add the mustard seeds and curry leaves.
After they have splattered, add the rest of the ingredients. Cook for 30 seconds on a low heat and immediately add the tempering to the chutney

title: Coconut Rice and Potato Fry
cooking_instructions:
In a kadai add coconut oil , channa dal, mustard seeds and urad dal.
Once it pops, add curry leaves, dry red chilli and saute for 8 - 10 seconds.
Now add coconut and saute for a minute on a medium flame.
Now add the cooked rice, salt and mix well. Cook and toss for about 5 minutes.
In a separate kadai add oil, urad dal and potato.
Add the crushed garlic cloves.  
Add red chili powder, turmeric powder, salt and mix well.
Keep on sauteing, until the potato cooks and becomes crispy, around 15 minutes.

title: Erode Punjabi Semiya Payasam
cooking_instructions:
In a heavy bottomed pan add milk and bring it to boil. 
Add the semiya, and lightly crushed cardamom pods
Simmer until the semiya is cooked.
Add the sugar, condensed milk and vanilla.
Simmer until the milk is reduced to 75%
To a small pan, add ghee. Once hot, fry the cashews until golden. Then add the raisins and fry until puffed. Remove from the ghee and set aside.
Add the cashews and raisins, remove from the heat
Allow it to cool, then refrigerate for 4 hours before consumption.

title: Kakinada Chicken Fry
cooking_instructions:
Add all the ingredients required for the masala powder to a pan and dry roast until fragrant, around 2 - 3 minutes. 
Allow the mixture to cool before blending into a powder. The powder shouldn’t be too fine.
