Alternatively it can be deep fried for 4 minutes or till fully cooked.
Garnish it with onion rings and lemon wedges. 
Add the marina style sprinkler on top and serve hot.

title: Parippu Pradhaman
cooking_instructions: Wash the dal. Heat 2 tbsp of ghee in a pressure cooker and saute the dal in it for 1 minute. Add 3 cups of water and pressure cook for 3 whistles. Mash it well after it is cooked.
In another pan, add the jaggery and 1 cup of water. Heat until the jaggery has completely dissolved. Strain the jaggery to remove any impurities and lumps.
Add the jaggery back into the pan and add the cooked dal. Stir continuously and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the thin coconut milk and cook for another 10 minutes.
Add the thick coconut milk and remove from the heat as soon as it comes to a boil.
In another pan, heat 3 tbsp of ghee and fry the cashew nuts until they turn golden brown. Remove it from the pan.
Heat the dry coconut slices in the same ghee until they start to turn golden brown. Remove them from the pan.
Add sesame seeds to the same pan. Once it is cooked, add it to the Pradhaman along with the fried cashew nuts and coconut.

title: Cookd Marina Fish Fry Kit (boneless)
cooking_instructions:
Add 1 pouch (75 g) masala to a bowl with juice from 1 lemon and mix to form a dry marinade.
Apply the marinade on the fish and coat it evenly. Let it marinate for 30 minutes for better results.
Heat the oil and deep fry the fish on a medium flame for 4 minutes or till fully cooked.
Alternatively it can be pan fried for 4 minutes on each side.
Garnish it with onion rings and lemon wedges. 
Add the marina style sprinkler on top and serve hot.

title: Cookd Marina Fish Fry Kit (slices)
cooking_instructions:
Add 1 pouch (75 g) masala to a bowl with 7 tbsp (100 ml) water, add juice from 1 lemon and mix to form a thick paste.
Apply the marinade on the fish and spread it evenly. Let it marinate for 30 minutes for better results.
Heat a pan, add oil and sear the fish on a medium flame for 4 minutes on each side.
Alternatively it can be deep fried for 4 minutes or til fully cooked
Garnish it with onion rings and lemon wedges. 
Add the marina style sprinkler on top and serve hot.

title: Cookd Marina Fish Fry Kit- Vazhakkai Fry
cooking_instructions:
Cut the Raw banana into slices
Add 1 pouch (75 g) masala to a bowl with 7 tbsp (100 ml) water, add juice from 1 lemon and mix to form a thick paste.
Apply the marinade on the raw banana and spread it evenly. Let it marinate for 30 minutes for better results.
Heat a pan, add oil and sear the raw banana on a medium flame for 3 minutes on each side.
Alternatively it can be deep fried for 4 minutes or till fully cooked.
Garnish it with onion rings and lemon wedges. 
Add the marina style sprinkler on top and serve hot.

title: Cookd Prawns Ghee Roast (Pouch)
cooking_instructions:
In a pan combine the curry paste with ½ cup (120ml) of water and bring to a boil. 
Add 400-500g of cleaned prawns. Cover and cook on medium heat for 5-10 minutes.
Remove the lid and stir the gravy on medium heat until the required consistency.
Finish with 1 tsp of ghee and curry leaves.

title: Cookd Chicken Ghee Roast (Pouch)
cooking_instructions:
In a pan combine the curry paste with ½ cup (120ml) of water and bring to a boil. 
Add 400-500g of chicken. Cover and cook on medium heat for 10 minutes.
Remove the lid and stir the gravy on medium heat until the required consistency.
Finish with 1 tsp of ghee and curry leaves.

title: Cookd Mushroom Ghee Roast (Pouch)
cooking_instructions:
In a pan combine the curry paste with ½ cup (120ml) of water and bring to a boil. 
Add 400-500g of mushrooms. Cover and cook on medium heat for 5-10 minutes. 
Remove the lid and stir the gravy on medium heat until the required consistency.
Finish with 1 tsp of ghee and curry leaves.

title: Cookd Paneer Ghee Roast (Pouch)
cooking_instructions:
In a pan combine the curry paste with ½ cup (120ml) of water and bring to a boil. 
Add 400-500g of paneer. Cover and cook on medium heat for 5-10 minutes.
Remove the lid and stir the gravy on medium heat until the required consistency.
Finish with 1 tsp of ghee and curry leaves.

title: Cookd Paneer Butter Masala (Milk)
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, add the butter masala curry paste. Mix it on a medium flame for a  minute.
Add water and bring to a simmer
Add the paneer, and mix it for a minute.
Cover and cook for 6 - 8 minutes, on a medium heat.
Once the paneer has softened, and the gravy has thickened, add milk and butter. Mix well to combine.
Cook for 1 minute before taking off the heat and garnishing with kasuri methi. 
Enjoy hot with naan or roti

title: Cookd Paneer Butter Masala (Cream)
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, add the butter masala curry paste. Mix it on a medium flame for a  minute.
Add water and bring to a simmer
Add the paneer, and mix it for a minute.
Cover and cook for 6 - 8 minutes, on a medium heat.
Once the paneer is cooked, and the gravy has thickened slightly add cream and butter. Mix well to combine.
Cook for 1 minute before taking off the heat and garnishing with cream. 
Enjoy hot with naan or roti

title: Masale Bhaat
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the rice for 20 mins.

Heat ghee in a pot and add the mustard seeds, once they splutter add the cumin seeds and saute for a minute. Add the sliced onions and saute until translucent. Add the ginger-garlic paste and saute till the raw aroma goes.
Add the red chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and goda masala. Add the diced vegetables and mix well.
Add the rice and peanuts and mix well. Cook until the water and rice are of the same level.
Cover and cook for 14 mins on a low flame. Fluff the rice with a fork and add chopped coriander.

title: Cookd Chicken Butter Masala (Milk)
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, add the butter masala curry paste. Mix it on a medium flame for a  minute.
Add water and bring to a simmer
Add the chicken, and mix it for a minute.
Cover and cook for 10 minutes, on a medium heat.
Once the chicken is cooked, and the gravy has thickened add milk and butter. Mix well to combine.
Cook for 1 minute before taking off the heat and garnishing with kasuri methi. 
Enjoy hot with naan or roti

title: Cookd Chicken Butter Masala (Cream)
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, add the butter masala curry paste. Mix it on a medium flame for a  minute.
Add water and bring to a simmer
Add the chicken, and mix it for a minute.
Cover and cook for 10 minutes, on a medium heat.
Once the chicken is cooked, and the gravy has thickened slightly add cream and butter. Mix well to combine.
Cook for 1 minute before taking off the heat and garnishing with cream. 
Enjoy hot with naan or roti

title: Maddur Vada
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, combine all the ingredients. 
Add the hot oil and mix well. 
Add water and bring together a soft but non-sticky dough. 
Cover and rest for 15 mins. 
Divide equally into roundels, flatten each piece on a parchment paper/ banana leaf. It must be 1 cm thick. 
Fry in medium-hot oil until golden brown and crispy. 
Each batch will take 4 to 5 minutes. Flip gently now and then for an even colour.

title: Sexy Chicken
cooking_instructions:
Add all the ingredients to a bowl and mix to combine into a smooth paste.
Apply the marinade to the chicken and marinate for 30 minutes.
Deep fry for 12 - 15 minutes, until the chicken is crispy and cooked through.
Serve hot with lemon wedges, onions and garlic mayonnaise.

title: Rasavangi
cooking_instructions:
In a kadhai, add all the ingredients for the paste one by one and slow roast until light golden brown and aromatic. 
Add in the coconut at the end to prevent it from browning. 
Let it cool and blend into a semi-smooth paste.
In a mixing bowl, add the tamarind and pour water. Let it soak for 15 minutes. 
Extract the tamarind water and set aside.
In the same kadhai, pour oil and add in diced brinjal and tomato. 
Sauté on a medium flame for 1 minute, pour water and bring to a boil. 
Cook the brinjal for 3-4 minutes or until soft and cooked through. 
Add in jaggery, salt and asafoetida and mix well. 
Add in the cooked dal, prepared paste and the tamarind water. 
Bring it to a boil. 
For the tempering, add in coconut oil, mustard seeds, dried red chilli, grated coconut and curry leaves. 
Add in the tempering and mix well. Serve hot.

title: Cookd Dindigul Chicken Biryani (500 g)
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak seeraga samba rice for 20 mins
To a pressure cooker, add the Cookd Dindigul Biryani paste and saute for 2 minutes. 
Add the chicken pieces and mix until combined.
Add 3 cups (750 ml) water and bring it to a boil.
Add the soaked and strained rice.
Gently mix until the rice and the water are at the same level.
Close the lid and pressure cook for 2 whistles on a medium heat.
Allow the biryani to rest for 15 minutes before opening the pressure cooker.
Add the seasoning oil and fluff the rice gently

title: Cookd Dindigul Mutton Biryani (500 g)
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
To a pressure cooker add the Cookd Dindigul biryani paste and saute for a minute
Add the mutton and mix to combine well.
Add 1 ½ cups(375 ml) of water and bring to a boil. 
Cover and pressure cook for 15 - 20 minutes, on a medium low heat. 
Once the pressure has naturally released, open the cooker and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cook and reduce for 6 - 7 minutes on a medium flame, until the consistency is thick again.
Add the soaked and strained rice, give it a gentle mix
Cover the cooker and pressure cook it for 2 whistles on a medium flame.
Turn off the flame after 2 whistles and let the steam reduce gradually for about 10 minutes.
Open the cooker, fluff the rice and serve it hot with raita.

title: Homestyle Vathakozhambu
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add the tamarind, pour water and let it soak.
In a heavy-bottomed kadhai, pour oil and add in the mustard, cumin seeds, urad dal, toor dal and saute until golden brown and aromatic. 
Add in the drumsticks and saute on a moderate flame for 3-4 minutes until half done. 
Add in the ladiesfinger, shallots, curry leaves and garlic and saute on a moderate flame for 5 more minutes or until softened and aromatic. 
Add the sambar powder, turmeric powder and saute for 30 seconds. 
Pour the extracted tamarind water and regular water, and bring it to a boil. 
Let it reduce and thicken for 4-5 minutes on a medium flame. 
Once reduced, serve hot over rice.

title: Cookd Wedding Bhai Veg Biryani (500 g)
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak basmati rice for 20 mins
To a pressure cooker, add the Cookd Wedding Bhai Biryani paste and saute for 2 minutes. 
Add the mixed vegetables and mix until combined.
Add 3 cups (750 ml) water and bring it to a boil.
Add the soaked and strained rice.
Gently mix until the rice and the water are at the same level.
Close the lid and pressure cook for 2 whistles on a medium heat.
Allow the biryani to rest for 15 minutes before opening the pressure cooker.
Add the seasoning oil and fluff the rice gently.

title: Cookd Wedding Bhai Chicken Biryani (500 g)
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak basmati rice for 20 mins
To a pressure cooker, add the Cookd Wedding Bhai Biryani paste and saute for 2 minutes. 
Add the chicken pieces and mix until combined.
Add 3 cups (750 ml) water and bring it to a boil.
Add the soaked and strained rice.
Gently mix until the rice and the water are at the same level.
Close the lid and pressure cook for 2 whistles on a medium heat.
Allow the biryani to rest for 15 minutes before opening the pressure cooker.
Add the seasoning oil and fluff the rice gently.

title: Mirchi Ka Salan
cooking_instructions: Soak the tamarind in ¼ cup of hot water.
Dry roast the peanuts, sesame seeds and grated coconut until the sesame seeds and coconut start to change colour. Add water and blend into a fine paste.
Slit the chilies and remove the seeds.
Fry them in oil for a minute. Remove from the oil and set aside.
Crackle mustard seeds in the oil. Add the cumin seeds and fenugreek seeds. Add the sliced onion and curry leaves. Cook until the onion turns golden brown.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and all the spice powders. Add the ground paste and add 1 cup of water. Cover and cook on a medium flame for 20 minutes.
Add the tamarind pulp and jaggery and boil for a further 5 minutes.
Add coriander leaves and the fried chilies and continue to simmer for 3 more minutes. Serve with Biryani, rice, or roti.

title: Raw Mango Rasam
cooking_instructions: In a pressure cooker, add the raw mango with some water and pressure cook for 4 whistles.
For the masala, coarse grind the ingredients and set aside.
Allow the pressure to release, mash the mango pulp into a bowl, and add 2 cups of water and mix well. Add freshly chopped coriander and sliced onions.
In a small pan, heat some oil, splutter the mustard seeds, and add the curry leaves. Add the masala, asafoetida and saute for a minute.
Add this tempering and masala into the rasam base and mix well. Serve on hot rice with ghee.

title: Pulinkari
cooking_instructions: Soak the tamarind

title: Wedding Mutton Biryani (500 g)
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
To a pressure cooker add the Cookd Wedding Bhai biryani paste and saute for a minute
Add the mutton and mix to combine well
Add 1 ½ cups (375 ml) of water and bring to a boil. 
Cover and pressure cook for 15 - 20 minutes, on a medium low heat. 
Once the pressure has naturally released, open the cooker and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cook and reduce for 6 - 7 minutes on a medium flame, until the consistency is thick again.
Add the soaked and strained rice, give it a gentle mix
Cover the cooker and pressure cook it for 2 whistles on a medium flame.
Turn off the flame after 2 whistles and let the steam reduce gradually for about 10 minutes.
Open the cooker, fluff the rice and serve it hot with raita.

title: Thenga Sathak chuttny
cooking_instructions:
In the kadai,  add the oil, mustard seeds, urad dal, and saute until they turn aromatic (around 10 seconds).
Add the onion, green chilli, tomato and saute until the onion turns light golden brown (around 5 mins)
Now add the grated coconut and mix.
Add salt and mix thoroughly and let it cool down. 
Once cooled, transfer it to a mixer jar and add coriander leaves. 
Blend into a fine paste and serve.

title: Cookd Dindigul Soya Mushroom Biryani (510 g)
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak seeraga samba  rice for 20 mins
To a pressure cooker, add the Cookd Dindigul Biryani paste and saute for 2 minutes. 
Add the mushrooms and saute for 2 minutes.
Add the soaked soya and mix to combine well. 
Add 3 cups (750 ml) water and bring it to a boil.
Add the soaked and strained rice.
Gently mix until the rice and the water are at the same level.
Close the lid and pressure cook for 2 whistles on a medium heat.
Allow the biryani to rest for 15 minutes before opening the pressure cooker.
Add the seasoning oil and fluff the rice gently.

title: Pachai Payiru Kulambu
cooking_instructions: Soak the dal for 1 hour
Grind Cumin Seeds, Coriander Seeds, Dried Red Chilli and Garlic together in a mixer grinder
Cook the broken Green Moong Dal along with turmeric powder in a pressure cooker for 5 whistles

In a pot, add groundnut oil, and add mustard seed, shallots, Curry leaves and green chilli
Add the ground spices and garlic, and continue to saute
Add the cooked dal, and simmer until everything comes together

title: Kozhikodan Halwa
cooking_instructions:
Make a plain dough with maida and water.
Add that into a pot of water and mix it thoroughly for 10-15 minutes. 
Strain the water through a muslin cloth. 
You will see a rubbery texture on the maida wastage. 
Leave the pot aside overnight and let the water settle. 
Remove the water on top and keep remaining maida milk. 
Grind the spices and keep it aside.
Take a pan, melt the jaggery well and keep thickening it. 
When it’s thick, add water to reduce the temperature.
Now, add the maida milk gradually and mix it well. 
Add coconut oil, ghee and the prepared masala
Keep on mixing it for 20-25 minutes to get the right texture.
At the end, add the sesame seeds, cashew nuts and coconut cuts. 
Mix it well until coconut oil is out and place it into a mould.
Let it rest for a minimum of 5-6 hours.

title: Baked Yogurt Cake
cooking_instructions: Crush the biscuits, add melted butter and cinnamon powder optionally.
Blend  together the cream, curd, and condensed milk. Add the vanilla essence.

In a baking dish/ lined muffin pan, layer the biscuit at the bottom and press it down. 
Pour the cheesecake mixture on top up to ¾ of the height. 
Place the bowl in an oven-proof tray and pour a cup of water in the tray.
Bake in the oven for 20 mins until firm but still wobbly.

Cool and refrigerate for 2 hours, minimum. 
Garnish with fresh fruit and serve!

title: Chidambaram Mutta Chutney
cooking_instructions:
In a cast-iron pan, add the onions and saute for 10 seconds
Add in the curry leaves, ginger garlic paste and tomatoes along with all the spice powders and saute for 2-3 minutes or until the tomato turns mushy and the onions turn soft. 
Once the raw flavour of the masalas disappears, add in 2 eggs and sauté until cooked and still soft. 
Turn the heat to simmer and break in the remaining 4 eggs and mix thoroughly, making sure it’s still runny. 
Remove from the pan immediately, garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot with dosa or parottas.

title: Kooni Karuvadu Sambal Fried Rice
cooking_instructions:
Wash and clean the kooni karuvadu
In a dry pan, saute until all the water is evaporated and it is dry
In a pan, add oil, onion, dried red chilli, curry leaves, garlic and saute until golden brown.
Add the grated coconut and continue to saute until the coconut turns golden brown.
Ground this into a coarse consistency, add the kooni karuvadu, red chilli powder, salt and lemon juice, and grind again into a coarse paste. 
Set this aside.
In another pan, add oil, onion, garlic, red chilli and saute
Add the Sambal and cook for 2 minutes
Add the egg and scramble it
Add the cooked rice and toss everything together
Finish with some spring onions

title: Chicken Masala
cooking_instructions: In a pan, dry roast the Kashmiri red chilli, red chilli and cashew nuts.
Transfer the dry roasted red chilli and cashew nuts to a mixer grinder, add roughly chopped tomatoes and grind everything into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a pan, add the finely chopped onions, and saute until the onions are translucent

Add the ginger-garlic paste and continue to cook for 2 minutes. Add the turmeric powder, chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder. Add 2 tbsp of water and continue to cook the spices for a minute.
Add the washed and cleaned chicken pieces. Mix well until the masala coats all the chicken pieces.
Add the ground masala paste and salt to the pan and cook for 7 minutes or until the oil separates from the masala.
Add 1 Cup of water. Cover and cook for 8 mins.
Add the kasuri methi and cook for 2 more minutes. Remove from the heat and serve hot with paratha, naan or chapati.

title: Kalyanam Chicken
cooking_instructions:
Season the chicken with crushed coriander seeds and salt. 
Add some oil to a pan. Once hot, add the chicken skin side down and sear for 3 - 4 minutes on a medium high heat, or until golden brown. 
Flip and sear for 1 minute, 
Remove from the pan.
To the same pan, add crushed coriander seeds and let toast for 30 seconds. 
Add the green chillis and curry leaves along with the onions and salt, and saute on a medium high heat for 8 - 9 minutes, or until softened and golden. 
Add turmeric powder, along with red chilli powder and to combine well. 
Add tomatoes and mix well. 
Cook for 5 more minutes, until the spices have cooked and the tomatoes have softened. 
Add mint.
Add water and scrape the bottom of the pan. 
Lower the heat and add curd and mix well, to combine. 
Let the gravy simmer for 2 minutes, before adding the chicken back to the gravy and covering to cook for 10 minutes. 
Garnish with coriander leaves and more crushed coriander seeds. 
Serve with pasta, chapati or rice!

title: Potato Chips
cooking_instructions: Peel the potatoes and wash them.

Slice them very thin using a slicer. Soak them in cold water for 5 minutes. 
Lay them out on a cloth/kitchen towel. Pat them until they are very dry. (atleast 75% dry)

Heat oil in a kadai until it’s very hot. Fry the chips in batches. 
Allow to fry for 2 minutes before stirring gently. Continue frying until the bubbles subside and the chips become crisp. The entire frying process should be on high flame. Transfer the chips to a large bowl.
Sprinkle chilli powder while tossing continuously. Once cooled down, transfer it to an airtight container or consume.

title: Capsicum Dahi Curry
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, heat some ghee and ad the cumin seeds and carrom seeds. 
Add the finely chopped garlic and saute until golden brown. 
Add finely chopped green chillies. 
Add the onions and saute. Add the sliced capsicum and saute on a low flame until soft. 
Add the powdered spices, seasonings and kasuri methi. Cook for 1-2 mins. 
Add the roasted gram flour and cook for 1-2 mins.
Turn off the flame and cool for 1-2 mins.
Whisk some curd and set aside. Add the whisked curd and mix well. If the pan is too hot, the curd will split. 
Finish generously with freshly chopped coriander leaves and serve hot with chappatis.

title: Eggless Garlic Mayonnaise
cooking_instructions: Add all the ingredients to a mixer jar
blend all ingredients until it is smooth

title: kathirikai kosumalli
cooking_instructions:
Add brinjal, potato, tomato, and water to a pressure cooker and cook for 3 whistles.
Once the pressure dissipates, remove half the water from the cooker and transfer it to another bowl.
Now peel the potato, mash the cooked vegetable gently and keep it aside.
Add oil, mustard seeds, and urad dal in a kadai and let it fry for a few seconds.
Add Oil, mustard seeds, urad dal, onion and green chillies. Saute for 5 minutes till the onion becomes translucent. 
Now add the mashed vegetables and simmer them for 10 minutes.
Finish with coriander leaves at the end and serve it hot.

title: Dhaba Pudhina Chicken
cooking_instructions:
Grind together mint leaves, coriander leaves, curd, green chilli, tamarind and some water. Set aside this paste.
In a bowl with the chicken, add corn flour, maida, salt, msg, pepper and egg. Mix well to coat the chicken properly
Heat oil in a deep frying pan and deep fry the chicken pieces for 5 minutes
In a stir-frying pan, heat oil, saute onions and garlic and curry leaves. Add the ground paste and cook for 2 minutes. Add salt, msg, sugar and pepper.
Add some water and bring this to a boil, add the boiled egg yolks and mash until the sauce becomes thick and creamy
Add the deep-fried chicken pieces and toss until evenly coated.
Add the chopped boiled egg whites and mix.

title: Rabbit Roast
cooking_instructions: Grind the cashews, poppy seeds, the grated coconut and some water.
Dry roast the black pepper corns, cumin seeds and grind them into a powder.

In a pan, add ground nut oil and add the whole spices and saute until aromatic
Saute onions, garlic and ginger garlic paste with this until golden brown and until the raw smell goes
Add the tomatoes and the powdered spices, and saute until everything comes together.

Add the rabbit meat and cook until everything comes together. 
Add water and cook for about 50 minutes
Add the coconut paste and cook for 10 minutes
Add the pepper and jeera powder, mix and cook for 2 more minutes and finish with coriander leaves

title: Kathrika Gotsu
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl add the tamarind, pour water and let it soak. 
Roast all the ingredients for the gotsu powder until golden brown and aromatic and set aside to cool. 
Blend the ingredients into a fine powder and set aside. 
Oil the brinjal mildly, and roast it over open flame until the skin is charred and the flesh turns soft. 
Peel off the skin and mash the brinjal and set aside. 
In a kadhai, pour sesame oil, add in the mustard and fenugreek seeds, once they splutter add in the onions and saute until it turns soft and slightly browned, around 2 minutes.
Add in the tomatoes, turmeric powder and saute until the tomato turns mushy, around 2 minutes.
Add in the mashed brinjal and mix thoroughly. 
Once thoroughly mixed add in the prepared gotsu powder, salt and mix thoroughly. 
Pour in the prepared tamarind water and bring it to a boil, let it cook for 5-6 minutes covered or until the raw flavour of the tamarind disappears.  
Once cooked and thickened garnish with coriander leaves. 
Serve hot with ghee pongal.

title: Coconut Chutney
cooking_instructions: Grind all the ingredients into a fine paste using water.
Heat oil and crackle mustard seeds. Turn off the heat and add curry leaves and dried red chili.
Add the tempering to the chutney and mix.

title: Mambazha Pulissery
cooking_instructions:
Add mangoes, cucumber, turmeric powder, green chilli, red chilly powder, jaggery with some water in a pot and keep it for boiling. 
When the mangoes and cucumber are half done, add the salt and coconut paste into the pot and mix it well. 
Let it boil completely.
Reduce to minimal heat and add curd. 
Temper the curry with mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, curry leaves and dry red chillies at last.

title: Palayasoru popcorn
cooking_instructions: Blend cooked rice and salt into very fine paste.

Transfer into a bowl and add shallots, green chilli and cumin seeds. 
Mix it well

Take a clean white cloth and place the rice batter into small rough pieces. 
Let it dry completely under the sun for two-three days. 
Remove it from the cloth. (You can splash water behind the cloth to remove it faster)
Fry these in hot oil till golden in color.

title: Cookd Dindigul Prawn Biryani (open pot)
cooking_instructions:
Add the Cookd biryani paste, saute for 2 minutes on a medium heat
Add the prawns, mix to coat in the paste and then add the water. 
Let the water come to a boil.
Add the soaked and strained rice and give it a mix
Stir until the water and rice reach the same level, you should see rice granules start to float at the top
Cover and cook it for 15 minutes on a medium low flame
Let the biryani rest for 10 minutes before opening and adding the seasoning oil
Fluff the rice gently and enjoy hot!

title: Cookd Ambur Prawn Biryani (open pot)
cooking_instructions:
Add the Cookd biryani paste, saute for 2 minutes on a medium heat
Add the prawns, mix to coat in the paste and then add the water. 
Let the water come to a boil.
Add the soaked and strained rice and give it a mix
Stir until the water and rice reach the same level, you should see rice granules start to float at the top
Cover and cook it for 15 minutes on a medium low flame
Let the biryani rest for 10 minutes before opening and adding the seasoning oil
Fluff the rice gently and enjoy hot!

title: Cookd Wedding Prawn Biryani (open pot)
cooking_instructions:
Add the Cookd biryani paste, saute for 2 minutes on a medium heat
Add the prawns, mix to coat in the paste and then add the water. 
Let the water come to a boil.
Add the soaked and strained rice and give it a mix
Stir until the water and rice reach the same level, you should see rice granules start to float at the top
Cover and cook it for 15 minutes on a medium low flame
Let the biryani rest for 10 minutes before opening and adding the seasoning oil
Fluff the rice gently and enjoy hot!

title: Pidiyum Kozhiyum
cooking_instructions:
Heat up the oil in a pan, add curry leaves and crushed ginger/garlic. 
Saute it for a few minutes. Add green chillies, onion and shallots. 
Caramelise it nicely and reduce it into a paste
Add kashmiri powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder and fennel seeds. Saute it under low heat for 5-10 minutes. Make sure it’s not burnt. 
Add the chicken with some salt, lime juice and water. Let it boil. 
Add thin coconut milk and completely boil the curry.
Now switch off the stove and add thick coconut milk, garam masala and curry leaves.
In a bowl, add rice flour, grated coconut, cumin seeds and salt. Make a dough using warm water.
Make it into small balls and keep it aside. (use oil in your hands to make balls without sticking)
In a pot, boil a litre and half of water and add cumin seeds. 
Add the rice balls with coconut milk and let it reduce into thick creamy consistency. 
You can add sugar for more sweetness. (it’s optional)

title: Cookd Wedding Bhai Kuska Biryani (Pressure Cooker)
cooking_instructions:
In a pressure cooker add the cookd Wedding Bhai biryani paste 
Saute for 30 seconds and pour water and bring it to a boil
Add the soaked rice to the pressure cooker
Close the cooker and cook for 2 whistles on a medium flame
Let the biryani rest for 10 minutes 
Open the cooker, add the seasoning oil, fluff up the biryani
Serve it hot with raita

title: Cookd Ambur Kuska Biryani (Pressure Cooker)
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak rice for 20 minutes
In a pressure cooker add the cookd ambur biryani paste 
Saute for 30 seconds and pour water and bring it to a boil
Add the soaked rice to the pressure cooker
Close the cooker and cook for 2 whistles on a medium flame
Let the biryani rest for 10 minutes 
Open the cooker, add the seasoning oil, fluff up the biryani
Serve it hot with raita

title: Cookd Kheema Dindigul Biryani (Pressure Cooker)
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
Heat a pressure cooker, add the Cookd Dindigul biryani paste and saute for 2 minutes. 
Add the mutton kheema and mix to combine.
Add 1 ½ Cups of water. Mix it and let the water start to boil
Close the pressure cooker and pressure cook for 5 whistles on a medium heat.
Once the pressure has naturally released, open the cooker and bring the mixture back to a boil.
Add the soaked rice and mix to combine. 
Close the lid and pressure cook for 2 whistles.
Let the pressure naturally release before opening the cooker.
Once the biryani has rested, open the cooker,  add the seasoning oil and fluff the rice.
Serve it hot with raita.

title: Ambur Naatukozhi Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
In a pressure cooker, add the Cookd Ambur Biryani Paste and the washed country chicken pieces. Mix it for a few 2 minutes
Add water , mix till they combine.
Cover and pressure cook for 2 whistles on a high flame and for 12 minutes (8-10 whistles) on a medium flame.
Let the pressure release gradually.
Open the cooker, check if the meat is cooked.
Add the soaked and strained rice
Cover the cooker and pressure cook it for 2 whistles on a medium flame
Turn off the flame after 2 whistles and let the steam reduce gradually for about 10 minutes.
Open the cooker, add the seasoning oil, fluff up the rice and serve it hot

title: Empty Salna
cooking_instructions: Grind the tomato into a paste.
Soak the poppy seeds and cashew nuts in water for at least 10 minutes. Grind it to a fine paste along with the coconut.
In a pan, heat oil and add star anise, cloves, cardamom, cinnamon, and fennel seeds.
Add the onion, green chilies, and curry leaves. Saute until the onion turns translucent.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and saute for 1 minute or until the raw smell disappears.
Add all the spice powders and salt. Mix well and add salt.
Add the tomato puree, coriander leaves, and mint leaves. Saute for a couple of minutes until everything is well combined.
Add the ground coconut paste and the water. Cover partially with a lid and let it simmer for 15 minutes.

title: Cookd Dindigul Veg Biryani (Open Pot)
cooking_instructions:
Wash the rice and soak it for 20 minutes.
To a deep pan, add the Cookd dindigul biryani paste and the vegetables and saute for 4 minutes
Add water, and let it heat up.
Add the soaked and strained rice. 
Once the water reaches a boil, reduce the flame to simmer, cover and cook for 12 minutes. 
Let the biryani rest for about 10 minutes
Open the lid, add the seasoning oil, fluff up the rice and serve it hot with raita.

title: Tandoori Paneer Tikka (Oven Baked)
cooking_instructions:
Combine the Tandoori Tikka Marinade and the Cookd Tandoori oil with curd.
Add the vegetables to the mixture and mix well, until everything is thoroughly coated. 
Refrigerate for 20-30 minutes or upto overnight for best results.
Preheat an oven to 210 C. Once up to temperature, place the chicken on a greased tray and place into the oven.
Bake for 15 minutes, flipping once halfway through.
Sprinkle the Cookd Tangy Seasoning on it.
Serve it hot

title: Cookd Chettinad Mango Pickle
cooking_instructions:
Toast the mustard seeds and fenugreek seeds in a dry pan for 1 - 2 minutes. 
Let them cool before blending into a fine powder.
To a pan, add oil along with crushed garlic and curry leaves.
Slowly heat up the oil until the garlic becomes golden. Remove the garlic from the oil and turn the flame off.
Let the oil cool completely. 
To a bowl, add the raw mango. Add the red chilli powder, salt and the Cookd Chettinad Masala. 
Mix to coat the mangoes well. 
Pour the cooled oil over the mango mixture and mix to incorporate.
You can enjoy the pickle instantly or after an hour (the raw mango will soften)

title: Mutton Getti Kolambu
cooking_instructions: In a pressure cooker, add oil, Cinnamon, Bay Leaf, Fennel Seeds, Mutton, Cumin Powder, Ginger Garlic Paste, salt, water and cover and pressure cook it for 20 minutes on a medium flame.

Now , in a kadai add oil, Cumin Seeds, Fennel Seeds, Stone Flower, cinnamon and let it aromatic. 
Now add the onions, garlic, cashew and saute it for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato and saute it for 5 minutes.
Now add the red chilli powder, turmeric and saute for a few minutes.Now add the coconut, mix and let it cool down.
Once it cools down, transfer it to a mixer jar and blent it to a paste.

In another kadai, add oil, Fennel Seeds, Cumin Seeds, Bay Leaf, Cardamom and let it aromatic.
Now add the prepared paste , cooked mutton to the kadai and mix it well.
Add water , salt and cover and cook it for 20 minutes.
Once it's done, add black pepper powder, coriander leaves and serve it hot with rice.

title: High Protein Mayo
cooking_instructions: In a mixer jar, add all the ingredients and blend into a smooth paste.
Transfer into a bowl and serve with breads, chapatis or even use with salads

title: Lavariya
cooking_instructions:
Add ghee into a pan and melt the jaggery with some water. 
Add grated coconut and cardamom powder. Mix it evenly
In a bowl, add rice flour, salt and make a dough with warm water. 
Knead it until it’s not sticky and don’t let it dry.
Insert it in an idiyappam maker and place it on a banana leaf. 
Add the filling and fold the leaves to get the right shape. 
In a steamer, place these pieces and steam it for 10/15 minutes.

title: Satti Babu Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak basmati rice for 30 minutes.
To make the rice, add oil and ghee to another pot.
Add the whole spices and toast until fragrant, around 30 seconds. 
Add the green chillis, curry leaves and cashews.
Saute for 1 - 2 minutes, or until the cashews start to turn golden brown.
Add the ginger garlic paste, mint leaves and coriander leaves. 
Saute for 1 - 2 minutes, or until fragrant. 
Add curd and fry for 30 seconds. 
Add water, salt and lemon juice.
Stir gently for 2 minutes, or until the rice starts to float to the top. 
Cover tightly and cook for 12 minutes on a low heat. 
Once done, rest for 15 minutes before opening and fluffing gently. 
Blend all the ingredients required for the masala.
In a pan, add oil. Once hot, add the chicken and fry for 2 - 3 minutes. 
Add the onions and green chillis and cook for another 4 - 5 minutes, or until the onions start to soften, 
Add ginger garlic paste, red chilli powder, turmeric poweder, and all of the prepared masala blend.
Mix to combine well and cook for 7 - 8 minutes. 
The chicken and onions should release enough water, but add as needed, if the chicken starts to stick to the bottom of the pan
Once the chicken is cooked and a thick gravy has formed, add curry leaves and remove from the heat. 
Serve the chicken on top of the rice, along with lemon, a fried boiled egg and onions.

title: Mullu Murungai Vadai
cooking_instructions:
Soak the rice in water for 1 hour
Grind all the ingredients mentioned under seasoning into a fine powder
Grind the soaked rice with all the other ingredients mentioned under Vadai into a smooth paste
In a deep frying pan, add Castor oil, rock salt, Ghee and Sesame oil and bring it up to frying temperature.
Make roundels, flatten the dough on a banana leaf, and deep fry until it is puffed up and cooked on both sides.
Sprinkle the seasoning powder on top and consume.

title: High Protein Vanilla Cake
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl, break the eggs
Add in all the wet ingredients and whisk until thoroughly combined. 
Add in the flour, baking powder and fold very gently until combined, making sure you don’t overmix the batter. 
Transfer the batter to a cake tin and add it to a preheated deep pan layered with salt. 
Cover and let it bake on a medium flame for 30-35 minutes or until thoroughly cooked. 
Optionally garnish with chocolate sauce and some fresh fruits.

title: Kheema Ambur Biryani (Pressure Cooker)
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
Heat a pressure cooker, add the Cookd Ambur biryani paste and saute for 2 minutes. 
Add the mutton kheema and mix to combine.
Add 1½ Cups of water. Mix it and let the water start to boil.
Close the pressure cooker and pressure cook for 5 whistles on a medium heat.
Once the pressure has naturally released, open the cooker and bring the mixture back to a boil.
Add the soaked rice and mix to combine. 
Close the lid and pressure cook for 2 whistles.
Let the pressure naturally release before opening the cooker. 
Once the biryani has rested, open the cooker,  add the seasoning oil and fluff the rice.
Serve it hot with raita.

title: Golden Coin Eggs
cooking_instructions: Hard boil the eggs, for 12 mins. Cool and peel them.
Slice the eggs into 1 inch round slices. Coat the eggs in corn starch.
Pan fry until golden brown on both sides.
In the same pan add the chilli flakes, ginger, garlic and soya sauce. Toss to coat.
Add the spring onion, toss and serve.

title: Cookd Ambur Veg Biryani (Open Pot)
cooking_instructions:
Wash the rice and soak it for 20 minutes.
To a deep pan, add the Cookd ambur biryani paste and the vegetables and saute for 4 minutes
Add water, and let it heat up, cover and cook on a medium flame for 3-4 minutes.
Add the soaked and strained rice. 
Once the water reaches a boil, reduce the flame to simmer, cover and cook for 12 minutes. 
Let the biryani rest for about 10 minutes
Open the lid, add the seasoning oil, fluff up the rice and serve it hot with raita.

title: Ambe Upkari
cooking_instructions:
Peel 3 semi-ripe (sweet & sour) mangoes. 
In a bowl, smash the pulp of 1 mango and combine with 2 cups of water and 1 slit green chilli. 
Bring this mixture to a boil, add the 2 peeled mangoes, jaggery and salt
Boil for 8-10 mins until the mangoes are a bit softer but still hold shape. 
In a tempering pan, heat oil, splutter the mustard seeds and add the dry red chillies, curry leaves and asafoetida. 
Add this tempering to the mango dish. 
Serve hot with steamed rice.

title: Thrissur Kovakkai Curry
alternate_titles: raw mango coconut milk kovakkai gravy
cooking_instructions:
Crush the shallots, ginger, garlic and green chillies. 
Add it to a pot with the powdered spices, curry leaves and coconut oil. Smash and mix well. 
Add the thin coconut milk, add 2 tbsp of thick coconut milk to the water. 
Place it on the stove. 
When it comes to a simmer, add the mango pieces. Cook for 5 mins. 
Add the kovakkai, the ends cut off and slit down the center. 
Cover and cook for 5-7 mins until tender. 
Finish with the thick coconut milk and switch off the stove.
In a tempering pan, heat coconut oil and add the sliced shallots. Fry till golden brown. 
Add the curry leaves, mix and pour into the gravy. 
Serve hot with rice.

title: Garlic Rice & Egg Roast  Lunch Box
cooking_instructions: Crush the garlic and keep it aside.
In a kadai, add urad dal, garlic, green chilli, curry leaves and saute until it turns out aromatic.
Now add the cooked rice, pepper powder, cumin powder, salt and mix it well.
In a vessel, boil the eggs , peel and cut into halves.

Now, in a pan add oil, Cookd Chettinad masala and saute for a minute.
Add eggs and roast it for a few minutes.

title: Cookd Andhra Carrot 65
cooking_instructions:
Mix the Madras 65 masala with water to form a thick paste. 
Add the carrot to it and mix well till it is coated with the masala.
Heat oil in a kadai and fry for 5-7 minutes till it becomes crispy and is cooked throughout.
Add chopped garlic.
Add curry leaves, green chilli and saute for a few seconds. 
Add tomato ketchup, soy sauce and mix well. Add kashmiri chilli powder for colour. 
Finally, add the beaten curd, mix till it combines and cook until thick.
Add the fried carrot 65, toss till it is coated well with the sauce, gently.
Serve it hot.

title: Set Dosa Vadacurry
cooking_instructions:
For the vada, drain the soaked channa dal and add it to a blender along with all the other ingredients for the vada and blend into a very coarse paste without adding any water. 
Deep-fry the batter into small vadais, making sure not to over-fry them. The vadai needs to be slightly soft so that it absorbs the gravy. 
Set the fried vadais aside. 
In a pan, roast all the ingredients except the coconut until golden brown and aromatic. 
Add in the coconut at the end and switch off the heat. 
Let the ingredients cool down and blend into a smooth paste. 
In a kadhai, pour oil and add the whole spices and toast until fragrant. 
Add the coriander and mint leaves, then add the onions and saute on a high flame for 3-4 minutes or until translucent and aromatic. 
Add in the tomatoes and cook on a medium flame for 3-4 minutes or until the tomatoes turn mushy and soft. 
Add in all the powdered spices, and saute for a minute on medium flame or until the raw flavour disappears.
Pour the prepared paste and mix thoroughly. 
Pour water and bring it to a boil. 
Cover and cook on a medium flame for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. 
Add in the prepared vadais and mix, cook for 1-2 more minutes until the vadais soak up the gravy and thicken.
Garnish with coriander leaves. 
In a mixing bowl, add in dosa batter, baking soda and curd along with some turmeric powder and mix thoroughly. 
The batter should be a little looser compared to a regular dosa batter.
Ladle in the batter, cover and cook on a low flame for 2 minutes or until thoroughly cooked and soft. 
Serve hot with the vada curry

title: kovakkai Fry & Soup Rice
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, add oil, mustard seeds, urad dal, curry leaves, dry red chilli, garlic and saute for a minute 
Now add the kovakkai and saute for 5 mins 
Now add the spice powder with salt and mix it well.
Pour some water, cover and cook for 10 minutes.
In a mixer jar add the peanut and blend into a powder 
Now add the peanut powder to it and saute 
Crush garlic, cumin seeds and whole black pepper together.
In a pressure cooker add oil, cinnamon, bay leaf, garlic, green chilli, onion and saute for 3 minutes.
Now add the tomatoes and saute for 5 minutes.
Now add the rice, moong dal, curry leaves, water, garlic mix and pressure cook it for 4 whistles (15 minutes).
Add coriander leaves at the end.

title: Peri Peri Chicken
cooking_instructions: Roast onions, capsicum and red chillies until they get some char on top
Add them into a blender and add garlic, coriander, oregano, bay leaf, vinegar, lemon, honey and some olive oil. Blend into a fine paste.
Add them into a blender and add garlic, coriander, oregano, bay leaf, vinegar, lemon, honey and some olive oil. Blend into a fine paste.

Marinate the chicken nicely with paprika and salt and then pour the mixture on top.
Marinate it nicely and keep it aside.

Sear the chicken in a hot pan then put inside the oven for 12 minutes on each side. 
Add salt to the base of your cooker/pot and create an elevation. 
Preheat the pot for 15 minutes.
Now place the chicken inside the pot and cook it for 15 minutes on both sides.
Flip it half way through. 
During baking, brush the remaining paste gradually on top of the chicken.

title: Mutton Roast
cooking_instructions:
In a pressure cooker, saute shallots with some coconut oil. 
Add the crushed red chilli powder and fry it for 5-10 minutes.
Add mutton with salt and pressure cook until it’s tender.

Open the lid and roast it until all water has evaporated
Top it off with some curry leaves (optional)
Serve it with parotta

title: Vendaika Mandi
cooking_instructions: Roast the lima beans, add water and pressure cook it for 20 minutes.
In a kadai add oil,mustard seeds, fenugreek, dry red chilli and let it pops for a minute.

Now add asafoetida, green chilli, curry leaf, garlic, small onions and saute for 2 minutes.
Now add the ladies finger and saute for 5 minutes.

Soak the tamarind in water for 15 minutes and extract tamarind water.
Now add the tamarind paste , water and simmer it for 2 minutes
Now add the lima beans and simmer it for 5 minutes.

title: Veg Momos
cooking_instructions: Knead a soft dough with the flour and water and cover and rest for 20 mins.
For the stuffing: heat oil in a pan over medium heat and add the ginger, garlic and onion, saute until the onions are translucent.
Add the cabbage, broccoli, and carrot. Mix well.
Add the salt, pepper and soya sauce. Cook for 5 mins. Finish with the MSG and chopped spring onion.
Divide the dough and roll out small roundels and stuff with the mixture by sticking the ends together forming a semi-circle and sticking together the ends of the semi-circle.
Steam for 6 mins.

title: Home style Mor Kozhambu
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer jar add all the ingredients for the paste and blend into a fine paste and set aside.
In a kadhai, pour oil and add in the ladies finger. 
Add in salt and turmeric powder and saute until soft. 
Add in the tomato and saute until soft.
Add in the paste and cook on a low medium flame for 2-3 minutes or until the raw flavour disappears. 
Pour in the water and bring it to a boil. 
Let the curry boil for 2 minutes, then reduce the flame to a simmer. 
Add the whisked curd to the curry, whisking continuously. 
Bring the kozhambu to a boil and turn off the flame.
Add in the prepared tempering and garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Pettikadai Palkova
cooking_instructions:
Add the fried gram, sugar, and cardamom to a mixie jar. 
Blend to a fine powder and sieve it to remove any larger particles.
In a pan, add 3 tbsp of ghee and the powder. Mix for 5 minutes on a low flame until aromatic. 
Add 1 tbsp of ghee more and switch off the flame. To check the consistency, when the mixture is squeezed between your palm, it should hold firm but crumble again when crushed. 
Transfer this to a pan and press it down firmly. Rest to cool down for 1 hour. 
Cut into squares and serve. This will not spoil, so it can be stored in an air tight container for a couple of weeks

title: Cookd Fish Fry (Small Pouch)
cooking_instructions: Add 1 pouch (40g) masala to a bowl with 5 tbsp (60 ml) water, add juice from 1 lemon and mix to form a thick paste.
Apply the marinade on the fish and spread it evenly. let it marinate for 30 minutes for better results.

Heat a tawa, add oil and sear the fish on a medium flame for 3 minutes on each side.
Serve it hot with fried curry leaves, onion rings and lemon wedges

title: Cookd Vazhakkai Fry (Small Pouch)
cooking_instructions: Add 1 pouch (40g) masala to a bowl with 4 tbsp (60 ml) water, add juice from 1 lemon and mix to form a thick paste.
Apply the marinade on the vazhakkai and spread it evenly. let it marinate for 30 minutes for better results.

Heat a tawa, add oil and sear the vazhakkai on a medium flame for 3 minutes on each side.
Serve it hot with onion rings and lemon wedges

title: Cookd Fish Fry Masala- Prawn Fry (Small Pouch)
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, add all the ingredients required for the marinade and mix them well to combine. 
Add the prawns to the marinade and mix to coat well. 
Let them marinate for at least 30 minutes or overnight for better results.
In a pan, add oil.
Once hot, add the prawn and fry on a high heat for 2 minutes per side, or until seared.
After flipping, add the curry leaves.
Once the prawns are cooked, remove and serve hot!

title: Tapioca Chips
cooking_instructions: Clean and peel off the tapioca and put it inside a water bowl before using.
Make a salt mixture with 2 tsp of salt and 150 ml of water.
Slice the tapioca using a mandolin slicer

Heat up the oil for deep frying.
Quickly add into the oil.
Let it fry and when it’s half fried, you can sprinkle salt water on top. 
You can take out the chips, when the oil settles. 
Sprinkle some red chilli powder on top when it’s hot.

title: Muttai Paniyaram
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl add egg, onion, tomato, carrot, green chilli, curry leaves, salt, red chilli powder, coriander leaves and mix it well. 
In a kuli paniyaram pan, pour oil and pour one tbsp of the egg mixture.
Now add garlic pickle on top of the paniyaram 
Gently flip it and cook it for a few minutes on a medium flame.
Serve it hot

title: Chocos for Babies
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl, add all the ingredients and knead into a tight dough, cover and let it sit for 10 minutes to hydrate
Roll the dough thin and cut into small roundels. 
Roll them into spheres, place them in your palm and press and shape them into chocos
In a deep pan, pour in the salt and let it preheat. 
In a plate/tray layered with parchment paper, place the chocos one by one, gently cover and let it bake on a medium flame for 30-35 minutes. 
Let it cool completely and store it in an airtight container

title: Cookd Malabar Veg Biryani (Pressure Cooker)
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak 250g of Seeraga Samba rice for 20 mins.
In a pressure cooker, add the Malabar biryani paste and saute it on a low flame for a minute.
Add the vegetables and mix with the paste for a minute.
Add 375 ml water and bring it to a boil.
Add the soaked rice and add it to the cooker.
Cover the pressure cooker and cook it on medium flame for 2 whistles and turn off the flame.
Let the steam reduce gradually and allow it to rest for 10-15 mins.
Open the cooker, pour over the seasoning oil and the required garnishes. Fluff the biryani rice gently. 
Drizzle ghee (optional) and serve hot!

title: Egg Patties
cooking_instructions: Hard boil the eggs, for 12 mins. Peel and grate them in a bowl.
In the same bowl add the other ingredients and make a medium soft mixture.
Shape the mixture into a roundel and then flatten them to make patties.
Shallow fry until golden on both sides.

title: Cookd Hyderabadi Veg Biryani (Pressure Cooker)
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak 250g of basmati rice for 20 mins.
In a pressure cooker, add the Hyderabadi biryani paste and saute it on a low flame for a minute.
Add the vegetables and mix with the paste for a minute
Add 375 ml water and bring it to a boil.
Add the soaked rice and add it to the cooker.
Cover the pressure cooker and cook it on medium flame for 2 whistles and turn off the flame.
Let the steam reduce gradually and allow it to rest for 10-15 mins.
Open the cooker, pour over the seasoning oil and the required garnishes. Fluff the biryani rice gently. 
Drizzle ghee (optional) and serve hot!

title: Gym Bro High Protein Lunch Box
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice and toor dal for 20 minutes.
In a pressure cooker, pour the ghee and add the fenugreek, mustard, cumin seeds, dried red chilli, curry leaves and peanuts. Let them splutter. 
Add in all the veggies (Shallots, Drumsticks, carrot and beans) and saute for 10 seconds.
Add in the powdered spices, tomato and saute for 1-2 minutes on a low-medium flame, making sure not to burn the masalas. 
Pour in the tamarind water and high-protein curd, and mix thoroughly.
Grate in the high-protein paneer, strain and add in the soaked rice and dal, diced capsicum. 
Pour water and bring it to a boil, add in the brown sugar, cover and let it pressure cook on a medium flame for 4 whistles (around 14 minutes). 
Let it rest, once the pressure releases, mix thoroughly and set aside.
In a pan, pour coconut oil and add chopped onions and tomatoes
Saute on a medium flame for 2-3 minutes or until the tomatoes turn mushy. 
Add in the soaked and drained soya chunks and mix thoroughly.
Add in the Cookd Madurai Chukka Masala, pour water and mix to combine. 
Saute for a minute on a medium flame and serve with the sambar rice.

title: Papada Vada
cooking_instructions:
Make a batter using the rice powder, sesame seeds, cumin seeds, salt, turmeric powder,  red chilly powder and water. 
Dosa batter consistency would be enough. (Runny but thick enough to coat the papadam)
Dip the papadam into the batter and fry it in hot oil. 
Fry until golden orange color

title: Restaurant Style Cauliflower Chops
cooking_instructions:
In a mixer, add all the ingredients for the coconut paste and blend into a smooth paste
Blend all the ingredients for the tomato paste and set aside.
In a kadhai, pour oil and add the whole garam masalas, saute for 30 seconds or until aromatic.
Add the onion and saute for 3-4 minutes or until light golden brown, add the tomato paste and saute for 10 seconds.
Add the cauliflower, add all the powdered spices and mix thoroughly. 
 Pour water, cover and cook on a simmer until the cauliflower is fork tender (around 6 mins)
Pour the prepared coconut paste and mix thoroughly, cook the gravy for further 5 minutes (adjust consistency if necessary)
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot with chapatis, dosa and idli.

title: Muttai Paruppu
cooking_instructions:
Add oil to a kadai. Once hot, add the onions, green chillis, salt and curry leaves, 
Saute for 3 - 4 minutes, or until softened and starting to turn light brown,
Add the tomatoes along with red chilli powder and turmeric powder. Saute for 2 - 3 minutes or until the raw smell goes. 

Add the soaked masoor dal along with the soaking water and mix to combine well. 
Bring to a boil and simmer for 20 - 25 minutes, until the dal is soft and mushy. 
To make the tempering, heat some oil along with ghee, 
Once hot, add garlic and fry for 1 - 2 minutes or until starting to turn golden. 
Add urad dal, cumin seeds and mustard seeds. 
Once the mustard seeds pop, add curry leaves along with the dry red chillis and cook for 30 seconds,
Add the tempering to the dal and mix well. 
Bring the dal to a simmer and crack 4 eggs into the dal.
Cook the eggs on the lowest heat for 10 minutes, or until set. 
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot with rice.

title: Cookd Fried Chicken (Mini Pack)
cooking_instructions: Add the Secret Marinade Blend to the chicken. Mix well till the meat is coated evenly with the marinade
Prepare a batter using 2 tbsp of the Ultra Crispy Fry Mix and 125 ml of water.

Coat it evenly with the dry Ultra Crispy Fry Mix first. 
Dip it in the batter and coat it thoroughly.
Coat it with the Ultra Crispy Fry Mix again and dust it in a downward motion to form the crust (crinkles)

Deep-fry it in medium-hot oil for 4 minutes at first, then increase the flame and let it fry until it turns golden brown and crispy.
Sprinkle the Cookd Seasoning in the fried chicken and toss it well
Serve it hot with a dip of your choice on the side.

title: Pumpkin Poli
cooking_instructions:
Boil the pumpkin in 1 ¼ Cup water until soft, and the water will be absorbed fully. Add jaggery powder, salt, turmeric powder, cardamom powder, and ghee. 
Mash this well into a puree.
Add this to the flour. Sprinkle some water, if needed. 
Clump together a rough dough. 
Cover and rest for 10 mins.
Once rested, knead the dough for 1-2 mins until it is non-sticky and smooth. 
Cover and rest again for 10 mins. 
Roll out the dough into a log and cut into even-sized pieces. 
Roll each piece into roundels. 
Using some flour to dust, roll them into thin and large discs.
Cook on a preheated tava until small bubbles appear on both sides. Use the spatula then to apply some pressure even on the roti until it cooks and puffs up on both sides. 
Apply ghee, sprinkle some grated coconut and jaggery, fold in half, and serve hot.

title: Cookd Fried Paneer (Mini Pack)
cooking_instructions:
Add the hot and spicy marinade to the Paneer. Mix well till the meat is coated evenly with the marinade
Prepare a batter using 2 tbsp of the 3 in 1 fry mix and 125 ml of water.
oat it evenly with the fry mix first
Dip it in the batter and coat it thoroughly
Coat it with the fry mix again and dust it well.
Deep fry it in hot oil till it turns golden brown
Sprinkle the seasoning over the fried paneer and toss it until it is well-coated with the seasoning.

title: Cookd Fried Cauliflower (Mini Pack)
cooking_instructions:
Soak the cauliflower florets in hot water for 5 minutes and strain them.
 Add the Cookd Secret marinade to the cauliflower. Mix well till the cauliflower is coated evenly with the marinade
Prepare a batter using 2 tbsp of the cookd ultra crispy fry mix and 90 ml of water.

Add the remaining fry mix to another bowl
Coat it evenly with the dry mix first
Dip it in the batter and coat it thoroughly
Coat it with the dry flour again and dust it well.

Deep fry it in hot oil till it turns golden brown
Sprinkle the seasoning on the fried cauliflower and toss it till it is coated well with the seasoning

title: Prawn Pepper Fry
cooking_instructions: Cook the prawns until it is half cooked on a pan with turmeric powder and 1 tbsp of coconut oil
Dry roast and grind into a fine powder, the ingredients under dry roast and grind.
In a pan add 1 tbsp of coconut oil. Add shallots and finely chopped ginger and garlic. Cook until everything turns golden brown.
Add the half-cooked prawns, toss in the ground spices, red chilli powder, garam masala, salt, curry leaves and mix well until raw smell from Masala has gone.
Serve hot as an appetizer.

title: Vada Pav
cooking_instructions: Pressure cook halved potatoes for 4 whistles. Peel them. Heat oil in a kadhai and let the mustard seeds splutter, add the coriander seeds, ginger, garlic, green chillies and curry leaves and saute well. Add hing, salt and turmeric powder.
Add the potatoes and chopped coriander leaves. Mash and mix well.
For the batter: combine the given ingredients to make a smooth batter.
Make roundels of this mixture.
Dip the potato mixture in the batter and deep fry until golden brown.
Place in between the pav and serve with peanut chutney.

title: Cookd Fried Prawn (Mini Pack)
cooking_instructions: Add the hot and spicy marinade to the prawns. Mix well till the meat is coated evenly with the marinade
Prepare a batter using 2 tbsp of the fry mix and 90 ml of water

Coat it evenly with the breading first
Dip it in the batter and coat it thoroughly
Coat it with the breading again and dust it in a downward motion to form the crust

Deep fry it in hot oil till it turns golden brown
Sprinkle the seasoning on the fried prawns and toss them well till it is coated with the seasoning

title: Cookd Popcorn Chicken (Mini Pack)
cooking_instructions: Add the hot and spicy marinade to the chicken. Mix well till the meat is coated evenly with the marinade
Prepare a batter using 5 tbsp of the 3 in 1 breading and 150ml of water.

Coat it evenly with the dry breading first.
Dip it in the batter and coat it thoroughly. 
Coat it with the dry breading again and dust it in a downward motion to form the crust.

Deep fry it in medium hot oil at first for 2 minutes and then on a high flame for another 3-4 minutes till golden brown.
Sprinkle the seasoning on the fried chicken and toss it well

title: Erachi Chor (Pressure Cooker)
cooking_instructions:
Add ghee into the pressure cooker and saute onions, crushed ginger, garlic and green chillies with some curry leaves.
Saute that till it’s mushy then add the tomatoes and saute till the paste is fully cooked. 
Add the masala powders and saute it for 5 minutes.
Now, add mutton, curd, mint leaves and coriander leaves and close the pressure cooker and cook it until the mutton is 85% cooked. (10 minutes under low medium flame would be enough)
Open the cooker, add the water and let it boil. Check for salt.
Add rice and cook it for two whistles under medium flame. 
Switch off the flame and let it rest for 10 minutes. 
Serve it hot with raita and papadam!

title: Capsicum Rice & Carrot Raita
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, dry roast the peanuts and sesame seeds and let it cool.
In the same pan, add oil, channa dal, urad dal, dry red chili, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, asafoetida and saute for a few minutes until it turns out aromatic. 
Once it cools down, transfer it to a mixer jar and coarsely blend it along with the roasted peanuts and sesame seeds.
In a pan, add oil, onion, capsicum and saute for a few minutes.
Now add turmeric powder, salt and mix it well.
Now cover and cook it for 5 minutes on a medium flame.
Now add the blended powder and saute for a few minutes.
Now add the cooked rice and saute for a few minutes.
In a bowel add one cup of curd.
Add the carrot, salt and mix it well.

title: Pournami Chicken Roast
cooking_instructions: Roast coriander seeds, black pepper, fennel seeds, curry leaves and grated coconut. Grind it and keep it aside.

In a pan pour oil, add mustard seeds, dry red chillies, curry leaves, crushed garlic, green chillies and chukk podi. Stir for a minute. 
Add shallots and grinded powder and saute for few minutes.

Add the chicken and garam masala. Mix it thoroughly
Pour a quarter cup of curd, salt with some water and keep it boiling.
Finish it off with neem flowers and coriander leaves.

title: Motta Roast
cooking_instructions: Boil the eggs for 8-10 minutes and keep it aside.
Crush garlic, ginger, fennel seeds and black pepper into a paste

Into a pan, pour coconut oil and saute the paste. 
Add curry leaves, dry red chilli, onion and green chillies.

When onions are all done and mushy, add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, kashmiri red chilli powder and coriander powder. 
Saute it nicely until it’s evenly roasted. 
Add the tomatoes with salt and pour water. Let it boil under the lid.

In a pan, pour some coconut oil and a tsp of kashmiri chilli powder. 
Make small slits around the eggs and toss it in the pan until it’s nicely seared.
Add the boiled eggs with garam masala and coriander leaves

title: Idiyappam Kothu
cooking_instructions:
In a pan add all the ingredients mentioned under roast and grind in the same order. Once this is roasted, grind it into a smooth paste in a mixer grinder with little water.
In a pot, add Oil, Cinnamon, Cloves, Green Chilli, Onion. Cook until onions are slightly golden.
Add Ginger Garlic Paste, Cook, until the raw smell of ginger and garlic leaves.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they are mushy.
Add Kashmiri Chilli powder, Coriander Powder, Turmeric Powder and cook for a further 2 minutes.
Add the ground paste, salt to the pan. Cook this for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken, 3 cups of water and cook for 20 mins, until the oil separates from the gravy and floats on top.
In a Tawa/Pan, heat oil and add the finely chopped onions, green chilli and curry leaves.
Once the onions are translucent add the finely chopped tomatoes and cook until the tomatoes are mushy.
Add the Eggs and Salt to the Pan/Tawa. Mix well and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the idiyappam, Chicken Salna, Shredded Chicken, mix well until combined and continue to cook by mixing it for 4 minutes.
Use the iron/steel ladle shred the idiyappam into small bits
Add the Black Pepper Powder, Coriander leaves, mix well and remove from the heat.

title: Bharli Vangi
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, dry roast the peanuts, kopra and sesame seeds separately.
In a pan, dry roast the peanuts, kopra and sesame seeds separately.
In the same pan, add oil and saute the sliced onion till brown.
Take out the onion, add whole garlic cloves and saute the garlic till it is brown. Add the sliced ginger and saute it for 30 secs.
In a mixer-grinder, add the above mentioned ingredients, along with kashmiri chili powder, cumin powder, coriander powder,turmeric powder, salt, garam masala and coriander leaves. Make a coarse mixture.
Wash the brinjals and slit it.
Stuff the brinjals with the filling and keep it aside
Heat oil in a pan.
Add mustard seeds and let it splutter.
Add the chopped onion and saute till it begins to brown.
Add the tomato and saute for a minute.
Add Kashmiri red chili powder and saute for a minute.
Add water and cover the gravy, let it cook till the brinjals are soft.
Adjust the seasoning.
Garnish with chopped coriander leaves.

title: Kamarkattu
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, melt the jaggery and water. 
Roast the grated coconut in a pan until light golden and a bit dry in texture. 
Strain and add the jaggery syrup into the pan with the coconut. Add the cardamom powder and ghee. 
Cook until the mixture is thick, foamy, and releases from the pan. Do this on a low-medium heat.
To check the perfect consistency, When a small drop is added to water, it should become hard and not be stretchy. 
Transfer this mixture to a bowl or plate, but do not spread it. Allow the surface to cool for a few minutes. 
Using a greased spoon, take out small portions of the hot mixture and roll them between greased palms into small roundels. 
Allow it to cool fully, it’ll harden and store air-tight.

title: Mulligatawny
cooking_instructions: Heat ghee in a pot and add the whole spices followed by the onion, green chillies, curry leaves, ginger and garlic, Saute for 2 minutes.
Add the boiled dal and boiled potato, Add the spice powders and salt.
Add 3 Cups of water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Use a hand blender and make a smooth soup base.
Add the tamarind pulp, lemon juice and simmer for 6 mins. Finish with the coconut milk and coriander leaves.

title: Cookd Donne Fish Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak 250g of seeraga samba rice rice for 20-30 mins
In a pressure cooker, add the donne biryani paste and saute it on a low flame for a minute.
Add the fish and mix with the paste for a minute.
Add 375 ml water and bring it to a boil.
Strain the soaked rice and add it to the cooker.
Cover the pressure cooker and cook it on medium flame for 2 whistles and turn off the flame.
Let the steam reduce gradually and allow it to rest for 10-15 mins.
Open the cooker, pour over the seasoning oil and fluff the biryani rice gently. 
Drizzle ghee (optional) and serve hot!

title: Cookd Hyderabadi Fish Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak 250g of kaima rice for 20-30 mins.
In another pot, bring 2L water to a boil with 1 tbsp (12g) of salt.
Strain the soaked rice and add it to the pot of water, boil for 5-6 mins, until the rice is 75% done.

In a biryani pot, add the malabar biryani paste and saute for a minute.
Add the fish and mix with the paste for a minute.
Cook for 2 - 3 minutes.
Strain the cooked rice and add directly on top of the biryani masala and add 1/4 cup of the boiled rice water.
Add fried onions, coriander leaves, mint leaves, fried cashews and fried raisins as garnish.
Cover tightly and cook on dum for 12-15 mins then allow it to rest for 10-15 mins.
Pour over the seasoning oil and fluff the biryani rice and masala gently
Drizzle ghee (optional) and serve hot!

title: Cookd Malabar Fish Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak 250g of kaima rice for 20-30 mins.
In another pot, bring 2L water to a boil with 1 tbsp (12g) of salt.
Strain the soaked rice and add it to the pot of water, boil for 5-6 mins, until the rice is 75% done.
In a biryani pot, add the malabar biryani paste and saute for a minute.
Add the fish and mix with the paste for a minute.
Cook for 2 - 3 minutes.
Strain the cooked rice and add directly on top of the biryani masala and add 1/4 cup of the boiled rice water.
Add fried onions, coriander leaves, mint leaves, fried cashews and fried raisins as garnish.
Cover tightly and cook on dum for 12-15 mins then allow it to rest for 10-15 mins.
Pour over the seasoning oil and fluff the biryani rice and masala gently
Drizzle ghee (optional) and serve hot!

title: Vaathu Kozhambu
cooking_instructions:
In a kadhai, pour in oil and add all the whole garam masalas and let them splutter. 
Add garlic, onions, shallots and green chilli and saute on a high flame for 2-3 minutes or until the onions turn translucent.
Add the ginger garlic paste and cook for 30 seconds or until the raw flavour disappears. Add the tomatoes, curry leaves, and cook on a medium flame for 2- 3 minutes or until the tomatoes turn mushy. 
Add in all the powdered spices, and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the raw smell of the spices disappears, making sure not to burn them.
Add the duck to the pan and mix thoroughly.
Pour water and bring it to a boil. 
Cover and cook on a low-medium flame for 45 minutes or until the duck is tender. 
Pour coconut milk and bring it to a boil, garnish with mint, coriander and curry leaves along with black pepper powder and serve hot.

title: Orapu Adai & Chow Chow Chutney
cooking_instructions:
Wash the rice, Chana Dal, Toor Dal and soak it for at least 2-3 hours
Strain and add it to a mixer jar,grind it into a paste. 
Transfer into a bowl and add onion, green chilli, coriander leaves, curry leaves, chopped garlic, coconut, red chilli powder, salt and mix it well.
Heat up a Tawa, spread on it and cook for 30 - 45 seconds.
Add a teaspoon of oil and cook it for a further 15 seconds to let it crisp up a little. 
Remove from the pan. Serve it hot.
In a pan add oil, dry red chilli, chow chow, tomato, salt and cook it for 10 to 15 minutes.
Add grated coconut and saute for 2 minutes.
Once it cools down, transfer it to a mixer jar and coarse blend it. 
In a kadai, add oil, mustard seeds, urad dal, curry leaves, asafoetida and let it splutter for a minute.
Add this to the mixture and mix it evenly.

title: Duck Mappas
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, add the spices and stir for a minute
Add crushed ginger, garlic and curry leaves. Fry it nicely.
Add the onions, green chillies and shallots. Saute until it’s all mushy and cooked.
Add the masalas and mix it thoroughly
Add the duck meat with some water and cook it for 5-10 minutes
Add in fennel powder, tomato and pour 1 cup of thin coconut milk and let it simmer for 20-30 minutes. 
Top it off with garam masala, coriander leaves and quarter cup of thick coconut milk. 
At the end, temper the curry with mustard seeds, curry leaves, dry red chillies and shallots. 
Serve it with appam.

title: Cookd Chicken Roast
cooking_instructions:
Heat 4 tbsp of coconut oil in a kadai.
Add 3 sliced onions (180g) and a spring of curry leaves.
Once the onions sweat and turn light brown, add 1 sliced tomato and cook well.
Add 500g chicken and ½ cup of water. Add the 1 pouch (25g) of masala.

Cook until the meat is cooked and the masala is dry and coats the meat. 
Finish with a fresh sprig of curry leaves.

title: elai puddu
cooking_instructions: Add 500 g sliced red meat to a pressure cooker with half a packet (12-13g) of masala. It can be slow-cooked without water or with ½ Cup of water, around 15 mins on a medium flame (5-6 whistles) or until the meat is tender.

Heat 4 tbsp of coconut oil in a kadhai. 
Add 3 sliced onions (180g) and a spring of curry leaves.
Once the onions sweat and turn light brown, add 1 sliced tomato and cook well.

Add the cooked meat. Add the remaining masala (12-13g). 
Cook until the masala is dry and coats the meat.
Finish with a fresh sprig of curry leaves.

title: Malpua- Leftover series
cooking_instructions: Combine the idli batter, maida, jaggery powder, cardamom powder, fennel seeds and milk. Whisk it to make a smooth batter.

Combine the sugar and water in a pan. Switch on the flame and cook it to 1 string consistency.
Add cardamom and food colour (optional) and switch off the flame.
To fry the malpua, take a pan and heat oil, reduce to a medium flame and add 1 ladle at a time holding your hand steady. Fry until golden brown on both sides and strain the malpua.

Put it in warm sugar syrup and let it soak the syrup.
Take it out and place it on a platter. Garnish with ghee and chopped almonds

title: Bakery Pudding Cake
cooking_instructions: Cut off the sides in the bread and coarsely blend it.
Now transfer it to a bowl and sieve through baking powder, baking soda, maida, cardamom powder and mix it well.

In a bowl, add the eggs and beat it with sugar by portions with equal quantity. 
Fold it with vanilla essence.
In a bowl add oil, ghee and mix it well.

Add the bread mix into the egg mixture. Mix it gently.
Now pour the oil mixture and mix it gently

Preheat the oven to 180C.
Transfer the batter into a baking pan and garnish it with some chopped cashew nuts. 
Bake for 30 minutes at 180C in a preheated oven, Cool it down before serving

title: Vanilla Shortbread Cookies
cooking_instructions: Preheat an oven to 200 C. Combine the flour, sugar, cold butter cubes and vanilla in a bowl and crumble with your fingertips to make a texture resembling sand.
Add the water and bring the dough together. Do not over knead the dough. Refrigerate for 20 mins.
Bake for 25 mins or until it is golden colour. Cool completely before serving.

title: Garlic Chicken Curry
cooking_instructions:
Fry the garlic and cashew nuts in oil until golden brown. 
Make into a fine paste with some water.
In a pan, heat ghee and add cumin seeds. Add a slit green chilli.
In a bowl, mix the curd, salt, and spice powders.

Add the garlic paste to the pan and cook for 2 minutes. 
Add the curd mixture and cook until the oil separates, about 3-4 mins.
Add the chicken and water, simmer, and cook for 10-12 minutes until thick and the chicken is tender.

Finish with kasuri methi and chopped coriander leaves. 
Serve hot with parathas.

title: Tumbler Pizza
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl, add all the dry ingredients for the dough and mix thoroughly. 
Make a well in the centre, and pour water.
Mix and knead the dough for 7-10 minutes, or until it is hydrated, soft, and supple. 
Cover the dough and let it rise for 35-40 minutes or until 1 ½ in size. 
For the sauce, in a pan, pour oil, add the seasonings and minced garlic. 
Saute until fragrant- making sure not to burn the chilli flakes. 
Add the chopped onion and sauté until the onions turn translucent. 
Pour the tomato puree, add salt and sugar and cook until the sauce turns into a thick paste. 
Finish the sauce with ketchup and cook until the raw flavour disappears. 
Once the dough has risen, on a floured surface, stretch the dough, making sure not to deflate the dough entirely. 
Add the stretched dough into a pan, and add in the tomato sauce the cheese and any topping of your choice. 
Cover and let it cook for 5-6 minutes on a low flame or until the cheese is melted. 
Serve hot

title: Irani cafe Burger
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, add the minced chicken, potato, garlic, red chili flakes, garam masala, onion powder, salt and milk. Mix it until well combined.
Rub some oil on hand and shape it into patties. Keep it aside.
Prepare the batter, by whisking refined flour, corn flour, salt and water together. It should have smooth consistency.

Take the panko crumbs out on a dish.
Dip the patty in the batter first and then coat it with panko crumbs.
Freeze the patties.
Fry the patties in hot oil till golden brown.
Mix the tomato ketchup and mayonnaise together
Heat oil in a pan, crack the egg onto it, season with salt and red chili flakes. Flip it carefully without breaking the yolk. Take it out when the yolk has slightly set.

Slice the buns. On the bottom half, spread the sauce, place the onion and tomato slices, place the patty followed by a cheese slice and fried egg. Apply some sauce on the top half and close the burger.

title: Ven Pongal Maggi
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, pour water and bring it to a boil. 
Add the Maggi noodle cakes and cook until 90% done. 
Strain and cool immediately, save ½ cup of the noodle water.
Crush cumin seeds, whole black pepper in a mortar and pestle and set aside.
In a non-stick pan, pour ghee, add the crushed cumin seeds and black pepper and chopped ginger, green chilli, curry leaves,  asafoetida and cashews.

Once the cashews turn golden brown, add the cooked maggi and mix thoroughly. 
Add in two tablespoons of cooked moong dal, ¼ cup of the reserved noodle water and mix thoroughly. 
Garnish with chopped cashews and fried curry leaves.

title: Cookd Tamil Nadu Lunch Sambar - Masala
cooking_instructions: Wash the toor dal until the water runs clean
Add the washed toor door and water into a pressure cooker and pressure cook on a low to medium flame for 4 whistles (around 7-8 minutes) and set aside.

Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a kadhai.
⁠Add 15–20 peeled shallots (100 g) and 1 chopped tomato (70 g). 
Add the diced Drumsticks, pour ½ cup of water and let it cook for 5-6 minutes on a low to medium flame. 
Instead of Drumsticks, you can add any vegetable of choice- 1 Cup (100g)
Add 1 pouch of Cookd Tamil Nadu Lunch Sambar Masala, mix and add the cooked dal and 1½ cups of water.
Close the lid and cook on a low- medium heat for 10 minutes.

In another pan, heat 2 tsp oil, add ¼ tsp mustard seeds and let them splutter, add 1 dried red chilli and some curry leaves.
Add the tempering to the sambar, finish with 1 tsp ghee and fresh coriander leaves.

⁠Add 15–20 peeled shallots (100 g) and 1 chopped tomato (70 g). 
Add the diced Drumsticks, pour ½ cup of water and let it cook for 5-6 minutes on a low to medium flame.

Add 1 pouch of Cookd Tamil Nadu Lunch Sambar Masala, mix and add 1 pouch cooked dal and 1½ cups of water. 
Close the lid and cook on a low- medium heat for 10 minutes. Once cooked, finish with 1 tsp ghee and fresh coriander leaves.
