In a hot pan, roast peanuts, followed by dry coconut and sesame seeds
Transfer it to a plate and cool it down.
Add it to the mixer, along with red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, cumin powder and salt. Pulse it to make the filling.
Slit the Kovakkai in a criss-cross pattern. Stuff it with the filling.
In a pan, add oil and heat. Add the onions and saute till translucent.
Place the kovakkai on it and cook on medium flame with a closed lid.
Add some water to prevent from sticking.
Finish off with garlic, mix it and garnish with coriander leaves.

title: High Protein Thenga Chutney
cooking_instructions:
Heat coconut oil in a pan. Add sliced onions, green chilli, garlic, roasted gram dal, and peanuts. Sauté on a low–medium flame for 3–4 minutes, until soft and cooked through.
Let the mixture cool completely, then transfer to a blend
Add coconut, salt, and hung curd. Blend into a smooth chutney.
For tempering, heat coconut oil. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter.
Add urad dal and curry leaves. Pour the tempering over the chutney, mix well, and serve.

title: Poroissant
cooking_instructions:
Mix together the egg, milkmaid, salt, sugar, and water until well combined.
Add the maida to the liquid mixture and combine to form a dough.
Knead the dough vigorously for at least 10 minutes until it is smooth and soft.
While the dough is resting, marinate the chicken with Cookd Kerala Chicken Fry Masala, crushed garlic, green chillies, and curry leaves.
Rest the dough for 10 minutes, then divide it into equal-sized balls.
Coat the balls with a little palm oil and let them rest for another 10–15 minutes.
Flatten each ball into a thin sheet and spread palm oil and a dusting of maida on top.
Cut the sheets into half and roll into balls.
Deep fry the marinated chicken in hot oil until it is cooked
Wrap the fried chicken pieces in the dough triangles to form a 3–4 inch croissant shape.
Fry the wrapped parcels in a pan until the outer layer is crispy and light golden.
Serve the hot chicken wraps immediately with a side of Salna.

title: Thenga Poondu Podi
cooking_instructions: Add all the ingredients in a mixie jar and pulse blend to form a coarse powder.

You can adjust the salt and spice as per your preference. 
While eating, add some gingelly oil and serve with hot idlis/ dosas.

title: Garlic Seasoning
cooking_instructions: Separate the garlic peel, then wash and dry it.
Blend it in a mixer grinder.
Store airtight.

title: Rasam Poached Eggs
cooking_instructions:
Soak the tamarind, squeeze it, and extract the tamarind water
Combine the ingredients for the paste in a mixer grinder and blend until smooth.
Heat the ghee in a pot, add the mustard seeds and let them splutter. Add the urad dal,
Add the ground masala, salt
Add the tamarind water and let it cook for 7-8 minutes. 
Reduce the flame to a simmer and let the rasam slightly cool down. 
Create a whirlpool using a spatula and break in the eggs one by one.
Let the eggs poach for 2-3 minutes on a simmer.
Take the eggs out and set aside.
Finish the rasam with chopped coriander leaves.

title: High-Protein Pasta
cooking_instructions:
In a pressure cooker, add the ghee. Once hot, add the pumpkin and carrot and saute for 2 - 3 minutes or until starting to soften.
Add water and bring to a boil.
Close and pressure cook on a medium heat for 12 minutes.
Once the pressure has released, open the pressure cooker and transfer the contents to a blender.
Once the contents have cooled sufficiently, blend into a smooth paste.
To cook the pasta, bring water to a boil. 
Once boiling, add salt.
Add the pasta and cook according to the package instructions.
Strain once the pasta is cooked.
Add the blended sauce to a pan, along with the strained pasta and toss to combine well.
Add the pasta seasoning and mix to combine.
Optional: add some grated cheese on top.

title: Pavakkai Chips
cooking_instructions:
Cut the bitter gourd into roundels.
Add salt and turmeric and mix well.
Soak the bitter gourd in warm water for 10–15 minutes.
Strain the water and keep the bitter gourd aside.
Add red chilli powder and coriander powder, besan, rice flour, corn flour, salt and curry leaves.
Mix well until the bitter gourd is evenly coated.
Heat oil in a pot over medium heat.
Fry the bitter gourd until golden brown.

title: Eeral Pallu Varuval
cooking_instructions:
Add Oil, bay leaf, cinnamon to a pan
Add onion, garlic and saute for 2 minutes
Add tomato and saute for 2 minutes
Add chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and add little water and cook for around 5 minutes, or until the raw smell goes.

Add the mutton liver and add water 
Cover and cook it for 20 mins, on a medium heat.
Now add the coconut slices and curry leaves and saute until dry roast.

title: Tumbler Brownies
cooking_instructions: In a heatproof mixing bowl, add sugar, oil or melted butter, cocoa powder and salt. Place the bowl on very low heat or over hot water and stir continuously until the sugar partially dissolves and the mixture turns glossy and smooth. Take it off the heat and let it rest for 30–40 seconds.
Add the eggs one by one to the warm mixture and whisk vigorously for 45–60 seconds until the batter thickens and looks shiny. Add vanilla essence and mix well.
Add the maida and gently fold until no dry flour is visible. Fold in chopped dark chocolate or chocolate chips if using.

In a heavy kadai or pressure cooker, add salt at the bottom, place a stand or steel plate over it, cover and preheat on a low flame for 10 minutes.
Grease a medium-sized steel or aluminium tin, pour in the brownie batter and level the top. Place the tin inside the preheated kadai, cover tightly and cook on a low flame for 35–40 minutes.
Insert a toothpick into the centre; it should come out with moist crumbs. Switch off the flame and remove the tin from the kadai.
Let the brownies cool completely for 45–60 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Thenga burfi- Kuppai Series
cooking_instructions:
Heat ghee in a pan
Add the coconut residue and roast it for a while
Add sugar, cardamom powder and roast till right consistency is achieved
Add the mixture to a greased plate, spread it out and let it set
Cut it into pieces and serve.

title: Oreo Shake
cooking_instructions: Blend the oreo, ice cream, milk, coffee powder and ice cubes together in a blender until just combined. Do not overblend.
Decorate a glass with chocolate syrup on the sides. Pour the drink into the glass. Top with whipped cream, crushed oreos and chocolate syrup.

title: Bread Porichathu
cooking_instructions:
Make the batter using maida, rice flour, sugar, turmeric powder, black sesame seeds and salt. It should be a smooth runny batter. 
Cut bread into triangles and keep it aside.
Heat oil in a pot and dip the bread into the batter and fry it. Only when it’s hot or it’ll be oily. 
Take it out when it’s golden in color

title: Murungakeerai Karpooravalli Chutney
cooking_instructions:
In a pan, heat some oil and saute the Murungakeerai & Karpooravalli Leaf. Add the garlic, green chilli, and ginger also.
Add this into a mixer grinder with coconut, fried gram dal, water, salt, and grind to a smooth paste.
Adjust the consistency with water, as needed. 
Make a tempering with oil, mustard seeds, split urad dal, dry red chillies, curry leaves, and asafoetida. 
Add this to the chutney and mix well. Serve with idly/ dosa/ pongal or vadai.

title: Beer Battered Pazhampori
cooking_instructions:
Cut the banana into quarters and coat them with maida. 
Make a batter with maida, sugar, salt, turmeric powder and beer into a smooth runny batter.
Add ice into the batter to prevent gluten formation
Now pour oil in a pot and make sure it’s super hot. 
Dip the banana in the batter and fry it till it’s golden brown in color.

title: KVKV Kulambu
cooking_instructions:
Cut the brinjal into four pieces and transfer it to a bowl.
Steam both the brinjal and the cluster beans until they are about 80 percent cooked.
Add turmeric and salt and mix well
Spread them on a tray and et them dry in the sun for 8 hours.
Now separate the cluster beans, mix them with curd, and keep them to dry until completely dry.
 Let the brinjal also dry completely.
In a kadai, add toor dal and water, and cook it for 20 minutes.
Soak the vathal in warm water, strain it, and keep it aside.
In a kadai, add oil, mustard seeds, onion, and tomato, and sauté for 5 minutes.
Now add chilli powder and salt, and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the cooked dal and the vathal, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Soak the tamarind in water, squeeze it, extract the tamarind water and add to the kadai
In a tadka pan, add all the remaining ingredients. Once they splutter, pour it into the kadai.
Finish with coriander leaves.

title: Cookd Chicken Thokku
cooking_instructions:
In a kadai, heat oil. Add mustard seeds and cumin seeds. Let it splutter.
Now add curry leaves and dry red chilli.
Add onion and saute until golden brown, about 10-12 minutes, followed by green chilli.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute till the raw smell goes away.
Add tomatoes and saute until soft
Now add Cookd Chicken Masala and mix. Add water to this and cook until the oil starts to separate
Add chicken and mix
Cook it till the gravy is thick again, releases oil, and the meat is tender. Adjust salt.
Finish with coriander leaves.

title: Cookd Mutton Thokku
cooking_instructions:
In a pressure cooker, add mutton, Cookd mutton masala and water. Pressure cook the mutton for 20 mins on low flame or until the meat is tender
In a kadai, heat oil. Add mustard seeds and cumin seeds. Let it splutter.
Now add curry leaves and dry red chilli.
Add onion and saute until golden brown, about 10-12 mins, followed by green chilli.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute till the raw smell goes away.
Once the onions are golden brown, add the tomatoes and saute until soft.
Now add some more Cookd Mutton Masala and mix. Add water to this and cook until the oil starts to separate.
Add the cooked mutton and mix.
Cook it till the gravy is thick again, and releases oil. Adjust salt if needed.
Finish with black pepper powder and fresh coriander leaves.

title: Cookd Mushroom Thokku
cooking_instructions:
In a kadai, heat oil. Add mustard seeds and cumin seeds. Let it splutter.
Now add curry leaves and dry red chilli.
Add onion and saute until golden brown, about 10-12 mins, followed by green chilli.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute till the raw smell goes away.
Once the onions are golden brown, add the tomatoes and saute until soft.
Now add Cookd Kulambu Chilli Masala and mix. Add water to this and cook until the oil starts to separate.
Add mushroom and mix. The water will release. 
Cook it till the gravy is thick again, and releases oil. Adjust salt if needed.
Finish with black pepper powder and fresh coriander leaves.

title: Cookd Soya Curry
cooking_instructions:
In a kadai, heat oil. Add onions and saute till it is translucent, about 7-8 mins. Now add tomato and saute until soft.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a few mins, until the raw smell goes.
Add Cookd Kulambu Chilli Masala and mix. Take it off the heat. 
Cool the mixture, add water and grind it into a smooth paste.
In another kadai, add oil, and let it heat.
Add mustard seeds, let it splutter. Add curry leaves, green chilli, and dry red chilli, followed by the paste.
Now add the soaked soya chunks and some more Cookd Kulambu Chilli Masala. Add ½ cup of water and let it simmer over medium heat for 15 mins. 
Adjust salt if needed. 
Finish with coriander leaves.

title: No Yeast Eggless Doughnuts
cooking_instructions: Combine the milk and vinegar, to make instant buttermilk.
Add the curd, melted butter, vanilla essence and sugar. Whisk until the sugar dissolves.
Combine the dry ingredients- flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt and set aside.
Combine the wet and dry ingredients and knead a smooth dough. Cover and rest the dough for 15 mins.
Roll the dough to ½ an inch thickness and cut out doughnuts and doughnut holes.
Fry in medium hot oil until golden brown and fluffy.
After cooled, they can be decorated with topping of your choice.

title: Cookd Kalyana Vatha kulambu (with coconut)
cooking_instructions:
In a kadai, heat gingelly oil. Fry vathal in the oil and take it out.
In the same oil, add mustard seeds, let it splutter, then add fenugreek seeds, dry red chilli, followed by curry leaves.
Add green chilli and garlic and saute for a few seconds. Add shallots. Sauté till it turns light brown and soft, about 6-8 mins. 
Now add tomatoes and saute till they become soft. 
Add Cookd Vatha kulambu masala and mix for a few seconds.
Add water to this, mix and let it simmer for 15 minutes on a medium-low flame until thick. 
Add coconut paste. Adjust salt if needed.
 Add the fried vathal and bring to a boil
Finish with fresh curry leaves and some raw gingelly oil. It can be paired with plain steamed rice.

title: Cookd Mutton Kulambu (with coconut)
cooking_instructions:
In a pressure cooker, add mutton, Cookd mutton masala and water. Pressure cook the mutton for 20 mins on low flame or until tender.
In a kadai, heat oil. Add onion to this and saute till it begins to brown.
Add tomato and saute till the tomatoes are soft mushy.
Add coconut and mix.
Now add Cookd Mutton Masala and mix for a few seconds. Take it off the heat.
Transfer into a mixer, add water and grind it into a fine paste.
Add mustard seeds, let it splutter. Add curry leaves, green chilli, and dry red chilli. 
Add onions and saute till it is translucent, about 7-8 mins. 
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a few mins, until the raw smell goes.
Now add tomato and saute until soft.
Add the paste, followed by cooked mutton.
Let it simmer over medium heat for 15 mins, until the meat is tender. Adjust salt if needed. 
Finish with coriander leaves. It can be served with idli/dosa.

title: Cookd Cauliflower Kurma (with coconut)
cooking_instructions:
In a saucepan, boil water. Add cauliflower florets and salt to this and let it boil for 3 mins
Take it out & strain it.
In a kadai, heat oil. Add onion to this and saute till it begins to brown.
Add tomato and saute till the tomatoes are soft and mushy.
Add coconut and mix.
Now add Cookd Kulambu Chilli Masala and mix for a few seconds. Take it off the heat.
Transfer into a mixer, add water and grind it into a fine paste.
In another kadai, add oil, and let it heat.
Add mustard seeds, let it splutter. Add curry leaves, green chilli, and dry red chilli. 
Add onions and saute till it is translucent, about 7-8 mins. 
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a few mins, until the raw smell goes.
Now add tomato and saute until soft.
Add Cookd Kulambu Chilli Masala and mix. Then add the paste, followed by the vegetable.
Add some water and let it simmer over medium heat for a few mins, until tender. Adjust salt if needed. 
Finish with coriander leaves. It can be served with idli/dosa.

title: Rasna- Kuppai Series
cooking_instructions:
Using a knife, separate the white part (pith) from the orange peel and discard it.
Sun dry the orange peel for 2 days or dehydrate it in the air fryer for 20 mins at 70 C.
In a mixer- grinder, combine the dried orange peel, sugar, citric acid,food colour and grind it into a fine powder.
Mix the powder with water and top it off with ice cubes.

title: Cookd Vathal Kulambu
cooking_instructions:
In a kadai, heat gingelly oil. Fry vathal in the oil and take it out.
In the same oil, add mustard seeds, let it splutter, then add fenugreek seeds, dry red chilli, followed by curry leaves.
Add green chilli and garlic and saute for a few seconds. Add shallots. Sauté till it turns light brown and soft, about 6-8 mins. 
Now add tomatoes and saute till they become soft.
Add Cookd Vatha kulambu masala and mix.
Add water to this, mix and let it simmer for 15 minutes on a medium-low flame until thick and the oil separates.
Adjust salt if needed. 
Add the fried vathal and bring to a boil.
Finish with fresh curry leaves and some raw gingelly oil. It can be paired with plain steamed rice.

title: Cookd Pressure Cooker Chicken Kulambu
cooking_instructions:
In a pressure cooker, add oil. Once the oil is hot, add mustard seeds. Let it splutter.
Add curry leaves, red chilli and green chilli.
Add onion and saute till it turns translucent, about 6-7 mins. Now add ginger garlic paste and saute for a few mins until the raw smell goes
Add tomato and saute until soft
Add 3 tbsp (30g) of Cookd Chicken Masala. You can add 4 tbsp (40g) of masala if you prefer a spicier curry. 
Followed by the chicken. Mix well. 
Add water and close the lid. Cook for 2 whistles on medium heat.
Open the lid, simmer to the desired consistency and adjust the salt if needed.
Finish with coriander leaves.

title: Cookd Pressure Cooker Mutton Kulambu
cooking_instructions:
In a pressure cooker, add oil. Once the oil is hot, add mustard seeds. Let it splutter.
Add curry leaves, red chilli and green chilli.
Add onion and saute till it turns translucent, about 6-7 mins. Now add ginger garlic paste and saute for a few mins until the raw smell goes.
Add tomato and saute until soft.
Add 3 tbsp (30g) Cookd Mutton Masala. You can add 4 tbsp (40g) of masala if you prefer a spicier curry. 
Followed by the Mutton. Mix well. 
Add water and close the lid. Cook for 1 whistle on high heat and 20-25 mins on a low heat. 
Open the lid, simmer to the desired consistency and adjust the salt if needed.
Finish with coriander leaves.

title: Cookd Chicken Kulambu (no coconut)
cooking_instructions:
In a kadai, heat oil. Add onions and saute till it is translucent, about 7-8 mins. Now add tomato and saute until soft
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a few mins, until the raw smell goes.
Add Cookd Chicken Masala and mix. Take it off the heat. 
Cool the mixture, add water and grind it into a smooth paste.
In another kadai, add oil, and let it heat.
Add mustard seeds, let them splutter. Add curry leaves, green chilli, dry red chili followed by the paste.
Now add the chicken and some more Cookd Chicken Masala. Add ½ cup of water and let it simmer over medium heat for 15 mins or until the chicken is cooked.
Adjust salt if needed. 
Finish with coriander leaves.

title: Cookd Mutton Kulambu (no coconut)
cooking_instructions:
In a pressure cooker, add mutton, 2 tbsp (20g) Cookd Mutton Masala and 2 cups (500ml) water. Pressure cook for 20 mins or until tender.
In a kadai, heat oil. Add onions and saute till they are translucent, about 7-8 mins. Now add tomato and saute until soft
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a few mins, until the raw smell goes
Add Cookd Mutton Masala and mix. Take it off the heat. 
Cool the mixture, add water and grind it into a smooth paste.
Add mustard seeds, let them splutter. Add curry leaves, green chilli, dry red chili followed by the paste.
Now add the cooked mutton. Add ½ cup of water and let it simmer till the desired consistency is achieved. Adjust salt if needed.
Finish with coriander leaves.

title: Cookd Murungakai Puli Kulambu
cooking_instructions:
In a kadai, heat gingelly oil and add mustard seeds, let it splutter, then add fenugreek seeds, dry red chilli, green chilli, followed by curry leaves. 
Add shallots and saute for a few seconds. Then add garlic and saute until light brown and soft, about 7-8 mins.
Now add tomatoes and saute till they become soft. Add drumstick pieces and saute for a few minutes.
Add Cookd Vathal kulambu masala and mix.
Add water to this, mix and let it simmer for 15 minutes on a medium-low flame until thick and the oil separates
Adjust salt if needed.
Finish with fresh curry leaves and some raw gingelly oil. It can be paired with plain steamed rice.

title: Sabudana Khichdi
cooking_instructions: Wash and Soak the tapioca pearls/ sabudana with water, 1 inch above the level of the dry tapioca pearls. For 3 hours up to overnight depending on the quality. Drain and set aside.
Heat oil in a kadai and add the small potato dices, cook until tender.
Add the cumin seeds, saute until aromatic and browned. Add the chopped chilli and ginger and mix well.
Next, add the soak and drained tapioca pearls, crushed peanuts, salt and sugar. Mix well for 4-5 minutes on a medium flame, until the tapioca pearl becomes translucent.
Finish with lemon juice and chopped coriander leaves. Mix well.

title: Cookd Kerala Fish Curry
cooking_instructions:
Heat 4 tbsp coconut oil in a kadai. Add 1/4 tsp mustard & fenugreek seeds, let it splutter.
Add 20-25 sliced shallots or 2 sliced onions & 1 slit green chilli. Cook until deep golden brown.
Add 1 sliced tomato & cook until soft.
Add 1 pouch (50 g) Cookd Kerala Fish Curry Masala, pour 2 cups (500 ml) water & boil for 6–7 mins until slightly thick.
Add curry leaves & 500 g of fish. Cook on low flame for 5 mins. Don’t mix too much.
Finish with coconut oil & curry leaves. Serve hot.

title: Dates Pickle
cooking_instructions:
Soak the tamarind in water and keep it aside. 
Heat oil in a pot and add the mustard seed. Let it splutter. 
Add garlic, ginger and green chillies. Saute for a few minutes.
Toss in some curry leaves also. 
Add turmeric powder and kashmiri chilli powder. Mix it well. 
Add the dates and combine them well with the masala
Add water and let it boil. 
When the dates are soft, add the tamarind water and jaggery.
Mix it well and let it thicken.

title: Cabbage Momo Bowl
cooking_instructions: Combine the flour, salt, oil, and water, and bring together a rough dough. Rest for 10 mins.
Knead until smooth and set aside.
In another bowl, add finely chopped cabbage, crumbled paneer, ginger, garlic, green chillies, and the seasonings. Add a little cornstarch to bind the mixture and prevent it from becoming watery.
Roll out the dough and cut it to cover the bowls. Each bowl needs 2 discs.
Portion this mixture into small bowls and layer with 1 dough disc in the middle. Use one disc to cover the top.

Steam these bowls for 15 mins on a medium flame. 
Garnish with spring onion/ chilli oil or soya sauce and serve hot.

title: Palakkai Uppu Kari
cooking_instructions:
In a kadai, add water, turmeric powder, salt, ginger–garlic paste, and raw jackfruit.
Cover and cook for 15 minutes, until it is about 80% cooked.
Mash the shallots and garlic together and keep aside.
In another kadai, heat oil. Add fennel seeds, urad dal, mashed shallots, dry red chilli, and curry leaves.
Sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the cooked raw jackfruit along with all the spice powders and sauté for another 2 minutes.
Add a little water and dry roast until the mixture comes together well.

title: Channa Dal Gelato
cooking_instructions:
Wash the channa dal thoroughly and soak it in enough water for 1-2 hours.
Pressure cook the soaked dal with 2 cups of water until fully cooked and soft.
Once cooked, drain any excess water and mash the dal lightly. Keep aside..
Add jaggery and ½ tsp cardamom powder and mix well.
Allow the mixture to cool completely.
Transfer the cooled mixture to a blender and blend until smooth and creamy, adding a little water if required to adjust consistency.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe container.Freeze for 2–3 hours, then remove and blend or whisk once to break ice crystals.
Return to the freezer and freeze until set.
Remove from the freezer 5–10 minutes before serving for a soft, gelato-like texture.

title: Pineapple Peel Rasam
cooking_instructions:
Process the pineapple- peel it and cut the core out. Wash the peel and make a chunky puree with the core.
For the base, add all the base ingredients in a stock pot and let it simmer.
Add the crushed masala. Let it simmer.
Roughly crush the cumin seeds, peppercorns, garlic for the masala
Remove the peel, once the rasam has simmered.
For the tadka, in a pan, add oil, mustard seeds, let it splutter, then add curry leaves, gundu chili, asafoetida. Pour it over the rasam.
Garnish with coriander leaves.

title: Tumbler- Garlic Bread
cooking_instructions:
In a mixing bowl, add flour, pizza seasoning, yeast,  pounded garlic, salt, sugar and mix thoroughly. 
Add butter, pour milk and knead into a soft and smooth dough. 
Let the dough rest for 45-50 minutes or until doubled in size. 
In the meantime, add butter, chopped garlic, pizza seasoning and garlic powder and melt into an aromatic garlic butter. 
Punch down the dough and shape it into a circle. Brush one half with the garlic butter and shape it into a semicircle, and transfer into a plate. Sprinkle with garlic powder. 
Let it slightly puff up (around 25-30 minutes)
And add it to a salt-lined pan, cover and let it bake for 25-30 minutes on high heat. 
Once cooked, take it out, brush with the garlic butter and serve hot.

title: Easy Ribbon Pakoda
cooking_instructions:
Sieve all the ingredients into a bowl. 
Add oil and water. Combine them well into a dough. It should be thick enough to come out of the ribbon mold.
Insert the dough into a mold and heat oil in a pot. 
When it’s hot, add the pakoda in circles and fry them until golden brown in color.
Toss in some curry leaves at the end and fry them. .

title: Chicken 65 (M65)
cooking_instructions: Mix the Madras 65 masala with water to form a thick paste. Add the chicken to it and mix well till it is coated with the masala

Heat oil in a kadai and fry the chicken for 5-7 minutes (small pieces) till it becomes crispy and is cooked throughout. Finally, fry a sprig of curry leaves along with the chicken before taking it out. Drain off the excess oil and serve it hot with lemon wedges.

title: Paneer 65 (M65)
cooking_instructions:
Prepare a batter by mixing water with one sachet of the madras 65 masala
Add paneer cubes. Mix it till the paneer is coated evenly with the masala

Heat oil in a kadai and fry the paneer for 2 minutes Finally, fry a sprig of curry leaves along with the paneer before taking it out. Drain off the excess oil and serve it hot with lemon wedges and onion rings

title: Paneer Tikka Chapati Quesadilla
cooking_instructions: For the paneer tikka, heat the mustard oil and add the red chilli powder. Allow it to cool down a bit and add all the other ingredients except the cubed paneer. Whisk to make a smooth marinade.
Add the paneer and rest for 30 mins in the fridge.
Grill them until it has char/grill marks on both sides
Remove, slice and toss in chaat masala, lemon juice and melted butter.
For the second mixture, heat olive oil in a pan and add the chopped garlic, saute until light brown. Add the onions, corn and capsicum and saute until soft.
Add the red chilli flakes, cumin powder and mixed dry herbs. Add salt and mix well.
Finally, add the tomatoes and mix well.Set aside this mixture.
Place the rotis on a board and apply some of the leftover marinade, place some of the mixture on one half, place the paneer, add some grated cheese on top and fold into a semi-circle shape.
Oil both the sides and further cook on a tava until golden brown and the cheese melts.

title: Cookd Fish Fry (80g pouch)
cooking_instructions: Add 1 pouch (50g) masala to a bowl with 5 tbsp (75 ml) water, add juice from 1 lemon and mix to form a thick paste.
Apply the marinade on the fish and spread it evenly. let it marinate for 30 minutes for better results.

Heat a tawa, add oil and sear the fish on a medium flame for 3 minutes on each side.
Serve it hot with fried curry leaves, onion rings and lemon wedges

title: Cookd Vazhakkai Fry (80 g)
cooking_instructions:
Add 1 pouch (50g) masala to a bowl with 5 tbsp (75 ml) water, add juice from 1 lemon and mix to form a thick paste.
Apply the marinade to the vazhakkai and spread it evenly. Let it marinate for 30 minutes for better results.
Heat a tawa, add oil and sear the vazhakkai on a medium flame for 3 minutes on each side.
Serve it hot with onion rings and lemon wedges

title: Masala Chai Milk Jelly
cooking_instructions:
Wash and peel some ginger. Grate is and squeeze out the juice. 
Heat milk until it is warm, but you can still place your finger in it for 5 secs. 
Add the ginger juice to a serving bowl and pour over the warm milk. 
Cover and rest for 10 mins for it to set.
For the masala chai syrup - Add jaggery powder, water, cardamom pods and tea leaves in a pan. 
Bring it to a boil and then simmer till it slightly thickens. 
Strain the syrup and set aside. 
While serving, pour the syrup over the pudding and serve!

title: Cookd Kathirika Kallu Varuval
cooking_instructions: Cut the brinjal into round shapes.

Now add the Cookd Marina Fish Fry Masala, water, and lemon juice, and mix it well.
Let it marinate for 15 minutes.
In a dosa tawa, add oil, curry leaves, and onion slices, and sauté for 2 minutes.

Now add the marinated brinjal to the pan and cook it well.
Serve it with curd rice.

title: kandarappam
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the rice along with the toor dal and urad dal for 90 minutes.

Then add them to the grinder and grind along with jaggery, salt, and cardamom into a smooth batter.
Take the batter out from the grinder.

Heat oil in a kadai.
Using a small kuli karandi, gently pour the batter into the hot oil and deep-fry until golden brown.

title: Neyyappam
cooking_instructions: Melt the jaggery with water and cool it down.
Blend the soaked idli rice with cumin seeds, cardamom, maida and salt. Make it into smooth runny batter like dosa batter
Mix it with the batter and roasted sesame seeds. Make it into a runny batter.

Heat up the oil and pour the batter into the centre and wait for it to rise up. 
Fry it till it’s golden brown in color.

title: Cookd Andhra Chicken 65
cooking_instructions:
Mix the Madras 65 masala with water to form a thick paste 
Add the chicken to it and mix well till it is coated with the masala
Heat oil in a kadai and fry the chicken for 5-7 minutes (small pieces) till it becomes crispy and is cooked throughout
Heat a pan, add oil.
Add chopped ginger and garlic.
Add curry leaves, green chilli and saute for a few seconds
Add tomato ketchup, soy sauce and mix well.
Finally, add the beaten curd, mix till it combines.
Add the fried chicken 65, toss till it is coated well with the sauce.
Serve it hot

title: Cookd Squid Tawa Fry
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, add all the ingredients required for the marinade and mix them well to combine. 
Add the squid rings to the marinade and mix to coat well. 
Let them marinate for at least 30 minutes or overnight for better results. 
In a pan, add oil.
Once hot, add curry leaves and let it crackle.
Add the squid and fry on a high heat for 4-5 minutes , or until seared well
Once the squid is cooked, remove and serve hot!

recipe_ingredients.ingredient_name: Cookd Fish Fry Masala (80 g pouch)

title: Cookd Prawn Fry
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, add all the ingredients required for the marinade and mix them well to combine. 
Add the prawns to the marinade and mix to coat well. 
Let them marinate for at least 30 minutes or overnight for better results. 
In a pan, add oil.
Once hot, add the prawn and fry on a high heat for 2 minutes per side, or until seared.
After flipping, add the curry leaves.
Once the prawns are cooked, remove and serve hot!

recipe_ingredients.ingredient_name: Cookd Fish Fry Masala (80 g pouch)

title: Chana Masala
cooking_instructions: Soak the channa over night
Heat oil and butter in a pressure cooker
Add whole spices and saute till they are aromatic
Add finely chopped onion, ginger garlic paste and cook till it turns golden brown
Add tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes
Add the powdered spices, salt and cook for 2 minutes
Add soaked chickpeas, 2 cups of water and pressure cook for 10 whistles
Open the pan once the pressure settles on its own, add coriander leaves, lemon juice and simmer for 2 minutes or until the gravy reaches desired consistency.
Garnish with more coriander leaves and serve hot with chapati/poori/batura

title: Murg Musallam
cooking_instructions: For the mince, heat oil in a kadai and add the onions. Fry them until light golden.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and green chillies and fry until no longer raw in aroma. Add the chopped nuts and raisins and mix well.
Add the powdered spices, salt.Add the mint and coriander leaves mix well.
Add the mince and mix well to prevent it from becoming a lump. Cook the mince half done
Make slits on the whole chicken carcass and rub with oil, salt and red chilli powder.
Stuff the mince in the cavity along with the boiled eggs. Use a string and tie up the chicken to enclose the mince well.

Heat oil, in a pot and add the chicken trussed chicken carcass and get a brown colour on all sides by frying in hot oil for less time, we don’t want to cook the chicken, just browning the outside. About 4-5 mins per side.Drain the chicken and set aside.
To make the paste, dry roast the de-skinned almonds and cashew nuts until slightly brown. Add the poppy seeds and roast further for 2 mins.
Blend to a smooth paste with water and set aside.
For the gravy, heat oil in a kadai, add the whole spices and add the onions. Brown them, lightly. Add the ginger-garlic paste and fry until no longer raw in aroma.
Add the tomatoes and cook until completely mashed and add the salt, powdered spices. Mix well and add 2 cups of water.
Add the prepared paste and bring to a boil.
Add the chicken and reduce the flame. Cook covered for 30 mins while stirring occasionally. Flip the chicken after 20 mins. Keep basting with the gravy.
Once the chicken is cooked and tender. Remove it from the gravy.
To finish the gravy, blend it smooth and add the cream, kewra water and saffron and mix well, prepare a thick and saucy consistency.
Plate the chicken and cut the strings. Top with the gravy, silver leaf and chopped nuts.

title: Prawn Rava Fry 80 g Pouch
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, add all the ingredients required for the marinade and mix them well to combine. 
Add the prawns to the marinade and mix to coat well. 
Let them marinate for at least 30 minutes, and up till overnight.
Right before frying the prawns, toss the prawn in rava, and coat them thoroughly.
In a pan, add oil.
Once hot, add the prawn and fry on a high heat for 2 minutes per side, or until seared.
After flipping, add the curry leaves.
Once the prawns are cooked, remove and serve hot!

recipe_ingredients.ingredient_name: Cookd Fish Fry Masala (80 g pouch)

title: Cookd Rava Fish Fry
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, add all the ingredients required for the marinade and mix them well to combine. 
Add the fish to the marinade and mix to coat well. 
Let them marinate for at least 30 minutes or overnight for better results.
Right before frying the fish, toss the fish in rava, and coat them thoroughly.
In a pan, add oil.
Once hot, add the fish and fry on a medium heat for 3 minutes per side, or until seared.
After flipping, add the curry leaves.
Once the fish is cooked, remove and serve hot!

recipe_ingredients.ingredient_name: Cookd Fish Fry Masala (80 g pouch)

title: Cookd Cauliflower 65
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, add half a packet of the madras 65 masala.
Add half a cup of water to it and make it into a batter.
Add the cauliflower florets to it and mix it using a spoon/fork till it combines evenly.
Sprinkle the remaining masala and mix using a spoon.
Deep fry in hot oil till it is crispy. (2minutes)
Garnish with fried curry leaves and serve it hot.

title: Chocolate Orange Cake
cooking_instructions: Combine the dry ingredients in a bowl and mix well.
Combine the dry ingredients in a bowl and mix well.
Combine the wet ingredients in a bowl and mix well.

Mix the dry and wet ingredients. Do not over-mix; some small clumps of flour are ok. 
Add to the baking pan.
Bake for 45-50 mins if it’s a pan & 20-25 mins if it's a cupcake pan.

title: Prawn Head Podi
cooking_instructions:
Clean the prawns and separate the head and shell
Blanch the head, shell and tail
Roast the prawn head and shell, till aromatic, keep aside
Dry roast coriander seeds, chanan dal, urad dal, toor dal, dried red chili, curry leaves

In a blender, combine all the roasted ingredients along with asafoetida, jaggery, tamarind and salt.
Serve it with steamed rice.

title: Easy Bread Upma
cooking_instructions:
In a kadhai, pour oil and add mustard seeds and urad dal, let it splutter. 
Add the finely chopped ginger and garlic and saute until aromatic. 
Add the finely chopped onions and saute for 5 seconds on a high flame.
Add the tomatoes and cook until it turns mushy.
Add the curry leaves, chilli powder, cashew nuts and garam masala and mix thoroughly. 
Add the cubed bread slices, salt, kasoori methi and capsicum and toss until combined. 
Pour water and toss until thoroughly combined, and the bread turns soft.

title: Cookd Fish Curry
cooking_instructions: Heat 4 tbsp gingelly oil in a kadai. Add 1/4 tsp mustard & fenugreek seeds, let it splutter.
Add 2 sliced onions, 5 cloves garlic  & 1 slit green chilli. Cook until deep golden brown.
Add 2 sliced tomatoes & cook until soft.
Add 1 pouch (50 g) Cookd Fish Curry Masala
Pour 2 cups (500 ml) water & boil for 6–7 mins until slightly thick.
Add curry leaves & 500 g of fish. Cook on low flame for 5 mins. Don’t mix too much.
Finish with curry leaves. Serve hot.

title: Sambar Biryani
cooking_instructions:
Soak the rice and dal together for 20 mins.
In a biryani pot, add oil, add mustard seeds, let it splutter. Then add the curry leaves, red chillies, followed by shallots and saute it till it becomes mushy.
Now add the tomatoes and saute.
Add Cookd Lunch Sambar Masala and mix.
Add the chicken and mix for 2 minutes.
Now add water and bring it to a boil.
 Add the soaked rice and dal and stir for a minute.
Cover it with a foil, reduce the flame and cook it in dum for 13 mins.
Break the dum, drizzle some ghee on top and garnish with coriander leaves.

recipe_ingredients.ingredient_name: Cookd Tamil Nadu Lunch Sambar Masala

title: Creamy Mashed Potatoes
cooking_instructions: Peel and cut the potato into dices. In a pot, add the potatoes and enough water to immerse them. Season with salt and bring to a boil. Boil until the potatoes can be pierced easily with a knife.
Strain the potatoes. You can mash them with a potato masher, but for even creamier mashed potatoes pass them through a strainer while they are still warm.
In a pan, simmer the butter along with garlic and cream on a low flame. Add this to the potatoes and fold it in using a spatula.
Season with salt and pepper. Add warm milk a little at a time until it reaches the desired consistency.

title: Peanut Rice and Potato Soya Chukka
cooking_instructions: In the same pan, add all the ingredients for the podi along with one portion of the roasted peanuts, and dry roast everything together.
Now, coarsely blend the mixture.
In another pan, prepare the tempering. Add the cooked white rice and salt to the pan, then mix well.

In a cooker, add oil, mustard seeds, urad dal, and fennel seeds. Let them splutter.
Add the onion and sauté for 2 minutes.
Then add the peeled potatoes and soaked soya chunks.

Add the cooked Madurai chukka masala and mix well.
Pour in water, cover, and pressure cook for 1 or 2 whistles.
Once the pressure is released, open the lid and stir-fry the mixture.

title: Chocolate Orange Cream
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, add the crushed cornflakes & melted butter. Mix to make the crumble base.
Layer this in small cups.

Heat the coconut milk in a pan till you can see the steam. Do not boil it. 
Break up the chocolate in a bowl, pour over the coconut milk. Cover for a few minutes.
Open the chocolate mixture, mix well, add the orange juice & zest from 1 orange. Mix well.

Pour this mixture into the cups and keep to set in the fridg for 2-3 hours until chill. 
Garnish with fruits/ nuts/ more cornflakes & serve.

title: Prawn 65 (50 g)
cooking_instructions:
Add 1 sachet of the madras 65 masala to a bowl and add 100 ml water to it. Mix it well till it becomes a paste without any lumps
Add the prawns and mix well till it is evenly coated with the masala
Heat oil in a kadai and fry the prawns for 5 minutes till it becomes crispy and is cooked throughout Finally, fry a sprig of curry leaves along with the prawns before taking it out. Drain off the excess oil and serve it hot with lemon wedges and onion rings.

title: Cookd Soya 65
cooking_instructions:
To a bowl, add the soya chunks, hot water, turmeric powder and let the soya soak it in for 10 minutes till it softens and doubles in size.
Strain it and squeeze out the extra water and transfer it to another bowl.
Add the cookd madras 65 masala and water and mix well till the soya is coated with the masala
Heat oil in a kadai and fry the soya chunks on a medium flame till it becomes crispy on the outside (4-5 minutes)
Add a sprig of curry leaves to the oil before taking it out and transfer it to a plate lined with tissue
Serve it hot

title: Honey Chilli Potatoes
cooking_instructions:
Peel the skin of the potatoes and cut them into wedges
Par boil the potatoes, till 70% cooked. Drain it.
Dust it in cornflour. 
Fry in hot oil for 2 minutes and drain it on tissue. 
Fry again in hot oil until crispy. Drain and keep aside.
In a pan, heat oil, add garlic, ginger, curry leaves and saute for few seconds.
Add onion and capsicum, saute for few seconds, do not fully cook the onion and capsicum.
Now add the guntur masala, followed by tomato ketchup,vinegar, soy sauce and honey.
Prepare corn flour slurry and add it in the sauce.
Add the fried wedges and toss.
Finish off the spring onion and sesame seeds
Serve it.

title: Aatukaal Kulambu
cooking_instructions:
In a pressure cooker, add the goat legs, water, onion, and tomato. Pressure cook for 6–7 whistles (about 30 minutes).
Meanwhile, in another pressure cooker, add the mochai and water. 
Pressure cook for 3 whistles on a medium flame.
In a large kadai, transfer the cooked goat legs along with the stock.
Add some water, cooked mochai, raw banana, salt, and chilli powder. 
Mix well, cover, and cook for 5 minutes on a medium flame.
Now add the tamarind water and coconut paste. 
Mix well and let it simmer for 5 minutes.
Prepare the tempering by heating oil and adding fennel seeds. 
Pour this over the gravy.
Must serve hot with rice, idli, or dosa

title: Cookd Ambur Chicken Biryani - Standee
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
In a pressure cooker, add the Cookd ambur biryani paste and the washed chicken pieces. Mix it for a few seconds. Add water, and mix till they combine.
Once it starts to heat up, add the soaked and strained rice. Mix it gently till the rice is submerged.
Cover the cooker and pressure cook it for 2 whistles on a medium flame. 
Turn off the flame after 2 whistles and let the steam reduce gradually for about 10 minutes. 
Open the cooker, fluff up the rice and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Ambur Mutton Biryani - Standee
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes
To a pressure cooker add the Cookd ambur biryani paste and mutton curry cut and mix for a few seconds. Add 1 Cup (250ml) of water. Mix it and let the water start to heat up. Close the cooker and pressure cook the mutton on a medium flame for 7-9 whistles . Turn off the flame and let the steam reduce gradually. Open the cooker and check if the mutton is cooked. If it isn't, close the cooker and cook it for 2 more whistles if necessary and let the steam reduce gradually
Add the soaked and strained rice, and add ½ Cup (125ml) of water.
Cover the cooker and pressure cook it for 2 whistles on a medium flame.Turn off the flame after 2 whistles and let the steam reduce gradually for about 10 minutes.Open the cooker,  fluff the rice and serve it hot with raita.

title: Cookd Ambur Veg Biryani - Standee
cooking_instructions: Wash the rice and soak it for 20 minutes
To a pressure cooker, add the Cookd ambur biryani paste and the vegetables and saute for a minute. Add water, let it heat up.

Add the soaked and strained rice and close the cooker tightly.
Pressure cook for 2 whistles on a medium flame. Turn off the flame after 2 whistles. Let the steam reduce gradually for about 10 minutes. Open the cooker, fluff up the rice and serve it hot with raita.

title: Creamy Shrimp Pasta
cooking_instructions: To cook the pasta, bring a large pot of water to a boil. Season with salt and add the pasta. Cook for 7-9 minutes or according to package instructions. The pasta should be soft but not mushy. Reserve 1 cup of the water for later use.
In a bowl, mix the shrimp with salt, pepper and chilli powder.
Heat oil and butter in a pan. Add the shrimp to the pan and cook for 4 minutes.
Remove the shrimp from the pan. Add in onion and garlic. Saute until the onion turns translucent. Season with salt and pepper.
Add cream and cheese. Add the reserved pasta water. Mix continuously until combined.
Add the pasta to the sauce along with the water and the cooked shrimp. Add lemon zest and lemon juice and mix well.

title: Cookd Dindigul Chicken Biryani - Standee
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak rice for 20 minutes.
In a pressure cooker add the cookd dindigul biryani paste and the chicken. Saute for 30 seconds and pour water and bring it to a boil.
Add the soaked rice to the pressure cooker. Close the cooker and cook for 2 whistles on a medium flame. Let the biryani rest for 10 minutes. Open the pressure cooker, fluff up the rice and serve it hot with raita.

title: Cookd Dindigul Mutton Biryani - Standee
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak rice for 20 minutes.
To a pressure cooker add the cookd dindigul biryani paste and mutton curry cut and mix for a 30 seconds. Add 1 Cup (250ml) of water. Mix it and let the water start to heat up.

Close the cooker and pressure cook the mutton on a medium flame for 7 whistles. Turn off the flame and let the steam reduce gradually. Open the cooker and check if the mutton is cooked. If it isn't, close the cooker and cook it for 2 more whistles if necessary and let the steam reduce gradually. Open the cooker, and ½ Cup (125ml) of water.

Add the soaked and strained rice, give it a gentle mix. Cover the cooker and pressure cook it for 2 whistles on a medium flame. Turn off the flame after 2 whistles and let the steam reduce gradually for about 10 minutes. Open the cooker, fluff the rice and serve it hot with raita.

title: Cookd Dindigul Mushroom & Soya Chunks Biryani - Standee
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak rice for 20 minutes.

In a pressure cooker add the cookd dindigul biryani paste and the mushrooms and soya chunks.
Saute for 30 seconds and pour water, let it come to a boil.

Add the soaked rice to the pressure cooker.
Close the cooker and cook for 2 whistles on a medium flame. Open the pressure cooker, fluff up the rice and serve it hot.

title: Cookd Wedding Chicken Biryani - Standee
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak basmati Rice for 20 mins
In a pressure cooker add the Cookd Wedding Biryani Paste and Chicken. Saute the chicken for 2 minutes, pour water.

Once the water starts to heat up, add the soaked and strained rice.
Pressure cook on a medium flame for 2 whistles. Let the steam reduce gradually for about 10 mins. Open the pressure cooker, fluff up the rice. Serve it hot with raita

title: Cookd Wedding Mutton Biryani - Standee
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes.
To a pressure cooker add the biryani paste and mutton curry cut and mix for a few seconds.
Add 1 Cup of water, mix it and let the water start to heat up. Close the cooker and pressure cook the mutton on a medium flame for 7-9 whistles. Turn off the flame and let the steam reduce gradually.
Open the cooker and check if the mutton is cooked. If it isn't, close the cooker and cook it for 2 more whistles if necessary and let the steam reduce gradually. Open the cooker, and ½ Cup (125ml) of water. Add the soaked and strained rice, give it a gentle mix
Cover the cooker and pressure cook it for 2 whistles on a medium flame. Turn off the flame after 2 whistles and let the steam reduce gradually for about 10 minutes. Open the cooker, fluff the rice and serve it hot with raita.

title: Cookd Wedding Veg Biryani - Standee
cooking_instructions:
Wash and soak basmati Rice for 20 mins.
In a pressure cooker add the Cookd Wedding Biryani Paste and add the vegetables along with it. Saute the vegetables for 2 minutes, pour 2 cups of water and let it heat up
Add the soaked and strained rice and pressure cook on a medium flame for 2 whistles. Let the steam reduce gradually for 10 mins. Open the cooker, add the seasoning oil, fluff up the biryani and serve it hot with raita.

title: Chicken Curry (with coconut)
cooking_instructions:
In a kadai, heat oil. Add onion to this and saute till it begins to brown.
Add tomato and saute till the tomatoes are soft.
Add coconut and mix.
Now add Cookd Chicken Masala and mix for a few seconds. Take it off the heat.
Transfer into a mixer, add water and grind it into a fine paste
In another kadai, add oil, and let it heat.
Add mustard seeds, let it splutter. Add curry leaves, green chilli, and dry red chilli. 
Add onions and saute till it is translucent, about 7-8 mins. 
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a few mins, until the raw smell goes.
Now add tomato and saute until soft.
Add Cookd Chicken Masala and mix.
Then add the paste, followed by chicken.
Add the chicken, water and let it simmer over medium heat for 15 mins, until the meat is tender
Adjust salt if needed. 
Finish with coriander leaves. It can be served with idli/dosa.

title: High Protein Upma
cooking_instructions:
Dry roast the rava until it is lightly browned and aromatic, then set it aside. 
Add high protein paneer, baking soda, vinegar and water and blend into a smooth paste and set aside. 
In the same pan, pour oil, add mustard seeds and urad dal and let it splutter. 
Add in curry leaves, green chilli, and onions, and sauté until translucent. 
Add the chicken mince and saute for 3 minutes until cooked, add in the chopped vegetables and saute for 2 minutes. 
Add all the spice powders, salt and mix well, and cook until the raw flavour of the masala disappears. 
Add the paneer mixture, water and bring it to a boil. 
Add the roasted rava, coriander and mint, and mix thoroughly, and bring it to a boil.
Cover and let it cook on a low flame for 6-7 minutes or until fully cooked. 
Garnish with coriander and mint and serve hot.

title: Thakkali Halwa
cooking_instructions:
In a hot water pan, boil the tomatoes for 10 minutes.
Soak the dates in hot water for 5 minutes.
Now remove the skin from the tomatoes
Add them to a bowl along with the dates.
Mash both the tomatoes and dates together and keep it aside
In the same pan, using the remaining ghee, add the mashed tomato mixture and cook it for a while.
Now add sugar and a little water to the pan and mix it well until it reaches a jam-like consistency.
In a kadai, add ghee, cashews, and raisins. Sauté until they turn golden brown.
Take them out from the kadai and keep them aside.
Finally, add the fried cashews and raisins to it and serve it hot.

title: Nankhatai Cookies
cooking_instructions: Sieve the maida, besan and baking soda into a bowl. Add rava, salt and cardamom powder,  Add powdered sugar and whisk it  to combine evenly.
Add ghee and rub in the flour using your fingers. Form it into a soft dough.

Cover and rest the dough for 15 minutes in the refrigerator. Knead gently to smoothen the dough. Divide them into portions the size of a small lemon. If there is any difficulty in shaping the dough, add a few drops of cold milk and mix.
Slightly flatten the dough balls. Place in a baking tray and make slight dents in the centre of the cookies. Garnish with chopped nuts of your choice.
Bake in a preheated oven at 170c for 10-12 minutes or until slightly golden. Take the tray out of the oven and allow them to cool at room temperature to harden completely.

title: One Bowl Coffee Banana Cake
cooking_instructions: In the baking dish, add and mash 1 overripe banana.
Add the oil, milk, vanilla essence, and sugar. Mix well.

Add the maida and baking soda and mix roughly. 
Add the vinegar and mix well to activate the baking soda. 
Clean the side of the bowl.
In another bowl, mix some sugar and coffee powder. Sprinkle it on top.

Bake for 30 mins in a preheated oven, at 180 °C, or until a skewer comes out clean. 
Cool for 30 mins and then serve.

title: Muttai Mittai
cooking_instructions: In a kadhai, add the khoa, sugar, ghee, cream, saffron and let it cook on a medium flame until completely melted.
When the mixture is warm, break in three eggs, and whisk continuously on a low flame until the mixture is thickened.

Transfer the mixture into a lined tin and bake it at 180 degree celsius for 15-20 minutes. 
Let the mixture cool completely before cutting it into cubes and serving.

title: No-knead Focaccia
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, mix honey and water. Add the yeast and allow it to bloom for 5 mins. 
It should be bubbly.
In a bowl, mix honey and water. Add the yeast and allow it to bloom for 5 mins. 
It should be bubbly.
With wet hands, lift and fold the dough from 4-6 sides. Cover and rest for 30 mins. 
Repeat this process 3 more times, 30 mins apart. 
Transfer to a well-oiled baking tray. 
Allow to rise one final time for 30 mins.
Drizzle over olive oil, dimple the dough with your fingertips. 
Place any garnishes/ herbs or veggies. 
Bake in a preheated oven at 200-220 °C for 20-30 mins until golden brown. 
Take it out of the oven and brush over some oil on the crust. 
Rest for 15-20 mins before slicing.

title: Podi Chilli Nei Dosa Noodles
cooking_instructions:
Prepare 3 soft dosas, making sure they’re pliable. 
Cut the dosas into thin strips like noodles and set asid
In a bowl/ add all the ingredients for the chilli nei
Heat the ghee until very hot and pour it in the bowl. 
Mix thoroughly.
Add the dosa strips and mix thoroughly. 
Serve hot, with coconut chutney and more idly podi.

title: Carrot Caramel Custard
cooking_instructions:
Peel the carrots and pressure cook them until mushy. Grind it into a smooth paste, along with the milk
In a pan, on medium heat, caramelise ½ cup sugar till golden brown and pour it into the pudding mould. Swirl to coat the sides.
Preheat the steamer.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs and keep aside.
In a saucepan, combine the carrot puree and sugar. Heat till warm.
Add the milk mixture to the egg mixture, slowly and mix.
Add the vanilla essence and mix.
Strain the mixture and pour it into the molds.
Steam it for 15 mins or until a knife inserted comes out clean.
Chill it in the fridge and serve cold.

title: Kettle Chicken Kulambu
cooking_instructions:
In a kettle, add oil, and let it heat.
Add mustard seeds, let them splutter. Add curry leaves, green chilli.
Now add onion, ginger garlic paste, tomato and saute until it cooks.
Now add the chicken and some more Cookd Chicken Masala. Add ½ cup of water and let it simmer over medium heat for 15 mins or until the chicken is cooked. Adjust salt if needed. 
Finish with coriander leaves.

title: Jackfruit Seed Laddoo- Kuppai Series
cooking_instructions:
Wash and dry the jackfruit seeds
Roast it till, cool it down a bit and separate the outer skin.
Pulse the seeds.
Make the jaggery syrup, add the crushed jackfruit seeds and rest of the ingredients and mix well.
Shape it into laddoos and let it rest for a while.

title: Egg Thokku - Kettle
cooking_instructions:
In a Kettle, heat oil. Add mustard seeds and cumin seeds. Let it splutter.
Now add curry leaves and dry red chilli.
Add onion and saute until golden brown, about 10-12 mins, followed by green chilli.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute till the raw smell goes away.
Once the onions are golden brown, add the tomatoes and saute until soft.
Now add Cookd Kulambu Chilli Masala and mix. Add water to this and cook until the oil starts to separate.
Add boiled eggs and mix. 
Adjust salt if needed.
Finish with fresh coriander leaves.

title: Mutton Cutlet
cooking_instructions: Boil the potatoes whole with skin in salted water until they can be pierced easily with a fork. Peel the potatoes and mash them.
Pressure cook the mutton with ginger and salt for 3 whistles. Reduce the flame to low after the 1st whistle.
Coarsely mince the cooked mutton in a mixer or a food processor.
Heat oil in a pan and saute onion, ginger, curry leaves and green chilli. Add the cooked mutton and the potato. Add pepper, garam masala and salt. Saute until any excess moisture has evaporated.
Once the mixture has cooled slightly, shape the mixture into cutlets.
Dip the cutlets first in beaten eggs and then in breadcrumbs. Shallow fry until golden brown on both sides.

title: Cookd Paneer Masala
cooking_instructions:
In a bowl, marinate the paneer with the curd and Cookd chicken masala. 
In a cooking pan, heat oil and add the fennel seeds. 
Add the onions and fry till golden brown. Add the curry leaves. 
Add the ginger-garlic paste and saute till the raw flavour goes.
Cook till the oil separates, on a low flame, covered. 
Serve hot, garnished with more coriander leaves

title: Peri Peri Potato Wedges
cooking_instructions: Cut the potatoes into wedges and rinse them in cold water.
Add them to water and bring it to a boil with salt and baking soda. Bring to a boil and drain them.
Transfer them to a cloth and air dry completely.
Combine the ingredients in the spice mix to prepare the Piri Piri masala.
To the potatoes, add the cornflour and some of the spice mix and toss to mix well.
Deep fry them in medium hot oil until golden brown and crispy. Toss again in the spice mix and serve.

title: Veg Club Sandwich
cooking_instructions: Grill the bell peppers and zucchini with some oil, a pinch of salt, and black pepper powder.
Toast the bread slices until golden brown and crisp.
To assemble the sandwich, apply mayonnaise on the slices of toasted bread slices.
Place lettuce, tomato slices, cucumber and onion slices, place a slice of cheese. Season with a pinch of salt and pepper. Place the grilled bell peppers and zucchini.
Place slices of cheese. Season with salt and pepper.
Cover the top with a slice of toasted bread with mayonnaise. Cut the sandwich into the desired shape and serve with ketchup and potato chips/ french fries to make it a meal.

title: Creamy Mayo and Egg Sandwich
cooking_instructions: Make a fresh coleslaw by combining the mayonnaise with the vegetables,vinegar, mustard, salt and black pepper powder.
To make the creamy scrambled eggs, whisk the eggs until foamy with salt and black pepper powder.
Heat a pan on low heat and add the butter, once melted pour the eggs and stir gently using a spatula. When the eggs have almost set, turn off the flame and add a tbsp of cream. Mix well.

To layer, lightly butter both sides of the bread slices. On a slice of bread place some coleslaw and egg mixture top with another slice of bread and trim off the crust. Cut into required shapes and serve with potato chips/ketchup.

title: Mango Kheer
cooking_instructions: In a mixer grinder, add the mango pulp, water and grind it to extract the mango puree.
Heat Ghee in a pan, add the vermicelli and roast for 2 mins on low heat
Add milk, bring it to a boil and simmer until the vermicelli is completely cooked. This should take around 12-15 mins
Add sugar and cardamom powder, mix well to dissolve the sugar and remove from heat.
Once the mixture cools down completely and comes to room temperature, add the mango puree. Mix well. Serve chilled, garnished with mango chunks, almond and pista flakes.

title: Cheese Balls
cooking_instructions: Cook the potatoes in a pressure cooker for 6 whistles with 2 cups of water. Remove the skin and mash the potatoes and allow it to cool.
Add the mashed potato to a bowl. Grate the cheddar cheese, mozzarella cheese and add it to the same bowl.
Add fresh cream, salt, red chilli powder, red chilli flakes and dried rosemary.
Mix all this into a dough. Divide this into even-sized balls and keep aside.
For breading the cheese balls, crack two eggs in a bowl and whisk, take 2 cups of flour in another bowl, take panko crumbs in another bowl.

Dust the cheese balls in flour and dip that in the egg mixture, coat it with panko crumbs, again dip this in the egg and coat it with panko crumbs. Double coating it will give extra crispiness and will prevent the cheese from oozing out.
Heat oil in a pan for deep-frying the cheese balls. Drop the cheese balls one by one into the oil and deep fry it until the outside is golden brown.

title: Restaurant Style Butter Chicken
cooking_instructions: Add the curd and the list of ingredients under marinade to the cleaned and washed chicken pieces. Let it marinate for 60 mins.
Score a cross using a knife on the bottom and top side of the tomatoes and cook it in boiling water for 45 seconds to remove the skin. Blend the tomatoes in a mixer grinder to make tomato puree
Heat oil in a pan or a normal pan and cook the chicken until it is done
Add tomato puree in a frying pan and cook it for 5 mins until most of the water has evaporated.
Add butter and chilli powder and cook for 1 more minute.. Then add Kasuri methi, salt, and garam masala powder, after 30 seconds, add fresh cream and stir.
The gravy is now ready, add the chicken pieces and serve immediately.

title: Chicken Keema
cooking_instructions: In a mixer grinder, add the tomatoes and grind it into smooth to extract the tomato puree.
Heat oil in a pan, add bay leaf, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, cumin seeds and saute.
Add green chilli, onion and saute till it gets golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste, turmeric powder, Kashmiri red chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder, salt, and saute for a minute.
Add the extracted tomato puree and cook for 3 mins.
Add the chicken mince and cook till the water is evaporated.
Add 1 ½ Cups of water, cover and simmer for 10 mins or until it reaches the desired consistency.
Add black pepper powder, coriander leaves, mix well and remove from the heat.

title: Mutton Tawa Fry
cooking_instructions: In a pan, heat 2 tsp of oil. Add the thinly sliced onions and continue to saute until the onions are golden brown and crispy. Set the yielded fried onions aside.

In a pressure cooker, add the washed and cleaned mutton pieces, turmeric powder, Kashmir chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder, ginger-garlic paste, salt, fried onion, curd and water. Mix well. Pressure cook the mutton for 6 whistles.
Once the pressure settles, open the pan and continue to cook on a medium flame until most of the water evaporates.
In another Tawa or pan, add oil, finely chopped onions, sliced green chili, curry leaves, and saute until the onions are translucent.
Add the cooked mutton pieces. Continue to saute the mutton pieces on a medium flame for 7 mins.
Add the black pepper powder, salt and garam masala powder. Cook for 2 mins. Remove from the heat and serve as an appetizer.

title: Bread Halwa
cooking_instructions: Chop the bread into cubes after removing the crust of the bread. Keep Aside.

In a Kadai, add 2 tbsp of Ghee. Once the ghee is hot, add the cashews and then the raisins. Roast until the cashews are golden brown and until the raisins puff up. Remove them from the pan and set aside.
To the same Kadai add the chopped bread cubes and continue to roast, stirring at intervals until the bread turns crispy and golden brown in colour.
Add sugar to the Kadai and continue to mix.
Add milk and stir until the sugar is dissolved. Simmer this on low flame until the bread absorbs the milk and starts to thicken.
Keep stirring until everything comes together and then add 2 tbsp of ghee amd cardamom powder.
Mix well until all the ghee is absorbed. Add the roasted cashew and raisins and continue to mix until ghee separates from the halwa mixture. Remove from the heat and serve hot.

title: Egg Bird's Nest
cooking_instructions: In a pressure cooker, add 2 cups of water and potatoes. Pressure cook for 6 whistles. Once the pressure settles down, remove the potatoes, peel the skin and mash them. Set this aside.
Grind the ginger and green chilli adding some water into a fine paste to prepare the ginger green chilli paste.

Bring 2 Cup of water to a boil, add the eggs and cook them for 9 mins. Remove from the heat, cool the eggs and remove the shells.Cut the eggs into half and remove the egg yolks and keep the egg yolks aside.
Mix the maida and water to form maida paste.
In a saucepan, add 1 cup of water, green peas and cook for 3 mins. Drain the green peas and set aside.
In a bowl, add cooked green peas, onion, red chilli powder, dry mango powder and salt. Mix well.
Place this peas mixture inside the eggs in the place of egg yolks. Apply the maida paste on the inner side of the eggs and stick vertically cut eggs together.
Take the mashed potatoes, add salt, ginger green chilli paste, garam masala and the egg yolks that were set aside. Mix well.
Coat the egg with the mashed potato mixture. Form into a ball and ensure the potato mixture is evenly distributed around the eggs.
In a bowl beat the remaining 2 eggs. In another bowl, take the vermicelli. Coat the egg potato ball with the beaten egg and then roll it in the vermicelli.
In a deep frying pot, add oil. Once the oil is hot, deep fry this until golden brown or for around 3 mins. Cut the balls into half and serve it with tomato ketchup.

title: Kurkuri Bhindi
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl, add the besan flour, rice flour, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt, asafoetida and mix well.
To the thinly sliced lady’s finger, squeeze the juice of half a lemon and toss well.
Mix well as the masalas get coated to it. Sprinkle some water, if needed.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan.Once the oil is hot, add the strips of lady’s finger one by one. Fry until it turns golden brown by keeping the flame on medium.
Drain from the oil and toss with dry mango powder.

title: Kerala Milk Cake
cooking_instructions: Boil the sugar and water together until completely melted. Set aside.
For the dough, combine the egg with the ghee. Add the baking soda, salt and cardamom powder.
Add the flour and milk powder. Mix into a dough, adding water a few drops at a time until it is similar to Chapathi dough. Knead well until smooth.
Roll out the dough into ½ inch thickness. Cut the edges to form a rectangle. Cut into small rectangle shapes.
Deep-fry on medium-low flame until golden brown.
Immediately transfer them to the warm sugar syrup. Allow them to soak for 10-15 minutes.

title: Chicken Kosha
cooking_instructions: For the marination, mix all the ingredients with the chicken and marinate for 30 minutes at least.
Heat the mustard oil in a pan. Add the potatoes and fry until golden brown. Remove it from the pan.
In the same oil, add all the whole spices and onion. Add salt and sugar. Saute until it turns golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for 1 minute or till the raw smell goes away.
In a bowl, combine all the spice powders with water to form a paste.
Add this to the pan. Add the tomato puree. Saute for 5 minutes or until the oil starts to separate from the sides.
Add the marinated chicken and saute for 3 minutes. Cover and cook for 10 minutes on a low flame.
Add the fried potatoes. Cover and cook again for 10 minutes or until the potatoes are completely cooked through.
Add garam masala, green chilli and ghee. Mix well and take it off the heat.

title: Fluffy Honey Cake
cooking_instructions: Preheat an oven to 180C.Line a bread mold with parchment paper.
Whisk 4 egg whites with the sugar added in additions until it holds stiff peaks, Add the vanilla essence also.
Add the egg yolks and whisk for a minute until it has a ribbon like consistency.
Sift and add the maida and the baking powder. Fold the mixture gently until well combined.
Heat the milk, honey and oil until warm.
Add some of the cake batter in the same bowl and mix well. Add it back into the batter and mix thoroughly, quickly.
Transfer to the mold and swirl around a skewer for uniformity of the batter and bake at 180C for 10 mins and 150C for 40-45 mins.
For the syrup heat the water, sugar and honey until completely dissolved.
Cool the cake completely, soak in the syrup once completely cooled. Dust with powdered sugar and slice into thick pieces.

title: French Toast
cooking_instructions: Whisk all the ingredients for the egg mixture together.
Dip the bread in the mixture. Melt butter in a pan. Toast the bread on medium heat until golden brown on both sides.

title: Laal Maas
cooking_instructions: Soak the red chillies in hot water for 30 minutes. Grind it into a paste.
Marinate the mutton with ginger garlic paste, salt, coriander powder, cumin powder and garam masala. Add the chilli paste. Marinate for at least 1 hour. It can also be marinated till overnight.
Heat ghee in a pressure cooker and add the whole spices (green cardamom, black cardamom, bayleaf, cinnamon, mace). Add the whole peeled garlic and onion. Saute until it turns golden brown in colour.
Add the marinated mutton and saute for 5 minutes. Add the curd and mix well. Add water.
Put the lid on and pressure cook for 30 minutes on medium-low heat.

Optionally, you can infuse a smoked flavour into the dish. Heat a charcoal over the stove until it turns gray/white and is hot. Place a metal bowl in the Laal Maas and place the hot charcoal in it. Add the cloves and ghee. Cover and let it sit for 4 minutes.

title: Chicken Shawarma
cooking_instructions: Pour the curd into a muslin cloth, and refrigerate for 2-3 hours.

For the dough, pour 1 cup of lukewarm water in a bowl. Make sure that the water is not too hot, as this will prevent the yeast from rising. Add the yeast and sugar to the water. Let it sit for 10 minutes. After 10 minutes, it will have risen a little and there will be a few bubbles on the surface. If not, the Yeast might be old or expired.
Combine the maida, whole wheat flour and salt in a large bowl. Add the oil, and mix it into the flour.
Add the wet yeast mixture into the flour. Mix it to form a rough dough
Transfer to a floured work surface and knead well until a smooth dough forms.
Cover with a damp cloth and rest for 2 hours in a warm, dry place.

To make the marinade for the chicken, mix the hung curd, lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, salt, white pepper powder, cumin powder, garam masala and ½ cup of garlic mayonnaise. Add the chicken pieces and mix well. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour, or up to overnight.
Cook the chicken on a heated and greased grill pan or a Tawa. Cook for approximately 6 minutes. Flip and cook until the chicken is cooked through, around 12 minutes.
Remove from heat and cut into small pieces.
Divide the dough into equal-sized portions. Using enough flour, roll out the dough a little thicker than a Roti. Do not leave the dough uncovered for too long, as it can become dry.
Cook on a heated Tawa until small bubbles start to appear. Flip and cook again till it starts puffing up while pressing gently.
Remove from heat and cover with a cloth.
Mix the sliced tomato and sliced onion together.
To assemble the shawarma, spread garlic mayonnaise on the Khubz/Pita. Place some of the chicken, along with the sliced onion and tomato. Form into a roll, and serve hot!

title: Kurkure Paneer
cooking_instructions: Combine the dry ingredients in a bowl.
Cut the paneer into small dices. Add the paneer and the ginger garlic paste.
Mix to coat, sprinkle the water to help the coating to stick to the paneer cubes. The cubes must be free, not sticking to each other.
Fry them in hot oil until crispy, add the pieces individually.
Toss with chaat masala before serving.

title: Matar Paneer Gravy
cooking_instructions: In a pan, heat 1 tbsp of oil, add sliced onions and saute until the onions turn golden brown.
Add the chopped garlic and ginger. Saute for a min. Add the chopped tomatoes and cook until the tomatoes are soft and mushy.
Cool this mixture down and grind it into a smooth paste using a mixer grinder.
In a pan, add 2 tbsp of oil. Once the oil is hot, add Bay leaf and cumin seeds. Allow the cumin seeds to splutter. Add green chillies.
Add Kashmiri Chilli Powder, Coriander powder, Turmeric Powder, Garam Masala Powder and 2 tbsp of water. Cook the spices for a minute.
Add the onion tomato paste and cook for 3 mins.
Add 1 ¾ Cup of water and salt. Add the green peas, cover the pan and cook for 6 mins.
Add the paneer cubes and cook for 2 mins. Add coriander leaves, mix well, remove from the heat.Serve hot with roti/paratha/phulka.

title: Noodles Omelette
cooking_instructions: Bring 2 cups of water to a boil in a pan, add the Instant noodles, tastemaker and cook for 5 mins or until all the water is absorbed and the noodles are cooked.
Cool the cooked noodles until it reaches room temperature. Add finely chopped onions, green chilli, coriander leaves, eggs, red chilli powder and salt. Mix well.
Heat a non-stick frying pan. Scoop the eggs mixed with Maggi using a ladle and pour it on the non-stick pan. Add some oil to the sides of the pan.
Flip and cook on the other side too. Serve hot with tomato ketchup.

title: Schezwan Veg Fried Rice
cooking_instructions: Wash and Soak the Basmati Rice for 30 mins.
Cook the Basmati rice in an open pot with 1 litre of water and ¼ tsp of salt. Once the rice is 80% done, drain the water and let the rice cool completely.
In a pan, add oil, butter, finely chopped garlic cloves, red torn into half, finely chopped onions, carrots, beans and capsicum. Saute this for 3 mins.
Add the Schezwan sauce and continue to saute for another 1 minute. Add the cooked rice to the pan.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper.
Increase the flame to high and stir fry the rice by tossing it. Add the spring onion and celery leaves and continue to stir fry. Remove from heat and serve hot.

title: Paneer Jalfrezi
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and let them crackle. Add dried red chillies, garlic and ginger.
Add onions and all the spice powders and salt. Add tomato ketchup and mix well.
Turn the flame to high and add all the other vegetables and saute for 2 minutes.
Add the paneer, vinegar, and coriander leaves. Mix well and turn off the heat.

title: Chicken Pakora
cooking_instructions: Cut the chicken into small dices. In the same bowl, add the powdered spices, cumin seeds, chopped coriander leaves, green chilli, salt and ghee. Mix to marinate well. Set aside for 20 mins.
Make a thick batter of besan, ajwain, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, salt, baking powder with water. Whisk until smooth.
Heat oil to medium heat. Dip the pieces of chicken in the batter and deep fry until golden brown and crispy.
Sprinkle with chaat masala and serve with lemon wedges.

title: Mushroom Xacuti
cooking_instructions: Dry roast all the spices until aromatic.
Dry roast the coconut with the garlic and poppy seeds for 3-5 mins.
Blend the spices and coconut with the garlic with half a cup of water into a smooth paste.
Heat oil and brown the onions.
Add the mushrooms, turmeric and salt and saute well. Add the tamarind pulp. Add the ground paste.
Add 1 cup of water and simmer for 5 mins. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve warm with pav or rice.

title: Kashmiri Dum Aloo
cooking_instructions: Pressure cook the potatoes for 1 whistle. Peel the baby potatoes and prick them with a fork.
In a bowl, combine curd, fennel powder, dry ginger powder, coriander powder and Kashmiri red chilli powder into a smooth paste.
Fry the potatoes until they turn golden brown.
Heat the mustard oil in a pan until it reaches its smoking point. Turn off the flame and allow it to cool slightly. Turn the heat back on and add black cardamom, cinnamon, cumin seeds and asafoetida.
On a very low flame, add the curd mixture and stir continuously until the oil floats on top. Add cashew paste for extra richness.
Add salt and water and bring it to a boil. Add the fried potatoes, cover and cook on a low flame for 10 minutes. Add coriander leaves, mix well and serve.

title: Paneer Pulao
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak basmati rice for 20 mins.
Heat ghee in a pan, add paneer cubes and fry till it turns golden brown. Keep aside.
In the same ghee, add bay leaf, cloves, green chilli, onion and saute for 2 mins, or until the onion turns translucent.
Add green peas and carrot. Cook for 2 mins. Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder and saute till the masalas get cooked.
Add the water and salt. Bring it to a boil.
Add the rice and boil until the level of the rice almost reaches the level of the water.
Pour coconut milk evenly over the rice. Add the fried paneer pieces on top along with coriander leaves. Cover tightly and cook on a very low flame for 12 minutes.

title: Lemon Coriander Soup
cooking_instructions: Heat butter in a pan, add garlic, ginger, onion and saute for 2 mins.
Add cabbage, carrot, coriander stem and saute for a minute.
Add Water, salt and simmer for 3 mins.
Mix cornflour with water to prepare a slurry. Add the prepared corn flour and water slurry, mix well and simmer for 3 mins.
Add black pepper powder, lemon juice, coriander leaves, mix well and remove from heat. Healthy Lemon Coriander Soup is ready to be served.

title: Honey Chilli Meatballs
cooking_instructions: Combine the ingredients for the meatballs and mix thoroughly.
Rest the meat for 20 mins, refrigerated.
Divide into small roundels with greased hands.
Combine the ketchup, soya sauce, honey and salt in a bowl for the sauce.
Pan-fry them until cooked through, around 10 mins.
For the preparation, heat oil in a wok. And add the garlic and saute until golden. Add the chilli flakes and mix well.
Add the sauce mix and bring to a boil. And add the chicken meatballs.
Toss well to coat thoroughly.
Finish with chopped spring onion greens and sesame seeds.

title: Baby Corn Manchurian
cooking_instructions: Slit the baby corn in 2, and then cut them into 1-inch pieces.
Coat the baby corn in 2 tbsp cornstarch, maida, ½ tsp salt and chilli powder. Sprinkle a few drops of water, to help the flour coat the baby corn pieces.
Deep fry in oil until golden. Set them aside.
In another pan, heat 2 tbsp oil and fry the chopped garlic and ginger. Add diced onion and capsicum. Cook them for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce, red chilli sauce, tomato ketchup, pepper powder and ½ tsp of salt. Add ¼ cup of water and cook it for 2 minutes.
Mix ½ tbsp of cornstarch with 2 tbsp of water and pour this paste into the pan. This will help to get a thick and glossy sauce.
Immediately add the fried baby corn and mix. Turn off the heat and serve hot.

title: Dal Makhani
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the black urad dal and rajma for 8 hours to overnight.

Drain the water and pressure cook the black urad dal and rajma with 4 cups of water and 1 tsp of salt for 30 mins on low heat. (Approximately 15-20 whistles). Once the pressure releases naturally, open and mash the rajma and black urad dal using a potato masher. Keep aside.
Using a mixer grinder, grind the tomatoes to prepare tomato puree.
In another Kadai, heat butter, add finely chopped onions, garam masala and saute the onions until golden brown. Add the ginger-garlic paste and cook until the raw smell leaves.
Add the tomato puree and cook until the tomatoes are cooked well and oil starts to separate from the masala.
Add the red chilli powder, salt and sugar. Add the cooked and mashed dal mixture.
Add 2 cups of water and let the dal simmer for 30 minutes on medium-low heat.
Add 1 tbsp of butter, Kasuri methi and ¼ cup of cream, mix well and simmer for 5 more minutes. Remove the Kadai from the heat.
