For the smoky flavour, burn one piece of charcoal in flame, put in a steel bowl which is placed on top of the dal and add 1 tsp of ghee. Once the smoke starts to emit from the charcoal, close the dal with a lid and allow it to smoke for 2 minutes.
Remove the charcoal and steel bowl. Serve the dal hot with rice/roti, garnishing it with more cream and butter.

title: Vegetable Stew
cooking_instructions: Grind the grated coconut with ¾ Cup of Water into a smooth paste. Pass the ground mixture through a sieve and extract thick coconut milk. Keep Aside.
Grind the residue after extracting thick coconut milk again with 2 cups of water. Pass the ground mixture through a sieve and extract thick coconut milk. Keep Aside.
Heat 1 tbsp of coconut oil in a Kadai. Add Cinnamon, Cardamom, Cloves and Black Pepper. Allow the spices to splutter.
Add the finely chopped Garlic and Juliennes of Ginger and saute. Add the thinly sliced onions, green chilli and curry leaves. Cook until the onions are translucent.
Add the cubed vegetables and saute for 2 minutes.
Add the thin coconut milk and salt. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Once the vegetables are cooked, add the thick coconut milk and simmer for 3 mins. Remove from heat and serve hot with Appam or Idiyappam.

title: Orange Chicken
cooking_instructions: Cut chicken thighs into cubes. Add salt , pepper, egg, cornstarch and flour, mix well to coat evenly.
Fry in batches until golden brown.
Double fry the chicken for 2 minutes in hot oil.
Juice two oranges and set them aside.
Prepare the sauce mixture by adding the orange juice, grate in the ginger and garlic, add the soy sauce, vinegar and sugar.
Heat oil and saute cashew nuts, Bring the sauce to a boil in a wok and add the cornstarch slurry and stir continuously.
Cook until the sauce has thickened, then add in the crispy chicken. Garnish with spring onions, orange slices, sesame seeds.

title: Apollo Fish Fry
cooking_instructions: Mix the fish pieces along with ginger garlic paste, lemon juice, salt, red chilli powder, turmeric powder and black pepper powder.
Add the egg, cornstarch and maida. Mix well to coat the fish evenly.
Deep-fry the fish for 4-5 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
In another pan, heat oil and add ginger, garlic and green chilli.
Add Kashmiri chilli powder, pepper powder, coriander powder, soy sauce curd and red chilli sauce. Mix well to combine everything together.
Add salt, curry leaves and the fried fish pieces into the pan. Add coriander leaves and lemon juice. Toss well and serve hot!

title: Garlic Mushroom
cooking_instructions: Use a flat pan for this recipe. Heat oil and butter. Add onions and saute until translucent.
Add the mushrooms into the pan. If the mushrooms are too big, cut them in half.
Let them cook on high heat. When they start to change colour, stir them gently and add the garlic.Allow them to cook for a few more minutes until they turn golden brown on all sides.
Add the salt, black pepper powder, soy sauce, lemon juice and coriander leaves. Toss gently and serve.

title: Lemon Pepper Chicken Wings
cooking_instructions: In a pan, combine the butter, lemon zest, grated garlic, salt and pepper.
Heat over a low flame for 4-5 minutes.
Turn off the heat and then add coriander leaves and lemon juice. Set aside the sauce.

Make sure the chicken wings are completely dry without any water. You can dry them with a kitchen towel to ensure that they are completely dry. Marinate the chicken with all the ingredients for the marination.
Coat each piece of chicken with the cornstarch evenly.
Deep-fry in oil on medium-low heat for 5 minutes. Remove the chicken from the oil.
Heat the same oil to high heat. Add the chicken back into the oil and deep-fry on high heat for 3 minutes or until golden brown and crisp.
Remove the chicken into a large bowl. Toss with the previously prepared sauce until evenly coated. Serve hot!

title: Fish Koliwada
cooking_instructions: Marinate the fish cubes with lemon juice, ginger garlic paste, salt, turmeric powder, cumin powder and kashmiri chilli powder. Marinate for 15 minutes.
Add the besan, ajwain, rice flour and baking soda. Mix well to coat the fish pieces evenly.
Make sure the oil is very hot before frying. Add the fish and once it forms a crust, reduce the heat to medium-low. Fry for around 5 minutes depending on the size of the fish pieces.
Remove onto a bowl/plate. Add the red chilli powder and chaat masala. Mix well. Serve garnished with coriander sprigs and lemon slices.

title: Chicken Liver Pepper Fry
cooking_instructions: Marinate the chicken liver with all the marination ingredients for at least 15 minutes.
Heat gingelly oil in a pan and add fennel seeds. When they start to splutter, add curry leaves, green chilli and shallots.

When the shallots turn translucent, add the ginger garlic paste and saute until the raw smell disappears, around 1-2 minutes. Add the marinated chicken liver and saute on high heat for 2 minutes. Reduce the flame to medium and continue cooking for 8 to 10 minutes or until the liver is cooked. Keep stirring occasionally.
Finish with black pepper powder and coriander leaves. Mix well and serve!

title: Parsi Akuri
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan and add the onions, garlic and green chilli. Saute until it turns translucent.
Add the tomatoes and all the powdered spices and salt. Cook for 3 minutes. Add the coriander leaves and stir.
Add the eggs on low heat. Stir continuously until it starts to thicken. Before it turns completely solid and while it is still runny, turn off the heat.
Add cold butter. Keep mixing it until the butter melts and the eggs turn creamy. Serve along with toast with butter/ghee or with roti.

title: Chicken Pepper Soup
cooking_instructions: Dry roast and grind peppercorns and jeera into a powder and keep aside
In a pressure cooker, add gingelly oil and finely chopped shallots and saute for 2 minutes on medium heat
Crush the ginger and garlic in a pestle and mortar and add it to the pressure cooker, cook until raw smell goes
Add the chopped tomato and cook for another 30 seconds.
Now add the washed and cleaned chicken with bones to the pan.
Add turmeric powder, salt and the ground powder, cook for 3 more minutes.
Add 750 ml of water and pressure cook for 6-7 whistles or 12 minutes.
Open the pan, add pepper powder, garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Baby Potato Fry
cooking_instructions: Bring 4 cups of water to a boil.
In a pan cook the baby potatoes in water for 12 mins.
Remove the skin of the potatoes and keep aside.
In a pan dry roast, all the ingredients mentioned under Dry roast and grind. In a mixer grinder grind this to into a powder.
In another pan, heat oil, add mustard seeds, urad dal, asafoetida, curry leaves.
Add the cooked baby potatoes and saute for 2 mins.
Add the powdered masala and continue to stir fry on a medium flame until the masala is coated well on the potatoes and the potatoes are roasted well. This should take about 5 mins.

title: McDonalds Filet-o-fish
cooking_instructions: For the sauce, combine all the ingredients together in a bowl.

Cut the fish fillet into squares that are approximately 3x3 inches. Dredge the seasoned fish pieces in Maida. Combine the egg, mayonnaise and mustard together. Dip the fish in this mixture and then coat with breadcrumbs.
Fry in oil until golden brown, around 4-6 minutes depending on the thickness of the fish pieces.
Spread butter on both halves of the burger bun. Toast until golden brown.
Assemble the burger with the cheese slice, the fried fish patty and then the tartar sauce on top.

title: Lazy Noodles
cooking_instructions: Add the water, soya sauce, honey, nut butter and red chilli flakes in a pan and bring to a boil.
Thicken the sauce with cornstarch mixed in ¼ Cup of water.
Add the sesame seeds and lemon juice. Add the boiled noodles and mix well.
Finish with chopped spring onion greens.

title: Papdi
cooking_instructions: Mix the salt and ajwain with the maida. Add the ghee and rub it into the flour using your hands.
Add water gradually and knead until you get a stiff dough.
Cover with a damp cloth and rest for 10 minutes.
Roll out into sheets thicker than a chapathi.
Prick it with a fork. Cut out into the desired size.
Deep fry on a medium flame until golden brown and crisp.
It can be eaten by itself or also served as Papdi Chaat.

title: Bhel Puri
cooking_instructions: Add the puffed rice, vegetables, peanuts and crushed papdi.
Add the chutneys, sev and spices. Season it. Mix all the ingredients together until well combined. Serve immediately.

title: Fruit Chaat
cooking_instructions: Cut the desired fruits into dices and add them to a bowl. To the fruits, add the powdered spices.
Add the chopped mint leaves and squeeze the juice of half a lemon. Mix well but gently to combine thoroughly.
To half the fruits, add powdered sugar and half a cup of cream and mix well to make a creamy version of fruit chaat.
The plain fruit chaat can be topped with tamarind chutney and served.

title: Nachos
cooking_instructions: Combine the wheat flour, corn flour and salt. Add the vinegar and water and knead a semi hard dough.
Apply oil on the dough and rest it for 15 mins, covered.
Roll out the dough into flat circles and make holes on the tortilla with a fork.
Cook them half way through on a tava and cut them into triangles.
Fry the triangles in medium hot oil until golden brown and crispy. Toss with salt and paprika to season.

title: Malvani Egg Masala
cooking_instructions: Soak the tamarind in ¼ cup of water, extract juice from the soaked tamarind and keep aside.
Cook the eggs in 3 cups of water for 10 mins.
Drain the water and peel the eggs, halve them and keep the eggs aside.
Using a mixer grinder, grind the tomatoes to prepare tomato puree.
In a pan, add all the ingredients under “Malvani Masala Powder” one by one and dry roast it for 2 mins.
Once cool, add it to a mixer grinder and grind it into a fine powder.
Heat oil in a pan, add sliced onion, saute till it starts turning golden brown on medium heat.
Add cashew and coconut, and grind into a smooth paste. Set it aside.
Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds, green chilli, ginger-garlic paste, curry leaves and saute until the raw smell goes.
Add the ground paste and cook for a minute, then add the red chilli powder, turmeric powder, Malvani masala powder, coriander powder, salt and cook until the oil separates from the curry.
Add tomato puree and cook until the oil separates from the gravy.
Add tamarind juice, 1 cup of water, mix well and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the slit boiled eggs, mix well and simmer for another 5 minutes.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot with rice/roti.

title: Chicken Lollipop
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, add 2 tsp of soy sauce, ginger garlic paste, black pepper powder, red chilli powder, salt, and egg. Mix everything together.
Add the chicken lollipop pieces to the same bowl and mix well.
Add cornflour and maida to the same bowl. Add 2 tbsp of water and mix until a batter is formed around the lollipop pieces.
n a deep-frying pan, heat oil and deep-fry, the battered lollipop pieces for 7 mins or until a crispy coating is formed outside and the chicken is cooked well.
In a pan add 2 tsp of oil, add the finely chopped onion and saute for 1 minute.
Add the finely chopped ginger and garlic. Continue to saute for 30 seconds.
Add red chilli sauce, tomato sauce, soy sauce, black pepper powder, and salt.
Add 2 tbsp of water and continue to cook for one minute. And 1 tbsp Spring Onions to it.
Reduce the flame to low and add the deep-fried lollipop pieces. Toss until the sauce coats the lollipop pieces.
Wrap the bone part with aluminum foil. Garnish with chopped spring onions. and serve hot.

title: Baby Corn Masala
cooking_instructions: Cook the baby corn with 2 cups of water in a saucepan for 6 mins and strain the water using a strainer. Keep aside.
Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds, curry leaves, ginger, garlic, onion and saute until it turns golden brown.
Add tomatoes and cook till it gets soft.
Add Cashew nuts, red chilli powder, garam masala powder and cook till the raw smell goes.
Cool the mixture. Blend it along with ½ cup of water to a paste using a mixer grinder.
Heat oil in a pan, add cloves, cinnamon, cumin seeds, baby corn and saute for 2 minutes.
Add 1 ½ tsp of salt, the ground paste,1 cups of water, cover and cook for 7 minutes.
Add Kasuri methi and stir well on medium flame until it reaches the gravy consistency. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot with rice/paratha/pulao.

title: Sprout Salad
cooking_instructions: Add the black chickpeas to a glass jar. Add water to cover them by 3 inches and cover the glass jar with a cheesecloth bound by a thread knot/rubber band.
Repeat the same with black-eyed peas and mung bean in separate jars.
Allow them to soak for 24 hrs.

On the next day, rinse the chickpeas well and strain the water and place them back into the jar, making sure that they are moist but not overly drenched. Cover the glass jar again with cheesecloth bound by a thread knot/rubber band.
Repeat the same steps with the other two sprouts as well.
Repeat the same step till they are sprouted. Usually, this takes 2 to 3 days.
Pressure cook the black-eyed peas and black chickpeas in 2 cups of water by adding ½ tsp of salt for 2 whistles.
Once cool, strain the water using a strainer.
Add the cooked black-eyed peas, black chickpeas, sprouted mung bean in a mixing bowl and mix well. Add onion, tomato, capsicum, pomegranate, green chilli and mix it.
Add another ½ salt, black pepper powder, lemon juice, coriander leaves and mix well.Healthy Salad is ready to serve.

title: Banana Oatmeal Muffins
cooking_instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C (400 F).
Mash the bananas using the potato masher.
In a small bowl, mix the Maida, Wheat Flour, Sugar, Baking Soda, Oats, Baking Powder and salt together.
In another bowl add milk, vinegar and mix well.
In a large bowl, crack the egg, add, Oil, vanilla essence, mashed banana and mix well using a hand mixer.
Add the milk and vinegar mixture and mix.
Mix the dry ingredients and wet ingredients together.

Grease butter in each muffin mould. Pour ¼ cup of batter into each muffin mould, bake for 18-20 mins till the tops are golden brown and the centre is done. Cool in the mould for 5 mins and then leave them to cool completely on a wire rack. Enjoy!

title: Nethili Fry
cooking_instructions: Remove the head, clean and wash the Anchovies and pat dry.

In a mixing bowl, add ginger garlic paste, lemon juice, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, pepper powder, garam masala powder, salt, maida, cornflour, rice flour, chopped curry leaves and mix together to form a thick batter.
Add the clean anchovies to the batter. Mix and coat each piece of the fish with the batter.
In a deep frying pan, heat oil necessary to deep fry the anchovies. Once the oil is hot, deep fry the anchovies in batches. Serve hot with a lemon wedge and onion rings.

title: Beetroot Chutney
cooking_instructions: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan, add the dried red chillies, tamarind and fry it lightly.
Add the shredded beetroot and salt to the pan. Saute the beetroot on a high flame for 10 mins till it's cooked.
Coarse grind the cooked beetroot with ¼ cup of water using a mixer grinder. Transfer this to the serving dish.
Heat a pan and add 2 tbsp oil. When the oil is heated up, add urad dal and fry till it turns golden brown.

Add the thalipu vadam and curry leaves. Once the leaves are lightly fried, add asafoetida. Add this tempering to the Chutney. Mix it well with the ground chutney. Serve it with hot idlis, dosas and as a dip with any other finger food.

title: Tawa Chicken
cooking_instructions: Cut the chicken into strips.
Marinate with the ingredients mentioned under marinade.
Grind the tomatoes in a mixer grinder to make tomato puree.
In a Tawa, heat butter and add the marinated chicken pieces. Cook for 2 mins and remove the chicken from the Tawa and set aside.
In the same Tawa, add oil. Once the oil is hot, add the cumin seeds and carom seeds. When the spices splutter, add the onions and saute until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste, green chillies, chopped capsicum and stir fry for 2 minutes.
Add red chilli powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, curd and salt. Cook this for a minute.
Add the tomato puree and cook for another 3 minutes.
Add the cooked chicken strips and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the garam masala powder, lemon juice and Kasuri methi and saute for 2 mins.
Add the coriander leaves, mix well and remove from the heat. Serve hot with roti/naan/chapati.

title: Egg Dum Biryani
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the basmati rice for 30 mins.
Heat 2 tsp of Ghee in a pan, add ¼ tsp red chilli powder, ¼ tsp cumin powder. Add the boiled eggs and stir fry them. Once the eggs are reddish-brown on all sides, remove them from the pan.
In the same pan crack two eggs, add ¼ tsp of salt and a pinch of pepper and scramble the eggs. Remove the scrambled eggs and keep aside.
In a biryani pot, add 2 tsp oil and 1 thinly sliced onion. Saute this until the onions are golden brown. Remove the fried onions and keep aside.
In the same pot, add 1 tbsp of oil, ghee. Add bay leaves, cinnamon, cloves and cardamom.
Add 3 thinly sliced onions and saute until the onions are translucent.
Add the slit green chilli and ginger garlic paste and continue cooking.
Add the tomatoes and cook until the tomatoes are mushy.
Add the turmeric powder, 2 tsp of red chilli powder, garam masala powder, salt and cook the masala.
Add ¼ cup of curd to this pot and continue cooking until the oil separates from the masala.
Add the basmati rice to the pot and add 3 cups of water. Cook this for 15 min or until most of the water is absorbed by the rice.
Add the masala coated boiled egg to the biryani pot and mix. Top the biryani with the fried onions, scrambled eggs and seal the biryani pot with dough or aluminium foil.
Place the biryani pot on a Tawa and dum cook on low heat for 10 mins. Remove from the heat, fluff the rice and serve hot with raita.

title: Mutton Boti Fry
cooking_instructions: Dry roast all the ingredients under dry roast and grind except garlic and ginger.
Transfer the roasted spices along with ginger, garlic and grind into a smooth paste adding ½ Cup of water.
Grind the onion and tomato in a mixer grinder and keep aside.
In a pressure cooker add the mutton intestine, onion-tomato paste, spice paste, turmeric powder and salt to taste.
Pressure cook this adding 3 cups of water for 10 whistles. Keep the cooked intestine aside.
In another pan, heat 2 tbsp of oil, add mustard seeds, fennel seeds and allow it to splutter. Add the shallots, pound garlic and saute until the shallots are translucent.
Add the curry leaves. Add the cooked intestine from the pressure cooker and continue to simmer for 5 mins.
Add chopped coriander leaves, mix well and remove from the heat. Serve hot with rice or idly.

title: Fish Fingers
cooking_instructions: Cut the fish fillet into 2 inch long strips.
In a mixing bowl, take the fish strips, add ginger garlic paste, chopped garlic, lemon juice, salt, pepper and dried thyme. Mix to coat the fish with all other ingredients.
In separate bowls, take flour and panko bread crumbs. Beats the eggs in another bowl.
Roll the fish strips in the flour. Dip the fish in the egg and coat the fish with panko crumbs. Repeat this breading for all the fish pieces.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan and deep fry the fish fillets for 3 mins. Remove from the pan, Serve hot with tomato ketchup or mayonnaise.

title: Chicken Cheese Maggi
cooking_instructions: Cut the chicken into thin strips and keep aside.
Heat a pan, add oil, finely chopped onions and cook until the onions are translucent.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and cook until the raw smell leaves.
Add the chopped tomatoes and red chilli powder, salt
Add the cut chicken strips. Cook this for 2 minutes.
Add 2 cups of water and bring it to a boil. Add the coriander leaves.
Add the Maggi noodles, Maggi tastemaker powder and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the grated cheese and stir. Remove from the heat and grate some more cheese on top of the cooked Maggi. Serve hot.

title: Rava Kichadi
cooking_instructions: Dry roast the Rava for a minute and keep aside.
In a Kadai, heat 1.5 tbsp of oil. Add the mustard seeds, chana dal, urad dal, and allow the mustard seeds to splutter.
Add cashew nuts, slit green chilli, curry leaves, chopped ginger, and saute for a minute.
Add finely chopped onions and saute until the onions are translucent.
Add finely chopped tomatoes and saute until the tomatoes are mushy.
Add the carrots, beans, and green peas. Add the salt, turmeric powder, and saute for 2 mins.
Add 4 cups of water and bring the water to a boil.
Add the roasted Rava and stir continuously until all the water is absorbed and the kichadi is cooked.
Add Coriander leaves, Ghee and mix well.
Remove from the heat, serve hot with Coconut Chutney.

title: Carrot Halwa
cooking_instructions: In a thick bottomed pan, heat ghee. Once the ghee is hot add cashews and raisins. Once the raisins puff and cashews become golden brown, remove it from the pan.
In the same pan, add the grated carrots and saute for 10 minutes stirring well.
Add the milk, mix with the carrots and let it simmer on low heat until the milk is absorbed.
Add the Khova, sugar, cardamom powder and mix well until everything dissolves. Increase the heat to high and saute for 8 mins stirring continuously.
Add the cashews and raisins. Remove from the heat, and serve the halwa warm.

title: Andhra Chicken Fry
cooking_instructions: Wash the chicken with some salt, turmeric powder, and water
Heat a pan, add gingelly oil, thinly sliced onion and saute for a minute.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook until raw smell leaves.
Add the washed chicken and saute for a minute.
Add Kashmiri Chilli powder, Salt and continue to cook for 2 mins
Add ½ Cup of water and continue to cook for 5 mins or until most of the water evaporates.
Switch off the flame, add the lemon juice, roughly chopped green chilli and curry leaves. Serve this hot as an appetizer.

title: Ennai Kathirika Kulambu
cooking_instructions: Wash and cut the brinjal, keep aside.
Soak the tamarind in 1 cup of water and extract tamarind juice.
Grind the raw peanuts and sesame seeds into a powder and keep aside.
In a mixer grinder, grind the tomatoes to make tomato puree.
In a pan, heat ¼ cup of oil. Add the chopped brinjal. Roast the brinjal for 5 mins. Remove the roasted brinjal from the pan.
In the same pan add mustard seeds and allow it to splutter. Add the shallots and continue to saute until it turns translucent.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the tomato puree to the pan and add ¼ Cup of water.
Add the red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, and salt. Cook this for 5 minutes.
Add the tamarind juice and cook for 3 mins.
Add the roasted brinjal and mash the brinjal with the curry. Add Jaggery.
Add the ground peanut and sesame powder. Mix and cook for 1 minute. Remove from the heat and serve it with steamed rice or as a side dish for Biryani.

title: Dragon Chicken
cooking_instructions: Cut the chicken into strips.
In a bowl, add cornflour, maida, salt, pepper, red chilli powder and water to form a batter. Add the chicken to the batter.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan. Fry the chicken pieces until crispy. Remove from the oil and set aside.
In a stir-frying pan, add 1 tsp oil and cashews. Roast the cashews until golden brown and set aside.
In the same pan, add heat 1 tbsp of oil. Add star anise, finely chopped garlic, chopped celery stem, and stir fry.
Add diced onion and capsicum and continue to stir fry.
Add 1 cup of water.
Add tomato sauce, chilli powder and continue to cook. Once the sauce starts to thicken, add honey. Add the chopped celery leaves and spring onion.
Add the fried chicken pieces.Stir fry until the sauce coats the chicken pieces.
Add the roasted cashews. Remove from heat and serve hot as an appetizer.

title: Cream of Mushroom Soup
cooking_instructions: In a small mixing bowl, mix flour, salt, pepper. Mix the flour mixture with water to form a slurry.
In a saucepan, heat butter, add chopped mushrooms and finely chopped onions and saute until golden brown.
Mix the slurry once and add it to the pan and bring it to a boil.
Reduce the heat and add the fresh cream. Simmer for 5 mins stirring continuously. Serve the soup hot with garlic bread.

title: Egg Masala Toast
cooking_instructions: Cut the crust of the bread slices and then cut the bread diagonally to form triangle-shaped pieces of bread. Keep aside.
In a bowl whisk, milk, egg, coriander leaves, finely chopped green chilli, ginger-garlic paste, salt, turmeric powder and pepper.
Dip the bread slices in the milk and egg dip and pan fry it.
Pan-fry the bread on both sides until the egg is cooked on a medium flame. Serve it hot as a snack.

title: Gobi 65
cooking_instructions: Make Florets of Cauliflower from a whole Cauliflower. Bring water to a boil in a pan and add some salt and turmeric powder.
Add the cauliflower florets and cook for 3 minutes then drain and pat dry with a paper towel.
Mix the maida, rice flour, cornflour, ginger garlic paste, curd, Kashmiri red chilli powder, Garam Masala powder, Coriander powder, Black Pepper powder and some salt to taste.
Add water and mix this into a smooth batter.
Add the cooked cauliflower florets to the batter and coat them with the batter.
In a deep frying pot heat the oil for deep frying. Deep fry the cauliflower florets until crispy. Should take around 2 minutes.
Fry the curry leaves and add it as a garnish. Serve them hot.

title: Pani Puri
cooking_instructions: Pressure cook the potatoes with water in a pressure cooker for 6 whistles.
Remove the skin and mash the potatoes.
Add finely chopped Onions, chopped coriander leaves, Cumin powder, chaat masala and salt to the mashed potatoes. Mix well and keep this stuffing aside.
In a bowl add Rava, Maida, Salt, Water and knead for 4 minutes into a stiff dough.
Cover the dough with a damp cloth and rest for 30 minutes.
Take a small portion of the dough and shape it into a ball. On a rolling board, apply oil and roll the dough ball into a thin sheet.
Using a round cookie cutter, cut roundels from the rolled sheet. Cover the cut roundels again with a damp cloth. Repeat the process till the dough is over.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan and deep fry the pooris in hot oil. Remove from the oil and let it cool so that it turns crispy.
Pound the ginger using a pestle and mortar.
Soak ¾ Cup of tamarind and ½ inch Ginger in 2 Cup of boiling water for 30 minutes.
Mash the pulp using hand and strain it using a strainer.
Heat a Kadai and bring the extracted tamarind juice to a boil. Add the jaggery and mix well until the jaggery melts.
Add the Red Chilli Powder, Cumin powder and salt. Simmer for 5 minutes on medium heat.
Grind the mint leaves, coriander leaves, ginger, green chilli with 2 tbsp of water in a mixer grinder.
Add this paste to 5 Cups of Cold Water and mix well.

Add dry mango powder, cumin powder, red chilli powder, black pepper powder, fennel powder, black salt, salt to taste, asafoetida and lemon juice. Mix well and keep this chill until the Paani Poori is assembled

title: Spinach Yam Curry
cooking_instructions: Soak tamarind in 2 tbsp of water and extract thick tamarind juice
Add 1 cup of water to a pressure cooker, add the chopped yam, chopped spinach, ¼ tsp of turmeric and 2 tsp of salt. Pressure cook this for 7 whistles.
Once the pressure settles, mash the spinach and yam.
In another pan, heat 1 tbsp of oil. Add the tempering ingredients - chana dal, urad dal, mustard seeds, cumin seeds, asafoetida, dried red chilli and roast the spices.
Add the mashed spinach and yam mixture to the pan and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the tamarind juice and jaggery.
Add red chilli powder and continue cooking this for 3 mins and remove from the heat. Serve hot with rice and ghee.

title: Poori Masala
cooking_instructions: To make the masala, boil 3 potatoes with 3 cups of water in a pressure cooker for 6 whistles.
Peel the potatoes and crumble them.

Heat a pan, add oil, mustard seeds, channa dal, asafoetida and allow the mustard seeds to splutter. Add chopped ginger, chopped green chilli and curry leaves. Add the cashews. Add the thinly sliced onions and cook until the onions are translucent.
Add the chopped tomatoes, salt, turmeric powder and cook until the tomatoes are mushy.
Add 2 cups of water and simmer for a minute. Add the besan flour and mix.
Add the cooked potatoes and stir. Cover and simmer this for 5 mins.
Add the chopped coriander leaves and mix well.
To make the Poori In a mixing bowl, add wheat flour, Rava and salt. Add water in batches. Knead it into a stiff dough.
Add oil and continue kneading.
Divide the dough into even-sized balls. Using a rolling pin, roll it into a round poori.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan and fry the poori. Repeat this for all the dough balls. Serve the Pooris with potato masala.

title: Crispy Fried Chicken
cooking_instructions: Combine the curd, salt, ginger garlic paste and water to make a soaking liquid for the chicken to brine in.
Place the chicken and soak for at least 2-4 hours and upto overnight for juicy and succulent chicken.
For the batter, combine the ingredients and whisk a smooth and lump free batter.
For the dry mix combine the ingredients in a large bowl and set aside.
Remove the chicken from the liquid and strain in a strainer until the surface is dry.
Combine the ingredients for the marination in a bowl and coat the chicken well. And Refrigerate for a minimum of 30 mins to develop flavours and marinate well.
Transfer the chicken to the dry mix, press and coat well until completely covered with the dry mix.
Transfer to the batter and dip to coat completely.
Drain the excess and place again in the dry mix. Press and coat well for around a minute.
Dust the excess flour off in a downward motion 10-15 mins to develop the characteristic crust.
Deep fry in medium hot oil mixed with vanaspati/ghee (optionally) for around 8-12 mins depending on the size of the piece.
Drain on a wire rack to retain the crispness.
Serve with honey mustard dip.

title: Jalebi
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the urad dhal for 8 hours. Wash and soak the rice for 1 hour.
In a blender, grind the urad dhal, rice, adding some orange food colour and water into a smooth batter.

In a pan heat sugar and water with 2 small lime slices to prepare the sugar syrup. Boil until the sugar syrup reaches single thread consistency. Remove the lemon pieces once the syrup starts to thicken.
Transfer the batter into a piping bag and cut the edge of the piping bag.
In a deep frying pan, add oil and heat it. Pipe the jalebi batter in the oil in small circles and fry until the jalebi turns crispy.
Transfer it immediately to the warm sugar syrup. Dip in the syrup for 3-4 minutes, remove it and serve.

title: Golden Fried Baby Corn
cooking_instructions: Blanch the baby corn in boiling water for 3 mins or until it is half cooked.
In a mixing bowl, mix together the maida, cornflour, rice flour, baking soda, red chilli powder, Cumin powder and salt with some water to form a batter.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan. Coat the baby corns in the batter and deep fry until its golden brown on all-sided.
Remove from oil, drain using a paper towel. Serve hot with tomato ketchup.

title: Egg Fried Rice
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the basmati rice for 30 mins.
Cook the basmati rice in an open pot with 1 litre of water and ¼ tsp of salt. Once the rice is 80% done, drain the water and let the rice cool completely.
In a pan, heat oil, add the eggs and scramble. Remove the scrambled eggs once it is cooked.
In the same pan add some more oil, butter, add finely chopped onion, carrots, beans and capsicum. Saute this for 3 minutes
Add the cooked rice to the pan.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, salt, sugar and pepper. Now increase the flame to high and stir fry the rice by tossing it.
Add the spring onion greens, eggs and continue to stir fry. Remove from heat and serve hot.

title: Arisi Paruppu Saadham
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak rice and Toor Dal for 30 mins
Grind the ingredients mentioned under To Grind and keep aside.
Heat oil in a pressure cooker and add the tempering ingredients
Add the shallots, red chillies and curry leaves.
Once the shallots turn golden brown add tomato and saute it.
Add the ground mixture, water, salt and turmeric powder.
Add the soaked Rice and Dal. Then pressure cook for 4 whistles.
Let the pressure settle on its own. Serve hot with ghee.

title: Mango Pudding
cooking_instructions: In a mixer grinder, add the mango pulp and grind it to extract the mango puree.
In a saucepan, add the water and bring it to a boil.
Keep stirring the hot water, add the gelatin and mix well until the gelatin is dissolved.
Add the sugar and mix until the sugar is dissolved. Set aside.
In a mixer grinder jar, add the mango puree, milk, gelatin and sugar mixture and grind it until all the ingredients are combined together.
Pour the pudding mixture into bowls and refrigerate for 5 hours to set. Garnish with some mango chunks and serve the chilled mango pudding.

title: Cheese Burst Pizza
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, add the water, yeast and sugar. Allow it to rest for 10 minutes. This allows the yeast to bloom. If it doesn’t rise, the yeast might be old or expired.
Add salt to the maida and mix, to make sure that the salt is distributed evenly.

Make a well in the centre of the maida, using your fingers or a wooden spoon. Add the wet mixture in the middle. Start adding a little bit of flour into the wet mixture. Continue doing this until all the flour is mixed in, and a shaggy dough is formed.
Add oil to the dough. Knead well again until the oil is completely mixed in and the dough becomes smooth.
Cover with a damp cloth and allow it to rise until doubled in size for at least 45 minutes, up to 1 ½ hours.
After the dough rises, divide it in two. One portion is for one pizza.
Cut the dough into a quarter and three-fourths.
Roll out the small portion into a flat disc. Heat on a tawa for 1 minute. Flip over and cook for a few seconds.
Roll out the larger portion. Apply the cheese spread and place the cooked dough on top.
Spread the pizza sauce, followed by the grated cheese and all the toppings.
Drizzle olive oil over the top.
Cook in a preheated oven at the highest temperature until the cheese is completely melted, around 8-12 minutes. Apply olive oil around the edges. Cut and serve.

title: Caramel Custard
cooking_instructions: In a pan, on medium heat, caramelise ½ cup sugar till golden brown and pour it into the pudding mould. Swirl to coat the sides.
Preheat the oven to 180 C/350 F.
In a medium bowl, beat the eggs till well blended.
In a saucepan, add milk, vanilla essence, condensed milk, 5 tbsp sugar and bring to a boil.
Drizzle hot milk into the eggs while beating all the time.
Strain the mixture to avoid any egg white lumps in the custard.

Place the moulds into a baking tin with tall sides and pour water just so that the bowl is immersed halfway. Bake for 50 mins or till the centres are still jiggly and when a knife inserted comes out smooth.
Let it cool for half an hour. Release from the sides and invert onto the serving platter. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Tender Coconut Payasam
cooking_instructions: Chop the Almonds and Pista
Chop the Tender Coconut Pulp into small cubes
In a bowl, add Tender coconut water, coconut milk, condensed milk and mix.
Add the coconut pulp and mix again.
Serve chilled garnished with chopped Almonds and Pistas.

title: Chocolate Burfi
cooking_instructions: Combine the butter, khoya, and sugar in a heavy bottom utensil and cook until it melts, add the vanilla essence.
Cook until it leaves the sides of the pan, low flame for 7 to 8 mins.
Spread it in a greased mould lined with grease-proof paper and level the surface.
Combine the butter, khoya, sugar and cocoa powder in a heavy bottom utensil and cook until it leaves the sides of the pan, low flame for 7 to 8 mins.
Spread on top of the vanilla mixture and top with chopped nuts, pat gently to level.
Set until cooled completely and cut into squares.

title: Mutton Seekh Kebab
cooking_instructions: Add the grated onion, green chilli, coriander, and mint leaves to a muslin cloth. Squeeze out all the excess water.
To a bowl, add the mutton mince and the squeezed vegetables. Add the salt, baking soda and all the spice powders.
Knead well until evenly combined.
Place a metal bowl in the center, and place hot charcoal in the bowl. Add ghee to it. When it starts smoking, cover tightly with a lid or aluminum foil. Allow it to rest for 3-4 minutes.
Using a skewer, form the meat mixture into a long kebab shape. Wetting your hand in water allows you to form a better shape. Carefully remove the kebabs onto a plate.
Heat ghee in a pan. Gently place the kebabs in the pan and cook on medium heat. Keep turning after a minute until it is golden brown. Cook for a total of 10-12 minutes.

title: Idicha Kozhi Varuval
cooking_instructions: In a pressure cooker, add 1 tsp of oil, add the chicken and saute for 30 seconds. Add ¼ tsp of salt and turmeric powder. Add 1 ½ cups of water and pressure cook the chicken for 4 Whistles.
Once the pressure settles down, remove the chicken from the pressure cooker and shred it using your hands. Keep the shredded chicken pieces with bone aside.
In another pan, heat 1 tbsp Coconut oil, add the onions and saute until they are translucent.
Add the finely chopped green chillies and ginger-garlic paste and saute until the raw smell leaves.
Add chilli powder, garam masala powder, salt and saute until the spices are cooked.
Add the shredded chicken pieces and toss. Add 2 tbsp of water or chicken stock water.
Add the curry leaves, black pepper powder and coriander leaves.

title: Spicy Chicken Burger
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, add the minced chicken, finely chopped onion, garlic, green chilli, ginger, red chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder, coriander leaves and salt. Mix everything together.
Form burger patties with the chicken mince.
Heat a pan, add oil and cook the patties for 4 mins on each side over medium heat.
Place a cheese slice, cover the pan and cook until the cheese melts.
To assemble the burger, cut the bun horizontally in the middle, toast the buns lightly on a pan.
Mix the mayonnaise and tomato ketchup together.
Toast the buns lightly on a pan.
Apply the sauce on the top and bottom half of the bun. Place lettuce leaves on that, placed the cooked chicken patty, onion slices, tomato slices and place the top side of the bun.

title: Mushroom Masala
cooking_instructions: Grind the cinnamon, cloves, cardamom seeds, garlic, ginger, green chilli and tomatoes together in a mixer grinder with ¼ Cup water. Keep this paste aside.
Heat a pan, add oil. Once the oil is hot add the cumin seeds, bay leaf. Let the cumin seeds splutter.
Add the ground paste and continue cooking for a minute. Add turmeric powder, salt, coriander powder, cumin powder, red chilli powder and cook until the oil separates from the masala.
Add ¼ Cup of water. Add the chopped mushrooms to the gravy. Cook until the mushrooms are soft and well cooked.
Add coriander leaves and remove from the heat. Serve hot with Roti/Chapati.

title: Egg Noodles
cooking_instructions: Bring water to a boil in a pot. Add salt to the water. Add the noodles and cook for 5 mins or as mentioned in the pack.
Strain the noodles from the water. Add some oil so that the noodles don’t stick together. Keep the cooked noodles aside.
Whisk 2 eggs, season with ¼ tsp salt.
Heat a stir-frying pan, add 1 tsp oil. Add the whisked eggs and cook the eggs and set aside.
In the same pan, heat 1 tbsp of oil. Add the thinly sliced onions, julienne of carrots, julienne of capsicum, and cabbage. Stir fry this for a minute.
Add the cooked Noodles. Season this with salt, pepper, sugar, soy sauce and vinegar. Stir fry this for 2 mins.
Add the eggs, spring onion mix well and remove from the heat. Serve hot.

title: Egg Kheema Masala
cooking_instructions: Hard boil 5 eggs.
Peel and grate the eggs.
Heat oil in a pan, add the onions and saute it till they turn golden brown.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and cook until raw smell leaves. Add the tomatoes and mix
Add salt, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, garam masala and cook for 3 minutes
Add the grated egg. Mix and add water. Cook until everything comes together.
Add Pepper powder, coriander leaves and mix well. Remove from the heat and serve hot with Chapati/Roti.

title: Prawn Thokku
cooking_instructions: Heat a pan, add oil, Cumin seeds and Curry leaves. Add the slit green chilli and thinly sliced onion. Saute till the onions are translucent.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and continue to saute. Add finely chopped tomatoes and cook until the tomatoes are mushy.
Add chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, salt and coriander leaves.
Once the spices are cooked, add the washed Prawns. Prawns will emit some water while they cook and shrink in size. Cook until water has evaporated and the gravy thickens.

title: Schezwan Chicken
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl, add maida, cornflour, salt, pepper and water. Mix to form a batter to deep-fry the chicken pieces.
Add chicken pieces to the batter. Heat oil in a deep frying pan and deep-fry the chicken pieces until it is cooked. Keep Aside.
In another pan, heat oil, add finely chopped garlic cloves, red chilli, finely chopped onion and saute for a minute.
Add 1 cup of water, 4 tbsp of Schezwan Sauce, tomato sauce, salt, sugar.
Once the sauce thickens, add the fried chicken pieces and toss along with the celery leaves and spring onion. Remove from heat and serve hot as an appetizer.

title: Gobi Manchurian
cooking_instructions: Blanch the cauliflower florets in hot water for 2 minutes.
Prepare a batter by mixing all the ingredients listed under batter with some water.
Coat the cauliflower florets in the batter.
Deep fry them in hot oil until they turn crispy. Keep aside.
To make the Manchurian sauce, in a hot pan add oil, finely chopped garlic and fry for a minute. Add the finely chopped onion, green chilli, capsicum and continue to stir fry.
Once the onion turns golden brown and the capsicum is cooked, add soy sauce, tomato sauce, chilli powder, salt and sugar.
Mix cornflour and water in a small bowl to make a slurry and add this to the pan. The sauce will start to thicken once the cornflour slurry is added. Add the chopped spring onion.
Add in the fried gobi and toss for 30 seconds. Remove from heat and serve it hot as an appetizer.

title: Mushroom Biryani
cooking_instructions: In a pan, add oil and the finely sliced onions. Saute it on medium-low flame until golden brown. Remove from the pan and keep aside.
Marinate the mushroom with all the other ingredients mentioned under Marination. Marinate this for 30 mins.
Wash and soak the basmati rice for 30 mins.
In a pressure cooker, heat the oil and ghee. Add bay leaf, cinnamon, cloves, cardamom and fry for 30 seconds.
Add the marinated mushroom and cook until the mushrooms are cooked.
Add the coconut milk. Add the water, salt and soaked rice.
Pressure cook this for 1 whistle and switch off the flame. Let the pressure settle down on its own.
Open the pressure cooker, fluff the rice. Garnish with fried onions and serve hot with raita.

title: Rava Kesari
cooking_instructions: Soak the saffron strands in water.
In a pan heat 4 tbsp of ghee and roast the cashews and raisins. Drain and keep aside.
Add the Rava to the same pan with the ghee already on the pan. Roast on low flame for 3 minutes or until aromatic.
In another pan boil 2 cups of water and add the roasted Rava. Keep stirring continuously until all the water is absorbed and there are no lumps.
Now add 1 ½ Cup of sugar and stir until the sugar dissolves.
Now add the saffron water, cardamom powder, the remaining ghee and stir continuously. Cook this for 3 minutes.
Add the roasted cashew and raisins. Cook for further 2 mins. Serve this hot.

title: Coconut Burfi
cooking_instructions: Grind grated coconut to coarse texture and keep aside.
Heat a pan and add sugar and water. Prepare sugar syrup.Boil the syrup to a one string consistency.
Add the grinded coconut to the sugar syrup. Add cardamom powder and stir continuously.
Gradually add the ghee and stir. Mix till the mixture holds the shape
Now transfer the coconut mixture to a greased plate.
Allow to set and cut into pieces when it is not completely set. Once it is completely set unmould and store in an airtight container.

title: Chicken Kulambu
cooking_instructions: In Kadai, add oil, shallots, red chilli and garlic. Saute this for 5 mins on a low flame.
Add the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, Black peppercorns and saute it for 5 mins. Switch off the flame and add grated cinnamon, cloves, fennel, coconut and turmeric powder.
Grind this mixture into a smooth paste using a mixer grinder.
In a Kadai, heat gingelly oil and add mustard seeds and fenugreek seeds. Once they splutter, add the shallots, curry leaves and green chilli and saute it. Add the chicken and saute it for few mins.
Add the ground paste, salt and 3 cups of water.
Garnish with coriander leaves. Serve Chicken Kulambu with Rice.

title: Chicken Satay & Peanut Sauce
cooking_instructions: Soak some bamboo skewers in water for at least 20 minutes.
Cut the chicken breast into 1-inch sized cubes. Set this aside.
Add the garlic, shallots, chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, soy sauce, salt and groundnut oil into a blender jar and make a fine paste.

Divide the mixture into two - one part for the marinade and one part for the sauce. Add the marinade to the chicken cubes, and mix well. Let it sit for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, we can make the peanut dipping sauce.
Add the dry roasted peanuts to a blender and blend it into a coarse powder.
Heat up 1 tsp of Groundnut oil in a pan, add the previously reserved paste. Stir continuously and cook for 2 minutes, or until the raw smell goes away.
Add the ground peanuts and sugar. Pour in ¼ cup of water, and mix. Once it is combined, add in another ¼ cup of water and mix well.
Turn off the heat, add the lemon juice, and set aside.
Now for the Chicken satay - remove the bamboo sticks from the water and pat them dry. Skewer the chicken cubes in the bamboo skewers.
Heat up a pan, add a few drizzles of oil and place them in the pan, with enough space between the skewers.
Turn over after 4 minutes, brush them with some oil, and cook them for a further 4 minutes.

title: Coconut Pudding
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, mix the gelatin and ¼ cup of coconut water and allow it to rest for 10 minutes. It will start to solidify.

In a saucepan over low heat, heat up ½ cup of coconut water, sugar, and the bloomed gelatin. Continue heating on low flame until the gelatin and sugar are dissolved. Add the sliced pistachios, almonds and tender coconut pieces. Do not bring this to a boil. Remove from heat.
Pour this into the serving dish. Refrigerate for 1 hour or until it has set.
For the second layer, combine the gelatin and water in a small bowl and rest for 10 minutes.
Add sugar to the coconut milk and mix.

Melt the bloomed gelatin by placing the bowl in hot water until the gelatin has dissolved. You can also microwave it for 30 seconds, in a microwave-safe bowl. Add the gelatin to the coconut milk mixture and whisk well until combined.
Pour it over the 1st layer after it has solidified in the refrigerator. Cool for 6 hours in the refrigerator.
Release the sides lightly using a knife. You can also dip the dish in warm water for 5-10 seconds to release the sides. Turn it onto a plate. Serve cold.

title: Bhindi Masala
cooking_instructions: In a pan, heat 2 tsp oil, add bhindi, ½ tsp salt and cook until sliminess is gone. Remove the cooked bhindi on a plate.
In the same pan, heat 2 tsp oil and add cumin seeds, once the cumin seeds start to splutter, add the chopped onions and saute until it turns golden brown.
Now add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute. Add green chillies and tomatoes and saute till tomatoes turn mushy.
Add the powdered spices - red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, garam masala, cumin powder
Add ½ of water, ½ cup of whisked curd, ½ tsp salt and bring the curry to a boil.
Now add the fried bhindi and ½ cup of water and cook for 10 minutes in low heat.
Now add ¼ sugar, 1 tsp kasuri methi and mix well. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot with paratha or roti.

title: Foxtail Millet Tomato Rice
cooking_instructions: Wash the Foxtail millets and keep aside.
Puree 3 tomatoes in a mixer grinder.

Heat a pressure cooker, add 1 tbsp of oil, mustard seeds, urad dal, chana dal and let the mustard seeds splutter. Add 5 cashew pieces and roast until golden brown. Add thinly sliced onions, chopped green chilli and cook until the onions are translucent.
Add the tomato puree and continue to cook. Add the red chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder and salt. Saute this for a minute.
Add the chopped coriander leaves, washed Fox Tail millet and 4 cups of water. Pressure cook this for 4 whistles and let the pressure settle down on its own.
Remove from the pressure cooker, garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot with raita.

title: Idiyappam and Coconut Milk
cooking_instructions: In a mixer grinder jar add the grated coconut, cardamom and 1 cup of water. Grind this in a mixer-grinder into a smooth paste.
Pass it through a sieve and extract the first press coconut milk.
Add the residue in the sieve into the blender jar, add 1 cup of water and grind it again.
Pass this again through the sieve to extract second press coconut milk.
Mix the two coconut milk in a bowl, add the powdered jaggery, a pinch of salt and mix well. Set this aside.
Dry roast the rice flour for 1 min in a pan on medium heat.
Heat 3 cups of water in a saucepan, add 2 tsp of Gingelly oil and bring it to a boil. Remove from heat.
In a bowl, add the dry roasted flour, salt and add water in parts and mix using a spatula. Add enough boiling water to form a soft, smooth and non-sticky dough is formed.
Once the dough cools down, knead it for 2 minutes.
Grease the inside portion of idiyappam press and add the dough. Grease the idly plate or idiyappam plate. Press the idiyappam on to the idly plate or idiyappam plate.
Steam for 10 mins. Remove it from the plate and serve it with sweet coconut milk

title: Red Velvet Cake
alternate_titles: Red Velvette Cake with Cream Cheese Frosting
cooking_instructions: Beat the milk and curd together and keep aside.
Separate the egg white and egg yolk. Beat the egg whites separately using the hand mixer until they form fluffy peaks. Should take about 3 minutes.
Whisk the dry ingredients (flour, baking soda, cocoa powder, salt) together in a bowl and keep aside.
In another large bowl, whisk the butter and sugar together until it is combined. Should take around 1 minute.
Add oil, egg yolks, vanilla essence and vinegar and beat for 2 minutes on high speed.
Add the whisked milk and curd.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients in two or three parts and continue mixing slowly using the hand mixer.
Add the red food colouring to the cake batter now and continue mixing.
Add the whisked egg whites and fold it gently into the cake batter using a spatula.
Line up two 9 inch baking trays with parchment paper and preheat the oven on 175 C for 10 minutes.
Divide the cake batter into the two baking trays and bake the cake for 30 minutes.
Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool on the pan before transferring on to the cooling wire rack. The cake needs to be completely cooled before frosting is applied.
To prepare the frosting, in a large bowl, beat the cream cheese, butter, milk, salt and vanilla essence using a hand mixer on medium speed until smooth.
Add the icing sugar. Beat on low speed for 30 seconds to allow the ingredients to combine and beat on high speed for 3 mins until combined completely.
To assemble the cake, slice a thin layer off the tops of the cake to create a flat surface.Apply frosting in the first layer of the cake and place the second layer on top.
Apply the remaining frosting all over the top and sides. Pipe the frosting and decorate the cake as per your wish. Refrigerate the cake for an hour before slicing for the icing to set completely.

title: Coriander Rice Balls
cooking_instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan, add the coriander leaves, chopped green chilli, grated coconut, tamarind. Saute this for 3 minutes.
Transfer this to a mixer grinder and grind it into a smooth paste with 2 tbsp of water.
In another pan, heat 1 tbsp of oil, add mustard seeds, asafoetida, urad dal, chana dal.
Once this splutters, add the ground paste, salt and cook for 3 minutes. Add Ghee.
Add 5 cups of water and bring it to a boil.
Reduce the flame to low and add the Rice Rava and stir continuously. Cook this for 10 mins or until the mixture becomes thick.
Once this cools down, make even sized balls of the mixture and steam cook it in an idly pot for 10 mins.

title: Bajji
cooking_instructions: Thinly slice the raw banana and keep aside. Cut onion into rings and keep aside.
In a mixing bowl, mix besan flour, rice flour, ajwain, red chilli powder, salt, baking soda.
Add water to form a batter. Not too thick or not too runny either.
Dip the raw banana slices and onion slices in the batter and deep fry in hot oil.
Drain the excess oil using a paper towel. Serve the Bajji hot with Chutney.

title: Japan Chicken
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl, add maida, cornflour, salt, pepper and water. Mix to form a batter to deep-fry the chicken pieces.
Add chicken pieces to the batter.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan and deep-fry the chicken pieces until it is cooked. Keep aside.
Grind the cashews into cashew powder using a mixer grinder.
Heat a pan, add butter, once the butter melts, add garlic and slit green chilli. Saute for a minute.
Add the milk, salt and sugar. Stir and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add the cashew powder and let the sauce thicken.
Add the deep-fried chicken pieces to the sauce. Stir fry until the sauce coats the chicken pieces.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot as an appetizer.

title: Crispy Corn Kernels
cooking_instructions: Bring 3 cups of water to a boil. Add ¼ tsp of salt. Add 1 Cup of Sweet corn and cook for 7 mins. Strain the sweet corn and allow it to cool.

Add the strained and cooled sweet corn to a bowl. Add cornflour, rice flour, maida, salt, chaat masala powder and black pepper powder. Add 3 tsp of water and coat each kernel of corn with the flour mix.
Pass the coated corns through a sieve to remove the excess flour.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan. Deep fry the coated corn kernels for 2 mins or until the corn turns crispy.
Remove it from the oil and keep aside.
In a pan, add oil, finely chopped onion, finely chopped garlic and finely chopped green chilli.

Add the fried crispy corn kernels. Add salt, red chilli powder, chaat masala, pepper powder and lemon juice. Mix well. Add the chopped coriander leaves, mix well and remove it from the heat. Serve hot.

title: Vanilla Frozen Yoghurt
cooking_instructions: Mix together the condensed milk, curd and vanilla essence.
Pour it into a bowl and freeze for 3 hours.
Mix it again until evenly smooth. Freeze again for 3 hours or until completely frozen.
Scoop and serve!

title: Egg Tawa Masala
cooking_instructions: Hard boil 3 eggs, for 12 minutes. Peel them and cut in half. Set them aside.
In a tawa, heat oil and butter. Add chopped onions and saute until golden brown, for about 5 minutes.
Add ginger and garlic paste and saute until the raw aroma goes, for 3 minutes.
Add the chopped green chilies. Add chopped tomato and mix well.
Add the powdered spices, salt and half a cup of water. Cook for 5 minutes until the masala becomes thick.
Add the lemon juice and chopped coriander leaves. Add the halved boiled eggs. Stir gently to coat them with the masala.
Garnish with coriander springs. Serve with pav, roti or pulao.

title: Brinjal Rice
cooking_instructions: Soak the tamarind in ½ cup of hot water for at least 20 minutes.
Soak the rice in water for at least 15 minutes.

To make the masala powder, dry roast the coriander seeds and dry red chilli for 30 seconds on low heat. To this, add the chana dal, cinnamon and peppercorns and saute until the chana dal starts to change its colour, around 2 minutes. Then add the methi seeds, cloves, cardamom, urad dal, cumin seeds and poppy seeds. Continue cooking on low heat until the spices turn aromatic.
Add the grated coconut and roast until the coconut starts to turn golden brown. Turn off the heat and allow this mixture to cool. Blend it into a fine powder.
Add rice to a pressure cooker with 2 ½ cups of water and ½ tsp of salt. Cook for 1 whistle.
Heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds and let them crackle. Then add in chana dal, urad dal, curry leaves and asafoetida. Then add in the sliced onions and let them cook for 1 minute.
Add the brinjal, turmeric and 1 tsp salt. Saute them and cook them for 2 minutes.
Add the previously prepared masala powder and tamarind pulp. Cook covered for 5 more minutes until the brinjal is soft and the masalas are cooked.
Add ¼ cup of water and allow to simmer for 2 more minutes.
Turn off the heat and add in the rice. Mix well to combine.

title: Instant Mango Pickle
cooking_instructions: Cut the raw mango into small cubes. Optionally, you may remove the skin.
In a bowl, combine the raw mango cubes with the salt, turmeric powder and red chilli powder. Mix well.

Heat the oil in a pan and add the mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds and asafoetida. When the mustard seeds have spluttered, remove from the heat and mix with the raw mango pieces and mix well. Store in an airtight container and refrigerate for up to a week.

title: Aloo Tikki Chaat
cooking_instructions: Peel and mash the boiled potatoes. Add the salt, cornstarch and rice flour. Mix well to combine evenly.
Shape into evenly sized Tikkis.
Shallow fry in ghee/oil on medium-low flame until golden brown on both sides.
Shallow fry in ghee/oil on medium-low flame until golden brown on both sides.

title: Chicken Karahi
cooking_instructions: Heat the oil in a pan and add the bayleaf and black cardamom. Add the chicken and salt. Fry it for 5 minutes or until it starts to change colour.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and green chillies and saute for a few minutes to remove the raw taste of the paste.
Add the water to the chicken. Place the tomatoes on top, cover and cook for 10 minutes on a low flame. Remove the skins from the tomatoes.
Add all the powdered spices and Kasuri methi, and mix well. Add the curd.
Cover and cook on a low flame for 15 minutes.
Add the coriander leaves and ginger juliennes. Simmer for a couple of minutes and then remove from the flame.

title: Halwai Style Moong Dal Halwa
cooking_instructions: Soak the moong dal in water for 2 hours.
Strain and blend to a fine paste without extra water.
Heat ghee in a heavy bottomed utensil and add the rava. Roast until aromatic and light brown.
To the ghee add the moong dal mixture and cook until it turns golden brown on a low flame while stirring continuously.
Add the entire quantity of ghee in additions while frying the dal.
Switch off the flame and allow the colour to develop for 10 mins.
Once it has changed colour, add the sugar and water. Bring to a boil while stirring continuously.
Add the chopped nuts and cardamom powder, saffron at this stage. Cook until the halwa has thickened.
Switch off the flame and finish with grated khoya, stir until mixed well. Garnish with chopped nuts and silver leaf.

title: Chilli Idly
cooking_instructions: Cut each idly into 4 pieces. Fry the idly pieces in hot oil until golden brown in colour and set them aside.
Heat oil in a wok and add chopped ginger, garlic and spring onions, saute them for 2 minutes.
Add the green chillies, onion and capsicum dices. Saute for 2 mins.
Add the sauces, salt and pepper powder. Mix well.
Mix together the water and cornstarch and add into the wok to make a thick sauce.
Add the fried idly's and chopped spring onion greens. Mix well and serve hot. Garnish with more fresh spring onion greens.

title: Chicken Biryani
cooking_instructions: Powder the ingredients mentioned under biryani masala in a blender. Keep aside.
Marinate Chicken with items mentioned under marination for 1 hour
Wash and soak the basmati rice for 30 minutes
In a pressure cooker, add groundnut oil and ghee. Add the whole spices.
Add finely chopped onion and cook until the colour of the onions changes to golden brown.
Add marinated chicken and cook until the chicken is half done on a low flame.
Add mint leaves, green chilli, chilli powder, curd, biryani masala and salt. Mix well.
Add soaked and drained basmati rice and 3 cups of water.
Pressure cook for 1 whistle and turn off the gas and do not open until the steam goes down.
Fluff the rice, serve it hot with raita.

title: Punjabi Lassi
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, add 2 cups of curd and then add the sugar and continue churning until all the sugar has dissolved.
Add the chilled water, rose water, saffron, and cardamom powder. Churn until an upper froth layer forms.
Transfer to a glass with ice cubes and garnish with chopped nuts.

title: Traditional Ribbon Pakoda
cooking_instructions: Grind Roasted gram to make roasted gram flour
In a mixing bowl, add rice flour, besan flour, roasted gram flour, Asafoetida, Salt, Chilli Powder, Butter.
Add a few sprinkles of water at a time and knead this into a dough.
Place this dough into a Murukku maker with Ribbon Pakoda nozzle
Heat oil in a deep frying pan, once the oil is hot, squeeze the dough from the Murukku maker directly into the oil.
Deep fry the Ribbon Pakoda on low heat. Store this in an airtight container and serve it as a snack.

title: Medu Vadai
cooking_instructions: Wash and Soak the Urad Dal for 4 hours
In a mixer grinder, grind the green chilli and ginger.
Add soaked Urad Dal to the same mixer grinder jar.Grind the urad dal with very little cold water until the batter is fluffy and soft but not too watery.
Add finely chopped Shallots, crushed black peppercorns, Chopped curry leaves, asafoetida and salt to the batter.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan. Wet your hands with water, make small balls of the batter. Use the thumb finger and make a hole in the middle. Drop the vadai into the oil carefully.
Deep fry until the vadai is crispy and golden brown. Repeat the process until the batter is over.

title: Pepper Chicken Fry
cooking_instructions: Take Chicken in a bowl and add Lemon Juice, Ginger garlic paste, turmeric powder and salt and mix well.
Coarsely grind the ingredients.
Heat oil in a Kadai, and add the curry leaves and thinly sliced onion.
Once the onions are golden brown, add the powdered spice.
Add the Chicken immediately and fry on low heat for about 5 mins.
Add ¼ cup of water and simmer on low heat covering the pan with a lid.
Once all the water evaporates, keep frying the chicken until the chicken is coated with masalas, add pepper powder and coriander leaves.

title: Bread Upma
cooking_instructions: In a pan toast the bread till it is brown and crispy. Remove from the heat and cut the bread into cubes.
In another pan heat oil, add mustard seeds, urad dal. Once it starts to splutter add asafoetida, chopped ginger, green chilli and curry leaves.
Add one finely chopped onion and saute it until it turns golden brown.
Add one finely chopped tomato and cook until it turns mushy.
Add turmeric powder, chilli powder, lemon juice and roasted peanuts.
Add 4 tbsp of water and cook until the mixture thickens.
Add the toasted and chopped bread cubes.
Combine everything together for 2 mins, add the coriander leaves and remove from heat. Serve hot as a snack or breakfast.

title: Mutton Kolhapuri
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pressure cooker and add the dried red chillies and sliced onion. Fry until it turns golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste, turmeric powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala and salt. Saute for 1 minute.
Add the mutton and stir well. Add water and pressure cook for 25 minutes on medium heat.
For the masala paste, heat oil in a pan and add all the ingredients except grated coconut, poppy seeds and water. Cook on a low flame until the spices turn aromatic.
Add the coconut and poppy seeds, and roast it on a slow flame until it changes colour.
Add water as required and grind it into a fine paste.
Heat 2 tbsp of oil and cook the paste on a low flame until the oil releases from the sides and the raw taste of the spices disappears.
Add the cooked mutton into the pan. Cover and cook for 5 minutes or until the oil starts to float on top. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve.

title: Easy Chicken Gravy
cooking_instructions: Roughly chop the onions and blend in a mixer grinder to make onion paste
Roughly chop the tomatoes and blend in a mixer grinder to make a tomato puree
Heat oil in a pan, add ginger garlic paste and onion paste. Saute this until the paste turns golden brown.
Add the tomato puree and cook for 5 mins.
Add the turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder, salt. Let the spices cook in the gravy for 2 mins.
Add the cleaned and washed chicken pieces. Cook the chicken for 20 mins.
Add 2 Cup of water, cover and let it simmer until the chicken is cooked.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve with roti/chapati or rice.

title: Street-style Masala Puri
cooking_instructions: Soak the white peas in water overnight, for at least 8 hours.
Add it to a pressure cooker along with potato, salt, turmeric powder and water.
Pressure cook for 5 whistles on medium heat. Mash it partly, leaving some peas whole too
Heat oil in a pan and add the fennel seeds, cumin seeds and cinnamon.
Add the onion and saute until it turns translucent. Add the ginger-garlic paste and saute for 2 minutes to remove the raw taste.
Add the tomatoes and saute until it turns mushy. Add the mint and coriander leaves, mix and turn off the heat.
Cool down the mixture and grind it into a paste.
Heat oil in a pan. Over low flame, add all the spice powders.
Add the masala paste and cook until the raw taste goes away, around 4 minutes.
Add the cooked peas mixture and simmer for 4 minutes. Add salt, water if needed and cook till the desired consistency is reached.
Crush the Puris and place them on the plate. Pour the peas over it. Top it with the onion, tomato, chutneys, chaat masala, sev and coriander leaves.

title: Tres Leches Cake
cooking_instructions: Separate the egg whites from the yolks.
Beat the egg whites with the sugar. Whip it until it forms stiff peaks.
In another bowl, combine the maida, baking powder and salt.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg yolks with sugar until pale and at ribbon consistency.
Add the milk and vanilla essence, and mix just to combine.
Add the flour mixture to the yolks and whisk again.
Fold in the egg whites gently into the egg yolks.
For the milk mixture, combine all the ingredients together and whisk. Set aside.
Pour the cake batter into a cake pan lined greased and lined with baking paper. Make streaks in the batter using a skewer to remove any air bubbles.
Bake at 180c for 30 minutes.
Once the cake has cooled down, make several holes on it using a skewer or toothpick.
Soak it with the milk mixture liquid. Apply whipped cream over the top. Refrigerate for 1 hour.
Trim the sides and cut into pieces. Decorate with whipped cream and strawberries. Serve cold. You can pour more of the milk mixture while serving too.

title: Seer Fish Fry
cooking_instructions: Wash and clean the Seer fish with water and pat dry with a kitchen towel.
In a shallow bowl, add Ginger Garlic Paste, Lemon Juice, Red Chilli Powder, Salt, Turmeric Powder, cornflour and water. Mix this to form a thick paste.
Take one fish slice at a time and apply the masala paste on both the side of the fish. Repeat this process for all the fish pieces.
Marinate the fish for 3-4 hours.
Heat Groundnut oil in a Tawa and shallow fry the fish on both sides till the fish is cooked. Should take around 3 mins per side on medium heat. Serve this hot with lemon slices and onion slices.

title: Mushroom Pepper Fry
cooking_instructions: Prepare a lump-free batter with Corn Flour, Maida, Salt and Pepper and some water.
Add chopped mushrooms to this.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan. Once the oil is hot, deep fry the mushrooms until they turn crispy. Set this aside.
In a stir-frying pan, heat oil, add finely chopped garlic and onion. Stir fry for a minute.
Add Green chilli, Curry leaves, Chilli powder, Garam Masala powder, Salt, Soy sauce and 2 tbsp of water.
Add deep-fried mushrooms and toss.
Add pepper powder and stir fry for 30 seconds and remove from heat. Serve hot as an appetizer.

title: Roadside Kaalan
cooking_instructions: Combine the mushroom, cabbage, ginger garlic paste, soya sauce, gram flour, maida, cornflour, salt, red chilli powder and garam masala, and mix well.
Sprinkle a few drops of water and mix well until it has formed into a red coloured mixture, adding more water as necessary.

Heat up enough oil in a pan for deep frying. Add small pieces of the mushroom mixture and fry them until they are golden brown and cooked through. The shape does not matter here as they are going to be mashed later. Set them aside.
In a mixer jar, grind the ingredients for the paste, into a fine paste.
Heat up oil in a pan and add the previously ground paste and the chopped curry leaves. Saute for 2 minutes on high flame.

Add ginger garlic paste Kashmiri chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, pepper powder, MSG and salt. Saute and cook for 5 minutes or until the raw smell disappears, adding a splash of water if it gets too dry.
Add soya sauce and tomato ketchup. In a small bowl, combine the cornstarch with ¼ cup of water. Add this to the pan and then add in the previously fried mushrooms.
In a small bowl, combine the cornstarch with ¼ cup of water. Cook until the mixture turns thick and glossy, then add the fried mushrooms.
Transfer the Kaalan Masala to the serving bowl and top it with the corn flakes, chopped onions and coriander leaves.

title: Rasmalai
cooking_instructions: To make the Rasmalai Balls, boil milk in a pan. Once the milk boils, switch off the flame and add ½ Cup of water to reduce the temperature of the milk down.
After 5-7 minutes add lemon juice till the milk curdles completely.

Use a strainer to drain the water and collect the chena. Rinse it with fresh water to remove traces of lemon juice. Leave it in the strainer for 10-15 mins and then squeeze the remaining water using the hand. Do not overdo, the chena should still be soft and moist.
In a mixing bowl add the chena and cornflour and mash it until it is smooth. This process has to be done for 10 minutes.
Make small size balls out of this.
Heat 4 cups water and 1 cup sugar in another wide pan. Wait till it comes to a full boil.
Gently flatten the balls and add them to the sugar syrup and cook for 12 minutes. The size of the balls with double once it is cooked.
Let the balls cool down to room temperature for 30 minutes.
To make the Rabri/Thickened milk, bring 3 cups of milk to boil in a pan. Reduce the flame to medium and keep stirring frequently and when cream layer forms, keep stirring.
Add saffron, sugar and cardamom powder when the milk comes to boil.
Boil this until milk thickens and reduces to half the quantity. Add chopped pista and remove it from the heat.
Remove the cooled balls from sugar syrup, Gently squeeze water from the balls and add the balls to the Warm Thickened Milk.
Refrigerate for 3-4 hours before serving. Serve with chopped pista and saffron strands.

title: Chicken Salna
cooking_instructions: In a pan add all the ingredients mentioned under roast and grind one by one in the same order. Once this is roasted, grind it into a smooth paste in a mixer grinder with little water.
In another simmering pot, add Oil, Cinnamon, Cloves, Green Chilli, Onion. Cook until onions are slightly golden.
Add Ginger Garlic Paste, Cook, until the raw smell of ginger and garlic leaves.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they are mushy.
Add Kashmiri Chilli powder, Coriander Powder, Turmeric Powder. Cook for a further 2 minutes.
Add the ground paste, salt to the pan. Cook this for 2 minutes.
Add 1 kg of chicken with bone. Add 3 cups of water and cook for 20 mins, until the chicken is well cooked and oil separates from the gravy and floats on top.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot with parota/Idly/Dosa/Idiyappam/Appam/Chapati

title: Pallipalayam Chicken
cooking_instructions: In a pestle and mortar, pound the shallots and garlic. Or shallots and garlic can be coarsely ground using a mixer grinder without adding water. Keep Aside.
In a pan, add coconut oil, deseeded dry red chilli, the ground mixture of onion and garlic. Saute this for 2 minutes or till the raw smell goes away.
Add Red chilli powder and turmeric powder to this and continue cooking.

To the above, add chicken pieces and salt. Cook for 10 minutes adding ½ Cup of water. If you are using country chicken, it might need more water and you have to cook for a longer time than normal chicken.
Add the coconut pieces cut into 1 inch thin strips and curry leaves. Cook for a further 5 minutes or until the chicken is cooked well.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot with Rice/Idli/Dosa.

title: Mangalorean Chicken Urval
cooking_instructions: Combine the chicken with all the ingredients for the marination. Marinate for 30 minutes.
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the Kashmiri chillies and cashew. Boil for 5 minutes. Remove it from the water. After it cools down, grind it into a fine paste, adding water as required.
Heat butter in a pan. Add the chilli paste and cook it for 5 minutes or until the butter separates from the sides.
Add the marinated chicken and saute for 2 minutes on high heat.
Cover and cook for 15 minutes or until the chicken is completely cooked. Remove from the heat.
In another pan, heat butter and add the cashew, green chilli and curry leaves. Remove it from the heat when the cashew turns into a light golden colour. Add it to the chicken and serve hot.

title: Haleem
cooking_instructions: To a pressure cooker, add the broken wheat, barley and the lentils. Pressure cook on high heat for 1 whistle, then cook on low heat for a further 35 minutes.
Grind into a smooth paste after it cools down.
Marinate the mutton with all the other ingredients for 1 hour.
Heat ghee in a pressure cooker and add all the whole spices. Saute for a few seconds to release its aroma. Add the onion and green chillies. Fry until golden brown.
Add the marinated mutton and saute on high heat for 4 minutes.
Add the dried rose petals and water. Cover and pressure cook for 50 minutes, reducing the heat after the first whistle.
Once the steam settles, open the cooker and remove some of the fat and set aside. Remove the large bones from the meat. Shred the meat.
In a large pot or in the same cooker, heat the mutton along with the cooked wheat & lentil mixture. Add the mint and coriander leaves.
Mash it with a masher/wooden spoon and cook on low heat for at least 20 minutes. Adjust the consistency with hot water if required.
Serve hot topped with fried onion, mint leaves, lemon wedge and fried cashews. Spoon some of the previously reserved fat on top.

title: Sofiyani Biryani
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the basmati rice for 20 mins.
Blend the soaked nuts with water to make a smooth paste.
Bring water to a boil in a pot, add salt and whole spices. Add some ginger garlic paste and a squeeze of lemon.
Add the rice and cook until 75% done, add milk with the rice. Strain the rice and set it aside.
For the chicken, in a pot take the ghee, chicken, ginger garlic paste, nut paste, khoya, onions, cured, green chillies, lemon, salt, spices. Mix it well.
Turn on the stove and bring the mixture to a boil and then allow it to simmer for 10 mins, covered.
Open the pot, add garam masala and add the cooked rice on top.
Add the rose water, kewra water, fresh cream and saffron strands.
Cover and simmer for 20-22 mins on a low flame.

title: Chicken Kainchi Kebab
cooking_instructions: Combine the chicken with all the ingredients for the marination. Marinate for 15 minutes.
Dust the marinated chicken with besan.
Deep fry the chicken until it turns golden brown. Serve it hot as a starter or a snack.

title: Paneer Pepper Fry
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, combine the rice flour, maida, cornflour, salt, black pepper powder with ¼ cup of water to make a thick paste.
Coat the paneer and fry until golden brown. Strain and set them aside.
In a pan, heat some oil and add green chillies and curry leaves.
Add the paneer followed by the red chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala and black pepper powder.
Toss well to coat, sprinkle some water, if needed. Finish with lemon juice and coriander leaves.

title: Salli Murgh
cooking_instructions: Cut the potato into thin straws and dry them on a towel and fry it in hot oil until golden brown. Season the fried potato straws with salt.
For the gravy, heat oil and ghee in a kadhai and the onions. Fry them until golden brown in colour.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and chopped green chillies.
Add the tomato puree of 3 fresh tomatoes and cook until thick.
Add the red chilli powder, salt and turmeric powder and water.
Add the chicken, apricots and simmer covered for 20 mins until tender, finish with potato straws, fresh chopped coriander leaves, cumin powder and garam masala powder.
Garnish with fried potato salli/straws.

title: Mango Coconut Smoothie
cooking_instructions: Add all the ingredients into a mixer grinder and grind it into a smooth thick smoothie.
Healthy Mango Coconut smoothie is ready to be served.

title: Turkish Eggs
cooking_instructions: Bring a pot of water to a simmer. Season generously with salt and add vinegar. The water should just be beginning to boil.
Using a spatula, swirl around the water to get it gently swirling towards the centre, like a whirlpool.
Add a cracked egg carefully into the water. Allow it to cook for 3 minutes.
Melt the butter over low heat. Add all the other ingredients and allow the flavours to infuse together over low heat for around 1 minute.
Combine all the ingredients for the labneh together and whisk until smooth.
Place the poached eggs on the labneh. Drizzle the chilli butter on top. Serve with toasted bread.

title: Panchmel Subzi
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds. Add the ginger-garlic paste and saute until the raw flavour goes.
Add the mixed vegetables and green chilli.
Add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, coriander powder, salt and ¼ cup of water.
Cover and simmer for 10 mins.
Finish with dry mango powder, garam masala powder and lemon juice.

title: Motichoor Laddu
cooking_instructions: Combine the besan, ghee, water and other ingredients to make a smooth runny batter.
Dissolve the sugar over heat with the water, cardamom powder, saffron and food colour. Further boil to reach 1 string consistency. Cover and set aside.
Heat oil over a medium flame and using a slotted spoon allow the bater to drip into the oil to form boondis, fry until golden and strain out of the oil.
Immediately immerse in the warm sugar syrup and allow it to soak and become soft, cover and rest for 30 mins. The Boondi will absorb all the syrup, add the nuts.
