Apply 1 tbsp of chocolate spread, sprinkle over the chopped nuts.
Grate a cheese cube in the middle and grate chocolate shavings on top. Cover with the other slice of bread.
Grill until golden brown and the chocolate, cheese have melted.
Serve warm with some cheese and chocolate grated on top.

title: Strawberry Milkshake
cooking_instructions: In a mixer grinder, blend the strawberries, milk, condensed milk ice cream and a few ice cubes.
In a tall glass pour strawberry syrup on the sides, pour the thick shake and top with whipped cream, strawberries and biscuit crumbs for garnish.

title: Restaurant Style Grilled Chicken
cooking_instructions: To a small blender jar, add the eggs, garlic, salt, sugar and lemon juice. Blend it for a few seconds to combine.
Drizzle the oil gradually in a thin stream while blending on low speed. Do not over-mix. Stop when the mayonnaise is thick. You can use more or less oil as needed.
In a bowl, mix together all the ingredients for the brine until everything is dissolved.
Make slits on the thicker parts of the whole chicken, especially the breast and legs. Add the chicken to the brine and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or ideally for 2 hours.
For the marination, add the de-seeded Kashmiri chillies to a pot of boiling water. Boil for 5 minutes or until the chillies are tender.
Add it to a blender along with all the other ingredients for the marination. Blend it to a smooth paste.
Take the chicken out of the brine and pat it completely dry using a cloth or thick paper towels.
Apply the marination all over the chicken and inside it too.
Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour, but preferably for 6 hours or overnight.
Preheat an oven to 220°c. Secure the legs and wings of the chicken by tying with a twine or by using toothpicks.
If your oven has a rotisserie rod, insert the chicken through it and secure it tightly using the screws. If you do not have the rod, you can place it on a roasting rack and cook it.
Cook at 220°c for 15 minutes, then reduce the heat to 190°c and cook for 1 hour more.
Serve it hot with the mayonnaise on the side.

title: Paruppu Urundai Kuzhambu
cooking_instructions: Soak the Toor dal and chana dal for 2 hrs. Keep aside.
Soak the Tamarind in 1 ½ Cup of water. Extract the tamarind juice from the soaked tamarind. Keep it aside.
Add the soaked Toor dal, chana dal, dried red chilli, fennel seeds, garlic and coarse grind it without adding water using a mixer grinder.
Transfer the coarse ground mixture to a mixing bowl, add chopped shallots, chopped curry leaves, chopped coriander leaves, 1 tsp of salt and mix well.
Make small balls of the mixture and steam it in a greased idly plate for 15 mins. Keep aside to cool down.
Grind the coconut and onion to a paste by adding some water using a mixer grinder.
Heat oil in a pan, add mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, Thalipu Vadam and let it sputter.
Add shallots, curry leaves and saute till it turns golden brown.
Add the ground coconut onion paste and saute for a minute.
Add asafoetida, turmeric powder, sambar powder, red chilli powder and saute for a minute.
Add the extracted tamarind juice, 1 tsp of salt, 2 cups of water mix well and bring to boil.
In low flame add the steamed dal koftas to the gravy and cook until the koftas float on the top.
Add coriander leaves and serve it hot with steamed rice.

title: One Pot Garlic Mushroom Pasta
cooking_instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan, add the sliced garlic and saute it for a few seconds. Add the mushroom and saute it on a high flame.
Add the oregano, chilli flakes, paprika and mix them well
Add the pasta, mix it well. Add the water, give it a stir. Season it with salt and black pepper powder.
Bring it to a boil, cover and let it cook till 90% of the water has evaporated.
Add the olives, mix it in. Garnish it with dried/chopped parsley. Serve it hot.

title: Easy Chicken Sausage Pulao
cooking_instructions: Cut the chicken sausage into 1-inch pieces
Heat oil in a pressure cooker. Fry the sausage pieces until they change colour. Remove them from the cooker.
Add ghee to the same cooker. Add the whole spices, then add onion. Saute until it turns a light golden brown.
Add the ginger garlic paste, salt, red chilli powder, turmeric powder and garam masala. Saute for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, slit green chillies, coriander leaves and mint leaves. Mix to combine. Add the Basmati rice and the fried sausages, and saute gently.
Add water, cover and cook for 1 whistle on high heat. Allow the steam to release naturally.
Fluff gently using a fork and serve.

title: Indonesian Chicken Rendang
cooking_instructions: Prepare rendang paste with Garlic, Ginger, Lemongrass, Red Chillies, Cumin, Fresh Coriander, Tamarind Paste, Lemon Juice, Salt and sugar.
Heat Oil in a pan, add the rendang paste and cook it till it gives out an aroma and releases oil.
Add the chicken and mix it well. Cover and cook it for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Cook the chicken till it is coated evenly with the rendang paste, add coconut milk and cook the mixture until almost dry. Check the taste and transfer it to a bowl. Garnish it with some fried Kaffir Lime leaves. Serve it hot.

title: Aloo Paratha
cooking_instructions: Take the wheat flour in a bowl, add water, salt and knead the dough until it is soft and smooth.
Add the oil and continue kneading the dough for another couple of minutes. Cover and rest the dough for 20-30 minutes.
Pressure cook the potatoes for 5 whistles with water.
Cool, peel the potatoes and mash them and ensure there aren’t any lumps or small pieces.
Add garam masala, chilli powder, salt, mango powder, coriander leaves and chopped green chilli to the mashed potatoes. Mix well and keep the stuffing aside.

Method 1 - Roll a small portion of dough into a 3-inch thick circle. Place the aloo stuffing inside and cover the stuffing by sealing the circumference of the dough. Flatten and roll using a rolling pin.

Method 2 - Roll two small portion of dough into individual 5 inch thin circles. Place the aloo stuffing on top of one circle and cover it with the other one. Seal the edges and roll into a paratha using a rolling pin on a rolling board.
Cook the paratha in a Tawa adding ghee on both sides. Serve hot with pickle and curd.

title: Rustic Tomato Soup
cooking_instructions: Add all the ingredients into a pot.
Place the pot on the stove to heat the mixture, cover and simmer for 20-30 mins until everything is soft and mushy. Add more water, if needed.
Blend using a hand blender until almost smooth.
Add fresh cream and mix well. Serve with a sprig of basil, fresh cream, and toasted baguette slices.

title: Chicken Mayo Sandwich
cooking_instructions: Chop the chicken into thin strips and then into cubes.
In a pan, heat oil and saute garlic. Cook the chicken
Add the remaining ingredients for the filling and mix thoroughly.
Take two slices of bread, apply butter on one side of the bread.
On the other side apply mayonnaise.
Place the cooked chicken stuffing on top of the mayonnaise side. Place the other bread slice on top.
In a non-stick pan, place the bread with butter side on the pan and cook on both sides with stuffing inside.

title: Greek Salad
cooking_instructions: In a large bowl, mix all the ingredients for the salad dressing until just combined.
Add in the tomato, cucumber, onion, capsicum, and olives.
Crumble the feta cheese and sprinkle over the top.Mix well to combine
Garnish with mint leaves and serve with rusk.

title: Chocolate Brownie
cooking_instructions: Melt the butter and chocolate together on the double boiler or microwave and set it aside to cool.
In a bowl beat the egg, vanilla essence, and sugar together.
In another bowl, combine the Dry Ingredients together (Maida, Cocoa Powder, and Baking Powder)
Combine the egg mixture and chocolate mixture together.
Sift in the dry ingredients as three parts into the wet mixture and fold it until no lumps.
Preheat the oven. Line a baking tray with parchment paper and fill the tray with the batter.
Bake it for 35 mins at 180-degree celsius.

title: Nilavembu Kashayam
cooking_instructions: In a saucepan, add 2 cups of water.
Add nilavembu, vetiver, vilamichai ver, korai kizhangu, black peppercorn, ginger, sandal powder and mix well.
Simmer for 15 mins on medium flame.
Strain the kashayam using a strainer. The kashayam is ready to drink.

title: Chettinad Pepper Chicken
cooking_instructions: Heat a pan, add all the ingredients under “for masala paste” except coconut and dry roast until aromatic.
Add the grated coconut and saute for a minute. Remove from the heat.
Heat 1 tbsp of oil in another pan, add onion, and saute till it turns translucent.
Add garlic, ginger and saute for a minute.
Add the tomato and cook till it gets mushy. Remove from the heat.
One cool, In a mixer grinder, add the dry roasted ingredients and sauteed ingredients, ¾ Cup of water and grind it into a smooth paste.
Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a Kadai, add dried red chili, curry leaves, and saute.
Add the ground masala paste, turmeric powder, salt, and saute for 2 mins.
Add the chicken, ½ cup of water and cook for 12 mins on high flame.
Add the coriander leaves, mix well and remove from the heat.

title: Amritsari Fish
cooking_instructions: If using a fillet of fish, cut the fish into 1-inch cubes.
In a bowl, add besan flour, red chili powder, cumin powder, ajwain seeds, ginger garlic paste, salt and mix well.
Add Soda and form a thin batter.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan. Dip the fish cubes in the batter and deep fry until crispy and golden brown. Serve hot with mayonnaise.

title: Prawn Pakoda
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl, take chopped shallots, curry leaves, chopped green chilli, ginger-garlic paste, besan flour, rice flour, cornflour, chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and lemon juice.
Add 3 tbsp of water and mix everything together. Add the prawns and mix well to coat each piece of the prawn with the batter.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan. Deep fry the prawns until crispy and golden brown. Should take around 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot as snacks or as an appetizer with a squeeze of lemon.

title: Egg Spinach Curry
cooking_instructions: Bring 6 cups of water to a boil, add spinach leaves and cook for 2 mins.
Drain this and transfer it to a bowl of cold water.
Add the spinach leaves to the mixer grinder and grind it into a smooth paste along with garlic, ginger, green chili.
Place the eggs on a saucepan, add 3 cups of water, bring the water to a boil, cover and cook the eggs for 9 minutes.
Once the eggs cool, remove the shells of the eggs and cut them into halves.
Heat oil in a pan, add red chili powder, salt and mix well. Add the boiled halve eggs and pan fry for 2 mins. Keep aside.
Heat oil in a Kadai, add bay leaf, cloves, cumin seeds, and let it splutter. Add onion and saute till it turns translucent.
Add tomato, turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder, salt, and cook the masalas for a minute.
Add the ground paste and saute for a minute. Add 1 ½ cups of water, cover, and cook for 10 mins on medium flame.
Add cream, mix well, add the pan-fried egg halves and simmer for 3 mins.
Egg Spinach Gravy is ready to be served with roti/chapati.

title: Chicken Manchurian
cooking_instructions: Bring 1 Cup of water to a boil. Add the red chillies and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the cooked red chilies to the mixer grinder and grind it into a smooth paste.
In a pan, heat 2 tsp of oil. Add the ground chilli paste. Cook this until the oil separates from the chilli paste.
In a mixing bowl, add cornflour, maida, salt, pepper and water. Mix to form a batter to deep-fry the chicken pieces.
Add chicken pieces to the batter.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan and deep-fry the chicken pieces until it is cooked. Keep Aside.
In another pan, to make the Manchurian sauce, heat oil, add the chopped garlic and ginger. Saute this until the garlic turns golden brown.
Add the chopped onions and continue to saute. Add the chopped capsicum and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the chilli paste, tomato sauce, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper. Mix well and cook for 2 minutes.
Mix 2 tsp of cornflour in ¼ cup of water to form a slurry. Add the cornflour slurry to the pan.
Mix well, once the sauce is in the desired consistency, add the batter-fried chicken cubes and toss.
Add the chopped spring onions and remove them from heat. Serve hot as an appetizer.

title: Piped Coconut Cookies
cooking_instructions: Preheat the oven at 180C. Cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy, scrape down the sides in between.
Add the vanilla essence, saffron milk and cardamom powder and dry ingredients and mix until combined well and smooth.
Fill into a piping bag fitted with a star nozzle/ nozzle of your choice.
Pipe rosettes onto a baking sheet/tray lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-18 mins per batch in a preheated oven at 180C until golden brown. Cool them completely before serving.

title: Tamatar Dhaniya Shorba
cooking_instructions: In a pot, heat the oil and add the whole spices. Saute for a minute, until aromatic.
Add the ginger and garlic, saute for a minute. Add the tomatoes and coriander stems. Saute for 3 minutes until the tomato softens.
Add the powdered spices and salt.
Add 2 cups of water and simmer for 10 mins.
Add lemon juice and mash the tomatoes well.
Strain the soup.
Serve with chopped tomatoes and coriander leaves.

title: Prawn Ghee Roast
cooking_instructions: In a pan dry roast Kashmiri red chilli, red chilli, coriander, cumin, fennel and pepper.
Grind the dry roasted ingredients with ginger, garlic cloves, lemon juice, curd, and tamarind juice to a smooth paste.
Heat ghee in a pan and saute the onion until it turns golden brown.
Add the masala paste and cook until the ghee separates from the sides and the raw taste disappears, around 8-10 minutes. Add a splash of water if it gets too dry.
Add the prawns and season with salt. Cover and cook for 2-4 minutes depending on the size of the prawns.
Add jaggery and curry leaves and saute for 1 minute. Remove from the heat and serve!

title: Carrot Kosambari
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the moong dal in water for 1 hour.
Add the grated carrot to a bowl. Add the soaked moong dal, grated coconut, salt and lemon juice to this.

For the tempering, heat up oil and crackle the mustard seeds. If the dry chillies are large, tear them into smaller pieces and add them. Add chopped green chilli, asafoetida and curry leaves. Add this tempering to the salad and mix well.
You can serve it as it is, or it can also be eaten with rice and rasam.

title: Restaurant Style Paneer Bhurji
cooking_instructions: Grate 3/4th of the paneer using the large-sized grater. Chop the remaining paneer into small cubes, or crumble it roughly using your hands. This adds more texture to the dish.
Heat oil in a pan and add the cumin seeds. Add the garlic, ginger, onion and green chilli. Saute until the onion turns translucent.
Add the turmeric powder, salt, Kashmiri chilli powder, coriander powder and cumin powder. Saute for a minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook until they soften.
Add the cashew paste and water, then saute for 3-4 minutes.
Add the paneer and stir.
Add the garam masala powder, Kasuri methi, and coriander leaves. Cook for 30 seconds and remove from the heat. Serve hot with roti or pav.

title: Egg Bonda
cooking_instructions: Cut the boiled eggs into halves, length-wise and keep it aside.
Cut the boiled eggs into halves, length-wise and keep it aside.
Add water and whisk it till a thick batter forms and there are no lumps.
In a kadai, heat oil for deep frying. Dunk the egg halves into the batter, coat it evenly and drop it into the oil
Fry on a medium heat till it turns golden brown and crispy.
Serve it hot along with chutney or ketchup

title: Palak Khichdi
cooking_instructions: Wash the rice until the water runs clear.
Wash and soak the moong dal for 30 minutes.
Add it into a pressure cooker along with the soaked moong dal, salt, water and turmeric. Pressure cook for 1 whistle, then allow the pressure to release naturally.
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the spinach and blanch for 1 minute.
Transfer the blanched spinach to a bowl of ice cold water.
Once it cools down, transfer it to a mixer jar and blend until smooth.
Heat ghee in a pan and add the cumin and asafoetida. Add the green chilli, ginger and garlic. Saute for a minute.
Add the onion and saute until translucent.
Add the chopped tomato along with all the powdered spices. Saute for 2 minutes or until the tomato has softened.
Add the spinach puree and saute on medium-high heat for 4-5 minutes.
Add the cooked rice mixture. Mix and adjust salt, if needed. Adjust the consistency with hot water as per preference. Add lemon juice, mix it well.
Add finely chopped coriander leaves and remove from the heat.
For the tempering, heat ghee in a pan and crackle the cumin seeds.
Add the thinly sliced garlic and dried red chilli. Saute until the garlic begins to brown lightly. Add the Kasuri methi, stir and remove from the heat.
Pour this tempering over the Khichdi. Serve with pickle, raita and papad.

title: BBQ Chicken Wings
cooking_instructions: In a Bowl, Mix salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, maida and eggs. Add the chicken wings and mix it till it coates evenly.
Coat the marinated chicken wings in flour and deep fry it in hot oil to a golden brown colour and take it out.
Fry the chicken for a second time to get crispy golden brown wings.
In a bowl, add bbq sauce, honey and chilli flakes and mix them well. Add the chicken wings to it till every wing is coated with the sauce
Transfer the wings to a plate, Garnish it with chopped parsley. Serve it hot.

title: Chettinad Mutton Kothukari
cooking_instructions: For the masala, dry roast the coriander seeds, cumin seeds and black peppercorn on medium-low heat, until they turn aromatic.
Add the green cardamom and dry red chillies. Continue to roast them until the chilli turns crisp. Allow it to cool, then grind into a fine powder.
Heat oil in a pan and add the whole spices, onion, curry leaves and green chillies. Saute until the onion just starts to turn golden brown.
Add the ginger garlic paste and saute for 1-2 minutes or until the raw smell disappears.
Add the tomato, turmeric powder and salt. Saute for 2 minutes.
Add the mutton mince and saute for 2 minutes, breaking down any lumps. Add the ground masala and mix it well.
Add the water, cover and cook for 20 minutes on low heat, until the meat is cooked and the oil floats on top.
Add milk and ghee, cover and cook for 4 minutes.
Open the lid and cook further on high flame if you want it at a thicker consistency. Add coriander leaves, mix and serve garnished with finely chopped onion.

title: Khow Suey
cooking_instructions: Combine all the ingredients for the green curry paste and blend in a mixer grinder to a smooth paste with ¼ cup water.
Boil the noodles until tender with oil and salt, as per packet instructions.
Coat the drained noodles with oil and set them aside.
Heat oil in a pan and deep fry the onions until golden brown, on a medium flame.
Fry the garlic similarly, and set aside.
Coarsely crush roasted peanuts and set them aside.
In a pan, heat oil, add the red chili, curry leaves, and turmeric powder. Add and fry the curry paste for 10 minutes until the raw smell and flavor goes.
Add the vegetables and saute for 3 minutes.
Add water, boil until the vegetables are tender. Add the salt, brown sugar, and soya sauce.
Add the thick coconut milk and basil leaves, bring to a single boil. Finish with lemon juice.
Serve with noodles and toppings as desired.

title: Curry Leaves Fried Prawns
cooking_instructions: In a pan, add oil, once the oil is hot add cumin seeds, black peppercorns, split urad dal, chana dal, dried red chilli and curry leaves. Saute this on low heat for 4 mins
Remove from the heat, allow it to cool. Once the ingredients have cooled down, grind into a fine powder using a mixer grinder.
Take prawns in a bowl, add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, salt, ginger garlic paste and lemon juice. Mix well. Add Maida to bind everything together. Mix well and keep aside.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan, once the oil is hot, add the prawns and deep fry for 2 mins.
Take the fried prawns in a mixing bowl, sprinkle the required quantity of curry leaf powder on top of the prawns. Toss to mix well. Serve hot as an appetizer.

title: Mixed Chikki
cooking_instructions: In a pan, dry roast the sesame and poppy seeds and set aside.
In the same pan, dry roast all the nuts for 5 minutes on a low flame and set aside.
In a pot, boil the jaggery and water together, until the syrup starts frothing. Check for hard ball consistency by putting a drop of the syrup in a cup of water, it must be hard and crisp to bite.
At this stage, add the nuts and seeds and mix well to coat well. Quickly transfer to a greased plate or mold lined with butter paper.
Place another sheet on top and roll with a rolling pin for an even surface.
Cut into squares while it is still warm.
Serve after it has completely cooled.

title: No Oven Gluten-Free Pizza
cooking_instructions: Take the flour in a bowl and add the salt and baking powder. Add warm water and oil to bring together the dough. The dough should be smooth and come together well.
Rest the dough for at least 15 mins.

On a butter paper, using greased hands, tap out a thin layer of dough carefully by applying pressure and moving the dough outward with your fingers and palm. Cut out a circular shape using a lid or cutter, if needed.
Cook this on a hot tawa until firm and develops a light colour.
Add the pizza sauce, cheese and toppings.
Add some water, cover and cook for about 2 mins on a medium heat. Serve hot.
Slice and serve hot.

title: Som Tam Salad
cooking_instructions: Blanch the beans in salted water for 2 minutes. Remove them from the water and cut them lengthwise.
For the dressing, in a bowl combine the brown sugar, lemon juice, soya sauce and minced garlic.
Mix the raw papaya, carrot, beans and chilli along with the dressing in a bowl.
Place the salad on a bed of mixed lettuce. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves, spring onion and crushed peanuts.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
cooking_instructions: Wash the Basmati rice and soak for 20 minutes.
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add salt and water. Add the soaked Basmati rice and cook for 5 minutes.
Strain the rice and spread it on a plate or tray. Allow it to cool. This prevents the rice from sticking to each other.
In a bowl, combine the chicken, soy sauce, black pepper powder and cornstarch.
Heat a wok and add 1 tbsp of oil. Add the eggs along with a pinch of salt. Scramble it and remove it from the pan.
Add 3 tbsp of oil and add the chicken, leaving space between each piece. Cook it for 3 minutes and remove it from the pan.
In the same pan, add the garlic, ginger and scallions. Saute and then add the cabbage, carrot and beans. Add sugar and saute for 1 minute on high heat.
Add white pepper powder, soy sauce and chilli sauce. Mix well.
Add the cooked rice, eggs and chicken. Toss until evenly combined. Add 1 tsp of salt.
Allow it to cook for 2 minutes, tossing occasionally. Add the spring onions, toss and remove from the heat.

title: Jangri
cooking_instructions: Add the sugar, water and green cardamom to a pan. Turn on the heat and cook until the sugar syrup has thickened.
Add lemon juice and orange food colour. Mix and set aside, covering it so that it remains warm.
Wash the Urad dal and soak for 1 hour.
Drain the water completely. Grind it into a smooth paste, adding minimal water as required.
Transfer the mixture into a bowl. Add cornstarch and a few drops of orange food colour. Mix using your hands or using a whisk for 5-10 minutes or until fluffy.
Test the consistency of the batter by dropping a small portion in a bowl of water. If it floats, it is at the right consistency. Transfer this batter to a piping bag or to a squeeze bottle.
In a flat pan, heat oil. Over medium heat, squeeze the batter into the oil. Make a large circle twice and then make smaller circles over the large circle.
Once the oil bubbling starts to subside, flip the Jangris. Cook until it reaches the same orange-red colour on both sides.
Drain off the excess oil and transfer it to warm sugar syrup. Let it soak for 4 minutes.
Transfer it to another tray/plate. Once they are all fried and soaked, garnish with chopped nuts.

title: Sunny-Side Up
cooking_instructions: Heat oil over medium heat in a pan, preferably non-stick. Using eggs that are fresh and refrigerated will help to retain the shape of the yolk. Gently pour the egg into the pan.
Season with salt and pepper, if using. Continue cooking on medium heat until the egg whites have solidified, but the yolk is still jiggly. If preferred, you can cook it further.
Remove it onto a plate. Serve with toast and optionally, sausages.

title: Punugulu
cooking_instructions: Combine the dosa batter, rice flour, rava, cumin seeds, salt, baking soda, onion, green chilli and coriander leaves in a bowl.
Mix it well to combine and then rest for 10 minutes.
Heat oil and add dollops of the mixture with wet hands.
Deep fry until golden brown.

title: Chilli Oil Hand Pulled Noodles
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add the remaining ingredients in a bowl and pour over the hot oil. Allow it to cool and store airtight.
For the hand pulled noodles: knead a rough dough with salt and water and rest covered for 10 mins.
Re-knead the dough until completely smooth and soft, rest again for 10 mins.
Divide the dough into 2-3 portions and flatten them.
Coat the flattened pieces thoroughly with oil. Layer them one on top of another and rest covered further for 1.5 hours, minimum.

You can make thin or thick noodles, as per preference. It will depend on how you cut the dough. Cut thin strips, pull and bounce, fold and repeat for thin noodles. For thicker noodles, cut into wide strips and repeat the process.
The cooking time will be fairly short, 1 mins to 2 mins depending on the thickness. Add each strip as ready into boiling water.
Drain the noodles, coat with oil and set aside for serving.
For the preparation: heat sesame oil in a pan and add veggies of choice. Saute briefly for 1-2 mins. Add the noodles and season with salt, sugar and soya sauce. Add MSG optionally.
Spoon over the chilli oil and coat thoroughly by tossing quickly and gently. Finish with spring onion.
Serve in a bowl garnished with spring onions, sprinkle over some sesame seeds.

title: Bachelor's Chicken Curry
cooking_instructions: Add all the ingredients into the pressure cooker (except the ghee and coriander leaves). Mix well. Optionally, marinate for 10 minutes.
Place the pressure cooker on the stove on high heat. After 1 whistle, turn the heat down to low and cook for 10 minutes.
Once the whistle settles, open the cooker lid and stir in the ghee and coriander leaves. Serve with rice, roti, parotta or any other rice/Indian bread.

title: Naatu Kozhi Fry
cooking_instructions: In a pan, dry roast the black peppercorns and cumin seeds. Remove from heat, grind it into a fine powder using a mixer grinder. Keep Aside.
Bring 1 cup of water to boil in a saucepan, add the dried red chilli and cook for 5 mins.
Grind the red chillies into a smooth paste and keep aside.
In a pan, add 2 tsp of Gingelly oil, add the ground chilli paste and cook for 5 mins over a low flame.
In a large Kadai, heat Gingelly oil. Add the Bay Leaf, Cinnamon, Cardamom, Cloves, Fennel Seeds and Star Anise.
Once the spices turn golden brown and are roasted well, add the curry leaves. Add the chopped shallots and saute till it turns golden brown.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and continue to saute. Add the turmeric powder and saute for a minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the coriander powder, chilli paste, garam masala, salt and cook for 2 mins.
Add the country chicken pieces and mix well. The masala should coat on each piece of the chicken. Continue to saute for 3 mins.
Add 4 cups of water and cook for 35 mins
Once the chicken is cooked, add the ground pepper and cumin powder. Mix well.
Add the chopped coriander leaves and remove from heat. Serve hot as an appetizer.

title: Maharastrian Peanut Chutney
cooking_instructions: Dry roast the peanuts in a pan until brown, for 5 minutes. Set them aside on a plate to cool down.
De-skin the roasted peanuts.
In a pan, add the oil and cumin seeds. Add the garlic, red chillies and saute for 4 minutes.
Add the peanuts to the pan. Add the powdered spices and salt.
Mix well and transfer to a mixer grinder. Pulse blend the mixture until coarse in texture.

title: Crispy Baked Chicken
cooking_instructions: Prheat the oven. Make a marination with the given ingredients.
Prick the chicken with a fork.
Apply the marination on the chicken thoroughly and refrigerate it for 30 mins.
Dust the chicken with maida, coat with eggs and then with breadcrumbs.
Bake the chicken for 45 mins and flip it half way through at 180C.

title: Bhakarkhani
cooking_instructions: Preheat the oven. In lukewarm milk, add the sugar and bloom the yeast for 5 mins.
In a bowl, take the maida, salt, baking powder and the nuts. Mix well.
Add the kewra water and the ghee, crumble the mixture to resemble sand.
Add the milk and knead a soft dough for 8-10 mins. Apply some ghee on the surface of the dough and rest the dough for 30 mins, covered.
Divide the dough into roundels, Roll out the dough into discs and dock/prick with a fork. Apply ghee on the top.
Bake the breads at 230C for 12-15 mins until golden brown. Brush the baked breads with ghee.

title: Egg Vadai
cooking_instructions: Crack open the eggs in a bowl and beat them. Add the finely chopped onion, coriander leaves to the beaten eggs.
Add the red chilli powder, pepper powder, turmeric powder, garam masala powder and salt. Mix well.
Add 2 ½ Cups of besan flour, mix to form a thick batter.

Heat oil necessary to deep fry the vadai. Dip hands into some water, take the vadai batter and drop small balls of vadai into the hot oil. Deep fry for 4 mins and remove from the heat. Serve hot with tomato ketchup.

title: No Oven Grill Chicken
cooking_instructions: To a small blender jar, add the eggs, garlic, salt, sugar and lemon juice. Blend it for a few seconds to combine.
Drizzle the oil gradually in a thin stream while blending on low speed. Do not over-mix. Stop when the mayonnaise is thick. You can use more or less oil as needed.
In a bowl, mix together all the ingredients for the brine until everything is dissolved.
Make slits on the thicker parts of the whole chicken, especially the breast and legs. Add the chicken to the brine and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or ideally for 2 hours.
For the marination, add the de-seeded Kashmiri chillies to a pot of boiling water. Boil for 5 minutes or until the chillies are tender.
Add it to a blender along with all the other ingredients for the marination. Blend it to a smooth paste.
Take the chicken out of the brine and pat it completely dry using a cloth or thick paper towels.
Apply the marination all over the chicken and inside it too. Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour, but preferably for 6 hours.
Secure the legs and wings of the chicken by tying with a twine or by using toothpicks.
In a large heavy-bottomed utensil, add salt and heat it on high for 15 minutes.
Place a plate and a metal ring/bowl inside. Place the chicken on the ring, and make sure that chicken does not touch the sides of the utensil.
Cover and cook on medium heat for 30 minutes.
Open the lid, brush the chicken with the rendered fat and cook for another 30 minutes.
Take out the chicken. Place it on an oiled wire rack directly on the stove. Sear it on all sides so that the skin gets seared and browned.

title: Schezwan Cheese Paneer Tikka
cooking_instructions: Add garlic and red chilli powder into hot oil. Whisk all the ingredients mentioned in the marination until smooth and thick.
Add the paneer and the vegetables and coat evenly, rest refrigerated for 30 mins.
Layer the paneer and vegetables on a skewer and roast on an open fire.
Baste with butter after roasted, sprinkle chaat masala.
To prepare the cheese sauce, melt butter in a pan and add the miada. Whisk in the milk until smooth and combined. Add salt and a pinch of turmeric.
Finish with cheese it now resembles a perfect nacho sauce!
Heat a sizzler pan and place the paneer pieces. Top with the cheese sauce and sprinkle finely chopped spring onion to garnish.

title: Tawa Pulao
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the basmati rice for 15 mins.
Pressure cook the potato, green peas, carrot in 2 cups of water for 2 whistles. Cut them into cubes.
Pressure cook the soaked basmati rice in 1 cup of water by adding ½ tsp of salt and 1 tsp of oil for 1 whistle.
Add the butter in a Tawa, once heated add cumin seeds and let it crack. Add onion and saute it along with ginger garlic paste until it turns golden brown.
Add tomato, capsicum, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, pav bhaji masala powder and saute well until the masalas get cooked.`
Add the cooked vegetables, salt and mix well. Add the cooked rice. Stir fry it for 5 mins on high flame.
Add the coriander leaves and serve them hot with lemon wedges, sliced Cucumber and Onion raita.

title: Paneer Makhni Biryani
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the rice for 20 mins.
To make the makhni gravy, boil the tomatoes, cashew nuts and kashmiri red chillies for 6 whistles with a cup of water.
Cool down and blend the mixture until smooth. Strain the gravy base and set it aside.
To prepare the gravy, fry the paneer in ghee until lightly golden and strain it out.
In the same pot add ginger garlic paste and saute until no longer in aroma.
Add the kashmiri red chilli powder and mix well.
Add the gravy base and simmer it for 5-10 mins.
Season with cardamom powder, garam masala, salt and sugar.
Add milk to adjust the consistency and mix well.
Finish with the butter, cream, fried paneer cubes and kasuri methi.
To make the biryani, cook the rice until 80% done in salted water. Strain and set aside.
In a pot layer the rice and gravy in 3-4 layer with chopped mint, coriander leaves and garam masala. Also flavour with rose water and kewra water.
Cover and simmer the biryani for 12 mins.

title: Sakkarai Pongal
cooking_instructions: Dry roast Raw rice and Moong dal in a pan
Wash the roasted Dal and Rice in Water.
Heat and melt Jaggery with ½ Cup of water in a pan and filter to remove impurities. Keep the Jaggery syrup aside.
In a pan heat ghee, add cashews, raisins and roast them till cashews turn golden brown and raisins puff up. Keep aside.
Cook the Dal and rice in a pressure cooker with 2 cups of water and ¼ cup of milk for 10 minutes
Mix Jaggery syrup with the Rice and Dal mixture and simmer for 2-3 minutes on low flame.
Add cardamom powder, a pinch of edible camphor and a pinch of salt to the pan and keep stirring continuously
Add ghee, tempering mixture and continue stirring until ghee is absorbed into the pongal. Remove from heat and serve.

title: Irani Chai
cooking_instructions: Pour the water into a metal bowl. Tie a muslin cloth over it dipping the centre in the water. Add the tea leaves in it.
In a pressure cooker, place a metal object to slightly elevate the surface. Add 1 ½ cups of water and place the bowl in the cooker. Cook for 5 whistles on high flame.
Remove it out and squeeze the muslin cloth. This is the decoction.
For the milk, heat it in a saucepan along with cardamom. Once it comes to a boil, reduce the flame and allow it to simmer for 10 minutes, stirring regularly.
Add the condensed milk and mix well. Switch off the heat.
Add the thickened milk into two cups. Add the decoction on top and serve. Add 1 tsp of sugar if you prefer.

title: Masala Cutting Chai
cooking_instructions: Crush the cardamom, cinnamon and clove lightly in a mortar and pestle. Add the piece of ginger too and crush it.
In a saucepan, add the water along with the crushed spices. Bring to a boil.
When it comes to a boil, add the tea and mix well. Allow it to boil for 2 minutes.
Add the milk. When it comes to a boil, reduce the flame and add the sugar. If you are not using sugar, you can skip it.
Allow it to simmer on a low flame for 1 minute. Strain and serve.

title: Shakshuka
cooking_instructions: Heat the oil in a pan and add the onion and garlic. Saute for 3 minutes or until the onion turns translucent.
When the onion turns translucent, add the capsicum. Saute and cook for 3 minutes or until it has softened
Add the chopped tomatoes to the pan. Add the salt, black pepper powder, kashmiri chilli powder, cumin powder, sugar and chilli flakes.
Mix well, add water, cover and cook on a low flame for 10 minutes.
Make a few cavities in the tomato sauce using a ladle. Crack in a whole egg. Repeat this step for all the eggs.
Cover and cook on a low flame for 10 minutes.
Turn off the heat and sprinkle the chopped coriander leaves on top.

title: Chinese Chopsuey
cooking_instructions: To make fried noodles, blanch the noodles in boiling water for 3 mins with 1 tsp of salt and drain. Cool down the noodles.
Cool down the noodles and dust with cornstarch.
Deep fry until crispy and golden brown.
For the sauce, Heat oil in a wok and add the minced ginger, garlic,spring onion and green chillies. Saute for 2 mins.
Add the rest of the vegetables into the wok and saute on a high flame.
Add a litre of water to the wok and allow it to come to a boil, let the vegetables get tender but not mushy or over-boiled. Season with salt.
Add sugar, white pepper powder and MSG. Add the soya sauce and vinegar.
Thicken the sauce with a mixture of cornstarch and water.
Finish with spring onion greens.

title: Chettinad Chicken Chukka
cooking_instructions: In a pan, dry roast the Black Peppercorns and Cumin seeds until they are aromatic. Grind this into a powder using a mixer grinder.
In another pan, heat oil, add Fennel Seeds, Cinnamon, Cardamom, Cloves, Cashew Nuts and Dried Red chilli. Once the spices start spluttering and the cashews are brown, add curry leaves.
Add the finely chopped onions, finely chopped garlic and continue to cook until the onions turn translucent.
Add the Ginger Garlic Paste, Turmeric Powder, Red Chilli Powder and continue to saute.
Add the finely chopped tomato and saute until the tomatoes are mushy. Add some water to bring the masala together and to prevent it from burning or sticking to the pan. Season with salt.
Add Chicken to the pan, mix well to coat the Chicken with masala. Cook the Chicken for 10 minutes by stirring in intervals or until the chicken is cooked fully.
Add the ground Pepper and Cumin powder which was prepared earlier to the pan. Mix well and saute for 2 mins.
Add coriander leaves, mix and remove from the heat.

title: No-Oven Stuffed Garlic Bread
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, add the water, yeast and sugar. Allow it to rest for 10 minutes. This allow the yeast to bloom. If it doesn’t rise, the yeast might be old or expired.

In a large bowl, add maida and salt. Mix to combine evenly. Make a well in the centre and add the wet mixture in the middle. Start adding a little bit of flour into the wet mixture. Continue doing this until all the flour is mixed in, and a shaggy dough is formed. Transfer the dough to a flat surface.
Knead well until a smooth dough forms.

Add 2 tbsp of oil to the dough. Knead well again until the oil is completely mixed in and the dough becomes smooth. Cover with a damp cloth and allow it to rise for at least 45 minutes, up to 1 ½ hours, or until doubled in size.
Mix the chopped garlic with the melted butter. This is our garlic butter for the bread.
Lightly knead the risen dough again. Divide into 4 portions.
Roll each portion of the dough out into a 2 cm thick disc. Move this dough to a plate/tray that can stand heat. This is the tray that we are going to use inside the cooker.
Spread some garlic butter in the centre of the dough. Fill with shredded cheese and corn. Fold in half to form a semi-circle shape.
Brush the top generously with garlic butter and sprinkle mixed herbs. Cut the bread gently into 2-inch thick slices, without cutting all the way to the bottom.

To prepare our cooking utensil, add 2 cups of salt to a cooker or a heavy-bottomed utensil. DO NOT use the whistle weight and the washer. Keep this on high flame for 15-20 minutes. It is advisable to use an older utensil for this purpose, as the bottom of the cooker could turn dark after use.

Place any metal ring to give an elevated surface to place the food on. Place the pan inside the cooker, on the metal bowl. Close and cook on a high flame for 15 minutes. Check if it has reached desired colour on the outside. If it is too light, brush with some more garlic butter and cook for 5 more minutes. Brush with some garlic butter, before serving.

title: Keto Pizza
cooking_instructions: Grate the cauliflower using a grater or a food processor.
Mix the grated cauliflower with salt. Microwave for 4-5 minutes. Alternatively, spread it roughly onto a tray and bake it for 10 minutes for 200°c.
Put the cooked cauliflower into a muslin cloth. Once it has slightly cooled enough to handle, squeeze out the excess moisture and press it well.
Add it into a bowl along with dried oregano, onion powder, garlic powder, grated Mozzarella cheese and egg. Mix to combine evenly.
Spread a sheet of baking paper on a tray. Spread the cauliflower mixturing and spread it slightly using a silicone spatula/spoon. Using your hands, shape it into a circle.
Bake for 15-20 minutes in the oven at 200°c, or until it holds its shape.
The cauliflower crust is ready. Flip the pizza crust carefully and remove the baking paper. Spread the sauce, cheese and any toppings of your choice.
Bake again for 6-7 minutes or until the cheese melts.
Sprinkle red chilli flakes and drizzle olive oil on the pizza. Slice and serve.

title: Vegetable Lasagna
cooking_instructions: Prepare pasta dough by mixing and kneading flour, water, salt and olive oil.
Knead till all the ingredients combine and form a semi-hard dough. Cover the dough in cling wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Roll the dough into a thin sheet, while generously dusting with Maida. Fold the sheet and roll again. This makes the sheet laminated and smooth. Cut it into rectangles.
Blanch it in boiling water for 3 minutes and transfer it to a bowl of ice water. Strain the sheets, set it on a plate greased with oil. Handle the sheets gently.
In a pan, milk butter, add flour and make a thick roux out of it.
Add milk and keep whisking it till a thick sauce forms. Season it and keep it aside.
In another pan, heat olive oil, add garlic and onions. Saute till the onions turn translucent. Add basil and oregano, mix well.
Add the vegetables except zucchini and cook it for 2 minutes. Finally add the zucchini and mix it well till it becomes soft.
Add tomato Puree, water and cook until the mixture is dry. Season the mixture with salt.
Grease an oven safe dish with olive oil, Pour a ladle of white sauce and spread it out. Gently place the lasagna sheet. Add a layer of vegetables. Sprinkle cheese on it.
Repeat the same process for another layer. For the final layer, add the lasagna sheet. Spread some white sauce. Cover the dish with silver foil.
Bake the lasagna at 180 degrees for 25 minutes in a preheated oven.
Take the dish out, add a generous amount of mozzarella cheese. Gratinate it till the cheese turns golden brown.
Garnish it with fried basil. Serve it hot

title: Sulaimani Tea
cooking_instructions: Add the water to a saucepan along with crushed cardamom, cinnamon and cloves. Allow it to boil for 1 minute.
Add the tea leaves and sugar. Boil for 1 minute or until the colour darkens. Turn off the flame.
Add lemon juice and mix well. Strain the tea.
Pour it into 2 cups and garnish with mint leaves.

title: Malai Kofta
cooking_instructions: Pressure cook the potatoes with 3 cups of water for 8 whistles.
In a mixing bowl, mash the boiled potatoes. Grate the paneer.
Add the chopped cashews and raisins. Add cornflour, salt, garam masala powder and knead it into a dough.
Divide the dough into equal portions and make smooth balls out of it.
In a deep frying pan, heat oil. Deep fry the kofta balls on medium heat until it is golden brown on all sides. Keep moving the balls within the pan for it to cook evenly.

To make the gravy, heat a Kadai, add 2 tbsp of ghee, add bay leaf, cardamon, cumin seeds and black peppercorns. Allow the spices to splutter. Add the thinly sliced onions and cook until the onions are translucent.
Add the coriander powder, red chilli powder and turmeric powder. Add the chopped ginger and garlic to the Kadai. Saute for a minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and continue to cook for a min. Add Salt.
Add 1 ½ cup of water and continue to simmer for a minute. Add the cashew nuts and cook for 5 minutes.
Now remove the bay leaves from the Kadai, and then transfer the contents of the Kadai into a mixer grinder and grind it into a smooth puree.
Heat 1 tbsp of ghee in a Kadai, add 1 tsp of Kashmiri red chilli powder, mix well and add the ground puree.
Add ½ cup of water and bring it to a boil and simmer for 2 mins.
Add the fresh cream, Kasuri methi mix well and remove from the heat.
While serving, add the kofta balls to the gravy, garnish with fresh cream and serve hot with Naan/Kulcha.

title: CSK Mocktail
cooking_instructions: In a glass, add the cucumber slices, mint and honey. Crush it using a muddler or a wooden object. Add pineapple juice to it and mix. Strain it into the serving glass.
Add ice cubes just until it reaches above the surface of the pineapple juice.
Add the lemon slices. Slowly pour the sprite into the glass.
In another glass, mix in the blue curacao and water. Gently pour it into the glass. Garnish with cherries.

title: Crispy Corn Flakes Paneer
cooking_instructions: Marinate the paneer with ginger garlic paste, red chilli powder, salt and garam masala.
Mix the flour, water and salt to make a thick batter.
Dip the paneer in the batter and coat with crushed corn flakes.
Deep fry until golden brown and crispy in medium heat.
Transfer it to a plate. Sprinkle with chaat masala and serve.

title: Scallion Pancakes
cooking_instructions: Bring together a rough dough with maida, water, salt and oil. Rest the dough for 20 mins.
Knead into a smooth dough, apply oil and rest again for 20 mins.
For the mixture, combine the ingredients in a bowl, add hot oil and mix well.
Roll out the dough thinly and apply the mixture.
Roll into a log and cut thin strips.
Open and bring together the pieces. Roll onto a ball and flatten them.
Cook on a hot skillet until golden brown and crispy. Fluff them up and serve warm.

title: Mutton Kuzhambu
cooking_instructions: Heat a pan, add coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, black peppercorns and dried red chilli. Dry roast them until aromatic and let them cool.
Heat oil in a pan, add shallots and saute till it gets translucent.
Add garlic, ginger, curry leaves and saute for a minute.
Add the grated coconut and saute for a minute.
In a mixer grinder, add the dry roasted ingredients as well as the sauteed shallot-coconut mixture, add 1 ½ cup of water and grind it into a smooth paste.
In another pan, add Gingelly oil. Once the oil is hot, add Bay leaf, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, Star Anise and Stone Flower for tempering.
Once the spices emit aroma, add shallots, garlic and continue to saute until the shallots turn golden brown. Add the curry leaves.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook until the tomatoes are mushy.
Add the cleaned and washed mutton pieces. Add salt and turmeric powder. Mix well.
Add 1 Cup of water, cover and cook for 20 mins or until the mutton is half cooked.
Add the ground masala paste to the pan. Add 3 cups of water.
Cover and simmer for 25 mins on until the mutton is fully cooked and the Kuzhambu reaches the desired consistency.
Add chopped coriander leaves and remove from heat. Serve hot with Rice/Idli/Dosa.

title: Punjabi Samosa
cooking_instructions: To prepare the samosa dough, take a bowl, add maida and ghee, mix to form crumbles.
Add ajwain seeds, salt and water. Knead to form a tight dough. Cover and rest this dough for 30 minutes.
Boil 4 peeled and cut potatoes in a pressure cooker with ½ cup of green peas for 2 whistles.
Remove from the pressure cooker and mash the potatoes.

In a pan, add oil, cumin seeds. Once the cumin seeds splutter, add chopped ginger and green chilli.Now add the boiled and mashed potatoes and green peas to the pan. Add Chilli powder, Turmeric powder, Garam masala, Dry Mango Powder and salt. Add coriander leaves once the spices are mixed with the potato. Switch off the flame and set this filling aside
Roll the dough into an oval shape and cut in half.
Mix some maida and water to form a thick paste which will act as glue to stick the sides when assembling the samosa.

Bring two ends of the straight edges and pinch them to form a cone. Fill the cone with Samosa Stuffing. Apply the paste around the circumference of the cones, fold it with a pleat and pinch the edges to seal the samosa. (Watch the recipe video for better understanding).

Add oil in a pan on low heat. Drop the samosa in the oil and continue to fry them for 10-12 minutes on low heat. Increase the heat and fry for another 5 minutes. This method of frying gives a flaky consistency to the samosa. Serve the samosas hot with Ketchup/Tamarind Chutney/Coriander Chutney.

title: Mutton Kola Urandai
cooking_instructions: Grind the fried gram dal into a fine powder using a mixer grinder.
Grind all the ingredients mentioned under Kola Masala Paste into a fine paste using a mixer grinder.

In a pan, add the minced mutton meat and cook without adding oil or water. The water coming out of the meat will be good enough. Cook the meat until all the water is evaporated and the meat browns. Should take around 4 mins.
Grind the meat in a mixer grinder.
In a mixing bowl, add the cooked and ground meat, kola masala paste and powdered fried gram dal. Mix everything together to form a soft dough.
Apply a little oil on to your hands. Make small round balls of the kola mixture.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan, On medium heat fry the kola balls for 3 mins.
Transfer it to a plate with a paper towel. Drain off the excess oil. Transfer it to a plate. Serve hot as an appetizer.

title: Goan Chicken Croquettes
cooking_instructions: Marinate the chicken with ginger-garlic paste, turmeric powder, lemon juice and ½ tsp of salt. Let it sit for at least 15 minutes.
In a pan, heat 2 tbsp of oil. Add the finely chopped onion and saute it for 1 minute.
Add the potato cubes and the marinated chicken. Add the garam masala and pepper powder and cook for 1 minute. Add ½ cup of water and cook, covered, until the potatoes have softened.
Remove the lid and cook on high heat until all the water has evaporated. It is important that this mixture should not have too much moisture. Let this mixture cool to room temperature.
Then grind it into a coarse paste in a mixer or food processor.
Shape this mixture into a log-shape, around 2 inches long.
Beat the egg in a bowl. Put the breadcrumbs onto a plate. Dip the shaped chicken croquettes in the egg, and then in the breadcrumbs. Set this on a separate plate.
Heat oil to deep fry, and fry them until golden brown.

title: Ragi Laddu
cooking_instructions: Roast the cashews and raisins in 1 tbsp of ghee until golden brown. Transfer to a bowl, set aside.
In the same pan add the ragi flour and roast until aromatic, 5 mins on a low flame. Stir continuously. Set it aside in a bowl.
Dissolve the jaggery with water on a flame and then boil it for 2 mins until it thickens slightly, almost to 1 string consistency.
Add 2 tbsp of ghee and the nuts to the ragi flour, combine well.
Add some syrup at a time to form a dough, in 2 additions.
Divide and form the dough into laddoos while still slightly warm with greased palms.

title: Kashmiri Noon Tea
cooking_instructions: Add the water to a saucepan along with the green tea leaves and baking soda. Bring it to a boil and continue cooking until almost all the water has evaporated.

Add 2 cups of cold water to the saucepan. Cook again until the colour changes to a reddish colour, around 5 minutes on high flame. Strain this decoction. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 10 days.
To make the tea, heat the milk along with salt. When it comes to a boil, add ¼ cup of the decoction and stir well.
Sprinkle sliced almonds and pistachios on top. Serve hot.

title: Vella Seedai
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the rice for 30 mins. Strain a cloth and dry for 10-15 mins.
Roast the urad dal until light brown and blend to a fine powder.
Blend the rice to a fine powder.
Roast the flour for a few mins over a low flame to dry up.
Sieve the rice flour and dal powder.
Add the coconut, cashew, cardamom powder and sesame seeds, ghee and set aside.
Melt the jaggery with water. Strain to remove the impurities.
Add the jaggery syrup to the flour mixture and mix well.
Shape the dough into small roundels.
Deep fry in medium hot oil until brown and crispy. Cool completely and serve.

title: Atho
cooking_instructions: To Fry-Fry the onions in the oil until golden brown. Remove the onion from the pan.
Fry garlic in the same oil until golden brown. Remove the garlic along with the oil into a bowl and set aside.
Tamarind Pulp- Soak the tamarind along with hot water for 15 minutes. Strain it to get the pulp.
To Grind- Grind the roasted peanuts and fried gram together into a powder. Set aside.
Salt Water- Mix the water and salt together until dissolved completely. Set aside for seasoning later.
Boiling Noodles-Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add salt and turmeric.
Add the noodles and cook according to package instructions. Strain the noodles and toss it with oil to prevent it from sticking.

Mixing the noodles- In a large bowl, add the noodles. Add a little bit of all the toppings according to your taste preference. 
Adjust the taste accordingly and serve garnished with some fried onion, coriander leaves and more crushed Thattai.

title: Egg Salad Sandwich
cooking_instructions: Cut the boiled eggs into quarters and transfer them to a bowl.
Add butter, mustard, mayonnaise and pepper to it.
Using a fork lightly mash the egg while mixing it along with the butter.
On a slice of bread, spread mayonnaise, place a piece of lettuce and finally add the egg mixture and spread it evenly. Place a few slices of gherkin on top of it.
Place another piece of lettuce on top and sandwich it with another slice of bread with mayonnaise on it. Cut each sandwich into 2 and serve at room temperature.

title: Andhra Stuffed Brinjal Curry
cooking_instructions: Cut slits on the bottom of the brinjal, but not all the way through. Soak them in salt water for 10 minutes.
Soak the tamarind in hot water for 15 minutes. Strain it to extract the tamarind juice.
In a pan, toast the peanuts on medium-low heat for 2 minutes or until it starts to turn crunchy.
Add the coriander seeds, cloves, cinnamon, black peppercorn, cardamom, sesame seeds and fenugreek seeds. Saute for 2 more minutes or until it turns aromatic.
Add the desiccated coconut and saute for 1 minute. If you are using fresh grated coconut, saute until it starts to turn dry.
Add it into a mixer. Add garlic, ginger, onion, turmeric, red chilli powder, and salt. Grind it into a paste.
Fill the Brinjal slits with the prepared stuffing. Reserve the remaining stuffing for later, if any.
Heat oil in a pan. Add the mustard seeds and cumin seeds, let them splutter. Add the curry leaves and onions. Saute until it starts to turn golden brown.
Add the salt, turmeric powder, and Kashmiri red chilli powder. Saute for a minute.
Add the stuffed brinjals and saute for 3 minutes.
Add the remaining masala and saute for a minute. Add the tamarind extract and water. Cover and cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add jaggery and chopped coriander leaves. Mix and turn off the heat. Serve with roti or rice.

title: Paneer Do Pyaza
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan and add all the whole spices and onion. Saute until the onion turns golden brown.

Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute. On low heat, add turmeric powder, Kashmiri red chilli powder, salt, coriander powder and cumin powder. Saute for 2 minutes or until the raw smell disappears. Add a splash of water if required.
Add the fresh tomato puree and saute for 5 minutes.
Add water and cashew paste and mix well. Cover and cook for 10 minutes on medium heat, stirring occasionally to ensure that it does not stick to the bottom of the pan.
In the meantime, prepare the paneer and onions. Heat oil in a pan and sear the paneer pieces just until they turn golden brown on both sides. Set aside.
Add ghee to the same pan and add cumin, dried Kashmiri chillies and garlic. Saute for 30 seconds.
Add the onions and toss on high heat for 30 seconds. Set aside.
To the gravy, add curd and stir continuously for a few minutes until the oil starts floating on the sides.
Add Kasuri methi, garam masala powder and cardamom powder Mix and then add the fried paneer and onions. Allow it to simmer for 1 more minute.
Remove from the heat and serve with rice or roti.

title: Dabeli
cooking_instructions: Dry roast the ingredients for the masala, except the powdered spices, salt and sugar.
Once they are aromatic, transfer them to a mixer grinder and add all the powdered spices, salt and sugar.

Blend to a fine powder and set it aside. To make the masala peanuts, heat oil in a pan and fry the peanuts for a minute. Switch off the flame and transfer to a bowl, sprinkle with red chilli powder and a pinch of salt.
In a pan, heat oil add the spice mix, salt and red chilli powder and add the Mashed potato
Add ¼ Cup of tamarind chutney and mix well to combine and cook on a low flame for 5 minutes. Add the lemon juice and mix well.
To assemble the dabeli, cut the pav, spread the potato filling.
Top with chopped onions, chopped coriander leaves, pomegranate, fine sev and the masala peanuts. Close the pav.
Heat some ghee in a pan and fry on a tava for a minute or two on both sides. And coat the sides with fine sev and serve.

title: Beetroot Pulao
cooking_instructions: Wash the rice and soak for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the rest of the ingredients.
In a pressure cooker, heat ghee and add all the whole spices. Add the onion and green chilli, then saute it until the onion turns translucent.
Add the ginger garlic paste, red chilli powder, coriander powder and salt. Saute for 2 minutes.
Add the beetroot, sugar and vinegar to help retain the colour of the beetroot. Add the mint and coriander leaves. Saute for a minute.
Add the rice and water. Mix and pressure cook for 2 whistles, turning the heat to low after the first whistle.
Fluff up the rice and serve warm with raita.

title: Punjabi Kadhi
cooking_instructions: Mix the besan with ajwain, onions, green chillies, coriander leaves, baking powder and salt into a thick batter with some water and set aside. Add a pinch of baking powder.
Fry small roundels of the batter of the pakoda in hot oil until golden brown.
Dip them in warm water for 5 mins and squeeze gently to drain.
To make the kadhi, whisk together the curd and besan with the powdered spices without any lumps and add water to reach a pouring consistency.
Heat ghee in kadhai, add the methi seeds, red chillies, cumin seeds, ajwain and asafoetida.
Gently add the curd mixture while whisking continuously.
Simmer the kadhi until no longer raw in aroma.
Add the soaked and drained pakodas.
To finish the kadhi, make a tadka of ghee with cumin, red chilli and red chilli powder.
Add the tadka to the kadhi and chopped coriander leaves. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Cream of Chicken Soup
cooking_instructions: Cut the chicken breast halfway through to make it flat. Season it with salt and pepper.
Heat some oil in a pot and cook the chicken on low flame. In 4 minutes, turn the chicken and cook it until the chicken is fully cooked. This will take around 4 more minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. Cut this chicken into cubes.
In the same pan, add butter and then add the garlic, onion and carrot. Saute it for 1 minute.
Then add the flour and mix well. Add 1 cup of Stock/Water and mix well to remove any lumps.
Add 2 cups of water, salt, pepper and thyme. Bring to a boil.
Add the milk, the chopped chicken and green peas, and simmer on a medium flame for 10 minutes.
After simmering, add fresh cream. Once it comes to a boil, immediately turn off the heat. Serve hot.

title: Spicy Mexican Salad
cooking_instructions: Combine and whisk together the ingredients for the dressing.
For the salad, combine the ingredients in a bowl. Pour over the dressing and gently combine.
Plate the salad, add a dollop of sour cream, and top with crushed tortilla chips and coriander sprigs.

title: Kozhi Urulai Kulambu
cooking_instructions: Heat a pan, dry roast the whole black pepper, dry red chilies, coriander, and cumin seeds. Put it in the blender and blend it to a fine powder. Keep it aside.
Heat another pan, add oil. Add the cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, curry leaves, green chilies, and let it crackle.
Add the onions and cook it till it turns golden brown.
Add the tomatoes and cook it till it is mashed and let’s out oil on the sides.
Add the potatoes, mix it well and let it cook for a while.
Add the masala, cook it till it gives out an aroma. Add water, mixt it till it combines with the masala
Add the chicken, mix it till it coats evenly, and cook it for a few minutes.
Add salt and sugar. Mix it well.
Cover the pan and let it cook for 20 minutes on a medium flame, stirring occasionally.
Check if the chicken and potatoes are cooked. Transfer it to a bowl. Garnish it with chopped coriander. Serve it hot.

title: Korean Pancakes
cooking_instructions: Whisk the flour, seasonings and garlic with water to get a smooth and lump free batter.
Add the sliced vegetables and mix well.
Heat a non-stick and add some oil. Pour ladles of the batter and cook until both sides are golden brown and crispy.

title: Double Egg Kati Roll
cooking_instructions: In a small mixing bowl, add the thinly sliced onions, chopped green chilli and add lemon juice to pickle the onions.
In a Kadai, heat Oil, add finely chopped onions and saute until golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes. Add the finely chopped capsicum and mix well.
Add Turmeric Powder, Red Chilli Powder, Coriander Powder, Garam Masala, Salt and Tomato Ketchup. Cook this for 2 minutes.
Add some water and then add the boiled eggs and cook until the mixture thickens.
Beat egg with a pinch of salt and keep aside.
In a tawa, Cook the paratha on both the sides until golden brown and flaky, adding some oil.
Add the beaten egg on one side of the paratha and flip and cook the egg side. Transfer this paratha to a plate or board for assembly of the kati roll.
Sprinkle some salt, chaat masala on the egg side of the paratha. Add the pickled onions a little off the center of the paratha. Add a teaspoon of lemon juice and tomato ketchup.
Add the boiled egg stuffing on top of the pickled onions. Top this with some Mayonnaise.
Roll this tightly making sure the filling is enclosed within the paratha. Wrap a parchment paper around two thirds of the roll and tuck the excess paper at the bottom. Serve it hot.

title: Goan Ros Omelette
cooking_instructions: Marinate the chicken with all the ingredients for marination. Rest for 20 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan and add ginger, garlic, green chilli, onion and all the whole spices. Saute until it turns aromatic and the onion is translucent.
Add the grated coconut and turmeric. Saute until golden brown.
Allow it to cool down, then grind into a smooth paste adding water as needed.
Heat oil in a pan and add the chopped onions. Saute until it turns translucent.
Add the tomato and saute for 1 minute, then add the marinated chicken and saute for 2-3 minutes on high heat.
Add the prepared masala paste and saute for 2 minutes.
Add water and bring it to a boil. Cover and cook for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle coriander leaves, mix and set aside.
Add onion, green chili, coriander, and salt to a bowl. Mix it well.
Add the eggs and beat until evenly combined.
Heat oil in a pan and make omelets in two batches.
Cut the omelet or roll it and place it on a plate. Spoon some of the chicken gravy over the omelet, then top with chopped onions and coriander leaves.

title: Potato Au Gratin
cooking_instructions: Thinly slice the potatoes and soak them in water.
Bring the milk and cream to a boil in a pan. Add the garlic and rosemary.
Season with salt and pepper.
Add the potatoes and cook until tender, about 10 mins.
Strain the potatoes from the mixture carefully and set them aside. Strain the milk mixture.
Preheat the oven to 200C.
In another pan, melt butter and add the maida to prepare a roux.
Slowly add and whisk the milk/cream mixture.
In a baking dish spread some of the sauce at the bottom. And layer the potatoes and sauce alternatively.
Top with more sauce, grated cheese and bread crumbs.
Bake until golden brown at 200C for 20 mins. Take it out of the oven, cut it evenly, and serve it hot.

title: Stir-Fried Beef
cooking_instructions: Marinate the beef strips with salt, pepper, and soy sauce. Marinate for 1 hour in the refrigerator.
In a hot wok/pan, add oil, chopped garlic, and ginger, and let it brown.
Add the chopped celery and saute it for a few seconds. Then add sliced onions, saute for a minute on a high flame. Add the julienned bell peppers and saute it for a few minutes.
Add the marinated beef and toss it on a high flame till it mixes evenly. Cook it till it starts releasing water.
Cover and cook the beef for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add Sugar and msg, toss the beef and cook it till it is dry.
Check the seasoning, transfer it to a bowl and garnish it with chopped spring onions and toasted sesame seeds.

title: Panzanella Salad
cooking_instructions: Tear the bread into rustic pieces, coat with olive oil, salt and pepper and bake at 200C for upto 5 mins until golden brown and crispy.
Combine all the chopped vegetables in a bowl.
In another bowl combine the ingredients for the dressing.
Add the croutons and pour the dressing over the veggies. Toss until well combined. And finish with some more fresh basil and crispy crouton pieces.

title: Railway Veg Cutlet
cooking_instructions: Pulse blend the green peas and sweet corn into a coarse mixture.
Heat oil in a kadai and add the ginger and green chillies. Saute for 2 mins.
Add all the vegetables and saute until tender.
Add the powdered spices and salt to season.
Add the vegetables to a bowl of boiled potatoes, ¼ Cup of bread crumbs and the chopped coriander leaves and mix well. Mash into a uniform filling.
In a bowl, mix the maida and water and set aside. In another bowl, place the breadcrumbs.
Shape the cutlets into desired shapes and dip it in the maida mixture. Coat it well in breadcrumbs.
Chill the cutlets for 20-30 mins. And shallow fry them until crispy and brown. Serve it hot.

title: Skillet Cookie
cooking_instructions: In a Bowl, add white sugar, brown sugar, softened butter, and use a spatula/whisk to cream it and then whisk it till it becomes a thick mixture.
Add the egg and vanilla essence and mix it well.
Sieve flour and baking soda into the sugar mixture and fold it in till it forms a moist dough.
Add the chopped chocolate and fold them in. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for an hour.
Divide the cookie dough into halves and grease a skillet with butter. Spread one half of the dough at the base of the skillet evenly.
Add the chopped chocolate. Cover it with the other half of the cookie dough like a pie and seal the edges.
Bake it in a preheated oven at 180 degrees celsius for 30 minutes and cool it down for 1 hour. Cut it and serve with ice cream.

title: Chicken Xacuti
cooking_instructions: Marinate the chicken pieces with ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, turmeric and 1 tsp salt. Let it rest for at least 20 minutes. Meanwhile, we can prepare the masala.

Heat oil and add the coriander seeds, on medium-low flame. After 30 seconds, add all the spices except the fennel and poppy seeds. Cook until the spices are fragrant. Then add the fennel seeds, poppy seeds, sliced onion and grated coconut. Cook until the onion and coconut start to brown.
Grind it into a smooth paste with water and set aside.
In a pot, add the chopped onions and saute until they turn golden brown. Then add the tomatoes and cook until they are soft.
Add the chicken and saute for 2 minutes. Add 1 cup of water and cook covered for 10 minutes.
Then add the masala paste and cook for 10 minutes.
Finally, stir in the coconut milk. When it comes to a boil, immediately turn off the heat.

title: Tuscan Chicken
cooking_instructions: Marinate the chicken thighs with salt and pepper. Heat a pan with 2 tbsp oil. Sear the chicken thighs on bot sides till it turnsgolden brown. Take the chicken off the pan and keep it aside.
Heat oil in a pan, add garlic, basil leaves, oregano and saute for a minute. Add chopped onion and saute it till it turns translucent.
Add the chopped tomato and saute for a minute.
Add the spinach leaves and saute till it shrinks.
Add the cream, mix it well and bring it to a soft boil.
Add the Black olives and mix it well.
Add half a cup of water. Season the sauce with salt and pepper.Add grated parmesan cheese, mix it till it dissolves.
Add the chicken to the sauce and gently spoon the sauce over the chicken and cook it for a few seconds.
Transfer it to a bowl, garnish it with chopped parsley. Serve it hot.

title: Paneer Tikka Salad
cooking_instructions: Make the marination by whisking together the oil and red chilli powder first. Add all the remaining ingredients and whisk again to form a smooth marination.
Add the Paneer, mix and marinate for 15 minutes. You can prepare the dressing and other ingredients in the meantime.
Arrange the paneer cubes onto skewers. Cook them over direct heat until they turn charred on all sides.
For the dressing, blend together mint leaves, coriander leaves, green chilli, lemon juice and ice cubes.
Whisk them along with mayonnaise, honey, chaat masala, roasted cumin powder and lemon zest. Set the dressing aside. It can also be stored in the refrigerator.
To assemble the salad, add all the veggies in a large bowl. Top with the Paneer. Drizzle the dressing over the salad. Mix it and serve immediately.

title: Spicy Bhujia Paratha
cooking_instructions: Knead a smooth and semi-firm dough using the flour, salt and water. Rest for 10 mins.
Add the ingredients to a bowl and mix well to get a well combined mixture and set aside.
Divide the dough, roll the roundels flat, thin and large discs. Apply ghee/ oil.
Make a slit on one end. Place the mixture and enfold into a triangle. Apply ghee after each fold, or as needed.Dust lightly with flour and roll gently into triangles.
Cook on a preheated tava with ghee/oil as needed until brown, spotted and cooked through. Serve it hot.

title: Bebinca
cooking_instructions: In a bowl whisk the egg yolks and 250 gms of sugar, add the powdered spices as well.
Alternatively and the flour and coconut milk to make a smooth batter.
Finally add the melted butter and ghee and whisk well to combine.
Divide the batter amongst 3 bowls.
Take the reserved 200 gms of sugar and add it to a sauce pan, add a little water and caramelize the sugar until golden brown.
Transfer this caramel to the bowls of batter in different ratios for varying colours. Now you should be left with 3 coloured batters

Grease and line a baking pan with parchment paper. Pour each batter in a fixed sequence and bake for 5 mins in between each addition. Continue the process until the batters are over, make sure to add equal quantities of each to get even layers.
Bake for 20 mins after adding the last layer. Allow the dessert to cool for an hour.
Demould and Slice it evenly. It is best served with vanilla ice cream.

title: Focaccia
cooking_instructions: In a bowl add 1 ¼ tbsp yeast and 1 cup water and let it bloom.
In another bowl add the dry ingredients and olive 3 tbsp olive oil and mix it well.
Add the yeast and water mixture and knead it to a soft, elastic dough
Transfer the dough into a bowl with flour dusted on the base and sides and cover it with a cloth.
Let the dough ferment for 1 hour.
Give the dough a knockback and let it ferment for another 30 minutes
In a sheet pan, brush olive oil evenly on the base and sides, transfer the dough to the sheet pan and spread the dough evenly from end to end.
Make little crevices with your fingers on the dough.
Add the olives and rosemary on the dough and press it in.
Brush olive oil on top.
Bake it at 180 degrees celsius for the first 20 minutes and at 200 degrees for 15 minutes.

title: Souvlaki
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, add 2 tbsp olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, hung curd, lemon juice, salt, pepper, oregano and mix it till it all combines.
Add the chicken, mix it till the marinade coats evenly on every piece. Let it marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour.
Skewer the chicken, bell peppers and onions alternatively.
Heat a grill pan, add oil and grill the skewered chicken evenly on all sides.Keep basting it with oil and make sure grill marks appear on both sides and the chicken is cooked all the way through.
Arrange it on a plate. Serve it hot along with tzatziki.

title: Crispy Thread Chicken
cooking_instructions: To the chicken, add all the other ingredients and marinate.
Bring a pot of water to a boil and season with salt. Add the noodles and boil until soft, following the time given on the package.
Drain the noodles completely. Add the cornflour and mix evenly.
Place a few strands of noodles on a plate. Place a piece of marinated chicken and start rolling from one side.
Deep-fry them until the noodles turn crispy, turning them gently halfway through.

title: Cashew Pakoda
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, mix the besan and rice flour. Add all the ingredients except the cashew, hot oil and water. Mix well so that the ingredients are distributed evenly.
Add hot oil and mix using your fingers to form crumbs.
Add the cashews and mix. Add water and mix to form a stiff dough. Mould it into a rough shape.

Add small roughly shaped pieces of the mixture into the oil over medium-low heat. Fry until it reaches a golden brown colour, around 6-8 minutes depending on the size. Remove from the oil and allow it to cool slightly and turn crisp.
Fry curry leaves in the same oil and sprinkle them over the fried Pakoda. Serve it with tea. Store it in an airtight container for 5 days.

title: Chocolate Pot de Creme
cooking_instructions: Heat the milk and cream together, pour over the chopped chocolate and allow it to melt.
Whisk in the egg yolks and divide into portion bowls. Place the bowls in a baking pan and pour hot water to half the height to create a water bath.
Bake in a preheated oven at 170C for 20 mins. Then chill it for 2 hours in the refrigerator and serve it chilled

title: White Sauce Chicken Pasta
cooking_instructions: Bring water to boil in a pot, cover and cook the pasta in the boiling water for 9 mins.
Drain the pasta and add 1 tsp of Olive oil to prevent the pasta from sticking on to each other.
In a pan, add 1 tsp of Olive oil, and chicken. Season this with ¼ tsp of salt and ¼ tsp of pepper. Cook the chicken for 3 mins. Remove the chicken from the pan.
In the same pan, add 1 tsp of Olive oil, 1 tbsp of butter.
Add finely chopped garlic to the pan and saute for 30 seconds.
Add 2 tbsp of maida to the pan, stir until maida and butter are mixed.
Add milk to the pan.
Add oregano, basil, salt and pepper.
By the time the sauce comes together and starts to thicken, add ½ cup of Cheddar Cheese. Add the cooked pasta and mix it with the sauce. And finally add the cooked chicken to the pan and mix well.
Remove from heat and serve.

title: Tava Sheermal
cooking_instructions: Soak the saffron 2 tbsp of warm water for 10 mins.
In a bowl combine the maida, sugar, ghee, cardamom powder and knead a soft dough with the milk and saffron. Rest the dough for 30 mins, covered.
Divide equally into 4 roundels.
Roll the dough into discs using maida. Dock the dough with a knife.
Cook on a hot tava using ghee generously until golden brown.

title: Langar Wali Dal
cooking_instructions: Add the soaked urad dal dal and chana dal in a pressure cooker with salt and turmeric powder and pressure cook for 6 whistles, on high flame. Allow the steam to escape naturally.
In a kadai, heat ghee and add the bay leaf, cumin seeds.
Add the chopped garlic, ginger and green chillies.
Add the onions and saute until light brown.
Add the tomatoes and cook until mushy. Add the red chilli powder, garam masala, coriander powder and season with salt. Sprinkle some water and cook until dry again. Add Sugar and mix it well.
Add the dal, mix it well. Cover and simmer for 10 mins.
Finish with butter and chopped coriander leaves. Serve it hot with rice or roti.

title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
cooking_instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Season with salt. Add the spaghetti and cook for 7-8 minutes or as per the package instructions. Do not overcook it.
Reserve some of the pasta water for later use. Drain the spaghetti, toss with some oil and set aside.
In a pan, heat olive oil and add sliced garlic. Saute on medium-low heat until it barely starts turning brown. Add the red chilli flakes and mix to infuse the flavour into the oil.
Add the reserved pasta water and bring it to a simmer. Add the cooked spaghetti and the chopped parsley. Continue cooking on high heat while mixing continuously until it forms a creamy consistency.
Adjust the seasoning by adding some salt. Finish with a drizzle of lemon juice and serve warm.
Serve it in a bowl. Use tongs and serve it in a slightly twisted heap. Optionally, grate some parmesan cheese on top.

title: Kaara Boondi
cooking_instructions: Mix all the dry ingredients together.
Add water and mix to form a thick but flowing batter.
Using a flat perforated ladle/spoon, drop the batter into hot oil. Make sure that the oil is hot enough while frying.
Deep fry until crisp and the oil has stopped sizzling. Remove it onto kitchen towel/tissue to absorb the excess oil.
Fry cashew until golden brown. And then fry curry leaves in the oil, until they turn crispy. Add that to the boondhi.
Mix them all along with Kashmiri chilli powder and asafoetida until evenly combined.

title: Chicken Changezi
cooking_instructions: Marinate the chicken with the given marinade ingredients for 20-30 mins.
For the gravy paste, heat oil in a pan, add the green chillies, cashew nuts and onions, saute until golden brown.
Add some water and blend into a fine puree.
Heat ghee in a pan and saute the chicken for about 8 mins.
Puree the tomatoes and set aside.
For the gravy, heat oil and add ginger garlic paste, saute for 2 mins.
Add the tomato puree and cook until thick and no longer raw in aroma.
Add the powdered spices, salt and the onion paste. Saute until the oil releases.
Add the chicken, milk and water and simmer for 5 minutes. Finish with crushed kasuri methi and chaat masala. Serve it hot.

title: Paneer Teriyaki
cooking_instructions: For the Teriyaki sauce, combine all the ingredients and whisk together until smooth. Set it aside.
Dust the paneer pieces lightly in cornstarch and shake off all the excess. Deep-fry on medium-high heat just until it turns crispy and the colour starts to turn slightly golden.
Heat oil in a pan over high heat. Add the spring onion, onion and capsicum pieces. Saute for 1 minute on high heat.
Add the sauce and simmer it just until it thickens.
