Add the paneer pieces and mix gently. Garnish with toasted white sesame seeds.

title: Chicken Schnitzel
cooking_instructions: Cut the chicken along the middle, lengthwise to get 2 slices from one chicken breast.
Place the chicken on a cutting board, cover it with cling wrap. Hammer the chicken breasts gently till it becomes a little flat and set it aside.
In a bowl, Add mustard, thyme, oil, salt, pepper and lemon juice, parsley and mix it well till it all combines.
Brush this marinade on the flattened chicken slices on both sides evenly and let it marinate for 10-15 minutes.
Coat the marinated chicken in the flour first, then eggs and finally the bread crumbs. Repeat the same for all slices.
Heat oil in a kadai for deep frying. Once the oil is hot, fry the crumbed chicken slices till it turns golden brown.
Transfer the chicken to a plate, garnish it with chopped parsley and lemon slices. Serve it hot with a salad on the side.

title: Spinach & Corn Empanadas
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, mix flour, salt, sugar, egg water and vinegar and knead it to a soft dough and keep it aside.
Blanch Spinach and keep it aside.
In a pan, heat oil, add garlic and saute until it is brown.
Add onions and saute it for a minute.
Add the corn kernels and cook it till it gets some colour on it.
Add 4 tablespoons of tomato puree and cook it well.
Add the blanched spinach, season the mixture, check the taste and keep the mixture aside.
Take the dough, dust it with flour, divide it into half. Take one half and roll it out into a big thin sheet.
Use a round cutter and cut as many roundels/circles of dough as possible.
Prepare a thick maida batter in a bowl and keep it aside.

Spoon the spinach and corn filling in the center of each piece of dough and some grated cheddar on top of it. And spread the maida batter around the ends of the cut dough. Fold it into a half-moon and press the ends and seal it. Press the ends with a fork to create a pattern.
Heat oil in a kadai, and deep fry the empanadas on a medium flame till both sides are of a golden brown colour.

title: Berry and Lemon Loaf
cooking_instructions: Preheat an oven at 160° C.
Combine the streusel ingredients and bring it all together until it forms a crumble and then set to one side.
Whisk the eggs, and sugar till thick and foamy, almost a ribbon like consistency.
Sieve in the dry ingredients and whisk gently to just combine the mixture, do not over-mix.

Pour in the oil and cream and mix until evenly combined . Add maida in the berries and mix well to coat. Fold in the berries to the batter. Pour into a greased & lined loaf tin upto ¾ of the height. Top with the streusel and then bake for about 80-90 mins , a skewer should come out clean.
De-mold and cool completely. Slice into thick slices.

title: Coconut Sevai
cooking_instructions: To cook ready-made vermicelli, soak the vermicelli in boiling water for 5 mins. Strain and set aside.
Heat the oil and ghee and splutter the mustard seeds. Add the urad dal, cashew nuts,  curry leaves. ginger and chilies and saute for a minute. And then add coconut.
Add the cooked vermicelli and toss with salt to season.

title: Lemon Sevai
cooking_instructions: To cook ready-made vermicelli, soak the vermicelli in boiling water for 5 mins. Strain and set aside.

Add mustard seeds to a pan. When the mustard seeds start to splutter, add the split urad dal, chana dal, dry red chilli, peanuts and green chilli. Saute until the chana dal starts to turn golden brown. Add in the curry leaves, asafoetida, salt, and turmeric powder.
Add the cooked sevai, lemon juice and sugar. Mix well. Taste and adjust the salt. Add chopped coriander leaves. Mix well and turn off the heat.

title: Baingan Bharta
cooking_instructions: Make 4 slits lengthwise in the brinjal, stuff 2 garlic cloves and 1 piece of green chilli then, coat the large brinjal with 1 tsp of oil.
Roast on an open flame until the skin is charred, for about 7 minutes.
Rest until cool enough to handle and then de-skin the brinjal. Mince the brinjal using a knife.
For the masala: heat oil in a pan and add the chopped ginger and garlic. Saute until aromatic. Add the onions and saute until they turn translucent.
Add the chopped green chillies and then the tomatoes. Cook until they turn soft.
Add the powdered spices, season with salt and cook for 3 mins on a low flame.
Add the minced brinjal. Stir well. Finish with chopped coriander leaves and lemon juice. Serve with roti, parathas or rice.

title: Easy Garlic Laccha Paratha
cooking_instructions: Knead a smooth and semi-firm dough using the flour, salt and water. Rest for 10 mins.
Combine the melted butter, salt, garlic, red chilli flakes and coriander leaves and set aside.
Divide the dough into roundels and use some dusting flour roll into thin large circles.
Apply the prepared garlic butter and make vertical incisions ¾ of the way. Dust some flour on top.
Roll up the incisions and then into concentric circles.
Dust lightly with flour and roll them flat.
Cook on a medium hot tava with some more oil/ butter until golden brown and crispy.
Fluff up before serving.

title: Sindhi Aloo Tuk
cooking_instructions: Peel and cut the potatoes in half. Soak them in cold water for a few minutes and rinse well to wash off excess starch. Lay out the potatoes on a cloth and allow them to dry out, dab off any excess water, if needed.
Add the potatoes into hot oil and cook until tender but still firm, a skewer or fork inserted must go in with resistance.
Strain the potatoes from the oil and allow them to cool for 5 mins.
Place them curved side down on a chopping board and press them until they flatten out.
Re-fry the potatoes until golden brown and crispy.
Heat oil in a pan and add the masalas, cook them for a minute and toss the crispy potatoes in the masala until well coated. Serve hot, garnished with lemon slices and coriander sprigs.

title: Coriander Chicken Curry
cooking_instructions: Heat oIl in a pan, add the cumin seeds, garlic and let it crackle.
Add the cashew nuts, green chillies and cook it till the cashews are slightly brown
Add the Coconut, saute it for a while. Add the coriander roots and cook it for a minute.
Transfer the mixture to a blender, add water and blend it to a fine paste.
In another pan, heat oil, add cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, cumin, green chillies, curry leaves and let it crackle.
Add the onions, saute them till they turn golden brown.
Add the ginger garlic paste and cook it for a few seconds.
Add turmeric and coriander powder. Cook it for a minute.
Add the chicken and mix it till it coats with the masala.
Add water, mix well. Cover and cook the chicken for 15 minutes on a medium flame, stirring occasionally.
Add the coriander paste, Mix it till the chicken is coated evenly. Season it with salt, pepper and sugar.
Cover and cook the chicken for 5 minutes on a medium flame, stirring occasionally.
Transfer the chicken to a bowl. Garnish it with chopped coriander. Serve it with rice, chapati/paratha or dosa.

title: Pita Chips
cooking_instructions: Cut the cooked pita bread into smaller pieces in the shape of your choice.
Deep fry in hot oil for about 30 secs until golden brown and drain from the oil.
Cool completely and serve with the dips of your choice. Store them airtight for up to 5 days.

title: Baba Ghanoush
cooking_instructions: Coat the big brinjal in oil and roast them over an open flame until charred. Rest them for 5 minutes or until cool enough to handle.
Peel the charred skins off completely.
Using a knife, mash the brinjals by finely mincing.
Transfer the egg plant to a bowl, mix the salt, lemon juice and olive oil.
Add the chopped vegetables and herbs and mix well.
Finally add the mix the pomegranate seeds.
Garnish with mint sprigs, pomegranate seeds and olive oil.

title: Parsi Chicken Farcha
cooking_instructions: Grind all the ingredients for the marination into a smooth paste.
Make slits on the chicken pieces. Add the marination to the chicken and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Add the chicken directly into a pan. Add a splash of water, cover and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove the chicken pieces from the pan and allow to cool slightly.
Season the Breadcrumbs with salt and pepper.
Add the eggs to a bowl. Add salt and coriander leaves, and beat well. Coat the chicken pieces completely in the breadcrumbs and then in the egg mixture.
Deep fry them on medium-low heat until golden brown on all sides.

title: Sweet Egg Toast
cooking_instructions: For the egg mixture, whisk together the egg, milk, sugar, saffron, condensed milk and cardamom powder.
Heat ghee in a pan. Dip the bread in the egg mixture and cook on a tava on medium heat.
Serve with honey and chopped nuts.

title: White Chocolate Blondies
cooking_instructions: Combine the butter and chocolate in a bowl. Melt and combine well in bursts of 30 seconds, stirring in between or on a double boiler.
Once slightly cooled, whisk in the sugar and eggs. The mixture must be smooth and glossy.
Finally add the dry ingredients, the flour, salt and baking soda and the chocolate chips/ bits. Do not over mix the batter.
Transfer to a lined and greased baking pan. Top with more chocolate, if needed.
Bake in a preheated oven at 170°C for 20-25 mins. Let it cool down completely, probably for an hour before cutting it and serving.

title: Pomegranate Mojito
cooking_instructions: Put the pomegranate seeds into a glass or a bowl with high sides. Use a muddler/wooden rolling pin to smash the pomegranate seeds and extract the juice.
Strain the juice in a glass and add lemon juice.
Pour it into a tall glass. Fill the glass with ice cubes, alternating with lemon slices and mint leaves. Fill the rest of the glass with sprite, and serve cold!

title: Roasted Pumpkin Soup
cooking_instructions: Cut the pumpkin into large wedges.
Add the pumpkin to a roasting pan along with garlic (with skin). Apply oil on them and season with salt.  Roast it in an oven preheated to 180 c for 45 minutes or until the pumpkin is tender.
Once roasted, scoop out the flesh of the pumpkin using a spoon. Remove the peel from the garlic and set aside.
Heat butter and oil in a pan. Add the onion and saute until translucent.
Add Kashmiri chilli powder, coriander powder, black pepper powder, nutmeg and cinnamon powder. Saute for 1 minute.
Add the roasted garlic and pumpkin. Add the stock/water and bring it to a boil.
Allow it to simmer for 5 minutes. Add the cream and turn off the heat immediately.
Once it has cooled down slightly, add the pumpkin mixture to a blender. Blend into a fine mixture, adding stock/water to adjust the consistency.
Garnish with cream and toasted pumpkin seeds. Serve with bread or salad, or by itself.

title: Tomato Rasam
cooking_instructions: Dry roast the ingredients for the rasam masala powder until aromatic for 5 minutes on medium heat.
Powder in a mixer grinder and set aside.
For the rasam, heat ghee in a pot over medium heat, add the mustard seeds, once they splutter, add the cumin and fenugreek seeds. Fry until aromatic, for 2 mins.
Add the curry leaves, whole red chilli and crushed garlic cloves. Add the roughly chopped tomatoes, salt and turmeric and saute for 4 mins, until mushy.
Add the rasam powder and asafoetida mix well for a further 2 mins.
Add the chopped coriander leaves. Pour water and simmer for 10 mins. Serve hot with rice.

title: Mushroom Fried Rice
alternate_titles: Easy To Make Mushroom Fried Rice
cooking_instructions: Heat Oil in a wok, add ginger, garlic, shallots and saute for a few seconds
Add the carrot and beans. Toss them on a high flame for a few seconds.
Add the diced mushroom, toss it. If it lets out water, cook it till all the water evaporates.
Add the cooked rice. Toss it till all ingredients combine evenly.
Add the salt, Pepper, Soy Sauce, and msg. Add spring onions. Toss and mix well.
Transfer it to a bowl. Garnish it with spring onions. Serve it hot.

title: Veechu Parotta
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl, add maida, salt, sugar and water.
Combine the flour and mix it to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 15 minutes by continuously folding the dough.
Add 1 tbsp of oil on dough and rest for 60 minutes.
Make individual 2-inch dough balls.
Add 2 tbsp of oil on the dough balls and rest for 30 minutes.
Take a dough ball and flatten as thin as possible by forming a large circle either by hand or using a rolling pin. Apply oil on the spread dough.
Place the spread dough on the tawa and fold it into a square.
Apply oil and cook on both sides for 2 minutes. Serve it hot.

title: Egg Veechu Parotta
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl, add maida, salt, sugar and water.
Combine the flour and mix it to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 15 minutes by continuously folding the dough.
Add 1 tbsp of oil on dough and rest for 60 minutes.
Make individual 2-inch dough balls.
Add 2 tbsp of oil on the dough balls and rest for 30 minutes.
Take a dough ball and flatten as thin as possible by forming a large circle by hand or using a rolling pin. Apply oil on the spread dough.
Prepare the egg mixture by beating eggs with salt, pepper and Chicken Salna.
Place the spread dough on the tawa and add the egg mixture. Fold the Parotta into a square encasing the egg mixture.
Sprinkle some oil, flip and cook on both sides. Serve it hot.

title: Chicken Ceylon Parotta
cooking_instructions: In a mixing bowl, add maida, salt, sugar and water.
Combine the flour and mix it to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 15 minutes by continuously folding the dough.
Add 1 tbsp of oil on dough and rest for 45 minutes.
Make individual 2-inch dough balls.
Add 2 tbsp of oil on the dough balls and rest for 30 minutes.
Take a dough ball and flatten as thin as possible by forming a large circle by hand or using a rolling pin. Apply oil on the spread dough.
Heat a tawa and place the spread parotta dough on the tawa. Place the cooked Chicken Kheema inside the spread dough and fold it into a packet.
Add oil, flip and cook on both sides. Serve it hot

title: Chicken a La King
cooking_instructions: Combine all the ingredients for the stock, bring to a boil and simmer for 15 mins until the chicken is tender.
Strain the stock and set aside. Reserve the chicken dices and the carrots.
Whisk the egg yolk and cream to make a liaison and set aside.
In a pan, for the sauce, melt butter and add the garlic. Add the maida, cook for 2 mins. Gently whisk in the chicken stock followed by milk.
To prepare the final dish, in the prepared sauce switch off the flame and whisk in the egg yolk and cream mixture to create a velvety and rich sauce.
Heat butter on a high heat and saute the mushroom and capsicum. Add into the prepared sauce and combine well. Add the carrots and chicken back. Finish with parsley. Serve hot with herbed rice.

title: Batter Chappati
cooking_instructions: Combine the wheat flour, salt, ghee and water and whisk to get a runny, smooth and lump free batter.
Pour the batter on a preheated non-stick tava on a low flame. Do not spread the batter much.
Allow the surface to completely dry out then flip it over to the other side.
Allow both sides to cook well, keep pressing gently with a ladle.
The chapati will begin to puff up, gently encourage the steam build up by pressing gently with the ladle. Increase the flame to medium and cook to desired colour. Apply ghee as needed before serving.

title: Hasselback Potatoes
cooking_instructions: Wash the potatoes thoroughly. Slice them evenly but not all the way through so that the bottom of the potato is intact.
In a bowl of melted butter, add chopped garlic and parsley. Mix them well till they combine.

Arrange the potatoes on a baking tray. Generously brush the flavoured butter on the potatoes and inside the gaps of each slice. Keep the remaining butter aside. Season the potatoes with salt and pepper.
Bake it at 180 degrees celsius for one hour. Keep basting the potatoes with the reserved butter at regular intervals.
Prepare a cheese melt but heating up cream, add the grated cheddar and mix it till the cheese melts.
Garnish it with parsley

title: Paneer Gulnar
cooking_instructions: Cut the paneer into thick squares and cut through the center from the side to make a pocket. Keep it aside.
Blend raw mango with the other ingredients into a fine chutney.
Spread the Chutney into the paneer pockets. Keep the remaining chutney aside. And add a little stuffing into the paneer pocket.
Prepare a batter out of besan flour and the other ingredients.
Dip the paneer in the batter and deep fry them to a golden brown color.
Serve it hot with the chutney on the side.

title: Berry and White Chocolate Cookies
cooking_instructions: Pre-heat the oven at 200°C
Thaw the frozen berries by microwaving for a minute.
Whisk the butter and sugar until light and fluffy, along with the berries.
Add the dry ingredients and mix well, finally fold in the white chocolate. And chill the batter for 20-30 mins.
Portion using a tablespoon and bake for 12-15 mins at 200°C.

title: Prawn & Half-Boil Dosa
cooking_instructions: In a pan, heat oil and add the fennel seeds and cumin seeds, followed by the curry leaves and green chillies.  And then add the shallots and saute until the shallots barely start to turn golden brown.
Add the ginger garlic paste, masala powders and salt. Saute for a minute.
Add the tomatoes and saute for 5 minutes or until the masala is completely cooked and the oil floats along the sides.
Add the prawns. Saute and cook for 3-4 minutes. Turn off the heat and set aside.
Per Portion: Grease a flat iron or non-stick pan on medium heat. Pour dosa batter and spread it around the pan thinly.
Spoon the prawn gravy in a circle. Break open an egg in the centre.  Then sprinkle salt on the eggs. Sprinkle pepper powder and chopped coriander leaves on the eggs and the prawn.
Cover and cook for 1-2 minutes. Serve hot!

title: Crepe
cooking_instructions: Combine the given ingredients to make a smooth and thin batter.
Pour the ladle full on a preheated non-stick pan on medium heat, flip the crepes after they set, in a minute.
Apply Nutella and place the bananas, fold to make a half-moon and fold again to make a conical shape. Dust them with icing sugar.

title: Kerala Raw Mango Curry
cooking_instructions: In an earthen pot/pan, mix the raw mango, shallots, ginger, green chilli and curry leaves along with all the spice powders, salt and vinegar. Allow it to rest for 15 minutes.
Place the pot over the stove. Add the water and bring it to a boil. Simmer until the mangoes soften.
For the tempering, heat oil in a pan. Add the mustard seeds and allow it to splutter. Add the curry leaves and dried red chillies.
Add the coconut milk. Turn off the heat as soon as it comes to a simmer.Transfer the curry to a bowl. Garnish it with the tempering. Mix and serve with rice!

title: Prawn Recheado
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, add kashmiri red chillies, ginger, garlic, whole spices, turmeric, tamarind pulp,  salt, sugar and 3 tbsp vinegar and let it soak for 35-40 minutes.
Blend the marinade to a thick fine paste
Mix the marinade with the prawns till it coats evenly on every prawn and let it marinate for 1 hour.
Heat a pan, add oil. Add the sliced onions, saute them till they are golden brown.
Add the marinated prawns and cook it till oil splutters from the sides and the prawns are cooked.
Transfer it to a plate, garnish it with chopped coriander and a lemon wedge. Serve it hot.

title: Moong Dal Pakoda
cooking_instructions: Wash the moong dal and soak for 4 hours. Drain the water completely from the soaked dal. Grind the moong dal, cumin seeds, and carom seeds into a coarse paste.
Add all the other ingredients in a bowl and mix well.
Using wet hands, put small amounts of the mixture into hot oil. Fry on medium-high heat until crisp and golden brown.

title: Vegetable Coconut Sambar
cooking_instructions: Soak the tamarind in ½ cup of water.
Wash and pressure cook the dal for 3 whistles with 3 Cups of water.
On a low flame, roast all the ingredients for the masala until aromatic, transfer to a mixer grinder and add the grated coconut. Grind to a smooth paste with ½ Cup of water.
For the preparation: heat oil and splutter the mustard seeds, add the shallots and saute for 2 minutes. Add the curry leaves.
Add the vegetables, tamarind pulp, salt, asafoetida, jaggery and turmeric powder.
Cover and Simmer for 10 mins.
Add the dal and adjust the consistency with water, as needed.
Add the masala paste and further simmer for 5 mins.
Finish with coriander leaves. Serve it hot with rice.

title: Afghani Chicken
cooking_instructions: Marinate the chicken with salt and lemon juice.
For the paste, combine the ingredients and blend to a fine paste, adding water as needed.
Add this paste to curd and whisk well. Add the fresh cream and kasuri methi also.
Add the chicken to this mixture and marinate for a minimum of 60 mins.
Heat butter in a pan and sear the chicken pieces on all sides. Set aside the chicken.
Add the marination to the pan after searing the chicken pieces.
Cover and simmer for 20 mins. And finish with fresh coriander leaves, ginger and green chillies.

title: Mexican Street Style Corn
cooking_instructions: To a hot pan, add butter, the sweet corn kernels and salt. Toss occasionally and cook for around 5 minutes or until softened and cooked.
Transfer it to a large bowl and allow it to cool. Add red chilli powder, lemon juice, coriander leaves, cheese and mayonnaise. Mix until evenly combined.
Crush a pack of cheetos by opening the packet first and then pounding it using a pan or rolling pin.
Transfer it to serving bowls or cups. Spread some cheese on top followed by mayonnaise. Sprinkle the Cheetos dust over the creamy corn and serve.

title: Cafe Mocha
cooking_instructions: Add the dark chocolate into a cup and top it with hot water. Allow it to sit for 2 minutes. Once the chocolate has started to melt, mix it.
Add instant coffee and salt, and mix again.
Foam the milk using a beater or a milk frother. Alternatively, in a heatproof tight jar, add the milk and sugar. Shake it vigorously for 30 seconds, taking care that it doesn’t spill.
Pour the foamed milk into the coffee chocolate mix. Dust it with some cocoa powder to garnish.

title: Tandoori Mint Chutney
cooking_instructions: In a mixer jar, add in the coriander leaves, mint leaves, cumin powder, chaat masala, lemon juice, salt and water. You can also add the young/tender stalks of the coriander leaves for the chutney. Grind it into a fine paste.
In a bowl, whisk the curd until it turns smooth.
Add the paste to the curd and whisk well again.

title: Wheat and Oats Pancake
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, add the wheat, oats, baking soda and water. Whisk it well to form a thick batter.
Heat another pan, add chopped jaggery and mix it continuously till it melts. Add the syrup to the batter and mix it till it combines evenly.
Mash the bananas with a fork. Add it to the batter and mix it till it combines evenly.
Heat a pan/tawa, add oil/butter. Pour a ladle of batter on the pan. Let it cook on low flame till pores start to appear and the side on the pan is golden brown. Flip it over and cook it for a minute.
Transfer it to a plate, Garnish it with powdered sugar, honey and sliced bananas. Serve it hot.

title: Wheat and Oats Utthappam
alternate_titles: Vegan wheat and oats savoury pancake,
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, add wheat, oats, baking soda, salt, and water. Whisk it well to form a thick batter.
Add onion, curry leaves, green chili, ginger to the batter and mix evenly
Heat a pan/tawa, add oil. Pour a ladle of batter on the pan. Add Idli Podi as needed. Flip it over and cook for 2 minutes.
Transfer it to a plate and serve with coconut chutney

title: Easy Chicken Varuval
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds, green chillies, curry leaves and let it crackle.
Add the sliced onions, saute it till it turns slightly brown.
Add the chicken and cook it for 2-3 minutes. Keep mixing continuously.
Season it with salt, pepper. Keep mixing till the mixture gets some colour.
Add water and mix the chicken well. Add Sugar and mix it well.
Transfer it to a bowl. Garnish it with chopped coriander leaves. Serve it hot.

title: 1 Bowl Bread
cooking_instructions: Combine the ingredients in a bowl and mix well to combine and bring together a dough.
Cover and rest for 2 hours.
Release the dough from the bowl and transfer to a greased bowl.
Allow the dough to rise again for 30 mins.
Bake in a preheated oven at 180C for 40 mins. Cool for 20-30 mins and slice into thick slices

title: Apple Pie Oats
cooking_instructions: Mix all the ingredients together (except toppings) and place in a glass/jar. Cover and refrigerate overnight or for a minimum of 2 hours.
Add the toppings and it’s ready for consumption.

title: Corn and Paneer Cutlet
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, add the blended corn, grated paneer, onion, green chilli, wheat floor, garlic powder, chaat masala powder, salt, and black pepper powder. Mix it till they all combine evenly.
Divide and shape it into evenly sized patties.
Heat a tawa, add olive oil, Grill the patties to a golden brown colour on both sides. Serve it hot with ketchup or any dip of your choice.

title: Quick Tandoori Chicken
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, mix the mustard oil and Kashmiri chilli powder. Add all the other ingredients for the marination except curd
Add the chicken and mix. Add the curd, mix and set aside.
Heat oil in a pan. Add the chicken and cook on medium heat until cooked through around 7-9 minutes.

Remove the chicken from the pan and into a metal phulka grill, or a metal strainer used for deep-frying. Show the chicken over direct flame for around 2 minutes, flipping occasionally. This step is for the colour and smoky flavour.
Add the chicken into a bowl. Add melted butter, chaat masala and coriander leaves. Toss it and serve with mint chutney, onion and lemon wedges.

title: Mango Coconut Oats
cooking_instructions: Mix all the ingredients together (except toppings) and place in a glass/jar. Cover and refrigerate overnight or for a minimum of 2 hours.
Add the toppings and it’s ready for consumption.

title: Banana & Peanut Oats
cooking_instructions: Mix all the ingredients together (except toppings) and place in a glass/jar. Cover and refrigerate overnight or for a minimum of 2 hours.
Add the toppings and it’s ready for consumption.

title: Kadai Paneer
cooking_instructions: In a pan, dry roast the whole spices for the kadai masala, 3 minutes on a medium flame.
Transfer to a mixer grinder, add turmeric powder and make a fine powder.
For the gravy, heat oil in a kadai. Add the onions and saute until golden brown.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and saute until the raw flavour goes. Add the tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add the kadai masala and a cup of water and cook until thick again.
Add the salt and capsicum slices and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add the chopped coriander and kasuri methi. Add the paneer cubes and ghee.
Garnish with ginger julienne and chopped coriander.

title: Strawberry Oats
cooking_instructions: Mix all the ingredients together (except toppings) and place in a glass/jar. Cover and refrigerate overnight or for a minimum of 2 hours.
Add the toppings and it’s ready for consumption.

title: Creamy Curd Rice
cooking_instructions: Cook raw rice with 4 ½ cups of water for 12 minutes.
Fry the cashews and raisins in butter and keep aside.
Once the rice is cooled, add milk, curd, fresh cream, butter and salt and whisk together.
Add the fried cashews, raisins, pomegranate kernels and grapes to the curd rice.
Serve as the last course of a meal.

title: Deep Blue Mocktail
cooking_instructions: In a glass, add the lemon slices, mint leaves and sugar. Muddle them using a muddler or any wooden object. Add in 1 Cup of soda water and 1 tbsp of blue curacao.
Strain it and set aside.
In a tall glass, fill halfway with ice cubes. Add 3 tbsp of the blue curacao syrup.
Gently add more ice cubes almost to the brim of the glass.
Gently pour in the strained soda water, filling up to 3/4th of the glass.
Fill up the glass with plain soda water.
Squeeze a piece of orange peel through a burning matchstick.
Garnish with an orange slice or orange peel.

title: Frozen Grape Daiquiri
cooking_instructions: Blend the frozen grapes, ice, honey and lemon juice together in a blender until smooth.
Pour into the glass.
Pour grenadine into the glass. Serve it cold

title: Simple Coconut Curry
cooking_instructions: Blanch the babycorn and mushroom in salted water with some turmeric powder, strain and set aside. The baby corn must be tender, add the mushroom for the last 2 mins.
Heat oil and add the mustard seeds, fennel seeds, fenugreek seeds and curry leaves.
Add the sliced ginger, small onions and slit green chillies. Saute until aromatic. Add turmeric powder and salt.
Add the blanched mushroom and babycorn.
Add coconut milk and a mixture of water and cornstarch to thicken the gravy. Simmer for 2-3 mins.
Finish with fresh curry leaves and coconut oil.

title: Blue Iceberg Slushie
cooking_instructions: Soak the butterfly pea flowers in the hot water for 10 minutes. When it cools down to room temperature, pour it into an ice tray and freeze it into ice cubes, for at least 4 hours.
In a blender jar, lightly crush the ice and set aside.
Lightly crush the blue ice cubes, that have been infused with the flowers.
Fill the serving glass halfway with the plain crushed ice.
Fill the rest of the glass with the blue crushed ice.
Squeeze the lemon over the ice. The colour will start to get enhanced.
Top it up with the sprite.
Garnish with a lemon slice.

title: Onion Uthappam
cooking_instructions: Combine all the ingredients for the onion mixture together.
Heat a tawa to a high temperature. Add a ladle of the dosa batter. Holes will begin to appear in a few seconds.
Spread some of the onion mixture on the Uthappam. Gently press the toppings. Drizzle oil over it. Reduce the flame to medium and cook for 1 minute.
Flip and cook for 2 minutes. Remove from the pan and serve hot.

title: Vegetable Uthappam
cooking_instructions: Combine all the ingredients for the vegetable mixture together.
Heat a tawa to a high temperature. Add a ladle of the dosa batter. Holes will begin to appear in a few seconds.
Spread some of the vegetable mixture on the Uthappam. Gently press the toppings. Drizzle oil over it. Reduce the flame to medium and cook for 1 minute.
Flip and cook for 2 minutes. Remove from the pan and serve hot.

title: Cream of Spinach Soup
cooking_instructions: Heat butter in a pan and add the ginger,garlic, green chillies and onions, saute until the onions are translucent.
Add the cleaned and chopped spinach and saute until tender. Season with salt and pepper.
Grind the spinach until it becomes a smooth paste.
Heat butter in a pot and add the maida, slowly whisk in the milk to make a bechamel/ white sauce.
Add the puree and water to adjust the consistency.
Finish with fresh cream and nutmeg powder.
Bring it to a boil and switch off the heat. Garnish with fresh cream.

title: Chicken Sausage Roll-ups
cooking_instructions: Add oil to a pan and cook the chicken sausage as per package instructions. Remove the sausages from the pan.

Add garlic and onion to the pan. Cook until the onion turns translucent. Add all the spice powders, tomato ketchup and capsicum. Cook for 3 minutes on medium heat. Add coriander leaves and turn off the heat.
To assemble the rolls, spread the cheese inside a chapathi. Place some of the mixture on the cheese and then place the sausage. Roll it up.
Heat oil in a pan and place the edges of the roll facing down. Cook until crisp on all sides.
Cut it into manageable slices and place it on a skewer. Serve on a platter.

title: Pan Fried Chicken Momo
cooking_instructions: Knead a soft dough using the lukewarm water, salt and maida. Rest it for 20 mins.
For the filling: combine all the ingredients and mix well.
Cut the dough into smaller portions even-sized portions.
Roll out the dough into flat discs using cornstarch to prevent sticking, use a round cutter for getting even-sized discs.
Place a tsp of mixture in each and seal using water.
Heat a pan with a tbsp of oil and a tsp sesame oil and sear one side of the gyoza for 2 minutes, until golden.
Add 3 tbsp of water to the pan, close and steam for 4 minutes. Open and cook to evaporate any remaining water. Garnish with spring onion.

title: Chicken Shahjahani
cooking_instructions: Soak cashew nuts, poppy seeds and melon seeds in ¾ cup of water for 30 minutes. Transfer it to a blender, add cream and curd. Blend it to a fine, thick paste. Keep it aside.
Whisk curd and cream together and keep it aside.
Heat oil in a pan, add cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, garlic, green chillies and let it crackle.
Add the chopped onions and cook till it is translucent. Cool the mixture down, transfer it to a blender and blend to a fine paste.
Heat oil, ghee and ginger garlic paste in a pan, add the onion paste, cook it for a minute
Add the dry powders and cook it for a few seconds.
Add the chicken, mix it well till it is coated evenly with the masala and cook it for a minute.
Add 1 ½ cups water and bring it to a boil. Cover and cook it for 20 minutes on a medium flame, stirring occasionally.
Add the nut paste and mix it well and bring it to a slight boil and then simmer it till the gravy thickens.
Add the curd and cream mixture to the gravy. Mix it well on a low flame
Season the gravy. Add a spoon of ghee.
Transfer it to a bowl. Garnish it with coriander leaves. Serve it hot.

title: Microwave Arrabiata Pasta
cooking_instructions: Combine the pasta and oil in a large microwave-safe bowl.
Add the cut vegetables, sauce, and seasonings.
Add water to the pasta bowl and mix it well
Microwave for 20-25 mins. Remove and mix well to combine well.
Top up with grated cheese, mixed herbs, chilli flakes and olives
Microwave for 2 mins more to melt the cheese. And serve it.

title: Chocolate and Chia Pudding
alternate_titles: Low Carb Chocolate and Chia Pudding
cooking_instructions: In a Bowl, add all the ingredients and mix it well till it combines evenly.
Pour it over a bowl and refrigerate it for 3 hours, preferably overnight.
Garnish it with any fruit or seeds of your choice. Serve it cold.

title: Brinji Rice
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan and fry the cashew on low heat until golden brown. Remove from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, fry the bread cubes on low heat. When they turn golden brown, remove them from the pan and set aside.
Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan. Add bay leaves, star anise and fennel seeds. Once it turns aromatic, add the green chilli and onion. Saute until the onion turns translucent.
Add the mint leaves, coriander leaves and ginger garlic paste. Saute for 1 minute.
Add the tomato and saute until the tomatoes soften. Then add the vegetables and mix well. Season with salt.
Add the soaked rice, coconut milk, and water. Bring it to a boil. cook until the level of the rice and water are almost equal.
Sprinkle the fried cashew and bread on top. Cover tightly, reduce the flame and cook for 10 minutes.
Mix it gently without breaking the rice. Serve with onion raita.

title: Broccoli Patties
cooking_instructions: Heat Oil in a pan, add the chopped onions and saute it till it turns translucent.
Add the chopped broccoli and saute it for a minute. Add water and keep stirring the broccoli till all the water evaporates.
Take it off the flame and let it cool down. Add cheese, bread crumbs, oil, salt and pepper, garlic powder, and mix it all till it binds evenly.
Divide it into equal portions and shape it into patties.
Heat a pan, add olive oil. Grill the patties on both sides till it turns golden brown.
Serve it hot with any dip or ketchup.

title: Orange Sunrise Mocktail
cooking_instructions: In a shaker, add the orange juice, pineapple juice, fresh cream and ice cubes. Shake well and pour it into the serving glass.
Pour the grenadine syrup into the center of the glass.
Garnish with an orange slice.

title: Corn Shorba
cooking_instructions: In a pot, heat oil and add all the whole spices (bay leaf, clove, cinnamon, coriander seeds, cumin seeds), garlic and ginger. Saute until aromatic.
Add the onion, carrot, salt and turmeric and saute for 2 mins.
Add the corn and 3 cups of water. Boil for 10 mins.
Cool the mixture, remove the bay leaf and blend it, let it remain a little chunky.
Add 1 tsp ghee to the soup base and the milk. Simmer for 6 mins.
Finish with ghee, coriander leaves and lemon juice.
Garnish with fresh cream and a pinch of garam masala powder.

title: Palak Gosht
cooking_instructions: Dry roast the spices and blend them into a fine powder.
Add the spices to the mutton with the ginger-garlic paste, powdered spices, salt.
Marinate the mutton for 30 mins.
Whisk together the curd and besan until smooth and set aside.
Blanch spinach in boiling water for 2 mins. Shock it in ice water and squeeze out the excess water, blend to a fine puree.
Pressure cook the mutton for 5 whistles with ¾ Cup of water. Allow the steam to escape naturally.
Heat oil in a kadhai and add the onions, saute until golden brown.
Add the green chillies.
Add the mutton and bring to a boil then simmer the gravy, add the curd stirring constantly.
Cover and simmer for 10 mins.
Add the palak puree into the mutton. Simmer covered for 10-12 mins. Adjust the consistency with water.
Finish with lemon juice,ghee, kasuri methi, garam masala and the ginger julienne.

title: Egg Roast
cooking_instructions: Add eggs to a saucepan, and cover the eggs with water. Bring the water to a rolling boil, cover and continue to boil the eggs for 9 minutes.
Score the eggs on the sides for the masala to seep in.
In a pan, heat the oil and add mustard seeds. Add finely chopped onion and cook until the onions turn brown.
Add Red Chilli Powder, Turmeric Powder, Cumin Powder and salt. Mix well and continue to cook for a minute. Add some water.
Add the boiled eggs and some curry leaves.
Serve hot with rice or roti.

title: Cabbage Thoran
cooking_instructions: In a large bowl, add the cabbage, coconut, green chilli, turmeric powder and salt. Mix well using your hands. Allow it to rest for 30 minutes.
In a pan, heat the coconut oil. Add mustard seeds and when they splutter, add the urad dal. Add the dry red chillies and curry leaves.
Add the cabbage mixture to the pan. Stir well and cover with a lid. Cook for 4 minutes on medium heat. Serve hot with rice.

title: Almond Chicken Curry
cooking_instructions: Boil the almonds in water until the skin becomes puffed.
Remove the skins from the almonds.
Grind into a smooth paste with all the other ingredients.
Mix the chicken with all the ingredients for the marination.
Add the almond paste and curd, and mix. Marinate for at least 20 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan and add all the whole spices. Add the green chilli and onion, saute until the onion is golden brown.
Add the chicken and saute for 5 minutes.
Add water, cover and cook for 15 minutes.
Open the lid, stir and cook until it reaches the desired consistency.
Add the Kewra water, coriander leaves and fresh cream. Turn off the heat.
Serve garnished with ginger juliennes and almond slices

title: Butter Chicken Pasta
cooking_instructions: Marinate the chicken with salt, red chilli powder and ginger garlic paste.
Heat oil in a large pan on high heat. Cook for 2-3 minutes, flipping it occasionally to get a sear on all sides. Remove the chicken from the pan.
Add butter to the pan, followed by the onion. Saute until translucent.
Add ginger garlic paste and all the spice powders. Saute for 2 minutes. Add a splash of water to prevent it from burning.
Add tomato puree and season with salt and sugar. Saute and cook for 5 minutes on low heat, stirring occasionally to prevent it from burning.
Add the seared chicken pieces, cover and cook again for 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, you can cook the pasta. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and season with salt. Add the pasta and cook for 8-9 minutes or according to package instructions. Once cooked, drain the pasta.
Add fresh cream, garam masala powder, Kasuri methi and coriander leaves. Stir until evenly combined. Add the pasta and mix it till it is coated with thew sauce. Serve it hot.

title: Fruit Jelly
cooking_instructions: Add the pineapple juice to a pan and add 2 tbsp of sugar and ¼ Cup of cornstarch. For other flavors you can follow the same process with Orange and Cranberry juice
Whisk the mixture to combine well.
Place on a flame and cook while stirring continuously until thick in consistency.
Pour the mixture into a parchment paper-lined tray greased with oil. The same procedure can be repeated for other flavours. And refrigerate for 4-5 hours until set and firm.
De-mold and coat with desiccated coconut. Cut further into small squares and coat individually with coconut on all sides.

title: Street Style Soya Fry
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the soya in hot water till it becomes soft. Strain it, squeeze the water off it and transfer it to a bowl.
Add the rest of the ingredients. Add water and mix it well till the soya chunks are coated evenly.
Heat oil in a kadai. Deep fry the soya chunks till it becomes slightly crispy.
Take it off the oil and keep it on a plate with tissue paper to let the oil drain off.
Heat a pan with oil. Add garlic, saute it for a few seconds
Add water and add the 3 sauces and mix it till it all combines evenly.
Add the soya chunks to it, toss it till it is evenly coated.
Transfer it to a bowl/plate. Garnish it with chopped onions and coriander leaves. Serve it hot.

title: Murgh Rezala
cooking_instructions: Soak poppy seeds and cashew nuts in a bowl with water. Keep it aside
Marinate the chicken with curd and ginger garlic paste and let it rest for an hour.
Boil the onions for 2 minutes, strain them.
Blend the soaked cashew nut, poppy seeds and boiled onion separately to a fine paste.
Heat oil and ghee in a pan, add cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, green chillies and let them crackle.
Add the onion paste and cook it for a few seconds on a medium flame.
Add the chicken, mix it well till it is coated evenly with the onion paste.
Add water, mix it well. Cover and cook the chicken for 10 minutes on a medium flame, stirring occasionally.
Add the red chilli powder, cashew nut paste, salt and sugar. Mix it well and cook it low low heat until it comes to a soft boil.
Transfer it to a bowl. Garnish it with Coriander leaves and fried onion. Serve it hot.

title: Garlic Pickle
cooking_instructions: Soak the tamarind in a cup of water.
In gingelly oil, fry the garlic until golden brown and set them aside to cool.
Blend to a paste, retain a few whole cloves.
In the same pan, splutter mustard seeds.
Add the curry leaves, fenugreek powder, asafoetida and the garlic paste.
On a low flame cook this mixture until the raw flavour goes.
Add 1 tbsp of chilli powder and the tamarind pulp. Add the whole cloves, too.
Cook until thick and the oil begins floating on the surface, season with salt and jaggery.
Allow the pickle to cool completely before storing it in an airtight container.

title: Chicken Margherita
cooking_instructions: Score and blanch the tomatoes, keep them in ice cold water.
Peel the skin, deseed it and chop it into chunky dices.
Heat olive oil in a pan, add garlic and saute it for a few seconds. Add the basil and cook it for a few seconds. Add the chopped tomatoes and saute for a minute.
Add the tomato puree, salt and sugar. Mix it well, add water, bring it to a boil. Cover and simmer the sauce for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season the chicken with salt, crushed black pepper and oil.
Heat oil in a non-stick pan, sear the chicken to a golden brown colour on both sides.
In a baking dish or skillet, apply sauce at the base, place the chicken over the sauce
Generously add mozzarella cheese on top. Place a roundel of tomato on each chicken breast, sprinkle julienned basil on top.
Bake it in the oven till the cheese is slightly golden brown. Serve it hot.

title: Tater Tots
cooking_instructions: Grate the potatoes and submerge them in ice cold water for 10 minutes. This removes the excess starch.
Squeeze out as much water as you can. Lay it on a cloth and allow it to dry for 5 minutes.
Add it into a pan along with butter and dried thyme. Cook on medium flame until the potatoes have softened, stirring regularly to prevent it from sticking to the bottom.
Remove it into a bowl. Allow it to slightly cool, then add corn flour, garlic powder, salt, black pepper powder and red chilli powder. Mix well.
Shape it into small oval shapes. Place it on a tray/plate and freeze for at least 45 minutes to an hour
Dust them lightly with corn flour.
Fry in hot oil until golden brown and crispy.

title: Besan Chilla
cooking_instructions: In a bowl, combine together all the ingredients except the ghee.
Mix well to form a lump-free, smooth and thick batter.
Heat a non-stick tawa and grease with ghee.
Pour the batter with a round ladle and spread to the required thickness. Add a few drops of ghee.
Flip the Chilla when browned on the underside, about 2 mins on a medium flame.
Serve with pickle or raita.

title: Goan Chilli Chicken
cooking_instructions: Grind all the ingredients for the marination.
Add it to the chicken, mix and marinate for 20 minutes.
Heat coconut oil in a pan, and add cinnamon and cloves. Add onion and saute until translucent.
Add the spice powders and salt, and mix to combine. Add tomatoes and cook until they’re softened.
Add the chicken and stir for 2 minutes. Add water, cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes.
Add all the sauces, vinegar and sugar. Cook on low heat for 4 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add green chilli and coriander leaves, and remove from the heat. Serve with pav, bread, rice or as an appetizer.

title: Olan
cooking_instructions: Wash and soak the peas for at least 5 hours. You can also soak it overnight.
In a pot, add the soaked peas and 1 cup of water and ½ tsp of salt. Boil it for 10 minutes. Check if the peas are soft, but they should not be easily mashed.
Add the diced white pumpkin along with green chillies and ½ tsp salt. Cook until the pumpkin turns translucent, around 5 minutes.
Add the thin coconut milk (2nd press) and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the thick coconut milk (1st press) and turn it off as soon as it comes to a boil.
Add coconut oil and curry leaves on top. Cover it and let it rest for 2 minutes before serving.

title: No Oven Caramel Custard
cooking_instructions: Grease a metal pan with oil and set aside.
For the caramel, heat the sugar and water together until it dissolves and turns into a deep golden colour.
Transfer it to the greased pan. Swirl the pan so that the bottom is evenly coated. Set aside to let it solidify.
In a saucepan, heat milk and sugar. It should become hot but should not boil.
In another large bowl, beat the eggs. Add the milk a little at a time while whisking continuously. Optionally, you can add vanilla essence.
Strain the mixture through a fine strainer. Pour it on the solidified caramel.
Cover it with a lid or aluminum foil. Place it in a steamer or a pot with adequate water and a metal stand on the bottom.
Steam for 25 minutes on medium heat. Check if it is done by pressing it gently with your fingers. It should bounce back lightly.
Remove the pan from the steamer and chill in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours, or for longer.
To serve, flip the custard pudding onto a plate.

title: One Pot Kerala Chicken Masala
cooking_instructions: In a heavy-bottomed pot, add all the ingredients.
Mix well using your hands.
Cover and cook on low heat for 20-25 minutes, depending on the size of your chicken pieces. Stir once or twice to ensure that it isn’t sticking.
Once it is done cooking, add some curry leaves and coconut oil on top. Turn off the flame, cover and rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with rice, appam, parotta, idiyappam or chapathi.

title: Beetroot Halwa
cooking_instructions: Wash, peel and grate the beetroots and keep aside.
In a thick bottomed pan, heat ghee. Once the ghee is hot add cashews and raisins. Once the raisins puff and cashews become golden brown, remove it from the pan.
In the same pan, add the grated beetroot and saute for 10 minutes stirring well.
Add the milk and let it simmer on low heat until the milk is absorbed.
Add the Khova, sugar, cardamom powder and mix well until everything dissolves.
Increase the heat to high and saute for 8 mins stirring continuously.
Add the cashews and raisins.
Remove from the heat, and serve the halwa warm.

title: Watermelon Granita
cooking_instructions: Freeze the watermelon cubes overnight.Add the frozen watermelon into a food processor along with the salt, lemon juice and sugar and blitz to a frozen mixture.

Transfer to a tray and fluff up with a fork, and freeze for 30 mins. Take the tray out of the fridge and run a fork through the mixture to create a snow-like texture.
Repeat the process, if needed until the mixture is like free ice granules, just like gola or snow.
Serve garnished with a mint sprig.

title: No Bake Oreo Tart
cooking_instructions: Blitz the Oreo cookies into crumbs in a food processor. You can also do this in a mixer or you could also put it in a ziplock bag and pound it with a rolling pin.
Add the melted butter and mix again briefly to combine.
Use this to line a tart pan lined with cling film/plastic wrap. Flatten using the back of a spoon. Place this in the freezer until we prepare the filling.

Bring water to a boil in a saucepan. In a heatproof bowl, add the chopped dark chocolate. Place the bowl over the saucepan. Add Cream and Buteer to the chocolate an stir constantly until the chocolate melts completely and becomes silky smooth. Allow it to cool slightly.
Pour the chocolate filling into the tart shell. Set in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours, then freeze for 1 hour before taking out the tart and slicing.

title: Doner Kebab
cooking_instructions: Grind the onion and garlic into a paste. Use a strainer to filter it into a bowl.
To the bowl, add all the other ingredients necessary for the marination and mix well. Allow it to marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil and butter in a pan. Cook the chicken pieces for 5 minutes on medium-high heat, flipping the chicken occasionally. Remove from the pan and allow it to cool slightly.
Slice into thin pieces.
Add it back into the pan with some oil and heat until slightly crisp.
For the sauce, whisk all the ingredients together until smooth.
Serve the kebab slices along with the lettuce, onion and tomato drizzled with the sauce. Serve as a wrap, between bread as a sandwich or over rice.

title: Lauki Kofta
cooking_instructions: Peel the bottle gourd, then cut into smaller pieces.
Grate it using a food processor or using a grater.
Using a muslin cloth, squeeze out the excess water. You can reserve the water to use in the gravy later.
To the grated bottle gourd, add all the ingredients except salt. Add extra besan if the mixture has too much moisture and is difficult to handle.
Add the salt and baking soda at the end. Then shape into Koftas around 1.5 inches in diameter.
Deep-fry on medium heat until it turns crisp and golden brown. Set aside.
For the gravy, heat ghee in a pan and add cumin, cinnamon, bay leaf and asafoetida. Add onion and green chilli. Saute until the onion turns a light golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste, salt and all the spice powders. Saute for 1 minute.
Add the tomato puree and mix. Cover and cook for 4-5 mins or until the oil starts to separate from the sides.
Add sugar, then water and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Add the fried Kofta and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Add the garam masala, Kasuri methi and coriander leaves. Turn off the heat. Serve hot with Roti or rice.

title: Sultani Dal
cooking_instructions: Wash the dal till water runs clear and soak for 30 minutes. Strain it and put it in the cooker. Add 1 cup of water and ½ tsp turmeric powder and cook it for 3-4 whistles, take it off the flame and let the pressure reduce gradually. Open the lid.
Mix the dal well and add milk, cream and curd to it and mix it well. Cook it on a low flame till the mixture thickens. Turn off the flame.
Place a small bowl with a hot piece of coal on top of the dal. Add a tablespoon of ghee and close the lid immediately and leave it for 5-7 minutes and then take the coal out.
In another pan, heat 2 tbsp oil, add cumin seeds, garlic, dry red chillies and let it crackle
Add the chopped onions and cook it to a golden brown color
Turn off the flame and add the red chilli powder and mix it well.
Transfer the dal mixture to the tadka, mix it well. Check the seasoning.
Top it off with a tablespoon of ghee. Garnish it with coriander sprigs. Serve it hot with rice or roti.

title: Mushroom Thokku
cooking_instructions: Heat Oil in a kadai, add mustard, cumin, green chilli and curry leaves. Let it crackle.
Add the sliced onions and saute till it turns golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and saute for a minute.
Add the spice powders and saute till it loses its raw flavor.
Add the tomatoes and let it cook till it is mashed and oil is released from the sides.
Season it with salt and sugar.
Add chopped coriander leaves. Mix it well. Keep it aside.
Heat oil in a kadai, add garlic, and saute it for a few seconds.
Add the mushrooms and saute it till it becomes soft.
Add the prepared tomato thokku, mix it well.
Add ¼ cup of water, mix it well. Add ¼ tsp of salt and garam masala.
Cook the mixture till it is semi-dry.
Garnish with coriander leaves. Serve it hot with rice/roti or any tiffin item.

title: Mixed Vegetable Thokku
cooking_instructions: Heat Oil in a kadai, add mustard, cumin, green chilli and curry leaves. Let it crackle.
Add the sliced onions and saute till it turns golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute.
Add the spice powders and saute till it loses its raw flavour.
Add the tomatoes and let it cook till it is mashed and oil is released from the sides.
Season it with salt and sugar. Mix it well.
Add chopped coriander leaves. Mix it well. Keep it aside.
Heat oil in a kadai, add the vegetables and saute them for 2 minutes. Add a pinch of salt. Mix it well
Add water, add the green peas and bring it to a boil. Let the vegetables cook for 5 minutes.
Add the prepared tomato thokku and mix it till it combines evenly into the mixture.
Add Garam masala, mix it well. Transfer it to a bowl, garnish it with chopped coriander leaves and serve it hot with dosa/idli, rice, chapati etc.

title: Mint Pesto Pasta
cooking_instructions: Combine the ingredients for the mint coriander pesto in a mixer blender, without the cheese. Pulse blend until coarse. Add the cheese and mix well. Set aside.
Boil water in a pot with salt and 1 tbsp oil. Add the pasta and cook, until tender about 10 minutes.
Drain, coat in oil and set aside. Retain a cup of the pasta water.
In a pan, heat oil over medium, add the sliced garlic and brown them, about 2 minutes. Add the sliced onions and mushroom, saute until tender.
Add the pesto paste as required and pasta water, salt and pepper.
Add the pasta and tomatoes, and toss well to coat.
Transfer to a bowl and garnish with grated cheese.

title: Fish Thokku
cooking_instructions: Heat Oil in a kadai, add mustard, cumin, green chilli and curry leaves. Let it crackle.
Add the sliced onions and saute till it turns golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and saute for a minute.
Add the spice powders and saute till it loses its raw flavour.
Add the tomatoes and let them cook till it is mashed and oil is released from the sides.
Season it with salt and sugar. Mix it well.
Add chopped coriander leaves. Mix it well. Keep it aside.
Heat oil in a pan, add ginger garlic paste, and let it cook in the oil for a few seconds.
Add the thokku and ¾ cup of water, mix it well. Add Garam masala and mix it well. Bring the thokku to a boil
Add the fish slices. Submerge it in the thokku. Cover and cook it for 10 minutes
Transfer it to a bowl, garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot with dosa/idli, rice, chapati etc.

title: Boiled Egg Thokku
cooking_instructions: Heat Oil in a kadai, add mustard, cumin, green chilli and curry leaves. Let it crackle.
Add the sliced onions and saute till it turns golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute.
Add the spice powders and saute till it loses its raw flavour.
Add the tomatoes and let it cook till it is mashed and oil is released from the sides.
Season it with salt and sugar. Mix it well.
Add chopped coriander leaves. Mix it well. Keep it aside.
Heat oil in a kadai, add the prepared tomato thokku, and cook it for a minute
Add ¼ cup of water, mix it well. Bring it to a boil
Score the boiled eggs, add them to the thokku and toss it till it is coated with the thokku
Transfer it to a bowl, garnish it with chopped coriander. Serve it hot with rice, dosa/idlis etc

title: Chicken Thokku
cooking_instructions: Heat Oil in a kadai, add mustard, cumin, green chilli and curry leaves. Let it crackle.
Add the sliced onions and saute till it turns golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute.
Add the spice powders and saute till it loses its raw flavour.
Add the tomatoes and let it cook till it is mashed and oil is released from the sides.
Season it with salt and sugar. Mix it well.
Add chopped coriander leaves. Mix it well. Keep it aside.
Heat oil in a pan. Add ginger-garlic paste and saute for a few seconds.
Add the chicken, mix it and let it cook for 4-5 minutes.
Add water and the prepared tomato thokku, mix it well and let the chicken cook.
Add salt and garam masala, mix it well. Cover and cook it on a low flame for 10 minutes
Transfer it to a bowl, garnish with coriander leaves. Serve it hot.

title: Vaazhakai Thokku
cooking_instructions: Heat Oil in a kadai, add mustard, cumin, green chilli and curry leaves. Let it crackle.
Add the sliced onions and saute till it turns golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute.
Add the spice powders and saute till it loses its raw flavour.
Add the tomatoes and let it cook till it is mashed and oil is released from the sides.
Season it with salt and sugar. Mix it well.
Add chopped coriander leaves. Mix it well. Keep it aside.
Heat oil in a kadai, Add the chopped vaazhakai, and cook it till it looks a little fried and becomes soft.
Add the prepared thokku and water. Mix it well. Add salt and mix it well. Let it cook till it becomes a semi-dry mixture.
Transfer it to a bowl, garnish it with coriander serve it hot with dosa/idli, rice, chapati, etc.

title: Paneer Thokku
cooking_instructions: Heat Oil in a kadai, add mustard, cumin, green chili, and curry leaves. Let it crackle.
Add the sliced onions and saute till it turns golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute.
Add the spice powders and saute till it loses its raw flavor.
Add the tomatoes and let it cook till it is mashed and oil is released from the sides.
Season it with salt and sugar. Mix it well.
Add chopped coriander leaves. Mix it well. Keep it aside.
Heat oil in a kadai, add the paneer cubes, and cook it till it gets a golden brown colour on the sides. Take it off the pan.
In the same pan, add the prepared tomato thokku and add ¼ cup of water, mix well. Heat it up for a minute.
Add salt and garam masala and mix it well. Add the paneer and mix it till it is coated evenly with the thokku.
Cook the mixture till it is semi-dry.
Transfer it to a bowl. Garnish it with chopped coriander leaves. Serve it hot with dosa/idli, rice, chapati, etc.

title: Cheesy Garlic Bread Bites
cooking_instructions: For the garlic bread bites, heat butter in a pan, add the garlic, Italian seasoning and salt. Saute until lightly browned.
Add the bread and roast on a low flame until crispy and the bread is golden brown. Set aside in a bowl.
For the cheese sauce, melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat and add the turmeric powder, salt, and maida. Cook for a minute.
Add the milk and mix well, cook until slightly thickened.
Switch off the flame, add the cheese and combine well.
To assemble the dish, add the crispy garlic bites on a plate, top with capsicum slices, and finally pour over the cheese sauce and add more Italian seasoning!

title: Easy Honey Grilled Chicken
cooking_instructions: Combine all the ingredients for the marination.
Add the chicken and mix. Arrange them onto the skewers.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Place the skewers and cook for 10 minutes, turning them occasionally. Remove from the pan and set aside.
For the sauce, combine the ingredients together.
To plate it, use a piping bag for the sauce. Draw the shape of a heart on the plate.
Place the chicken skewer as an arrow through the heart.

title: One Pot Creamy Mushroom Pasta
cooking_instructions: Add oil and butter to a pan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic and mushroom. Saute for 5 minutes, or until the mushroom lightly browns.
Add water, mixed dried herbs, salt, pepper and red chilli flakes. Bring it to a boil.
Add the pasta, cover and cook on medium-low heat for 15-18  mins or until the pasta is cooked.
Once the pasta is cooked, add the fresh cream and cheese. Mix it and turn off the heat. Keep it covered until you serve.

title: Sinful Chocolate Sundae
cooking_instructions: Chop the chocolate and add it to the bowl
Heat the fresh cream and milk over low heat until slightly bubbling.
Add it to the bowl with the chopped chocolate. Cover and rest for 1 minute.
Open the lid and mix well until almost smooth.
Add it to two glasses. Keep it in the freezer for 30 minutes, or until slightly thickened.
Roughly chop the Oreos and keep it aside
Cut the strawberries and keep it aside
Add vanilla ice cream, leaving some space on the top of the glass. Lightly smoothen the top. Add the Oreos and Strawberries
Freeze until ready to serve.

title: Easy Honey Grilled Chicken
cooking_instructions: Combine all the ingredients for the marination.
Add the paneer and mix. Arrange them onto the skewers.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Place the skewers and cook for 10 minutes, turning them occasionally. Remove from the pan and set aside.
For the sauce, combine the ingredients together.
To plate it, use a piping bag for the sauce. Draw the shape of a heart on the plate.
Place the chicken skewer as an arrow through the heart.

title: Chicken 65
cooking_instructions: Clean and cut chicken into 1-inch cubes

In a bowl, add the chicken, lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, red chilli powder, garam masala, coriander powder, turmeric powder, cumin powder, cornflour, rice flour, egg, green chilli, curry leaves and salt. Mix this well and marinate the chicken in this mixture for 60 mins
Add oil in a deep frying pan, heat the oil and deep fry the marinated chicken in batches for 5-6 mins.
Serve hot with lemon slices and onion rings.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
cooking_instructions: Preheat the oven to 210C.
For the pie crust: place the flour and salt in a bowl. Add the salt. Add cold cubes of butter and crumble between fingers to resemble the texture of sand.
Add the liquid components, water, and egg. Combine to form a dough. Do not overwork the dough. Cover and rest for 30 mins in the fridge.
For the filling: heat oil in a pan, saute the onion and garlic until translucent. Add the diced chicken and saute lightly.
Add the diced potato and carrot, green peas and mushroom. Season with salt, pepper, and oregano.
Add the dry flour and mix well followed by the water and milk. Cook until thick.
Roll out the dough and cut into desired shapes. Line the top of the pan with the pie crust. Apply egg wash on the top.
Bake for 30 minutes at 210 C until golden brown.

title: Tomato Thokku
cooking_instructions: Heat Oil in a kadai, add mustard, cumin, green chilli and curry leaves. Let it crackle.
Add the sliced onions and saute till it turns golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste and saute for a minute.
Add the spice powders and saute till it loses its raw flavour.
Add the tomatoes and let it cook till it is mashed and oil is released from the sides.
Season it with salt and sugar. Mix it well.
Add chopped coriander leaves. Mix it well. Serve it hot along with rice or roti.

title: Grilled Chicken Salad
cooking_instructions: Marinate the chicken with oil, salt, pepper, and soya sauce. Allow it to rest for at least 10 minutes.
Prepare the dressing by combining the ingredients and set aside.
Heat a grill pan. Place the chicken breast and cook on high heat for 1 minute on each side and cook for 6 mins on a low flame.
Rest the chicken for 5-10 mins on a chopping board and cut into cubes.
For the salad, combine all the ingredients in a bowl, add a little dressing as needed.
Serve the salad in a bowl along with the chicken, and serve the remaining dressing on the side.

title: Rava Upma
cooking_instructions: Heat a kadai and dry roast the rava till it is not raw anymore.
Heat oil in a kadai, add mustard, curry leaves, green chillies, and let it crackle.
Add the onions and saute till it turns translucent.
Add water, add salt and bring it to a boil.
Add the roasted rava and keep mixing it continuously till it thickens and all the water evaporates and the mixture is dry and crumbly.
Transfer it to a bowl/plate, garnish it with coriander. Serve it hot.

title: Classic Cheeselings
cooking_instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a bowl and knead a smooth dough.
Roll out the dough into a thin layer and cut small squares.
Separate the squares individually.
Deep fry in medium hot oil until crispy and golden brown.
Drain and cool completely before serving.

title: Venad Paal Konju
cooking_instructions: Marinate the prawns with all the other ingredients. Set it aside for 10 minutes.
Add coconut oil and curry leaves to the coconut milk. Mix well and set aside.
In a flat pan, heat oil. Add all the prawns in a single layer. Add the green chilli, ginger and garlic.
Allow them to cook for 2 minutes, then flip them.
Drizzle coconut milk a little at a time. Add more once the coconut milk has already evaporated.
Sprinkle black pepper and toss. Remove it from the heat and serve with rice!

title: Street Style Paneer Tikka Sandwich
cooking_instructions: Add all the ingredients for the mint chutney (except mayonnaise) into the jar and grind into a smooth paste.
Add mayonnaise and mix briefly just to combine.
Mix the ingredients for the marination and add the paneer.
Heat a flat pan and slightly fry the paneer cubes.
On a slice of bread, spread mint mayonnaise and tomato ketchup.
Place the paneer cubes, and the diced onion and capsicum on the sides. Sprinkle chaat masala on it.
Spread grated cheese all over the sandwich. Sprinkle garam masala powder, chilli flakes and coriander leaves on top.
Bake it for 5 minutes in a preheated oven at 190°c, or until the cheese is melted.
Cut it into cubes. Serve with mint mayonnaise and tomato ketchup.

title: Cafe Style Paneer Tikka Sandwich
cooking_instructions: Add all the ingredients for the mint chutney (except mayonnaise) into the jar and grind into a smooth paste.
Add mayonnaise and mix briefly just to combine.
In a bowl, mix together mustard oil and red chilli powder. Add all the other ingredients and mix.
Heat oil in a pan, and add the marinated paneer. Stir occasionally and cook for 5 minutes or until the excess moisture has thickened.
Turn off the heat and allow it to cool slightly. Add the mayonnaise and ketchup, and mix. The filling is ready.
Spread butter on two slices of bread. Apply the mint mayonnaise to it.
Place a cheese slice followed by the filling, then tomato slices and finally another cheese slice.
Toast it on a pan or in a sandwich griller.
Serve with more of the mint mayonnaise and ketchup.

title: Cappuccino
cooking_instructions: Beat the sugar, water and coffee until thick and frothy for about 8 mins using a fork or milk frother.
Take about 20 ml of milk and using a milk frother, make the milk froth up.
Add the coffee froth in a glass and add 2 cups of hot milk. Gently mix and combine.
To decorate the coffee, add some milk froth, coffee froth, and dust with cocoa powder

title: Greek Chicken and Lemon Soup
cooking_instructions: Prepare Chicken stock by boiling the chicken in water. Add a teaspoon of thyme to it and let it absorb the flavour. Bring it to a boil and cook it for 10 minutes. Turn off the heat.
Take the chicken out and Cut/shred it. Keep the stock and chicken aside.
Beat eggs in a bowl. Slowly add the lemon juice while whisking the eggs. Add a cup of chicken stock to it while whisking it simultaneously.
Pour the mixture back into the chicken stock. Add the chicken to it. Simmer it for a few minutes.
Season it with salt and pepper. Add cream and mix it well.
Transfer it to a soup bowl, Garnish it with chopped parsley. Serve it hot.

title: Deep Fried Oreos
cooking_instructions: Combine the flour, sugar and baking powder. Add the milk and eggs, vanilla essence and whisk into a smooth and thick batter.
Heat oil for frying. Dip the Oreos in this batter and deep fry until golden colour.

title: Fried Egg
cooking_instructions: Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat and add the oil.
Add an egg and allow it to cook for 1-2 mins, flip the egg and cook further for 1-3 mins depending on how firm you want the egg yolk to be.
Serve by adding a pinch of salt and black pepper powder.

title: Dahi Aloo
cooking_instructions: Boil the potatoes till it is cooked. Strain it and keep it aside.
In a bowl whisk curd, dry mango powder, red chilli powder, besan flour, salt together till the mixture is smooth.
Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds, chopped ginger, curry leaves, dry red chillies and let it crackle
Add the curd mixture. Add water. Mix it well. Bring it to a soft boil. Add the potatoes and let it cook in the mixture for 5 minutes on a low flame
Transfer the dish to a bowl. Garnish it with coriander leaves. Serve it hot with rice.

title: Lazy Chicken Roast
cooking_instructions: Add the chicken to the pan. Add all the other ingredients and mix.
Place the pan on the stove, over medium heat. Cover and cook on medium heat for 10 minutes.
Open the lid and continue cooking for 10-15 more minutes.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve as a starter/with rice or chapathi.

title: Desi Pasta
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan and add all the ingredients except the water and cheese.
Add enough water to cover the pasta. Cover and cook for 10 minutes or until the pasta is cooked.
Open the lid, stir and cook for a minute. Add cheese, stir and serve!

title: Paneer Fried Rice
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a wok, add the paneer cubes, and saute till it gets some colour on its sides. Take it off the pan and keep it aside.
Heat oil in a wok, add ginger, garlic, shallots, and saute for a few seconds
Add the carrot and beans. Toss them on a high flame for a few seconds.
Add the cooked rice. Add salt, pepper, soya sauce, and MSG. Toss it till all ingredients combine evenly.
Add the paneer and Spring Onions. Toss and mix well.
Transfer it to a bowl. Garnish it with spring onions. Serve it hot.

title: Egg Florentine
cooking_instructions: Heat water in a pan, add a little salt to it and let it boil.
Add the shredded spinach to it, blanch it for a few seconds, strain it immediately.
Heat up another pan, add butter/oil and saute chopped garlic in it till it turns to a light brown color.
Add the blanched spinach and mix it well
Finally add cream, salt, and pepper. Mix it well and set it aside.
To poach the eggs, Heat water in a saucepan, add salt and 2 tsp vinegar, and let the water come to a rolling boil. Reduce the flame at this point.
Using a spoon or a whisk create a swirl in the water by stirring it well
Break an egg into a bowl and drop it right in the middle of the swirl and let the swirl slow down
Let the egg cook for 4 minutes on a medium to low flame
Use a perforated spoon to take out the egg and place it on a plate. Repeat the same process for the remaining eggs.
Toast the bread/ bun to a golden brown color on both sides and place it on a plate
Evenly spread the creamed spinach on each slice of bread
Finally, gently place the poached eggs on top of the creamed spinach
Sprinkle some crushed pepper and chopped parsley on top

title: Usili Paruppu
cooking_instructions: Soak the chana dal in water for one hour with dry red chillies. Strain it and Put it in a blender. Add salt and asafoetida and blend it to a coarse texture without adding water.

Take idli moulds, brush oil on them and arrange the blended dal in each section. Fill a vessel with water to a quarter, place the idli moulds in it. Cover and steam it for 10-15 minutes. Take it out and let it cool down
Heat oil in a pan, add mustard, cumin, curry leaves, dry red chillies, and let them crackle.
Add onions and cook it till it is translucent. Add ¼ tsp of asafoetida and mix it well.
Add turmeric powder and mix it well.
Add the chopped beans, saute it for a minute, add water and let it cook till the water is absorbed.
Crumble the steamed dal mixture and add it to the beans. Mix it evenly.
Add ghee, mix it well. Turn off the flame and transfer the mixture to a bowl.
Top it off with a spoon of ghee. Serve it hot.

title: Poached Egg
cooking_instructions: Bring a pot of water to a simmer. Season generously with salt and add vinegar. The water should just be beginning to boil.
Using a spatula, swirl around the water to get it gently swirling towards the center, like a whirlpool.
Add a cracked egg carefully into the water. Allow it to cook for 3 minutes.
Take it out of the water, and serve on toast. Sprinkle crushed black pepper/powder on top.

title: Souffle Omelette
cooking_instructions: Separate the egg yolks and whites. Whisk the yolks with black pepper and set aside.
In a separate bowl, whisk the egg whites with salt until they hold stiff peaks.
Gently fold the yolk mixture into the whites.
Grease a non stick pan with butter and heat it over a medium flame.
Pour the egg mixture, cover and cook for 3-4 mins.
Finish with chives/ spring onions and fold it in half.

title: Egg White Omelette
cooking_instructions: Whisk together the egg whites with salt, onion, green chilli and coriander leaves until well mixed and frothy.
Grease a nonstick pan with butter on medium-low heat and pour the egg mixture.
Cover and cook for about 4 mins.
Finish by cracking some black pepper on top and serving it with toasted bread slices

title: Crispy Cajun Potatoes
cooking_instructions: Pressure cook the potatoes for 2 whistles with a cup of water and a tsp of salt.
Strain and smash them with the skin-on. Coat them with cornstarch.
Deep fry for a minute. Strain out of the oil and rest for a minute.
Fry them again until crispy and golden brown.
Mix all the ingredients for the sauce in a bowl until well combined.
Pour over the fried potatoes and then garnish with chopped coriander leaves.

title: Masala Omelette
cooking_instructions: Mix the chopped onion, tomato, green chilli, and coriander with the red chilli powder, turmeric powder, and salt.
Add the eggs and whisk until well combined.
Heat a non-stick pan, greased with butter on a medium flame, and add the egg mixture.
Cover and cook the eggs for 2-3 mins.
Flip it and cook further for a minute. Serve It hot.

title: Scrambled Eggs
cooking_instructions: Beat/whisk the eggs until frothy with salt and pepper.
Heat a non-stick pan on low heat and melt the butter, pour the eggs and keep stirring until the eggs are almost set.
Switch off the flame and add the fresh cream. Mix well.
Garnish with chives/spring onion greens.

title: Cooker Chicken Curry
cooking_instructions: Using a mixie, pulse grind the cashew into a powder. Set aside.
In a pressure cooker, heat oil and add onion and curry leaves. Saute until the onion turns translucent.
Add tomato and ginger garlic paste. Saute for 2-3 minutes or until the tomato softens.
Add the chicken, turmeric powder and salt. Mix it, cover and cook with a lid for 7 minutes. And Add all the spice powders and mix.
Add the cashew powder. Add a splash of water if it gets dry. Saute for 2 minutes.
Add coriander leaves, mint leaves and water. Cover and pressure cook on medium-high heat for 3 whistles.
After the last whistle, turn off the flame and rest for 10 minutes. It is now ready to serve!

title: Wheat Rumali Roti
cooking_instructions: Knead a smooth and semi-firm dough using the flour, oil, salt and water.
Rest for 10 mins, covered .
Divide the dough into even sized roundels, in even numbers.
Roll out the dough into flat roundels of even size.
Apply oil on one and place another one on top of the first one. Ensure they are even on the edges.
Dust with flour as needed and roll into large thin roundels, as big and thin as possible.
Cook on a preheated tava on medium heat, until lightly coloured on both sides.
The two roundels will naturally separate, peel them and fold into individual rumali rotis.
Oil/ ghee can be applied if needed. Serve it hot

title: Sunny Leone Burger
cooking_instructions: Heat oil in a pan and saute the capsicum and green chilli for 2 minutes.
Add tomato and saute for a minute, until it starts to soften
Add schezwan sauce and processed cheese, and mix until the cheese melts.
Add paneer, onion and mozzarella and just mix until it is evenly combined. Turn off the heat.
Cut a bun in half, but don’t cut it all the way through. Fill the cheese stuffing inside each bun.
In a tawa, heat butter on low heat. Add the schezwan sauce, Kashmiri chilli powder, chaat masala and coriander leaves.
Add the buns to the pan and coat on all sides. Toast lightly until the colour becomes slightly darker.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped onions and coriander leaves.

title: Fish Balls
cooking_instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add turmeric powder, salt and ginger garlic paste. Mix and add the fish. Cover and cook for 5 minutes.
Take out the fish. Shred it into small pieces using your hands or using a fork. Remove the bones.
Heat oil in a pan. Add the garlic, ginger, green chilli and onion. Saute until it turns translucent. Add the red chilli flakes and black pepper powder.
Add the fish and turn off the heat, once it has cooled down slightly. Add breadcrumbs and eggs. Mix until evenly combined.
Add more salt Shape this mixture into balls.
In a bowl, mix together eggs and water for the coating. Keep breadcrumbs ready in another bowl. This is for the coating.
Coat the fish balls first in the egg mixture using a fork, then in the breadcrumbs. Coat evenly.
Deep-fry on high heat until it turns golden brown and crisp on the outside.
Serve with tomato ketchup or mayonnaise.

title: Katti Paruppu
cooking_instructions: In a pressure cooker, add the washed dal, tomato, turmeric powder, green chilli, garlic, and water. Pressure cook it for 4 whistles. Turn off the flame and let the pressure decrease gradually.
In a pan, heat oil, add mustard, dry chilli, ginger curry leaves and add the onions and saute till it turns translucent. Then add asafoetida. Let it crackle for a few seconds.
Add it to the dal mixture. Mix it well.
Add salt and mix well. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot with rice.

title: Schezwan Chicken Pops
cooking_instructions: Add all the ingredients for the chicken mixture into a mixer. Grind until almost smooth, it’s okay if there are a few chunks.
Grease your hands and plate with oil. Make small balls from the mixture. Freeze for 15 minutes.
For the coating, combine maida and cornflour together. Coat the chicken balls in the mixture evenly.
Deep-fry on medium heat for 5-6 minutes. Set aside.
In a pan, heat oil and add the schezwan sauce and mayonnaise. Add the fried chicken and toss.
Serve using toothpicks, and garnish with mayonnaise

title: Mini Pizza Sandwich
cooking_instructions: Cut the bread slices into a round shape using a bowl.
